H1.definition: אָב ʼâb, awb; a primitive word;  father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application:—chief, (fore-) father(-less), × patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.

H1000.definition: בֵּיצָה bêytsâh, bay-tsaw'; from the same as H948;  an egg (from its whiteness):—egg.

H1003.definition: בִּירָנִית bîyrânîyth, bee-raw-neeth'; from H1002;  a fortress:—castle.

H1004.partOfSpeech: proper patrial adjective, adverb, masculine noun
H1004.definition: בַּיִת bayith, bah'-yith; probably from H1129 abbreviated;  a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.):—court, daughter, door, + dungeon, family, + forth of, × great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, + prison, + steward, + tablet, temple, web, + within(-out).

H1005.definition: בַּיִת bayith, bah-yith; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1004:—house.

H1007.definition: בֵּית אָוֶן Bêyth ʼÂven, bayth aw'-ven; from H1004 and H205; house of vanity;  Beth-Aven, a place in Palestine:—Beth-aven.

H1008.definition: בֵּית־אֵל Bêyth-ʼÊl, bayth-ale'; from H1004 and H410; house of God;  Beth-El, a place in Palestine:—Beth-el.

H1009.definition: בֵּית אַרְבֵּאל Bêyth ʼArbêʼl, bayth ar-bale'; from H1004 and H695 and H410; house of God's ambush;  Beth-Arbel, a place in Palestine:—Beth-Arbel.

H1011.definition: בֵּית בִּרְאִי Bêyth Birʼîy, bayth bir-ee'; from H1004 and H1254; house of a creative one;  Beth-Biri, a place in Palestine:—Bethbirei.

H1014.definition: בֵּית גָּמוּל Bêyth Gâmûwl, bayth gaw-mool'; from H1004 and the passive participle of H1576; house of (the) weaned;  Beth-Gamul, a place East of the Jordan:—Beth-gamul.

H1016.definition: בֵּית־דָּגוֹן Bêyth-Dâgôwn, bayth-daw-gohn'; from H1004 and H1712; house of Dagon;  Beth-Dagon, the name of two places in Palestine:—Beth-dagon.

H1020.definition: בֵּית הַיְשִׁימוֹת Bêyth ha-Yshîy-môwth, bayth hah-yesh-eemoth'; from H1004 and the plural of H3451 with the article interposed; house of the deserts;  Beth-ha-Jeshimoth, a town East of the Jordan:—Beth-jeshimoth.

H1024.definition: בֵּית הַמַּרְכָּבוֹת Bêyth ham-Markâbôwth, bayth ham-markaw-both'; or (shortened) בֵּית מַרְכָּבוֹת Bêyth Mar-kâbôwth; from H1004 and the plural of H4818 (with or without the article interposed); place of (the) chariots;  Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth, a place in Palestine:—Bethmarcaboth.

H1026.definition: בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה Bêyth hâ-ʻĂrâbâh, bayth haw-ar-aw-baw; from H1004 and H6160 with the article interposed; house of the Desert;  Beth-ha-Arabah, a place in Palestine:—Beth-arabah.

H1027.definition: בֵּית הָרָם Bêyth hâ-Râm, bayth haw-rawm'; from H1004 and H7311 with the article interposed; house of the height;  Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan:—Beth-aram.

H103.definition: אָגַר ʼâgar, aw-gar'; a primitive root;  to harvest:—gather.

H1032.definition: בֵּית חוֹרוֹן Bêyth Chôwrôwn, bayth kho-rone'; from H1004 and H2356; house of hollowness;  Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine:—Beth-horon.

H1033.definition: בֵּית כַּר Bêyth Kar, bayth kar; from H1004 and H3733; house of pasture;  Beth-Car, a place in Palestine:—Beth-car.

H1035.definition: בֵּית לֶחֶם Bêyth Lechem, bayth leh'-khem; from H1004 and H3899; house of bread;  Beth-Lechem, a place in Palestine:—Bethlehem.

H1037.definition: בֵּית מִלּוֹא Bêyth Millôwʼ, bayth mil-lo'; or בֵּית מִלֹּא Bêyth Millôʼ; from H1004 and H4407; house of (the) rampart;  Beth-Millo, the name of two citadels:—house of Millo.

H104.definition: אִגְּרָא ʼiggᵉrâʼ, ig-er-aw'; (Aramaic) of Persian origin;  an epistle (as carried by a state courier or postman):—letter.

H1047.definition: בֵּית פְּעוֹר Bêyth Pᵉʻôwr, bayth pe-ore'; from H1004 and H6465; house of Peor;  Beth-Peor, a place East of the Jordan:—Bethpeor.

H1049.partOfSpeech: noun, proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1049.definition: בֵּית צוּר Bêyth Tsûwr, bayth tsoor'; from H1004 and H6697; house of (the) rock;  Beth-Tsur, a place in Palestine:—Beth-zur.

H1052.definition: בֵּית שְׁאָן Bêyth Shᵉʼân, bayth she-awn'; or בֵּית שָׁן Bêyth Shân; from H1004 and H7599; house of ease;  Beth-Shean or Beth-Shan, a place in Palestine:—Beth-shean, Beth-Shan.

H1053.definition: בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ Bêyth Shemesh, bayth sheh'-mesh; from H1004 and H8121; house of (the) sun;  Beth-Shemesh, a place in Palestine:—Beth-shemesh.

H1055.definition: בִּיתָן bîythân, bee-thawn'; probably from H1004;  a palace (i.e. large house):—palace.

H1056.definition: בָּכָא Bâkâʼ, baw-kaw'; from H1058, weeping;  Baca, a valley in Palestine:—Baca.

H1057.definition: בָּכָא bâkâʼ, baw-kaw'; the same as H1056;  the weeping tree (some gum-distilling tree, perhaps the balsam):—mulberry tree.

H1058.definition: בָּכָה bâkâh, baw-kaw'; a primitive root;  to weep; generally to bemoan:—× at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, × more, mourn, × sore, × with tears, weep.

H106.definition: אֶגְרֹף ʼegrôph, eg-rofe'; from H1640 (in the sense of grasping);  the clenched hand:—fist.

H1060.definition: בְּכוֹר bᵉkôwr, bek-ore'; from H1069;  first-born; hence, chief:—eldest (son), firstborn(-ling).

H1061.definition: בִּכּוּר bikkûwr, bik-koor'; from H1069;  the first-fruits of the crop:—first fruit (-ripe (figuratively)), hasty fruit.

H1063.definition: בִּכּוּרָה bikkûwrâh, bik-koo-raw'; feminine of H1061;  the early fig:—firstripe (fruit).

H1065.definition: בְּכִי Bᵉkîy, bek-ee'; from H1058;  a weeping; by analogy, a dripping:—overflowing, × sore, (continual) weeping, wept.

H1066.definition: בֹּכִים Bôkîym, bo-keem'; plural active participle of H1058; (with the article) the weepers;  Bo-kim, a place in Palestine:—Bochim.

H1069.definition: בָּכַר bâkar, baw-kar'; a primitive root; properly, to burst the womb, i.e. (causatively) bear or make early fruit (of woman or tree); also (as denominative from H1061)  to give the birthright:—make firstborn, be firstling, bring forth first child (new fruit).

H107.definition: אִגֶּרֶת ʼiggereth, ig-eh'-reth; feminine of H104;  an epistle:—letter.

H1072.definition: בִּכְרָה bikrâh, bik-raw'; feminine of H1070;  a young she-camel:—dromedary.

H1074.definition: בֹּכְרוּ Bôkᵉrûw, bo-ker-oo'; from H1069; first-born;  Bokeru, an Israelite:—Bocheru.

H1077.definition: בַּל bal, bal; from H1086;  properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest:—lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.

H1078.definition: בֵּל Bêl, bale; by contraction for H1168;  Bel, the Baal of the Babylonians:—Bel.

H1082.definition: בָּלַג bâlag, baw-lag'; a primitive root;  to break off or loose (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), i.e. desist (from grief) or invade (with destruction):—comfort, (recover) strength(-en).

H1083.definition: בִּלְגַה Bilgah, bil-gaw'; from H1082; desistance;  Bilgah, the name of two Israelites:—Bilgah.

H1084.definition: בִּלְגַּי Bilgay, bil-gah'ee; from H1082; desistant;  Bilgai, an Israelite:—Bilgai.

H1085.definition: בִּלְדַּד Bildad, bil-dad'; of uncertain derivation;  Bildad, one of Job's friends:—Bildad.

H1086.definition: בָּלָה bâlâh, baw-law'; a primitive root;  to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend):—consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste.

H1087.definition: בָּלֶה bâleh, baw-leh'; from H1086;  worn out:—old.

H109.definition: אָדַב ʼâdab, aw-dab'; a primitive root;  to languish:—grieve.

H1090.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper locative noun
H1090.definition: בִּלְהָה Bilhâh, bil-haw'; from H1089; timid;  Bilhah, the name of one of Jacob's concubines; also of a place in Palestine:—Bilhah.

H1091.definition: בַּלָּהָה ballâhâh, bal-law-haw'; from H1089;  alarm; hence, destruction:—terror, trouble.

H1092.definition: בִּלְהָן Bilhân, bil-hawn'; from H1089; timid;  Bilhan, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite:—Bilhan.

H1093.definition: בְּלוֹ bᵉlôw, bel-o'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H1086;  excise (on articles consumed):—tribute.

H1094.definition: בְּלוֹא bᵉlôwʼ, bel-o'; or (fully) בְּלוֹי bᵉlôwy; from H1086;  (only in plural construction) rags:—old.

H1095.definition: בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר Bêlṭᵉshaʼtstsar, bale-tesh-ats-tsar'; of foreign derivation;  Belteshatstsar, the Babylonian name of Daniel:—Belteshazzar.

H1096.definition: בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר Bêlṭᵉshaʼtstsar, bale-tesh-ats-tsar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1095:—Belteshazzar.

H1097.definition: בְּלִי bᵉlîy, bel-ee'; from H1086;  properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.:—corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no...is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.

H1098.definition: בְּלִיל bᵉlîyl, bel-eel'; from H1101;  mixed, i.e. (specifically) feed (for cattle):—corn, fodder, provender.

H11.definition: אֲבַדּוֹן ʼăbaddôwn, ab-ad-done'; intensive from H6;  abstract, a perishing; concrete, Hades:—destruction.

H110.definition: אַדְבְּאֵל ʼAdbᵉʼêl, ad-beh-ale'; probably from H109 (in the sense of chastisement) and H410; disciplined of God;  Adbeel, a son of Ishmael:—Adbeel.

H1100.definition: בְּלִיַּעַל bᵉlîyaʻal, bel-e-yah'-al; from H1097 and H3276;(often in connection with H376, H802, H1121, etc.)  without profit, worthlessness; by extension, destruction, wickedness:—Belial, evil, naughty, ungodly (men), wicked.

H1101.definition: בָּלַל bâlal, baw-lal'; a primitive root; (also denominatively from H1098) to fodder  to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; to fodder:—anoint, confound, × fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper.

H1103.definition: בָּלַס bâlaç, baw-las'; a primitive root;  to pinch sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them):—gatherer.

H1104.definition: בָּלַע bâlaʻ, baw-lah'; a primitive root;  to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy:—cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up).

H1106.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1106.definition: בֶּלַע Belaʻ, beh'-lah; the same as H1105;  Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites:—Bela.

H1107.definition: בִּלְעֲדֵי bilʻădêy, bil-ad-ay'; or בַּלְעֲדֵי balʻădêy; constructive plural from H1077 and H5703, not till, i.e. (as preposition or adverb)  except, without, besides:—beside, not (in), save, without.

H1109.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1109.definition: בִּלְעָם Bilʻâm, bil-awm'; probably from H1077 and H5971; not (of the) people, i.e. foreigner;  Bilam, a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine:—Balaam, Bileam.

H1111.definition: בָּלָק Bâlâq, baw-lawk'; from H1110; waster;  Balak, a Moabitish king:—Balak.

H1112.definition: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר Bêlshaʼtstsar, bale-shats-tsar'; or בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר Bêlʼshatstsarlemma בֵּלְאשַׁצּר missing vowel, corrected to בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר; of foreign origin (compare H1095);  Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king:—Belshazzar.

H1113.definition: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר Bêlshaʼtstsar, bale-shats-tsar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1112:—Belshazzar.

H1114.definition: בִּלְשָׁן Bilshân, bil-shawn'; of uncertain derivation;  Bilshan, an Israelite:—Bilshan.

H1115.definition: בִּלְתִּי biltîy, bil-tee'; constructive feminine of H1086 (equivalent to H1097);  properly, a failure of, i.e. (used only as a negative particle, usually with a prepositional prefix) not, except, without, unless, besides, because not, until, etc.:—because un(satiable), beside, but,   continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without.

H1116.definition: בָּמָה bâmâh, bam-maw'; from an unused root (meaning to be high);  an elevation:—height, high place, wave.

H1117.definition: בָּמָה Bâmâh, baw-maw'; the same as H1116;  Bamah, a place in Palestine:—Bamah. See also H1120.

H1118.definition: בִּמְהָל Bimhâl, bim-hawl'; probably from H4107 with prepositional prefix; with pruning;  Bimhal, an Israelite:—Bimhal.

H1119.definition: בְּמוֹ bᵉmôw, bem-o'; prolongation for prepositional prefix;  in, with, by, etc.:—for, in into, through.

H1121.definition: בֵּן bên, bane; from H1129;  a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.):—afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, (+) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, + (young) bullock, + (young) calf, × came up in, child, colt, × common, × corn, daughter, × of first,   firstborn, foal, + very fruitful, + postage, × in, + kid, + lamb, (+) man, meet, + mighty, + nephew, old, (+) people,   rebel, + robber, × servant born, × soldier, son, + spark,   steward, + stranger, × surely, them of, + tumultuous one,   valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.

H1124.definition: בְּנָא bᵉnâʼ, ben-aw'; (Aramaic) or בְּנָה bᵉnâh; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1129;  to build:—build, make.

H1125.definition: בֶּן־אֲבִינָדָב Ben-ʼĂbîynâdâb, ben-ab-ee''-naw-dawb'; from H1121 and H40; (the) son of Abinadab;  Ben-Abinadab, an Israelite:—the son of Abinadab.

H1127.definition: בֶּן־גֶּבֶר Ben-Geber, ben-gheh'-ber; from H1121 and H1397; son of (the) hero;  Ben-Geber, an Israelite:—the son of Geber.

H1128.definition: בֶּן־דֶּקֶר Ben-Deqer, ben-deh'-ker; from H1121 and a derivative of H1856; son of piercing (or of a lance);  Ben-Deker, an Israelite:—the son of Dekar.

H1129.definition: בָּנָה bânâh, baw-naw'; a primitive root;  to build (literally and figuratively):—(begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), × surely.

H113.definition: אָדוֹן ʼâdôwn, aw-done'; or (shortened) אָדֹן ʼâdôn; from an unused root (meaning to rule);  sovereign, i.e. controller (human or divine):—lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with 'Adoni-'.

H1130.definition: בֶּן־הֲדַד Ben-Hădad, ben-had-ad'; from H1121 and H1908; son of Hadad;  Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings:—Benhadad.

H1131.definition: בִּנּוּי Binnûwy, bin-noo'-ee; from H1129; built up;  Binnui, an Israelite:—Binnui.

H1133.definition: בֶּן־חוּר Ben-Chûwr, ben-khoor'; from H1121 and H2354; son of Chur;  Ben-Chur, an Israelite:—the son of Hur.

H1134.definition: בֶּן־חַיִל Ben-Chayil, ben-khah'-yil; from H1121 and H2428; son of might;  Ben-Chail, an Israelite:—Ben-hail.

H1136.definition: בֶּן־חֶסֶד Ben-Cheçed, ben-kheh'-sed; from H1121 and H2617; son of kindness;  Ben-Chesed, an Israelite:—the son of Hesed.

H1137.definition: בָּנִי Bânîy, baw-nee'; from H1129; built;  Bani, the name of five Israelites:—Bani.

H1138.definition: בֻּנִּי Bunnîy, boon-nee'; or (fuller) בּוּנִי Bûwnîy; from H1129; built;  Bunni or Buni, an Israelite:—Bunni.

H114.definition: אַדּוֹן ʼAddôwn, ad-done'; probably intensive for H113; powerful;  Addon, apparently an Israelite:—Addon.

H1141.definition: בְּנָיָה Bᵉnâyâh, ben-aw-yaw'; or בּנָיָהוּ Bnâyâhûw; (prolonged) from H1129 and H3050; Jah has built;  Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites:—Benaiah.

H1144.definition: בִּנְיָמִין Binyâmîyn, bin-yaw-mene'; from H1121 and H3225; son of (the) right hand;  Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory:—Benjamin.

H1146.definition: בִּנְיָן binyân, bin-yawn'; from H1129;  an edifice:—building.

H1147.definition: בִּנְיָן binyân, bin-yawn'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1146:—building.

H1148.definition: בְּנִינוּ Bᵉnîynûw, ben-ee-noo'; probably from H1121 with pron. suff.; our son;  Beninu, an Israelite:—Beninu.

H115.definition: אֲדוֹרַיִם ʼĂdôwrayim, ad-o-rah'-yim; dual from H142 (in the sense of eminence); double mound;  Adorajim, a place in Palestine:—Adoraim.

H1150.definition: בִּנְעָא Binʻâʼ, bin-aw'; or בִּנְעָה Binʻâh; of uncertain derivation;  Bina or Binah, an Israelite:—Binea, Bineah.

H1151.definition: בֶּן־עַמִּי Ben-ʻAmmîy, ben-am-mee'; from H1121 and H5971 with pronomial suffix; son of my people;  Ben-Ammi, a son of Lot:—Ben-ammi.

H1155.definition: בֹּסֶר bôçer, bo'ser; from the same as H1154:—sour grape.

H1156.definition: בְּעָא bᵉʻâʼ, beh-aw'; (Aramaic) or בְּעָה bᵉʻâh; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1158;  to seek or ask:—ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek.

H1157.definition: בְּעַד bᵉʻad, beh-ad'; from H5704 with prepositional prefix;  in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.:—about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within.

H1158.definition: בָּעָה bâʻâh, baw-aw'; a primitive root;  to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask:—cause, inquire, seek up, swell out.

H116.definition: אֱדַיִן ʼĕdayin, ed-ah'-yin; (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation;  then (of time):—now, that time, then.

H1162.definition: בֹּעַז Bôʻaz, bo'-az; from an unused root of uncertain meaning;  Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple:—Boaz.

H1166.definition: בָּעַל bâʻal, baw-al'; a primitive root; also as denominative from H1167  to be master; hence, to marry:—have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, × wife).

H1167.definition: בַּעַל baʻal, bah'-al; from H1166;  a master; hence, a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense):—  archer,   babbler,   bird, captain, chief man,   confederate,   have to do,   dreamer, those to whom it is due,   furious, those that are given to it, great,   hairy, he that hath it, have,   horseman, husband, lord, man,   married, master, person,   sworn, they of.

H1168.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1168.definition: בַּעַל Baʻal, bah'-al; the same as H1167;  Baal, a Phoenician deity:—Baal, (plural) Baalim.

H117.definition: אַדִּיר ʼaddîyr, ad-deer'; from H142;  wide or (generally) large; figuratively, powerful:—excellent, famous, gallant, glorious, goodly, lordly, mighty(-ier one), noble, principal, worthy.

H1170.definition: בַּעַל בְּרִית Baʻal Bᵉrîyth, bah'-al ber-eeth'; from H1168 and H1285; Baal of (the) covenant;  Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites:—Baal-berith.

H1173.definition: בַּעֲלָה Baʻălâh, bah-al-aw'; the same as H1172;  Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine:—Baalah.

H1177.definition: בַּעַל חָנָן Baʻal Chânân, bah'-al khaw-nawn'; from H1167 and H2603; possessor of grace;  Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite:—Baal-hanan.

H1179.definition: בַּעַל חֶרְמוֹן Baʻal Chermôwn, bah'-al kher-mone'; from H1167 and H2768; possessor of Hermon;  Baal-Chermon, a place in Palestine:—Baal-hermon.

H118.definition: אֲדַלְיָא ʼĂdalyâʼ, ad-al-yaw'; of Persian derivation;  Adalja, a son of Haman:—Adalia.

H1181.definition: בַּעֲלֵי בָּמוֹת Baʻălêy Bâmôwth, bah-al-ay' baw-moth'; from the plural of H1168 and the plural of H1116; Baals of (the) heights;  Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan:—lords of the high places.

H1182.definition: בְּעֶלְיָדָע Bᵉʻelyâdâʻ, beh-el-yaw-daw'; from H1168 and H3045; Baal has known;  Beeljada, an Israelite:—Beeliada.

H1183.definition: בְּעַלְיָה Bᵉʻalyâh, beh-al-yaw'; from H1167 and H3050; Jah (is) master;  Bealjah, an Israelite:—Bealiah.

H1186.definition: בַּעַל מְעוֹן Baʻal Mᵉʻôwn, bah-al meh-one'; from H1168 and H4583; Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare H1010);  Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan:—Baal-meon.

H1187.definition: בַּעַל פְּעוֹר Baʻal Pᵉʻôwr, bah'-al peh-ore'; from H1168 and H6465; Baal of Peor;  Baal-Peor, a Moabitish deity:—Baal-peor.

H1188.definition: בַּעַל פְּרָצִים Baʻal Pᵉrâtsîym, bah'-al per-aw-tseem'; from H1167 and the plural of H6556; possessor of breaches;  Baal-Peratsim, a place in Palestine:—Baal-perazim.

H1189.definition: בַּעַל צְפוֹן Baʻal Tsᵉphôwn, bah'-al tsef-one'; from H1168 and H6828 (in the sense of cold) (according to others an Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter;  Baal-Tsephon, a place in Eqypt:—Baal-zephon.

H119.definition: אָדַם ʼâdam, aw-dam'; to show blood (in the face), i.e. flush or turn rosy:—be (dyed, made) red (ruddy).

H1195.definition: בַּעֲנָא Baʻănâʼ, bah-an-aw'; the same as H1196;  Baana, the name of four Israelite:—Baana, Baanah.

H1196.definition: בַּעֲנָה Baʻănâh, bah-an-aw'; from a derivative of H6031 with prepositional prefix; in affliction  Baanah, the name of four Israelites:—Baanah.

H1197.definition: בָּעַר bâʻar, baw-ar'; a primitive root; also as denominative from H1198  to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating); to be (-come) brutish:—be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set (on fire), waste.

H1198.definition: בַּעַר baʻar, bah'-ar; from H1197;  properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid:—brutish (person), foolish.

H120.definition: אָדַם ʼâdam, aw-dam'; from H119;  ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.):—× another,   hypocrite,   common sort, × low, man (mean, of low degree), person.

H1201.definition: בַּעְשָׁא Baʻshâʼ, bah-shaw'; from an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness;  Basha, a king of Israel:—Baasha.

H1204.definition: בָּעַת bâʻath, baw-ath'; a primitive root;  to fear:—affright, be (make) afraid, terrify, trouble.

H1205.definition: בְּעָתָה bᵉʻâthâh, beh-aw-thaw'; from H1204;  fear:—trouble.

H1209.definition: בֵּצַי Bêtsay, bay-tsah'-ee; perhaps the same as H1153;  Betsai, the name of two Israelites:—Bezai.

H121.definition: אָדָם ʼÂdâm, aw-dawm'; the same as H120;  Adam the name of the first man, also of a place in Palestine:—Adam.

H1212.definition: בְּצַלְאֵל Bᵉtsalʼêl, bets-al-ale'; probably from H6738 and H410 with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God;  Betsalel, the name of two Israelites:—Bezaleel.

H1214.definition: בָּצַע bâtsaʻ, baw-tsah'; a primitive root  to break off, i.e. (usually) plunder; figuratively, to finish, or (intransitively) stop:—(be) covet(-ous), cut (off), finish, fulfill, gain (greedily), get, be given to (covetousness), greedy, perform, be wounded.

H1215.definition: בֶּצַע betsaʻ, beh'-tsah; from H1214;  plunder; by extension, gain (usually unjust):—covetousness, (dishonest) gain, lucre, profit.

H1216.definition: בָּצֵק bâtsêq, baw-tsake'; a primitive root;  perhaps to swell up, i.e. blister:—swell.

H1217.definition: בָּצֵק bâtsêq, baw-tsake'; from H1216;  dough (as swelling by fermentation):—dough, flour.

H1219.definition: בָּצַר bâtsar, baw-tsar'; a primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from H1210)  to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification):—cut off, (de-) fenced, fortify, (grape) gather(-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold.

H122.definition: אָדֹם ʼâdôm, aw-dome'; from H119;  rosy:—red, ruddy.

H1220.definition: בֶּצֶר betser, beh'-tser; from H1219;  strictly a clipping, i.e. gold (as dug out):—gold defence.

H1221.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1221.definition: בֶּצֶר Betser, beh'-tser; the same as H1220, an inaccessible spot;  Betser, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite:—Bezer.

H1224.definition: בׇּצְרָה Botsrâh, bots-raw'; the same as H1223;  Botsrah, a place in Edom:—Bozrah.

H1229.definition: בַּקְבֻּקְיָה Baqbuqyâh, bak-book-yaw'; from H1228 and H3050; emptying (i.e. wasting) of Jah;  Bakbukjah, an Israelite:—Bakbukiah.

H123.definition: אֱדֹם ʼĔdôm, ed-ome'; or (fully) אֱדוֹם ʼĔdôwm ; from H122; red (see Genesis 25:25);  Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occupied by him:—Edom, Edomites, Idumea.

H1231.definition: בֻּקִּי Buqqîy, book-kee'; from H1238; wasteful;  Bukki, the name of two Israelites:—Bukki.

H1232.definition: בֻּקִּיָּה Buqqîyâh, book-kee-yaw'; from H1238 and H3050; wasting of Jah;  Bukkijah, an Israelite:—Bukkiah.

H1234.definition: בָּקַע bâqaʻ, baw-kah'; a primitive root;  to cleave; generally, to rend, break, rip or open:—make a breach, break forth (into, out, in pieces, through, up), be ready to burst, cleave (asunder), cut out, divide, hatch, rend (asunder), rip up, tear, win.

H1237.definition: בִּקְעָה biqʻâh, bik-aw'; from H1234;  properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains:—plain, valley.

H1238.definition: בָּקַק bâqaq, baw-kah'; a primitive root;  to pour out, i.e. to empty, figuratively, to depopulate; by analogy, to spread out (as a fruitful vine):—(make) empty (out), fail, × utterly, make void.

H1241.definition: בָּקָר bâqâr, baw-kawr'; from H1239;  a beeve or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd:—beeve, bull (+ -ock), + calf, + cow, great (cattle), + heifer, herd, kine, ox.

H1242.definition: בֹּקֶר bôqer, bo'-ker; from H1239; properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning:—(+) day, early, morning, morrow.

H1245.definition: בָּקַשׁ bâqash, baw-kash'; a primitive root;  to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after:—ask, beg, beseech, desire, enquire, get, make inquisition, procure, (make) request, require, seek (for).

H1246.definition: בַּקָּשָׁה baqqâshâh, bak-kaw-shaw'; from H1245;  a petition:—request.

H125.definition: אֲדַמְדָּם ʼădamdâm, ad-am-dawm'; reduplicated from H119;  reddish:—(somewhat) reddish.

H1250.definition: בָּר bâr, bawr; or בַּר bar; from H1305 (in the sense of winnowing);  grain of any kind (even while standing in the field); by extension the open country:—corn, wheat.

H1254.definition: בָּרָא bârâʼ, baw-raw'; a primitive root;  (absolutely) to create; (qualified) to cut down (a wood), select, feed (as formative processes):—choose, create (creator), cut down, dispatch, do, make (fat).

H1256.definition: בְּרָאיָה Bᵉrâʼyâh, ber-aw-yaw'; from H1254 and H8050; Jah has created;  Berajah, an Israelite:—Beraiah.

H1257.definition: בַּרְבֻּר barbur, bar-boor'; by reduplication from H1250;  a fowl (as fattened on grain):—fowl.

H1259.definition: בָּרָד bârâd, baw-rawd'; from H1258;  hail:—hail(stones).

H126.definition: אַדְמָה ʼAdmâh, ad-maw'; contracted for H127; earthy;  Admah, a place near the Dead Sea:—Admah.

H1261.definition: בָּרֹד bârôd, baw-rode'; from H1258;  spotted (as if with hail):—grisled.

H1262.definition: בָּרָה bârâh, baw-raw'; a primitive root; to select; also (as denominative from H1250) to feed; also (as equivalent to H1305) to render clear (Ecclesiastes 3:18)  to select; to feed; to render clear:—choose, (cause to) eat, manifest, (give) meat.

H1263.definition: בָּרוּךְ Bârûwk, baw-rook'; passive participle from H1288; blessed;  Baruk, the name of three Israelites:—Baruch.

H1265.definition: בְּרוֹשׁ bᵉrôwsh, ber-osh'; of uncertain derivation;  a cypress (?) tree; hence, a lance or a musical instrument (as made of that wood):—fir (tree).

H1268.definition: בֵּרוֹתָה Bêrôwthâh, bay-ro-thaw'; or בֵּרֹתַי Bêrôthay; probably from H1266; cypress or cypresslike;  Berothah or Berothai, a place north of Palestine:—Berothah, Berothai.

H127.definition: אֲדָמָה ʼădâmâh, ad-aw-maw'; from H119;  soil (from its general redness):—country, earth, ground, husband(-man) (-ry), land.

H1270.definition: בַּרְזֶל barzel, bar-zel'; perhaps from the root of H1269;  iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement:—(ax) head, iron.

H1271.definition: בַּרְזִלַּי Barzillay, bar-zil-lah'-ee; from H1270; iron-hearted;  Barzillai, the name of three Israelites:—Barzillai.

H1272.definition: בָּרַח bârach, baw-rakh'; a primitive root;  to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly:—chase (away); drive away, fain, flee (away), put to flight, make haste, reach, run away, shoot.

H1275.definition: בֵּרִי Bêrîy, bay-ree'; probably by contraction from H882;  Beri, an Israelite:—Beri.

H1277.definition: בָּרִיא bârîyʼ, baw-ree'; from H1254 (in the sense of H1262);  fatted or plump:—fat ((fleshed), -ter), fed, firm, plenteous, rank.

H1278.definition: בְּרִיאָה bᵉrîyʼâh, ber-ee-aw'; feminine from H1254;  a creation, i.e. a novelty:—new thing.

H1279.definition: בִּרְיָה biryâh, beer-yaw'; feminine from H1262;  food:—meat.

H1280.definition: בְּרִיחַ bᵉrîyach, ber-ee'-akh; from H1272;  a bolt:—bar, fugitive.

H1282.definition: בָּרִיחַ Bârîyach, baw-ree'-akh; the same as H1281;  Bariach, an Israelite:—Bariah.

H1283.definition: בְּרִיעָה Bᵉrîyʻâh, ber-ee'-aw; apparently from the feminine of H7451 with a prepositional prefix; in trouble;  Beriah, the name of four Israelites:—Beriah.

H1285.definition: בְּרִית bᵉrîyth, ber-eeth'; from H1262 (in the sense of cutting [like H1254]);  a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh):—confederacy, (con-) feder(-ate), covenant, league.

H1287.definition: בֹּרִית bôrîyth, bo-reeth'; feminine of H1253;  vegetable alkali:—sope.

H1288.definition: בָּרַךְ bârak, baw-rak'; a primitive root;  to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason):—× abundantly, × altogether, × at all, blaspheme, bless, congratulate, curse, × greatly, × indeed, kneel (down), praise, salute, × still, thank.

H1289.definition: בְּרַךְ bᵉrak, ber-ak'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1288:—bless, kneel.

H1290.definition: בֶּרֶךְ berek, beh'-rek; from H1288;  a knee:—knee.

H1293.definition: בְּרָכָה Bᵉrâkâh, ber-aw-kaw'; from H1288;  benediction; by implication prosperity:—blessing, liberal, pool, present.

H1295.definition: בְּרֵכָה bᵉrêkâh, ber-ay-kaw'; from H1288;  a reservoir (at which camels kneel as a resting-place):—(fish-) pool.

H1296.definition: בֶּרֶכְיָה Berekyâh, beh-rek-yaw'; or בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ Berekyâhûw; from H1290 and H3050; knee (i.e. blessing) of Jah;  Berekjah, the name of six Israelites:—Berachiah, Berechiah.

H1297.definition: בְּרַם bᵉram, ber-am'; (Aramaic) perhaps from H7313 with a prepositional prefix;  properly, highly, i.e. surely; but used adversatively, however:—but, nevertheless, yet.

H1298.definition: בֶּרַע Beraʻ, beh'-rah; of uncertain derivation;  Bera, a Sodomitish king:—Bera.

H1299.definition: בָּרַק bâraq, baw-rak'; a primitive root;  to lighten (lightning):—cast forth.

H130.definition: אֱדֹמִי ʼĔdômîy, ed-o-mee'; or (fully) אֱדוֹמִי ʼĔdôwmîy ; patronymic from H123; See H726.  an Edomite, or descendants from (or inhabitants of) Edom:—Edomite.

H1300.definition: בָּרָק bârâq, baw-rawk'; from H1299;  lightning; by analogy, a gleam; concretely, a flashing sword:—bright, glitter(-ing sword), lightning.

H1301.definition: בָּרָק Bârâq, baw-rawk'; the same as H1300;  Barak, an Israelite:—Barak.

H1305.definition: בָּרַר bârar, baw-rar'; a primitive root;  to clarify (i.e. brighten), examine, select:—make bright, choice, chosen, cleanse (be clean), clearly, polished, (shew self) pure(-ify), purge (out).

H1308.definition: בְּשׂוֹר Bᵉsôwr, bes-ore'; from H1319; cheerful;  Besor, a stream of Palestine:—Besor.

H1309.definition: בְּשׂוֹרָה bᵉsôwrâh, bes-o-raw'; or (shortened) בְּשֹׂרָה bᵉsôrâh; feminine from H1319;  glad tidings; by implication, reward for good news:—reward for tidings.

H1310.definition: בָּשַׁל bâshal, baw-shal'; a primitive root;  properly, to boil up; hence, to be done in cooking; figuratively to ripen:—bake, boil, bring forth, roast, seethe, sod (be sodden).

H1312.definition: בִּשְׁלָם Bishlâm, bish-lawm'; of foreign derivation;  Bishlam, a Persian:—Bishlam.

H1314.definition: בֶּשֶׂם besem, beh'-sem; or בֹּשֶׂם bôsem; from the same as H1313;  fragrance; by implication, spicery; also the balsam plant:—smell, spice, sweet (odour).

H1315.definition: בׇּשְׂמַת Bosmath, bos-math'; feminine of H1314 (the second form); fragrance;  Bosmath, the name of a wife of Esau, and of a daughter of Solomon:—Bashemath, Basmath.

H1316.definition: בָּשָׁן Bâshân, baw-shawn'; of uncertain derivation;  Bashan (often with the article), a region East of the Jordan:—Bashan.

H1317.definition: בׇּשְׁנָה boshnâh, bosh-naw'; feminine from H954;  shamefulness:—shame.

H1319.definition: בָּשַׂר bâsar, baw-sar'; a primitive root;  properly, to be fresh, i.e. full (rosy, figuratively cheerful); to announce (glad news):—messenger, preach, publish, shew forth, (bear, bring, carry, preach, good, tell good) tidings.

H132.definition: אַדְמֹנִי ʼadmônîy, ad-mo-nee'; or (fully) אַדְמוֹנִי ʼadmôwnîy ; from H119;  reddish (of the hair or the complexion):—red, ruddy.

H1320.definition: בָּשָׂר bâsâr, baw-sawr'; from H1319;  flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of a man:—body, (fat, lean) flesh(-ed), kin, (man-) kind,   nakedness, self, skin.

H1321.definition: בְּשַׁר bᵉshar, bes-ar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1320:—flesh.

H1322.definition: בֹּשֶׁת bôsheth, bo'-sheth; from H954;  shame (the feeling and the condition, as well as its cause); by implication (specifically) an idol:—ashamed, confusion,   greatly, (put to) shame(-ful thing).

H1323.definition: בַּת bath, bath; from H1129 (as feminine of H1121);  a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively):—apple (of the eye), branch, company, daughter, × first, × old,   owl, town, village.

H1324.definition: בַּת bath, bath; probably from the same as H1327;  a bath or Hebrew measure (as a means of division) of liquids:—bath.

H1325.definition: בַּת bath, bath; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1324:—bath.

H1328.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1328.definition: בְּתוּאֵל Bᵉthûwʼêl, beth-oo-ale'; apparently from the same as H1326 and H410; destroyed of God;  Bethuel, the name of a nephew of Abraham, and of a place in Palestine:—Bethuel. Compare 1329.

H133.definition: אַדְמָתָא ʼAdmâthâʼ, ad-maw-thaw'; probably of Persian derivation;  Admatha, a Persian nobleman:—Admatha.

H1330.definition: בְּתוּלָה bᵉthûwlâh, beth-oo-law'; feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to separate;  a virgin (from her privacy); sometimes (by continuation) a bride; also (figuratively) a city or state:—maid, virgin.

H1331.definition: בְּתוּלִים bᵉthûwlîym, beth-oo-leem'; masculine plural of the same as H1330;  (collectively and abstractly) virginity; by implication and concretely, the tokens of it:—× maid, virginity.

H1335.definition: בֶּתֶר bether, beh'-ther; from H1334;  a section:—part, piece.

H1338.definition: בִּתְרוֹן Bithrôwn, bith-rone'; from H1334; (with the article) the craggy spot;  Bithron, a place East of the Jordan:—Bithron.

H1339.definition: בַּת־שֶׁבַע Bath-Shebaʻ, bath-sheh'-bah; from H1323 and H7651 (in the sense of H7650); daughter of an oath;  Bath-Sheba, the mother of Solomon:—Bath-sheba.

H1341.definition: גֵּא gêʼ, gay'; for H1343;  haughty:—proud.

H1342.definition: גָּאָה gâʼâh, gaw-aw'; a primitive root;  to mount up; hence, in general, to rise, (figuratively) be majestic:—gloriously, grow up, increase, be risen, triumph.

H1343.definition: גֵּאֶה gêʼeh, gay-eh'; from H1342;  lofty; figuratively, arrogant:—proud.

H1344.definition: גֵּאָה gêʼâh, gay-aw'; feminine from H1342;  arrogance:—pride.

H1345.definition: גְּאוּאֵל Gᵉʼûwʼêl, gheh-oo-ale'; from H1342 and H410; majesty of God;  Geuel, an Israelite:—Geuel.

H1346.definition: גַּאֲוָה gaʼăvâh, gah-av-aw'; from H1342;  arrogance or majesty; by implication, (concretely) ornament:—excellency, haughtiness, highness, pride, proudly, swelling.

H1347.definition: גָּאוֹן gâʼôwn, gaw-ohn'; from H1342;  the same as H1346:—arrogancy, excellency(-lent), majesty, pomp, pride, proud, swelling.

H135.definition: אַדָּן ʼAddân, ad-dawn'; intensive from the same as H134; firm;  Addan, an Israelite:—Addan.

H1350.definition: גָּאַל gâʼal, gaw-al'; a primitive root,  to redeem (according to the Oriental law of kinship), i.e. to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property, marry his widow, etc.):—× in any wise, × at all, avenger, deliver, (do, perform the part of near, next) kinsfolk(-man), purchase, ransom, redeem(-er), revenger.

H1351.definition: גָּאַל gâʼal, gaw-al'; a primitive root, (rather identified with H1350, through the idea of freeing, i.e. repudiating);  to soil or (figuratively) desecrate:—defile, pollute, stain.

H1353.definition: גְּאֻלָּה gᵉʼullâh, gheh-ool-law'; feminine passive participle of H1350;  redemption (including the right and the object); by implication, relationship:—kindred, redeem, redemption, right.

H1356.definition: גֵּב gêb, gabe; from H1461;  a log (as cut out); also well or cistern (as dug):—beam, ditch, pit.

H1358.definition: גֹּב gôb, gobe; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H1461;  a pit (for wild animals) (as cut out):—den.

H136.definition: אֲדֹנָי ʼĂdônây, ad-o-noy'; an emphatic form of H113;  the Lord (used as a proper name of God only):—(my) Lord.

H1361.definition: גָּבַהּ gâbahh, gaw-bah'; a primitive root;  to soar, i.e. be lofty; figuratively, to be haughty:—exalt, be haughty, be (make) high(-er), lift up, mount up, be proud, raise up great height, upward.

H1363.definition: גֹּבַהּ gôbahh, go'-bah; from H1361;  elation, grandeur, arrogance:—excellency, haughty, height, high, loftiness, pride.

H1364.definition: גָּבֹהַּ gâbôahh, gaw-bo'-ah; or גָּבוֹהַּ gâbôwahh; (fully) from H1361;  elevated (or elated), powerful, arrogant:—haughty, height, high(-er), lofty, proud, × exceeding proudly.

H1366.definition: גְּבוּל gᵉbûwl, gheb-ool'; or גְּבֻל gᵉbul; (shortened) from H1379;  properly, a cord (as twisted), i.e. (by implication) a boundary; by extension the territory inclosed:—border, bound, coast, × great, landmark, limit, quarter, space.

H1368.definition: גִּבּוֹר gibbôwr, ghib-bore'; or גִּבֹּר gibbôr; (shortened) intensive from the same as H1397;  powerful; by implication, warrior, tyrant:—champion, chief, × excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man.

H1369.definition: גְּבוּרָה gᵉbûwrâh, gheb-oo-raw'; feminine passive participle from the same as H1368;  force (literally or figuratively); by implication, valor, victory:—force, mastery, might, mighty (act, power), power, strength.

H137.definition: אֲדֹנִי־בֶזֶק ʼĂdônîy-Bezeq, ad-o''-nee-beh'-zek; from H113 and H966; lord of Bezek;  Adoni-Bezek; a Canaanitish king:—Adonibezek.

H1372.definition: גַּבַּחַת gabbachath, gab-bakh'-ath; from the same as H1371;  baldness in the forehead; by analogy, a bare spot on the right side of cloth:—bald forehead, × without.

H1375.definition: גְּבִיעַ gᵉbîyaʻ, gheb-ee'-ah; from an unused root (meaning to be convex);  a goblet; by analogy, the calyx of a flower:—house, cup, pot.

H1376.definition: גְּבִיר gᵉbîyr, gheb-eer'; from H1396;  a master:—lord.

H1377.definition: גְּבִירָה gᵉbîyrâh, gheb-ee-raw'; feminine of H1376;  a mistress:—queen.

H1379.definition: גָּבַל gâbal, gaw-bal'; a primitive root; also as a denominative from H1366  properly, to twist as a rope; to bound (as by a line):—be border, set (bounds about).

H138.definition: אֲדֹנִיָּה ʼĂdônîyâh, ad-o-nee-yaw'; original (prolonged) אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ ʼĂdônîyâhûw ; from H113 and H3050; lord (i.e. worshipper) of Jah;  Adonijah, the name of three Israelites:—Adonijah.

H1381.definition: גְּבָל Gᵉbâl, gheb-awl'; the same as H1380;  Gebal, a region in Idumaea:—Gebal.

H1387.definition: גֶּבַע Gebaʻ, gheh'-bah; from the same as H1375, a hillock;  Geba, a place in Palestine:—Gaba, Geba, Gibeah.

H1389.definition: גִּבְעָה gibʻâh, ghib-aw'; feminine from the same as H1387;  a hillock:—hill, little hill.

H1390.definition: גִּבְעָה Gibʻâh, ghib-aw'; the same as H1389;  Gibah; the name of three places in Palestine:—Gibeah, the hill.

H1391.definition: גִּבְעוֹן Gibʻôwn, ghib-ohn'; from the same as H1387; hilly;  Gibon, a place in Palestine:—Gibeon.

H1396.definition: גָּבַר gâbar, gaw-bar'; a primitive root;  to be strong; by implication, to prevail, act insolently:—exceed, confirm, be great, be mighty, prevail, put to more (strength), strengthen, be stronger, be valiant.

H1397.definition: גֶּבֶר geber, gheh'-ber; from H1396;  properly, a valiant man or warrior; generally, a person simply:—every one, man, × mighty.

H1398.definition: גֶּבֶר Geber, gheh'-ber; the same as H1397;  Geber, the name of two Israelites:—Geber.

H1399.definition: גְּבַר gᵉbar, gheb-ar'; from H1396; the same as H1397;  a person:—man.

H14.definition: אָבָה ʼâbâh, aw-baw'; a primitive root;  to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent:—consent, rest content will, be willing.

H1400.definition: גְּבַר gᵉbar, gheb-ar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1399:—certain, man.

H1401.definition: גִּבָּר gibbâr, ghib-bawr'; (Aramaic) intensive of H1400;  valiant, or warrior:—mighty.

H1403.definition: גַּבְרִיאֵל Gabrîyʼêl, gab-ree-ale'; from H1397 and H410; man of God;  Gabriel, an archangel:—Garbriel.

H1405.definition: גִּבְּתוֹן Gibbᵉthôwn, ghib-beth-one'; intensive from H1389; a hilly spot;  Gibbethon, a place in Palestine:—Gibbethon.

H1406.definition: גָּג gâg, gawg; probably by reduplication from H1342;  a roof; by analogy, the top of an altar:—roof (of the house), (house) top (of the house).

H1410.definition: גָּד Gâd, gawd; from H1464;  Gad, a son of Jacob, including his tribe and its territory; also a prophet:—Gad.

H1413.definition: גָּדַד gâdad, gaw-dad'; a primitive root (compare H1464);  to crowd; also to gash (as if by pressing into):—assemble (selves by troops), gather (selves together, self in troops), cut selves.

H1414.definition: גְּדַד gᵉdad, ghed-ad'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1413;  to cut down:—hew down.

H1416.definition: גְּדוּד gᵉdûwd, ghed-ood'; from H1413;  a crowd (especially of soldiers):—army, band (of men), company, troop (of robbers).

H1419.definition: גָּדוֹל gâdôwl, gaw-dole'; or גָּדֹל gâdôl; (shortened) from H1431;  great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent:—  aloud, elder(-est),   exceeding(-ly),   far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, × sore, (×) very.

H1420.definition: גְּדוּלָה gᵉdûwlâh, ghed-oo-law'; or גְּדֻלָּה gᵉdullâh; (shortened) or (less accurately) גְּדוּלָּה gᵉdûwllâh; feminine of H1419;  greatness; (concretely) mighty acts:—dignity, great things(-ness), majesty.

H1423.definition: גְּדִי gᵉdîy, ghed-ee'; from the same as H1415;  a young goat (from browsing):—kid.

H1426.definition: גַּדִּי Gaddîy, gad-dee'; intensive for H1424;  Gaddi, an Israelite:—Gaddi.

H1427.definition: גַּדִּיאֵל Gaddîyʼêl, gad-dee-ale'; from H1409 and H410; fortune of God;  Gaddiel, an Israelite:—Gaddiel.

H1429.definition: גְּדִיָּה gᵉdîyâh, ghed-ee-yaw'; feminine of H1423;  a young female goat:—kid.

H143.definition: אֲדָר ʼĂdâr, ad-awr'; probably of foreign derivation; perhaps meaning fire;  Adar, the 12th Hebrew month:—Adar.

H1431.definition: גָּדַל gâdal, gaw-dal'; a primitive root; properly, to twist (compare H1434), i.e.  to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride):—advance, boast, bring up, exceed, excellent, be(-come, do, give, make, wax), great(-er, come to... estate,   things), grow(up), increase, lift up, magnify(-ifical), be much set by, nourish (up), pass, promote, proudly (spoken), tower.

H1433.definition: גֹּדֶל gôdel, go'-del; from H1431;  magnitude (literally or figuratively):—greatness, stout(-ness).

H1436.definition: גְּדַּלְיָה Gᵉdalyâh, ghed-al-yaw'; or (prolonged) גְּדַלְיָהוּ Gᵉdalyâhûw; from H1431 and H3050; Jah has become great;  Gedaljah, the name of five Israelites:—Gedaliah.

H1437.definition: גִּדַּלְתִּי Giddaltîy, ghid-dal'-tee; from H1431; I have made great;  Giddalti, an Israelite:—Giddalti.

H1438.definition: גָּדַע gâdaʻ, gaw-dah'; a primitive root;  to fell a tree; generally, to destroy anything:—cut (asunder, in sunder, down, off), hew down.

H1439.definition: גִּדְעוֹן Gidʻôwn, ghid-ohn'; from H1438; feller (i.e. warrior);  Gidon, an Israelite:—Gideon.

H144.definition: אֲדָר ʼĂdâr, ad-awr'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H143:—Adar.

H1444.definition: גֶּדֶר geder, gheh'-der; from H1443;  a circumvallation:—wall.

H1446.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1446.definition: גְדֹר Gᵉdôr, ghed-ore'; or (fully) גְּדוֹר Gᵉdôwr; from H1443; inclosure;  Gedor, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites:—Gedor.

H1447.definition: גָּדֵר gâdêr, gaw-dare'; from H1443;  a circumvallation; by implication, an inclosure:—fence, hedge, wall.

H1448.definition: גְּדֵרָה gᵉdêrâh, ghed-ay-raw'; feminine of H1447;  inclosure (especially for flocks):—(sheep-) cote (fold) hedge, wall.

H1450.definition: גְּדֵרוֹת Gᵉdêrôwth, ghed-ay-rohth'; plural of H1448; walls;  Gederoth, a place in Palestine:—Gederoth.

H1454.definition: גֵּה gêh, gay; probably a clerical error for H2088;  this:—this.

H1456.definition: גֵּהָה gêhâh, gay-haw'; from H1455;  a cure:—medicine.

H1457.definition: גָּהַר gâhar, gaw-har'; a primitive root;  to prostrate oneself:—cast self down, stretch self.

H1459.definition: גַּו gav, gav; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1460;  the middle:—midst, same, there-(where-) in.

H146.definition: אַדָּר ʼAddâr, ad-dawr'; intensive from H142; ample;  Addar, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite:—Addar.

H1460.definition: גֵּו gêv, gave; from H1342 (corresponding to H1354);  the back; by analogy, the middle:—  among, back, body.

H1463.definition: גּוֹג Gôwg, gohg; of uncertain derivation;  Gog, the name of an Israelite, also of some northern nation:—Gog.

H1466.definition: גֵּוָה gêvâh, gay-vaw'; the same as H1465;  exaltation; (figuratively) arrogance:—lifting up, pride.

H1469.definition: גּוֹזָל gôwzâl, go-zawl'; or (shortened) גֹזָל gôzâllemma גזָל missing vowel, corrected to גֹזָל; from H1497;  a nestling (as being comparatively nude of feathers):—young (pigeon).

H1470.definition: גּוֹזָן Gôwzân, go-zawn'; probably from H1468; a quarry (as a place of cutting stones);  Gozan, a province of Assyria:—Gozan.

H1471.definition: גּוֹי gôwy, go'-ee; rarely (shortened) גֹּי gôy; apparently from the same root as H1465 (in the sense of massing);  a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts:—Gentile, heathen, nation, people.

H1472.definition: גְּוִיָּה gᵉvîyâh, ghev-ee-yaw'; prolonged for H1465;  a body, whether alive or dead:—(dead) body, carcase, corpse.

H1473.definition: גּוֹלָה gôwlâh, go-law'; or (shortened) גֹּלָה gôlâh; active participle feminine of H1540;  exile; concretely and collectively exiles:—(carried away), captive(-ity), removing.

H1474.definition: גּוֹלָן Gôwlân, go-lawn'; from H1473; captive;  Golan, a place east of the Jordan:—Golan.

H1476.definition: גּוּנִי Gûwnîy, goo-nee'; probably from H1598; protected;  Guni, the name of two Israelites:—Guni.

H1478.definition: גָּוַע gâvaʻ, gaw-vah'; a primitive root;  to breathe out, i.e. (by implication) expire:—die, be dead, give up the ghost, perish.

H1481.definition: גּוּר gûwr, goor; a primitive root;  properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather for hostility (as afraid):—abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn, stand in awe, (be) stranger, × surely.

H1482.definition: גּוּר gûwr, goor; or (shortened) גֻּר gur; perhaps from H1481;  a cub (as still abiding in the lair), especially of the lion:—whelp, young one.

H1484.definition: גּוֹר gôwr, gore; or (feminine) גֹּרָה gôrâh; a variation of H1482:—whelp.

H1486.definition: גּוֹרָל gôwrâl, go-rawl'; or (shortened) גֹּרָל gôrâl; from an unused root meaning to be rough (as stone);  properly, a pebble, i.e. a lot (small stones being used for that purpose); figuratively, a portion or destiny (as if determined by lot):—lot.

H1488.definition: גֵּז gêz, gaze; from H1494;  a fleece (as shorn); also mown grass:—fleece, mowing, mown grass.

H1494.definition: גָּזַז gazâz, gaw-zaz'; a primitive root (akin to H1468);  to cut off; specifically to shear a flock or shave the hair; figuratively to destroy an enemy:—cut off (down), poll, shave, (sheep-) shear(-er).

H1495.definition: גָּזֵז Gâzêz, gaw-zaze'; from H1494; shearer;  Gazez, the name of two Israelites:—Gazez.

H1496.definition: גָּזִית gâzîyth, gaw-zeeth'; from H1491;  something cut, i.e. dressed stone:—hewed, hewn stone, wrought.

H1497.definition: גָּזַל gâzal, gaw-zal'; a primitive root;  to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob:—catch, consume, exercise (robbery), pluck (off), rob, spoil, take away (by force, violence), tear.

H1498.definition: גָּזֵל gâzêl, gaw-zale'; from H1497;  robbery, or (concretely) plunder:—robbery, thing taken away by violence.

H150.definition: אֲדַרְכֹּן ʼădarkôn, ad-ar-kone'; of Persian origin;  a daric or Persian coin:—dram.

H1500.definition: גְּזֵלָה gᵉzêlâh, ghez-ay-law'; feminine of H1498 and meaning the same:—that (he had robbed) (which he took violently away), spoil, violence.

H1501.definition: גָּזָם gâzâm, gaw-zawm'; from an unused root meaning to devour;  a kind of locust:—palmer-worm.

H1504.definition: גָּזַר gâzar, gaw-zar'; a primitive root;  to cut down or off; (figuratively) to destroy, divide, exclude, or decide:—cut down (off), decree, divide, snatch.

H1506.definition: גֶּזֶר gezer, gheh'-zer; from H1504;  something cut off; a portion:—part, piece.

H1507.definition: גֶּזֶר Gezer, gheh'-zer; the same as H1506;  Gezer, a place in Palestine:—Gazer, Gezer.

H151.definition: אֲדֹרָם ʼĂdôrâm, ad-o-rawm'; contracted for H141;  Adoram (or Adoniram), an Israelite:—Adoram.

H1513.definition: גֶּחֶל gechel, geh'-khel; or (feminine) גַּחֶלֶת gacheleth; from an unused root meaning to glow or kindle;  an ember:—(burning) coal.

H1516.definition: גַּיְא gayʼ, gah'-ee; or (shortened) גַּי gay; probably (by transmutation) from the same root as H1466 (abbreviated);  a gorge (from its lofty sides; hence, narrow, but not a gully or winter-torrent):—valley.

H1517.definition: גִּיד gîyd, gheed; probably from H1464;  a thong (as compressing); by analogy, a tendon:—sinew.

H1518.definition: גִּיחַ gîyach, ghee'-akh; or (shortened) גֹּחַ gôach; a primitive root;  to gush forth (as water), generally to issue:—break forth, labor to bring forth, come forth, draw up, take out.

H1520.definition: גִּיחַ Gîyach, ghee'-akh; from H1518; a fountain;  Giach, a place in Palestine:—Giah.

H1522.definition: גֵּיחֲזִי Gêychăzîy, gay-khah-zee'; or גֵּחֲזִי Gêchăzîy; apparently from H1516 and H2372; valley of a visionary;  Gechazi, the servant of Elisha:—Gehazi.

H1523.definition: גִּיל gîyl, gheel; or (by permutation) גּוּל gûwl; a primitive root;  properly, to spin round (under the influence of any violent emotion), i.e. usually rejoice, or (as cringing) fear:—be glad, joy, be joyful, rejoice.

H1524.definition: גִּיל gîyl, gheel; from H1523;  a revolution (of time, i.e. an age); also joy:—× exceedingly, gladness, × greatly, joy, rejoice(-ing), sort.

H1528.definition: גִּיר gîyr, gheer; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1615;  lime:—plaster.

H1529.definition: גֵּישָׁן Gêyshân, gay-shawn'; from the same as H1487; lumpish;  Geshan, an Israelite:—Geshan.

H1530.definition: גַּל gal, gal; from H1556;  something rolled, i.e. a heap of stone or dung (plural ruins), by analogy, a spring of water (plural waves):—billow, heap, spring, wave.

H1533.definition: גִּלְבֹּעַ Gilbôaʻ, ghil-bo'-ah; from H1530 and H1158; fountain of ebullition;  Gilboa, a mountain of Palestine:—Gilboa.

H1534.definition: גַּלְגַּל galgal, gal-gal'; by reduplication from H1556;  a wheel; by analogy, a whirlwind; also dust (as whirled):—heaven, rolling thing, wheel.

H1537.definition: גִּלְגָּל Gilgâl, ghil-gawl'; the same as H1536 (with the article as a properly, noun);  Gilgal, the name of three places in Palestine:—Gilgal. See also H1019.

H1540.definition: גָּלָה gâlâh, gaw-law'; a primitive root;  to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication, to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively, to reveal:—  advertise, appear, bewray, bring, (carry, lead, go) captive (into captivity), depart, disclose, discover, exile, be gone, open, × plainly, publish, remove, reveal, × shamelessly, shew, × surely, tell, uncover.

H1541.definition: גְּלָה gᵉlâh, ghel-aw'; (Aramaic) or גְּלָא gᵉlâʼ; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1540:—bring over, carry away, reveal.

H1542.definition: גִּלֹה Gilôh, ghee-lo'; or (fully) גִּילֹה Gîylôh; from H1540; open;  Giloh, a place in Palestine:—Giloh.

H1543.definition: גֻּלָּה gullâh, gool-law'; feminine from H1556;  a fountain, bowl or globe (all as round):—bowl, pommel, spring.

H1544.definition: גִּלּוּל gillûwl, ghil-lool'; or (shortened) גִּלֻּל gillul; from H1556;  properly, a log (as round); by implication, an idol:—idol.

H1545.definition: גְּלוֹם gᵉlôwm, ghel-ome'; from H1563;  clothing (as wrapped):—clothes.

H1546.definition: גָּלוּת gâlûwth, gaw-looth'; feminine from H1540;  captivity; concretely, exiles (collectively):—(they that are carried away) captives(-ity).

H1548.definition: גָּלַח gâlach, gaw-lakh'; a primitive root;  properly, to be bald, i.e. (causatively) to shave; figuratively to lay waste:—poll, shave (off).

H1549.definition: גִּלָּיוֹן gillâyôwn, ghil-law-yone'; or גִּלְיוֹן gilyôwn; from H1540;  a tablet for writing (as bare); by analogy, a mirror (as a plate):—glass, roll.

H1551.definition: גָּלִיל Gâlîyl, gaw-leel'; or (prolonged) גָּלִילָה Gâlîylâh; the same as H1550; a circle (with the article);  Galil (as a special circuit) in the North of Palestine:—Galilee.

H1552.definition: גְלִילָה gᵉlîylâh, ghel-ee-law'; feminine of H1550;  a circuit or region:—border, coast, country.

H1554.definition: גַּלִּים Gallîym, gal-leem'; plural of H1530; springs;  Gallim, a place in Palestine:—Gallim.

H1555.definition: גׇּלְיַת Golyath, gol-yath'; perhaps from H1540; exile;  Goljath, a Philistine:—Goliath.

H1556.definition: גָּלַל gâlal, gaw-lal'; a primitive root;  to roll (literally or figuratively):—commit, remove, roll (away, down, together), run down, seek occasion, trust, wallow.

H1557.definition: גָּלָל gâlâl, gaw-lawl'; from H1556;  dung (as in balls):—dung.

H1558.definition: גָּלָל gâlâl, gaw-lawl'; from H1556;  a circumstance (as rolled around); only used adverbially, on account of:—because of, for (sake).

H1561.definition: גֵּלֶל gêlel, gay'-lel; a variation of H1557;  dung (plural balls of dung):—dung.

H1562.definition: גִּלֲלַי Gilălay, ghe-lal-ah'-ee; from H1561; dungy;  Gilalai, an Israelite:—Gilalai.

H1567.definition: גַּלְעֵד Galʻêd, gal-ade'; from H1530 and H5707; heap of testimony;  Galed, a memorial cairn East of the Jordan:—Galeed.

H1568.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1568.definition: גִּלְעָד Gilʻâd, ghil-awd'; probably from H1567;  Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites:—Gilead, Gileadite.

H157.definition: אָהַב ʼâhab, aw-hab'; or אָהֵב ʼâhêb ; a primitive root;  to have affection for (sexually or otherwise):—(be-) love(-d, -ly, -r), like, friend.

H1571.definition: גַּם gam, gam; by contraction from an unused root meaning to gather;  properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and:—again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.

H1576.definition: גְּמוּל gᵉmûwl, ghem-ool'; from H1580;  treatment, i.e. an act (of good or ill); by implication, service or requital:—  as hast served, benefit, desert, deserving, that which he hath given, recompense, reward.

H1578.definition: גְּמוּלָה gᵉmûwlâh, ghem-oo-law'; feminine of H1576;  meaning the same:—deed, recompense, such a reward.

H1579.definition: גִּמְזוֹ Gimzôw, ghim-zo'; of uncertain derivation;  Gimzo, a place in Palestine:—Gimzo.

H158.definition: אַהַב ʼahab, ah'-hab; from H157;  affection (in a good or a bad sense):—love(-r).

H1580.definition: גָּמַל gâmal, gaw-mal'; a primitive root;  to treat a person (well or ill), i.e. benefit or requite; by implication (of toil), to ripen, i.e. (specifically) to wean:—bestow on, deal bountifully, do (good), recompense, requite, reward, ripen,   serve, mean, yield.

H1581.definition: גָּמָל gâmâl, gaw-mawl'; apparently from H1580 (in the sense of labor or burden-bearing);  a camel:—camel.

H1583.definition: גַּמְלִיאֵל Gamlîyʼêl, gam-lee-ale'; from H1580 and H410; reward of God;  Gamliel, an Israelite:—Gamaliel.

H1584.definition: גָּמַר gâmar, gaw-mar'; a primitive root;  to end (in the sense of completion or failure):—cease, come to an end, fail, perfect, perform.

H1586.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper masculine noun
H1586.definition: גֹּמֶר Gômer, go'-mer; from H1584; completion;  Gomer, the name of a son of Japheth and of his descendants; also of a Hebrewess:—Gomer.

H1588.definition: גַּן gan, gan; from H1598;  a garden (as fenced):—garden.

H1589.definition: גָּנַב gânab, gaw-nab'; a primitive root;  to thieve (literally or figuratively); by implication, to deceive:—carry away, × indeed, secretly bring, steal (away), get by stealth.

H1590.definition: גַּנָּב gannâb, gaw-nab'; from H1589;  a stealer:—thief.

H1592.definition: גְּנֻבַת Gᵉnubath, ghen-oo-bath'; from H1589; theft;  Genubath, an Edomitish prince:—Genubath.

H1593.definition: גַּנָּה gannâh, gan-naw'; feminine of H1588;  a garden:—garden.

H1594.definition: גִּנָּה ginnâh, ghin-naw'; another form for H1593:—garden.

H1595.definition: גֶּנֶז genez, gheh'-nez; from an unused root meaning to store;  treasure; by implication, a coffer:—chest, treasury.

H1596.definition: גְּנַז gᵉnaz, ghen-az'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1595;  treasure:—treasure.

H1599.definition: גִּנְּתוֹן Ginnᵉthôwn, ghin-neth-one; or גִּנְּתוֹ Ginnᵉthôw; from H1598; gardener;  Ginnethon or Ginnetho, an Israelite:—Ginnetho, Ginnethon.

H16.definition: אֵבֶה ʼêbeh, ay-beh'; from H14 (in the sense of bending toward);  the papyrus:—swift.

H160.definition: אַהֲבָה ʼahăbâh, a-hab-aw; feminine of H158 and meaning the same:—love.

H1600.definition: גָּעָה gâʻâh, gaw-aw'; a primitive root;  to bellow (as cattle):—low.

H1602.definition: גָּעַל gâʻal, gaw-al'; a primitive root;  to detest; by implication, to reject:—abhor, fail, lothe, vilely cast away.

H1603.definition: גַּעַל Gaʻal, gah'-al; from H1602; loathing;  Gaal, an Israelite:—Gaal.

H1605.definition: גָּעַר gâʻar, gaw-ar'; a primitive root;  to chide:—corrupt, rebuke, reprove.

H1607.definition: גָּעַשׁ gâʻash, gaw-ash'; a primitive root  to agitate violently:—move, shake, toss, trouble.

H1608.definition: גַּעַשׁ Gaʻash, ga'-ash; from H1607; a quaking;  Gaash, a hill in Palestine:—Gaash.

H1609.definition: גַּעְתָּם Gaʻtâm, gah-tawm'; of uncertain derivation;  Gatam, an Edomite:—Gatam.

H1611.definition: גַּף gaph, gaf; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1610;  a wing:—wing.

H1612.definition: גֶּפֶן gephen, gheh'-fen; from an unused root meaning to bend;  a vine (as twining), especially the grape:—vine, tree.

H1617.definition: גֵּרָא Gêrâʼ, gay-raw'; perhaps from H1626; a grain;  Gera, the name of six Israelites:—Gera.

H1619.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1619.definition: גָּרֵב Gârêb, gaw-rabe'; from the same as H1618; scabby;  Gareb, the name of an Israelite, also of a hill near Jerusalem:—Gareb.

H162.definition: אֲהָהּ ʼăhâhh, a-haw'; apparently a primitive word expressing pain exclamatorily;  Oh!:—ah, alas.

H1620.definition: גַּרְגַּר gargar, gar-gar'; by reduplication from H1641;  a berry (as if a pellet of rumination):—berry.

H1624.definition: גָּרָה gârâh, gaw-raw'; a primitive root;  properly, to grate, i.e. (figuratively) to anger:—contend, meddle, stir up, strive.

H1625.definition: גֵּרָה gêrâh, gay-raw'; from H1641;  the cud (as scraping the throat):—cud.

H1626.definition: גֵּרָה gêrâh, gay-raw'; from H1641 (as in H1625); properly, (like H1620) a kernel (round as if scraped), i.e.  a gerah or small weight (and coin):—gerah.

H1627.definition: גָּרוֹן gârôwn, gaw-rone'; or (shortened) גָּרֹן gârôn; from H1641; (compare H1621)  the throat (as roughened by swallowing):—× aloud, mouth, neck, throat.

H1629.definition: גָּרַז gâraz, gaw-raz'; a primitive root;  to cut off:—cut off.

H163.definition: אַהֲוָא ʼAhăvâʼ, a-hav-aw'; probably of foreign origin;  Ahava, a river of Babylonia:—Ahava.

H1630.definition: גְּרִזִים Gᵉrizîym, gher-ee-zeem'; plural of an unused noun from H1629 (compare H1511), cut up (i.e. rocky);  Gerizim, a mountain of Palestine:—Gerizim.

H1631.definition: גַּרְזֶן garzen, gar-zen'; from H1629;  an axe:—ax.

H1639.definition: גָּרַע gâraʻ, gaw-rah'; a primitive root;  to scrape off; by implication, to shave, remove, lessen, withhold:—abate, clip, (di-) minish, do (take) away, keep back, restrain, make small, withdraw.

H164.definition: אֵהוּד ʼÊhûwd, ay-hood'; from the same as H161; united;  Ehud, the name of two or three Israelites:—Ehud.

H1640.definition: גָּרַף gâraph, gaw-raf'; a primitive root;  to bear off violently:—sweep away.

H1641.definition: גָּרַר gârar, gaw-rar'; a primitive root;  to drag off roughly; by implication, to bring up the cud (i.e. ruminate); by analogy, to saw:—catch, chew, × continuing, destroy, saw.

H1642.definition: גְּרָר Gᵉrâr, gher-awr'; probably from H1641; a rolling country;  Gerar, a Philistine city:—Gerar.

H1644.definition: גָּרַשׁ gârash, gaw-rash'; a primitive root;  to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce:—cast up (out), divorced (woman), drive away (forth, out), expel, × surely put away, trouble, thrust out.

H1647.definition: גֵּרְשֹׁם Gêrᵉshôm, gay-resh-ome'; for H1648;  Gereshom, the name of four Israelites:—Gershom.

H1648.definition: גֵּרְשׁוֹן Gêrᵉshôwn, gay-resh-one'; or גֵּרְשׁוֹם Gêrᵉshôwm; from H1644; a refugee;  Gereshon or Gereshom, an Israelite:—Gershon, Gershom.

H165.definition: אֱהִי ʼĕhîy, e-hee'; apparently an orthographical variation for H346;  where:—I will be (Hosea 13:10,14) (which is often the rendering of the same Hebrew form from 1961).

H1650.definition: גְּשׁוּר Gᵉshûwr, ghesh-oor'; from an unused root (meaning to join); bridge;  Geshur, a district of Syria:—Geshur, Geshurite.

H1652.definition: גָּשַׁם gâsham, gaw-sham'; a primitive root;  to shower violently:—(cause to) rain.

H1653.definition: גֶּשֶׁם geshem, gheh'-shem; from H1652;  a shower:—rain, shower.

H1660.definition: גַּת gath, gath; probably from H5059 (in the sense of treading out grapes);  a wine-press (or vat for holding the grapes in pressing them):—(wine-) press (fat).

H1661.definition: גַּת Gath, gath; the same as H1660;  Gath, a Philistine city:—Gath.

H1664.definition: גִּתַּיִם Gittayim, ghit-tah'-yim; dual of H1660; double winepress;  Gittajim, a place in Palestine:—Gittaim.

H1666.definition: גֶּתֶר Gether, gheh'-ther; of uncertain derivation;  Gether, a son of Aram, and the region settled by him:—Gether.

H1667.definition: גַּת־רִמּוֹן Gath-Rimmôwn, gath-rim-mone'; from H1660 and H7416; wine-press of (the) pomegranate;  Gath-Rimmon, a place in Palestine:—Gath-rimmon.

H1668.definition: דָּא dâʼ, daw; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2088;  this:—one ... another, this.

H1669.definition: דָּאַב dâʼab, daw-ab'; a primitive root;  to pine:—mourn, sorrow(-ful).

H167.definition: אָהַל ʼâhal, aw-hal'; a denominative from H168;  to tent:—pitch (remove) a tent.

H1672.definition: דָּאַג dâʼag, daw-ag'; a primitive root;  be anxious:—be afraid (careful, sorry), sorrow, take thought.

H1673.definition: דֹּאֵג Dôʼêg, do-ayg'; or (fully) דּוֹאֵג Dôwʼêg; active participle of H1672; anxious;  Doeg, an Edomite:—Doeg.

H1674.definition: דְּאָגָה dᵉʼâgâh, deh-aw-gaw'; from H1672;  anxiety:—care(-fulness), fear, heaviness, sorrow.

H1675.definition: דָּאָה dâʼâh, daw-aw'; a primitive root;  to dart, i.e. fly rapidly:—fly.

H1677.definition: דֹּב dôb, dobe; or (fully) דּוֹב dôwb; from H1680;  the bear (as slow):—bear.

H168.definition: אֹהֶל ʼôhel, o'-hel; from H166;  a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance):—covering, (dwelling) (place), home, tabernacle, tent.

H1681.definition: דִּבָּה dibbâh, dib-baw'; from H1680 (in the sense of furtive motion);  slander:—defaming, evil report, infamy, slander.

H1683.definition: דְּבּוֹרָה Dᵉbôwrâh, deb-o-raw'; or (shortened) דְּבֹרָה Dᵉbôrâh; the same as H1682;  Deborah, the name of two Hebrewesses:—Deborah.

H1685.definition: דְּבַח dᵉbach, deb-akh'; (Aramaic) from H1684;  a sacrifice:—sacrifice.

H1686.definition: דִּבְיוֹן dibyôwn, dib-yone'; in the margin for the textual reading, חֶרְיוֹן cheryôwn; both, (in the plural only and) of uncertain derivation,  probably some cheap vegetable, perhaps a bulbous root:—dove's dung.

H1687.definition: דְּבִיר dᵉbîyr, deb-eer'; or (shortened) דְּבִר dᵉbir; from H1696 (apparently in the sense of oracle);  the shrine or innermost part of the sanctuary:—oracle.

H1688.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1688.definition: דְּבִיר Dᵉbîyr, deb-eer'; or (shortened) דְּבִר Dᵉbir; (Joshua 13:26 (but see H3810)), the same as H1687;  Debir, the name of an Amoritish king and of two places in Palestine:—Debir.

H169.definition: אֹהֶל ʼÔhel, o'-hel; the same as H168;  Ohel, an Israelite:—Ohel.

H1690.definition: דְּבֵלָה dᵉbêlâh, deb-ay-law'; from an unused root (akin to H2082) probably meaning to press together;  a cake of pressed figs:—cake (lump) of figs.

H1692.definition: דָּבַק dâbaq, daw-bak'; a primitive root;  properly, to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere; figuratively, to catch by pursuit:—abide fast, cleave (fast together), follow close (hard after), be joined (together), keep (fast), overtake, pursue hard, stick, take.

H1695.definition: דָּבֵק dâbêq, daw-bake'; from H1692;  adhering:—cleave, joining, stick closer.

H1696.definition: דָבַר dâbar, daw-bar'; a primitive root;  perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue:—answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use (entreaties), utter, × well, × work.

H1697.definition: דָּבָר dâbâr, daw-baw'; from H1696;  a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause:—act, advice, affair, answer, × any such (thing), because of, book, business, care, case, cause, certain rate,   chronicles, commandment, × commune(-ication),   concern(-ing),   confer, counsel,   dearth, decree, deed, × disease, due, duty, effect,   eloquent, errand, (evil favoured-) ness,   glory,   harm, hurt,   iniquity,   judgment, language,   lying, manner, matter, message, (no) thing, oracle, × ought, × parts,   pertaining,   please, portion,   power, promise, provision, purpose, question, rate, reason, report, request, × (as hast) said, sake, saying, sentence,   sign,   so, some (uncleanness), somewhat to say,   song, speech, × spoken, talk, task,   that, × there done, thing (concerning), thought,   thus, tidings, what(-soever),   wherewith, which, word, work.

H1698.definition: דֶּבֶר deber, deh'-ber; from H1696 (in the sense of destroying);  a pestilence:—murrain, pestilence, plague.

H170.definition: אׇהֳלָה ʼOhŏlâh, o-hol-aw'; in form a feminine of H168, but in fact for אׇהֳלָהּ ʼOhŏlâhh; from H168; her tent (i.e. idolatrous sanctuary);  Oholah, a symbolic name for Samaria:—Aholah.

H1705.definition: דֲּבְרַת Dăbrath, daw-ber-ath'; from H1697 (perhaps in the sense of H1699);  Daberath, a place in Palestine:—Dabareh, Daberath.

H1706.definition: דְּבַשׁ dᵉbash, deb-ash'; from an unused root meaning to be gummy;  honey (from its stickiness); by analogy, syrup:—honey(-comb).

H1707.definition: דַּבֶּשֶׁת dabbesheth, dab-beh'-sheth; intensive from the same as H1706;  a sticky mass, i.e. the hump of a camel:—hunch (of a camel).

H1708.definition: דַּבֶּשֶׁת Dabbesheth, dab-beh'-sheth; the same as H1707;  Dabbesheth, a place in Palestine:—Dabbesheth.

H1709.definition: דָּג dâg, dawg; or (fully) דָּאג dâʼg; (Nehemiah 13:16), from H1711; a fish (as prolific); or perhaps rather from H1672 (as timid); but still better from H1672 (in the sense of squirming, i.e. moving by the vibratory action of the tail);  a fish (often used collectively):—fish.

H1710.definition: דָּגָה dâgâh, daw-gaw'; feminine of H1709, and meaning the same:—fish.

H1712.definition: דָּגוֹן Dâgôwn, daw-gohn'; from H1709; the fish-god;  Dagon, a Philistine deity:—Dagon.

H1715.definition: דָּגָן dâgân, daw-gawn'; from H1711;  properly, increase, i.e. grain:—corn (floor), wheat.

H1717.definition: דַּד dad, dad; apparently from the same as H1730;  the breast (as the seat of love, or from its shape):—breast, teat.

H1719.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1719.definition: דְּדָן Dᵉdân, ded-awn'; or (prolonged) דְּדָנֶה Dᵉdâneh; (Ezekiel 25:13), of uncertain derivation;  Dedan, the name of two Cushites and of their territory:—Dedan.

H172.definition: אׇהֳלִיבָה ʼOhŏlîybâh, o''-hol-ee-baw'; (similarly with H170) for אׇהֳלִיבָהּ ʼOhŏlîybâhh ; from H168; my tent (is) in her;  Oholibah, a symbolic name for Judah:—Aholibah.

H1722.definition: דְּהַב dᵉhab, deh-hab'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2091;  gold:—gold(-en).

H173.definition: אׇהֳלִיבָמָה ʼOhŏlîybâmâh, o''-hol-ee-baw-maw'; from H168 and H1116; tent of (the) height;  Oholibamah, a wife of Esau:—Aholibamah.

H1730.definition: דּוֹד dôwd, dode; or (shortened) דֹּד dôd; from an unused root meaning properly, to boil, i.e.  (figuratively) to love; by implication, a love-token, lover, friend; specifically an uncle:—(well-) beloved, father's brother, love, uncle.

H1731.definition: דּוּד dûwd, dood; from the same as H1730;  a pot (for boiling); also (by resemblance of shape) a basket:—basket, caldron, kettle, (seething) pot.

H1732.definition: דָּוִד Dâvid, daw-veed'; rarely (fully); דָּוִיד Dâvîyd; from the same as H1730; loving;  David, the youngest son of Jesse:—David.

H1736.definition: דּוּדַי dûwday, doo-dah'-ee; from H1731;  a boiler or basket; also the mandrake (as an aphrodisiac):—basket, mandrake.

H1737.definition: דּוֹדַי Dôwday, do-dah'ee; formed like H1736; amatory;  Dodai, an Israelite:—Dodai.

H1739.definition: דָּוֶה dâveh, daw-veh'; from H1738;  sick (especially in menstruation):—faint, menstruous cloth, she that is sick, having sickness.

H174.definition: אֲהָלִים ʼăhâlîym, a-haw-leem'; or (feminine) אֲהָלוֹת ʼăhâlôwth (only used thus in the plural); of foreign origin;  aloe wood (i.e. sticks):—(tree of lign-) aloes.

H1742.definition: דַּוָּי davvây, dav-voy'; from H1739;  sick; figuratively, troubled:—faint.

H1743.definition: דּוּךְ dûwk, dook; a primitive root;  to bruise in a mortar:—beat.

H1746.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1746.definition: דּוּמָה Dûwmâh, doo-maw'; the same as H1745;  Dumah, a tribe and region of Arabia:—Dumah.

H1747.definition: דּוּמִיָּה dûwmîyâh, doo-me-yaw'; from H1820;  stillness; adverbially, silently; abstractly quiet, trust:—silence, silent, waiteth.

H175.definition: אַהֲרוֹן ʼAhărôwn, a-har-one'; of uncertain derivation;  Aharon, the brother of Moses:—Aaron.

H1752.definition: דּוּר dûwr, dure; a primitive root;  properly, to gyrate (or move in a circle), i.e. to remain:—dwell.

H1753.definition: דּוּר dûwr, dure; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1752;  to reside:—dwell.

H1754.definition: דּוּר dûwr, dure; from H1752;  a circle, ball or pile:—ball, turn, round about.

H1755.definition: דּוֹר dôwr, dore; or (shortened) דֹּר dôr; from H1752;  properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling:—age, × evermore, generation, (n-) ever, posterity.

H1756.definition: דּוֹר Dôwr, dore; or (by permutation) דֹּאר Dôʼr; (Joshua 17:11; 1 Kings 4:11), from H1755; dwelling;  Dor, a place in Palestine:—Dor.

H1758.definition: דּוּשׁ dûwsh, doosh; or דּוֹשׁ dôwsh; or דִּישׁ dîysh; a primitive root;  to trample or thresh:—break, tear, thresh, tread out (down), at grass (Jeremiah 50:11, by mistake for H1877).

H176.definition: אוֹ ʼôw, o; presumed to be the 'constructive' or genitival form of אַו ʼav ; short for H185;  desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if:—also, and, either, if, at the least, × nor, or, otherwise, then, whether.

H1760.definition: דָּחָה dâchâh, daw-khaw'; or דָּחַח dâchach; (Jeremiah 23:12), a primitive root;  to push down:—chase, drive away (on), overthrow, outcast, × sore, thrust, totter.

H1763.definition: דְּחַל dᵉchal, deh-khal'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2119;  to slink, i.e. (by implication) to fear, or (causatively) be formidable:—make afraid, dreadful, fear, terrible.

H1764.definition: דֹּחַן dôchan, do'-khan; of uncertain derivation;  millet:—millet.

H1765.definition: דָּחַף dâchaph, daw-khaf'; a primitive root;  to urge, i.e. hasten:—(be) haste(-ned), pressed on.

H1767.definition: דַּי day, dahee; of uncertain derivation;  enough (as noun or adverb), used chiefly with preposition in phrases:—able, according to, after (ability), among, as (oft as), (more than) enough, from, in, since, (much as is) sufficient(-ly), too much, very, when.

H1768.definition: דִּי dîy, dee; (Aramaic) apparently for H1668;  that, used as relative conjunction, and especially (with a preposition) in adverbial phrases; also as preposition of:—× as, but, for(-asmuch  ),   now, of, seeing, than, that, therefore, until,   what (-soever), when, which, whom, whose.

H1769.definition: דִּיבוֹן Dîybôwn, dee-bome'; or (shortened) דִּיבֹן Dîybôn; from H1727; pining:— Dibon, the name of three places in Palestine:—Dibon. (Also, with H1410 added, Dibon-gad.)

H177.definition: אוּאֵל ʼÛwʼêl, oo-ale'; from H176 and H410; wish of God;  Uel, and Israelite:—Uel.

H1771.definition: דַּיָּג dayâg, dah-yawg'; from H1770;  a fisherman:—fisher.

H1777.definition: דִּין dîyn, deen; or (Genesis 6:3) דּוּן dûwn; a primitive root;  to rule; by implication to judge (as umpire); also to strive (as at law):—contend contend execute (judgment) judge minister judgment plead (the cause) at strife strive.

H1779.definition: דִּין dîyn, deen; or (Job 19:29) דּוּן dûwn; from H1777;  judgement (the suit, justice, sentence or tribunal); by implication also strife:—cause, judgement, plea, strife.

H178.definition: אוֹב ʼôwb, obe; from the same as H1 (apparently through the idea of prattling a father's name);  properly, a mumble, i.e. a water-skin (from its hollow sound); hence a necromancer (ventriloquist, as from a jar):—bottle, familiar spirit.

H1780.definition: דִּין dîyn, deen; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1779:—judgement.

H1783.definition: דִּינָה Dîynâh, dee-naw'; feminine of H1779; justice;  Dinah, the daughter of Jacob:—Dinah.

H1787.definition: דִּישׁוֹן Dîyshôwn, dee-shone'; Diyshon, the same as H1788;  Dishon, the name of two Edomites:—Dishon.

H1789.definition: דִּישָׁן Dîyshân, dee-shawn'; another form of H1787  Dishan, an Edomite:—Dishan, Dishon.

H179.definition: אוֹבִיל ʼôwbîyl, o-beel'; probably from H56; mournful;  Obil, an Ishmaelite:—Obil.

H1791.definition: דֵּךְ dêk, dake; (Aramaic) or דָּךְ dâk; (Aramaic), prolonged from H1668;  this:—the same, this.

H1792.definition: דָּכָא dâkâʼ, daw-kaw'; a primitive root (compare H1794);  to crumble; transitively, to bruise (literally or figuratively):—beat to pieces, break (in pieces), bruise, contrite, crush, destroy, humble, oppress, smite.

H1794.definition: דָּכָה dâkâh, daw-kaw'; a primitive root (compare H1790, H1792);  to collapse (phys. or mentally):—break (sore), contrite, crouch.

H1797.definition: דִּכֵּן dikkên, dik-kane'; (Aramaic) prolonged from H1791;  this:—same, that, this.

H1798.definition: דְּכַר dᵉkar, dek-ar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2145;  properly, a male, i.e. of sheep:—ram.

H18.definition: אֵבוּס ʼêbûwç, ay-booce'; from H75;  a manger or stall:—crib.

H1800.definition: דַּל dal, dal; from H1809;  properly, dangling, i.e. (by implication) weak or thin:—lean, needy, poor (man), weaker.

H1801.definition: דָּלַג dâlag, daw-lag'; a primitive root;  to spring:—leap.

H1802.definition: דָּלָה dâlâh, daw-law'; a primitive root (compare H1809);  properly, to dangle, i.e. to let down a bucket (for drawing out water); figuratively, to deliver:—draw (out), × enough, lift up.

H1803.definition: דַּלָּה dallâh, dal-law'; from H1802;  properly, something dangling, i.e. a loose thread or hair; figuratively, indigent:—hair, pining sickness, poor(-est sort).

H1804.definition: דָּלַח dâlach, daw-lakh'; a primitive root;  to roil water:—trouble.

H1806.definition: דְּלָיָה Dᵉlâyâh, del-aw-yaw'; or (prolonged) דְּלָיָהוּ Dᵉlâyâhûwxlit Dᵉlâyâhhûw corrected to Dᵉlâyâhûw; from H1802 and H3050; Jah has delivered;  Delajah, the name of five Israelites:—Dalaiah, Delaiah.

H1807.definition: דְּלִילָה Dᵉlîylâh, del-ee-law'; from H1809; languishing  Delilah, a Philistine woman:—Delilah.

H1809.definition: דָּלַל dâlal, daw-lal'; a primitive root (compare H1802);  to slacken or be feeble; figuratively, to be oppressed:—bring low, dry up, be emptied, be not equal, fail, be impoverished, be made thin.

H181.definition: אוּד ʼûwd, ood; from an unused root meaning to rake together;  a poker (for turning or gathering embers):—(fire-) brand.

H1811.definition: דָּלַף dâlaph, daw-laf'; a primitive root;  to drip; by implication, to weep:—drop through, melt, pour out.

H1812.definition: דֶּלֶף deleph, deh'-lef; from H1811;  a dripping:—dropping.

H1813.definition: דַּלְפוֹן Dalphôwn, dal-fone'; from H1811; dripping;  Dalphon, a son of Haman:—Dalphon.

H1814.definition: דָּלַק dâlaq, daw-lak'; a primitive root;  to flame (literally or figuratively):—burning, chase, inflame, kindle, persecute(-or), pursue hotly.

H1817.definition: דֶּלֶת deleth, deh'-leth; from H1802;  something swinging, i.e. the valve of a door:—door (two-leaved), gate, leaf, lid. (Psalm 141:3).

H1818.definition: דָּם dâm, dawm; from H1826 (compare H119);  blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood):—blood(-y, -guiltiness), (-thirsty), + innocent.

H1819.definition: דָּמָה dâmâh, daw-maw'; a primitive root;  to compare; by implication, to resemble, liken, consider:—compare, devise, (be) like(-n), mean, think, use similitudes.

H182.definition: אוֹדוֹת ʼôwdôwth, o-doth'; or (shortened) אֹדוֹת ʼôdôwth (only thus in the plural); from the same as H181;  turnings (i.e. occasions); (adverb) on account of:—(be-) cause, concerning, sake.

H1820.definition: דָּמָה dâmâh, daw-mam'; a primitive root;  to be dumb or silent; hence, to fail or perish; trans. to destroy:—cease, be cut down (off), destroy, be brought to silence, be undone, × utterly.

H1821.definition: דְּמָה dᵉmâh, dem-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1819;  to resemble:—be like.

H1823.definition: דְּמוּת dᵉmûwth, dem-ooth'; from H1819;  resemblance; concretely, model, shape; adverbially, like:—fashion, like (-ness, as), manner, similitude.

H1824.definition: דְּמִי dᵉmîy, dem-ee'; or דֳּמִי dŏmîy; from H1820;  quiet:—cutting off, rest, silence.

H1826.definition: דָּמַם dâmam, daw-man'; a primitive root (compare H1724, H1820);  to be dumb; by implication, to be astonished, to stop; also to perish:—cease, be cut down (off), forbear, hold peace, quiet self, rest, be silent, keep (put to) silence, be (stand) still, tarry, wait.

H1829.definition: דִּמְנָה Dimnâh, dim-naw'; feminine from the same as H1828; a dung-heap;  Dimnah, a place in Palestine:—Dimnah.

H183.definition: אָוָה ʼâvâh, aw-vaw'; a primitive root;  to wish for:—covet, (greatly) desire, be desirous, long, lust (after).

H1830.definition: דָּמַע dâmaʻ, daw-mah'; a primitive root;  to weep:—× sore, weep.

H1832.definition: דִּמְעָה dimʻâh, dim-aw'; feminine of H1831;  weeping:—tears.

H1834.definition: דַּמֶּשֶׂק Dammeseq, dam-meh'-sek; or דּוּמֶשֶׂק Dûwmeseq; or דַּרְמֶשֶׂק Darmeseq; of foreign origin;  Damascus, a city of Syria:—Damascus.
