H1835.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1835.definition: דָּן Dân, dawn; from H1777; judge;  Dan, one of the sons of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory; likewise a place in Palestine colonized by them:—Daniel

H1836.definition: דֵּן dên, dane; (Aramaic) an orthographical variation of H1791;  this:—(afore-) time,   after this manner, here (-after), one...another, such, there(-fore), these, this (matter),   thus, where(-fore), which.

H1840.definition: דָנִיֵּאל Dânîyêʼl, daw-nee-yale'; in Ezekiel it is; דָּנִאֵל Dâniʼêl; from H1835 and H410; judge of God;  Daniel or Danijel, the name of two Israelites:—Daniel.

H1841.definition: דָּנִיֵּאל Dânîyêʼl, daw-nee-yale'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1840;  Danijel, the Hebrew prophet:—Daniel.

H1844.definition: דֵּעָה dêʻâh, day-aw'; feminine of H1843;  knowledge:—knowledge.

H1847.definition: דַּעַת daʻath, dah'-ath; from H3045;  knowledge:—cunning, (ig-) norantly, know(-ledge), (un-) awares (wittingly).

H1849.definition: דָּפַק dâphaq, daw-fak'; a primitive root;  to knock; by analogy, to press severely:—beat, knock, overdrive.

H1851.definition: דַּק daq, dak; from H1854;  crushed, i.e. (by implication) small or thin:—dwarf, lean(-fleshed), very little thing, small, thin.

H1853.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H1853.definition: דִּקְלָה Diqlâh, dik-law'; of foreign origin;  Diklah, a region of Arabia:—Diklah.

H1854.definition: דָּקַק dâqaq, daw-kak'; a primitive root (compare H1915);  to crush (or intransitively) crumble:—beat in pieces (small), bruise, make dust, (into) × powder, (be, very) small, stamp (small).

H1855.definition: דְּקַק dᵉqaq, dek-ak'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1854;  to crumble or (trans.) crush:—break to pieces.

H1856.definition: דָּקַר dâqar, daw-kar'; a primitive root;  to stab; by analogy, to starve; figuratively, to revile:—pierce, strike (thrust) through, wound.

H1858.definition: דַּר dar, dar; apparently from the same as H1865;  properly, a pearl (from its sheen as rapidly turned); by analogy, pearl-stone, i.e. mother-of-pearl or alabaster:—× white.

H1859.definition: דָּר dâr, dawr; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1755;  an age:—generation.

H1860.definition: דְּרָאוֹן dᵉrâʼôwn, der-aw-one'; or דֵּרָאוֹן dêrâʼôwn; from an unused root (meaning to repulse);  an object of aversion:—abhorring, contempt.

H1865.definition: דְּרוֹר dᵉrôwr, der-ore'; from an unused root (meaning to move rapidly);  freedom; hence, spontaneity of outflow, and so clear:—liberty, pure.

H1867.definition: דָּֽרְיָוֵשׁ Dârᵉyâvêsh, daw-reh-yaw-vaysh'; of Persian origin;  Darejavesh, a title (rather than name) of several Persian kings:—Darius.

H1868.definition: דָּֽרְיָוֵשׁ Dârᵉyâvêsh, daw-reh-yaw-vaysh'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1867:—Darius.

H1869.definition: דָּרַךְ dârak, daw-rak'; a primitive root;  to tread; by implication, to walk; also to string a bow (by treading on it in bending):—archer, bend, come, draw, go (over), guide, lead (forth), thresh, tread (down), walk.

H187.definition: אוּזָל ʼÛwzâl, oo-zawl'; of uncertain derivation;  Uzal, a son of Joktan:—Uzal.

H1870.definition: דֶּרֶךְ derek, deh'-rek; from H1869;  a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb:—along, away, because of,   by, conversation, custom, (east-) ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, (high-) (path-) way(-side), whither(-soever).

H1875.definition: דָּרַשׁ dârash, daw-rash'; a primitive root;  properly, to tread or frequent; usually to follow (for pursuit or search); by implication, to seek or ask; specifically to worship:—ask, × at all, care for, × diligently, inquire, make inquisition, (necro-) mancer, question, require, search, seek (for, out), × surely.

H1876.definition: דָּשָׁא dâshâʼ, daw-shaw'; a primitive root;  to sprout:—bring forth, spring.

H1877.definition: דֶּשֶׁא desheʼ, deh'-sheh; from H1876;  a sprout; by analogy, grass:—(tender) grass, green, (tender) herb.

H1878.definition: דָּשֵׁן dâshên, daw-shane'; a primitive root; also denominatively (from H1880)  to be fat; transitively, to fatten (or regard as fat); specifically to anoint; figuratively, to satisfy; to remove (fat) ashes (of sacrifices):—accept, anoint, take away the (receive) ashes (from), make (wax) fat.

H188.definition: אוֹי ʼôwy, o'-ee; probably from H183 (in the sense of crying out after);  lamentation; also interjectionally Oh!:—alas, woe.

H1881.definition: דָּת dâth, dawth; of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation;  a royal edict or statute:—commandment, commission, decree, law, manner.

H1882.definition: דָּת dâth, dawth; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1881;:—decree, law.

H1883.definition: דֶּתֶא detheʼ, deh'-thay; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1877:—tender grass.

H1885.definition: דָּתָן Dâthân, daw-thawn'; of uncertain derivation;  Dathan, an Israelite:—Dathan.

H1887.definition: הֵא hêʼ, hay; a primitive particle;  lo!:—behold, lo.

H1889.definition: הֶאָח heʼâch, heh-awkh'; from H1887 and H253;  aha!:—ah, aha, ha.

H189.definition: אֱוִי ʼĔvîy, ev-ee'; probably from H183; desirous;  Evi, a Midianitish chief:—Evi.

H1891.definition: הָבַל hâbal, haw-bal'; a primitive root;  to be vain in act, word, or expectation; specifically to lead astray:—be (become, make) vain.

H1892.definition: הֶבֶל hebel, heh'bel; or (rarely in the abs.) הֲבֵל hăbêl; from H1891;  emptiness or vanity; figuratively, something transitory and unsatisfactory; often used as an adverb:—× altogether, vain, vanity.

H1893.definition: הֶבֶל Hebel, heh'-bel; the same as H1892;  Hebel, the son of Adam:—Abel.

H1896.definition: הֵגֵא Hêgêʼ, hay-gay'; or (by permutation) הֵגַי Hêgay; probably of Persian origin;  Hege or Hegai, a eunuch of Xerxes:—Hegai, Hege.

H1897.definition: הָגָה hâgâh, haw-gaw'; a primitive root (compare H1901);  to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication, to ponder:—imagine, meditate, mourn, mutter, roar, × sore, speak, study, talk, utter.

H1898.definition: הָגָה hâgâh, haw-gaw'; a primitive root;  to remove:—stay, stay away.

H1899.definition: הֶגֶה hegeh, heh'-geh; from H1897;  a muttering (in sighing, thought, or as thunder):—mourning, sound, tale.

H190.definition: אוֹיָה ʼôwyâh, o-yaw'; feminine of H188:—woe.

H1902.definition: הִגָּיוֹן higgâyôwn, hig-gaw-yone'; intensive from H1897;  a murmuring sound, i.e. a musical notation (probably similar to the modern affettuoso to indicate solemnity of movement); by implication, a machination:—device, Higgaion, meditation, solemn sound.

H1904.definition: הָגָר Hâgâr, haw-gawr'; of uncertain (perhaps foreign) derivation;  Hagar, the mother of Ishmael:—Hagar.

H1906.definition: הֵד hêd, hade; for H1959;  a shout:—sounding again.

H1907.definition: הַדָּבָר haddâbâr, had-daw-bawr'; (Aramaic) probably of foreign origin;  a vizier:—counsellor.

H1908.definition: הֲדַד Hădad, had-ad'; probably of foreign origin (compare H111);  Hadad, the name of an idol, and of several kings of Edom:—Hadad.

H1909.definition: הֲדַדְעֶזֶר Hădadʻezer, had-ad-eh'-zer; from H1908 and H5828; Hadad (is his) help;  Hadadezer, a Syrian king:—Hadadezer. Compare H1928.

H191.definition: אֱוִיל ʼĕvîyl, ev-eel'; from an unused root (meaning to be perverse);  (figuratively) silly:—fool(-ish) (man).

H1913.definition: הֲדוֹרָם Hădôwrâm, had-o-rawm'; or הֲדֹרָם Hădôrâm; probably of foreign derivation;  Hadoram, a son of Joktan, and the tribe descended from him:—Hadoram.

H1914.definition: הִדַּי Hidday, hid-dah'ee; of uncertain derivation;  Hiddai, an Israelite:—Hiddai.

H1915.definition: הָדַךְ hâdak, haw-dak'; a primitive root (compare H1854);  to crush with the foot:—tread down.

H1918.definition: הֲדַס hădaç, had-as'; of uncertain derivation;  the myrtle:—myrtle (tree).

H1919.definition: הֲדַסָּה Hădaççâh, had-as-saw'; feminine of H1918;  Hadassah (or Esther):—Hadassah.

H1921.definition: הָדַר hâdar, haw-dar'; a primitive root;  to swell up (literally or figuratively, active or passive); by implication, to favor or honour, be high or proud:—countenance, crooked place, glorious, honour, put forth.

H1926.definition: הָדָר hâdâr, haw-dawr'; from H1921;  magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor:—beauty, comeliness, excellency, glorious, glory, goodly, honour, majesty.

H1927.definition: הֲדָרָה hădârâh, had-aw-raw'; feminine of H1926;  decoration:—beauty, honour.

H1929.definition: הָהּ hâhh, haw; a shortened form of H162;  ah! expressing grief:—woe worth.

H193.definition: אוּל ʼûwl, ool; from an unused root meaning to twist, i.e. (by implication) be strong;  the body (as being rolled together); also powerful:—mighty, strength.

H1930.definition: הוֹ hôw, ho; by permutation from H1929;  oh!:—alas.

H1931.partOfSpeech: demonstrative pronoun, third person singular personal pronoun
H1931.definition: הוּא hûwʼ, hoo; of which the feminine (beyond the Pentateuch) is הִיא hîyʼ; he a primitive word, the third person pronoun singular;  he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are:—he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.

H1932.definition: הוּא hûwʼ, hoo; (Aramaic) or (feminine) הִיא hîyʼ; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1931:—× are, it, this.

H1933.definition: הָוָא hâvâʼ, haw-vaw'; or הָוָה hâvâh; a primitive root (compare H183, H1961) supposed to mean properly, to breathe;  to be (in the sense of existence):—be, × have.

H1934.definition: הָוָא hâvâʼ, hav-aw'; (Aramaic) or הָוָה hâvâh; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1933;  to exist; used in a great variety of applications (especially in connection with other words):—be, become,   behold,   came (to pass),   cease,   cleave,   consider,   do,   give,   have,   judge,   keep,   labour,   mingle (self),   put,   see,   seek,   set,   slay,   take heed, tremble,   walk,   would.

H1935.definition: הוֹד hôwd, hode; from an unused root;  grandeur (i.e. an imposing form and appearance):—beauty, comeliness, excellency, glorious, glory, goodly, honour, majesty.

H1936.definition: הוֹד Hôwd, hode; the same as H1935;  Hod, an Israelite:—Hod.

H1938.definition: הוֹדַוְיָה Hôwdavyâh, ho-dav-yaw'; from H1935 and H3050; majesty of Jah;  Hodavjah, the name of three Israelites:—Hodaviah.

H194.definition: אוּלַי ʼûwlay, oo-lah'ee; or (shortened) אֻלַי ʼulay; from H176;  if not; hence perhaps:—if so be, may be, peradventure, unless.

H1940.definition: הוֹדִיָּה Hôwdîyâh, ho-dee-yaw'; a form for the feminine of H3064;  a Jewess:—Hodiah.

H1941.definition: הוֹדִיָּה Hôwdîyâh, ho-dee-yaw'; a form of H1938;  Hodijah, the name of three Israelites:—Hodijah.

H1942.definition: הַוָּה havvâh, hav-vaw'; from H1933 (in the sense of eagerly coveting and rushing upon;  by implication, of falling); desire; also ruin:—calamity, iniquity, mischief, mischievous (thing), naughtiness, naughty, noisome, perverse thing, substance, very wickedness.

H1943.definition: הֹוָה hôvâh, ho-vaw'; another form for H1942;  ruin:—mischief.

H1945.definition: הוֹי hôwy, hoh'ee; a prolonged form of H1930 (akin to H188);  oh!:—ah, alas, ho, O, woe.

H1946.definition: הוּךְ hûwk, hook; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1981;  to go; causatively, to bring:—bring again, come, go (up).

H1947.definition: הוֹלֵלָה hôwlêlâh, ho-lay-law'; feminine active participle of H1984;  folly:—madness.

H1948.definition: הוֹלֵלוּת hôwlêlûwth, ho-lay-looth'; from active participle of H1984;  folly:—madness.

H1949.definition: הוּם hûwm, hoom; a primitive root (compare H2000);  to make an uproar, or agitate greatly:—destroy, move, make a noise, put, ring again.

H1952.definition: הוֹן hôwn, hone; from the same as H1951 in the sense of H202;  wealth; by implication, enough:—enough,   for nought, riches, substance, wealth.

H1953.definition: הוֹשָׁמָע Hôwshâmâʻ, ho-shaw-maw'; from H3068 and H8085; Jehovah has heard;  Hoshama, an Israelite:—Hoshama.

H1954.definition: הוֹשֵׁעַ Hôwshêaʻ, ho-shay'-ah; from H3467; deliverer;  Hoshea, the name of five Israelites:—Hosea, Hoshea, Oshea.

H1955.definition: הוֹשַׁעְיָה Hôwshaʻyâh, ho-shah-yaw'; from H3467 and H3050; Jah has saved;  Hoshajah, the name of two Israelites:—Hoshaiah.

H1956.definition: הוֹתִיר Hôwthîyr, ho-theer'; from H3498; he has caused to remain;  Hothir, an Israelite:—Hothir.

H1958.definition: הִי hîy, he; for H5092;  lamentation:—woe. (For hiyr, see H1931, H1932.)

H1961.definition: הָיָה hâyâh, haw-yaw; a primitive root (compare H1933);  to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary):—beacon, × altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall,   follow, happen, × have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, × use.

H1963.definition: הֵיךְ hêyk, hake; another form for H349;  how?:—how.

H1964.definition: הֵיכָל hêykâl, hay-kawl'; probably from H3201 (in the sense of capacity);  a large public building, such as a palace or temple:—palace, temple.

H1965.definition: הֵיכַל hêykal, hay-kal'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1964:—palace, temple.

H1968.definition: הֵימָן Hêymân, hay-mawn'; probably from H539; faithful;  Heman, the name of at least two Israelites:—Heman.

H1969.definition: הִין hîyn, heen; probably of Egyptian origin;  a hin or liquid measure:—hin.

H197.definition: אוּלָם ʼûwlâm, oo-lawm'; or (shortened), אֻלָם ʼulâm ; from H481 (in the sense of tying);  a vestibule (as bound to the building):—porch.

H1973.definition: הָלְאָה hâlᵉʼâh, haw-leh-aw'; from the primitive form of the article (hal);  to the distance, i.e. far away; also (of time) thus far:—back, beyond, (hence,-) forward, hitherto, thence, forth, yonder.

H1975.definition: הַלָּז hallâz, hal-lawz'; from H1976;  this or that:—side, that, this.

H1976.definition: הַלָּזֶה hallâzeh, hal-law-zeh'; from the article (see H1973) and H2088;  this very:—this.

H1977.definition: הַלֵּזוּ hallêzûw, hal-lay-zoo'; another form of H1976;  that:—this.

H1980.definition: הָלַךְ hâlak, haw-lak'; akin to H3212; a primitive root;  to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively):—(all) along, apace, behave (self), come, (on) continually, be conversant, depart,   be eased, enter, exercise (self),   follow, forth, forward, get, go (about, abroad, along, away, forward, on, out, up and down),   greater, grow, be wont to haunt, lead, march, × more and more, move (self), needs, on, pass (away), be at the point, quite, run (along),   send, speedily, spread, still, surely,   tale-bearer,   travel(-ler), walk (abroad, on, to and fro, up and down, to places), wander, wax, (way-) faring man, × be weak, whirl.

H1981.definition: הֲלַךְ hălak, hal-ak'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1980 (compare H1946);  to walk:—walk.

H1984.definition: הָלַל hâlal, haw-lal'; a primitive root;  to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make a show, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify:—(make) boast (self), celebrate, commend, (deal, make), fool(-ish, -ly), glory, give (light), be (make, feign self) mad (against), give in marriage, (sing, be worthy of) praise, rage, renowned, shine.

H1986.definition: הָלַם hâlam, haw-lam'; a primitive root;  to strike down; by implication, to hammer, stamp, conquer, disband:—beat (down), break (down), overcome, smite (with the hammer).

H1987.definition: הֶלֶם Helem, hay'-lem; from H1986; smiter;  Helem, the name of two Israelites:—Helem.

H1988.definition: הֲלֹם hălôm, hal-ome'; from the article (see H1973);  hither:—here, hither(-to), thither.

H199.definition: אוּלָם ʼûwlâm, oo-lawm'; apparently a variation of H194;  however or on the contrary:—as for, but, howbeit, in very deed, surely, truly, wherefore.

H1992.partOfSpeech: third person plural masculine personal pronoun
H1992.definition: הֵם hêm, haym; or (prolonged) הֵמָּה hêmmâh; masculine plural from H1931;  they (only used when emphatic):—it, like, × (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, × so, × such, their, them, these, they, those, which, who, whom, withal, ye.

H1993.definition: הָמָה hâmâh, haw-maw'; a primitive root (compare H1949);  to make a loud sound (like English 'hum'); by implication, to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor:—clamorous, concourse, cry aloud, be disquieted, loud, mourn, be moved, make a noise, rage, roar, sound, be troubled, make in tumult, tumultuous, be in an uproar.

H1994.definition: הִמּוֹ himmôw, him-mo'; (Aramaic) or (prolonged) הִמּוֹן himmôwn; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1992;  they:—× are, them, those.

H1995.definition: הָמוֹן hâmôwn, haw-mone'; or הָמֹן hâmôn; (Ezekiel 5:7), from H1993;  a noise, tumult, crowd; also disquietude, wealth:—abundance, company, many, multitude, multiply, noise, riches, rumbling, sounding, store, tumult.

H200.definition: אִוֶּלֶת ʼivveleth, iv-veh'-leth; from the same as H191;  silliness:—folly, foolishly(-ness).

H2000.definition: הָמַם hâmam, haw-mam'; a primitive root (compare H1949, H1993);  properly, to put in commotion; by implication, to disturb, drive, destroy:—break, consume, crush, destroy, discomfit, trouble, vex.

H2001.definition: הָמָן Hâmân, haw-mawn'; of foreign derivation;  Haman, a Persian vizier:—Haman.

H2004.definition: הֵן hên, hane; feminine plural from H1931;  they (only used when emphatic):—× in, such like, (with) them, thereby, therein, (more than) they, wherein, in which, whom, withal.

H2005.definition: הֵן hên, hane; a primitive particle;  lo!; also (as expressing surprise) if:—behold, if, lo, though.

H2006.definition: הֵן hên, hane; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2005;  lo! also there(-fore), (un-) less, whether, but, if:—(that) if, or, whether.

H2007.partOfSpeech: third person plural feminine personal pronoun
H2007.definition: הֵנָּה hênnâh, hane'-naw; prolongation for H2004;  themselves (often used emphatic for the copula, also in indirect relation):—× in, × such (and such things), their, (into) them, thence, therein, these, they (had), on this side, whose, wherein.

H2008.definition: הֵנָּה hênnâh, hane'-naw; from H2004;  hither or thither (but used both of place and time):—here, hither(-to), now, on this (that) side,   since, this (that) way, thitherward,   thus far, to...fro,   yet.

H2009.definition: הִנֵּה hinnêh, hin-nay'; prolongation for H2005;  lo!:—behold, lo, see.

H201.definition: אוֹמָר ʼÔwmâr, o-mawr'; from H559; talkative;  Omar, a grandson of Esau:—Omar.

H2012.definition: הֵנַע Hênaʻ, hay-nah'; probably of foreign derivation;  Hena, a place apparently in Mesopotamia:—Hena.

H2013.definition: הָסָה hâçâh, haw-saw'; a primitive root;  to hush:—hold peace (tongue), (keep) silence, be silent, still.

H2015.definition: הָפַךְ hâphak, haw-fak'; a primitive root;  to turn about or over; by implication, to change, overturn, return, pervert:—× become, change, come, be converted, give, make (a bed), overthrow (-turn), perverse, retire, tumble, turn (again, aside, back, to the contrary, every way).

H202.definition: אוֹן ʼôwn, one; probably from the same as H205 (in the sense of effort, but successful);  ability, power, (figuratively) wealth:—force, goods, might, strength, substance.

H2022.definition: הַר har, har; a shortened form of H2042;  a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively):—hill (country), mount(-ain), × promotion.

H2023.definition: הֹר Hôr, hore; another form of H2022; mountain;  Hor, the name of a peak in Idumaea and of one in Syria:—Hor.

H2024.definition: הָרָא Hârâʼ, haw-raw'; perhaps from H2022; mountainousness;  Hara, a region of Media:—Hara.

H2026.definition: הָרַג hârag, haw-rag'; a primitive root;  to smite with deadly intent:—destroy, out of hand, kill, murder(-er), put to (death), make (slaughter), slay(-er), × surely.

H2027.definition: הֶרֶג hereg, heh'-reg; from H2026;  slaughter:—be slain, slaughter.

H2029.definition: הָרָה hârâh, haw-raw'; a primitive root;  to be (or become) pregnant, conceive (literally or figuratively):—been, be with child, conceive, progenitor.

H2030.definition: הָרֶה hâreh, haw-reh'; or הָרִי hârîy; (Hosea 14:1), from H2029;  pregnant:—(be, woman) with child, conceive, × great.

H2032.definition: הֵרוֹן hêrôwn, hay-rone'; or הֵרָיוֹן hêrâyôwn; from H2029;  pregnancy:—conception.

H2036.definition: הֹרָם Hôrâm, ho-rawm'; from an unused root (meaning to tower up); high;  Horam, a Canaanitish king:—Horam.

H2039.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2039.definition: הָרָן Hârân, haw-rawn'; perhaps from H2022; mountaineer;  Haran, the name of two men:—Haran.

H2040.definition: הָרַס hâraç, haw-ras'; a primitive root;  to pull down or in pieces, break, destroy:—beat down, break (down, through), destroy, overthrow, pluck down, pull down, ruin, throw down, × utterly.

H2042.definition: הָרָר hârâr, haw-rawr'; from an unused root meaning to loom up;  a mountain:—hill, mount(-ain).

H2047.definition: הֲתָךְ Hăthâk, hath-awk'; probably of foreign origin;  Hathak, a Persian eunuch:—Hatach.

H2048.definition: הָתַל hâthal, haw-thal'; a primitive root;  to deride; by implication, to cheat:—deal deceitfully, deceive, mock.

H2049.definition: הָתֹל hâthôl, haw-thole'; from H2048 (only in plural collectively);  a derision:—mocker.

H205.definition: אָוֶן ʼâven, aw-ven'; from an unused root perhaps meaning properly, to pant (hence, to exert oneself, usually in vain; to come to naught);  strictly nothingness; also trouble, vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol:—affliction, evil, false, idol, iniquity, mischief, mourners(-ing), naught, sorrow, unjust, unrighteous, vain, vanity, wicked(-ness). Compare H369.

H2052.definition: וָהֵב Vâhêb, vaw-habe'; of uncertain derivation;  Vaheb, a place in Moab:—what he did.

H2053.definition: וָו vâv, vaw; probably  a hook (the name of the sixth Hebrew letter):—hook.

H2056.definition: וָלָד vâlâd, vaw-lawd'; for H3206;  a boy:—child.

H2057.definition: וַנְיָה Vanyâh, van-yaw'; perhaps for H6043;  Vanjah, an Israelite:—Vaniah.

H2060.definition: וַשְׁתִּי Vashtîy, vash-tee'; of Persian origin;  Vashti, the queen of Xerxes:—Vashti.

H2061.definition: זְאֵב zᵉʼêb, zeh-abe'; from an unused root meaning to be yellow;  a wolf:—wolf.

H2062.definition: זְאֵב Zᵉʼêb, zeh-abe'; the same as H2061;  Zeeb, a Midianitish prince:—Zeeb.

H2063.definition: זֹאת zôʼth, zothe'; irregular feminine of H2088;  this (often used adverb):—hereby (-in, -with), it, likewise, the one (other, same), she, so (much), such (deed), that, therefore, these, this (thing), thus.

H2066.definition: זָבָד Zâbâd, zaw-bawd'; from H2064; giver;  Zabad, the name of seven Israelites:—Zabad.

H2067.definition: זַבְדִּי Zabdîy, zab-dee'; from H2065; giving;  Zabdi, the name of four Israelites:—Zabdi.

H2069.definition: זְבַדְיָה Zᵉbadyâh, zeb-ad-yaw'; or זְבַדְיָהוּ Zᵉbadyâhûw; from H2064 and H3050; Jah has given;  Zebadjah, the name of nine Israelites:—Zebadiah.

H207.definition: אוֹנוֹ ʼÔwnôw, o-no'; or (shortened) אֹנוֹ ʼÔnôw; prolonged from H202; strong;  Ono, a place in Palestine:—Ono.

H2070.definition: זְבוּב zᵉbûwb, zeb-oob'; from an unused root (meaning to flit);  a fly (especially one of a stinging nature):—fly.

H2073.definition: זְבוּל zᵉbûwl, ze-bool'; or זְבֻל zᵉbul; from H2082;  a residence:—dwell in, dwelling, habitation.

H2074.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2074.definition: זְבוּלוּן Zᵉbûwlûwn, zeb-oo-loon'; or זְבֻלוּן Zᵉbulûwn; or זְבוּלֻן Zᵉbûwlun; from H2082; habitation;  Zebulon, a son of Jacob; also his territory and tribe:—Zebulun.

H2076.definition: זָבַח zâbach, zaw-bakh'; a primitive root;  to slaughter an animal (usually in sacrifice):—kill, offer, (do) sacrifice, slay.

H2077.definition: זֶבַח zebach, zeh'-bakh; from H2076;  properly, a slaughter, i.e. the flesh of an animal; by implication, a sacrifice (the victim or the act):—offer(-ing), sacrifice.

H2078.definition: זֶבַח Zebach, zeh'-bakh; the same as H2077; sacrifice;  Zebach, a Midianitish prince:—Zebah.

H2079.definition: זַבַּי Zabbay, zab-bah'-ee; probably by orthographical error for H2140;  Zabbai (or Zaccai), an Israelite:—Zabbai.

H2080.definition: זְבִידָה Zᵉbîydâh, zeb-ee-daw'; feminine from H2064; giving;  Zebidah, an Israelitess:—Zebudah.

H2081.definition: זְבִינָא Zᵉbîynâʼ, zeb-ee-naw'; from an unused root (meaning to purchase); gainfulness;  Zebina, an Israelite:—Zebina.

H2083.definition: זְבֻל Zᵉbul, zeb-ool'; the same as H2073; dwelling;  Zebul, an Israelite:—Zebul. Compare H2073.

H2086.definition: זֵד zêd, zade'; from H2102;  arrogant:—presumptuous, proud.

H2087.definition: זָדוֹן zâdôwn, zaw-done'; from H2102;  arrogance:—presumptuously, pride, proud (man).

H2088.definition: זֶה zeh, zeh; a primitive word;  the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that:—he, × hence, × here, it(-self), × now, × of him, the one...the other, × than the other, (× out of) the (self) same, such (a one) that, these, this (hath, man), on this side...on that side, × thus, very, which. Compare H2063, H2090, H2097, H2098.

H209.definition: אוֹנָן ʼÔwnân, o-nawn'; a variation of H207; strong;  Onan, a son of Judah:—Onan.

H2090.definition: זֹה zôh, zo; for H2088;  this or that:—as well as another, it, this, that, thus and thus.

H2091.definition: זָהָב zâhâb, zaw-hawb'; from an unused root meaning to shimmer;  gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky:—gold(-en), fair weather.

H2092.definition: זָהַם zâham, zaw-ham'; a primitive root;  to be rancid, i.e. (transitively) to loathe:—abhor.

H2094.definition: זָהַר zâhar, zaw-har'; a primitive root;  to gleam; figuratively, to enlighten (by caution):—admonish, shine, teach, (give) warn(-ing).

H2097.definition: זוֹ zôw, zo; for H2088;  this or that:—that, this.

H2098.definition: זוּ zûw, zoo; for H2088;  this or that:—that, this, × wherein, which, whom.

H2100.definition: זוּב zûwb, zoob; a primitive root;  to flow freely (as water), i.e. (specifically) to have a (sexual) flux; figuratively, to waste away; also to overflow:—flow, gush out, have a (running) issue, pine away, run.

H2101.definition: זוֹב zôwb, zobe; from H2100;  a seminal or menstrual flux:—issue.

H2102.definition: זוּד zûwd, zood; or (by permutation) זִיד zîyd; a primitive root;  to seethe; figuratively, to be insolent:—be proud, deal proudly, presume, (come) presumptuously, sod.

H2108.definition: זוּלָה zûwlâh, zoo-law'; from H2107;  probably scattering, i.e. removal; used adverbially, except:—beside, but, only, save.

H211.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H211.definition: אוֹפִיר ʼÔwphîyr, o-feer'; or (shortened) אֹפִיר ʼÔphîyr; and אוֹפִר ʼÔwphir; of uncertain derivation;  Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan, and of a gold region in the East:—Ophir.

H2110.definition: זוּן zûwn, zoon; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2109:—feed.

H2111.definition: זוּעַ zûwaʻ, zoo'-ah; a primitive root;  properly, to shake off, i.e. (figuratively) to agitate (as with fear):—move, tremble, vex.

H2113.definition: זְוָעָה zᵉvâʻâh, zev-aw-aw'; from H2111;  agitation, fear:—be removed, trouble, vexation. Compare H2189.

H2114.definition: זוּר zûwr, zoor; a primitive root;  to turn aside (especially for lodging); hence to be a foreigner, strange, profane; specifically (active participle) to commit adultery:—(come from) another (man, place), fanner, go away, (e-) strange(-r, thing, woman).

H2118.definition: זָחַח zâchach, zaw-khakh'; a primitive root;  to shove or displace:—loose.

H2119.definition: זָחַל zâchal, zaw-khal'; a primitive root;  to crawl; by implication, to fear:—be afraid, serpent, worm.

H212.definition: אוֹפָן ʼôwphân, o-fawn'; or (shortened) אֹפָן ʼôphân; from an unused root meaning to revolve;  a wheel:—wheel.

H2123.definition: זִיז zîyz, zeez; from an unused root apparently meaning to be conspicuous;  fulness of the breast; also a moving creature:—abundance, wild beast.

H2124.definition: זִיזָא Zîyzâʼ, zee-zaw'; apparently from the same as H2123; prominence;  Ziza, the name of two Israelites:—Ziza.

H2126.definition: זִינָא Zîynâʼ, zee-naw'; from H2109; well-fed; or perhaps an orthographical error for H2124;  Zina, an Israelite:—Zina.

H2127.definition: זִיעַ Zîyaʻ, zee'-ah; from H2111; agitation;  Zia, an Israelite:—Zia.

H2128.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2128.definition: זִיף Zîyph, zeef; from the same as H2203; flowing;  Ziph, the name of a place in Palestine; also of an Israelite:—Ziph.

H213.definition: אוּץ ʼûwts, oots; a primitive root;  to press; (by implication) to be close, hurry, withdraw:—(make) haste(-n, -y), labor, be narrow.

H2131.definition: זִיקָה zîyqâh, zee-kaw'; (Isaiah 50:11) (feminine); and זִק ziq; or זֵק zêq; from H2187;  properly, what leaps forth, i.e. flash of fire, or a burning arrow; also (from the original sense of the root) a bond:—chain, fetter, firebrand, spark.

H2132.definition: זַיִת zayith, zay'-yith; probably from an unused root (akin to H2099);  an olive (as yielding illuminating oil), the tree, the branch or the berry:—olive (tree, -yard), Olivet.

H2133.definition: זֵיתָן Zêythân, zay-thawn'; from H2132; olive grove;  Zethan, an Israelite:—Zethan.

H2134.definition: זַךְ zak, zak; from H2141;  clear:—clean, pure.

H2135.definition: זָכָה zâkâh, zaw-kaw'; a primitive root (compare H2141);  to be translucent; figuratively, to be innocent:—be (make) clean, cleanse, be clear, count pure.

H2139.definition: זַכּוּר Zakkûwr, zaw-koor'; from H2142; mindful;  Zakkur, the name of seven Israelites:—Zaccur, Zacchur.

H214.definition: אוֹצָר ʼôwtsâr, o-tsaw'; from H686;  a depository:—armory, cellar, garner, store(-house), treasure(-house) (-y).

H2140.definition: זַכַּי Zakkay, zak-kah'-ee; from H2141; pure;  Zakkai, an Israelite:—Zaccai.

H2142.definition: זָכַר zâkar, zaw-kar'; a primitive root; also as denominative from H2145  properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male:—× burn (incense), × earnestly, be male, (make) mention (of), be mindful, recount, record(-er), remember, make to be remembered, bring (call, come, keep, put) to (in) remembrance, × still, think on, × well.

H2143.definition: זֵכֶר zêker, zay'-ker; or זֶכֶר zeker; from H2142;  a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration:—memorial, memory, remembrance, scent.

H2145.definition: זָכָר zâkâr, zaw-kawr'; from H2142;  properly, remembered, i.e. a male (of man or animals, as being the most noteworthy sex):—× him, male, man(child, -kind).

H2146.definition: זִכְרוֹן zikrôwn, zik-rone'; from H2142;  a memento (or memorable thing, day or writing):—memorial, record.

H2147.definition: זִכְרִי Zikrîy, zik-ree'; from H2142; memorable;  Zicri, the name of twelve Israelites:—Zichri.

H2148.definition: זְכַרְיָה Zᵉkaryâh, zek-ar-yaw'; or זְכַרְיָהוּ Zᵉkaryâhûw; from H2142 and H3050; Jah has remembered;  Zecarjah, the name of twenty-nine Israelites:—Zachariah, Zechariah.

H215.definition: אוֹר ʼôwr, ore; a primitive root;  to be (causative, make) luminous (literally and metaphorically):—× break of day, glorious, kindle, (be, en-, give, show) light (-en, -ened), set on fire, shine.

H2151.definition: זָלַל zâlal, zaw-lal'; a primitive root (compare H2107);  to shake (as in the wind), i.e. to quake; figuratively, to be loose morally, worthless or prodigal:—blow down, glutton, riotous (eater), vile.

H2152.definition: זַלְעָפָה zalʻâphâh, zal-aw-faw'; or זִלְעָפָה zilʻâphâhxlit zilʻâphâph corrected to zilʻâphâh; from H2196;  a glow (of wind or anger); also a famine (as consuming):—horrible, horror, terrible.

H2153.definition: זִלְפָּה Zilpâh, zil-paw; from an unused root apparently meaning to trickle, as myrrh; fragrant dropping;  Zilpah, Leah's maid:—Zilpah.

H2154.definition: זִמָּה zimmâh, zim-maw'; or זַמָּה zammâh; from H2161;  a plan, especially a bad one:—heinous crime, lewd(-ly, -ness), mischief, purpose, thought, wicked (device, mind, -ness).

H2155.definition: זִמָּה Zimmâh, zim-maw'; the same as H2154;  Zimmah, the name of two Israelites:—Zimmah.

H2156.definition: זְמוֹרָה zᵉmôwrâh, zem-o-raw'; or זְמֹרָה zᵉmôrâh (feminine); and זְמֹר zᵉmôr (masculine); from H2168;  a twig (as pruned):—vine, branch, slip.

H2158.definition: זָמִיר zâmîyr, zaw-meer'; or זָמִר zâmir; and (feminine) זְמִרָה zᵉmirâh; from H2167;  a song to be accompanied with instrumental music:—psalm(-ist), singing, song.

H216.definition: אוֹר ʼôwr, ore; from H215;  illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.):—bright, clear,   day, light (-ning), morning, sun.

H2161.definition: זָמַם zâmam, zaw-mam'; a primitive root;  to plan, usually in a bad sense:—consider, devise, imagine, plot, purpose, think (evil).

H2163.definition: זָמַן zâman, zaw-man'; a primitive root;  to fix (a time):—appoint.

H2165.definition: זְמָן zᵉmân, zem-awn'; from H2163;  an appointed occasion:—season, time.

H2166.definition: זְמָן zᵉmân, zem-awn'; (Aramaic) from H2165; the same as H2165:—season, time.

H2167.definition: זָמַר zâmar, zaw-mar'; a primitive root (perhaps identical with H2168 through the idea of striking with the fingers);  properly, to touch the strings or parts of a musical instrument, i.e. play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music:—give praise, sing forth praises, psalms.

H2168.definition: זָמַר zâmar, zaw-mar'; a primitive root (compare H2167, H5568, H6785);  to trim (a vine):—prune.

H217.definition: אוּר ʼûwr, oor; from H215;  flame; hence (in the plural) the East (as being the region of light):—fire, light. See also H224.

H2170.definition: זְמָר zᵉmâr, zem-awr'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2167;  instrumental music:—musick.

H2171.definition: זַמָּר zammâr, zam-mawr'; (Aramaic) from the same as H2170;  an instrumental musician:—singer.

H2174.definition: זִמְרִי Zimrîy, zim-ree'; from H2167; musical;  Zimri, the name of five Israelites, and of an Arabian tribe:—Zimri.

H2175.definition: זִמְרָן Zimrân, zim-rawn'; from H2167; musical;  Zimran, a son of Abraham by Keturah:—Zimran.

H2177.definition: זַן zan, zan; from H2109;  properly, nourished (or fully developed), i.e. a form or sort:—divers kinds, × all manner of store.

H2180.definition: זָנָב zânâb, zaw-nawb'; from H2179 (in the original sense of flapping);  the tail (literally or figuratively):—tail.

H2181.definition: זָנָה zânâh, zaw-naw'; a primitive root [highly fed and therefore wanton];  to commit adultery (usually of the female, and less often of simple fornication, rarely of involuntary ravishment); figuratively, to commit idolatry (the Jewish people being regarded as the spouse of Jehovah):—(cause to) commit fornication, × continually, × great, (be an, play the) harlot, (cause to be, play the) whore, (commit, fall to) whoredom, (cause to) go a-whoring, whorish.

H2182.definition: זָנוֹחַ Zânôwach, zaw-no'-akh; from H2186; rejected;  Zanoach, the name of two places in Palestine:—Zanoah.

H2186.definition: זָנַח zânach, zaw-nakh'; a primitive root meaning to push aside, i.e.  reject, forsake, fail:—cast away (off), remove far away (off).

H219.definition: אוֹרָה ʼôwrâh, o-raw'; feminine of H216;  luminousness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity; also a plant (as being bright):—herb, light.

H2190.definition: זַעֲוָן Zaʻăvân, zah-av-awn'; from H2111; disquiet;  Zaavan, an Idumaean:—Zaavan.

H2192.definition: זְעֵיר zᵉʻêyr, zeh-ayr'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2191:—little.

H2194.definition: זָעַם zâʻam, zaw-am'; a primitive root;  properly, to foam at the mouth, i.e. to be enraged:—abhor, abominable, (be) angry, defy, (have) indignation.

H2196.definition: זָעַף zâʻaph, zaw-af'; a primitive root;  properly, to boil up, i.e. (figuratively) to be peevish or angry:—fret, sad, worse liking, be wroth.

H2197.definition: זַעַף zaʻaph, zah'-af; from H2196;  anger:—indignation, rage(-ing), wrath.

H2199.definition: זָעַק zâʻaq, zaw-ak'; a primitive root;  to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly:—assemble, call (together), (make a) cry (out), come with such a company, gather (together), cause to be proclaimed.

H22.definition: אֲבִיאֵל ʼĂbîyʼêl, ab-ee-ale'; from H1 and H410; father (i.e. possessor) of God;  Abiel, the name of two Israelites:—Abiel.

H2201.definition: זַעַק zaʻaq, zah'-ak; and (feminine) זְעָקָה zᵉʻâqâhxlit zᵉâqâh corrected to zᵉʻâqâh; from H2199;  a shriek or outcry:—cry(-ing).

H2203.definition: זֶפֶת zepheth, zeh'-feth; from an unused root (meaning to liquify);  asphalt (from its tendency to soften in the sun):—pitch.

H2204.definition: זָקֵן zâqên, zaw-kane'; a primitive root;  to be old:—aged man, be (wax) old (man).

H2205.definition: זָקֵן zâqên, zaw-kane'; from H2204;  old:—aged, ancient (man), elder(-est), old (man, men and...women), senator.

H2206.definition: זָקָן zâqân, zaw-kawn'; from H2204;  the beard (as indicating age):—beard.

H2208.definition: זָקֻן zâqun, zaw-koon'; properly, passive participle of H2204 (used only in the plural as a noun);  old age:—old age.

H2209.definition: זִקְנָה ziqnâh, zik-naw'; feminine of H2205;  old age:—old (age).

H221.definition: אוּרִי ʼÛwrîy, oo-ree'; from H217; fiery;  Uri, the name of three Israelites:—Uri.

H2212.definition: זָקַק zâqaq, zaw-kak'; a primitive root;  to strain, (figuratively) extract, clarify:—fine, pour down, purge, purify, refine.

H2213.definition: זֵר zêr, zare; from H2237 (in the sense of scattering);  a chaplet (as spread around the top), i.e. (specifically) a border moulding:—crown.

H2214.definition: זָרָא zârâʼ, zaw-raw'; from H2114 (in the sense of estrangement) (compare H2219);  disgust:—loathsome.

H2216.definition: זְרֻבָּבֶל Zᵉrubbâbel, zer-oob-baw-bel'; from H2215 and H894; descended of (i.e. from) Babylon, i.e. born there;  Zerubbabel, an Israelite:—Zerubbabel.

H2217.definition: זְרֻבָּבֶל Zᵉrubbâbel, zer-oob-baw-bel'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2216:—Zerubbabel.

H2218.definition: זֶרֶד Zered, zeh'-red; from an unused root meaning to be exuberant in growth; lined with shrubbery;  Zered, a brook East of the Dead Sea:—Zared, Zered.

H2219.definition: זָרָה zârâh, zaw-raw'; a primitive root (compare H2114);  to toss about; by implication, to diffuse, winnow:—cast away, compass, disperse, fan, scatter (away), spread, strew, winnow.

H222.definition: אוּרִיאֵל ʼÛwrîyʼêl, oo-ree-ale'; from H217 and H410; flame of God;  Uriel, the name of two Israelites:—Uriel.

H2220.definition: זְרוֹעַ zᵉrôwaʻ, zer-o'-ah; or (shortened) זְרֹעַ zᵉrôaʻ; and (feminine) זְרוֹעָה zᵉrôwʻâh; or זְרֹעָה zᵉrôʻâh; from H2232;  the arm (as stretched out), or (of animals) the foreleg; figuratively, force:—arm,   help, mighty, power, shoulder, strength.

H2221.definition: זֵרוּעַ zêrûwaʻ, zay-roo'-ah; from H2232;  something sown, i.e. a plant:—sowing, thing that is sown.

H2224.definition: זָרַח zârach, zaw-rakh'; a primitive root;  properly, to irradiate (or shoot forth beams), i.e. to rise (as the sun); specifically, to appear (as a symptom of leprosy):—arise, rise (up), as soon as it is up.

H2226.definition: זֶרַח Zerach, zeh'-rakh; the same as H2225;  Zerach, the name of three Israelites, also of an Idumaean and an Ethiopian prince:—Zarah, Zerah.

H2228.definition: זְרַחְיָה Zᵉrachyâh, zer-akh-yaw'; from H2225 and H3050; Jah has risen;  Zerachjah, the name of two Israelites:—Zerahiah.

H2229.definition: זָרַם zâram, zaw-ram'; a primitive root;  to gush (as water):—carry away as with a flood, pour out.

H223.definition: אוּרִיָּה ʼÛwrîyâh, oo-ree-yaw'; or (prolonged) אוּרִיָּהוּ ʼÛwrîyâhûw ; from H217 and H3050; flame of Jah;  Urijah, the name of one Hittite and five Israelites:—Uriah, Urijah.

H2232.definition: זָרַע zâraʻ, zaw-rah'; a primitive root;  to sow; figuratively, to disseminate, plant, fructify:—bear, conceive seed, set with sow(-er), yield.

H2233.definition: זֶרַע zeraʻ, zeh'-rah; from H2232;  seed; figuratively, fruit, plant, sowing-time, posterity:—× carnally, child, fruitful, seed(-time), sowing-time.

H2235.definition: זֵרֹעַ zêrôaʻ, zay-ro'-ah; or זֵרָעֹן zêrâʻôn; from H2232;  something sown (only in the plural), i.e. a vegetable (as food):—pulse.

H2236.definition: זָרַק zâraq, zaw-rak'; a primitive root;  to sprinkle (fluid or solid particles):—be here and there, scatter, sprinkle, strew.

H2237.definition: זָרַר zârar, zaw-rar'; a primitive root (compare H2114);  perhaps to diffuse, i.e. (specifically) to sneeze:—sneeze.

H2238.definition: זֶרֶשׁ Zeresh, zeh'-resh; of Persian origin;  Zeresh, Haman's wife:—Zeresh.

H2239.definition: זֶרֶת zereth, zeh'-reth; from H2219;  the spread of the fingers, i.e. a span:—span.

H2240.definition: זַתּוּא Zattûwʼ, zat-too'; of uncertain derivation;  Zattu, an Israelite:—Zattu.

H2241.definition: זֵתָם Zêthâm, zay-thawm'; apparently a variation for H2133;  Zetham, an Israelite:—Zetham.

H2242.definition: זֵתַר Zêthar, zay-thar'; of Persian origin;  Zethar, a eunuch of Xerxes:—Zethar.

H2244.definition: חָבָא châbâʼ, khaw-baw'; a primitive root (compare H2245);  to secrete:—× held, hide (self), do secretly.

H2246.definition: חֹבָב Chôbâb, kho-bawb'; from H2245; cherished;  Chobab, father-in-law of Moses:—Hobab.

H2249.definition: חָבוֹר Châbôwr, khaw-bore'; from H2266; united;  Chabor, a river of Assyria:—Habor.

H225.definition: אוּת ʼûwth, ooth; a primitive root;  properly, to come, i.e. (implied) to assent:—consent.

H2250.definition: חַבּוּרָה chabbûwrâh, khab-boo-raw'; or חַבֻּרָה chabburâh; or חֲבֻרָה chăburâh; from H2266;  properly, bound (with stripes), i.e. a weal (or black-and-blue mark itself):—blueness, bruise, hurt, stripe, wound.

H2254.definition: חָבַל châbal, khaw-bal'; a primitive root;  to wind tightly (as a rope), i.e. to bind; specifically, by a pledge; figuratively, to pervert, destroy; also to writhe in pain (especially of parturition):—× at all, band, bring forth, (deal) corrupt(-ly), destroy, offend, lay to (take a) pledge, spoil, travail, × very, withhold.

H2256.definition: חֶבֶל chebel, kheh'-bel; or חֵבֶל chêbel; from H2254;  a rope (as twisted), especially a measuring line; by implication, a district or inheritance (as measured); or a noose (as of cords); figuratively, a company (as if tied together); a throe (especially of parturition); also ruin:—band, coast, company, cord, country, destruction, line, lot, pain, pang, portion, region, rope, snare, sorrow, tackling.

H226.definition: אוֹת ʼôwth, oth; probably from H225 (in the sense of appearing);  a signal (literally or figuratively), as a flag, beacon, monument, omen, prodigy, evidence, etc.:—mark, miracle, (en-) sign, token.

H2263.definition: חָבַק châbaq, khaw-bak'; a primitive root;  to clasp (the hands or in embrace):—embrace, fold.

H2264.definition: חִבֻּק chibbuq, khib-book'; from H2263;  a clasping of the hands (in idleness):—fold.

H2265.definition: חֲבַקּוּק Chăbaqqûwq, khab-ak-kook'; by reduplication from H2263; embrace;  Chabakkuk, the prophet:—Habakkuk.

H2266.definition: חָבַר châbar, khaw-bar'; a primitive root;  to join (literally or figuratively); specifically (by means of spells) to fascinate:—charm(-er), be compact, couple (together), have fellowship with, heap up, join (self, together), league.

H2267.definition: חֶבֶר cheber, kheh'-ber; from H2266;  a society; also a spell:—  charmer(-ing), company, enchantment, × wide.

H2268.definition: חֶבֶר Cheber, kheh'-ber; the same as H2267; community;  Cheber, the name of a Kenite and of three Israelites:—Heber.

H227.definition: אָז ʼâz, awz; a demonstrative adverb;  at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore:—beginning, for, from, hitherto, now, of old, once, since, then, at which time, yet.

H2270.definition: חָבֵר châbêr, khaw-bare'; from H2266;  an associate:—companion, fellow, knit together.

H2274.definition: חֶבְרָה chebrâh, kheb-raw'; feminine of H2267;  association:—company.

H2275.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2275.definition: חֶבְרוֹן Chebrôwn, kheb-rone'; from H2267; seat of association;  Chebron, a place in Palestine, also the name of two Israelites:—Hebron.

H2279.definition: חֹבֶרֶת chôbereth, kho-beh'-reth; feminine active participle of H2266;  a joint:—which coupleth, coupling.

H228.definition: אֲזָא ʼăzâʼ, az-zaw'; (Aramaic) or אֲזָה ʼăzâh (Aramaic);  to kindle; (by implication) to heat:—heat, hot.

H2280.definition: חָבַשׁ châbash, khaw-bash'; a primitive root;  to wrap firmly (especially a turban, compress, or saddle); figuratively, to stop, to rule:—bind (up), gird about, govern, healer, put, saddle, wrap about.

H2282.definition: חַג chag, khag; or חָג châg; from H2287;  a festival, or a victim therefor:—(solemn) feast (day), sacrifice, solemnity.

H2287.definition: חָגַג châgag, khaw-gag'; a primitive root (compare H2283, H2328);  properly, to move in a circle, i.e. (specifically) to march in a sacred procession, to observe a festival; by implication, to be giddy:—celebrate, dance, (keep, hold) a (solemn) feast (holiday), reel to and fro.

H2292.definition: חַגַּי Chaggay, khag-gah'-ee; from H2282; festive;  Chaggai, a Hebrew prophet:—Haggai.

H2293.definition: חַגִּיָּה Chaggîyâh, khag-ghee-yaw'; from H2282 and H3050; festival of Jah;  Chaggijah, an Israelite:—Haggiah.

H2295.definition: חׇגְלָה Choglâh, khog-law'; of uncertain derivation; probably a partridge;  Choglah, an Israelitess:—Hoglah. See also H1031.

H2296.definition: חָגַר châgar, khaw-gar'; a primitive root;  to gird on (as a belt, armor, etc.):—be able to put on, be afraid, appointed, gird, restrain, × on every side.

H2298.definition: חַד chad, khad; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2297;  as card. one; as article single; as an ordinal, first; adverbially, at once:—a, first, one, together.

H2299.definition: חַד chad, khad; from H2300;  sharp:—sharp.

H2300.definition: חָדַד châdad, khaw-dad'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, make) sharp or (figuratively) severe:—be fierce, sharpen.

H2301.definition: חֲדַד Chădad, khad-ad'; from H2300; fierce;  Chadad, an Ishmaelite:—Hadad.

H2302.definition: חָדָה châdâh, khaw-daw'; a primitive root;  to rejoice:—make glad, be joined, rejoice.

H2307.definition: חָדִיד Châdîyd, khaw-deed'; from H2300; a peak;  Chadid, a place in Palestine:—Hadid.

H2308.definition: חָדַל châdal, khaw-dal'; a primitive root;  properly, to be flabby, i.e. (by implication) desist; (figuratively) be lacking or idle:—cease, end, fall, forbear, forsake, leave (off), let alone, rest, be unoccupied, want.

H231.definition: אֵזוֹב ʼêzôwb, ay-zobe'; probably of foreign derivation;  hyssop:—hyssop.

H2315.definition: חֶדֶר cheder, kheh'-der; from H2314;  an apartment (usually literal):—((bed) inner) chamber, innermost(-ward) part, parlour,   south, × within.

H2318.definition: חָדַשׁ châdash, khaw-dash'; a primitive root;  to be new; causatively, to rebuild:—renew, repair.

H2319.definition: חָדָשׁ châdâsh, khaw-dawsh'; from H2318;  new:—fresh, new thing.

H2320.definition: חֹדֶשׁ chôdesh, kho'-desh; from H2318;  the new moon; by implication, a month:—month(-ly), new moon.

H2330.definition: חוּד chûwd, khood; a primitive root;  properly, to tie a knot, i.e. (figuratively) to propound a riddle:—put forth.

H2331.definition: חָוָה châvâh, khaw-vah'; a primitive root; (compare H2324, H2421);  properly, to live; by implication (intensively) to declare or show:—show.

H2332.definition: חַוָּה Chavvâh, khav-vaw'; causatively from H2331; life-giver;  Chavvah (or Eve), the first woman:—Eve.

H2334.definition: חַוּוֹת יָעִיר Chavvôwth Yâʻîyr, khav-vothe' yaw-eer'; from the plural of H2333 and a modification of H3265;  hamlets of Jair, a region of Palestine:—(Bashan-) Havoth-jair.

H2339.definition: חוּט chûwṭ, khoot; from an unused root probably meaning to sew;  a string; by implication, a measuring tape:—cord, fillet, line, thread.

H234.definition: אַזְכָּרָה ʼazkârâh, az-kaw-raw'; from H2142;  a reminder; specifically remembrance-offering:—memorial.

H2340.definition: חִוִּי Chivvîy, khiv-vee'; perhaps from H2333; a villager;  a Chivvite, one of the aboriginal tribes of Palestine:—Hivite.

H2341.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2341.definition: חֲוִילָה Chăvîylâh, khav-ee-law'; probably from H2342; circular;  Chavilah, the name of two or three eastern regions; also perhaps of two men:—Havilah.

H2342.definition: חוּל chûwl, khool; or חִיל chîyl; a primitive root;  properly, to twist or whirl (in a circular or spiral manner), i.e. (specifically) to dance, to writhe in pain (especially of parturition) or fear; figuratively, to wait, to pervert:—bear, (make to) bring forth, (make to) calve, dance, drive away, fall grievously (with pain), fear, form, great, grieve, (be) grievous, hope, look, make, be in pain, be much (sore) pained, rest, shake, shapen, (be) sorrow(-ful), stay, tarry, travail (with pain), tremble, trust, wait carefully (patiently), be wounded.

H2343.definition: חוּל Chûwl, khool; from H2342; a circle;  Chul, a son of Aram; also the region settled by him:—Hul.

H2345.definition: חוּם chûwm, khoom; from an unused root meaning to be warm, i.e. (by implication)  sunburnt or swarthy (blackish):—brown.

H2346.definition: חוֹמָה chôwmâh, kho-maw'; feminine active participle of an unused root apparently meaning to join;  a wall of protection:—wall, walled.

H2347.definition: חוּס chûwç, khoos; a primitive root;  properly, to cover, i.e. (figuratively) to compassionate:—pity, regard, spare.

H235.definition: אָזַל ʼâzal, aw-zal'; a primitive root;  to go away, hence, to disappear:—fail, gad about, go to and fro (but in Ezekiel 27:19 the word is rendered by many 'from Uzal,' by others 'yarn'), be gone (spent).

H2351.definition: חוּץ chûwts, khoots; or (shortened) חֻץ chuts; (both forms feminine in the plural) from an unused root meaning to sever;  properly, separate by a wall, i.e. outside, outdoors:—abroad, field, forth, highway, more, out(-side, -ward), street, without.

H2353.definition: חוּר chûwr, khoor; from H2357;  white linen:—white.

H2354.definition: חוּר Chûwr, khoor; the same as H2353 or H2352;  Chur, the name of four Israelites and one Midianite:—Hur.

H2356.definition: חוֹר chôwr, khore; or (shortened) חֹר chôr; the same as H2352;  a cavity, socket, den:—cave, hole.

H2357.definition: חָוַר châvar, khaw-var'; a primitive root;  to blanch (as with shame):—wax pale.

H236.definition: אֲזַל ʼăzal, az-al'; (Aramaic) the same as H235;  to depart:—go (up).

H2360.definition: חוּרַי Chûwray, khoo-rah'ee; probably an orthographical variation for H2359;  Churai, an Israelite:—Hurai.

H2361.definition: חוּרָם Chûwrâm, khoo-rawm'; probably from H2353; whiteness, i.e. noble;  Churam, the name of an Israelite and two Syrians:—Huram. Compare H2438.

H2362.definition: חַוְרָן Chavrân, khav-rawn'; apparently from H2357 (in the sense of H2352); cavernous;  Chavran, a region East of the Jordan:—Hauran.

H2363.definition: חוּשׁ chûwsh, koosh; a primitive root;  to hurry; figuratively, to be eager with excitement or enjoyment:—(make) haste(-n), ready.

H2365.definition: חוּשַׁי Chûwshay, khoo-shah'-ee; from H2363; hasty;  Chushai, an Israelite:—Hushai.

H2366.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper masculine noun
H2366.definition: חוּשִׁים Chûwshîym, khoo-sheem'; or חֻשִׁים Chushîym; or חֻשִׁם Chushim; plural from H2363; hasters;  Chushim, the name of three Israelites:—Hushim.

H2367.definition: חוּשָׁם Chûwshâm, khoo-shawm'; or חֻשָׁם Chushâm; from H2363; hastily;  Chusham, an Idumaean:—Husham.

H2368.definition: חוֹתָם chôwthâm, kho-thawm'; or חֹתָם chôthâm; from H2856;  a signature-ring:—seal, signet.

H2370.definition: חֲזָא chăzâʼ, khaz-aw'; (Aramaic) or חֲזָה chăzâh; (Aramaic), corresponding to H2372;  to gaze upon; mentally to dream, be usual (i.e. seem):—behold, have (a dream), see, be wont.

H2371.definition: חֲזָאֵל Chăzâʼêl, khaz-aw-ale'; or חֲזָהאֵל Chăzâhʼêl; from H2372 and H410; God has seen;  Chazael, a king of Syria:—Hazael.

H2372.definition: חָזָה châzâh, khaw-zaw'; a primitive root;  to gaze at; mentally to perceive, contemplate (with pleasure); specifically, to have a vision of:—behold, look, prophesy, provide, see.

H2373.definition: חָזֶה châzeh, khaw-zeh'; from H2372;  the breast (as most seen in front):—breast.

H2374.definition: חֹזֶה chôzeh, kho-zeh'; active participle of H2372;  a beholder in vision; also a compact (as looked upon with approval):—agreement, prophet, see that, seer, (star-) gazer.

H2376.definition: חֵזֵו chêzêv, khay'-zev; (Aramaic) from H2370;  a sight:—look, vision.

H2377.definition: חָזוֹן châzôwn, khaw-zone'; from H2372;  a sight (mentally), i.e. a dream, revelation, or oracle:—vision.

H238.definition: אָזַן ʼâzan, aw-zan'; a primitive root; probably to expand; but used only as a denominative from H241;  to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen:—give (perceive by the) ear, hear(-ken). See H239.

H2380.definition: חָזוּת châzûwth, khaw-zooth'; from H2372;  a look; hence (figuratively) striking appearance, revelation, or (by implication) compact:—agreement, notable (one), vision.

H2384.definition: חִזָּיוֹן chizzâyôwn, khiz-zaw-yone'; from H2372;  a revelation, expectation by dream:—vision.

H2385.definition: חֲזִיז chăzîyz, khaw-zeez'; from an unused root meaning to glare;  a flash of lightning:—bright cloud, lightning.

H2386.definition: חֲזִיר chăzîyr, khaz-eer'; from an unused root probably meaning to inclose;  a hog (perhaps as penned):—boar, swine.

H2387.definition: חֵזִיר Chêzîyr, khay-zeer'; from the same as H2386; perhaps protected;  Chezir, the name of two Israelites:—Hezir.

H2388.definition: חָזַק châzaq, khaw-zak'; a primitive root;  to fasten upon; hence, to seize, be strong (figuratively, courageous, causatively strengthen, cure, help, repair, fortify), obstinate; to bind, restrain, conquer:—aid, amend, × calker, catch, cleave, confirm, be constant, constrain, continue, be of good (take) courage(-ous, -ly), encourage (self), be established, fasten, force, fortify, make hard, harden, help, (lay) hold (fast), lean, maintain, play the man, mend, become (wax) mighty, prevail, be recovered, repair, retain, seize, be (wax) sore, strengthen (self), be stout, be (make, shew, wax) strong(-er), be sure, take (hold), be urgent, behave self valiantly, withstand.

H2389.definition: חָזָק châzâq, khaw-zawk'; from H2388;  strong (usu. in a bad sense, hard, bold, violent):—harder, hottest,   impudent, loud, mighty, sore, stiff(-hearted), strong(-er).

H2393.definition: חֶזְקָה chezqâh, khez-kaw'; feminine of H2391;  prevailing power:—strength(-en self), (was) strong.

H2394.definition: חׇזְקָה chozqâh, khoz-kaw'; feminine of H2392;  vehemence (usually in a bad sense):—force, mightily, repair, sharply.

H2395.definition: חִזְקִי Chizqîy, khiz-kee'; from H2388; strong;  Chizki, an Israelite:—Hezeki.

H2396.definition: חִזְקִיָּה Chizqîyâh, khiz-kee-yaw'; or חִזְקִיָּהוּ Chizqîyâhûw; also יְחִזְקִיָּה Yᵉchizqîyâh; or יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ Yᵉchizqîyâhûw; from H2388 and H3050; strengthened of Jah;  Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites:—Hezekiah, Hizkiah, Hizkijah. Compare H3169.

H2397.definition: חָח châch, khawkh; once (Ezekiel 29:4) חָחִי châchîy; from the same as H2336;  a ring for the nose (or lips):—bracelet, chain, hook.

H2398.definition: חָטָא châṭâʼ, khaw-taw'; a primitive root;  properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn:—bear the blame, cleanse, commit (sin), by fault, harm he hath done, loss, miss, (make) offend(-er), offer for sin, purge, purify (self), make reconciliation, (cause, make) sin(-ful, -ness), trespass.

H2399.definition: חֵטְא chêṭᵉʼ, khate; from H2398;  a crime or its penalty:—fault, × grievously, offence, (punishment of) sin.

H24.definition: אָבִיב ʼâbîyb, aw-beeb'; from an unused root (meaning to be tender);  green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan:—Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize).

H2400.definition: חַטָּא chaṭṭâʼ, khat-taw'; intensively from H2398;  a criminal, or one accounted guilty:—offender, sinful, sinner.

H2401.definition: חֲטָאָה chăṭâʼâh, khat-aw-aw'; feminine of H2399;  an offence, or a sacrifice for it:—sin (offering).

H2403.definition: חַטָּאָה chaṭṭâʼâh, khat-taw-aw'; or חַטָּאת chaṭṭâʼth; from H2398;  an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender:—punishment (of sin), purifying(-fication for sin), sin(-ner, offering).

H2406.definition: חִטָּה chiṭṭâh, khit-taw'; of uncertain derivation;  wheat, whether the grain or the plant:—wheat(-en).

H2407.definition: חַטּוּשׁ Chaṭṭûwsh, khat-toosh'; from an unused root of uncertain signification;  Chattush, the name of four or five Israelites:—Hattush.

H2409.definition: חֲטָּיָא chăṭṭâyâʼ, khat-taw-yaw'; (Aramaic) from the same as H2408;  an expiation:—sin offering.

H241.definition: אֹזֶן ʼôzen, o'-zen; from H238;  broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man):—  advertise, audience,   displease, ear, hearing,   show.

H2416.definition: חַי chay, khah'-ee; from H2421;  alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively:—  age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance,   merry, multitude,   (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.

H2417.definition: חַי chay, khah'-ee; (Aramaic) from H2418;  alive; also (as noun in plural) life:—life, that liveth, living.

H2418.definition: חֲיָא chăyâʼ, khah-yaw'; (Aramaic) or חֲיָה chăyâh; (Aramaic), corresponding to H2421;  to live:—live, keep alive.

H2419.definition: חִיאֵל Chîyʼêl, khee-ale'; from H2416 and H410; living of God;  Chiel, an Israelite:—Hiel.

H2420.definition: חִידָה chîydâh, khee-daw'; from H2330;  a puzzle, hence, a trick, conundrum, sententious maxim:—dark saying (sentence, speech), hard question, proverb, riddle.

H2421.definition: חָיָה châyâh, khaw-yaw'; a primitive root (compare H2331, H2421);  to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive:—keep (leave, make) alive, × certainly, give (promise) life, (let, suffer to) live, nourish up, preserve (alive), quicken, recover, repair, restore (to life), revive, (× God) save (alive, life, lives), × surely, be whole.

H2423.definition: חֵיוָא chêyvâʼ, khay-vaw'; (Aramaic) from H2418;  an animal:—beast.

H2424.definition: חַיּוּת chayûwth, khah-yooth'; from H2421;  life:—× living.

H2425.definition: חָיַי châyay, khaw-yah'-ee; a primitive root (compare H2421);  to live; causatively to revive:—live, save life.

H2426.definition: חֵיל chêyl, khale; or (shortened) חֵל chêl; a collateral form of H2428;  an army; also (by analogy,) an intrenchment:—army, bulwark, host, + poor, rampart, trench, wall.

H2427.definition: חִיל chîyl, kheel; and (feminine) חִילָה chîylâh; from H2342;  a throe (expectant of childbirth):—pain, pang, sorrow.

H2428.definition: חַיִל chayil, khah'-yil; from H2342;  probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength:—able, activity, ( ) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, ( ) valiant(-ly), valour, virtuous(-ly), war, worthy(-ily).

H2429.definition: חַיִל chayil, khah'-yil; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2428;  an army, or strength:—aloud, army, × most (mighty), power.

H2432.definition: חִילֵן Chîylên, khee-lane'; from H2428; fortress;  Chilen, a place in Palestine:—Hilen.

H2436.definition: חֵיק chêyq, khake; or חֵק chêq; and חוֹק chôwq; from an unused root, apparently meaning to inclose;  the bosom (literally or figuratively):—bosom, bottom, lap, midst, within.

H2437.definition: חִירָה Chîyrâh, khee-raw'; from H2357 in the sense of splendor;  Chirah, an Adullamite:—Hirah.

H2438.definition: חִירָם Chîyrâm, khee-rawm'; or חִירוֹם Chîyrôwmlemma חִירֹם missing vav, corrected to חִירוֹם; another form of H2361;  Chiram or Chirom, the name of two Tyrians:—Hiram, Huram.

H2442.definition: חָכָה châkâh, khaw-kaw'; a primitive root (apparently akin to H2707 through the idea of piercing);  properly, to adhere to; hence, to await:—long, tarry, wait.

H2445.definition: חַכִּים chakkîym, khak-keem'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2449;  wise, i.e. a Magian:—wise.

H2449.definition: חָכַם châkam, khaw-kam'; a primitive root,  to be wise (in mind, word or act):—× exceeding, teach wisdom, be (make self, shew self) wise, deal (never so) wisely, make wiser.

H2450.definition: חָכָם châkâm, khaw-kawm'; from H2449;  wise, (i.e. intelligent, skillful or artful):—cunning (man), subtle, (un-), wise((hearted), man).

H2451.definition: חׇכְמָה chokmâh, khok-maw'; from H2449;  wisdom (in a good sense):—skilful, wisdom, wisely, wit.

H2452.definition: חׇכְמָה chokmâh, khok-maw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2451;  wisdom:—wisdom.

H2454.definition: חׇכְמוֹת chokmôwth, khok-moth'; or חַכְמוֹת chakmôwth; collateral forms of H2451;  wisdom:—wisdom, every wise (woman).

H2455.definition: חֹל chôl, khole; from H2490;  properly, exposed; hence, profane:—common, profane (place), unholy.

H2456.definition: חָלָא châlâʼ, khaw-law'; a primitive root (compare H2470);  to be sick:—be diseased.

H2458.definition: חֶלְאָה Chelʼâh, khel-aw'; the same as H2457;  Chelah, an Israelitess:—Helah.

H2459.definition: חֶלֶב cheleb, kheh'-leb; or חֵלֶב chêleb; from an unused root meaning to be fat;  fat, whether literally or figuratively; hence, the richest or choice part:—× best, fat(-ness), × finest, grease, marrow.

H2460.definition: חֵלֶב Chêleb, khay'-leb; the same as H2459; fatness;  Cheleb, an Israelite:—Heleb.

H2461.definition: חָלָב châlâb, khaw-lawb'; from the same as H2459;  milk (as the richness of kine):—  cheese, milk, sucking.

H2465.definition: חֶלֶד cheled, kheh'-led; from an unused root apparently meaning to glide swiftly;  life (as a fleeting portion of time); hence, the world (as transient):—age, short time, world.

H2466.definition: חֵלֶד chêled, khay'-led; the same as H2465;  Cheled, an Israelite:—Heled.

H2470.definition: חָלָה châlâh, khaw-law'; a primitive root (compare H2342, H2470, H2490);  properly, to be rubbed or worn; hence (figuratively) to be weak, sick, afflicted; or (causatively) to grieve, make sick; also to stroke (in flattering), entreat:—beseech, (be) diseased, (put to) grief, be grieved, (be) grievous, infirmity, intreat, lay to, put to pain, × pray, make prayer, be (fall, make) sick, sore, be sorry, make suit (× supplication), woman in travail, be (become) weak, be wounded.

H2471.definition: חַלָּה challâh, khal-law'; from H2490;  a cake (as usually punctured):—cake.

H2472.definition: חֲלוֹם chălôwm, khal-ome'; or (shortened) חֲלֹם chălôm; from H2492;  a dream:—dream(-er).

H2478.definition: חַלְחוּל Chalchûwl, khal-khool'; by reduplication from H2342; contorted;  Chalchul, a place in Palestine:—Halhul.

H248.definition: אֶזְרוֹעַ ʼezrôwaʻ, ez-ro'-a; a variation for H2220;  the arm:—arm.

H2481.definition: חֲלִי chălîy, khal-ee'; from H2470;  a trinket (as polished):—jewel, ornament.

H2483.definition: חֳלִי chŏlîy, khol-ee'; from H2470;  malady, anxiety, calamity:—disease, grief, (is) sick(-ness).

H2485.definition: חָלִיל châlîyl, khaw-leel'; from H2490;  a flute (as perforated):—pipe.

H2486.definition: חָלִילָה châlîylâh, khaw-lee'-law; or חָלִלָה châlilâh; a directive from H2490;  literal for a profaned thing; used (interjection) far be it!:—be far, (× God) forbid.

H2487.definition: חֲלִיפָה chălîyphâh, khal-ee-faw'; from H2498;  alternation:—change, course.

H249.definition: אֶזְרָח ʼezrâch, ez-rawkh'; from H2224 (in the sense of springing up);  a spontaneous growth, i.e. native (tree or persons):—bay tree, (home-) born (in the land), of the (one's own) country (nation).

H2490.definition: חָלַל châlal, khaw-lal'; a primitive root (compare H2470); also denominative (from H2485)  properly, to bore, i.e. (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively, to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an 'opening wedge'); to play (the flute):—begin (× men began), defile, × break, defile, × eat (as common things), × first, × gather the grape thereof, × take inheritance, pipe, player on instruments, pollute, (cast as) profane (self), prostitute, slay (slain), sorrow, stain, wound.

H2491.definition: חָלָל châlâl, khaw-lawl'; from H2490;  pierced (especially to death); figuratively, polluted:—kill, profane, slain (man), × slew, (deadly) wounded.

H2492.definition: חָלַם châlam, khaw-lam'; a primitive root;  properly, to bind firmly, i.e. (by implication) to be (causatively to make) plump; also (through the figurative sense of dumbness) to dream:—(cause to) dream(-er), be in good liking, recover.

H2493.definition: חֵלֶם chêlem, khay'-lem; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2492;  a dream:—dream.

H2496.definition: חַלָּמִישׁ challâmîysh, klal-law-meesh'; probably from H2492 (in the sense of hardness);  flint:—flint(-y), rock.

H2498.definition: חָלַף châlaph, khaw-laf'; a primitive root;  properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change:—abolish, alter, change, cut off, go on forward, grow up, be over, pass (away, on, through), renew, sprout, strike through.

H2499.definition: חֲלַף chălaph, khal-af'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2498;  to pass on (of time):—pass.

H2500.definition: חֵלֶף chêleph, klay'-lef; from H2498;  properly, exchange; hence (as preposition) instead of:—× for.

H2502.definition: חָלַץ châlats, khaw-lats'; a primitive root;  to pull off; hence (intensively) to strip, (reflexive) to depart; by implication, to deliver, equip (for fight); present, strengthen:—arm (self), (go, ready) armed (× man, soldier), deliver, draw out, make fat, loose, (ready) prepared, put off, take away, withdraw self.

H2503.definition: חֶלֶץ Chelets, kheh'-lets; or חֵלֶץ Chêlets; from H2502; perhaps, strength;  Chelets, the name of two Israelites:—Helez.

H2505.definition: חָלַק châlaq, khaw-lak'; a primitive root;  to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate:—deal, distribute, divide, flatter, give, (have, im-) part(-ner), take away a portion, receive, separate self, (be) smooth(-er).

H2506.definition: חֵלֶק chêleq, khay'lek; from H2505;  properly, smoothness (of the tongue); also an allotment:—flattery, inheritance, part, × partake, portion.

H2508.definition: חֲלָק chălâq, khal-awk'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2505;  a part:—portion.

H251.definition: אָח ʼâch, awkh; a primitive word;  a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance [like H1]):—another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with 'Ah-' or 'Ahi-'.

H2510.definition: חָלָק Châlâq, khaw-lawk'; the same as H2509; bare;  Chalak, a mountain of Idumaea:—Halak.

H2512.definition: חַלֻּק challuq, khal-look'; from H2505;  smooth:—smooth.

H2513.definition: חֶלְקָה chelqâh, khel-kaw'; feminine of H2506;  properly, smoothness; figuratively, flattery; also an allotment:—field, flattering(-ry), ground, parcel, part, piece of land (ground), plat, portion, slippery place, smooth (thing).

H2517.definition: חֶלְקַי Chelqay, khel-kah'ee; from H2505; apportioned;  Chelkai, an Israelite:—Helkai.

H2518.definition: חִלְקִיָּה Chilqîyâh, khil-kee-yaw'; or חִלְקִיָּהוּ Chilqîyâhûw; from H2506 and H3050; portion of Jah;  Chilhijah, the name of eight Israelites:—Hillkiah.

H2519.definition: חֲלַקְלַקָּה chălaqlaqqâh, khal-ak-lak-kaw'; by reduplication from H2505;  properly, something very smooth; i.e. a treacherous spot; figuratively, blandishment:—flattery, slippery.

H2520.definition: חֶלְקַת Chelqath, khel-kath'; a form of H2513; smoothness;  Chelkath, a place in Palestine:—Helkath.

H2521.definition: חֶלְקַת הַצֻּרִים Chelqath hats-Tsurîym, khel-kath' hatstsoo-reem'; from H2520 and the plural of H6697, with the article inserted; smoothness of the rocks;  Chelkath Hats-tsurim, a place in Palestine:—Helkath-hazzurim.

H2522.definition: חָלַשׁ châlash, khaw-lash'; a primitive root;  to prostrate; by implication, to overthrow, decay:—discomfit, waste away, weaken.

H2526.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2526.definition: חָם Châm, khawm; the same as H2525; hot (from the tropical habitat);  Cham, a son of Noah; also (as a patronymic) his descendants or their country:—Ham.

H2527.definition: חֹם chôm, khome; from H2552;  heat:—heat, to be hot (warm).

H2529.definition: חֶמְאָה chemʼâh, khem-aw'; or (shortened) חֵמָה chêmâh; from the same root as H2346;  curdled milk or cheese:—butter.

H253.definition: אָח ʼâch, awkh; a variation for H162;  Oh! (expressive of grief or surprise):—ah, alas.

H2530.definition: חָמַד châmad, khaw-mad'; a primitive root;  to delight in:—beauty, greatly beloved, covet, delectable thing, (× great) delight, desire, goodly, lust, (be) pleasant (thing), precious (thing).

H2531.definition: חֶמֶד chemed, kheh'-med; from H2530;  delight:—desirable, pleasant.

H2532.definition: חֶמְדָּה chemdâh, khem-daw'; feminine of H2531;  delight:—desire, goodly, pleasant, precious.

H2533.definition: חֶמְדָּן Chemdân, khem-dawn'; from H2531; pleasant;  Chemdan, an Idumaean:—Hemdan.

H2534.definition: חֵמָה chêmâh, khay-maw'; or (Daniel 11:44) חֵמָא chêmâʼ; from H3179;  heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever):—anger, bottles, hot displeasure, furious(-ly, -ry), heat, indignation, poison, rage, wrath(-ful). See H2529.

H2540.definition: חַמּוֹן Chammôwn, kham-mone'; from H2552; warm spring;  Chammon, the name of two places in Palestine:—Hammon.

H2543.definition: חֲמוֹר chămôwr, kham-ore'; or (shortened) חֲמֹר chămôr; from H2560;  a male ass (from its dun red):—(he) ass.

H2544.definition: חֲמוֹר Chămôwr, kham-ore'; the same as H2543; donkey;  Chamor, a Canaanite:—Hamor.

H2549.definition: חֲמִישִׁי chămîyshîy, kham-ee-shee'; or חֲמִשִּׁי chămishshîy; ordinal from H2568;  fifth; also a fifth:—fifth (part).

H2550.definition: חָמַל châmal, khaw-mal'; a primitive root;  to commiserate; by implication, to spare:—have compassion, (have) pity, spare.

H2552.definition: חָמַם châmam, khaw-mam'; a primitive root;  to be hot (literally or figuratively):—enflame self, get (have) heat, be (wax) hot, (be, wax) warm (self, at).

H2553.definition: חַמָּן chammân, kham-mawn'; from H2535;  a sun-pillar:—idol, image.

H2554.definition: חָמַס châmaç, khaw-mas'; a primitive root;  to be violent; by implication, to maltreat:—make bare, shake off, violate, do violence, take away violently, wrong, imagine wrongfully.

H2555.definition: חָמָס châmâç, khaw-mawce'; from H2554;  violence; by implication, wrong; by metonymy unjust gain:—cruel(-ty), damage, false, injustice, × oppressor, unrighteous, violence (against, done), violent (dealing), wrong.

H2556.definition: חָמֵץ châmêts, khaw-mates'; a primitive root;  to be pungent; i.e. in taste (sour, i.e. literally fermented, or figuratively, harsh), in color (dazzling):—cruel (man), dyed, be grieved, leavened.

H2557.definition: חָמֵץ châmêts, khaw-mates'; from H2556;  ferment, (figuratively) extortion:—leaven, leavened (bread).

H2558.definition: חֹמֶץ chômets, kho'-mets; from H2556;  vinegar:—vinegar.

H256.definition: אַחְאָב ʼAchʼâb, akh-awb'; once (by contraction) אֶחָב ʼEchâb (Jeremiah 29:22); from H251 and H1; brother (i.e. friend) of (his) father;  Achab, the name of a king of Israel and of a prophet at Babylon:—Ahab.

H2562.definition: חֲמַר chămar, kham-ar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2561;  wine:—wine.

H2563.definition: חֹמֶר chômer, kho'mer; from H2560;  properly, a bubbling up, i.e. of water, a wave; of earth, mire or clay (cement); also a heap; hence, a chomer or dry measure:—clay, heap, homer, mire, motion.

H2565.definition: חֲמֹרָה chămôrâh, kham-o-raw'; from H2560 (compare H2563);  a heap:—heap.

H2568.definition: חָמֵשׁ châmêsh, khaw-maysh'; masculine חֲמִשָּׁה chămishshâh; a primitive numeral;  five:—fif(-teen), fifth, five (× apiece).

H2571.definition: חָמֻשׁ châmush, khaw-moosh'; passive participle of the same as H2570;  staunch, i.e. able-bodied soldiers:—armed (men), harnessed.

H2572.definition: חֲמִשִּׁים chămishshîym, kham-ish-sheem'; multiple of H2568;  fifty:—fifty.

H2574.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2574.definition: חֲמָת Chămâth, kham-awth'; from the same as H2346; walled;  Chamath, a place in Syria:—Hamath, Hemath.

H2580.definition: חֵן chên khane; from H2603; graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty):—favour, grace(-ious), pleasant, precious, (well-) favoured.

H2583.definition: חָנָה chânâh, khaw-naw'; a primitive root (compare H2603);  properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch a tent; generally to encamp (for abode or siege):—abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent.

H2584.definition: חַנָּה Channâh, khan-naw'; from H2603; favored;  Channah, an Israelitess:—Hannah.

H2585.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2585.definition: חֲנוֹךְ Chănôwk, khan-oke'; from H2596; initiated;  Chanok, an antediluvian patriach:—Enoch.

H2586.definition: חָנוּן Chânûwn, khaw-noon'; from H2603; favored;  Chanun, the name of an Ammonite and of two Israelites:—Hanun.

H2587.definition: חַנּוּן channûwn, khan-noon'; from H2603;  gracious:—gracious.

H259.definition: אֶחָד ʼechâd, ekh-awd'; a numeral from H258;  properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first:—a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any(-thing), apiece, a certain, (dai-) ly, each (one),   eleven, every, few, first,   highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together,

H2590.definition: חָנַט chânaṭ, khaw-nat'; a primitive root;  to spice; by implication, to embalm; also to ripen:—embalm, put forth.

H2591.definition: חִנְטָא chinṭâʼ, khint-taw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2406;  wheat:—wheat.

H2592.definition: חַנִּיאֵל Channîyʼêl, khan-nee-ale'; from H2603 and H410; favor of God;  Channiel, the name of two Israelites:—Hanniel.

H2593.definition: חָנִיךְ chânîyk, kaw-neek'; from H2596;  initiated; i.e. practiced:—trained.

H2595.definition: חֲנִית chănîyth, khan-eeth'; from H2583;  a lance (for thrusting, like pitching a tent):—javelin, spear.

H2596.definition: חָנַךְ chânak, khaw-nak'; a primitive root; (compare H2614)  properly, to narrow; figuratively, to initiate or discipline:—dedicate, train up.

H26.definition: אֲבִיגַיִל ʼĂbîygayil, ab-ee-gah'-yil; or shorter אֲבִיגַל ʼĂbîygal; from H1 and H1524; father (i.e. source) of joy;  Abigail or Abigal, the name of two Israelitesses:—Abigal.

H260.definition: אָחוּ ʼâchûw, aw'-khoo; of uncertain (perhaps Egyptian) derivation;  a bulrush or any marshy grass (particularly that along the Nile):—flag, meadow.

H2600.definition: חִנָּם chinnâm, khin-nawm'; from H2580;  gratis, i.e. devoid of cost, reason or advantage:—without a cause (cost, wages), causeless, to cost nothing, free(-ly), innocent, for nothing (nought), in vain.

H2601.definition: חֲנַמְאֵל Chănamʼêl, khan-am-ale'; probably by orthographical variation for H2606;  Chanamel, an Israelite:—Hanameel.

H2603.definition: חָנַן chânan, khaw-nan'; a primitive root (compare H2583);  properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition):—beseech, × fair, (be, find, shew) favour(-able), be (deal, give, grant (gracious(-ly), intreat, (be) merciful, have (shew) mercy (on, upon), have pity upon, pray, make supplication, × very.

H2604.definition: חֲנַן chănan, khan-an'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2603;  to favor or (causatively) to entreat:—shew mercy, make supplication.

H2605.definition: חָנָן Chânân, khaw-nawn'; from H2603; favor;  Chanan, the name of seven Israelites:—Canan.

H2607.definition: חֲנָנִי Chănânîy, khan-aw-nee'; from H2603; gracious;  Chanani, the name of six Israelites:—Hanani.

H2608.definition: חֲנַנְיָה Chănanyâh, khan-an-yaw'; or חֲנַנְיָהוּ Chănanyâhûw; from H2603 and H3050; Jah has favored;  Chananjah, the name of thirteen Israelites:—Hananiah.

H2610.definition: חָנֵף chânêph, khaw-nafe'; a primitive root;  to soil, especially in a moral sense:—corrupt, defile, × greatly, pollute, profane.

H2611.definition: חָנֵף chânêph, khaw-nafe'; from H2610;  soiled (i.e. with sin), impious:—hypocrite(-ical).

H2612.definition: חֹנֶף chôneph, kho'-nef; from H2610;  moral filth, i.e. wickedness:—hypocrisy.

H2617.definition: חֶסֶד cheçed, kheh'-sed; from H2616;  kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subjectively) beauty:—favour, good deed(-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-) kindness, merciful (kindness), mercy, pity, reproach, wicked thing.

H2619.definition: חֲסַדְיָה Chăçadyâh, khas-ad-yaw'; from H2617 and H3050; Jah has favored;  Chasadjah, an Israelite:—Hasadiah.

H2620.definition: חָסָה châçâh, khaw-saw'; a primitive root; (compare H982)  to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in:—have hope, make refuge, (put) trust.

H2623.definition: חָסִיד châçîyd, khaw-seed'; from H2616;  properly, kind, i.e. (religiously) pious (a saint):—godly (man), good, holy (one), merciful, saint, (un-) godly.

H2627.definition: חַסִּיר chaççîyr, khas-seer'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2637;  deficient:—wanting.

H2631.definition: חֲסַן chăçan, khas-an'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2630;  to hold in occupancy:—possess.

H2632.definition: חֵסֶן chêçen, khay'-sen; (Aramaic) from H2631;  strength:—power.

H2633.definition: חֹסֶן chôçen, kho'-sen; from H2630;  wealth:—riches, strength, treasure.

H2635.definition: חֲסַף chăçaph, khas-af'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of H2636;  a clod:—clay.

H2636.definition: חַסְפַּס chaçpaç, khas-pas'; reduplicated from an unused root meaning apparently to peel;  a shred or scale:—round thing.

H2637.definition: חָסֵר châçêr, khaw-sare'; a primitive root;  to lack; by implication, to fail, want, lessen:—be abated, bereave, decrease, (cause to) fail, (have) lack, make lower, want.

H2638.definition: חָסֵר châçêr, khaw-sare'; from H2637;  lacking; hence, without:—destitute, fail, lack, have need, void, want.

H2644.definition: חָפָא châphâʼ, khaw-faw'; an orthographical variation of H2645;  properly, to cover, i.e. (in a sinister sense) to act covertly:—do secretly.

H2645.definition: חָפָה châphâh, khaw-faw'; a primitive root (compare H2644, H2653);  to cover; by implication, to veil, to encase, protect:—ceil, cover, overlay.

H265.definition: אֲחוֹחַ ʼĂchôwach, akh-o'-akh; by reduplication from H251; brotherly;  Achoach, an Israelite:—Ahoah.

H2652.definition: חׇפְנִי Chophnîy, khof-nee'; from H2651; perhaps pugilist;  Chophni, an Israelite:—Hophni.

H2654.definition: חָפֵץ châphêts, khaw-fates'; a primitive root;  properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire:—× any at all, (have, take) delight, desire, favour, like, move, be (well) pleased, have pleasure, will, would.

H2655.definition: חָפֵץ châphêts, khaw-fates'; from H2654;  pleased with:—delight in, desire, favour, please, have pleasure, whosoever would, willing, wish.
