H2656.definition: חֵפֶץ chêphets, khay'-fets; from H2654;  pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind):—acceptable, delight(-some), desire, things desired, matter, pleasant(-ure), purpose, willingly.

H2658.definition: חָפַר châphar, khaw-far'; a primitive root;  properly, to pry into; by implication, to delve, to explore:—dig, paw, search out, seek.

H2660.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2660.definition: חֵפֶר Chêpher, khay'-fer; from H2658 or H2659; a pit of shame;  Chepher, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites:—Hepher.

H2664.definition: חָפַשׂ châphas, khaw-fas'; a primitive root;  to seek; causatively, to conceal oneself (i.e. let be sought), or mask:—change, (make) diligent (search), disquise self, hide, search (for, out).

H2665.definition: חֵפֶשׂ chêphes, khay'-fes; from H2664;  something covert, i.e. a trick:—search.

H2669.definition: חׇפְשׁוּת chophshûwth, khof-shooth'; and חׇפְשִׁית chophshîyth; from H2666; (with H1004, a hospital)  prostration by sickness:—several.

H267.definition: אֲחוּמַי ʼĂchûwmay, akh-oo-mah'-ee; perhaps from H251 and H4325; brother (i.e. neighbour) of water;  Achumai, an Israelite:—Ahumai.

H2670.definition: חׇפְשִׁי chophshîy, khof-shee'; from H2666;  exempt (from bondage, tax or care):—free, liberty.

H2671.definition: חֵץ chêts, khayts; from H2686; also by interchange for H6086  properly, a piercer, i.e. an arrow; by implication, a wound; figuratively, (of God) thunder-bolt; the shaft of a spear:—  archer, arrow, dart, shaft, staff, wound.

H2672.definition: חָצַב châtsab, khaw-tsab'; or חָצֵב châtsêb; a primitive root;  to cut or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication, to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave:—cut, dig, divide, grave, hew (out, -er), made, mason.

H2673.definition: חָצָה châtsâh, khaw-tsaw'; a primitive root (compare H2086);  to cut or split in two; to halve:—divide, × live out half, reach to the midst, participle

H2674.definition: חָצוֹר Châtsôwr, khaw-tsore'; a collective form of H2691; village;  Chatsor, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine and of one in Arabia:—Hazor.

H2677.definition: חֵצִי chêtsîy, khay-tsee'; from H2673;  the half or middle:—half, middle, mid(-night), midst, part, two parts.

H2678.definition: חִצִּי chitstsîy, khits-tsee'; or חֵצִי chêtsîy; prolongation from H2671;  an arrow:—arrow.

H268.definition: אָחוֹר ʼâchôwr, aw-khore'; or (shortened) אָחֹר ʼâchôr ; from H299;  the hinder part; hence (adverb) behind, backward; also (as facing north) the West:—after(-ward), back (part, -side, -ward), hereafter, (be-) hind(-er part), time to come, without.

H2682.definition: חָצִיר châtsîyr, khaw-tseer'; perhaps originally the same as H2681, from the greenness of a courtyard;  grass; also a leek (collectively):—grass, hay, herb, leek.

H2689.definition: חֲצֹצְרָה chătsôtsᵉrâh, khats-o-tser-aw'; by reduplication from H2690;  a trumpet (from its sundered or quavering note):—trumpet(-er).

H269.definition: אָחוֹת ʼâchôwth, aw-khoth'; irregular feminine of H251;  a sister (used very widely [like H251 number H250, corrected to H251], literally and figuratively):—(an-) other, sister, together.

H2690.definition: חָצַר châtsar, khaw-tsar'; a primitive root; properly, to surround with a stockade, and thus separate from the open country; but used only in the reduplicated form חֲצֹצֵר chătsôtsêr; or (2 Chronicles 5:12) חֲצֹרֵר chătsôrêr; as dem. from H2689;  to trumpet, i.e. blow on that instrument:—blow, sound, trumpeter.

H2691.definition: חָצֵר châtsêr, khaw-tsare'; (masculine and feminine); from H2690 in its original sense;  a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls):—court, tower, village.

H2694.definition: חֲצַר הַתִּיכוֹן Chătsar hat-Tîykôwn, khats-ar' hat-tee-kone'; from H2691 and H8484 with the article interposed; village of the middle;  Chatsar-hat-Tikon, a place in Palestine:—Hazar-hatticon.

H2695.definition: חֶצְרוֹ Chetsrôw, khets-ro'; by an orthographical variation for H2696; enclosure;  Chetsro, an Israelite:—Hezro, Hezrai.

H2696.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2696.definition: חֶצְרוֹן Chetsrôwn, khets-rone'; from H2691; court-yard;  Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine; also of two Israelites:—Hezron.

H27.definition: אֲבִידָן ʼĂbîydân, ab-ee-dawn'; from H1 and H1777; father of judgment (i.e. judge);  Abidan, an Israelite:—Abidan.

H270.definition: אָחַז ʼâchaz, aw-khaz'; a primitive root;  to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession):—  be affrighted, bar, (catch, lay, take) hold (back), come upon, fasten, handle, portion, (get, have or take) possess(-ion).

H2700.definition: חֲצַרְמָוֶת Chătsarmâveth, khats-ar-maw'-veth; from H2691 and H4194; village of death;  Chatsarmaveth, a place in Arabia:—Hazarmaveth.

H2702.definition: חֲצַר סוּסִים Chătsar Çûwçîym, khats-ar' soo-seem'; from H2691 and the plural of H5483; village of horses;  Chatsar-Susim, a place in Palestine:—Hazar-susim.

H2706.definition: חֹק chôq, khoke; from H2710;  an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage):—appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree(-d), due, law, measure, × necessary, ordinance(-nary), portion, set time, statute, task.

H2707.definition: חָקָה châqâh, khaw-kaw'; a primitive root;  to carve; by implication, to delineate; also to entrench:—carved work, portrayed, set a print.

H2708.definition: חֻקָּה chuqqâh, khook-kaw'; feminine of H2706, and meaning substantially the same:—appointed, custom, manner, ordinance, site, statute.

H271.definition: אָחָז ʼÂchâz, aw-khawz'; from H270; possessor;  Achaz, the name of a Jewish king and of an Israelite:—Ahaz.

H2710.definition: חָקַק châqaq, khaw-kak'; a primitive root;  properly, to hack, i.e. engrave (Judges 5:14, to be a scribe simply); by implication, to enact (laws being cut in stone or metal tablets in primitive times) or (generally) prescribe:—appoint, decree, governor, grave, lawgiver, note, pourtray, print, set.

H2711.definition: חֵקֶק chêqeq, khay'-kek; from H2710;  an enactment, a resolution:—decree, thought.

H2712.definition: חֻקֹּק Chuqqôq, Khook-koke'; or (fully) חוּקֹק Chûwqôq; from H2710; appointed;  Chukkok or Chukok, a place in Palestine:—Hukkok, Hukok.

H2713.definition: חָקַר châqar, khaw-kar'; a primitive root;  properly, to penetrate; hence, to examine intimately:—find out, (make) search (out), seek (out), sound, try.

H2714.definition: חֵקֶר chêqer, khay'-ker; from H2713;  examination, enumeration, deliberation:—finding out, number, (un-) search(-able, -ed, out, -ing).

H2717.definition: חָרַב chârab, khaw-rab'; or חֲרֵב chărêb; a primitive root;  to parch (through drought) i.e. (by analogy,) to desolate, destroy, kill:—decay, (be) desolate, destroy(-er), (be) dry (up), slay, × surely, (lay, lie, make) waste.

H2718.definition: חֲרַב chărab, khar-ab'; (Aramaic) a root corresponding to H2717;  to demolish:—destroy.

H2719.definition: חֶרֶב chereb, kheh'-reb; from H2717;  drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement:—axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.

H272.definition: אֲחֻזָּה ʼăchuzzâh, akh-ooz-zaw'; feminine passive participle from H270;  something seized, i.e. a possession (especially of land):—possession.

H2722.definition: חֹרֵב Chôrêb, kho-rabe'; from H2717; desolate;  Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains:—Horeb.

H2723.definition: חׇרְבָּה chorbâh, khor-baw'; feminine of H2721;  properly, drought, i.e. (by implication) a desolation:—decayed place, desolate (place, -tion), destruction, (laid) waste (place).

H2724.definition: חָרָבָה chârâbâh, khaw-raw-baw'; feminine of H2720;  a desert:—dry (ground, land).

H2725.definition: חֲרָבוֹן chărâbôwn, khar-aw-bone'; from H2717;  parching heat:—drought.

H2726.definition: חַרְבוֹנָא Charbôwnâʼ, khar-bo-naw'; or חַרְבוֹנָה Charbôwnâh; of Persian origin;  Charbona or Charbonah, a eunuch of Xerxes:—Harbona, Harbonah.

H2727.definition: חָרַג chârag, khaw-rag'; a primitive root;  properly, to leap suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to be dismayed:—be afraid.

H2729.definition: חָרַד chârad, khaw-rad'; a primitive root;  to shudder with terror; hence, to fear; also to hasten (with anxiety):—be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble.

H2730.definition: חָרֵד chârêd, khaw-rade'; from H2729;  fearful; also reverential:—afraid, trembling.

H2734.definition: חָרָה chârâh, khaw-raw'; a primitive root (compare H2787);  to glow or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to blaze up, of anger, zeal, jealousy:—be angry, burn, be displeased, × earnestly, fret self, grieve, be (wax) hot, be incensed, kindle, × very, be wroth. See H8474.

H274.definition: אֲחַזְיָה ʼĂchazyâh, akh-az-yaw'; or (prolonged) אֲחַזְיָהוּ ʼĂchazyâhûw ; from H270 and H3050; Jah has seized;  Achazjah, the name of a Jewish and an Israelite king:—Ahaziah.

H2740.definition: חָרוֹן chârôwn, khaw-rone'; or (shortened) חָרֹן chârôn; from H2734;  a burning of anger:—sore displeasure, fierce(-ness), fury, (fierce) wrath(-ful).

H2742.definition: חֲרוּץ chărûwts, khaw-roots'; or חָרֻץ châruts; passive participle of H2782;  properly, incised or (active) incisive; hence (as noun masculine or feminine) a trench (as dug), gold (as mined), a threshing-sledge (having sharp teeth); (figuratively) determination; also eager:—decision, diligent, (fine) gold, pointed things, sharp, threshing instrument, wall.

H2747.definition: חֶרֶט chereṭ, kheh'-ret; from a primitive root meaning to engrave;  a chisel or graver; also a style for writing:—graving tool, pen.

H2749.definition: חַרְטֹם charṭôm, khar-tome'; (Aramaic) the same as H2748:—magician.

H2750.definition: חֳרִי chŏrîy, khor-ee'; from H2734;  a burning (i.e. intense) anger:—fierce, × great, heat.

H2753.definition: חֹרִי Chôrîy, kho-ree'; or חוֹרִי Chôwrîy; the same as H2752;  Chori, the name of two men:—Hori.

H2754.definition: חָרִיט chârîyṭ, khaw-reet'; or חָרִט châriṭ; from the same as H2747;  properly, cut out (or hollow), i.e. (by implication) a pocket:—bag, crisping pin.

H2756.definition: חָרִיף Chârîyph, khaw-reef'; from H2778; autumnal;  Chariph, the name of two Israelites:—Hariph.

H2758.definition: חָרִישׁ chârîysh, khaw-reesh'; from H2790;  ploughing or its season:—earing (time), ground.

H276.definition: אֲחֻזַּת ʼĂchuzzath, akh-ooz-zath'; a variation of H272; possession;  Achuzzath, a Philistine:—Ahuzzath.

H2761.definition: חֲרַךְ chărak, khar-ak'; (Aramaic) a root probably allied to the equivalent of H2787;  to scorch:—singe.

H2763.definition: חָרַם châram, khaw-ram'; a primitive root;  to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physical and reflexive, to be blunt as to the nose:—make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).

H2764.definition: חֵרֶם chêrem, khay'-rem; or (Zechariah 14:11) חֶרֶם cherem; from H2763;  physical (as shutting in) a net (either literally or figuratively); usually a doomed object; abstractly extermination:—(ac-) curse(-d, -d thing), dedicated thing, things which should have been utterly destroyed, (appointed to) utter destruction, devoted (thing), net.

H2765.definition: חֳרֵם Chŏrêm, khor-ame'; from H2763; devoted;  Chorem, a place in Palestine:—Horem.

H2766.definition: חָרִם Chârim, khaw-reem'; from H2763; snub-nosed;  Charim, an Israelite:—Harim.

H2767.definition: חׇרְמָה Chormâh, khor-maw'; from H2763; devoted;  Chormah, a place in Palestine:—Hormah.

H2768.definition: חֶרְמוֹן Chermôwn, kher-mone'; from H2763; abrupt;  Chermon, a mount of Palestine:—Hermon.

H277.definition: אֲחִי ʼĂchîy, akh-ee'; from H251; brotherly;  Achi, the name of two Israelites:—Ahi.

H2771.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2771.definition: חָרָן Chârân, kaw-rawn'; from H2787; parched;  Charan, the name of a man and also of a place:—Haran.

H2774.definition: חַרְנֶפֶר Charnepher, khar-neh'fer; of uncertain derivation;  Charnepher, an Israelite:—Harnepher.

H2775.definition: חֶרֶס chereç, kheh'-res; or (with a directive enclitic) חַרְסָה charçâh; from an unused root meaning to scrape; also perhaps from the mediating idea of H2777  the sun:—sun.

H2776.definition: חֶרֶס Chereç, kheh'-res; the same as H2775; shining;  Cheres, a mountain in Palestine:—Heres.

H2778.definition: חָרַף châraph, khaw-raf'; a primitive root; also denominative (from H2779)  to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter:—betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid.

H2779.definition: חֹרֶף chôreph, kho'-ref; from H2778;  properly, the crop gathered, i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season; figuratively, ripeness of age:—cold, winter (-house), youth.

H278.definition: אֵחִי ʼÊchîy, ay-khee'; probably the same as H277;  Echi, an Israelite:—Ehi.

H2780.definition: חָרֵף Chârêph, khaw-rafe'; from H2778; reproachful;  Chareph, an Israelite:—Hareph.

H2781.definition: חֶרְפָּה cherpâh, kher-paw'; from H2778;  contumely, disgrace, the pudenda:—rebuke, reproach(-fully), shame.

H2782.definition: חָרַץ chârats, khaw-rats'; a primitive root;  properly, to point sharply, i.e. (literally) to wound; figuratively, to be alert, to decide:—bestir self, decide, decree, determine, maim, move.

H2787.definition: חָרַר chârar, khaw-rar'; a primitive root;  to glow, i.e. literally (to melt, burn, dry up) or figuratively (to show or incite passion):—be angry, burn, dry, kindle.

H2789.definition: חֶרֶשׂ cheres, kheh'-res; a collateral form mediating between H2775 and H2791;  a piece of pottery:—earth(-en), (pot-) sherd,   stone.

H279.definition: אֲחִיאָם ʼĂchîyʼâm, akh-ee-awm'; from H251 and H517; brother of the mother (i.e. uncle);  Achiam, an Israelite:—Ahiam.

H2790.definition: חָרַשׁ chârash, khaw-rash'; a primitive root;  to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness):—× altogether, cease, conceal, be deaf, devise, ear, graven, imagine, leave off speaking, hold peace, plow(-er, man), be quiet, rest, practise secretly, keep silence, be silent, speak not a word, be still, hold tongue, worker.

H2791.definition: חֶרֶשׁ cheresh, kheh'-resh; from H2790;  magical craft; also silence:—cunning, secretly.

H2792.definition: חֶרֶשׁ Cheresh, kheh'-resh; the same as H2791  Cheresh, a Levite:—Heresh.

H2795.definition: חֵרֵשׁ chêrêsh, khay-rashe'; from H2790;  deaf (whether literally or spiritual):—deaf.

H2796.definition: חָרָשׁ chârâsh, khaw-rawsh'; from H2790;  a fabricator or any material:—artificer, (+) carpenter, craftsman, engraver, maker,   mason, skilful, (+) smith, worker, workman, such as wrought.

H28.definition: אֲבִידָע ʼĂbîydâʻ, ab-ee-daw'; from H1 and H3045; father of knowledge (i.e. knowing);  Abida, a son of Abraham by Keturah:—Abida, Abidah.

H2801.definition: חָרַת chârath, khaw-rath'; a primitive root;  to engrave:—graven.

H2803.definition: חָשַׁב châshab, khaw-shab'; a primitive root;  properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute:—(make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.

H2805.definition: חֵשֶׁב chêsheb, khay'-sheb; from H2803;  a belt or strap (as being interlaced):—curious girdle.

H2806.definition: חַשְׁבַּדָּנָה Chashbaddânâh, khash-bad-daw'-naw; from H2803 and H1777; considerate judge;  Chasbaddanah, an Israelite:—Hasbadana.

H2809.definition: חֶשְׁבּוֹן Cheshbôwn, khesh-bone'; the same as H2808;  Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan:—Heshbon.

H281.definition: אֲחִיָּה ʼĂchîyâh, akh-ee-yaw; or (prolonged) אֲחִיָּהוּ ʼĂchîyâhûw ; from H251 and H3050; brother (i.e. worshipper) of Jah;  Achijah, the name of nine Israelites:—Ahiah, Ahijah.

H2811.definition: חֲשַׁבְיָה Chăshabyâh, khash-ab-yaw'; or חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ Chăshabyâhûw; from H2803 and H3050; Jah has regarded;  Chashabjah, the name of nine Israelites:—Hashabiah.

H2812.definition: חֲשַׁבְנָה Chăshabnâh, khash-ab-naw'; feminine of H2808; inventiveness;  Chashnah, an Israelite:—Hashabnah.

H2813.definition: חֲשַׁבְנְיָה Chăshabnᵉyâh, khash-ab-neh-yaw'; from H2808 and H3050; thought of Jah;  Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites:—Hashabniah.

H2814.definition: חָשָׁה châshâh, khaw-shaw'; a primitive root;  to hush or keep quiet:—hold peace, keep silence, be silent, (be) still.

H2815.definition: חַשּׁוּב Chashshûwb, khash-shoob'; from H2803; intelligent;  Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites:—Hashub, Hasshub.

H282.definition: אֲחִיהוּד ʼĂchîyhûwd, akh-ee-hood'; from H251 and H1935; brother (i.e. possessor) of renown;  Achihud, an Israelite:—Ahihud.

H2820.definition: חָשַׂךְ châsak, khaw-sak'; a primitive root; also interchangeable with H2821  to restrain or (reflexively) refrain; by implication, to refuse, spare, preserve; to observe:—assuage, × darken, forbear, hinder, hold back, keep (back), punish, refrain, reserve, spare, withhold.

H2821.definition: חָשַׁךְ châshak, khaw-shak'; a primitive root;  to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken:—be black, be (make) dark, darken, cause darkness, be dim, hide.

H2822.definition: חֹשֶׁךְ chôshek, kho-shek'; from H2821;  the dark; hence (literally) darkness; figuratively, misery, destruction, death, ignorance, sorrow, wickedness:—dark(-ness), night, obscurity.

H2823.definition: חָשֹׁךְ châshôk, khaw-shoke'; from H2821;  dark (figuratively, i.e. obscure):—meaning

H2825.definition: חֲשֵׁכָה chăshêkâh, khash-ay-kaw'; or חֲשֵׁיכָה chăshêykâhxlit chăshêkâh corrected to chăshêykâh; from H2821;  darkness; figuratively, misery:—darkness.

H2828.definition: חָשֻׁם Châshum, khaw-shoom'; from the same as H2831; enriched;  Chashum, the name of two or three Israelites:—Hashum.

H283.definition: אַחְיוֹ ʼAchyôw, akh-yo'; prolonged from H251; brotherly;  Achio, the name of three Israelites:—Ahio.

H2830.definition: חַשְׁמַל chashmal, khash-mal'; of uncertain derivation;  probably bronze or polished spectrum metal:—amber.

H2834.definition: חָשַׂף châsaph, khaw-saf'; a primitive root;  to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid):—make bare, clean, discover, draw out, take, uncover.

H2835.definition: חָשִׂף châsiph, khaw-seef'; from H2834;  properly, drawn off, i.e. separated; hence, a small company (as divided from the rest):—little flock.

H2836.definition: חָשַׁק châshaq, khaw-shak'; a primitive root; also interchangeable for H2820  to cling, i.e. join, (figuratively) to love, delight in; elliptically; to deliver:—have a delight, (have a) desire, fillet, long, set (in) love.

H2837.definition: חֵשֶׁק chêsheq, khay'-shek; from H2836;  delight:—desire, pleasure.

H2842.definition: חָשַׁשׁ châshash, khaw-shash'; by variation for H7179;  dry grass:—chaff.

H2844.definition: חַת chath, khath; from H2865;  concretely, crushed; also afraid; abstractly, terror:—broken, dismayed, dread, fear.

H2845.definition: חֵת Chêth, khayth; from H2865; terror;  Cheth, an aboriginal Canaanite:—Heth.

H2847.definition: חִתָּה chittâh, khit-taw'; from H2865;  fear:—terror.

H285.definition: אֲחִיטוּב ʼĂchîyṭûwb, akh-ee-toob'; from H251 and H2898; brother of goodness;  Achitub, the name of several priests:—Ahitub.

H2850.definition: חִתִּי Chittîy, khit-tee'; patronymically from H2845;  a Chittite, or descendant of Cheth:—Hittite, Hittities.

H2851.definition: חִתִּית chittîyth, khit-teeth'; from H2865;  fear:—terror.

H2856.definition: חָתַם châtham, khaw-tham'; a primitive root;  to close up; especially to seal:—make an end, mark, seal (up), stop.

H2857.definition: חֲתַם chătham, khath-am'; (Aramaic) a root corresponding to H2856;  to seal:—seal.

H2859.definition: חָתַן châthan, khaw-than'; a primitive root;  to give (a daughter) away in marriage; hence (generally) to contract affinity by marriage:—join in affinity, father in law, make marriages, mother in law, son in law.

H2860.definition: חָתָן châthân, khaw-thawn'; from H2859;  a relative by marriage (especially through the bride); figuratively, a circumcised child (as a species of religious espousal):—bridegroom, husband, son in law.

H2862.definition: חָתַף châthaph, khaw-thaf'; a primitive root;  to clutch:—take away.

H2864.definition: חָתַר châthar, khaw-thar'; a primitive root;  to force a passage, as by burglary; figuratively, with oars:—dig (through), row.

H2865.definition: חָתַת châthath, khaw-thath'; a primitive root;  properly, to prostrate; hence, to break down, either (literally) by violence, or (figuratively) by confusion and fear:—abolish, affright, be (make) afraid, amaze, beat down, discourage, (cause to) dismay, go down, scare, terrify.

H2867.definition: חֲתַת Chăthath, khath-ath'; the same as H2866;  Chathath, an Israelite:—cathath.

H2868.definition: טְאֵב ṭᵉʼêb, teh-abe'; (Aramaic) a primitive root;  to rejoice:—be glad.

H2870.definition: טָבְאֵל ṭâbᵉʼêl, taw-beh-ale'; from H2895 and H410; pleasing (to) God;  Tabeel, the name of a Syrian and of a Persian:—Tabeal, Tabeel.

H2871.definition: טָבוּל ṭâbûwl, taw-bool'; passive participle of H2881;  properly, dyed, i.e. a turban (probably as of colored stuff):—dyed attire.

H2873.definition: טָבַח ṭâbach, taw-bakh'; a primitive root;  to slaughter (animals or men):—kill, (make) slaughter, slay.

H2874.definition: טֶבַח ṭebach, teh'-bakh; from H2873;  properly, something slaughtered; hence, a beast (or meat, as butchered); abstractly butchery (or concretely, a place of slaughter):—× beast, slaughter, × slay, × sore.

H2875.definition: טֶבַח Ṭebach, teh'-bakh; the same as H2874; massacre;  Tebach, the name of a Mesopotamian and of an Israelite:—Tebah.

H2877.definition: טַבָּח ṭabbâch, tab-bawkh'; (Aramaic) the same as H2876;  a lifeguardsman:—guard.

H288.definition: אֲחִימֶלֶךְ ʼĂchîymelek, akh-ee-meh'-lek; from H251 and H4428; brother of (the) king;  Achimelek, the name of an Israelite and of a Hittite:—Ahimelech.

H2882.definition: טְבַלְיָהוּ Ṭᵉbalyâhûw, teb-al-yaw'-hoo; from H2881 and H3050; Jah has dipped;  Tebaljah, an Israelite:—Tebaliah.

H2883.definition: טָבַע ṭâbaʻ, taw-bah'; a primitive root;  to sink:—drown, fasten, settle, sink.

H2885.definition: טַבַּעַת ṭabbaʻath, tab-bah'-ath; from H2883;  properly, a seal (as sunk into the wax), i.e. signet (for sealing); hence (generally) a ring of any kind:—ring.

H2887.definition: טֵבֶת Ṭêbeth, tay'-beth; probably of foreign derivation;  Tebeth, the tenth Hebrew month:—Tebeth.

H2889.definition: טָהוֹר ṭâhôwr, taw-hore'; or טָהֹר ṭâhôr; from H2891;  pure (in a physical, chemical, ceremonial or moral sense):—clean, fair, pure(-ness).

H289.definition: אֲחִימַן ʼĂchîyman, akh-ee-man'; or אֲחִימָן ʼĂchîymân ; from H251 and H4480; brother of a portion (i.e. gift);  Achiman, the name of an Anakite and of an Israelite:—Ahiman.

H2891.definition: טָהֵר ṭâhêr, taw-hare'; a primitive root; properly, to be bright; i.e. (by implication)  to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy):—be (make, make self, pronounce) clean, cleanse (self), purge, purify(-ier, self).

H2895.definition: טוֹב ṭôwb, tobe; a primitive root,  to be (transitively, do or make) good (or well) in the widest sense:—be (do) better, cheer, be (do, seem) good, (make) goodly, × please, (be, do, go, play) well.

H2896.definition: טוֹב ṭôwb, tobe; from H2895;  good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well):—beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, × fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, -liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, × most, pleasant,   pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well(-favoured).

H2898.definition: טוּב ṭûwb, toob; from H2895;  good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare:—fair, gladness, good(-ness, thing, -s), joy, go well with.

H29.definition: אֲבִיָּה ʼĂbîyâh, ab-ee-yaw'; or prolonged אֲבִיָּהוּ ʼĂbîyâhûw ; from H1 and H3050; father (i.e. worshipper) of Jah;  Abijah, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses:—Abiah, Abijah.

H290.definition: אֲחִימַעַץ ʼĂchîymaʻats, akh-ee-mah'-ats; from H251 and the equivalent of H4619; brother of anger;  Achimaats, the name of three Israelites:—Ahimaaz.

H2900.definition: טוֹבִיָּה Ṭôwbîyâh, to-bee-yaw'; or טוֹבִיָּהוּ Ṭôwbîyâhûw; from H2896 and H3050; goodness of Jehovah;  Tobijah, the name of three Israelites and of one Samaritan:—Tobiah, Tobijah.

H2901.definition: טָוָה ṭâvâh, taw-vaw'; a primitive root;  to spin:—spin.

H2904.definition: טוּל ṭûwl, tool; a primitive root;  to pitch over or reel; hence (transitively) to cast down or out:—carry away, (utterly) cast (down, forth, out), send out.

H2905.definition: טוּר ṭûwr, toor; from an unused root meaning to range in a regular manner;  a row; hence, a wall:—row.

H2906.definition: טוּר ṭûwr, toor; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6697;  a rock or hill:—mountain.

H2908.definition: טְוָת ṭᵉvâth, tev-awth'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2901;  hunger (as twisting):—fasting.

H2912.definition: טָחַן ṭâchan, taw-khan'; a primitive root;  to grind meal; hence, to be a concubine (that being their employment):—grind(-er).

H2914.definition: טְחֹר ṭᵉchôr, tekh-ore'; from an unused root meaning to burn;  a boil or ulcer (from the inflammation), especially a tumor in the anus or pudenda (the piles):—emerod.

H2916.definition: טִיט ṭîyṭ, teet; from an unused root meaning apparently to be sticky (rather perhaps a demonstrative); from H2894, through the idea of dirt to be swept away);  mud or clay; figuratively, calamity:—clay, dirt, mire.

H2919.definition: טַל ṭal, tal; from H2926;  dew (as covering vegetation):—dew.

H292.definition: אֲחִינָדָב ʼĂchîynâdâb, akh-ee-naw-dawb'; from H251 and H5068; brother of liberality;  Achinadab, an Israelite:—Ahinadab.

H2924.definition: טָלֶה ṭâleh, taw-leh'; by variation for H2922;  a lamb:—lamb.

H2927.definition: טְלַל ṭᵉlal, tel-al'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H2926;  to cover with shade:—have a shadow.

H2928.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H2928.definition: טֶלֶם Ṭelem, teh'-lem; from an unused root meaning to break up or treat violently; oppression;  Telem, the name of a place in Idumaea, also of a temple doorkeeper:—Telem.

H2929.definition: טַלְמוֹן Ṭalmôwn, tal-mone'; from the same as H2728; oppressive;  Talmon, a temple doorkeeper:—Talmon.

H293.definition: אֲחִינֹעַם ʼĂchîynôʻam, akh-ee-no'-am; from H251 and H5278; brother of pleasantness;  Achinoam, the name of two Israelitesses:—Ahinoam.

H2930.definition: טָמֵא ṭâmêʼ, taw-may'; a primitive root;  to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated):—defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, × utterly.

H2931.definition: טָמֵא ṭâmêʼ, taw-may'; from H2930;  foul in a religious sense:—defiled,   infamous, polluted(-tion), unclean.

H2932.definition: טֻמְאָה ṭumʼâh, toom-aw'; from H2930;  religious impurity:—filthiness, unclean(-ness).

H2934.definition: טָמַן ṭâman, taw-man'; a primitive root;  to hide (by covering over):—hide, lay privily, in secret.

H2938.definition: טָעַם ṭâʻam, taw-am'; a primitive root;  to taste; figuratively, to perceive:—× but, perceive, taste.

H2940.definition: טַעַם ṭaʻam, tah'-am; from H2938;  properly, a taste, i.e. (figuratively) perception; by implication, intelligence; transitively, a mandate:—advice, behaviour, decree, discretion, judgment, reason, taste, understanding.

H2942.definition: טְעֵם ṭᵉʻêm, teh-ame'; (Aramaic) from H2939, and equivalent to H2941;  properly, flavor; figuratively, judgment (both subjective and objective); hence, account (both subjectively and objectively):—  chancellor,   command, commandment, decree,   regard, taste, wisdom.

H2943.definition: טָעַן ṭâʻan, taw-an'; a primitive root;  to load a beast:—lade.

H2945.definition: טַף ṭaph, taf; from H2952 (perhaps referring to the tripping gait of children);  a family (mostly used collectively in the singular):—(little) children (ones), families.

H2946.definition: טָפַח ṭâphach, taw-fakh'; a primitive root; or perhaps a denominative from H2947, from dandling on the palms  to flatten out or extend (as a tent); figuratively, to nurse a child (as promotive of growth);:—span, swaddle.

H2948.definition: טֹפַח ṭôphach, to'-fakh; from H2946  (the same as 2947):—hand-breadth (broad).

H295.definition: אֲחִיעֶזֶר ʼĂchîyʻezer, akh-ee-eh'-zer; from H251 and H5828; brother of help;  Achiezer, the name of two Israelites:—Ahiezer.

H2958.definition: טְרוֹם ṭᵉrôwm, ter-ome'; a variation of H2962;  not yet:—before.

H296.definition: אֲחִיקָם ʼĂchîyqâm, akh-ee-kawm'; from H251 and H6965; brother of rising (i.e. high);  Achikam, an Israelite:—Ahikam.

H2962.definition: טֶרֶם ṭerem, teh'-rem; from an unused root apparently meaning to interrupt or suspend;  properly, non-occurrence; used adverbially, not yet or before:—before, ere, not yet.

H2963.definition: טָרַף ṭâraph, taw-raf'; a primitive root;  to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels):—catch, × without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, × surely, tear (in pieces).

H2964.definition: טֶרֶף ṭereph, teh'-ref; from H2963;  something torn, i.e. a fragment, e.g. a fresh leaf, prey, food:—leaf, meat, prey, spoil.

H2966.definition: טְרֵפָה ṭᵉrêphâh, ter-ay-faw'; feminine (collectively) of H2964;  prey, i.e. flocks devoured by animals:—ravin, (that which was) torn (of beasts, in pieces).

H2970.definition: יַאֲזַנְיָה Yaʼăzanyâh, yah-az-an-yaw'; or יַאֲזַנְיָהוּ Yaʼăzanyâhûw; from H238 and H3050; heard of Jah;  Jaazanjah, the name of four Israelites:—Jaazaniah. Compare H3153.

H2971.definition: יָאִיר Yâʼîyr, yaw-ere'; from H215; enlightener;  Jair, the name of four Israelites:—Jair.

H2973.definition: יָאַל yâʼal, yaw-al'; a primitive root;  properly, to be slack, i.e. (figuratively) to be foolish:—dote, be (become, do) foolish(-ly).

H2974.definition: יָאַל yâʼal, yaw-al'; a primitive root (probably rather the same as H2973 through the idea of mental weakness);  properly, to yield, especially assent; hence (positive) to undertake as an act of volition:—assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, × willingly, would.

H2977.definition: יֹאשִׁיָּה Yôʼshîyâh, yo-shee-yaw'; or יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ Yôʼshîyâhûw; from the same root as H803 and H3050; founded of Jah;  Joshijah, the name of two Israelites:—Josiah.

H2979.definition: יְאָתְרַי yᵉʼâthᵉray, yeh-aw-ther-ah'ee; from the same as H871; stepping;  Jeatherai, an Israelite:—Jeaterai.

H2981.definition: יְבוּל yᵉbûwl, yeb-ool'; from H2986;  produce, i.e. a crop or (figuratively) wealth:—fruit, increase.

H2982.definition: יְבוּס Yᵉbûwç, yeb-oos'; from H947; trodden, i.e. threshing-place;  Jebus, the original name of Jerusalem:—Jebus.

H2984.definition: יִבְחַר Yibchar, yib-khar'; from H977; choice;  Jibchar, an Israelite:—Ibhar.

H2985.definition: יָבִין Yâbîyn, yaw-bene'; from H995; intelligent;  Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings:—Jabin.

H2986.definition: יָבַל yâbal, yaw-bal'; a primitive root;  properly, to flow; causatively, to bring (especially with pomp):—bring (forth), carry, lead (forth).

H2988.definition: יָבָל yâbâl, yaw-bawl'; from H2986;  a stream:—(water-) course, stream.

H2989.definition: יָבָל Yâbâl, yaw-bawl'; the same as H2988;  Jabal, an antediluvian:—Jabal.

H299.definition: אֲחִירַע ʼĂchîyraʻ, akh-ee-rah'; from H251 and H7451; brother of wrong;  Achira, an Israelite:—Ahira.

H2999.definition: יַבֹּק Yabbôq, yab-boke'; probably from H1238; pouring forth;  Jabbok, a river east of the Jordan:—Jabbok.

H30.definition: אֲבִיהוּא ʼĂbîyhûwʼ, ab-ee-hoo'; from H1 and H1931; father (i.e. worshipper) of Him (i.e. God);  Abihu, a son of Aaron:—Abihu.

H3001.definition: יָבֵשׁ yâbêsh, yaw-bashe'; a primitive root;  to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage):—be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame(-fully), × utterly, wither (away).

H3002.definition: יָבֵשׁ yâbêsh, yaw-bashe'; from H3001;  dry:—dried (away), dry.

H3003.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3003.definition: יָבֵשׁ Yâbêsh, yaw-bashe'; the same as H3002 (also יָבֵישׁ Yâbêysh; often with the addition of H1568, i.e. Jabesh of Gilad);  Jobesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:—Jobesh (-Gilead).

H3004.definition: יַבָּשָׁה yabbâshâh, yab-baw-shaw'; from H3001;  dry ground:—dry (ground, land).

H3005.definition: יִבְשָׂם Yibsâm, yib-sawm'; from the same as H1314; fragrant;  Jibsam, an Israelite:—Jibsam.

H3006.definition: יַבֶּשֶׁת yabbesheth, yab-beh'-sheth; a variation of H3004;  dry ground:—dry land.

H3008.definition: יִגְאָל Yigʼâl, yig-awl'; from H1350; avenger;  Jigal, the name of three Israelites:—Igal, Igeal.

H3013.definition: יָגָה yâgâh, yaw-gaw'; a primitive root;  to grieve:—afflict, cause grief, grieve, sorrowful, vex.

H3015.definition: יָגוֹן yâgôwn, yaw-gohn'; from H3013;  affliction:—grief, sorrow.

H302.definition: אֲחִיתֹפֶל ʼĂchîythôphel, akh-ee-tho'-fel; from H251 and H8602; brother of folly;  Achithophel, an Israelite:—Ahithophel.

H3021.definition: יָגַע yâgaʻ, yaw-gah'; a primitive root;  properly, to gasp; hence, to be exhausted, to tire, to toil:—faint, (make to) labour, (be) weary.

H3027.definition: יָד yâd, yawd; a primitive word;  a hand (the open one [indicating power, means, direction, etc.], in distinction from 3709, the closed one); used (as noun, adverb, etc.) in a great variety of applications, both literally and figuratively, both proximate and remote [as follows]:—(  be) able, × about,   armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, × bounty,   broad, (broken-) handed, × by, charge, coast,   consecrate,   creditor, custody, debt, dominion, × enough,   fellowship, force, × from, hand(-staves, -y work), × he, himself, × in, labour,   large, ledge, (left-) handed, means, × mine, ministry, near, × of, × order, ordinance, × our, parts, pain, power, × presumptuously, service, side, sore, state, stay, draw with strength, stroke,   swear, terror, × thee, × by them, × themselves, × thine own, × thou, through, × throwing,   thumb, times, × to, × under, × us, × wait on, (way-) side, where,   wide, × with (him, me, you), work,   yield, × yourselves.

H3028.definition: יַד yad, yad; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3027:—hand, power.

H3029.definition: יְדָא yᵉdâʼ, yed-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3034;  to praise:—(give) thank(-s).

H3034.definition: יָדָה yâdâh, yaw-daw'; a primitive root; used only as denominative from H3027; literally, to use (i.e. hold out) the hand;  physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands):—cast (out), (make) confess(-ion), praise, shoot, (give) thank(-ful, -s, -sgiving).

H3035.definition: יִדּוֹ Yiddôw, yid-do'; from H3034; praised;  Jiddo, an Israelite:—Iddo.

H3037.definition: יַדּוּעַ Yaddûwaʻ, yad-doo'-ah; from H3045; knowing;  Jaddua, the name of two Israelites:—Jaddua.

H3038.definition: יְדוּתוּן Yᵉdûwthûwn, yed-oo-thoon'; or יְדֻתוּן Yᵉduthûwn; or יְדִיתוּן Yᵉdîythûwn; probably from H3034; laudatory;  Jeduthun, an Israelite:—Jeduthun.

H3039.definition: יְדִיד yᵉdîyd, yed-eed'; from the same as H1730;  loved:—amiable, (well-) beloved, loves.

H304.definition: אַחְלַי ʼAchlay, akh-lah'ee; the same as H305; wishful;  Achlai, the name of an Israelitess and of an Israelite:—Ahlai.

H3041.definition: יְדִידְיָה Yᵉdîydᵉyâh, yed-ee-deh-yaw'; from H3039 and H3050; beloved of Jah;  Jedidejah, a name of Solomon:—Jedidiah.

H3042.definition: יְדָיָה Yᵉdâyâh, yed-aw-yaw'; from H3034 and H3050; praised of Jah;  Jedajah, the name of two Israelites:—Jedaiah.

H3043.definition: יְדִיעֲאֵל Yᵉdîyʻăʼêl, yed-ee-ah-ale'; from H3045 and H410; knowing God;  Jediael, the name of three Israelites:—Jediael.

H3045.definition: יָדַע yâdaʻ, yaw-dah'; a primitive root;  to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.):—acknowledge, acquaintance(-ted with), advise, answer, appoint, assuredly, be aware, (un-) awares, can(-not), certainly, comprehend, consider, × could they, cunning, declare, be diligent, (can, cause to) discern, discover, endued with, familiar friend, famous, feel, can have, be (ig-) norant, instruct, kinsfolk, kinsman, (cause to let, make) know, (come to give, have, take) knowledge, have (knowledge), (be, make, make to be, make self) known,   be learned,   lie by man, mark, perceive, privy to, × prognosticator, regard, have respect, skilful, shew, can (man of) skill, be sure, of a surety, teach, (can) tell, understand, have (understanding), × will be, wist, wit, wot.

H3046.definition: יְדַע yᵉdaʻ, yed-ah'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3045:—certify, know, make known, teach.

H3048.definition: יְדַעְיָה Yᵉdaʻyâh, yed-ah-yaw'; from H3045 and H3050; Jah has known;  Jedajah, the name of two Israelites:—Jedaiah.

H3050.partOfSpeech: proper noun with reference to deity
H3050.definition: יָהּ Yâhh, yaw; contraction for H3068, and meaning the same;  Jah, the sacred name:—Jah, the Lord, most vehement. Compare names in '-iah,' '-jah.'

H3051.definition: יָהַב yâhab, yaw-hab'; a primitive root;  to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come:—ascribe, bring, come on, give, go, set, take.

H3052.definition: יְהַב yᵉhab, yeh-hab'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3051:—deliver, give, lay,   prolong, pay, yield.

H3054.definition: יָהַד yâhad, yaw-had'; denominative from a form corresponding to H3061;  to Judaize, i.e. become Jewish:—become Jews.

H3058.definition: יֵהוּא Yêhûwʼ, yay-hoo'; from H3068 and H1931; Jehovah (is) He;  Jehu, the name of five Israelites:—Jehu.

H3059.definition: יְהוֹאָחָז Yᵉhôwʼâchâz, yeh-ho-aw-khawz'; from H3068 and H270; Jehovah-seized;  Jehoachaz, the name of three Israelites:—Jehoahaz. Compare H3099.

H3060.definition: יְהוֹאָשׁ Yᵉhôwʼâsh, yeh-ho-awsh'; from H3068 and (perhaps) H784; Jehovah-fired; Jehoash, the name of two Israelite kings:—Jehoash. Compare H3101.

H3061.definition: יְהוּד Yᵉhûwd, yeh-hood'; (Aramaic) contracted from a form corresponding to H3063;  properly, Judah, hence, Judaea:—Jewry, Judah, Judea.

H3062.definition: יְהוּדָאִי Yᵉhûwdâʼîy, yeh-hoo-daw-ee'; (Aramaic) patrial from H3061;  a Jehudaite (or Judaite), i.e. Jew:—Jew.

H3063.definition: יְהוּדָה Yᵉhûwdâh, yeh-hoo-daw'; from H3034; celebrated;  Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory:—Judah.

H3064.definition: יְהוּדִי Yᵉhûwdîy, yeh-hoo-dee'; patronymically from H3063;  a Jehudite (i.e. Judaite or Jew), or descendant of Jehudah (i.e. Judah):—Jew.

H3065.definition: יְהוּדִי Yᵉhûwdîy, yeh-hoo-dee'; the same as H3064;  Jehudi, an Israelite:—Jehudi.

H3067.definition: יְהוּדִית Yᵉhûwdîyth, yeh-ho-deeth'; the same as H3066; Jewess;  Jehudith, a Canaanitess:—Judith.

H3075.definition: יְהוֹזָבָד Yᵉhôwzâbâd, yeh-ho-zaw-bawd'; from H3068 and H2064; Jehovah-endowed;  Jehozabad, the name of three Israelites:—Jehozabad. Compare H3107.

H3076.definition: יְהוֹחָנָן Yᵉhôwchânân, yeh-ho-khaw-nawn'; from H3068 and H2603; Jehovah-favored;  Jehochanan, the name of eight Israelites:—Jehohanan, Johanan. Compare H3110.

H3077.definition: יְהוֹיָדָע Yᵉhôwyâdâʻ, yeh-ho-yaw-daw'; from H3068 and H3045; Jehovah-known;  Jehojada, the name of three Israelites:—Jehoiada. Compare H3111.

H3078.definition: יְהוֹיָכִין Yᵉhôwyâkîyn, yeh-ho-yaw-keen'; from H3068 and H3559; Jehovah will establish;  Jehojakin, a Jewish king:—Jehoiachin. Compare H3112.

H3079.definition: יְהוֹיָקִים Yᵉhôwyâqîym, yeh-ho-yaw-keem'; from H3068 abbreviated and H6965; Jehovah will raise;  Jehojakim, a Jewish king:—Jehoiakim. Compare H3113.

H3080.definition: יְהוֹיָרִיב Yᵉhôwyârîyb, yeh-ho-yaw-reeb'; from H3068 and H7378; Jehovah will contend;  Jehojarib, the name of two Israelites:—Jehoiarib. Compare H3114.

H3081.definition: יְהוּכַל Yᵉhûwkal, yeh-hoo-kal'; from H3201; potent;  Jehukal, an Israelite:—Jehucal. Compare H3116.

H3082.definition: יְהוֹנָדָב Yᵉhôwnâdâb, yeh-ho-naw-dawb'; from H3068 and H5068; Jehovah-largessed;  Jehonadab, the name of an Israelite and of an Arab:—Jehonadab, Jonadab. Compare H3122.

H3083.definition: יְהוֹנָתָן Yᵉhôwnâthân, yeh-ho-naw-thawn'; from H3068 and H5414; Jehovah-given;  Jehonathan, the name of four Israelites:—Jonathan. Compare H3129.

H3087.definition: יְהוֹצָדָק Yᵉhôwtsâdâq, yeh-ho-tsaw-dawk'; from H3068 and H6663; Jehovah-righted;  Jehotsadak, an Israelite:—Jehozadek, Josedech. Compare H3136.

H3088.definition: יְהוֹרָם Yᵉhôwrâm, yeh-ho-rawm'; from H3068 and H7311; Jehovah-raised;  Jehoram, the name of a Syrian and of three Israelites:—Jehoram, Joram. Compare H3141.

H309.definition: אָחַר ʼâchar, aw-khar'; a primitive root;  to loiter (i.e. be behind); by implication to procrastinate:—continue, defer, delay, hinder, be late (slack), stay (there), tarry (longer).

H3091.definition: יְהוֹשׁוּעַ Yᵉhôwshûwaʻ, yeh-ho-shoo'-ah; or יְהוֹשֻׁעַ Yᵉhôwshuʻa; from H3068 and H3467; Jehovah-saved;  Jehoshua (i.e. Joshua), the Jewish leader:—Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare H1954, H3442.

H3092.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3092.definition: יְהוֹשָׁפָט Yᵉhôwshâphâṭ, yeh-ho-shaw-fawt'; from H3068 and H8199; Jehovah-judged;  Jehoshaphat, the name of six Israelites; also of a valley near Jerusalem:—Jehoshaphat. Compare H3146.

H3096.definition: יַהַץ Yahats, yah'-hats; or יַהְצָה Yahtsâh; or (feminine) יַהְצָה Yahtsâh; from an unused root meaning to stamp; perhaps threshing-floor;  Jahats or Jahtsah, a place East of the Jordan:—Jahaz, Jahazah, Jahzah.

H3097.definition: יוֹאָב Yôwʼâb, yo-awb'; from H3068 and H1; Jehovah-fathered;  Joab, the name of three Israelites:—Joab.

H3098.definition: יוֹאָח Yôwʼâch, yo-awkh'; from H3068 and H251; Jehovah-brothered;  Joach, the name of four Israelites:—Joah.

H3099.definition: יוֹאָחָז Yôwʼâchâz, yo-aw-khawz'; a form of H3059;  Joachaz, the name of two Israelites:—Jehoahaz, Joahaz.

H31.definition: אֲבִיהוּד ʼĂbîyhûwd, ab-ee-hood'; from H1 and H1935; father (i.e. possessor) of renown;  Abihud, the name of two Israelites:—Abihud.

H310.definition: אַחַר ʼachar, akh-ar'; from H309;  properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses):—after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, + out (over) live, + persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.

H3100.definition: יוֹאֵל Yôwʼêl, yo-ale'; from H3068 and H410; Jehovah (is his) God;  Joel, the name of twelve Israelites:—Joel.

H3101.definition: יוֹאָשׁ Yôwʼâsh, yo-awsh'; or יֹאָשׁ Yôʼâsh; (2 Chronicles 24:1), a form of H3060;  Joash, the name of six Israelites:—Joash.

H3103.definition: יוֹבָב Yôwbâb, yo-bawb'; from H2980; howler;  Jobab, the name of two Israelites and of three foreigners:—Jobab.

H3104.definition: יוֹבֵל yôwbêl, yo-bale'; or יֹבֵל yôbêl; apparently from H2986;  the blast of a horn (from its continuous sound); specifically, the signal of the silver trumpets; hence, the instrument itself and the festival thus introduced:—jubile, ram's horn, trumpet.

H3107.definition: יוֹזָבָד Yôwzâbâd, yo-zaw-bawd'; a form of H3075;  Jozabad, the name of ten Israelites:—Josabad, Jozabad.

H311.definition: אַחַר ʼachar, akh-ar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H310;  after:—(here-) after.

H3110.definition: יוֹחָנָן Yôwchânân, yo-khaw-nawn'; a form of H3076;  Jochanan, the name of nine Israelites:—Johanan.

H3111.definition: יוֹיָדָע Yôwyâdâʻ, yo-yaw-daw'; a form of H3077;  Jojada, the name of two Israelites:—Jehoiada, Joiada.

H3113.definition: יוֹיָקִים Yôwyâqîym, yo-yaw-keem'; a form of H3079;  Jojakim, an Israelite:—Joiakim. Compare H3137.

H3115.definition: יוֹכֶבֶד Yôwkebed, yo-keh'-bed; from H3068 contracted and H3513; Jehovah-gloried;  Jokebed, the mother of Moses:—Jochebed.

H3117.definition: יוֹם yôwm, yome; from an unused root meaning to be hot;  a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb):—age,   always,   chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone),   elder, × end,   evening,   (for) ever(-lasting, -more), × full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now,   old,   outlived,   perpetually, presently,   remaineth, × required, season, × since, space, then, (process of) time,   as at other times,   in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), × whole (  age), (full) year(-ly),   younger.

H3118.definition: יוֹם yôwm, yome; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3117;  a day:—day (by day), time.

H3119.definition: יוֹמָם yôwmâm, yo-mawm'; from H3117;  daily:—daily, (by, in the) day(-time).

H312.definition: אַחֵר ʼachêr, akh-air'; from H309;  properly, hinder; generally, next, other, etc.:—(an-) other man, following, next, strange.

H3120.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3120.definition: יָוָן Yâvân, yaw-vawn'; probably from the same as H3196; effervescing (i.e. hot and active);  Javan, the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, i.e. Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia:—Javan.

H3121.definition: יָוֵן yâvên, yaw-ven'; from the same as H3196;  properly, dregs (as effervescing); hence, mud:—mire, miry.

H3122.definition: יוֹנָדָב Yôwnâdâb, yo-naw-dawb'; a form of H3082;  Jonadab, the name of an Israelite and of a Rechabite:—Jonadab.

H3123.definition: יוֹנָה yôwnâh, yo-naw'; probably from the same as H3196;  a dove (apparently from the warmth of their mating):—dove, pigeon.

H3124.definition: יוֹנָה Yôwnâh, yo-naw'; the same as H3123;  Jonah, an Israelite:—Jonah.

H3129.definition: יוֹנָתָן Yôwnâthân, yo-naw-thawn'; a form of H3083;  Jonathan, the name of ten Israelites:—Jonathan.

H3130.definition: יוֹסֵף Yôwçêph, yo-safe'; future of H3254; let him add (or perhaps simply active participle adding);  Joseph, the name of seven Israelites:—Joseph. Compare H3084.

H3134.definition: יוֹעֶזֶר Yôwʻezer, yo-eh'-zer; from H3068 and H5828; Jehovah (is his) help;  Joezer, an Israelite:—Joezer.

H3135.definition: יוֹעָשׁ Yôwʻâsh, yo-awsh'; from H3068 and H5789; Jehovahhastened;  Joash, the name of two Israelites:—Joash.

H3138.definition: יוֹרֶה yôwreh, yo-reh'; active participle of H3384;  sprinkling; hence, a sprinkling (or autumnal showers):—first rain, former (rain).

H314.definition: אַחֲרוֹן ʼachărôwn, akh-ar-one'; or (shortened) אַחֲרֹן ʼachărôn; from H309;  hinder; generally, late or last; specifically (as facing the east) western:—after (-ward), to come, following, hind(-er, -ermost, -most), last, latter, rereward, ut(ter) most.

H3140.definition: יוֹרַי Yôwray, yo-rah'-ee; from H3384; rainy;  Jorai, an Israelite:—Jorai.

H3141.definition: יוֹרָם Yôwrâm, yo-rawm'; a form of H3088;  Joram, the name of three Israelites and one Syrian:—Joram.

H3147.definition: יוֹתָם Yôwthâm, yo-thawm'; from H3068 and H8535; Jehovah (is) perfect;  Jotham, the name of three Israelites:—Jotham.

H3148.definition: יוֹתֵר yôwthêr, yo-thare'; active participle of H3498;  properly, redundant; hence, over and above, as adjective, noun, adverb or conjunction:—better, more(-over), over, profit.

H315.definition: אַחְרַח ʼAchrach, akh-rakh'; from H310 and H251; after (his) brother;  Achrach, an Israelite:—Aharah.

H3150.definition: יִזִּיָּה Yizzîyâh, yiz-zee-yaw'; from the same as the first part of H3149 and H3050; sprinkled of Jah;  Jizzijah, an Israelite:—Jeziah.

H3152.definition: יִזְלִיאָה Yizlîyʼâh, yiz-lee-aw'; perhaps from an unused root (meaning to draw up); he will draw out;  Jizliah, an Israelite:—Jezliah.

H3153.definition: יְזַנְיָה Yᵉzanyâh, yez-an-yaw'; or יְזַנְיָהוּ Yᵉzanyâhûw; probably for H2970;  Jezanjah, an Israelite:—Jezaniah.

H3156.definition: יִזְרַחְיָה Yizrachyâh, yiz-rakh-yaw'; from H2224 and H3050; Jah will shine;  Jizrachjah, the name of two Israelites:—Izrahiah, Jezrahiah.

H3157.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3157.definition: יִזְרְעֵאל Yizrᵉʻêʼl, yiz-reh-ale'; from H2232 and H410; God will sow;  Jizreel, the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites:—Jezreel.

H3160.definition: יְחֻבָּה Yᵉchubbâh, yekh-oob-baw'; from H2247; hidden;  Jechubbah, an Israelite:—Jehubbah.

H3161.definition: יָחַד yâchad, yaw-khad'; a primitive root;  to be (or become) one:—join, unite.

H3162.definition: יַחַד yachad, yakh'-ad; from H3161;  properly, a unit, i.e. (adverb) unitedly:—alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal.

H3165.definition: יֶחְדִּיָּהוּ Yechdîyâhûw, yekh-dee-yaw'-hoo; from H3162 and H3050; unity of Jah;  Jechdijah, the name of two Israelites:—Jehdeiah.

H3166.definition: יַחֲזִיאֵל Yachăzîyʼêl, yakh-az-ee-ale'; from H2372 and H410; beheld of God;  Jachaziel, the name of five Israelites:—Jahaziel, Jahziel.

H3169.definition: יְחִזְקִיָּה Yᵉchizqîyâh, yekh-iz-kee-yaw'; or יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ Yᵉchizqîyâhûw; from H3388 and H3050; strengthened of Jah;  Jechizkijah, the name of five Israelites:—Hezekiah, Jehizkiah. Compare H2396.

H317.definition: אׇחֳרִי ʼochŏrîy, okh-or-ee'; (Aramaic) from H311;  other:—(an-) other.

H3171.definition: יְחִיאֵל Yᵉchîyʼêl, yekh-ee-ale'; or (2 Chronicles 29:14) יְחַוְאֵל Yᵉchavʼêl; from H2421 and H410; God will live;  Jechiel (or Jechavel), the name of eight Israelites:—Jehiel.

H3173.definition: יָחִיד yâchîyd, yaw-kheed'; from H3161;  properly, united, i.e. sole; by implication, beloved; also lonely; (feminine) the life (as not to be replaced):—darling, desolate, only (child, son), solitary.

H3176.definition: יָחַל yâchal, yaw-chal'; a primitive root;  to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope:—(cause to, have, make to) hope, be pained, stay, tarry, trust, wait.

H3179.definition: יָחַם yâcham, yaw-kham'; a primitive root;  probably to be hot; figuratively, to conceive:—get heat, be hot, conceive, be warm.

H3180.definition: יַחְמוּר yachmûwr, yakh-moor'; from H2560;  a kind of deer:—fallow deer.

H3181.definition: יַחְמַי Yachmay, yakh-mah'-ee; probably from H3179; hot;  Jachmai, an Israelite:—Jahmai.

H3182.definition: יָחֵף yâchêph, yaw-khafe'; from an unused root meaning to take off the shoes;  unsandalled:—barefoot, being unshod.

H3183.definition: יַחְצְאֵל Yachtsᵉʼêl, yakh-tseh-ale'; from H2673 and H410; God will allot;  Jachtseel, an Israelite:—Jahzeel. Compare H3185.

H3185.definition: יַחְצִיאֵל Yachtsîyʼêl, yakh-tsee-ale'; from H2673 and H410; allotted of God;  Jachtsiel, an Israelite:—Jahziel. Compare H3183.

H3187.definition: יָחַשׂ yâchas, yaw-khas'; a primitive root; to sprout; used only as denominative from H3188;  to enroll by pedigree:—(number after, number throughout the) genealogy (to be reckoned), be reckoned by genealogies.

H3189.definition: יַחַת Yachath, yakh'-ath; from H3161; unity;  Jachath, the name of four Israelites:—Jahath.

H319.definition: אַחֲרִית ʼachărîyth, akh-ar-eeth'; from H310;  the last or end, hence, the future; also posterity:—(last, latter) end (time), hinder (utter) -most, length, posterity, remnant, residue, reward.

H3190.definition: יָטַב yâṭab, yaw-tab'; a primitive root;  to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right):—be accepted, amend, use aright, benefit, be (make) better, seem best, make cheerful, be comely,   be content, diligent(-ly), dress, earnestly, find favour, give, be glad, do (be, make) good(-ness), be (make) merry, please (  well), shew more (kindness), skilfully, × very small, surely, make sweet, thoroughly, tire, trim, very, be (can, deal, entreat, go, have) well (said, seen).

H3191.definition: יְטַב yᵉṭab, yet-ab'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3190:—seem good.

H3195.definition: יְטוּר Yᵉṭûwr, yet-oor'; probably from the same as H2905; encircled (i.e. inclosed);  Jetur, a son of Ishmael:—Jetur.

H3196.definition: יַיִן yayin, yah'-yin; from an unused root meaning to effervesce;  wine (as fermented); by implication, intoxication:—banqueting, wine, wine(-bibber).

H3197.definition: יַךְ yak, yak; by erroneous transcription for H3027;  a hand or side:—(way-) side.

H3198.definition: יָכַח yâkach, yaw-kahh'; a primitive root;  to be right (i.e. correct); reciprocal, to argue; causatively, to decide, justify or convict:—appoint, argue, chasten, convince, correct(-ion), daysman, dispute, judge, maintain, plead, reason (together), rebuke, reprove(-r), surely, in any wise.

H3199.definition: יָכִין Yâkîyn, yaw-keen'; from H3559; he (or it) will establish;  Jakin, the name of three Israelites and of a temple pillar:—Jachin.

H3201.definition: יָכֹל yâkôl, yaw-kole'; or (fuller) יָכוֹל yâkôwl; a primitive root;  to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might):—be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, (-not)), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer.

H3202.definition: יְכֵל yᵉkêl, yek-ale'; (Aramaic) or יְכִיל yᵉkîyl; (Aramaic), to H3201:—be able, can, couldest, prevail.

H3204.definition: יְכׇנְיָה Yᵉkonyâh, yek-on-yaw'; and יְכׇנְיָהוּ Yᵉkonyâhûw; or (Jeremiah 27:20) יְכוֹנְיָה Yᵉkôwnᵉyâh; from H3559 and H3050; Jah will establish;  Jekonjah, a Jewish king:—Jeconiah. Compare H3659.

H3205.definition: יָלַד yâlad, yaw-lad'; a primitive root;  to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage:—bear, beget, birth(-day), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, calve, child, come, be delivered (of a child), time of delivery, gender, hatch, labour, (do the office of a) midwife, declare pedigrees, be the son of, (woman in, woman that) travail(-eth, -ing woman).

H3206.definition: יֶלֶד yeled, yeh'-led; from H3205;  something born, i.e. a lad or offspring:—boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one).

H3207.definition: יַלְדָּה yaldâh, yal-daw'; feminine of H3206;  a lass:—damsel, girl.

H3209.definition: יִלּוֹד yillôwd, yil-lode'; passive from H3205;  born:—born.

H321.definition: אׇחֳרָן ʼochŏrân, okh-or-awn'; (Aramaic) from H311; the same as H317;  other:—(an-) other.

H3211.definition: יָלִיד yâlîyd, yaw-leed'; from H3205;  born:—(home-) born, child, son.

H3212.definition: יָלַךְ yâlak, yaw-lak'; a primitive root (compare H1980);  to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses):—× again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow,   follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper,   pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, × be weak.

H3213.definition: יָלַל yâlal, yaw-lal'; a primitive root;  to howl (with a wailing tone) or yell (with a boisterous one):—(make to) howl, be howling.

H3214.definition: יְלֵל yᵉlêl, yel-ale'; from H3213;  howl:—a howling.

H3215.definition: יְלָלָה yᵉlâlâh, yel-aw-law'; feminine of H3214  a howling:—a howling.

H3217.definition: יַלֶּפֶת yallepheth, yal-leh'-feth; from an unused root apparently meaning to stick or scrape;  scurf or tetter:—scabbed.

H3218.definition: יֶלֶק yeleq, yeh'-lek; from an unused root meaning to lick up;  a devourer; specifically, the young locust:—cankerworm, caterpillar.

H322.definition: אֲחֹרַנִּית ʼăchôrannîyth, akh-o-ran-neeth'; prolonged from H268;  backwards:—back (-ward, again).

H3220.definition: יָם yâm, yawm; from an unused root meaning to roar;  a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south:—sea (× -faring man, (-shore)), south, west (-ern, side, -ward).

H3221.definition: יָם yâm, yawm; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3220:—sea.

H3222.definition: יֵם yêm, yame; from the same as H3117;  a warm spring:—mule.

H3223.definition: יְמוּאֵל Yᵉmûwʼêl, yem-oo-ale'; from H3117 and H410; day of God;  Jemuel, an Israelite:—Jemuel.

H3224.definition: יְמִימָה Yᵉmîymâh, yem-ee-maw'; perhaps from the same as H3117; properly, warm, i.e. affectionate; hence, dove (compare H3123);  Jemimah, one of Job's daughters:—Jemimah.

H3225.definition: יָמִין yâmîyn, yaw-meen'; from H3231;  the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south:—  left-handed, right (hand, side), south.

H3226.definition: יָמִין Yâmîyn, yaw-meen'; the same as H3225;  Jamin, the name of three Israelites:—Jamin. See also H1144.

H3227.definition: יְמִינִי yᵉmîynîy, yem-ee-nee'; for H3225;  right:—(on the) right (hand).

H323.definition: אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפַּן ʼăchashdarpan, akh-ash-dar-pan'; of Persian derivation;  a satrap or governor of a main province (of Persia):—lieutenant.

H3231.definition: יָמַן yâman, yaw-man'; a primitive root; to be (physically) right (i.e. firm); but used only as denominative from H3225 and transitive,  to be right-handed or take the right-hand side:—go (turn) to (on, use) the right hand.

H3232.definition: יִמְנָה Yimnâh, yim-naw'; from H3231; prosperity (as betokened by the right hand);  Jimnah, the name of two Israelites; also (with the article) of the posterity of one of them:—Imna, Imnah, Jimnah, Jimnites.

H3233.definition: יְמָנִי yᵉmânîy, yem-aw-nee'; from H3231;  right (i.e. at the right hand):—(on the) right (hand).

H3234.definition: יִמְנָע Yimnâʻ, yim-naw'; from H4513; he will restrain;  Jimna, an Israelite:—Imna.

H3235.definition: יָמַר yâmar, yaw-mar'; a primitive root;  to exchange; by implication, to change places:—boast selves, change.

H3238.definition: יָנָה yânâh, yaw-naw'; a primitive root;  to rage or be violent; by implication, to suppress, to maltreat:—destroy, (thrust out by) oppress(-ing, -ion, -or), proud, vex, do violence.

H324.definition: אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפַּן ʼăchashdarpan, akh-ash-dar-pan'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H323:—prince.

H3240.definition: יָנַח yânach, yaw-nakh'; a primitive root;  to deposit; by implication, to allow to stay:—bestow, cast down, lay (down, up), leave (off), let alone (remain), pacify, place, put, set (down), suffer, withdraw, withhold. (The Hiphil forms with the dagesh are here referred to, in accordance with the older grammarians; but if any distinction of the kind is to be made, these should rather be referred to 5117, and the others here.)

H3243.definition: יָנַק yânaq, yaw-nak'; a primitive root;  to suck; causatively, to give milk:—milch, nurse(-ing mother), (give, make to) suck(-ing child, -ling).

H3245.definition: יָסַד yâçad, yaw-sad'; a primitive root;  to set (literally or figuratively); intensively, to found; reflexively, to sit down together, i.e. settle, consult:—appoint, take counsel, establish, (lay the, lay for a) found(-ation), instruct, lay, ordain, set, × sure.

H3246.definition: יְסֻד yᵉçud, yes-ood'; from H3245;  a foundation (figuratively, i.e. beginning):—× began.

H3247.definition: יְסוֹד yᵉçôwd, yes-ode'; from H3245;  a foundation (literally or figuratively):—bottom, foundation, repairing

H325.definition: אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ ʼĂchashvêrôwsh, akh-ash-vay-rosh'; or (shortened) אַחַשְׁרֹשׁ ʼAchashrôsh (Esther 10:1); of Persian origin;  Achashverosh (i.e. Ahasuerus or Artaxerxes, but in this case Xerxes), the title (rather than name) of a Persian king:—Ahasuerus.

H3253.definition: יִסְמַכְיָהוּ Yiçmakyâhûw, yis-mak-yaw-hoo'; from H5564 and H3050; Jah will sustain;  Jismakjah, an Israelite:—Ismachiah.

H3254.definition: יָסַף yâçaph, yaw-saf'; a primitive root;  to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing):—add, × again, × any more, × cease, × come more,   conceive again, continue, exceed, × further, × gather together, get more, give more-over, × henceforth, increase (more and more), join, × longer (bring, do, make, much, put), × (the, much, yet) more (and more), proceed (further), prolong, put, be (strong-) er, × yet, yield.

H3256.definition: יָסַר yâçar, yaw-sar'; a primitive root;  to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct:—bind, chasten, chastise, correct, instruct, punish, reform, reprove, sore, teach.

H3258.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3258.definition: יַעְבֵּץ Yaʻbêts, yah-bates'; from an unused root probably meaning to grieve; sorrowful;  Jabets, the name of an Israelite, and also of a place in Palestine:—Jabez.

H3259.definition: יָעַד yâʻad, yaw-ad'; a primitive root;  to fix upon (by agreement or appointment); by implication, to meet (at a stated time), to summon (to trial), to direct (in a certain quarter or position), to engage (for marriage):—agree,(maxke an) appoint(-ment, a time), assemble (selves), betroth, gather (selves, together), meet (together), set (a time).

H3261.definition: יָעָה yâʻâh, yaw-aw'; a primitive root; apparently  to brush aside:—sweep away.

H3262.definition: יְעוּאֵל Yᵉʻûwʼêl, yeh-oo-ale'; from H3261 and H410; carried away of God;  Jeuel, the name of four Israelites:—Jehiel, Jeiel, Jeuel. Compare H3273.

H3263.definition: יְעוּץ Yᵉʻûwts, yeh-oots'; from H5779; counsellor;  Jeuts, an Israelite:—Jeuz

H3265.definition: יָעוּר Yâʻûwr, yaw-oor'; apparently the passive participle of the same as H3293; wooded;  Jaur, an Israelite:—Jair(from the margin).

H3266.definition: יְעוּשׁ Yᵉʻûwsh, yeh-oosh'; from H5789; hasty;  Jeush, the name of an Edomite and of four Israelites:—Jehush, Jeush. Compare H3274.

H3268.definition: יַעֲזִיאֵל Yaʻăzîyʼêl, yah-az-ee-ale'; from H3267 and H410; emboldened of God;  Jaaziel, an Israelite:—Jaaziel.

H3270.definition: יַעֲזֵיר Yaʻăzêyr, yah-az-ayr'; or יַעְזֵר Yaʻzêr; from H5826; helpful;  Jaazer or Jazer, a place East of the Jordan:—Jaazer, Jazer.

H3272.definition: יְעַט yᵉʻaṭ, yeh-at'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3289;  to counsel; reflexively, to consult:—counsellor, consult together.

H3273.definition: יְעִיאֵל Yᵉʻîyʼêl, yeh-ee-ale'; from H3261 and H410; carried away of God;  Jeiel, the name of six Israelites:—Jeiel, Jehiel. Compare H3262.

H3274.definition: יְעִישׁ Yᵉʻîysh, yeh-eesh'; from H5789; hasty;  Jeish, the name of an Edomite and of a an Israelite:—Jeush (from the margin). Compare H3266.

H3275.definition: יַעְכָּן Yaʻkân, yah-kawn'; from the same as H5912; troublesome;  Jakan, an Israelite:—Jachan.

H3276.definition: יָעַל yâʻal, yaw-al'; a primitive root;  properly, to ascend; figuratively, to be valuable (objectively; useful, subjectively; benefited):—× at all, set forward, can do good, (be, have) profit, (able).

H3277.definition: יָעֵל yâʻêl, yaw-ale'; from H3276;  an ibex (as climbing):—wild goat.

H3278.definition: יָעֵל Yâʻêl, yaw-ale'; the same as H3277;  Jael, a Canaanite:—Jael.

H3280.definition: יַעֲלָה yaʻălâh, yah-al-aw'; feminine of H3277:—roe.

H3281.definition: יַעְלָם Yaʻlâm, yah-lawm'; from H5956; occult;  Jalam, an Edomite:—Jalam.

H3282.definition: יַעַן yaʻan, yah'-an; from an unused root meaning to pay attention;  properly, heed; by implication, purpose (sake or account); used adverbially to indicate the reason or cause:—because (that), forasmuch (+ as), seeing then, + that, + whereas, + why.

H3286.definition: יָעַף yâʻaph, yaw-af'; a primitive root;  to tire (as if from wearisome flight):—faint, cause to fly, (be) weary (self).

H3289.definition: יָעַץ yâʻats, yaw-ats'; a primitive root;  to advise; reflexively, to deliberate or resolve:—advertise, take advise, advise (well), consult, (give, take) counsel(-lor), determine, devise, guide, purpose.

H3290.definition: יַעֲקֹב Yaʻăqôb, yah-ak-obe'; from H6117; heel-catcher (i.e. supplanter);  Jaakob, the Israelitish patriarch:—Jacob.

H3291.definition: יַעֲקֹבָה Yaʻăqôbâh, yah-ak-o'-baw; from H3290;  Jaakobah, an Israelite:—Jaakobah.

H3293.definition: יַעַר yaʻar, yah'-ar; from an unused root probably meaning to thicken with verdure;  a copse of bushes; hence, a forest; hence, honey in the comb (as hived in trees):—(honey-) comb, forest, wood.

H3294.definition: יַעְרָה Yaʻrâh, yah-raw'; a form of H3295;  Jarah, an Israelite:—Jarah.

H3297.definition: יְעָרִים Yᵉʻârîym, yeh-aw-reem'; plural of H3293; forests;  Jearim, a place in Palestine:—Jearim. Compare H7157.

H3298.definition: יַעֲרֶשְׁיָה Yaʻăreshyâh, yah-ar-esh-yaw'; from an unused root of uncertain signification and H3050;  Jaareshjah, an Israelite:—Jaresiah.

H3299.definition: יַעֲשׂוּ Yaʻăsûw, yah-as-oo'; from H6213; they will do;  Jaasu, an Israelite:—Jaasau.

H330.definition: אֵטוּן ʼêṭûwn, ay-toon'; from an unused root (probably meaning to bind);  properly, twisted (yarn), i.e. tapestry:—fine linen.

H3300.definition: יַעֲשִׂיאֵל Yaʻăsîyʼêl, yah-as-ee-ale'; from H6213 and H410; made of God;  Jaasiel, an Israelite:—Jaasiel, Jasiel.

H3301.definition: יִפְדְּיָה Yiphdᵉyâh, yif-deh-yaw'; from H6299 and H3050; Jah will liberate;  Jiphdejah, an Israelite:—Iphedeiah.

H3302.definition: יָפָה yâphâh, yaw-faw'; a primitive root;  properly, to be bright, i.e. (by implication) beautiful:—be beautiful, be (make self) fair(-r), deck.

H3303.definition: יָפֶה yâpheh, yaw-feh'; from H3302;  beautiful (literally or figuratively):—  beautiful, beauty, comely, fair(-est, one),   goodly, pleasant, well.

H3305.definition: יָפוֹ Yâphôw, yaw-fo'; or יָפוֹא Yâphôwʼ; (Ezra 3:7), from H3302; beautiful;  Japho, a place in Palestine:—Japha, Joppa.

H3306.definition: יָפַח yâphach, yaw-fakh'; a primitive root;  properly, to breathe hard, i.e. (by implication) to sigh:—bewail self.

H3309.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3309.definition: יָפִיעַ Yâphîyaʻ, yaw-fee'-ah; from H3313; bright;  Japhia, the name of a Canaanite, an Israelite, and a place in Palestine:—Japhia.

H3310.definition: יַפְלֵט Yaphlêṭ, yaf-late'; from H6403; he will deliver;  Japhlet, an Israelite:—Japhlet.

H3312.definition: יְפֻנֶּה Yᵉphunneh, yef-oon-neh'; from H6437; he will be prepared;  Jephunneh, the name of two Israelites:—Jephunneh.

H3313.definition: יָפַע yâphaʻ, yaw-fah'; a primitive root;  to shine:—be light, shew self, (cause to) shine (forth).

H3315.definition: יֶפֶת Yepheth, yeh'-feth; from H6601; expansion;  Jepheth, a son of Noah; also his posterity:—Japheth.

H3316.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3316.definition: יִפְתָּח Yiphtâch, yif-tawkh'; from H6605; he will open;  Jiphtach, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine:—Jephthah, Jiphtah.

H3318.definition: יָצָא yâtsâʼ, yaw-tsaw'; a primitive root;  to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.:—× after, appear, × assuredly, bear out, × begotten, break out, bring forth (out, up), carry out, come (abroad, out, thereat, without),   be condemned, depart(-ing, -ure), draw forth, in the end, escape, exact, fail, fall (out), fetch forth (out), get away (forth, hence, out), (able to, cause to, let) go abroad (forth, on, out), going out, grow, have forth (out), issue out, lay (lie) out, lead out, pluck out, proceed, pull out, put away, be risen, × scarce, send with commandment, shoot forth, spread, spring out, stand out, × still, × surely, take forth (out), at any time, × to (and fro), utter.

H3320.definition: יָצַב yâtsab, yaw-tsab'; a primitive root;  to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station, offer, continue:—present selves, remaining, resort, set (selves), (be able to, can, with-) stand (fast, forth, -ing, still, up).

H3323.definition: יִצְהָר yitshâr, yits-hawr'; from H6671;  oil (as producing light); figuratively, anointing:—  anointed oil.

H3324.definition: יִצְהָר Yitshâr, yits-hawr'; the same as H3323;  Jitshar, an Israelite:—Izhar.

H3326.definition: יָצוּעַ yâtsûwaʻ, yaw-tsoo'-ah; passive participle of H3331;  spread, i.e. a bed; (architecture) an extension, i.e. wing or lean-to (a single story or collectively):—bed, chamber, couch.

H3327.definition: יִצְחָק Yitschâq, yits-khawk'; from H6711; laughter (i.e. mochery);  Jitschak (or Isaac), son of Abraham:—Isaac. Compare H3446.

H3328.definition: יִצְחַר Yitschar, yits-khar'; from the same as H6713; he will shine;  Jitschar, an Israelite:—and Zehoar (from the margin).

H333.definition: אָטֵר ʼÂṭêr, aw-tare'; from H332; maimed;  Ater, the name of three Israelites:—Ater.

H3330.definition: יַצִּיב yatstsîyb, yats-tseeb'; (Aramaic) from H3321;  fixed, sure; concretely, certainty:—certain(-ty), true, truth.

H3331.definition: יַצַע yatsaʻ, yaw-tsah'; a primitive root;  to strew as a surface:—make (one's) bed, × lie, spread.

H3332.definition: יָצַק yâtsaq, yaw-tsak'; a primitive root;  properly, to pour out (transitive or intransitive); by implication, to melt or cast as metal; by extension, to place firmly, to stiffen or grow hard:—cast, cleave fast, be (as) firm, grow, be hard, lay out, molten, overflow, pour (out), run out, set down, stedfast.

H3334.definition: יָצַר yâtsar, yaw-tsar'; a primitive root;  to press (intransitive), i.e. be narrow; figuratively, be in distress:—be distressed, be narrow, be straitened (in straits), be vexed.

H3335.definition: יָצַר yâtsar, yaw-tsar'; probably identical with H3334 (through the squeezing into shape); (compare H3331);  to mould into a form; especially as a potter; figuratively, to determine (i.e. form a resolution):—× earthen, fashion, form, frame, make(-r), potter, purpose.

H3337.definition: יֵצֶר Yêtser, yay-tser; the same as H3336;  Jetser, an Israelite:—Jezer.

H3341.definition: יָצַת yâtsath, yaw-tsath'; a primitive root;  to burn or set on fire; figuratively, to desolate:—burn (up), be desolate, set (on) fire (fire), kindle.

H3342.definition: יֶקֶב yeqeb, yeh'-keb; from an unused root meaning to excavate;  a trough (as dug out); specifically, a wine-vat (whether the lower one, into which the juice drains; or the upper, in which the grapes are crushed):—fats, presses, press-fat, wine(-press).

H335.definition: אַי ʼay, ah'ee; perhaps from H370;  where? hence how?:—how, what, whence, where, whether, which (way).

H3355.definition: יׇקְטָן Yoqṭân, yok-tawn'; from H6994; he will be made little;  Joktan, an Arabian patriarch:—Joktan.

H3356.definition: יָקִים Yâqîym, yaw-keem'; from H6965; he will raise;  Jakim, the name of two Israelites:—Jakim. Compare H3079.

H3358.definition: יַקִּיר yaqqîyr, yak-keer'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3357:—noble, rare.

H3359.definition: יְקַמְיָה Yᵉqamyâh, yek-am-yaw'; from H6965 and H3050; Jah will rise;  Jekamjah, the name of two Israelites:—Jekamiah. Compare H3079.

H3360.definition: יְקַמְעָם Yᵉqamʻâm, yek-am'-awm; from H6965 and H5971; (the) people will rise;  Jekamam, an Israelite:—Jekameam. Compare H3079, H3361.

H3361.definition: יׇקְמְעָם Yoqmᵉʻâm, yok-meh-awm'; from H6965 and H5971; (the) people will be raised;  Jokmeam, a place in Palestine:—Jokmeam. Compare H3360, H3362.

H3362.definition: יׇקְנְעָם Yoqnᵉʻâm, yok-neh-awm'; from H6969 and H5971; (the) people will be lamented;  Jokneam, a place in Palestine:—Jokneam.

H3364.definition: יָקַץ yâqats, yaw-kats'; a primitive root;  to awake (intransitive):—(be) awake(-d).

H3365.definition: יָקַר yâqar, yaw-kar'; a primitive root;  properly, apparently, to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) valuable; causatively, to make rare (figuratively, to inhibit):—be (make) precious, be prized, be set by, withdraw.

H3366.definition: יְקָר yᵉqâr, yek-awr'; from H3365;  value, i.e. (concretely) wealth; abstractly, costliness, dignity:—honour, precious (things), price.

H3367.definition: יְקָר yᵉqâr, yek-awr'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3366:—glory, honour.

H3368.definition: יָקָר yâqâr, yaw-kawr'; from H3365;  valuable (objectively or subjectively):—brightness, clear, costly, excellent, fat, honourable women, precious, reputation.

H3369.definition: יָקֹשׁ yâqôsh, yaw-koshe'; a primitive root;  to ensnare (literally or figuratively):—fowler (lay a) snare.

H337.definition: אִי ʼîy, ee; short from H188;  alas!:—woe.

H3370.definition: יׇקְשָׁן Yoqshân, yok-shawn'; from H3369; insidious;  Jokshan, an Arabian patriarch:—Jokshan.

H3372.definition: יָרֵא yârêʼ, yaw-ray'; a primitive root;  to fear; morally to revere; causatively to frighten:—affright, be (make) afraid, dread(-ful), (put in) fear(-ful, -fully, -ing), (be had in) reverence(-end), × see, terrible (act, -ness, thing).

H3373.definition: יָרֵא yârêʼ, yaw-ray'; from H3372;  fearing; morally, reverent:—afraid, fear (-ful).

H3374.definition: יִרְאָה yirʼâh, yir-aw'; feminine of H3373;  fear (also used as infinitive); morally, reverence:—× dreadful, × exceedingly, fear(-fulness).

H3378.definition: יְרֻבַּעַל Yᵉrubbaʻal, yer-oob-bah'-al; from H7378 and H1168; Baal will contend;  Jerubbaal, a symbolic name of Gideon:—Jerubbaal.

H3379.definition: יָרׇבְעָם Yârobʻâm, yaw-rob-awm'; from H7378 and H5971; (the) people will contend;  Jarobam, the name of two Israelite kings:—Jeroboam.

H338.definition: אִי ʼîy, ee; probably identical with H337 (through the idea of a doleful sound);  a howler (used only in the plural), i.e. any solitary wild creature:—wild beast of the islands.

H3381.definition: יָרַד yârad, yaw-rad'; a primitive root;  to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications):—× abundantly, bring down, carry down, cast down, (cause to) come(-ing) down, fall (down), get down, go(-ing) down(-ward), hang down, × indeed, let down, light (down), put down (off), (cause to, let) run down, sink, subdue, take down.

H3382.definition: יֶרֶד Yered, yeh'-red; from H3381; a descent;  Jered, the name of an antediluvian, and of an Israelite:—Jared.

H3383.partOfSpeech: proper noun with reference to a river
H3383.definition: יַרְדֵּן Yardên, yar-dane'; from H3381; a descender;  Jarden, the principal river of Palestine:—Jordan.

H3384.definition: יָרָה yârâh, yaw-raw'; or (2 Chronicles 26:15) יָרָא yârâʼ; a primitive root;  properly, to flow as water (i.e. to rain); transitively, to lay or throw (especially an arrow, i.e. to shoot); figuratively, to point out (as if by aiming the finger), to teach:—(+) archer, cast, direct, inform, instruct, lay, shew, shoot, teach(-er,-ing), through.

H3387.definition: יָרוֹק yârôwq, yaw-roke'; from H3417;  green, i.e. an herb:—green thing.

H3389.definition: יְרוּשָׁלִַ͏ם Yᵉrûwshâlaim, yer-oo-shaw-lah'-im; rarely יְרוּשָׁלַיִם Yᵉrûwshâlayim; a dual (in allusion to its two main hills (the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of H3390)); probably from (the passive participle of) H3384 and H7999; founded peaceful;  Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine:—Jerusalem.

H339.definition: אִי ʼîy, ee; from H183;  properly, a habitable spot (as desirable); dry land, a coast, an island:—country, isle, island.

H3390.definition: יְרוּשָׁלֵם Yᵉrûwshâlêm, yer-oo-shaw-lame' (Chaldee) corresponding to H3389:—Jerusalem.

H3391.definition: יֶרַח yerach, yeh'-rakh; from an unused root of uncertain significance; a lunation, i.e. month:—month, moon.

H3392.definition: יֶרַח Yerach, yeh'-rakh; the same as H3391;  Jerach, an Arabian patriarch:—Jerah.

H3393.definition: יְרַח yᵉrach, yeh-rakh'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3391;  a month:—month.

H3394.definition: יָרֵחַ yârêach, yaw-ray'-akh; from the same as H3391;  the moon:—moon. Yrechow. See H3405.

H3395.definition: יְרֹחָם Yᵉrôchâm, yer-o-khawm'; from H7355; compassionate;  Jerocham, the name of seven or eight Israelites:—Jeroham.

H3396.definition: יְרַחְמְאֵל Yᵉrachmᵉʼêl, yer-akh-meh-ale'; from H7355 and H410; God will compassionate;  Jerachmeel, the name of three Israelites:—Jerahmeel.

H34.definition: אֶבְיוֹן ʼebyôwn, eb-yone'; from H14, in the sense of want (especially in feeling);  destitute:—beggar, needy, poor (man).

H340.definition: אָיַב ʼâyab, aw-yab'; a primitive root;  to hate (as one of an opposite tribe or party); hence to be hostile:—be an enemy.

H3400.definition: יְרִיאֵל Yᵉrîyʼêl, yer-ee-ale'; from H3384 and H410; thrown of God;  Jeriel, an Israelite:—Jeriel. Compare H3385.

H3401.definition: יָרִיב yârîyb, yaw-rebe'; from H7378;  literally he will contend; properly, adjective contentious; used as noun, an adversary:—that content(-eth), that strive.

H3402.definition: יָרִיב Yârîyb, yaw-rebe'; the same as H3401;  Jarib, the name of three Israelites:—Jarib.

H3404.definition: יְרִיָּה Yᵉrîyâh, yer-ee-yaw'; or יְרִיָּהוּ Yᵉrîyâhûw; from H3384 and H3050; Jah will throw;  Jerijah, an Israelite:—Jeriah, Jerijah.

H3405.definition: יְרִיחוֹ Yᵉrîychôw, yer-ee-kho'; or יְרֵחוֹ Yᵉrêchôw; or variation (1 Kings 16:34) יְרִיחֹה Yᵉrîychôh; perhaps from H3394; its month; or else from H7306; fragrant;  Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine:—Jericho.

H3406.definition: יְרִימוֹת Yᵉrîymôwth, yer-ee-mohth'; or יְרֵימוֹת Yᵉrêymôwth; or יְרֵמוֹת Yᵉrêmôwth; feminine plural from H7311; elevations;  Jerimoth or Jeremoth, the name of twelve Israelites:—Jermoth, Jerimoth, and Ramoth (from the margin).

H3407.definition: יְרִיעָה yᵉrîyʻâh, yer-ee-aw'; from H3415;  a hanging (as tremulous):—curtain.

H3409.definition: יָרֵךְ yârêk, yaw-rake'; from an unused root meaning to be soft;  the thigh (from its fleshy softness); by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively, a shank, flank, side:—× body, loins, shaft, side, thigh.

H341.definition: אֹיֵב ʼôyêb, o-yabe'; or (fully) אוֹיֵב ʼôwyêb; active participle of H340;  hating; an adversary:—enemy, foe.

H3411.definition: יְרֵכָה yᵉrêkâh, yer-ay-kaw'; feminine of H3409;  properly, the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess:—border, coast, part, quarter, side.

H3412.definition: יַרְמוּת Yarmûwth, yar-mooth'; from H7311; elevation;  Jarmuth, the name of two places in Palestine:—Jarmuth.

H3413.definition: יְרֵמַי Yᵉrêmay, yer-ay-mah'-ee; from H7311; elevated;  Jeremai, an Israelite:—Jeremai.

H3414.definition: יִרְמְיָה Yirmᵉyâh, yir-meh-yaw'; or יִרְמְיָהוּ Yirmᵉyâhûw; from H7311 and H3050; Jah will rise;  Jirmejah, the name of eight or nine Israelites:—Jeremiah.

H3415.definition: יָרַע yâraʻ, yaw-rah'; a primitive root;  properly, to be broken up (with any violent action) i.e. (figuratively) to fear:—be grevious (only Isaiah 15:4; the rest belong to H7489).

H3417.definition: יָרָק yârâq, yaw-rak'; a primitive root;  to spit:—× but, spit.

H3418.definition: יֶרֶק yereq, yeh'-rek; from H3417 (in the sense of vacuity of color);  properly, pallor, i.e. hence, the yellowish green of young and sickly vegetation; concretely, verdure, i.e. grass or vegetation:—grass, green (thing).
