H342.definition: אֵיבָה ʼêybâh, ay-baw'; from H340;  hostility:—emnity, hatred.

H3420.definition: יֵרָקוֹן yêrâqôwn, yay-raw-kone'; from H3418;  paleness, whether of persons (from fright), or of plants (from drought):—greenish, yellow.

H3422.definition: יְרַקְרַק yᵉraqraq, yer-ak-rak'; from the same as H3418;  yellowishness:—greenish, yellow.

H3423.definition: יָרַשׁ yârash, yaw-rash'; or יָרֵשׁ yârêsh; a primitive root;  to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin:—cast out, consume, destroy, disinherit, dispossess, drive(-ing) out, enjoy, expel, × without fail, (give to, leave for) inherit(-ance, -or)   magistrate, be (make) poor, come to poverty, (give to, make to) possess, get (have) in (take) possession, seize upon, succeed, × utterly.

H3426.definition: יֵשׁ yêsh, yaysh; perhaps from an unused root meaning to stand out, or exist; entity; used adverbially or as a copula for the substantive verb (H1961);  there is or are (or any other form of the verb to be, as may suit the connection):—(there) are, (he, it, shall, there, there may, there shall, there should) be, thou do, had, hast, (which) hath, (I, shalt, that) have, (he, it, there) is, substance, it (there) was, (there) were, ye will, thou wilt, wouldest.

H3427.definition: יָשַׁב yâshab, yaw-shab'; a primitive root;  properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry:—(make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, × fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, × marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.

H3434.definition: יָשׇׁבְעָם Yâshobʻâm, yaw-shob-awm'; from H7725 and H5971; people will return;  Jashobam, the name of two or three Israelites:—Jashobeam.

H3435.definition: יִשְׁבָּק Yishbâq, yish-bawk'; from an unused root corresponding to H7662; he will leave;  Jishbak, a son of Abraham:—Ishbak.

H3436.definition: יׇשְׁבְּקָשָׁה Yoshbᵉqâshâh, yosh-bek-aw-shaw'; from H3427 and H7186; a hard seat;  Joshbekashah, an Israelite:—Joshbekashah.

H3437.definition: יָשׁוּב Yâshûwb, yaw-shoob'; or יָשִׁיב Yâshîyb; from H7725; he will return;  Jashub, the name of two Israelites:—Jashub.

H3438.definition: יִשְׁוָה Yishvâh, yish-vaw'; from H7737; he will level;  Jishvah, an Israelite:—Ishvah, Isvah.

H3439.definition: יְשׁוֹחָיָה Yᵉshôwchâyâh, yesh-o-khaw-yaw'; from the same as H3445 and H3050; Jah will empty;  Jeshochajah, an Israelite:—Jeshoaiah.

H3440.definition: יִשְׁוִי Yishvîy, yish-vee'; from H7737; level;  Jishvi, the name of two Israelites:—Ishuai, Ishvi, Isui, Jesui.

H3442.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3442.definition: יֵשׁוּעַ Yêshûwaʻ, yay-shoo'-ah; for H3091; he will save;  Jeshua, the name of ten Israelites, also of a place in Palestine:—Jeshua.

H3444.definition: יְשׁוּעָה yᵉshûwʻâh, yesh-oo'-aw; feminine passive participle of H3467;  something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity:—deliverance, health, help(-ing), salvation, save, saving (health), welfare.

H3446.definition: יִשְׂחָק Yischâq, yis-khawk'; from H7831; he will laugh;  Jischak, the heir of Abraham:—Isaac. Compare H3327.

H3447.definition: יָשַׁט yâshaṭ, yaw-shat'; a primitive root;  to extend:—hold out.

H3448.definition: יִשַׁי Yishay, yee-shah'-ee; by Aramaic אִישַׁי ʼÎyshay; from the same as H3426; extant;  Jishai, David's father:—Jesse.

H3449.definition: יִשִּׁיָּה Yishshîyâh, yish-shee-yaw'; or יִשִּׁיָּהוּ Yishshîyâhûw; from H5383 and H3050; Jah will lend;  Jishshijah, the name of five Israelites:—Ishiah, Isshiah, Ishijah, Jesiah.

H345.definition: אַיָּה ʼAyâh, ah-yaw'; the same as H344;  Ajah, the name of two Israelites:—Aiah, Ajah.

H3450.definition: יְשִׁימָאֵל Yᵉshîymâʼêl, yes-eem-aw-ale'; from H7760 and H410; God will place;  Jesimael, an Israelite:—Jesimael.

H3452.definition: יְשִׁימוֹן yᵉshîymôwn, yesh-ee-mone'; from H3456;  a desolation:—desert, Jeshimon, solitary, wilderness.

H3457.definition: יִשְׁמָא Yishmâʼ, yish-maw'; from H3456; desolate;  Jishma, an Israelite:—Ishma.

H3458.definition: יִשְׁמָעֵאל Yishmâʻêʼl, yish-maw-ale'; from H8085 and H410; God will hear;  Jishmael, the name of Abraham's oldest son, and of five Israelites:—Ishmael.

H346.definition: אַיֵּה ʼayêh, ah-yay'; prolonged from H335;  where?:—where.

H3460.definition: יִשְׁמַעְיָה Yishmaʻyâh, yish-mah-yaw'; or יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּ Yishmaʻyâhûwlemma יְשְׁמַעְיָהוּ first vowel, corrected to יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּ; from H8085 and H3050; Jah will hear;  Jishmajah, the name of two Israelites:—Ishmaiah.

H3461.definition: יִשְׁמְרַי Yishmᵉray, yish-mer-ah'-ee; from H8104; preservative;  Jishmerai, an Israelite:—Ishmerai.

H3462.definition: יָשֵׁן yâshên, yaw-shane'; a primitive root;  properly, to be slack or languid, i.e. (by implication) sleep (figuratively, to die); also to grow old, stale or inveterate:—old (store), remain long, (make to) sleep.

H3463.definition: יָשֵׁן yâshên, yaw-shane'; from H3462;  sleepy:—asleep, (one out of) sleep(-eth, -ing), slept.

H3465.definition: יָשָׁן yâshân, yaw-shawn'; from H3462;  old:—old.

H3466.definition: יְשָׁנָה Yᵉshânâh, yesh-aw-naw'; feminine of H3465;  Jeshanah, a place in Palestine:—Jeshanah.

H3467.definition: יָשַׁע yâshaʻ, yaw-shah'; a primitive root;  properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor:—× at all, avenging, defend, deliver(-er), help, preserve, rescue, be safe, bring (having) salvation, save(-iour), get victory.

H3468.definition: יֶשַׁע yeshaʻ, yeh'-shah; or יֵשַׁע yêshaʻ; from H3467;  liberty, deliverance, prosperity:—safety, salvation, saving.

H3469.definition: יִשְׁעִי Yishʻîy, yish-ee'; from H3467; saving;  Jishi, the name of four Israelites:—Ishi.

H347.definition: אִיּוֹב ʼÎyôwb, ee-yobe'; from H340; hated (i.e. persecuted);  Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience:—Job.

H3470.definition: יְשַׁעְיָה Yᵉshaʻyâh, yesh-ah-yaw'; or יְשַׁעְיָהוּ Yᵉshaʻyâhûw; from H3467 and H3050; Jah has saved;  Jeshajah, the name of seven Israelites:—Isaiah, Jesaiah, Jeshaiah.

H3472.definition: יִשְׁפָּה Yishpâh, yish-paw'; perhaps from H8192; he will scratch;  Jishpah, an Israelite:—Ispah.

H3473.definition: יִשְׁפָּן Yishpân, yish-pawn'; probably from the same as H8227; he will hide;  Jishpan, an Israelite:—Ishpan.

H3474.definition: יָשַׁר yâshar, yaw-shar'; a primitive root;  to be straight or even; figuratively, to be (causatively, to make) right, pleasant, prosperous:—direct, fit, seem good (meet),   please (will), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look, make, take the) straight (way), be upright(-ly).

H3475.definition: יֵשֶׁר Yêsher, yay'-sher; from H3474; the right;  Jesher, an Israelite:—Jesher.

H3476.definition: יֹשֶׁר yôsher, yo'-sher; from H3474;  the right:—equity, meet, right, upright(-ness).

H3477.definition: יָשָׁר yâshâr, yaw-shawr'; from H3474;  straight (literally or figuratively):—convenient, equity, Jasher, just, meet(-est),   pleased well right(-eous), straight, (most) upright(-ly, -ness).

H3478.definition: יִשְׂרָאֵל Yisrâʼêl, yis-raw-ale'; from H8280 and H410;  he will rule as God; Jisraël, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity:—Israel.

H3479.definition: יִשְׂרָאֵל Yisrâʼêl, yis-raw-ale'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3478:—Israel.

H348.definition: אִיזֶבֶל ʼÎyzebel, ee-zeh'-bel; from H336 and H2083;  Izebel, the wife of king Ahab:—Jezebel.

H3481.definition: יִשְׂרְאֵלִי Yisrᵉʼêlîy, yis-reh-ay-lee'; patronymically from H3478;  a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael:—of Israel, Israelite.

H3485.partOfSpeech: proper collective noun, proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3485.definition: יִשָּׂשכָר Yissâˢkâr, yis-saw-kawr'; (strictly yis-saws-kawr'); from H5375 and H7939; he will bring a reward;  Jissaskar, a son of Jacob:—Issachar.

H3487.definition: יַת yath, yath; (Aramaic) corresponding to H853;  a sign of the object of a verb:—  whom.

H3488.definition: יְתִב yᵉthib, yeth-eeb'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3427;  to sit or dwell:—dwell, (be) set, sit.

H3489.definition: יָתֵד yâthêd, yaw-thade'; from an unused root meaning to pin through or fast;  a peg:—nail, paddle, pin, stake.

H349.definition: אֵיךְ ʼêyk, ake; also אֵיכָה ʼêykâh ; and אֵיכָכָה ʼêykâkâh ; prolonged from H335;  how? or how!; also where:—how, what.

H3490.definition: יָתוֹם yâthôwm, yaw-thome'; from an unused root meaning to be lonely;  a bereaved person:—fatherless (child), orphan.

H3492.definition: יַתִּיר Yattîyr, yat-teer'; from H3498; redundant;  Jattir, a place in Palestine:—Jattir.

H3493.definition: יַתִּיר yattîyr, yat-teer'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3492;  preeminent; as an adverb, very:—exceeding(-ly), excellent.

H3496.definition: יַתְנִיאֵל Yathnîyʼêl, yath-nee-ale'; from an unused root meaning to endure, and H410; continued of God;  Jathniel, an Israelite:—Jathniel.

H3498.definition: יָתַר yâthar, yaw-thar'; a primitive root;  to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively to leave, cause to abound, preserve:—excel, leave (a remnant), left behind, too much, make plenteous, preserve, (be, let) remain(-der, -ing, -nant), reserve, residue, rest.

H3499.definition: יֶתֶר yether, yeh'-ther; from H3498;  properly, an overhanging, i.e. (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free):—  abundant, cord, exceeding, excellancy(-ent), what they leave, that hath left, plentifully, remnant, residue, rest, string, with.

H350.definition: אִי־כָבוֹד ʼÎy-kâbôwd, ee-kaw-bode'; from H336 and H3519; (there is) no glory, i.e. inglorious;  Ikabod, a son of Phineas:—I-chabod.

H3500.definition: יֶתֶר Yether, yeh'-ther; the same as H3499;  Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite:—Jether, Jethro. Compare H3503.

H3503.definition: יִתְרוֹ Yithrôw, yith-ro'; from H3499 with pron. suffix; his excellence;  Jethro, Moses' father-in-law:—Jethro. Compare H3500.

H3506.definition: יִתְרָן Yithrân, yith-rawn'; from H3498; excellent;  Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite:—Ithran.

H3507.definition: יִתְרְעָם Yithrᵉʻâm, yith-reh-awm'; from H3499 and H5971; excellence of people;  Jithream, a son of David:—Ithream.

H3509.definition: יְתֵת Yᵉthêth, yeh-thayth'; of uncertain derivation;  Jetheth, an Edomite:—Jetheth.

H351.definition: אֵיכֹה ʼêykôh, ay-ko; probably a variation for H349, but not as an interogative;  where:—where.

H3511.definition: כְּאֵב kᵉʼêb, keh-abe'; from H3510;  suffering (physical or mental), adversity:—grief, pain, sorrow.

H3513.definition: כָּבַד kâbad, kaw-bad'; or כָּבֵד kâbêd; a primitive root;  to be heavy, i.e. in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable); causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses):—abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, × be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, × more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop.

H3515.definition: כָּבֵד kâbêd, kaw-bade'; from H3513;  heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid):—(so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick.

H3518.definition: כָּבָה kâbâh, kaw-baw'; a primitive root;  to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger):—go (put) out, quench.

H3519.definition: כָּבוֹד kâbôwd, kaw-bode'; rarely כָּבֹד kâbôd; from H3513;  properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness:—glorious(-ly), glory, honour(-able).

H352.definition: אַיִל ʼayil, ah'-yil; from the same as H193;  properly, strength; hence, anything strong; specifically a chief (politically); also a ram (from his strength); a pilaster (as a strong support); an oak or other strong tree:—mighty (man), lintel, oak, post, ram, tree.

H3524.definition: כַּבִּיר kabbîyr, kab-beer'; from H3527;  vast, whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty; of time, aged), or in number, many:—  feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant.

H3526.definition: כָּבַס kâbaç, kaw-bas'; a primitive root;  to trample; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative:—fuller, wash(-ing).

H3528.definition: כְּבָר kᵉbâr, keb-awr'; from H3527;  properly, extent of time, i.e. a great while; hence, long ago, formerly, hitherto:—already, (seeing that which), now.

H3529.definition: כְּבָר Kᵉbâr, keb-awr'; the same as H3528; length;  Kebar, a river of Mesopotamia:—Chebar. Compare H2249.

H353.definition: אֱיָל ʼĕyâl, eh-yawl'; a variation of H352;  strength:—strength.

H3532.definition: כֶּבֶשׂ kebes, keh-bes'; from an unused root meaning to dominate;  a ram (just old enough to butt):—lamb, sheep.

H3533.definition: כָּבַשׁ kâbash, kaw-bash'; a primitive root;  to tread down; hence, negatively, to disregard; positively, to conquer, subjugate, violate:—bring into bondage, force, keep under, subdue, bring into subjection.

H3535.definition: כִּבְשָׂה kibsâh, kib-saw'; or כַּבְשָׂה kabsâh; feminine of H3532;  a ewe:—(ewe) lamb.

H3538.definition: כְּדַב kᵉdab, ked-ab'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H3576;  false:—lying.

H354.definition: אַיָּל ʼayâl, ah-yawl'; an intensive form of H352 (in the sense of ram);  a stag or male deer:—hart.

H3540.definition: כְּדׇרְלָעֹמֶר Kᵉdorlâʻômer, ked-or-law-o'-mer; of foreign origin;  Kedorlaomer, an early Persian king:—Chedorlaomer.

H3541.definition: כֹּה kôh, ko; from the prefix k and H1931;  properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now:—also, here,   hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way),   mean while, yonder.

H3543.definition: כָּהָה kâhâh, kaw-haw'; a primitive root;  to be weak, i.e. (figuratively) to despond (causatively, rebuke), or (of light, the eye) to grow dull:—darken, be dim, fail, faint, restrain, × utterly.

H3547.definition: כָּהַן kâhan, kaw-han'; a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services; but used only as denominative from H3548;  to officiate as a priest; figuratively, to put on regalia:—deck, be (do the office of a, execute the, minister in the) priest('s office).

H3548.definition: כֹּהֵן kôhên, ko-hane'; active participle of H3547;  literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman):—chief ruler, × own, priest, prince, principal officer.

H3550.definition: כְּהֻנָּה kᵉhunnâh, keh-hoon-naw'; from H3547;  priesthood:—priesthood, priest's office.

H3553.definition: כּוֹבַע kôwbaʻ, ko'-bah; from an unused root meaning to be high or rounded;  a helmet (as arched):—helmet. Compare H6959.

H3555.definition: כְּוִיָּה kᵉvîyâh, kev-ee-yaw'; from H3554;  a branding:—burning.

H3556.definition: כּוֹכָב kôwkâb, ko-kawb'; probably from the same as H3522 (in the sense of rolling) or H3554 (in the sense of blazing);  a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince:—star(-gazer).

H3557.definition: כּוּל kûwl, kool; a primitive root;  properly, to keep in; hence, to measure; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses):—(be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold(-ing in), nourish(-er), be present, make provision, receive, sustain, provide sustenance (victuals).

H3558.definition: כּוּמָז kûwmâz, koo-mawz'; from an unused root meaning to store away;  a jewel (probably gold beads):—tablet.

H3559.definition: כּוּן kûwn, koon; a primitive root;  properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous):—certain(-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixed, frame, be meet, ordain, order, perfect, (make) preparation, prepare (self), provide, make provision, (be, make) ready, right, set (aright, fast, forth), be stable, (e-) stablish, stand, tarry, × very deed.

H3561.definition: כַּוָּן kavvân, kav-vawn'; from H3559;  something prepared, i.e. a sacrificial wafer:—cake.

H3562.definition: כּוֹנַנְיָהוּ Kôwnanyâhûw, ko-nan-yaw'-hoo; from H3559 and H3050; Jah has sustained;  Conanjah, the name of two Israelites:—Conaniah, Cononiah. Compare H3663.

H3563.definition: כּוֹס kôwç, koce; from an unused root meaning to hold together;  a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup-like cavity of its eye):—cup, (small) owl. Compare H3599.

H3564.definition: כּוּר kûwr, koor; from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through;  a pot or furnace (as if excavated):—furnace. Compare H3600.

H3566.definition: כּוֹרֶשׁ Kôwresh, ko'-resh; or (Ezra 1:1-2 (last time)) כֹּרֶשׁ Kôresh; from the Persian;  Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king:—Cyrus.

H3567.definition: כּוֹרֶשׁ Kôwresh, ko'-resh; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3566:—Cyrus.

H3568.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3568.definition: כּוּשׁ Kûwsh, koosh; probably of foreign origin;  Cush (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory; also of an Israelite:—Chush, Cush, Ethiopia.

H357.definition: אַיָּלוֹן ʼAyâlôwn, ah-yaw-lone'; from H354; deer-field;  Ajalon, the name of five places in Palestine:—Aijalon, Ajalon.

H3573.definition: כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם Kûwshan Rishʻâthayim, koo-shan' rish-awthah'-yim; apparently from H3572 and the dual of H7564; Cushan of double wickedness;  Cushan-Rishathajim, a Mesopotamian king:—Chushan-rishathayim.

H3576.definition: כָּזַב kâzab, kaw-zab'; a primitive root;  to lie (i.e. deceive), literally or figuratively:—fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain.

H3577.definition: כָּזָב kâzâb, kaw-zawb'; from H3576;  falsehood; literally (untruth) or figuratively (idol):—deceitful, false, leasing,   liar, lie, lying.

H3581.definition: כֹּחַ kôach, ko'-akh; or (Daniel 11:6) כּוֹחַ kôwach; from an unused root meaning to be firm;  vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard:—ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.

H3582.definition: כָּחַד kâchad, kaw-khad'; a primitive root;  to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy:—conceal, cut down (off), desolate, hide.

H3583.definition: כָּחַל kâchal, kaw-khal'; a primitive root;  to paint (with stibium):—paint.

H3584.definition: כָּחַשׁ kâchash, kaw-khash'; a primitive root;  to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe):—deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-) lie, lying, submit selves.

H3586.definition: כֶּחָשׁ kechâsh, kekh-awsh'; from H3584;  faithless:—lying.

H3588.definition: כִּי kîy, kee; a primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating causal relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent;  (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed:—and,   (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly),   but, certainly, doubtless,   else, even,   except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that,   nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore,   (al-) though,   till, truly,   until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.

H359.definition: אֵילוֹת ʼÊylôwth, ay-loth'; or אֵילַת ʼÊylath ; from H352; trees or a grove (i.e. palms);  Eloth or Elath, a place on the Red Sea:—Elath, Eloth.

H3591.definition: כִּידוֹן kîydôwn, kee-dohn'; from the same as H3589; (perhaps smaller than H2595)  properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart:—lance, shield, spear, target.

H3595.definition: כִּיּוֹר kîyôwr, kee-yore'; or כִּיֹּר kîyôr; from the same as H3564;  properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish for coals or a caldron for cooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform:—hearth, laver, pan, scaffold.

H3599.definition: כִּיס kîyç, keece; a form for H3563;  a cup; also a bag for money or weights:—bag, cup, purse.

H36.definition: אֲבִיטוּב ʼĂbîyṭûwb, ab-ee-toob'; from H1 and H2898; father of goodness (i.e. good);  Abitub, an Israelite:—Abitub.

H3602.definition: כָּכָה kâkâh, kaw'-kaw; from H3541;  just so, referring to the previous or following context:—after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus.

H3603.definition: כִּכָּר kikkâr, kik-kawr'; from H3769;  a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large [round] coin):—loaf, morsel, piece, plain, talent.

H3604.definition: כִּכֵּר kikkêr, kik-kare'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3603;  a talent:—talent.

H3605.definition: כֹּל kôl, kole; or (Jeremiah 33:8) כּוֹל kôwl; from H3634;  properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense):—(in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

H3606.definition: כֹּל kôl, kole; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3605:—all, any,   (forasmuch) as,   be-(for this) cause, every,   no (manner, -ne),   there (where) -fore,   though, what (where, who) -soever, (the) whole.

H3609.definition: כִּלְאָב Kilʼâb, kil-awb'; apparently from H3607 and H1; restraint of (his) father;  Kilab, an Israelite:—Chileab.

H3610.definition: כִּלְאַיִם kilʼayim, kil-ah'-yim; dual of H3608 in the original sense of separation;  two heterogeneities:—divers seeds (-e kinds), mingled (seed).

H3611.definition: כֶּלֶב keleb, keh'-leb; from an unused root means. to yelp, or else to attack;  a dog; hence (by euphemism) a male prostitute:—dog.

H3612.definition: כָּלֵב Kâlêb, kaw-labe'; perhaps a form of H3611, or else from the same root in the sense of forcible;  Caleb, the name of three Israelites:—Caleb.

H3615.definition: כָּלָה kâlâh, kaw-law'; a primitive root;  to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitive (to complete, prepare, consume):—accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when... were) done, (be an) end (of), expire, (cause to) fail, faint, finish, fulfil, × fully, × have, leave (off), long, bring to pass, wholly reap, make clean riddance, spend, quite take away, waste.

H3617.definition: כָּלָה kâlâh, kaw-law'; from H3615;  a completion; adverb, completely; also destruction:—altogether, (be, utterly) consume(-d), consummation(-ption), was determined, (full, utter) end, riddance.

H3618.definition: כַּלָּה kallâh, kal-law'; from H3634;  a bride (as if perfect); hence, a son's wife:—bride, daughter-in-law, spouse.

H362.definition: אֵילִם ʼÊylim, ay-leem'; plural of H352; palm-trees;  Elim, a place in the Desert:—Elim.

H3620.definition: כְּלוּב Kᵉlûwb, kel-oob'; the same as H3619;  Kelub, the name of two Israelites:—Chelub.

H3622.definition: כְּלוּהַי Kᵉlûwhay, kel-oo-hah'-ee; from H3615; completed;  Keluhai, an Israelite:—Chelluh.

H3627.definition: כְּלִי kᵉlîy, kel-ee'; from H3615;  something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon):—armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage,   furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, × one from another, that which pertaineth, pot,   psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon,   whatsoever.

H3628.definition: כְּלִיא kᵉlîyʼ, kel-ee'; or כְּלוּא kᵉlûwʼ; from H3627 (compare H3608);  a prison:—prison.

H3629.definition: כִּלְיָה kilyâh, kil-yaw'; feminine of H3627 (only in the plural);  a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self):—kidneys, reins.

H3631.definition: כִּלָּיוֹן killâyôwn, kil-law-yone'; from H3615;  pining, destruction:—consumption, failing.

H3632.definition: כָּלִיל kâlîyl, kaw-leel'; from H3634;  complete; as noun, the whole (specifically, a sacrifice entirely consumed); as adverb, fully:—all, every whit, flame, perfect(-ion), utterly, whole burnt offering (sacrifice), wholly.

H3633.definition: כַּלְכֹּל Kalkôl, kal-kole'; from H3557; sustenance;  Calcol, an Israelite:—Calcol, Chalcol.

H3634.definition: כָּלַל kâlal, kaw-lal'; a primitive root;  to complete:—(make) perfect.

H3635.definition: כְּלַל kᵉlal, kel-al'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3634;  to complete:—finish, make (set) up.

H3636.definition: כְּלָל Kᵉlâl, kel-awl'; from H3634; complete;  Kelal, an Israelite:—Chelal.

H3637.definition: כָּלַם kâlam, kaw-lawm'; a primitive root;  properly, to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult:—be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put to) shame.

H3639.definition: כְּלִמָּה kᵉlimmâh, kel-im-maw'; from H3637;  disgrace:—confusion, dishonour, reproach, shame.

H3640.definition: כְּלִמּוּת kᵉlimmûwth, kel-im-mooth'; from H3639;  disgrace:—shame.

H3643.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3643.definition: כִּמְהָם Kimhâm, kim-hawm'; from H3642; pining;  Kimham, an Israelite:—Chimham.

H3644.definition: כְּמוֹ kᵉmôw, kem-o'; or כָּמוֹ kâmôw; a form of the prefix k, but used separately [compare H3651];  as, thus, so:—according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth.

H3645.partOfSpeech: proper noun with reference to deity
H3645.definition: כְּמוֹשׁ Kᵉmôwsh, kem-oshe'; or (Jeremiah 48:7) כְּמִישׁ Kᵉmîysh; from an unused root meaning to subdue; the powerful;  Kemosh, the god of the Moabites:—Chemosh.

H3648.definition: כָּמַר kâmar, kaw-mar'; a primitive root;  properly, to intertwine or contract, i.e. (by implication) to shrivel (as with heat); figuratively, to be deeply affected with passion (love or pity):—be black, be kindled, yearn.

H3649.definition: כָּמָר kâmâr, kaw-mawr'; from H3648;  properly, an ascetic (as if shrunk with self-maceration), i.e. an idolatrous priest (only in plural):—Chemarims (idolatrous) priests.

H3651.definition: כֵּן kên, kane; from H3559;  properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles):—  after that (this, -ward, -wards), as... as,   (for-) asmuch as yet,   be (for which) cause,   following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), × the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely,   there (where) -fore, this, thus, true, well, × you.

H3652.definition: כֵּן kên, kane; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3651;  so:—thus.

H3654.definition: כֵּן kên, kane; from H3661 in the sense of fastening; (from infixing its sting; used only in plural (and irregular in Exodus 8:17,18; Hebrews 13:14))  a gnat:—lice, × manner.

H3656.definition: כַּנֶּה Kanneh, kan-neh'; for H3641;  Canneh, a place in Assyria:—Canneh.

H3658.definition: כִּנּוֹר kinnôwr, kin-nore'; from a unused root meaning to twang;  a harp:—harp.

H3659.definition: כׇּנְיָהוּ Konyâhûw, kon-yaw'-hoo; for H3204;  Conjah, an Israelite king:—Coniah.

H3660.definition: כְּנֵמָא kᵉnêmâʼ, ken-ay-maw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3644;  so or thus:—so, (in) this manner (sort), thus.

H3662.definition: כְּנָנִי Kᵉnânîy, ken-aw-nee'; from H3661; planted;  Kenani, an Israelite:—Chenani.

H3663.definition: כְּנַנְיָה Kᵉnanyâh, ken-an-yaw'; or כְּנַנְיָהוּ Kᵉnanyâhûw; from H3661 and H3050; Jah has planted;  Kenanjah, an Israelite:—Chenaniah.

H3664.definition: כָּנַס kânaç, kaw-nas'; a primitive root;  to collect; hence, to enfold:—gather (together), heap up, wrap self.

H3665.definition: כָּנַע kânaʻ, kaw-nah'; a primitive root;  properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish:—bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.

H3667.partOfSpeech: masculine noun, proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3667.definition: כְּנַעַן Kᵉnaʻan, ken-ah'-an; from H3665; humiliated;  Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him:—Canaan, merchant, traffick.

H3668.definition: כְּנַעֲנָה Kᵉnaʻănâh, ken-ah-an-aw'; feminine of H3667;  Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites:—Chenaanah.

H3669.definition: כְּנַעַנִי Kᵉnaʻanîy, ken-ah-an-ee'; patrial from H3667;  a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication, a pedlar (the Canaanites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans):—Canaanite, merchant, trafficker.

H367.definition: אֵימָה ʼêymâh, ay-maw'; or (shortened) אֵמָה ʼêmâh; from the same as H366;  fright; concrete, an idol (as a bugbear):—dread, fear, horror, idol, terrible, terror.

H3670.definition: כָּנַף kânaph, kaw-naf'; a primitive root;  properly, to project laterally, i.e. probably (reflexive) to withdraw:—be removed.

H3671.definition: כָּנָף kânâph, kaw-nawf'; from H3670;  an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle:—  bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), × flying,   (one an-) other, overspreading, × quarters, skirt, × sort, uttermost part, wing(-ed).

H3672.definition: כִּנְּרוֹת Kinnᵉrôwth, kin-ner-oth'; or כִּנֶּרֶת Kinnerethlemma כִּנֶרֶת missing dagesh, corrected to כִּנֶּרֶת; respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as H3658; perhaps harp-shaped;  Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine:—Chinnereth, Chinneroth, Cinneroth.

H3673.definition: כָּנַשׁ kânash, kaw-nash'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3664;  to assemble:—gather together.

H3677.definition: כֶּסֶא keçeʼ, keh'-seh; or כֶּסֶה keçeh; apparently from H3680;  properly, fulness or the full moon, i.e. its festival:—(time) appointed.

H3678.definition: כִּסֵּא kiççêʼ, kis-say'; or כִּסֵּה kiççêh; from H3680;  properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied):—seat, stool, throne.

H3680.definition: כָּסָה kâçâh, kaw-saw'; a primitive root;  properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy):—clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare H3780.

H3682.definition: כְּסוּת kᵉçûwth, kes-ooth'; from H3680;  a cover (garment); figuratively, a veiling:—covering, raiment, vesture.

H3683.definition: כָּסַח kâçach, kaw-sakh'; a primitive root;  to cut off:—cut down (up).

H3685.definition: כְּסִיל Kᵉçîyl, kes-eel'; the same as H3684;  any notable constellation; specifically Orion (as if a burly one):—constellation, Orion.

H3689.definition: כֶּסֶל keçel, keh'-sel; from H3688;  properly, fatness, i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust:—confidence, flank, folly, hope, loin.

H369.definition: אַיִן ʼayin, ah'-yin; as if from a primitive root meaning to be nothing or not exist;  a nonentity; generally used as a negative particle:—else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370.

H3691.definition: כִּסְלֵו Kiçlêv, kis-lave'; probably of foreign origin;  Kisleu, the 9th Hebrew month:—Chisleu.

H3697.definition: כָּסַם kâçam, kaw-sam'; a primitive root; to shear:—× only, poll. Compare H3765.

H370.definition: אַיִן ʼayin, ah-yin'; probably identical with H369 in the sense of query (compare H336)  where? (only in connection with prepositional prefix, whence):—whence, where.

H3700.definition: כָּסַף kâçaph, kaw-saf'; a primitive root;  properly, to become pale, i.e. (by implication) to pine after; also to fear:—(have) desire, be greedy, long, sore.

H3701.definition: כֶּסֶף keçeph, keh'-sef; from H3700;  silver (from its pale color); by implication, money:—money, price, silver(-ling).

H3702.definition: כְּסַף kᵉçaph, kes-af'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3701:—money, silver.

H3703.definition: כָּסִפְיָא Kâçiphyâʼ, kaw-sif-yaw'; perhaps from H3701; silvery;  Casiphja, a place in Babylon:—Casiphia.

H3705.definition: כְּעַן kᵉʻan, keh-an'; (Aramaic) probably from H3652;  now:—now.

H3707.definition: כַּעַס kaʻaç, kaw-as'; a primitive root;  to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant:—be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth.

H3708.definition: כַּעַס kaʻaç, kah'-as; or (in Job) כַּעַשׂ kaʻas; from H3707;  vexation:—anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, × sore, sorrow, spite, wrath.

H3709.definition: כַּף kaph, kaf; from H3721;  the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power:—branch,   foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.

H371.definition: אִין ʼîyn, een; apparently a shortened form of H369; but (like H370) an interrogative;  is it not?:—not.

H3712.definition: כִּפָּה kippâh, kip-paw'; feminine of H3709;  a leaf of a palmtree:—branch.

H3713.definition: כְּפוֹר kᵉphôwr, kef-ore'; from H3722;  properly, a cover, i.e. (by implication) a tankard (or covered goblet); also white frost (as covering the ground):—bason, hoar(-y) frost.

H3715.definition: כְּפִיר kᵉphîyr, kef-eer'; from H3722;  a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane):—(young) lion, village. Compare H3723.

H3716.definition: כְּפִירָה Kᵉphîyrâh, kef-ee-raw'; feminine of H3715; the village (always with the art.);  Kephirah, a place in Palestine:—Chephirah.

H3717.definition: כָּפַל kâphal, kaw-fal'; a primitive root;  to fold together; figuratively, to repeat:—double.

H3718.definition: כֶּפֶל kephel, keh'-fel; from H3717;  a duplicate:—double.

H3719.definition: כָּפַן kâphan, kaw-fan'; a primitive root;  to bend:—bend.

H3721.definition: כָּפַף kâphaph, kaw-faf'; a primitive root;  to curve:—bow down (self).

H3722.definition: כָּפַר kâphar, kaw-far'; a primitive root;  to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel:—appease, make (an atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon, purge (away), put off, (make) reconcile(-liation).

H3724.definition: כֹּפֶר kôpher, ko'-fer; from H3722;  properly, a cover, i.e. (literally) a village (as covered in); (specifically) bitumen (as used for coating), and the henna plant (as used for dyeing); figuratively, a redemption-price:—bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village.

H3729.definition: כְּפַת kᵉphath, kef-ath'; (Aramaic) a root of uncertain correspondence;  to fetter:—bind.

H3733.definition: כַּר kar, kar; from H3769 in the sense of plumpness;  a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out):—captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also H1033, H3746.

H3738.definition: כָּרָה kârâh, kaw-raw'; a primitive root;  properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open:—dig, × make (a banquet), open.

H3739.definition: כָּרָה kârâh, kaw-raw'; usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of H3738 (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain);  to purchase:—buy, prepare.

H374.definition: אֵיפָה ʼêyphâh, ay-faw'; or (shortened) אֵפָה ʼêphâh ; of Egyptian derivation;  an ephah or measure for grain; hence, a measure in general:—ephah, (divers) measure(-s).

H3740.definition: כֵּרָה kêrâh, kay-raw'; from H3739;  a purchase:—provision.

H3742.definition: כְּרוּב kᵉrûwb, ker-oob'; of uncertain derivation;  a cherub or imaginary figure:—cherub, (plural) cherubims.

H3743.definition: כְּרוּב Kᵉrûwb, ker-oob'; the same as H3742;  Kerub, a place in Babylon:—Cherub.

H3747.definition: כְּרִית Kᵉrîyth, ker-eeth'; from H3772; a cut;  Kerith, a brook of Palestine:—Cherith.

H375.definition: אֵיפֹה ʼêyphôh, ay-fo'; from H335 and H6311;  what place?; also (of time) when?; or (of means) how?:—what manner, where.

H3754.definition: כֶּרֶם kerem, keh'-rem; from an unused root of uncertain meaning;  a garden or vineyard:—vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also H1021.

H3756.definition: כַּרְמִי Karmîy, kar-mee'; from H3754; gardener;  Karmi, the name of three Israelites:—Carmi.

H3758.definition: כַּרְמִיל karmîyl, kar-mele'; probably of foreign origin;  carmine, a deep red:—crimson.

H3759.definition: כַּרְמֶל karmel, kar-mel'; from H3754;  a planted field (garden, orchard, vineyard or park); by implication, garden produce:—full (green) ears (of corn), fruitful field (place), plentiful (field).

H376.definition: אִישׁ ʼîysh, eesh; contracted for H582 (or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to be extant);  a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation):—also, another, any (man), a certain,   champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind),   none, one, people, person,   steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802.

H3760.definition: כַּרְמֶל Karmel, kar-mel'; the same as H3759;  Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine:—Carmel, fruitful (plentiful) field, (place).

H3764.definition: כׇּרְסֵא korçêʼ, kor-say'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3678;  a throne:—throne.

H3766.definition: כָּרַע kâraʻ, kaw-rah'; a primitive root;  to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate:—bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, × very.

H3767.definition: כָּרָע kârâʻ, kaw-raw'; from H3766;  the leg (from the knee to the ankle) of men or locusts (only in the dual):—leg.

H3768.definition: כַּרְפַּס karpaç, kar-pas'; of foreign origin;  byssus or fine vegetable wool:—green.

H3769.definition: כָּרַר kârar, kaw-rar'; a primitive root;  to dance (i.e. whirl):—dance(-ing).

H3772.definition: כָּרַת kârath, kaw-rath'; a primitive root;  to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces):—be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), × lose, perish, × utterly, × want.

H3773.definition: כָּרֻתָה kâruthâh, kaw-rooth-aw'; passive participle feminine of H3772;  something cut, i.e. a hewn timber:—beam.

H3778.definition: כַּשְׂדִּי Kasdîy, kas-dee'; (occasionally with enclitic) כַּשְׂדִּימָה Kasdîymâh; towards the Kasdites into Chaldea), patronymically from H3777 (only in the plural);  a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people:—Chaldeans, Chaldees, inhabitants of Chaldea).

H3779.definition: כַּשְׂדַּי Kasday, kas-dah'-ee; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3778;  a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication, a Magian or professional astrologer:—Chaldean.

H378.definition: אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת ʼÎysh-Bôsheth, eesh-bo'-sheth; from H376 and H1322; man of shame;  Ish-Bosheth, a son of King Saul:—Ish-bosheth.

H3782.definition: כָּשַׁל kâshal, kaw-shal'; a primitive root;  to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall:—bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, × utterly, be weak.

H3784.definition: כָּשַׁף kâshaph, kaw-shaf'; a primitive root;  properly, to whisper a spell, i.e. to inchant or practise magic:—sorcerer, (use) witch(-craft).

H3785.definition: כֶּשֶׁף kesheph, keh'-shef; from H3784;  magic:—sorcery, witchcraft.

H3788.definition: כִּשְׁרוֹן kishrôwn, kish-rone'; from H3787;  success, advantage:—equity, good, right.

H3789.definition: כָּתַב kâthab, kaw-thab'; a primitive root;  to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe):—describe, record, prescribe, subscribe, write(-ing, -ten).

H379.definition: אִישְׁהוֹד ʼÎyshᵉhôwd, eesh-hode'; from H376 and H1935; man of renown;  Ishod, an Israelite:—Ishod.

H3790.definition: כְּתַב kᵉthab, keth-ab'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3789:—write(-ten).

H3791.definition: כָּתָב kâthâb, kaw-thawb'; from H3789;  something written, i.e. a writing, record or book:—register, scripture, writing.

H3792.definition: כְּתָב kᵉthâb, keth-awb'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3791:—prescribing, writing(-ten).

H3793.definition: כְּתֹבֶת kᵉthôbeth, keth-o'-beth; from H3789;  a letter or other mark branded on the skin:—× any (mark).

H3794.definition: כִּתִּי Kittîy, kit-tee'; or כִּתִּיִּי Kittîyîy; patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural);  a Kittite or Cypriote; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine:—Chittim, Kittim.

H3795.definition: כָּתִית kâthîyth, kaw-theeth'; from H3807;  beaten, i.e. pure (oil):—beaten.

H38.definition: אֲבִיָּם ʼĂbîyâm, ab-ee-yawm'; from H1 and H3220; father of (the) sea (i.e. seaman);  Abijam (or Abijah), a king of Judah:—Abijam.

H3800.definition: כֶּתֶם kethem, keh'-them; from H3799;  properly, something carved out, i.e. ore; hence, gold (pure as originally mined):—((most) fine, pure) gold(-en wedge).

H3801.definition: כְּתֹנֶת kᵉthôneth, keth-o'-neth; or כֻּתֹּנֶת kuttôneth; from an unused root meaning to cover (compare H3802);  a shirt:—coat, garment, robe.

H3802.definition: כָּתֵף kâthêph, kaw-thafe'; from an unused root meaning to clothe;  the shoulder (proper, i.e. upper end of the arm; as being the spot where the garments hang); figuratively, side-piece or lateral projection of anything:—arm, corner, shoulder(-piece), side, undersetter.

H3803.definition: כָּתַר kâthar, kaw-thar'; a primitive root;  to enclose; hence (in a friendly sense) to crown, (in a hostile one) to besiege; also to wait (as restraining oneself):—beset round, compass about, be crowned, inclose round, suffer.

H3804.definition: כֶּתֶר kether, keh'-ther; from H3803;  properly, a circlet, i.e. a diadem:—crown.

H3805.definition: כֹתֶרֶת kôthereth, ko-theh'-reth; feminine active participle of H3803;  the capital of a column:—chapiter.

H3807.definition: כָּתַת kâthath, kaw-thath'; a primitive root;  to bruise or violently strike:—beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp.

H3808.definition: לֹא lôʼ, lo; or לוֹא lôwʼ; or לֹה lôh; (Deuteronomy 3:11), a primitive particle; + not (the simple or abstract negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles:—× before, + or else, ere, + except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), (× as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, + surely, + as truly as, + of a truth, + verily, for want, + whether, without.

H3809.definition: לָא lâʼ, law; (Aramaic) or לָה lâh; (Aramaic) (Daniel 4:32), corresponding to H3808:—or even, neither, no(-ne, -r), (can-) not, as nothing, without.

H3811.definition: לָאָה lâʼâh, law-aw'; a primitive root;  to tire; (figuratively) to be (or make) disgusted:—faint, grieve, lothe, (be, make) weary (selves).

H3812.definition: לֵאָה Lêʼâh, lay-aw'; from H3811; weary;  Leah, a wife of Jacob:—Leah.

H3813.definition: לָאַט lâʼaṭ, law-at'; a primitive root;  to muffle:—cover.

H3814.definition: לָאט lâʼṭ, lawt; from H3813 (or perhaps for active participle of H3874);  properly, muffled, i.e. silently:—softly.

H3816.definition: לְאֹם lᵉʼôm, leh-ome'; or לְאוֹם lᵉʼôwm; from an unused root meaning to gather;  a community:—nation, people.

H3820.definition: לֵב lêb, labe; a form of H3824; the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything:—care for, comfortably, consent, × considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart(-ed), × heed, × I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), × regard(-ed), × themselves, × unawares, understanding, × well, willingly, wisdom.

H3823.definition: לָבַב lâbab, law-bab'; a primitive root;  properly, to be enclosed (as if with fat); by implication (as denominative from H3824); to unheart; i.e. (in a good sense) transport (with love), or (in a bad sense) stultify; to make cakes:—make cakes, ravish, be wise.

H3824.definition: לֵבָב lêbâb, lay-bawb'; from H3823; used also like H3820  the heart (as the most interior organ);:—  bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, (faint), (tender-) heart(-ed), midst, mind, × unawares, understanding.

H3825.definition: לְבַב lᵉbab, leb-ab'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3824:—heart.

H3828.definition: לְבוֹנָה lᵉbôwnâh, leb-o-naw'; or לְבֹנָה lᵉbônâh; from H3836;  frankincense (from its whiteness or perhaps that of its smoke):—(frank-) incense.

H383.definition: אִיתַי ʼîythay, ee-thah'ee; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3426;  properly, entity; used only as a particle of affirmation, there is:—art thou, can, do ye, have, it be, there is (are), × we will not.

H3830.definition: לְבוּשׁ lᵉbûwsh, leb-oosh'; or לְבֻשׁ lᵉbush; from H3847;  a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife:—apparel, clothed with, clothing, garment, raiment, vestment, vesture.

H3833.definition: לָבִיא lâbîyʼ, law-bee'; or (Ezekiel 19:2) לְבִיָּא lᵉbîyâʼ; irregular masculine plural לְבָאִים lᵉbâʼîym; irregular feminine plural לְבָאוֹת lᵉbâʼôwth; from an unused root meaning to roar; compare H738  a lion (properly, a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer;)):—(great, old, stout) lion, lioness, young (lion).

H3835.definition: לָבַן lâban, law-ban'; a primitive root; also as denominative from H3843  to be (or become) white; to make bricks:—make brick, be (made, make) white(-r).

H3836.definition: לָבָן lâbân, law-bawn'; or (Genesis 49:12) לָבֵן lâbên; from H3835;  white:—white.

H3837.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3837.definition: לָבָן Lâbân, law-bawn'; the same as H3836;  Laban, a Mesopotamian; also a place in the Desert:—Laban.

H3839.definition: לִבְנֶה libneh, lib-neh'; from H3835;  some sort of whitish tree, perhaps the storax:—poplar.

H384.definition: אִיתִיאֵל ʼÎythîyʼêl, eeth-ee-ale'; perhaps from H837 and H410; God has arrived;  Ithiel, the name of an Israelite, also of a symbolical person:—Ithiel.

H3841.definition: לִבְנָה Libnâh, lib-naw'; the same as H3839;  Libnah, a place in the Desert and one in Palestine:—Libnah.

H3842.definition: לְבָנָה lᵉbânâh, leb-aw-naw'; from H3835;  properly, (the) white, i.e. the moon:—moon. See also H3838.

H3843.definition: לְבֵנָה lᵉbênâh, leb-ay-naw'; from H3835;  a brick (from the whiteness of the clay):—(altar of) brick, tile.

H3844.definition: לְבָנוֹן Lᵉbânôwn, leb-aw-nohn'; from H3825; (the) white mountain (from its snow);  Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine:—Lebanon.

H3845.definition: לִבְנִי Libnîy, lib-nee'; from H3835; white;  Libni, an Israelite:—Libni.

H3847.definition: לָבַשׁ lâbash, law-bash'; or לָבֵשׁ lâbêsh; a primitive root;  properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on a garment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively:—(in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear.

H3849.definition: לֹג lôg, lohg; from an unused root apparently meaning to deepen or hollow (like H3537);  a log or measure for liquids:—log (of oil).

H3850.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3850.definition: לֹד Lôd, lode; from an unused root of uncertain signification;  Lod, a place in Palestine:—Lod.

H3851.definition: לַהַב lahab, lah'-hab; from an usused root meaning to gleam;  a flash; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of a weapon:—blade, bright, flame, glittering.

H3852.definition: לֶהָבָה lehâbâh, leh-aw-baw'; or לַהֶבֶת lahebeth; feminine of H3851, and meaning the same:—flame(-ming), head (of a spear).

H3854.definition: לַהַג lahag, lah'-hag; from an unused root meaning to be eager;  intense mental application:—study.

H3856.definition: לָהַהּ lâhahh, law-hah'; a primitive root meaning properly, to burn, i.e. (by implication)  to be rabid (figuratively, insane); also (from the exhaustion of frenzy) to languish:—faint, mad.

H3857.definition: לָהַט lâhaṭ, law-hat'; a primitive root;  properly, to lick, i.e. (by implication) to blaze:—burn (up), set on fire, flaming, kindle.

H3859.definition: לָהַם lâham, law-ham'; a primitive root;  properly, to burn in, i.e. (figuratively) to rankle:—wound.

H386.definition: אֵיתָן ʼêythân, ay-thawn'; or (shortened) אֵתָן ʼêthân ; from an unused root (meaning to continue);  permanence; hence (concrete) permanent; specifically a chieftain:—hard, mighty, rough, strength, strong.

H3861.definition: לָהֵן lâhên, law-hane'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3860;  therefore; also except:—but, except, save, therefore, wherefore.

H3863.definition: לוּא lûwʼ, loo; or לֻא luʼ; or לוּ lûw;  a conditional particle; if; by implication (interj. as a wish) would that!:—if (haply), peradventure, I pray thee, though, I would, would God (that).

H3864.definition: לוּבִי Lûwbîy, loo-bee'; or לֻבִּי Lubbîy; (Daniel 11:43), partrial from a name probably derived from an unused root meaning to thirst, i.e. a dry region; apparently  a Libyan or inhabitant of interior Africa (only in plural):—Lubim(-s), Libyans.

H3865.definition: לוּד Lûwd, lood; probably of foreign derivation;  Lud, the name of two nations:—Lud, Lydia.

H3866.definition: לוּדִי Lûwdîy, loo-dee'; or לוּדִיִּי Lûwdîyîy; patrial from H3865;  a Ludite or inhabitants of Lud (only in plural):—Ludim. Lydians.

H3867.definition: לָוָה lâvâh, law-vaw'; a primitive root;  properly, to twine, i.e. (by implication) to unite, to remain; also to borrow (as a form of obligation) or (causatively) to lend:—abide with, borrow(-er), cleave, join (self), lend(-er).

H3869.definition: לוּז lûwz, looz; probably of foreign origin;  some kind of nut-tree, perhaps the almond:—hazel.

H387.definition: אֵיתָן ʼÊythân, ay-thawn'; the same as H386; permanent;  Ethan, the name of four Israelites:—Ethan.

H3871.definition: לוּחַ lûwach, loo'-akh; or לֻחַ luach; from a primitive root;  probably meaning to glisten; a tablet (as polished), of stone, wood or metal:—board, plate, table.

H3873.definition: לוֹחֵשׁ Lôwchêsh, lo-khashe'; active participle of H3907; (the) enchanter;  Lochesh, an Israelite:—Hallohesh, Haloshesh (including the article).

H3876.definition: לוֹט Lôwṭ, lote; the same as H3875;  Lot, Abraham's nephew:—Lot.

H3877.definition: לוֹטָן Lôwṭân, lo-tawn'; from H3875; covering;  Lotan, an Idumaean:—Lotan.

H3878.definition: לֵוִי Lêvîy, lay-vee'; from H3867; attached;  Levi, a son of Jacob:—Levi. See also H3879, H3881.

H3879.definition: לֵוִי Lêvîy, lay-vee'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3880:—Levite.

H388.definition: אֵיתָנִים ʼÊythânîym, ay-thaw-neem'; plural of H386; always with the article; the permanent brooks;  Ethanim, the name of a month:—Ethanim.

H3881.definition: לֵוִיִּי Lêvîyîy, lay-vee-ee'; or לֵוִי Lêvîy; patronymically from H3878;  a Levite or descendant of Levi:—Leviite.

H3882.definition: לִוְיָתָן livyâthân, liv-yaw-thawn'; from H3867;  a wreathed animal, i.e. a serpent (especially the crocodile or some other large sea-monster); figuratively, the constellation of the dragon; also as a symbol of Babylon:—leviathan, mourning.

H3883.definition: לוּל lûwl, lool; from an unused root meaning to fold back;  a spiral step:—winding stair. Compare H3924.

H3884.definition: לוּלֵא lûwlêʼ, loo-lay'; or לוּלֵי lûwlêy; from H3863 and H3808;  if not:—except, had not, if (...not), unless, were it not that.

H3885.definition: לוּן lûwn, loon; or לִין lîyn; a primitive root;  to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain):—abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).

H3886.definition: לוּעַ lûwaʻ, loo'-ah; a primitive root;  to gulp; figuratively, to be rash:—swallow down (up).

H3887.definition: לוּץ lûwts, loots; a primitive root;  properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede:—ambassador, have in derision, interpreter, make a mock, mocker, scorn(-er, -ful), teacher.

H3888.definition: לוּשׁ lûwsh, loosh; a primitive root;  to knead:—knead.

H3889.definition: לוּשׁ Lûwsh, loosh; from H3888; kneading;  Lush, a place in Palestine:—Laish (from the margin). Compare H3919.

H389.definition: אַךְ ʼak, ak; akin to H403;  a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only:—also, in any wise, at least, but, certainly, even, howbeit, nevertheless, notwithstanding, only, save, surely, of a surety, truly, verily,   wherefore, yet (but).

H3891.definition: לְזוּת lᵉzûwth, lez-ooth'; from H3868;  perverseness:—perverse.

H3892.definition: לַח lach, lakh; from an unused root meaning to be new;  fresh, i.e. unused or undried:—green, moist.

H3895.definition: לְחִי lᵉchîy, lekh-ee'; from an unused root meaning to be soft;  the cheek (from its fleshiness); hence, the jaw-bone:—cheek (bone), jaw (bone).

H3897.definition: לָחַךְ lâchak, law-khak'; a primitive root;  to lick:—lick (up).

H3898.definition: לָחַם lâcham, law-kham'; a primitive root;  to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction):—devour, eat, × ever, fight(-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war(-ring).

H3899.definition: לֶחֶם lechem, lekh'-em; from H3898; See also H1036  food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it):—(shew-) bread, × eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals.

H39.definition: אֲבִימָאֵל ʼĂbîymâʼêl, ab-ee-maw-ale'; from H1 and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe);  Abimael, a son of Joktan:—Abimael.

H3900.definition: לְחֶם lᵉchem, lekh-em'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3899:—feast.

H3901.definition: לָחֶם lâchem, law-khem'; from H3898,  battle:—war.

H3902.definition: לַחְמִי Lachmîy, lakh-mee'; from H3899; foodful; (or perhaps erroneous transcription) for H1022  Lachmi, an Israelite; or rather probably a brief form:—Lahmi. See also H3433.

H3905.definition: לָחַץ lâchats, law-khats'; a primitive root;  properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to distress:—afflict, crush, force, hold fast, oppress(-or), thrust self.

H3908.definition: לַחַשׁ lachash, lakh'-ash; from H3907;  properly, a whisper, i.e. by implication, (in a good sense) a private prayer, (in a bad one) an incantation; concretely, an amulet:—charmed, earring, enchantment, orator, prayer.

H3909.definition: לָט lâṭ, lawt; a form of H3814 or else participle from H3874;  properly, covered, i.e. secret; by implication, incantation; also secrecy or (adverb) covertly:—enchantment, privily, secretly, softly.

H3915.definition: לַיִל layil, lah'-yil; or (Isaiah 21:11) לֵיל lêyl; also לַיְלָה laylâh; from the same as H3883;  properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity:—(mid-)night (season).

H3916.definition: לֵילְיָא lêylᵉyâʼ, lay-leh-yaw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3815:—night.

H3919.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H3919.definition: לַיִשׁ Layish, lah'-yish; the same as H3918;  Laish, the name of two places in Palestine:—Laish. Compare H3889.

H3920.definition: לָכַד lâkad, law-kad'; a primitive root;  to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere:—× at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take.

H3923.definition: לָכִישׁ Lâkîysh, law-keesh'; from an unused root of uncertain meaning;  Lakish, a place in Palestine:—Lachish.

H3924.definition: לֻלָאָה lulâʼâh, loo-law-aw'; from the same as H3883;  a loop:—loop.

H3925.definition: לָמַד lâmad, law-mad'; a primitive root;  properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive):—(un-) accustomed, × diligently, expert, instruct, learn, skilful, teach(-er, -ing).

H3927.definition: לְמוּאֵל Lᵉmûwʼêl, lem-oo-ale'; or לְמוֹאֵל Lᵉmôwʼêl; from H3926 and H410; (belonging) to God;  Lemuel or Lemoel, a symbolic name of Solomon:—Lemuel.

H3928.definition: לִמּוּד limmûwd, lim-mood'; or לִמֻּד limmud; from H3925;  instructed:—accustomed, disciple, learned, taught, used.

H3929.definition: לֶמֶךְ Lemek, leh'-mek; from an unused root of uncertain meaning;  Lemek, the name of two antediluvian patriarchs:—Lamech.

H393.definition: אַכְזָר ʼakzâr, ak-zawr'; from an unused root (apparently meaning to act harshly);  violent; by implication deadly; also (in a good sense) brave:—cruel, fierce.

H3932.definition: לָעַג lâʻag, law-ag'; a primitive root;  to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly:—have in derision, laugh (to scorn), mock (on), stammering.

H3934.definition: לָעֵג lâʻêg, law-ayg'; from H3932;  a buffoon; also a foreigner:—mocker, stammering.

H3936.definition: לַעְדָּן Laʻdân, lah-dawn'; from the same as H3935;  Ladan, the name of two Israelites:—Laadan.

H3937.definition: לָעַז lâʻaz, law-az'; a primitive root;  to speak in a foreign tongue:—strange language.

H394.definition: אַכְזָרִי ʼakzârîy, ak-zawr-ree'; from H393;  terrible:—cruel (one).

H3940.definition: לַפִּיד lappîyd, lap-peed'; or לַפִּד lappid; from an unused root probably meaning to shine;  a flambeau, lamp or flame:—(fire-) brand, (burning) lamp, lightning, torch.

H3943.definition: לָפַת lâphath, law-fath'; a primitive root;  properly, to bend, i.e. (by implication) to clasp; also (reflexively) to turn around or aside:—take hold, turn aside (self).

H3947.definition: לָקַח lâqach, law-kakh'; a primitive root;  to take (in the widest variety of applications):—accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, × many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

H3948.definition: לֶקַח leqach, leh'-kakh; from H3947;  properly, something received, i.e. (mentally) instruction (whether on the part of the teacher or hearer); also (in an active and sinister sense) inveiglement:—doctrine, learning, fair speech.

H3950.definition: לָקַט lâqaṭ, law-kat'; a primitive root;  properly, to pick up, i.e. (generally) to gather; specifically, to glean:—gather (up), glean.

H3952.definition: לָקַק lâqaq, law-kak'; a primitive root;  to lick or lap:—lap, lick.

H3955.definition: לְשַׁד lᵉshad, lesh-ad'; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; apparently juice, i.e.  (figuratively) vigor; also a sweet or fat cake:—fresh, moisture.

H3956.definition: לָשׁוֹן lâshôwn, law-shone'; or לָשֹׁן lâshôn; also (in plural) feminine לְשֹׁנָה lᵉshônâh; from H3960;  the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water):—  babbler, bay,   evil speaker, language, talker, tongue, wedge.

H3957.definition: לִשְׁכָּה lishkâh, lish-kaw'; from an unused root of uncertain meaning;  a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging):—chamber, parlour. Compare H5393.

H3959.definition: לֶשֶׁם Leshem, leh'-shem; the same as H3958;  Leshem, a place in Palestine:—Leshem.

H3960.definition: לָשַׁן lâshan, law-shan'; a primitive root; properly, to lick; but used only as a denominative from H3956;  to wag the tongue, i.e. to calumniate:—accuse, slander.

H3964.definition: מָא mâʼ, maw; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4100;  (as indefinitely) that:—+ what.

H3966.definition: מְאֹד mᵉʼôd, meh-ode'; from the same as H181;  properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated):—diligently, especially, exceeding(-ly), far, fast, good, great(-ly), × louder and louder, might(-ily, -y), (so) much, quickly, (so) sore, utterly, very (  much, sore), well.

H3967.definition: מֵאָה mêʼâh, may-aw'; or מֵאיָה mêʼyâh; properly, a primitive numeral  a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction:—hundred((-fold), -th),   sixscore.

H3969.definition: מְאָה mᵉʼâh, meh-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H3967; properly, a primitive numeral  a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction}:—hundred.

H397.definition: אֲכִישׁ ʼĂkîysh, aw-keesh'; of uncertain derivation;  Akish, a Philistine king:—Achish.

H3971.definition: מאוּם mʼûwm, moom; usually מוּם mûwm; as if passive participle from an unused root probably meaning to stain  a blemish (physically or morally):—blemish, blot, spot.

H3972.definition: מְאוּמָה mᵉʼûwmâh, meh-oo'-maw; apparently a form of H3971;  properly, a speck or point, i.e. (by implication) something; with negative, nothing:—fault,   no(-ught), ought, somewhat, any (no-)thing.

H3974.definition: מָאוֹר mâʼôwr, maw-ore'; or מָאֹר mâʼôr; also (in plural) feminine מְאוֹרָה mᵉʼôwrâh; or מְאֹרָה mᵉʼôrâh; from H215;  properly, a luminous body or luminary, i.e. (abstractly) light (as an element); figuratively, brightness, i.e.cheerfulness; specifically, a chandelier:—bright, light.

H3975.definition: מְאוּרָה mᵉʼûwrâh, meh-oo-raw'; feminine passive participle of H215;  something lighted, i.e. an aperture; by implication, a crevice or hole (of a serpent):—den.

H3976.definition: מֹאזֵן môʼzên, mo-zane'; from H239;  (only in the dual) a pair of scales:—balances.

H3978.definition: מַאֲכָל maʼăkâl, mah-ak-awl'; from H398;  an eatable (includ. provender, flesh and fruit):—food, fruit, (bake-)meat(-s), victual.

H398.definition: אָכַל ʼâkal, aw-kal'; a primitive root;  to eat (literally or figuratively):—× at all, burn up, consume, devour(-er, up), dine, eat(-er, up), feed (with), food, × freely, × in...wise(-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, × quite.

H3980.definition: מַאֲכֹלֶת maʼăkôleth, mah-ak-o'-leth; from H398;  something eaten (by fire), i.e. fuel:—fuel.

H3984.definition: מָאן mâʼn, mawn; (Aramaic) probably from a root corresponding to H579 in the sense of an inclosure by sides;  a utensil:—vessel.

H3985.definition: מָאֵן mâʼên, maw-ane'; a primitive root;  to refuse:—refuse, × utterly.

H3987.definition: מֵאֵן mêʼên, may-ane'; from H3985;  refractory:—refuse.

H3988.definition: מָאַס mâʼaç, maw-as'; a primitive root;  to spurn; also (intransitively) to disappear:—abhor, cast away (off), contemn, despise, disdain, (become) loathe(some), melt away, refuse, reject, reprobate, × utterly, vile person.

H3989.definition: מַאֲפֶה maʼăpheh, mah-af-eh'; from H644;  something baked, i.e. a batch:—baken.

H399.definition: אֲכַל ʼăkal, ak-al'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H398:—  accuse, devour, eat.

H3990.definition: מַאֲפֵל maʼăphêl, mah-af-ale'; from the same as H651;  something opaque:—darkness.

H3991.definition: מַאְפֵלְיָה maʼphêlᵉyâh, mah-af-ay-leh-yaw'; prolonged feminine of H3990;  opaqueness:—darkness.

H3993.definition: מַאֲרָב maʼărâb, mah-ar-awb'; from H693;  an ambuscade:—lie in ambush, ambushment, lurking place, lying in wait.

H3995.definition: מִבְדָּלָה mibdâlâh, mib-daw-law'; from H914;  a separation, i.e. (concretely) a separate place:—separate.

H3996.definition: מָבוֹא mâbôwʼ, maw-bo'; from H935; (with or without H8121)  an entrance (the place or the act); specifically sunset or the west; also (adverb with preposition) towards:—by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down,   westward. Compare H4126.

H40.definition: אֲבִימֶלֶךְ ʼĂbîymelek, ab-ee-mel'-ek; from H1 and H4428; father of (the) king;  Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites:—Abimelech.

H400.definition: אֹכֶל ʼôkel, o'-kel; from H398;  food:—eating, food, meal(-time), meat, prey, victuals.

H4002.definition: מַבּוּעַ mabbûwaʻ, mab-boo'-ah; from H5042;  a fountain:—fountain, spring.

H4004.definition: מִבְחוֹר mibchôwr, mib-khore'; from H977;  select, i.e. well fortified:—choice.

H4006.definition: מִבְחָר Mibchâr, mib-khawr'; the same as H4005;  Mibchar, an Israelite:—Mibhar.

H4009.definition: מִבְטָח mibṭâch, mib-tawkh'; from H982;  properly, a refuge, i.e. (objective) security, or (subjective) assurance:—confidence, hope, sure, trust.

H4012.definition: מְבֻנַּי Mᵉbunnay, meb-oon-hah'-ee; from H1129; built up;  Mebunnai, an Israelite:—Mebunnai.

H4013.definition: מִבְצָר mibtsâr, mib-tsawr'; also (in plural) feminine (Daniel 11:l5) מִבְצָרָה mibtsârâh; from H1219;  a fortification, castle, or fortified city; figuratively, a defender:—(de-, most) fenced, fortress, (most) strong (hold).

H4014.definition: מִבְצָר Mibtsâr, mib-tsawr'; the same as H4013;  Mibtsar, an Idumaean:—Mibzar.

H4017.definition: מִבְשָׂם Mibsâm, mib-sawm'; from the same as H1314; fragrant;  Mibsam, the name of an Ishmaelite and of an Israelite:—Mibsam.

H402.definition: אׇכְלָה ʼoklâh, ok-law'; feminine of H401;  food:—consume, devour, eat, food, meat.

H4021.definition: מִגְבָּעָה migbâʻâh, mig-baw-aw'; from the same as H1389;  a cap (as hemispherical):—bonnet.

H4022.definition: מֶגֶד meged, meh'-ghed; from an unused root probably meaning to be eminent;  properly, a distinguished thing; hence something valuable, as a product or fruit:—pleasant, precious fruit (thing).

H4023.definition: מְגִדּוֹן Mᵉgiddôwn, meg-id-done'; (Zechariah H12) or מְגִדּוֹ Mᵉgiddôw; from H1413; rendezvous;  Megiddon or Megiddo, a place in Palestine:—Megiddo, Megiddon.

H4024.definition: מִגְדּוֹל Migdôwl, mig-dole'; or מִגְדֹּל Migdôl; probably of Egyptian origin;  Migdol, a place in Egypt:—Migdol, tower.

H4025.definition: מַגְדִּיאֵל Magdîyʼêl, mag-dee-ale'; from H4022 and H410; preciousness of God;  Magdiel, an Idumaean:—Magdiel.

H4026.definition: מִגְדָּל migdâl, mig-dawl'; also (in plural) feminine מִגְדָּלָה migdâlâh; from H1431;  a tower (from its size or height); by analogy, a rostrum; figuratively, a (pyramidal) bed of flowers:—castle, flower, tower. Compare the names following.

H403.definition: אָכֵן ʼâkên, aw-kane'; from H3559 (compare H3651);  firmly; figuratively, surely; also (adversative) but:—but, certainly, nevertheless, surely, truly, verily.

H4031.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H4031.definition: מָגוֹג Mâgôwg, maw-gogue'; from H1463;  Magog, a son of Japheth; also a barbarous northern region:—Magog.

H4032.definition: מָגוֹר mâgôwr, maw-gore'; or (Lamentations 2:22) מָגוּר mâgûwr; from H1481 in the sense of fearing;  a fright (objective or subjective):—fear, terror. Compare H4036.

H4033.definition: מָגוּר mâgûwr, maw-goor'; or מָגֻר mâgur; from H1481 in the sense of lodging;  a temporary abode; by extension, a permanent residence:—dwelling, pilgrimage, where sojourn, be a stranger. Compare H4032.

H4034.definition: מְגוֹרַה mᵉgôwrah, meg-o-raw'; feminine of H4032;  affright:—fear.

H4037.definition: מַגְזֵרָה magzêrâh, mag-zay-raw'; from H1504;  a cutting implement, i.e. a blade:—axe.

H4039.definition: מְגִלָּה mᵉgillâh, meg-il-law'; from H1556;  a roll:—roll, volume.

H404.definition: אָכַף ʼâkaph, aw-kaf'; a primitive root; apparently meaning to curve (as with a burden);  to urge:—crave.

H4043.definition: מָגֵן mâgên, maw-gane'; also (in plural) feminine מְגִנָּה mᵉginnâh; from H1598;  a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile:—× armed, buckler, defence, ruler,   scale, shield.

H4046.definition: מַגֵּפָה maggêphâh, mag-gay-faw'; from H5062;  a pestilence; by analogy, defeat:—(× be) plague(-d), slaughter, stroke.

H4047.definition: מַגְפִּיעָשׁ Magpîyʻâsh, mag-pee-awsh'; apparently from H1479 or H5062 and H6211; exterminator of (the) moth;  Magpiash, an Israelite:—Magpiash.

H4049.definition: מְגַר mᵉgar, meg-ar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4048;  to overthrow:—destroy.

H4054.definition: מִגְרָשׁ migrâsh, mig-rawsh'; also (in plural) feminine (Ezekiel 27:28) מִגְרָשָׁה migrâshâh; from H1644;  a suburb (i.e. open country whither flocks are driven from pasture); hence, the area around a building, or the margin of the sea:—cast out, suburb.

H4055.definition: מַד mad, mad; or מֵד mêd; from H4058;  properly, extent, i.e. height; also a measure; by implication, a vesture (as measured); also a carpet:—armour, clothes, garment, judgment, measure, raiment, stature.

H4057.definition: מִדְבָּר midbâr, mid-bawr'; from H1696 in the sense of driving;  a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs):—desert, south, speech, wilderness.

H4058.definition: מָדַד mâdad, maw-dad'; a primitive root;  properly, to stretch; by implication, to measure (as if by stretching a line); figuratively, to be extended:—measure, mete, stretch self.

H4060.definition: מִדָּה middâh, mid-daw'; feminine of H4055;  properly, extension, i.e. height or breadth; also a measure (including its standard); hence a portion (as measured) or a vestment; specifically, tribute (as measured):—garment, measure(-ing), meteyard, piece, size, (great) stature, tribute, wide.

H4061.definition: מִדָּה middâh, mid-daw'; (Aramaic) or מִנְדָּה mindâh; (Aramaic), corresponding to H4060;  tribute in money:—toll, tribute.

H4064.definition: מַדְוֶה madveh, mad-veh'; from H1738;  sickness:—disease.

H4065.definition: מַדּוּחַ maddûwach, mad-doo'akh; from H5080;  seduction:—cause of banishment.

H4066.definition: מָדוֹן mâdôwn, maw-dohn'; from H1777;  a contest or quarrel:—brawling, contention(-ous), discord, strife. Compare H4079, H4090.

H4069.definition: מַדּוּעַ maddûwaʻ, mad-doo'-ah; or מַדֻּעַ madduaʻ; from H4100 and the passive participle of H3045;  what (is) known?; i.e. (by implication) (adverbially) why?:—how, wherefore, why.

H4070.definition: מְדוֹר mᵉdôwr, med-ore'; (Aramaic) or מְדֹר mᵉdôr; (Aramaic), or מְדָר mᵉdâr; (Aramaic), from H1753;  a dwelling:—dwelling.

H4072.definition: מִדְחֶה midcheh, mid-kheh'; from H1760;  overthrow:—ruin.

H4073.definition: מְדַחְפָה mᵉdachphâh, med-akh-faw'; from H1765;  a push, i.e. ruin:—overthrow.

H4074.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H4074.definition: מָדַי Mâday, maw-dah'-ee; of foreign derivation;  Madai, a country of central Asia:—Madai, Medes, Media.

H408.definition: אַל ʼal, al; a negative particle (akin to H3808);  not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing:—nay, neither, + never, no, nor, not, nothing (worth), rather than.

H4080.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H4080.definition: מִדְיָן Midyân, mid-yawn'; the same as H4079;  Midjan, a son of Abraham; also his country and (collectively) his descendants:—Midian, Midianite.

H4081.definition: מִדִּין Middîyn, mid-deen'; a variation for H4080:—Middin.

H4082.definition: מְדִינָה mᵉdîynâh, med-ee-naw'; from H1777;  properly, a judgeship, i.e. jurisdiction; by implication, a district (as ruled by a judge); generally, a region:—(× every) province.

H4083.definition: מְדִינָה mᵉdîynâh, med-ee-naw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4082:—province.

H4084.definition: מִדְיָנִי Midyânîy, mid-yaw-nee'; patronymical or patrial from H4080;  a Midjanite or descendant (native) of Midjan:—Midianite. Compare H4092.

H4086.definition: מַדְמֵן Madmên, mad-mane'; from the same as H1828; dunghill;  Madmen, a place in Palestine:—Madmen.

H4088.definition: מַדְמֵנָה Madmênâh, mad-may-naw'; the same as H4087;  Madmenah, a place in Palestine:—Madmenah.

H409.definition: אַל ʼal, al; (Aramaic) corresponding to H408:—not.

H4090.definition: מְדָן mᵉdân, med-awn'; a form of H4066:—discord, strife.

H4091.definition: מְדָן Mᵉdân, med-awn'; the same as H4090;  Medan, a son of Abraham:—Medan.

H4093.definition: מַדָּע maddâʻ, mad-daw'; or מַדַּע maddaʻ; from H3045;  intelligence or consciousness:—knowledge, science, thought.

H41.definition: אֲבִינָדָב ʼĂbîynâdâb, ab-ee-naw-dawb'; from H1 and H5068; father of generosity (i.e. liberal);  Abinadab, the name of four Israelites:—Abinadab.

H410.definition: אֵל ʼêl, ale; shortened from H352;  strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity):—God (god), × goodly, × great, idol, might(-y one), power, strong. Compare names in '-el.'

H4100.definition: מָה mâh, maw; or מַה mah; or מָ mâ; or מַ ma; also מֶה meh; a primitive particle;  properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses:—how (long, oft, (-soever)), (no-) thing, what (end, good, purpose, thing), whereby(-fore, -in, -to, -with), (for) why.

H4101.definition: מָה mâh, maw; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4100:—how great (mighty), that which, what(-soever), why.

H4103.definition: מְהוּמָה mᵉhûwmâh, meh-hoo-maw'; from H1949;  confusion or uproar:—destruction, discomfiture, trouble, tumult, vexation, vexed.

H4104.definition: מְהוּמָן Mᵉhûwmân, meh-hoo-mawn'; of Persian origin;  Mehuman, a eunuch of Xerxes:—Mehuman.

H4106.definition: מָהִיר mâhîyr, maw-here'; or מָהִר mâhir; from H4116;  quick; hence, skilful:—diligent, hasty, ready.

H4107.definition: מָהַל mâhal, maw-hal'; a primitive root;  properly, to cut down or reduce, i.e. by implication, to adulterate:—mixed.

H4109.definition: מַהֲלָךְ mahălâk, mah-hal-awk'; from H1980;  a walk, i.e. a passage or a distance:—journey, walk.

H411.definition: אֵל ʼêl, ale; a demonstrative particle (but only in a plural sense)  these or those:—these, those. Compare 428.

H4111.definition: מַהֲלַלְאֵל Mahălalʼêl, mah-hal-al-ale'; from H4110 and H410; praise of God;  Mahalalel, the name of an antediluvian patriarch and of an Israelite:—Mahalaleel.

H4113.definition: מַהֲמֹרָה mahămôrâh, mah-ham-o-raw'; from an unused root of uncertain meaning;  perhaps an abyss:—deep pit.

H4114.definition: מַהְפֵּכָה mahpêkâh, mah-pay-kaw'; from H2015;  a destruction:—when...overthrew, overthrow(-n).

H4116.definition: מָהַר mâhar, maw-har'; a primitive root;  properly, to be liquid or flow easily, i.e. (by implication); to hurry (in a good or a bad sense); often used (with another verb) adverbially, promptly:—be carried headlong, fearful, (cause to make, in, make) haste(-n, -ily), (be) hasty, (fetch, make ready) × quickly, rash, × shortly, (be so) × soon, make speed, × speedily, × straightway, × suddenly, swift.

H4118.definition: מַהֵר mahêr, mah-hare'; from H4116;  properly, hurrying; hence (adverbially) in a hurry:—hasteth, hastily, at once, quickly, soon, speedily, suddenly.

H412.definition: אֵל ʼêl, ale; (Aramaic) corresponding to H411:—these.

H4120.definition: מְהֵרָה mᵉhêrâh, meh-hay-raw'; feminine of H4118;  properly, a hurry; hence (adverbially) promptly:—hastily, quickly, shortly, soon, make (with) speed(-ily), swiftly.

H4121.definition: מַהֲרַי Mahăray, mah-har-ah'-ee; from H4116; hasty;  Maharai, an Israelite:—Maharai.

H4123.definition: מַהֲתַלָּה mahăthallâh, mah-hath-al-law'; from H2048;  a delusion:—deceit.

H4124.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H4124.definition: מוֹאָב Môwʼâb, mo-awb; from a prolonged form of the prepositional prefix m- and H1; from (her [the mother's]) father;  Moab, an incestuous son of Lot; also his territory and descendants:—Moab.

H4125.definition: מוֹאָבִי Môwʼâbîy, mo-aw-bee'; feminine מוֹאָבִיָּה Môwʼâbîyâh; or מוֹאָבִית Môwʼâbîythxlit Môwâbîyth corrected to Môwʼâbîyth; patronymical from H4124;  a Moabite or Moabitess, i.e. a descendant from Moab:—(woman) of Moab, Moabite(-ish, -ss).

H4127.definition: מוּג mûwg, moog; a primitive root;  to melt, i.e. literally (to soften, flow down, disappear), or figuratively (to fear, faint):—consume, dissolve, (be) faint(-hearted), melt (away), make soft.

H4129.definition: מוֹדַע môwdaʻ, mo-dah'; or rather מֹדָע môdâʻ; from H3045;  an acquaintance:—kinswoman.

H413.definition: אֵל ʼêl, ale; (but only used in the shortened constructive form אֶל ʼel ); a primitive particle; properly, denoting motion towards, but occasionally used of a quiescent position, i.e.  near, with or among; often in general, to:—about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, × hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

H4131.definition: מוֹט môwṭ, mote; a primitive root;  to waver; by implication, to slip, shake, fall:—be carried, cast, be out of course, be fallen in decay, × exceedingly, fall(-ing down), be (re-) moved, be ready, shake, slide, slip.

H4133.definition: מוֹטָה môwṭâh, mo-taw'; feminine of H4132;  a pole; by implication, an ox-bow; hence, a yoke (either literal or figurative):—bands, heavy, staves, yoke.

H4134.definition: מוּךְ mûwk, mook; a primitive root;  to become thin, i.e. (figuratively) be impoverished:—be (waxen) poor(-er).

H4135.definition: מוּל mûwl, mool; a primitive root;  to cut short, i.e. curtail (specifically the prepuce, i.e. to circumcise); by implication, to blunt; figuratively, to destroy:—circumcise(-ing), selves), cut down (in pieces), destroy, × must needs.

H4136.definition: מוּל mûwl, mool; or מוֹל môwl; (Deuteronomy 1:1), or מוֹאל môwʼl; (Nehemiah 12:38), or מֻל mul; (Numbers 22:5), from H4135;  properly, abrupt, i.e. a precipice; by implication, the front; used only adverbially (with prepositional prefix) opposite:—(over) against, before, (fore-) front, from, (God-) ward, toward, with.

H4137.definition: מוֹלָדָה Môwlâdâh, mo-law-daw'; from H3205; birth;  Moladah, a place in Palestine:—Moladah.

H4143.definition: מוּסָד mûwçâd, moo-sawd'; from H3245;  a foundation:—foundation.

H4144.definition: מוֹסָד môwçâd, mo-sawd'; from H3245;  a foundation:—foundation.

H4146.definition: מוֹסָדָה môwçâdâh, mo-saw-daw'; or מֹסָדָה môçâdâh; feminine of H4144;  a foundation:—foundation.

H4148.definition: מוּסָר mûwçâr, moo-sawr'; from H3256;  properly, chastisement; figuratively, reproof, warning or instruction; also restraint:—bond, chastening(-eth), chastisement, check, correction, discipline, doctrine, instruction, rebuke.

H4150.definition: מוֹעֵד môwʻêd, mo-ade'; or מֹעֵד môʻêd; or (feminine) מוֹעָדָה môwʻâdâh; (2 Chronicles 8:13), from H3259;  properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally a year; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand):—appointed (sign, time), (place of, solemn) assembly, congregation, (set, solemn) feast, (appointed, due) season, solemn(-ity), synogogue, (set) time (appointed).

H4158.definition: מוֹפַעַת Môwphaʻath, mo-fah'-ath; (Jeremiah 48:21) or מֵיפַעַת mêyphaʻath; or מֵפַעַת mêphaʻath; from H3313; illuminative;  Mophaath or Mephaath, a place in Palestine:—Mephaath.
