H4159.definition: מוֹפֵת môwphêth, mo-faith'; or מֹפֵת môphêth; from H3302 in the sense of conspicuousness;  a miracle; by implication, a token or omen:—miracle, sign, wonder(-ed at).

H416.definition: אֵל בֵּית־אֵל ʼÊl Bêyth-ʼÊl, ale bayth-ale'; from H410 and H1008; the God of Bethel;  El-Bethel, the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob:—El-beth-el.

H4161.definition: מוֹצָא môwtsâʼ, mo-tsaw'; or מֹצָא môtsâʼxlit môtsâ corrected to môtsâʼ; from H3318;  a going forth, i.e. (the act) an egress, or (the place) an exit; hence, a source or product; specifically, dawn, the rising of the sun (the East), exportation, utterance, a gate, a fountain, a mine, a meadow (as producing grass):—brought out, bud, that which came out, east, going forth, goings out, that which (thing that) is gone out, outgoing, proceeded out, spring, vein, (water-) course (springs).

H4162.definition: מוֹצָא môwtsâʼ, mo-tsaw'; the same as H4161;  Motsa, the name of two Israelites:—Moza.

H4168.definition: מוֹקֵד môwqêd, mo-kade'; from H3344;  a fire or fuel; abstractly, a conflagration:—burning, hearth.

H4170.definition: מוֹקֵשׁ môwqêsh, mo-kashe'; or מֹקֵשׁ môqêsh; from H3369;  a noose (for catching animals) (literally or figuratively); by implication, a hook (for the nose):—be ensnared, gin, (is) snare(-d), trap.

H4171.definition: מוּר mûwr, moor; a primitive root;  to alter; by implication, to barter, to dispose of:—× at all, (ex-) change, remove.

H4172.definition: מוֹרָא môwrâʼ, mo-raw'; or מֹרָא môrâʼ; or מוֹרָה môwrâhxlit môrâh corrected to môwrâh; (Psalm 9:20), from H3372;  fear; by implication, a fearful thing or deed:—dread, (that ought to be) fear(-ed), terribleness, terror.

H4173.definition: מוֹרַג môwrag, mo-rag'; or מֹרַג môrag; from an unused root meaning to triturate;  a threshing sledge:—threshing instrument.

H4174.definition: מוֹרָד môwrâd, mo-rawd'; from H3381;  a descent; as architecture, an ornamental appendage, perhaps a festoon:—going down, steep place, thin work.

H4175.definition: מוֹרֶה môwreh, mo-reh'; from H3384; (see H3138)  an archer; also teacher or teaching; also the early rain:—(early) rain.

H4177.definition: מוֹרָה môwrâh, mo-raw'; from H4171 in the sense of shearing;  a razor:—razor.

H4179.definition: מוֹרִיָּה Môwrîyâh, mo-ree-yaw'; or מֹרִיָּה Môrîyâh; from H7200 and H3050; seen of Jah;  Morijah, a hill in Palestine:—Moriah.

H418.definition: אַלְגּוּמִּים ʼalgûwmmîym, al-goom-meem'; by transposition for H484;  sticks of algum wood:—algum (trees).

H4184.definition: מוּשׁ mûwsh, moosh; a primitive root;  to touch:—feel, handle.

H4185.definition: מוּשׁ mûwsh, moosh; a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as H4184 through the idea of receding by contact);  to withdraw (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitive or transitive):—cease, depart, go back, remove, take away.

H4186.definition: מוֹשָׁב môwshâb, mo-shawb'; or מֹשָׁב môshâb; from H3427;  a seat; figuratively, a site; abstractly, a session; by extension an abode (the place or the time); by implication, population:—assembly, dwell in, dwelling(-place), wherein (that) dwelt (in), inhabited place, seat, sitting, situation, sojourning.

H419.definition: אֶלְדָּד ʼEldâd, el-dad'; from H410 and H1730; God has loved;  Eldad, an Israelite:—Eldad.

H4191.definition: מוּת mûwth, mooth; a primitive root;  to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill:—× at all, × crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy(-er), (cause to, be like to, must) die, kill, necro(-mancer), × must needs, slay, × surely, × very suddenly, × in (no) wise.

H4194.definition: מָוֶת mâveth, maw'-veth; from H4191;  death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin:—(be) dead(-ly), death, die(-d).

H4195.definition: מוֹתָר môwthâr, mo-thar'; from H3498;  literally gain; figuratively, superiority:—plenteousness, preeminence, profit.

H4196.definition: מִזְבֵּחַ mizbêach, miz-bay'-akh; from H2076;  an altar:—altar.

H4197.definition: מֶזֶג mezeg, meh'-zeg; from an unused root meaning to mingle (water with wine);  tempered wine:—liquor.

H4199.definition: מִזָּה Mizzâh, miz-zaw'; probably from an unused root meaning to faint with fear; terror;  Mizzah, an Edomite:—Mizzah.

H4201.definition: מְזוּזָה mᵉzûwzâh, mez-oo-zaw'; or מְזֻזָה mᵉzuzâh; from the same as H2123;  a door-post (as prominent):—(door, side) post.

H4206.definition: מָזִיחַ mâzîyach, maw-zee'-akh; or מֵזַח mêzach; from H2118;  a belt (as movable):—girdle, strength.

H4207.definition: מַזְלֵג mazlêg, maz-layg'; or (feminine) מִזְלָגָה mizlâgâh; from an unused root meaning to draw up;  a fork:—fleshhook.

H4209.definition: מְזִמָּה mᵉzimmâh, mez-im-maw'; from H2161;  a plan, usually evil (machination), sometimes good (sagacity):—(wicked) device, discretion, intent, witty invention, lewdness, mischievous (device), thought, wickedly.

H421.definition: אָלָה ʼâlâh, aw-law'; a primitive root (rather identical with H422 through the idea of invocation);  to bewail:—lament.

H4212.definition: מְזַמְּרָה mᵉzammᵉrâh, mez-am-mer-aw'; from H2168;  a tweezer (only in the plural):—snuffers.

H4214.definition: מִזְרֶה mizreh, miz-reh'; from H2219;  a winnowing shovel (as scattering the chaff):—fan.

H4216.definition: מַזָּרָה mazzârâh, maz-zaw-raw'; apparently from H5144 in the sense of distinction;  some noted constellation (only in the plural), perhaps collectively, the zodiac:—Mazzoroth. Compare H4208.

H4217.definition: מִזְרָח mizrâch, miz-rawkh'; from H2224;  sunrise, i.e. the east:—east (side, -ward), (sun-) rising (of the sun).

H4219.definition: מִזְרָק mizrâq, miz-rawk'; from H2236;  a bowl (as if for sprinkling):—bason, bowl.

H422.definition: אָלָה ʼâlâh, aw-law'; a primitive root;  properly, to adjure, i.e. (usually in a bad sense) imprecate:—adjure, curse, swear.

H4222.definition: מָחָא mâchâʼ, maw-khaw'; a primitive root;  to rub or strike the hands together (in exultation):—clap.

H4223.definition: מְחָא mᵉchâʼ, mekh-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4222;  to strike in pieces; also to arrest; specifically to impale:—hang, smite, stay.

H4224.definition: מַחֲבֵא machăbêʼ, makh-ab-ay'; or מַחֲבֹא machăbôʼ; from H2244;  a refuge:—hiding (lurking) place.

H4225.definition: מַחְבֶּרֶת machbereth, makh-beh'-reth; from H2266;  a junction, i.e. seam or sewed piece:—coupling.

H4229.definition: מָחָה mâchâh, maw-khaw'; a primitive root;  properly, to stroke or rub; by implication, to erase; also to smooth (as if with oil), i.e. grease or make fat; also to touch, i.e. reach to:—abolish, blot out, destroy, full of marrow, put out, reach unto, × utterly, wipe (away, out).

H423.definition: אָלָה ʼâlâh, aw-law'; from H422;  an imprecation:—curse, cursing, execration, oath, swearing.

H4231.definition: מָחוֹז mâchôwz, maw-khoze'; from an unused root meaning to enclose;  a harbor (as shut in by the shore):—haven.

H4232.definition: מְחוּיָאֵל Mᵉchûwyâʼêl, mekh-oo-yaw-ale'; or מְחִיּיָאֵל Mᵉchîyyâʼêl; from H4229 and H410; smitten of God;  Mechujael or Mechijael, an antediluvian patriarch:—Mehujael.

H4236.definition: מַחֲזֶה machăzeh, makh-az-eh'; from H2372;  a vision:—vision.

H4237.definition: מֶחֱזָה mechĕzâh, mekh-ez-aw'; from H2372;  a window:—light.

H4238.definition: מַחֲזִיאוֹת Machăzîyʼôwth, makh-az-ee-oth'; feminine plural from H2372; visions;  Machazioth, an Israelite:—Mahazioth.

H424.definition: אֵלָה ʼêlâh, ay-law'; feminine of H352;  an oak or other strong tree:—elm, oak, teil-tree.

H4241.definition: מִחְיָה michyâh, mikh-yaw'; from H2421;  preservation of life; hence, sustenance; also the live flesh, i.e. the quick:—preserve life, quick, recover selves, reviving, sustenance, victuals.

H4243.definition: מְחִיר Mᵉchîyr, mekh-eer'; the same as H4242; price;  Mechir, an Israelite:—Mehir.

H4244.definition: מַחְלָה Machlâh, makh-law'; from H2470; sickness;  Machlah, the name apparently of two Israelitesses:—Mahlah.

H4245.definition: מַחֲלֶה machăleh, makh-al-eh'; or (feminine) מַחֲלָה machălâh; from H2470;  sickness:—disease, infirmity, sickness.

H4248.definition: מַחְלוֹן Machlôwn, makh-lone'; from H2470; sick;  Machlon, an Israelite:—Mahlon.

H4249.definition: מַחְלִי Machlîy, makh-lee'; from H2470; sick;  Machli, the name of two Israelites:—Mahli.

H425.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H425.definition: אֵלָה ʼÊlâh, ay-law'; the same as H424;  Elah, the name of an Edomite, of four Israelites, and also of a place in Palestine:—Elah.

H4253.definition: מַחְלָפָה machlâphâh, makh-law-faw'; from H2498;  a ringlet of hair (as gliding over each other):—lock.

H4256.definition: מַחֲלֹקֶת machălôqeth, makh-al-o'-keth; from H2505;  a section (of Levites, people or soldiers):—company, course, division, portion. See also H5555.

H4258.definition: מַחֲלַת Machălath, makh-al-ath'; the same as H4257; sickness;  Machalath, the name of an Ishmaelitess and of an Israelitess:—Mahalath.

H426.definition: אֱלָהּ ʼĕlâhh, el-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H433;  God:—God, god.

H4260.definition: מַחֲמָאָה machămâʼâh, makh-am-aw-aw'; a denominative from H2529;  something buttery (i.e. unctuous and pleasant), as (figuratively) flattery:—× than butter.

H4261.definition: מַחְמָד machmâd, makh-mawd'; from H2530;  delightful; hence, a delight, i.e. object of affection or desire:—beloved, desire, goodly, lovely, pleasant (thing).

H4262.definition: מַחְמֻד machmud, makh-mood'; or מַחְמוּד machmûwd; from H2530;  desired; hence, a valuable:—pleasant thing.

H4264.definition: מַחֲנֶה machăneh, makh-an-eh'; from H2583;  an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence, an army, whether literal (of soldiers) or figurative (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts):—army, band, battle, camp, company, drove, host, tents.

H4265.definition: מַחֲנֵה־דָן Machănêh-Dân, makh-an-ay'-dawn; from H4264 and H1835; camp of Dan;  Machaneh-Dan, a place in Palestine:—Mahaneh-dan.

H4266.definition: מַחֲנַיִם Machănayim, makh-an-ah'-yim; dual of H4264; double camp;  Machanajim, a place in Palestine:—Mahanaim.

H4267.definition: מַחֲנַק machănaq, makh-an-ak'; from H2614;  choking:—strangling.

H4268.definition: מַחֲסֶה machăçeh, makh-as-eh'; or מַחְסֶה machçeh; from H2620;  a shelter (literally or figuratively):—hope, (place of) refuge, shelter, trust.

H4270.definition: מַחְסוֹר machçôwr, makh-sore'; or מַחְסֹר machçôr; from H2637;  deficiency; hence, impoverishment:—lack, need, penury, poor, poverty, want.

H4274.definition: מַחְצֵב machtsêb, makh-tsabe'; from H2672;  properly, a hewing; concretely, a quarry:—hewed(-n).

H4275.definition: מֶחֱצָה mechĕtsâh, mekh-ets-aw'; from H2673;  a halving:—half.

H4276.definition: מַחֲצִית machătsîyth, makh-ats-eeth'; from H2673;  a halving or the middle:—half (so much), mid(-day).

H4279.definition: מָחָר mâchâr, maw-khar'; probably from H309;  properly, deferred, i.e. the morrow; usually (adverbially) tomorrow; indefinitely, hereafter:—time to come, tomorrow.

H428.definition: אֵלֶּה ʼêl-leh, ale'-leh; prolonged from H411;  these or those:—an-(the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who(-m).

H4283.definition: מׇחֳרָת mochŏrâth, mokh-or-awth'; or מׇחֳרָתָם mochŏrâthâm; (1 Samuel 30:17), feminine from the same as H4279;  the morrow or (adverbially) tomorrow:—morrow, next day.

H4284.definition: מַחֲשָׁבָה machăshâbâh, makh-ash-aw-baw'; or מַחֲשֶׁבֶת machăshebeth; from H2803;  a contrivance, i.e. (concretely) a texture, machine, or (abstractly) intention, plan (whether bad, a plot; or good, advice):—cunning (work), curious work, device(-sed), imagination, invented, means, purpose, thought.

H4285.definition: מַחְשָׁךְ machshâk, makh-shawk'; from H2821;  darkness; concretely, a dark place:—dark(-ness, place).

H4287.definition: מַחַת Machath, makh'-ath; probably from H4229; erasure;  Machath, the name of two Israelites:—Mahath.

H4288.definition: מְחִתָּה mᵉchittâh, mekh-it-taw'; from H2846;  properly, a dissolution; concretely, a ruin, or (abstractly) consternation:—destruction, dismaying, ruin, terror.

H4289.definition: מַחְתָּה machtâh, makh-taw'; the same as H4288 in the sense of removal;  a pan for live coals:—censer, firepan, snuffdish.

H4291.definition: מְטָא mᵉṭâʼ, met-aw'; (Aramaic) or מְטָה mᵉṭâh; (Aramaic), apparently corresponding to H4672 in the intransitive sense of being found present;  to arrive, extend or happen:—come, reach.

H4293.definition: מַטְבֵּחַ maṭbêach, mat-bay'-akh; from H2873;  slaughter:—slaughter.

H4294.definition: מַטֶּה maṭṭeh, mat-teh'; or (feminine) מַטָּה maṭṭâh; from H5186;  a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively, a support of life, e.g. bread):—rod, staff, tribe.

H4295.definition: מַטָּה maṭṭâh, mat'-taw; from H5786 with directive enclitic appended;  downward, below or beneath; often adverbially with or without prefixes:—beneath, down(-ward), less, very low, under(-neath).

H4296.definition: מִטָּה miṭṭâh, mit-taw'; from H5186;  a bed (as extended) for sleeping or eating; by analogy, a sofa, litter or bier:—bed(-chamber), bier.

H4299.definition: מַטְוֶה maṭveh, mat-veh'; from H2901;  something spun:—spun.

H43.definition: אֶבְיָסָף ʼEbyâçâph, eb-yaw-sawf'; contracted from H23;  Ebjasaph, an Israelite:—Ebiasaph.

H430.definition: אֱלֹהִים ʼĕlôhîym, el-o-heem'; plural of H433;  gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative:—angels, × exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), × (very) great, judges, × mighty.

H4301.definition: מַטְמוֹן maṭmôwn, mat-mone'; or מַטְמֹן maṭmôn; or מַטְמֻן maṭmun; from H2934;  a secret storehouse; hence, a secreted valuable (buried); generally money:—hidden riches, (hid) treasure(-s).

H4302.definition: מַטָּע maṭṭâʻ, mat-taw'; from H5193;  something planted, i.e. the place (a garden or vineyard), or the thing (a plant, figuratively or men); by implication, the act, planting:—plant(-ation, -ing).

H4303.definition: מַטְעַם maṭʻam, mat-am'; or (feminine) מַטְעַמָּה maṭʻammâh; from H2938;  a delicacy:—dainty (meat), savoury meat.

H4304.definition: מִטְפַּחַת miṭpachath, mit-pakh'-ath; from H2946;  a wide cloak (for a woman):—vail, wimple.

H4305.definition: מָטַר mâṭar, maw-tar'; a primitive root;  to rain:—(cause to) rain (upon).

H4306.definition: מָטַר mâṭar, maw-tawr'; from H4305;  rain:—rain.

H431.definition: אֲלוּ ʼălûw, al-oo'; (Aramaic) probably prolonged from H412;  lo!:—behold.

H4310.definition: מִי mîy, me; an interrogative pronoun of persons, as H4100 is of things,  who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix:—any (man), × he, × him,   O that! what, which, who(-m, -se, -soever),   would to God.

H4311.definition: מֵידְבָא Mêydᵉbâʼ, may-deb-aw'; from H4325 and H1679; water of quiet;  Medeba, a place in Palestine:—Medeba.

H4312.definition: מֵידָד Mêydâd, may-dawd'; from H3032 in the sense of loving; affectionate;  Medad, an Israelite:—Medad.

H4316.definition: מִיכָא Mîykâʼ, mee-kaw'; a variation for H4318;  Mica, the name of two Israelites:—Micha.

H4317.definition: מִיכָאֵל Mîykâʼêl, me-kaw-ale'; from H4310 and (the prefix derivative from) H3588 and H410; who (is) like God?;  Mikael, the name of an archangel and of nine Israelites:—Michael.

H4318.definition: מִיכָה Mîykâh, mee-kaw'; an abbreviated form of H4320;  Micah, the name of seven Israelites:—Micah, Micaiah, Michah.

H4319.definition: מִיכָהוּ Mîykâhûw, me-kaw'-hoo; a contr. for H4321;  Mikehu, an Israelite prophet:—Micaiah (2 Chronicles 18:8).

H432.definition: אִלּוּ ʼillûw, il-loo'; probably from H408;  nay, i.e. (softened) if:—but if, yea though.

H4320.definition: מִיכָיָה Mîykâyâh, me-kaw-yaw'; from H4310 and (the prefix derivative from) H3588 and H3050; who (is) like Jah?;  Micajah, the name of two Israelites:—Micah, Michaiah. Compare H4318.

H4321.definition: מִיכָיְהוּ Mîykâyᵉhûw, me-kaw-yeh-hoo'; or מִכָיְהוּ Mikâyᵉhûw; (Jeremiah 36:11), abbreviated form for H4322;  Mikajah, the name of three Israelites:—Micah, Micaiah, Michaiah.

H4324.definition: מִיכָל Mîykâl, me-kawl'; apparently the same as H4323; revulet;  Mikal, Saul's daughter:—Michal.

H4325.definition: מַיִם mayim, mah'-yim; dual of a primitive noun (but used in a singular sense);  water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen:—  piss, wasting, water(-ing, (-course, -flood, -spring)).

H4326.definition: מִיָּמִן Mîyâmin, me-yaw-meem'; a form for H4509;  Mijamin, the name of three Israelites:—Miamin, Mijamin.

H4329.definition: מֵיסָךְ mêyçâk, may-sawk'; from H5526;  a portico (as covered):—covert.

H433.definition: אֱלוֹהַּ ʼĕlôwahh, el-o'-ah; rarely (shortened) אֱלֹהַּ ʼĕlôahh; probably prolonged (emphatic) from H410;  a deity or the Deity:—God, god. See H430.

H4331.definition: מֵישָׁא Mêyshâʼ, may-shaw'; from H4185; departure;  Mesha, a place in Arabia; also an Israelite:—Mesha.

H4332.definition: מִישָׁאֵל Mîyshâʼêl, mee-shaw-ale'; from H4310 and H410 with the abbreviated form insep. relatively (see H834) interposed; who (is) what God (is) ?;  Mishael, the name of three Israelites:—Mishael.

H4333.definition: מִישָׁאֵל Mîyshâʼêl, mee-shaw-ale'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4332;  Mishael, an Israelite:—Mishael.

H4334.definition: מִישׁוֹר mîyshôwr, mee-shore'; or מִישֹׁר mîyshôr; from H3474;  a level, i.e. a plain (often used (with the article prefix) as a proper name of certain districts); figuratively, concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) justice (sometimes adverbially, justly):—equity, even place, plain, right(-eously), (made) straight, uprightness.

H4335.definition: מֵישַׁךְ Mêyshak, may-shak'; borrowed from H4336;  Meshak, an Israelite:—Meshak.

H4336.definition: מֵישַׁךְ Mêyshak, may-shak'; (Aramaic) of foreign origin and doubtful significance; name of H4333  Meshak, the Babylonian:—Meshak.

H4339.definition: מֵישָׁר mêyshâr, may-shawr'; from H3474;  evenness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity or concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) rectitude (only in plural with singular sense; often adverbially):—agreement, aright, that are equal, equity, (things that are) right(-eously, things), sweetly, upright(-ly, -ness).

H434.definition: אֱלוּל ʼĕlûwl, el-ool'; for H457;  good for nothing:—thing of nought.

H4341.definition: מַכְאֹב makʼôb, mak-obe'; sometimes מַכְאוֹב makʼôwb; also (feminine Isaiah 53:3) מַכְאֹבָה makʼôbâh; from H3510;  anguish or (figuratively) affliction:—grief, pain, sorrow.

H4344.definition: מַכְבַּנַּי Makbannay, mak-ban-nah'-ee; patrial from H4343;  a Macbannite or native of Macbena:—Machbanai.

H4346.definition: מַכְבָּר makbâr, mak-bawr'; from H3527 in the sense of covering; (compare H4345)  a cloth (as netted):—thick cloth.

H4347.definition: מַכָּה makkâh, mak-kaw'; or (masculine) מַכֶּה makkeh; (plural only) from H5221;  a blow (in 2 Chronicles 2:10, of the flail); by implication, a wound; figuratively, carnage, also pestilence:—beaten, blow, plague, slaughter, smote, × sore, stripe, stroke, wound(-ed).

H4349.definition: מָכוֹן mâkôwn, maw-kone'; from H3559;  properly, a fixture, i.e. a basis; generally a place, especially as an abode:—foundation, habitation, (dwelling-, settled) place.

H4350.definition: מְכוֹנָה mᵉkôwnâh, mek-o-naw'; or מְכֹנָה mᵉkônâh; feminine of H4349;  a pedestal, also a spot:—base.

H4353.definition: מָכִיר Mâkîyr, maw-keer'; from H4376; salesman;  Makir, an Israelite:—Machir.

H4355.definition: מָכַךְ mâkak, maw-kak'; a primitive root;  to tumble (in ruins); figuratively, to perish:—be brought low, decay.

H4362.definition: מִכְמַן mikman, mik-man'; from the same as H3646 in the sense of hiding;  treasure (as hidden):—treasure.

H4363.definition: מִכְמָס Mikmâç, mik-maws'; (Ezra 2:2 or מִכְמָשׁ Mikmâsh; or מִכְמַשׁ Mikmash; (Nehemiah 11:31), from H3647; hidden;  Mikmas or Mikmash, a place in Palestine:—Mikmas, Mikmash.

H4365.definition: מִכְמֶרֶת mikmereth, mik-meh'-reth; or מִכְמֹרֶת mikmôreth; feminine of H4364;  a (fisher's) net:—drag, net.

H4367.definition: מַכְנַדְבַי Maknadbay, mak-nad-bah'-ee; from H4100 and H5068 with a particle interposed; what (is) like (a) liberal (man) ?;  Maknadbai, an Israelite:—Machnadebai.

H437.definition: אַלּוֹן ʼallôwn, al-lone'; a variation of H436:—oak.

H4370.definition: מִכְנָס miknâç, mik-nawce'; from H3647 in the sense of hiding;  (only in dual) drawers (from concealing the private parts):—breeches.

H4371.definition: מֶכֶס mekeç, meh'-kes; probably from an unused root meaning to enumerate;  an assessment (as based upon a census):—tribute.

H4374.definition: מְכַסֶּה mᵉkaççeh, mek-as-seh'; from H3680;  a covering, i.e. garment; specifically, a coverlet (for a bed), an awning (from the sun); also the omentum (as covering the intestines):—clothing, to cover, that which covereth.

H4376.definition: מָכַר mâkar, maw-kar'; a primitive root;  to sell, literally (as merchandise, a daughter in marriage, into slavery), or figuratively (to surrender):—× at all, sell (away, -er, self).

H4379.definition: מִכְרֶה mikreh, mik-reh'; from H3738;  a pit (for salt):—(salt-) pit.

H4383.definition: מִכְשׁוֹל mikshôwl, mik-shole'; or מִכְשֹׁל mikshôl; masculine from H3782;  a stumbling-block, literally or figuratively (obstacle, enticement (specifically an idol), scruple):—caused to fall, offence, × (no-) thing offered, ruin, stumbling-block.

H4384.definition: מַכְשֵׁלָה makshêlâh, mak-shay-law'; feminine from H3782;  a stumbling-block, but only figuratively (fall, enticement [idol]):—ruin, stumbling-block.

H4385.definition: מִכְתָּב miktâb, mik-tawb'; from H3789;  a thing written, the characters, or a document (letter, copy, edict, poem):—writing.

H439.definition: אַלּוֹן בָּכוּת ʼAllôwn Bâkûwth, al-lone' baw-kooth'; from H437 and a variation of H1068; oak of weeping;  Allon-Bakuth, a monumental tree:—Allon-bachuth.

H4390.definition: מָלֵא mâlêʼ, maw-lay'; or מָלָא mâlâʼ; (Esther 7:5), a primitive root;  to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively):—accomplish, confirm,   consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (be, become, × draw, give in, go) full(-ly, -ly set, tale), (over-) flow, fulness, furnish, gather (selves, together), presume, replenish, satisfy, set, space, take a (hand-) full,   have wholly.

H4392.definition: מָלֵא mâlêʼ, maw-lay'; from H4390;  full (literally or figuratively) or filling (literally); also (concretely) fulness; adverbially, fully:—× she that was with child, fill(-ed, -ed with), full(-ly), multitude, as is worth.

H4393.definition: מְלֹא mᵉlôʼ, mel-o'; rarely מְלוֹא mᵉlôwʼ; or מְלוֹ mᵉlôw; (Ezekiel 41:8), from H4390;  fulness (literally or figuratively):—× all along, × all that is (there-) in, fill, (× that whereof...was) full, fulness, (hand-) full, multitude.

H4396.definition: מִלֻּאָה milluʼâh, mil-loo-aw'; feminine of H4394;  a filling, i.e. setting (of gems):—enclosing, setting.

H4397.definition: מֲלְאָךְ mălʼâk, mal-awk'; from an unused root meaning to despatch as a deputy;  a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher):—ambassador, angel, king, messenger.

H4399.definition: מְלָאכָה mᵉlâʼkâh, mel-aw-kaw'; from the same as H4397;  properly, deputyship, i.e. ministry; generally, employment (never servile) or work (abstractly or concretely); also property (as the result of labor):—business,   cattle,   industrious, occupation, (  -pied),   officer, thing (made), use, (manner of) work((-man), -manship).

H44.definition: אֲבִיעֶזֶר ʼĂbîyʻezer, ab-ee-ay'-zer; from H1 and H5829; father of help (i.e. helpful);  Abiezer, the name of two Israelites:—Abiezer.

H4400.definition: מַלְאֲכוּת malʼăkûwth, mal-ak-ooth'; from the same as H4397;  a message:—message.

H4401.definition: מַלְאָכִי Malʼâkîy, mal-aw-kee'; from the same as H4397; ministrative;  Malaki, a prophet:—Malachi.

H4405.definition: מִלָּה millâh, mil-law'; from H4448 (plural masculine as if from מִלֶּה milleh;  a word; collectively, a discourse; figuratively, a topic:—  answer, by-word, matter, any thing (what) to say, to speak(-ing), speak, talking, word.

H4406.definition: מִלָּה millâh, mil-law'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4405;  a word, command, discourse, or subject:—commandment, matter, thing. Word.

H4407.definition: מִלּוֹא millôwʼ, mil-lo'; or מִלֹּא mil-lôʼ; (2 Kings 12:20), from H4390;  a rampart (as filled in), i.e. the citadel:—Millo. See also H1037.

H4409.definition: מַלּוּךְ Mallûwk, mal-luke'; or מַלּוּכִי Mallûwkîy; (Nehemiah 12:14), from H4427; regnant;  Malluk, the name of five Israelites:—Malluch, Melichu (from the margin).

H441.definition: אַלּוּף ʼallûwph, al-loof'; or (shortened) אַלֻּף ʼalluph; from H502;  familiar; a friend, also gentle; hence, a bullock (as being tame; applied, although masculine, to a cow); and so, a chieftain (as notable, like neat cattle):—captain, duke, (chief) friend, governor, guide, ox.

H4410.definition: מְלוּכָה mᵉlûwkâh, mel-oo-kaw'; feminine passive participle of H4427;  something ruled, i.e. a realm:—kingsom, king's, × royal.

H4411.definition: מָלוֹן mâlôwn, maw-lone'; from H3885;  a lodgment, i.e. caravanserai or encampment:—inn, place where...lodge, lodging (place).

H4413.definition: מַלּוֹתִי Mallôwthîy, mal-lo'-thee; apparently from H4448; I have talked (i.e. loquacious)  Mallothi, an Israelite:—Mallothi.

H4416.definition: מְלַח mᵉlach, mel-akh'; (Aramaic) from H4415;  salt:—  maintenance, salt.

H4417.definition: מֶלַח melach, meh'-lakh; from H4414;  properly, powder, i.e. (specifically) salt (as easily pulverized and dissolved):—salt(-pit).

H4418.definition: מָלָח mâlâch, maw-lawkh'; from H4414 in its original sense;  a rag or old garment:—rotten rag.

H4420.definition: מְלֵחָה mᵉlêchâh, mel-ay-khaw'; from H4414 (in its denominative sense); understood as land (H776)  properly, salted (i.e. land), i.e. a desert:—barren land(-ness), salt (land).

H4421.definition: מִלְחָמָה milchâmâh, mil-khaw-maw'; from H3898 (in the sense of fighting);  a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. war-fare):—battle, fight(-ing), war(-rior).

H4422.definition: מָלַט mâlaṭ, maw-lat'; a primitive root;  properly, to be smooth, i.e. (by implication) to escape (as if by slipperiness); causatively, to release or rescue; specifically, to bring forth young, emit sparks:—deliver (self), escape, lay, leap out, let alone, let go, preserve, save, × speedily, × surely.

H4424.definition: מְלַטְיָה Mᵉlaṭyâh, mel-at-yaw'; from H4423 and H3050; (whom) Jah has delivered;  Melatjah, a Gibeonite:—Melatiah.

H4427.definition: מָלַךְ mâlak, maw-lak'; a primitive root;  to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel:—consult, × indeed, be (make, set a, set up) king, be (make) queen, (begin to, make to) reign(-ing), rule, × surely.

H4428.definition: מֶלֶךְ melek, meh'-lek; from H4427;  a king:—king, royal.

H4429.definition: מֶלֶךְ Melek, meh'-lek; the same as H4428; king;  Melek, the name of two Israelites:—Melech, Hammelech (by including the article).

H443.definition: אֶלְזָבָד ʼElzâbâd, el-zaw-bawd'; from H410 and H2064; God has bestowed;  Elzabad, the name of two Israelites:—Elzabad.

H4430.definition: מֶלֶךְ melek, meh'-lek; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4428;  a king:—king, royal.

H4432.definition: מֹלֶךְ Môlek, mo'-lek; from H4427;  Molek (i.e. king), the chief deity of the Ammonites:—Molech. Compare H4445.

H4435.definition: מִלְכָּה Milkâh, mil-kaw'; a form of H4436; queen;  Milcah, the name of a Hebrewess and of an Israelite:—Milcah.

H4436.definition: מַלְכָּה malkâh, mal-kaw'; feminine of H4428;  a queen:—queen.

H4437.definition: מַלְכוּ malkûw, mal-koo'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4438;  dominion (abstractly or concretely):—kingdom, kingly, realm, reign.

H4438.definition: מַלְכוּת malkûwth, mal-kooth'; or מַלְכֻת malkuth; or (in plural) מַלְכֻיָּה malkuyâh; from H4427;  a rule; concretely, a dominion:—empire, kingdom, realm, reign, royal.

H444.definition: אָלַח ʼâlach, aw-lakh'; a primitive root;  to muddle, i.e. (figuratively and intransitive) to turn (morally) corrupt:—become filthy.

H4441.definition: מַלְכִּיָּה Malkîyâh, mal-kee-yaw'; or מַלְכִּיָּהוּ Malkîyâhûwlemma מַלְכִּיָהוּ missing dagesh, corrected to מַלְכִּיָּהוּ; (Jeremiah 38:6), from H4428 and H3050; king of (i.e. appointed by) Jah;  Malkijah, the name of ten Israelites:—Malchiah, Malchijah.

H4444.definition: מַלְכִּישׁוּעַ Malkîyshûwaʻ, mal-kee-shoo'-ah; from H4428 and H7769; king of wealth;  Malkishua, an Israelite:—Malchishua.

H4445.definition: מַלְכָּם Malkâm, mal-kawm'; or מִלְכּוֹם Milkôwm; from H4428 for H4432;  Malcam or Milcom, the national idol of the Ammonites:—Malcham, Milcom.

H4447.definition: מֹלֶכֶת Môleketh, mo-leh'-keth; feminine active participle of H4427; queen;  Moleketh, an Israelitess:—Hammoleketh (including the article).

H4448.definition: מָלַל mâlal, maw-lal'; a primitive root;  to speak (mostly poetical) or say:—say, speak, utter.

H4449.definition: מְלַל mᵉlal, mel-al'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4448;  to speak:—say, speak(-ing).

H445.definition: אֶלְחָנָן ʼElchânân, el-khaw-nawn'; from H410 and H2603; God (is) gracious;  Elchanan, an Israelite:—Elkanan.

H4450.definition: מִלֲלַי Milălay, mee-lal-ah'-ee; from H4448; talkative;  Milalai, an Israelite:—Milalai.

H4452.definition: מָלַץ mâlats, maw-lats'; a primitive root;  to be smooth, i.e. (figuratively) pleasant:—be sweet.

H4454.definition: מָלַק mâlaq, maw-lak'; a primitive root;  to crack a joint; by implication, to wring the neck of a fowl (without separating it):—wring off.

H4456.definition: מַלְקוֹשׁ malqôwsh, mal-koshe'; from H3953; (compare H3954)  the spring rain; figuratively, eloquence:—latter rain.

H446.definition: אֱלִיאָב ʼĔlîyʼâb, el-ee-awb'; from H410 and H1; God of (his) father;  Eliab, the name of six Israelites:—Eliab.

H4462.definition: מְמוּכָן Mᵉmûwkân, mem-oo-kawn'; or (transp.) מוֹמֻכָן Môwmukân; (Esther 1:16), of Persian derivation;  Memucan or Momucan, a Persian satrap:—Memucan.

H4464.definition: מַמְזֵר mamzêr, mam-zare'; from an unused root meaning to alienate;  a mongrel, i.e. born of a Jewish father and a heathen mother:—bastard.

H4465.definition: מִמְכָּר mimkâr, mim-kawr'; from H4376;  merchandise; abstractly, a selling:—× ought, (that which cometh of) sale, that which...sold, ware.

H4466.definition: מִמְכֶּרֶת mimkereth, mim-keh'-reth; feminine of H4465;  a sale:—  sold as.

H4467.definition: מַמְלָכָה mamlâkâh, mam-law-kaw'; from H4427;  dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm):—kingdom, king's, reign, royal.

H4469.definition: מַמְסָךְ mamçâk, mam-sawk'; from H4537;  mixture, i.e. (specifically) wine mixed (with water or spices):—drink-offering, mixed wine.

H447.definition: אֱלִיאֵל ʼĔlîyʼêl, el-ee-ale'; from H410 repeated; God of (his) God;  Eliel, the name of nine Israelites:—Eliel.

H4471.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H4471.definition: מַמְרֵא Mamrêʼ, mam-ray'; from H4754(in the sense of vigor); lusty;  Mamre, an Amorite:—Mamre.

H4474.definition: מִמְשָׁל mimshâl, mim-shawl'; from H4910;  a ruler or (abstractly) rule:—dominion, that ruled.

H4475.definition: מֶמְשָׁלָה memshâlâh, mem-shaw-law'; feminine of H4474;  rule; also (concretely in plural) a realm or a ruler:—dominion, government, power, to rule.

H4476.definition: מִמְשָׁק mimshâq, mim-shawk'; from the same as H4943;  a possession:—breeding.

H4478.definition: מָן mân, mawn; from H4100;  literally a whatness (so to speak), i.e. manna (so called from the question about it):—manna.

H4479.definition: מָן mân, mawn; (Aramaic) from H4101;  who or what (properly, interrogatively, hence, also indefinitely and relatively):—what, who(-msoever,   -so).

H448.definition: אֱלִיאָתָה ʼĔlîyʼâthâh, el-ee-aw-thaw'; or (contraction) אֱלִיָּתָה ʼĔlîyâthâh; from H410 and H225; God of (his) consent;  Eliathah, an Israelite:—Eliathah.

H4480.definition: מִן min, min; or מִנִּי minnîy; or מִנֵּי minnêy; (constructive plural) (Isaiah 30:11); for H4482;  properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses:—above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, × neither, × nor, (out) of, over, since, × then, through, × whether, with.

H4481.definition: מִן min, min; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4480:—according, after,   because,   before, by, for, from, × him, × more than, (out) of, part, since, × these, to, upon,   when.

H4482.definition: מֵן mên, mane; from an unused root meaning to apportion;  a part; hence, a musical chord (as parted into strings):—in [the same] (Psalm 68:23), stringed instrument (Psalm 150:4), whereby (Psalm 45:8 [defective plural]).

H4483.definition: מְנָא mᵉnâʼ, men-aw'; (Aramaic) or מְנָה mᵉnâh; (Aramaic), corresponding to H4487;  to count, appoint:—number, ordain, set.

H4486.definition: מַנְדַּע mandaʻ, man-dah'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4093;  wisdom or intelligence:—knowledge, reason, understanding.

H4487.definition: מָנָה mânâh, maw-naw'; a primitive root;  properly, to weigh out; by implication, to allot or constitute officially; also to enumerate or enroll:—appoint, count, number, prepare, set, tell.

H4488.definition: מָנֶה mâneh, maw-neh'; from H4487;  properly, a fixed weight or measured amount, i.e. (technically) a maneh or mina:—maneh, pound.

H4489.definition: מֹנֶה môneh, mo-neh'; from H4487;  properly, something weighed out, i.e. (figuratively) a portion of time, i.e. an instance:—time.

H449.definition: אֱלִידָד ʼĔlîydâd, el-ee-dawd'; from the same as H419; God of (his) love;  Elidad, an Israelite:—Elidad.

H4490.definition: מָנָה mânâh, maw-naw'; from H4487;  properly, something weighed out, i.e. (generally) a division; specifically (of food) a ration; also a lot:—such things as belonged, part, portion.

H4494.definition: מָנוֹחַ mânôwach, maw-no'-akh; from H5117;  quiet, i.e. (concretely) a settled spot, or (figuratively) a home:—(place of) rest.

H4495.definition: מָנוֹחַ Mânôwach, maw-no'-akh; the same as H4494; rest;  Manoach, an Israelite:—Manoah.

H4496.definition: מְנוּחָה mᵉnûwchâh, men-oo-khaw'; or מְנֻחָה mᵉnuchâh; feminine of H4495;  repose or (adverbially) peacefully; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony); hence (concretely) an abode:—comfortable, ease, quiet, rest(-ing place), still.

H4498.definition: מָנוֹס mânôwç, maw-noce'; from H5127;  a retreat (literally or figuratively); abstractly, a fleeing:—× apace, escape, way to flee, flight, refuge.

H45.definition: אֲבִי־עַלְבוֹן ʼĂbîy-ʻalbôwn, ab-ee-al-bone'; from H1 and an unused root of uncertain derivation; probably, father of strength (i.e. valiant);  Abialbon, an Israelite:—Abialbon.

H450.definition: אֶלְיָדָע ʼElyâdâʻ, el-yaw-daw'; from H410 and H3045; God (is) knowing;  Eljada, the name of two Israelites and of an Aramaean leader:—Eliada.

H4500.definition: מָנוֹר mânôwr, maw-nore'; from H5214;  a yoke (properly, for plowing), i.e. the frame of a loom:—beam.

H4501.definition: מְנוֹרָה mᵉnôwrâh, men-o-raw'; or מְנֹרָה mᵉnôrâh; feminine of H4500 (in the original sense of H5216);  a chandelier:—candlestick.

H4503.definition: מִנְחָה minchâh, min-khaw'; from an unused root meaning to apportion, i.e. bestow;  a donation; euphemistically, tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary):—gift, oblation, (meat) offering, present, sacrifice.

H4505.definition: מְנַחֵם Mᵉnachêm, men-akh-ame'; from H5162; comforter;  Menachem, an Israelite:—Menahem.

H4506.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H4506.definition: מָנַחַת Mânachath, maw-nakh'-ath; from H5117; rest;  Manachath, the name of an Edomite and of a place in Moab:—Manahath.

H4508.definition: מִנִּי Minnîy, min-nee'; of foreign derivation;  Minni, an Armenian province:—Minni.

H4509.definition: מִנְיָמִין Minyâmîyn, min-yaw-meen'; from H4480 and H3225; from (the) right hand;  Minjamin, the name of two Israelites:—Miniamin. Compare H4326.

H451.definition: אַלְיָה ʼalyâh, al-yaw'; from H422 (in the original sense of strength);  the stout part, i.e. the fat tail of the Oriental sheep:—rump.

H4513.definition: מָנַע mânaʻ, maw-nah'; a primitive root;  to debar (negatively or positively) from benefit or injury:—deny, keep (back), refrain, restrain, withhold.

H4517.definition: מְנַעְנַע mᵉnaʻnaʻ, men-ah-ah'; from H5128;  a sistrum (so called from its rattling sound):—cornet.

H4518.definition: מְנַקִּית mᵉnaqqîyth, men-ak-keeth'; from H5352;  a sacrificial basin (for holding blood):—bowl.

H4519.definition: מְנַשֶּׁה Mᵉnashsheh, men-ash-sheh'; from H5382; causing to forget;  Menashsheh, a grandson of Jacob, also the tribe descended from him, and its territory:—Manasseh.

H452.definition: אֵלִיָּה ʼÊlîyâh, ay-lee-yaw'; or prolonged אֵלִיָּהוּ ʼÊlîyâhûw; from H410 and H3050; God of Jehovah;  Elijah, the name of the famous prophet and of two other Israelites:—Elijah, Eliah.

H4522.definition: מַס maç, mas; or מִס miç; from H4549;  properly, a burden (as causing to faint), i.e. a tax in the form of forced labor:—discomfited, levy, task(-master), tribute(-tary).

H4529.definition: מָסָה mâçâh, maw-saw'; a primitive root;  to dissolve:—make to consume away, (make to) melt, water.

H453.definition: אֱלִיהוּ ʼĔlîyhûw, el-ee-hoo'; or (fully) אֱלִיהוּא ʼĔlîyhûwʼ; from H410 and H1931; God of him;  Elihu, the name of one of Job's friends, and of three Israelites:—Elihu.

H4531.definition: מַסָּה maççâh, mas-saw'; from H5254;  a testing, of men (judicial) or of God (querulous):—temptation, trial.

H4532.definition: מַסָּה Maççâh, mas-saw'; the same as H4531;  Massah, a place in the Desert:—Massah.

H4538.definition: מֶסֶךְ meçek, meh'-sek; from H4537;  a mixture, i.e. of wine with spices:—mixture.

H454.definition: אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַי ʼElyᵉhôwʻêynay, el-ye-ho-ay-nah'ee; or (shortened) אֶלְיוֹעֵינַי ʼElyôwʻêynay; from H413 and H3068 and H5869; towards Jehovah (are) my eyes;  Eljehoenai or Eljoenai, the name of seven Israelites:—Elihoenai, Elionai.

H4541.definition: מַסֵּכָה maççêkâh, mas-say-kaw'; from H5258;  properly, a pouring over, i.e. fusion of metal (especially a cast image); by implication, a libation, i.e. league; concretely a coverlet (as if poured out):—covering, molten (image), vail.

H4543.definition: מִסְכְּנָה miçkᵉnâh, mis-ken-aw'; by transp. from H3664;  a magazine:—store(-house), treasure.

H4544.definition: מִסְכֵּנֻת miçkênuth, mis-kay-nooth'; from H4542;  indigence:—scarceness.

H4548.definition: מַסְמֵר maçmêr, mas-mare'; or מִסְמֵר miçmêr; also (feminine) מַסְמְרָה maçmᵉrâh; or מִסְמְרָה miçmᵉrâh; or even מַשְׂמְרָה masmᵉrâh; (Ecclesiastes 12:11), from H5568;  a peg (as bristling from the surface):—nail.

H4549.definition: מָסַס mâçaç, maw-sas'; a primitive root;  to liquefy; figuratively, to waste (with disease), to faint (with fatigue, fear or grief):—discourage, faint, be loosed, melt (away), refuse, × utterly.

H455.definition: אֶלְיַחְבָּא ʼElyachbâʼ, el-yakh-baw'; from H410 and H2244; God will hide;  Eljachba, an Israelite:—Eliahbah.

H4552.definition: מִסְעָד miçʻâd, mis-awd'; ' from H5582;  a balustrade (for stairs):—pillar.

H4553.definition: מִסְפֵּד miçpêd, mis-pade'; from H5594;  a lamentation:—lamentation, one mourneth, mourning, wailing.

H4554.definition: מִסְפּוֹא miçpôwʼ, mis-po'; from an unused root meaning to collect;  fodder:—provender.

H4555.definition: מִסְפָּחָה miçpâchâh, mis-paw-khaw'; from H5596;  a veil (as spread out):—kerchief.

H4557.definition: מִסְפָּר miçpâr, mis-pawr'; from H5608;  a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration:—  abundance, account, × all, × few, (in-) finite, (certain) number(-ed), tale, telling,   time.

H4558.definition: מִסְפָּר Miçpâr, mis-pawr'; the same as H4457; number;  Mispar, an Israelite:—Mizpar. Compare H4559.

H4559.definition: מִסְפֶּרֶת Miçpereth, mis-peh'-reth; feminine of H4437; enumeration;  Mispereth, an Israelite:—Mispereth. Compare H4458.

H456.definition: אֱלִיחֹרֶף ʼĔlîychôreph, el-ee-kho'-ref; from H410 and H2779; God of autumn;  Elichoreph, an Israelite:—Elihoreph.

H4565.definition: מִסְתָּר miçtâr, mis-tawr'; from H5641;  properly, a concealer, i.e. a covert:—secret(-ly, place).

H457.definition: אֱלִיל ʼĕlîyl, el-eel'; apparently from H408;  good for nothing, by analogy vain or vanity; specifically an idol:—idol, no value, thing of nought.

H4570.definition: מַעְגָּל maʻgâl, mah-gawl'; or feminine מַעְגָּלָה maʻgâlâh; from the same as H5696;  a track (literally or figuratively); also a rampart (as circular):—going, path, trench, way(-side).

H4571.definition: מָעַד mâʻad, maw-ad'; a primitive root;  to waver:—make to shake, slide, slip.

H4572.definition: מַעֲדַי Maʻăday, mah-ad-ah'-ee; from H5710; ornamental;  Maadai, an Israelite:—Maadai.

H4573.definition: מַעֲדְיָה Maʻădyâh, mah-ad-yaw'; from H5710 and H3050; ornament of Jah;  Maadjah, an Israelite:—Maadiah. Compare H4153.

H4574.definition: מַעֲדָן maʻădân, mah-ad-awn'; or (feminine) מַעֲדַנָּה maʻădannâh; from H5727;  a delicacy or (abstractly) pleasure (adverbially, cheerfully):—dainty, delicately, delight.

H4578.definition: מֵעֶה mêʻeh, may-aw'; from an unused root probably meaning to be soft;  used only in plural the intestines, or (collectively) the abdomen, figuratively, sympathy; by implication, a vest; by extension the stomach, the uterus (or of men, the seat of generation), the heart (figuratively):—belly, bowels, × heart, womb.

H458.definition: אֱלִימֶלֶךְ ʼĔlîymelek, el-ee-meh'-lek; from H410 and H4428; God of (the) king;  Elimelek, an Israelite:—Elimelech.

H4581.definition: מָעוֹז mâʻôwz, maw-oze'; (also מָעוּז mâʻûwz ); or מָעֹז mâʻôz (also מָעֻז mâʻuz; from H5810;  a fortified place; figuratively, a defence:—force, fort(-ress), rock, strength(-en), (× most) strong (hold).

H4583.definition: מָעוֹן mâʻôwn, maw-ohn'; or מָעִין mâʻîyn; (1 Chronicles 4:41), from the same as H5772;  an abode, of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence, a retreat (asylum):—den, dwelling((-) place), habitation.

H4584.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H4584.definition: מָעוֹן Mâʻôwn, maw-ohn'; the same as H4583; a residence;  Maon, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:—Maon, Maonites. Compare H1010, H4586.

H4585.definition: מְעוֹנָה mᵉʻôwnâh, meh-o-naw'; or מְעֹנָה mᵉʻônâh; feminine of H4583, and meaning the same:—den, habitation, (dwelling) place, refuge.

H4587.definition: מְעוֹנֹתַי Mᵉʻôwnôthay, meh-o-no-thah'-ee; plural of H4585; habitative;  Meonothai, an Israelite:—Meonothai.

H459.definition: אִלֵּין ʼillêyn, il-lane'; (Aramaic) or shorter אִלֵּן ʼillên; prolonged from H412;  these:—the, these.

H4590.definition: מַעַזְיָה Maʻazyâh, mah-az-yaw'; or מַעַזְיָהוּ Maʻazyâhûw; probably from H5756 (in the sense of protection) and H3050; rescue of Jah;  Maazjah, the name of two Israelites:—Maaziah.

H4591.definition: מָעַט mâʻaṭ, maw-at'; a primitive root;  properly, to pare off, i.e. lessen; intransitively, to be (or causatively, to make) small or few (or figuratively, ineffective):—suffer to decrease, diminish, (be, × borrow a, give, make) few (in number, -ness), gather least (little), be (seem) little, (× give the) less, be minished, bring to nothing.

H4592.definition: מְעַט mᵉʻaṭ, meh-at'; or מְעָט mᵉʻâṭ; from H4591;  a little or few (often adverbial or comparative):—almost (some, very) few(-er, -est), lightly, little (while), (very) small (matter, thing), some, soon, × very.

H4596.definition: מְעִי mᵉʻîy, meh-ee'; from H5753; (compare H5856)  a pile of rubbish (as contorted), i.e. a ruin:—heap.

H4597.definition: מָעַי Mâʻay, maw-ah'-ee; probably from H4578; sympathetic;  Maai, an Israelite:—Maai.

H4598.definition: מְעִיל mᵉʻîyl, meh-eel'; from H4603 in the sense of covering;  a robe (i.e. upper and outer garment):—cloke, coat, mantle, robe.

H4599.definition: מַעְיָן maʻyân, mah-yawn'; or מַעְיְנוֹ maʻyᵉnôw; (Psalm 114:8), or (feminine) מַעְיָנָה maʻyânâh; from H5869 (as a denominative in the sense of a spring);  a fountain (also collectively), figuratively, a source (of satisfaction):—fountain, spring, well.

H46.definition: אָבִיר ʼâbîyr, aw-beer'; from H82;  mighty (spoken of God):—mighty (one).

H460.definition: אֶלְיָסָף ʼElyâçâph, el-yaw-sawf'; from H410 and H3254; God (is) gatherer;  Eljasaph, the name of two Israelites:—Eliasaph.

H4600.definition: מָעַךְ mâʻak, maw-ak'; a primitive root;  to press, i.e. to pierce, emasculate, handle:—bruised, stuck, be pressed.

H4601.partOfSpeech: proper noun, proper feminine noun, proper masculine noun
H4601.definition: מַעֲכָה Maʻăkâh, mah-ak-aw'; or מַעֲכָת Maʻăkâth; (Joshua 13:13), from H4600; depression;  Maakah (or Maakath), the name of a place in Syria, also of a Mesopotamian, of three Israelites, and of four Israelitesses and one Syrian woman:—Maachah, Maachathites. See also H1038.

H4603.definition: מָעַל mâʻal, maw-al'; a primitive root;  properly, to cover up; used only figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. treacherously:—transgress, (commit, do a) trespass(-ing).

H4604.definition: מַעַל maʻal, mah'-al; from H4603;  treachery, i.e. sin:—falsehood, grievously, sore, transgression, trespass, × very.

H4605.definition: מַעַל maʻal, mah'al; from H5927;  properly,the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.:—above, exceeding(-ly), forward, on (× very) high, over, up(-on, -ward), very.

H4609.definition: מַעֲלָה maʻălâh, mah-al-aw'; feminine of H4608;  elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grade-mark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms):—things that come up, (high) degree, deal, go up, stair, step, story.

H461.definition: אֱלִיעֶזֶר ʼĔlîyʻezer, el-ee-eh'-zer; from H410 and H5828; God of help;  Eliezer, the name of a Damascene and of ten Israelites:—Eliezer.

H4611.definition: מַעֲלָל maʻălâl, mah-al-awl'; from H5953;  an act (good or bad):—doing, endeavour, invention, work.

H4613.definition: מׇעֳמָד moʻŏmâd, moh-om-awd'; from H5975;  literally a foothold:—standing.

H4616.definition: מַעַן maʻan, mah'-an; from H6030;  properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that:—because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to, ... 's sake), + lest, that, to.

H4617.definition: מַעֲנֶה maʻăneh, mah-an-eh'; from H6030;  a reply (favorable or contradictory):—answer, × himself.

H4618.definition: מַעֲנָה maʻănâh, mah-an-aw'; from H6031, in the sense of depression or tilling;  a furrow:—  acre, furrow.

H462.definition: אֱלִיעֵינַי ʼĔlîyʻêynay, el-ee-ay-nah'ee; probably contracted for H454;  Elienai, an Israelite:—Elienai.

H4621.definition: מַעֲצָד maʻătsâd, mah-ats-awd'; from an unused root meaning to hew;  an axe:—ax, tongs.

H4625.definition: מַעֲקָשׁ maʻăqâsh, mah-ak-awsh'; from H6140;  a crook (in a road):—crooked thing.

H4626.definition: מַעַר maʻar, mah'-ar; from H6168;  a nude place, i.e. (literally) the pudenda, or (figuratively) a vacant space:—nakedness, proportion.

H4628.definition: מַעֲרָב maʻărâb, mah-ar-awb'; or (feminine) מַעֲרָבָה maʻărâbâh; from H6150, in the sense of shading;  the west (as a region of the evening sun):—west.

H463.definition: אֱלִיעָם ʼĔlîyʻâm, el-ee-awm'; from H410 and H5971; God of (the) people;  Eliam, an Israelite:—Eliam.

H4634.definition: מַעֲרָכָה maʻărâkâh, mah-ar-aw-kaw'; feminine of H4633;  an arrangement; concretely, a pile; specifically a military array:—army, fight, be set in order, ordered place, rank, row.

H4639.definition: מַעֲשֶׂה maʻăseh, mah-as-eh'; from H6213;  an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property:—act, art,   bakemeat, business, deed, do(-ing), labor, thing made, ware of making, occupation, thing offered, operation, possession, × well, (handy-, needle-, net-) work(ing, -manship), wrought.

H464.definition: אֱלִיפַז ʼĔlîyphaz, el-ee-faz'; from H410 and H6337; God of gold;  Eliphaz, the name of one of Job's friends, and of a son of Esau:—Eliphaz.

H4641.definition: מַעֲשֵׂיָה Maʻăsêyâh, mah-as-ay-yaw'; or מַעֲשֵׂיָהוּ Maʻăsêyâhûw; from H4639 and H3050; work of Jah;  Maasejah, the name of sixteen Israelites:—Maaseiah.

H4643.definition: מַעֲשֵׂר maʻăsêr, mah-as-ayr'; or מַעֲשַׂר maʻăsar; and (in plural) feminine מַעַשְׂרָה maʻasrâh; from H6240;  a tenth; especially a tithe:—tenth (part), tithe(-ing).

H4644.definition: מֹף Môph, mofe; of Egyptian origin;  Moph, the capital of Lower Egypt:—Memphis. Compare H5297.

H4648.definition: מְפִיבֹשֶׁת Mᵉphîybôsheth, mef-ee-bo'-sheth; or מְפִבֹשֶׁת Mᵉphibôsheth; probably from H6284 and H1322; dispeller of shame (i.e. of Baal);  Mephibosheth, the name of two Israelites:—Mephibosheth.

H4649.definition: מֻפִּים Muppîym, moop-peem'; a plural apparently from H5130; wavings;  Muppim, an Israelite:—Muppim. Compare H8206.

H465.definition: אֱלִיפָל ʼĔlîyphâl, el-ee-fawl'; from H410 and H6419; God of judgment;  Eliphal, an Israelite:—Eliphal.

H4656.definition: מִפְלֶצֶת miphletseth, mif-leh'-tseth; from H6426;  a terror, i.e. an idol:—idol.

H466.definition: אֱלִיפְלֵהוּ ʼĔlîyphᵉlêhûw, el-ee-fe-lay'-hoo; from H410 and H6395; God of his distinction;  Eliphelehu, an Israelite:—Elipheleh.

H4662.definition: מִפְקָד miphqâd, mif-kawd'; from H6485;  an appointment, i.e. mandate; concretely, a designated spot; specifically, a census:—appointed place, commandment, number.

H467.definition: אֱלִיפֶלֶט ʼĔlîypheleṭ, el-ee-feh'-let; or (shortened) אֱלְפֶּלֶט ʼĔlpeleṭ; from H410 and H6405; God of deliverance;  Eliphelet or Elpelet, the name of six Israelites:—Eliphalet, Eliphelet, Elpalet.

H4672.definition: מָצָא mâtsâʼ, maw-tsaw'; a primitive root;  properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present:—  be able, befall, being, catch, × certainly, (cause to) come (on, to, to hand), deliver, be enough (cause to) find(-ing, occasion, out), get (hold upon), × have (here), be here, hit, be left, light (up-) on, meet (with), × occasion serve, (be) present, ready, speed, suffice, take hold on.

H4673.definition: מַצָּב matstsâb, mats-tsawb'; from H5324;  a fixed spot; figuratively, an office, a military post:—garrison, station, place where...stood.

H4674.definition: מֻצָּב mutstsâb, moots-tsawb'; from H5324;  a station, i.e. military post:—mount.

H4676.definition: מַצֵּבָה matstsêbâh, mats-tsay-baw'; feminine (causatively) participle of H5324;  something stationed, i.e. a column or (memorial stone); by analogy, an idol:—garrison, (standing) image, pillar.

H468.definition: אֱלִיצוּר ʼĔlîytsûwr, el-ee-tsoor'; from H410 and H6697; God of (the) rock;  Elitsur, an Israelite:—Elizur.

H4682.definition: מַצָּה matstsâh, mats-tsaw'; from H4711 in the sense of greedily devouring for sweetness;  properly, sweetness; concretely, sweet (i.e. not soured or bittered with yeast); specifically, an unfermented cake or loaf, or (elliptically) the festival of Passover (because no leaven was then used):—unleaved (bread, cake), without leaven.

H4683.definition: מַצָּה matstsâh, mats-tsaw'; from H5327;  a quarrel:—contention, debate, strife.

H4685.definition: מָצוֹד mâtsôwd, maw-tsode'; or (feminine) מְצוֹדָה mᵉtsôwdâh; or מצֹדָה mtsôdâh; from H6679; also (by interchange for H4679)  a net (for capturing animals or fishes); a fastness or (beseiging) tower:—bulwark, hold, munition, net, snare.

H4687.definition: מִצְוָה mitsvâh, mits-vaw'; from H6680;  a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law):—(which was) commanded(-ment), law, ordinance, precept.

H469.definition: אֱלִיצָפָן ʼĔlîytsâphân, el-ee-tsaw-fawn'; or (shortened) אֶלְצָפָן ʼEltsâphân; from H410 and H6845; God of treasure;  Elitsaphan or Eltsaphan, an Israelite:—Elizaphan, Elzaphan.

H4690.definition: מָצוּק mâtsûwq, maw-tsook'; or מָצֻק mâtsuq; from H6693;  something narrow, i.e. a column or hilltop:—pillar, situate.

H4692.definition: מָצוֹר mâtsôwr, maw-tsore'; or מָצוּר mâtsûwr; from H6696;  something hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of besiegers), (abstractly) a siege, (figuratively) distress; or (subjectively) a fastness:—besieged, bulwark, defence, fenced, fortress, siege, strong (hold), tower.

H4694.definition: מְצוּרָה mᵉtsûwrâh, mets-oo-raw'; or מְצֻרָה mᵉtsurâh; feminine of H4692;  a hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of siege), or (subjectively) a rampart (of protection), (abstractly) fortification:—fenced (city, fort, munition, strong hold.

H4696.definition: מֵצַח mêtsach, may'-tsakh; from an unused root meaning to be clear, i.e. conspicuous;  the forehead (as open and prominent):—brow, forehead,   impudent.

H47.definition: אַבִּיר ʼabbîyr, ab-beer'; for H46:—angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout(-hearted), strong (one), valiant.

H470.definition: אֱלִיקָא ʼĔlîyqâʼ, el-ee-kaw'; from H410 and H6958; God of rejection;  Elika, an Israelite:—Elika.

H4700.definition: מְצֵלֶת mᵉtsêleth, mets-ay'-leth; from H6750;  (only dual) double tinklers, i.e. cymbals:—cymbals.

H4701.definition: מִצְנֶפֶת mitsnepheth, mits-neh'-feth; from H6801;  a tiara, i.e. official turban (of a king or high priest):—diadem, mitre.

H4703.definition: מִצְעָד mitsʻâd, mits-awd'; from H6805;  a step; figuratively, companionship:—going, step.

H4705.definition: מִצְעָר mitsʻâr, mits-awr'; from H6819;  petty (in size or number); adverbially, a short (time):—little one (while), small.

H4706.definition: מִצְעָר Mitsʻâr, mits-awr'; the same as H4705;  Mitsar, a peak of Lebanon:—Mizar.

H4708.definition: מִצְפֶּה Mitspeh, mits-peh'; the same as H4707;  Mitspeh, the name of five places in Palestine:—Mizpeh, watch tower. Compare H4709.

H4709.definition: מִצְפָּה Mitspâh, mits-paw'; feminine of H4708;  Mitspah, the name of two places in Palestine:—Mitspah. (This seems rather to be only an orthographic variation of H4708 when 'in pause'.)

H471.definition: אֶלְיָקִים ʼElyâqîym, el-yaw-keem'; from H410 and H6965; God of raising;  Eljakim, the name of four Israelites:—Eliakim.

H4710.definition: מִצְפֻּן mitspun, mits-poon'; from H6845;  a secret (place or thing, perhaps, treasure):—hidden thing.

H4714.definition: מִצְרַיִם Mitsrayim, mits-rah'-yim; dual of H4693;  Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt:—Egypt, Egyptians, Mizraim.

H4716.definition: מַק maq, mak; from H4743;  properly, a melting, i.e. putridity:—rottenness, stink.

H4717.definition: מַקָּבָה maqqâbâh, mak-kaw-baw'; from H5344;  properly, a perforatrix, i.e. a hammer (as piercing):—hammer.

H4719.definition: מַקֵּדָה Maqqêdâh, mak-kay-daw'; from the same as H5348 in the denominative sense of herding (compare H5349); fold;  Makkedah, a place in Palestine:—Makkedah.

H472.definition: אֱלִישֶׁבַע ʼĔlîyshebaʻ, el-ee-sheh'-bah; from H410 and H7651 (in the sense of H7650); God of (the) oath;  Elisheba, the wife of Aaron:—Elisheba.

H4720.definition: מִקְדָּשׁ miqdâsh, mik-dawsh'; or מִקְּדָשׁ miqqᵉdâsh; (Exodus 15:17), from H6942;  a consecrated thing or place, especially, a palace, sanctuary (whether of Jehovah or of idols) or asylum:—chapel, hallowed part, holy place, sanctuary.

H4723.definition: מִקְוֶה miqveh, mik-veh'; or מִקְוֵה miqvêh; (1 Kings 10:28), or מִקְוֵא miqvêʼlemma מִּקְוֵא extra dagesh, corrected to מִקְוֵא; (2 Chronicles 1:16), from H6960;  something waited for, i.e. confidence (objective or subjective); also a collection, i.e. (of water) a pond, or (of men and horses) a caravan or drove:—abiding, gathering together, hope, linen yarn, plenty (of water), pool.

H4725.definition: מָקוֹם mâqôwm, maw-kome'; or מָקֹם mâqôm; also (feminine) מְקוֹמָה mᵉqôwmâh; or מְקֹמָה mᵉqômâh; from H6965;  properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind):—country, × home, × open, place, room, space, × whither(-soever).

H4726.definition: מָקוֹר mâqôwr, maw-kore'; or מָקֹר mâqôr; from H6979;  properly, something dug, i.e. a (general) source (of water, even when naturally flowing; also of tears, blood (by euphemism, of the female pudenda); figuratively, of happiness, wisdom, progeny):—fountain, issue, spring, well(-spring).

H473.definition: אֱלִישָׁה ʼĔlîyshâh, el-ee-shaw'; probably of foreign derivation;  Elishah, a son of Javan:—Elishah.

H4731.definition: מַקֵּל maqqêl, mak-kale; or (feminine) מַקְּלָה maqqᵉlâh; from an unused root meaning apparently to germinate;  a shoot, i.e. stick (with leaves on, or for walking, striking, guiding, divining):—rod, (hand-)staff.

H4732.definition: מִקְלוֹת Miqlôwth, mik-lohth'; (or perhaps mik-kel-ohth') plural of (feminine) H4731; rods;  Mikloth, a place in the Desert:—Mikloth.

H4734.definition: מִקְלַעַת miqlaʻath, mik-lah'-ath; from H7049;  a sculpture (probably in bas-relief):—carved (figure), carving, graving.

H4735.definition: מִקְנֶה miqneh, mik-neh'; from H7069;  something bought, i.e. property, but only live stock; abstractly, acquisition:—cattle, flock, herd, possession, purchase, substance.

H4737.definition: מִקְנֵיָהוּ Miqnêyâhûw, mik-nay-yaw'-hoo; from H4735 and H3050; possession of Jah;  Miknejah, an Israelite:—Mikneiah.

H4738.definition: מִקְסָם miqçâm, mik-sawn'; from H7080;  an augury:—divination.

H474.definition: אֱלִישׁוּעַ ʼĔlîyshûwaʻ, el-ee-shoo'-ah; from H410 and H7769; God of supplication (or of riches);  Elishua, the son of King David:—Elishua.

H4740.definition: מַקְצוֹעַ maqtsôwaʻ, mak-tso'-ah; or מַקְצֹעַ maqtsôaʻ; or (feminine) מַקְצֹעָה maqtsôʻâh; from H7106 in the denominative sense of bending;  an angle or recess:—corner, turning.

H4743.definition: מָקַק mâqaq, maw-kak'; ' a primitive root;  to melt; figuratively, to flow, dwindle, vanish:—consume away, be corrupt, dissolve, pine away.

H4744.definition: מִקְרָא miqrâʼ, mik-raw'; from H7121;  something called out, i.e. a public meeting (the act, the persons, or the place); also a rehearsal:—assembly, calling, convocation, reading.

H4745.definition: מִקְרֶה miqreh, mik-reh'; from H7136;  something met with, i.e. an accident or fortune:—something befallen, befalleth, chance, event, hap(-peneth).

H4748.definition: מִקְשֶׁה miqsheh, mik-sheh'; from H7185 in the sense of knotting up round and hard;  something turned (rounded), i.e. a curl (of tresses):—× well (set) hair.

H4749.definition: מִקְשָׁה miqshâh, mik-shaw'; feminine of H4748;  rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering (repoussé):—beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece.

H475.definition: אֶלְיָשִׁיב ʼElyâshîyb, el-yaw-sheeb'; from H410 and H7725; God will restore;  Eljashib, the name of six Israelites:—Eliashib.

H4750.definition: מִקְשָׁה miqshâh, mik-shaw'; denominative from H7180;  literally a cucumbered field, i.e. a cucumber patch:—garden of cucumbers.

H4751.definition: מַר mar, mar; or (feminine) מָרָה mârâh; from H4843;  bitter (literally or figuratively); also (as noun) bitterness, or (adverbially) bitterly:—  angry, bitter(-ly, -ness), chafed, discontented, × great, heavy.

H4752.definition: מַר mar, mar; from H4843 in its original sense of distillation;  a drop:—drop.

H4753.definition: מֹר môr, more; or מוֹר môwr; from H4843;  myrrh (as distilling in drops, and also as bitter):—myrrh.

H4757.definition: מְרֹאדַךְ בַּלְאָדָן Mᵉrôʼdak Balʼâdân, mer-o-dak' bal-awdawn'; of foreign derivation;  Merodak-Baladan, a Babylonian king:—Merodach-baladan. Compare H4781.

H4758.definition: מַרְאֶה marʼeh, mar-eh'; from H7200;  a view (the act of seeing); also an appearance (the thing seen), whether (real) a shape (especially if handsome, comeliness; often plural the looks), or (mental) a vision:—× apparently, appearance(-reth), × as soon as beautiful(-ly), countenance, fair, favoured, form, goodly, to look (up) on (to), look(-eth), pattern, to see, seem, sight, visage, vision.

H4759.definition: מַרְאָה marʼâh, mar-aw'; feminine of H4758;  a vision; also (causatively) a mirror:—looking glass, vision.

H476.definition: אֱלִישָׁמָע ʼĔlîyshâmâʻ, el-ee-shaw-maw'; from H410 and H8085; God of hearing;  Elishama, the name of seven Israelites:—Elishama.

H4762.definition: מַרְאֵשָׁה Marʼêshâh, mar-ay-shaw'; or מַרֵשָׁה Marêshâh; formed like H4761; summit;  Mareshah, the name of two Israelites and of a place in Palestine:—Mareshah.

H4763.definition: מְרַאֲשָׁה mᵉraʼăshâh, mer-ah-ash-aw'; formed like H4761;  properly, a headpiece, i.e. (plural for adverbial) at (or as) the head-rest (or pillow):—bolster, head, pillow. Compare H4772.

H4764.definition: מֵרָב Mêrâb, may-rawb'; from H7231; increase;  Merab, a daughter of Saul:—Merab.

H4765.definition: מַרְבַד marbad, mar-bad'; from H7234;  a coverlet:—covering of tapestry.

H4767.definition: מִרְבָּה mirbâh, meer-baw'; from H7235;  abundance, i.e. a great quantity:—much.

H477.definition: אֱלִישָׁע ʼĔlîyshâʻ, el-ee-shaw'; contracted for H474.;  Elisha, the famous prophet:—Elisha.

H4771.definition: מַרְגּוֹעַ margôwaʻ, mar-go'-ah; from H7280;  a resting place:—rest.

H4775.definition: מָרַד mârad, maw-rad'; a primitive root;  to rebel:—rebel(-lious).

H4778.definition: מֶרֶד Mered, meh'-red; the same as H4777;  Mered, an Israelite:—Mered.

H4780.definition: מַרְדּוּת mardûwth, mar-dooth'; from H4775;  rebelliousness:—× rebellious.

H4781.definition: מְרֹדָךְ Mᵉrôdâk, mer-o-dawk'; of foreign derivation;  Merodak, a Babylonian idol:—Merodach. Compare H4757.

H4782.definition: מׇרְדְּכַי Mordᵉkay, mor-dek-ah'-ee; of foreign derivation;  Mordecai, an Israelite:—Mordecai.

H4783.definition: מֻרְדָּף murdâph, moor-dawf'; from H7291;  persecuted:—persecuted.

H4784.definition: מָרָה mârâh, maw-raw'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively, to provoke):—bitter, change, be disobedient, disobey, grievously, provocation, provoke(-ing), (be) rebel (against, -lious).

H4785.definition: מָרָה Mârâh, maw-raw'; the same as H4751 feminine; bitter;  Marah, a place in the Desert:—Marah.

H4787.definition: מׇרָּה morrâh, mor-raw'; a form of H4786;  trouble:—bitterness.

H4789.definition: מֵרוֹז Mêrôwz, may-roze'; of uncertain derivation;  Meroz, a place in Palestine:—Meroz.

H479.definition: אִלֵּךְ ʼillêk, il-lake'; (Aramaic) prolonged from H412;  these:—these, those.

H4790.definition: מְרוֹחַ mᵉrôwach, mer-o-akh'; from H4799;  bruised, i.e. emasculated:—broken.

H4791.definition: מָרוֹם mârôwm, maw-rome'; from H7311;  altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft):—(far) above, dignity, haughty, height, (most, on) high (one, place), loftily, upward.

H480.definition: אַלְלַי ʼalᵉlay, al-le-lah'ee; by reduplication from H421;  alas!:—woe.

H4800.definition: מֶרְחָב merchâb, mer-khawb'; from H7337;  enlargement, either literally (an open space, usually in a good sense), or figuratively (liberty):—breadth, large place (room).

H4801.definition: מֶרְחָק merchâq, mer-khawk'; from H7368;  remoteness, i.e. (concretely) a distant place; often (adverbially) from afar:—(a-, dwell in, very) far (country, off). See also 1023.

H4803.definition: מָרַט mâraṭ, maw-rat'; a primitive root;  to polish; by implication, to make bald (the head), to gall (the shoulder); also, to sharpen:—bright, furbish, (have his) hair (be) fallen off, peeled, pluck off (hair).

H4805.definition: מְרִי mᵉrîy, mer-ee'; from H4784;  bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) rebellion; concretely, bitter, or rebellious:—bitter, (most) rebel(-lion, -lious).

H4808.definition: מְרִיבָה mᵉrîybâh, mer-ee-baw'; from H7378;  quarrel:—provocation, strife.

H481.definition: אָלַם ʼâlam, aw-lam'; a primitive root;  to tie fast; hence (of the mouth) to be tongue-tied:—bind, be dumb, put to silence.

H4811.definition: מְרָיָה Mᵉrâyâh, mer-aw-yaw'; from H4784; rebellion;  Merajah, an Israelite:—Meraiah. Compare H3236.

H4812.definition: מְרָיוֹת Mᵉrâyôwth, mer-aw-yohth'; plural of H4811; rebellious;  Merajoth, the name of two Israelites:—Meraioth.

H4813.definition: מִרְיָם Miryâm, meer-yawm'; from H4805; rebelliously;  Mirjam, the name of two Israelitesses:—Miriam.

H4814.definition: מְרִירוּת mᵉrîyrûwth, mer-ee-rooth'; from H4843;  bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) grief:—bitterness.

H4817.definition: מֶרְכָּב merkâb, mer-kawb'; from H7392;  a chariot; also a seat (in a vehicle):—chariot, covering, saddle.

H4818.definition: מֶרְכָּבָה merkâbâh, mer-kaw-baw'; feminine of H4817;  a chariot:—chariot. See also H1024.

H4820.definition: מִרְמָה mirmâh, meer-maw'; from H7411 in the sense of deceiving;  fraud:—craft, deceit(-ful, -fully), false, feigned, guile, subtilly, treachery.

H4821.definition: מִרְמָה Mirmâh, meer-maw'; the same as H4820;  Mirmah, an Israelite:—Mirma.

H4822.definition: מְרֵמוֹת Mᵉrêmôwth, mer-ay-mohth'; plural from H7311; heights;  Meremoth, the name of two Israelites:—Meremoth.

H4823.definition: מִרְמָס mirmâç, meer-mawce'; from H7429;  abasement (the act or the thing):—tread (down) -ing, (to be) trodden (down) under foot.

H4825.definition: מֶרֶס Mereç, meh'-res; of foreign derivation;  Meres, a Persian:—Meres.

H4826.definition: מַרְסְנָא Marçᵉnâʼ, mar-sen-aw'; of foreign derivation;  Marsena, a Persian:—Marsena.

H4828.definition: מֵרֵעַ mêrêaʻ, may-ray'-ah; from H7462 in the sense of companionship;  a friend:—companion, friend.

H4829.definition: מִרְעֶה mirʻeh, meer-eh'; from H7462 in the sense of feeding;  pasture (the place or the act); also the haunt of wild animals:—feeding place, pasture.

H483.definition: אִלֵּם ʼillêm, il-lame'; from H481;  speechless:—dumb (man).

H4832.definition: מַרְפֵּא marpêʼ, mar-pay'; from H7495;  properly, curative, i.e. literally (concretely) a medicine, or (abstractly) a cure; figuratively (concretely) deliverance, or (abstractly) placidity:—(in-)cure(-able), healing(-lth), remedy, sound, wholesome, yielding.

H484.definition: אַלְמֻגִּים ʼalmuggîym, al-moog-gheem'; probably of foreign derivation (used thus only in the plural);  almug (i.e. probably sandle-wood) sticks:—almug trees. Compare H418.

H4840.definition: מֶרְקָח merqâch, mer-kawkh'; from H7543;  a spicy herb:—× sweet.

H4843.definition: מָרַר mârar, maw-rar'; a primitive root; properly, to trickle (see H4752); but used only as a denominative from H4751;  to be (causatively, make) bitter (literally or figuratively):—(be, be in, deal, have, make) bitter(-ly, -ness), be moved with choler, (be, have sorely, it) grieved(-eth), provoke, vex.

H4844.definition: מְרֹר mᵉrôr, mer-ore'; or מְרוֹר mᵉrôwr; from H4843;  a bitter herb:—bitter(-ness).

H4846.definition: מְרֹרָה mᵉrôrâh, mer-o-raw'; or מְרוֹרָה mᵉrôwrâh; from H4843;  properly, bitterness; concretely, a bitter thing; specifically bile; also venom (of a serpent):—bitter (thing), gall.

H485.definition: אֲלֻמָּה ʼălummâh, al-oom-maw'; or (masculine) אָלֻם ʼâlum; passive participle of H481;  something bound; a sheaf:—sheaf.

H4853.definition: מַשָּׂא massâʼ, mas-saw'; from H5375;  a burden; specifically, tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively, an utterance, chiefly a doom, especially singing; mental, desire:—burden, carry away, prophecy, × they set, song, tribute.

H4854.definition: מַשָּׂא Massâʼ, mas-saw'; the same as H4853; burden;  Massa, a son of Ishmael:—Massa.

H4857.definition: מַשְׁאָב mashʼâb, mash-awb'; from H7579;  a trough for cattle to drink from:—place of drawing water.

H486.definition: אַלְמוֹדָד ʼAlmôwdâd, al-mo-dawd'; probably of foreign derivation  Almodad, a son of Joktan:—Almodad.

H4861.definition: מִשְׁאָל Mishʼâl, mish-awl'; from H7592; request;  Mishal, a place in Palestine:—Mishal, Misheal. Compare H4913.

H4864.definition: מַשְׂאֵת masʼêth, mas-ayth'; from H5375;  properly, (abstractly) a raising (as of the hands in prayer), or rising (of flame); figuratively, an utterance; concretely, a beacon (as raised); a present (as taken), mess, or tribute; figuratively, a reproach (as a burden):—burden, collection, sign of fire, (great) flame, gift, lifting up, mess, oblation, reward.

H4865.definition: מִשְׁבְּצָה mishbᵉtsâh, mish-bets-aw'; from H7660;  a brocade; by analogy, a (reticulated) setting of a gem:—ouch, wrought.

H4867.definition: מִשְׁבָּר mishbâr, mish-bawr'; from H7665;  a breaker (of the sea):—billow, wave.

H4872.definition: מֹשֶׁה Môsheh, mo-sheh'; from H4871; drawing out (of the water), i.e. rescued;  Mosheh, the Israelite lawgiver:—Moses.

H4876.definition: מַשּׁוּאָה mashshûwʼâh, mash-shoo-aw'; or מַשֻּׁאָה mashshuʼâh; for H4875;  ruin:—desolation, destruction.

H4877.definition: מְשׁוֹבָב Mᵉshôwbâb, mesh-o-bawb'; from H7725; returned;  Meshobab, an Israelite:—Meshobab.

H4878.definition: מְשׁוּבָה mᵉshûwbâh, mesh-oo-baw'; or מְשֻׁבָה mᵉshubâh; from H7725;  apostasy:—backsliding, turning away.

H4885.definition: מָשׂוֹשׂ mâsôws, maw-soce'; from H7797;  delight, concretely (the cause or object) or abstractly (the feeling):—joy, mirth, rejoice.

H4886.definition: מָשַׁח mâshach, maw-shakh'; a primitive root;  to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint; by implication, to consecrate; also to paint:—anoint, paint.

H4887.definition: מְשַׁח mᵉshach, mesh-akh'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H4886;  oil:—oil.

H4888.definition: מִשְׁחָה mishchâh, meesh-khaw'; or מׇשְׁחָה moshchâh; from H4886;  unction (the act); by implication, a consecratory gift:—(to be) anointed(-ing), ointment.

H4895.definition: מַשְׂטֵמָה masṭêmâh, mas-tay-maw'; from the same as H7850;  enmity:—hatred.

H4897.definition: מֶשִׁי meshîy, meh'-shee; from H4871;  silk (as drawn from the cocoon):—silk.

H4898.definition: מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵל Mᵉshêyzabʼêl, mesh-ay-zab-ale'; from an equivalent to H7804 and H410; delivered of God;  Meshezabel, an Israelite:—Meshezabeel.

H4899.definition: מָשִׁיחַ mâshîyach, maw-shee'-akh; from H4886;  anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically, the Messiah:—anointed, Messiah.

H49.definition: אֲבִישַׁג ʼĂbîyshag, ab-ee-shag'; from H1 and H7686; father of error (i.e. blundering);  Abishag, a concubine of David:—Abishag.

H490.definition: אַלְמָנָה ʼalmânâh, al-maw-naw'; feminine of H488;  a widow; also a desolate place:—desolate house (palace), widow.

H4900.definition: מָשַׁךְ mâshak, maw-shak'; a primitive root;  to draw, used in a great variety of applications (including to sow, to sound, to prolong, to develop, to march, to remove, to delay, to be tall, etc.):—draw (along, out), continue, defer, extend, forbear, × give, handle, make (pro-, sound) long, × sow, scatter, stretch out.

H4902.definition: מֶשֶׁךְ Meshek, meh'-shek; the same in form as H4901, but probably of foreign derivation;  Meshek, a son of Japheth, and the people descended from him:—Mesech, Meshech.

H4904.definition: מִשְׁכָּב mishkâb, mish-kawb'; from H7901;  a bed (figuratively, a bier); abstractly, sleep; by euphemism, carnal intercourse:—bed(-chamber), couch, lieth (lying) with.

H4905.definition: מַשְׂכִּיל maskîyl, mas-keel'; from H7919;  instructive, i.e. a didactic poem:—Maschil.

H4906.definition: מַשְׂכִּית maskîyth, mas-keeth'; from the same as H7906;  a figure (carved on stone, the wall, or any object); figuratively, imagination:—conceit, image(-ry), picture, × wish.

H4907.definition: מִשְׁכַּן mishkan, mish-kan'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4908;  residence:—habitation.

H4908.definition: מִשְׁכָּן mishkân, mish-kawn'; from H7931;  a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls):—dwelleth, dwelling (place), habitation, tabernacle, tent.

H4909.definition: מַשְׂכֹּרֶת maskôreth, mas-koh'-reth; from H7936;  wages or a reward:—reward, wages.

H4910.definition: מָשַׁל mâshal, maw-shal'; a primitive root;  to rule:—(have, make to have) dominion, governor, × indeed, reign, (bear, cause to, have) rule(-ing, -r), have power.

H4911.definition: מָשַׁל mâshal, maw-shal'; denominative from H4912;  to liken, i.e. (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively, to resemble:—be(-come) like, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter.

H4912.definition: מָשָׁל mâshâl, maw-shawl'; apparently from H4910 in some original sense of superiority in mental action;  properly, a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature; hence, a simile (as an adage, poem, discourse):—byword, like, parable, proverb.

H4913.definition: מָשָׁל Mâshâl, maw-shawl'; for H4861;  Mashal, a place in Palestine:—Mashal.

H4917.definition: מִשְׁלַחַת mishlachath, mish-lakh'-ath; feminine of H4916;  a mission, i.e. (abstractly and favorable) release, or (concretely and unfavorable) an army:—discharge, sending.

H4918.definition: מְשֻׁלָּם Mᵉshullâm, mesh-ool-lawm'; from H7999; allied;  Meshullam, the name of seventeen Israelites:—Meshullam.

H4920.definition: מְשֶׁלֶמְיָה Mᵉshelemyâh, mesh-eh-lem-yaw'; or מְשֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ Mᵉshelemyâhûw; from H7999 and H3050; ally of Jah;  Meshelemjah, an Israelite:—Meshelemiah.

H4923.definition: מְשַׁמָּה mᵉshammâh, mesh-am-maw'; from H8074;  a waste or amazement:—astonishment, desolate.

H4924.definition: מַשְׁמָן mashmân, mash-mawn'; from H8080;  fat, i.e. (literally and abstractly) fatness; but usually (figuratively and concretely) a rich dish, a fertile field, a robust man:—fat (one, -ness, -test, -test place).

H4925.definition: מִשְׁמַנָּה Mishmannâh, mish-man-naw'; from H8080; fatness;  Mashmannah, an Israelite:—Mishmannah.

H4926.definition: מִשְׁמָע mishmâʻ, mish-maw'; from H8085;  a report:—hearing.

H4927.definition: מִשְׁמָע Mishmâʻ, mish-maw'; the same as H4926;  Mishma, the name of a son of Ishmael, and of an Israelite:—Mishma.

H4931.definition: מִשְׁמֶרֶת mishmereth, mish-mer'-reth; feminine of H4929;  watch, i.e. the act (custody), or (concretely) the sentry, the post; objectively preservation, or (concretely) safe; figuratively observance, i.e. (abstractly) duty or (objectively) a usage or party:—charge, keep, or to be kept, office, ordinace, safeguard, ward, watch.

H4932.definition: מִשְׁנֶה mishneh, mish-neh'; from H8138;  properly, a repetition, i.e. a duplicate (copy of a document), or a double (in amount); by implication, a second (in order, rank, age, quality or location):—college, copy, double, fatlings, next, second (order), twice as much.

H4936.definition: מִשְׁעָם Mishʻâm, mish-awm'; apparently from H8159; inspection;  Misham, an Israelite:—Misham.

H4937.definition: מִשְׁעֵן mishʻên, mish-ane'; or מִשְׁעָן mishʻân; from H8172;  a support (concretely), i.e. (figuratively) a protector or sustenance:—stay.

H4939.definition: מִשְׂפָּח mispâch, mis-pawkh'; from H5596;  slaughter:—oppression.

H494.definition: אֶלְנָתָן ʼElnâthân, el-naw-thawn'; from H410 and H5414; God (is the) giver;  Elnathan, the name of four Israelites:—Elnathan.

H4940.definition: מִשְׁפָּחָה mishpâchâh, mish-paw-khaw'; from H8192 (compare H8198);  a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people:—family, kind(-red).

H4941.definition: מִשְׁפָּט mishpâṭ, mish-pawt'; from H8199;  properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style:—  adversary, ceremony, charge, × crime, custom, desert, determination, discretion, disposing, due, fashion, form, to be judged, judgment, just(-ice, -ly), (manner of) law(-ful), manner, measure, (due) order, ordinance, right, sentence, usest, × worthy,   wrong.

H4945.definition: מַשְׁקֶה mashqeh, mash-keh'; from H8248;  properly, causing to drink, i.e. a butler; by implication (intransitively), drink (itself); figuratively, a well-watered region:—butler(-ship), cupbearer, drink(-ing), fat pasture, watered.

H4948.definition: מִשְׁקָל mishqâl, mish-kawl'; from H8254;  weight (numerically estimated); hence, weighing (the act):—(full) weight.

H4952.definition: מִשְׁרָה mishrâh, mish-raw'; from H8281 in the sense of loosening;  maceration, i.e. steeped juice:—liquor.

H4959.definition: מָשַׁשׁ mâshash, maw-shash'; a primitive root;  to feel of; by implication, to grope:—feel, grope, search.

H4960.definition: מִשְׁתֶּה mishteh, mish-teh'; from H8354;  drink, by implication, drinking (the act); also (by implication) a banquet or (generally) feast:—banquet, drank, drink, feast((-ed), -ing).

H4962.definition: מַת math, math; from the same as H4970;  properly, an adult (as of full length); by implication, a man (only in the plural):—  few, × friends, men, persons, × small.

H4966.definition: מָתוֹק mâthôwq, maw-thoke'; or מָתוּק mâthûwq; from H4985;  sweet:—sweet(-er, -ness).

H4968.definition: מְתוּשֶׁלַח Mᵉthûwshelach, meth-oo-sheh'-lakh; from H4962 and H7973; man of a dart;  Methushelach, an antediluvian patriarch:—Methuselah.

H497.definition: אֶלְעָדָה ʼElʻâdâh, el-aw-daw'; from H410 and H5710; God has decked;  Eladah, an Israelite:—Eladah.

H4970.definition: מָתַי mâthay, maw-thah'ee; from an unused root meaning to extend;  properly, extent (of time); but used only adverbially (especially with other particle prefixes), when (either relative or interrogative):—long, when.

H4973.definition: מְתַלְּעָה mᵉthallᵉʻâh, meth-al-leh-aw'; contr. from H3216;  properly, a biter, i.e. a tooth:—cheek (jaw) tooth, jaw.

H4974.definition: מְתֹם mᵉthôm, meth-ohm'; from H8552;  wholesomeness; also (adverb) completely:—men (by reading H4962), soundness.

H4975.definition: מֹתֶן môthen, mo'-then; from an unused root meaning to be slender;  properly, the waist or small of the back; only in plural the loins:—  greyhound, loins, side.

H4976.definition: מַתָּן mattân, mat-tawn'; from H5414;  a present:—gift, to give, reward.

H4977.definition: מַתָּן Mattân, mat-tawn'; the same as H4976;  Mattan, the name of a priest of Baal, and of an Israelite:—Mattan.

H4978.definition: מַתְּנָא mattᵉnâʼ, mat-ten-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H4979:—gift.

H4979.definition: מַתָּנָה mattânâh, mat-taw-naw'; feminine of H4976;  a present; specifically (in a good sense), a sacrificial offering, (in a bad sense) a bribe:—gift.

H498.definition: אֶלְעוּזַי ʼElʻûwzay, el-oo-zah'ee; from H410 and H5756 (in the sense of H5797); God (is) defensive;  Eluzai, an Israelite:—Eluzai.

H4982.definition: מַתְּנַי Mattᵉnay, mat-ten-ah'ee; from H4976; liberal;  Mattenai, the name of three Israelites:—Mattenai.

H4983.definition: מַתַּנְיָה Mattanyâh, mat-tan-yaw'; or מַתַּנְיָהוּ Mattanyâhûw; from H4976 and H3050; gift of Jah;  Mattanjah, the name of ten Israelites:—Mattaniah.

H4985.definition: מָתַק mâthaq, maw-thak'; a primitive root;  to suck, by implication, to relish, or (intransitively) be sweet:—be (made, × take) sweet.

H499.definition: אֶלְעָזָר ʼElʻâzâr, el-aw-zawr'; from H410 and H5826; God (is) helper;  Elazar, the name of seven Israelites:—Eleazar.

H4990.definition: מִתְרְדָת Mithrᵉdâth, mith-red-awth'; of Persian origin;  Mithredath, the name of two Persians:—Mithredath.

H4992.definition: מַתַּתָּה Mattattâh, mat-tat-taw'; for H4993; gift of Jah;  Mattattah, an Israelite:—Mattathah.
