H4993.definition: מַתִּתְיָה Mattithyâh, mat-tith-yaw'; or מַתִּתְיָהוּ Mattithyâhûw; from H4991 and H3050; gift of Jah; Mattithjah, the name of four Israelites:—Mattithiah.

H4994.definition: נָא nâʼ, naw; a primitive particle of incitement and entreaty, which may usually be rendered;  'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction:—I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.

H4996.definition: נֹא Nôʼ, no; of Egyptian origin;  No (i.e. Thebes), the capital of Upper Egypt:—No. Compare H528.

H4997.definition: נֹאד nôʼd, node; or נאוֹד nʼôwdlemma נֹאוד vowel, corrected to נאוֹדxlit nôʼwd corrected to nʼôwd; also (feminine) נֹאדָה nôʼdâh; from an unused root of uncertain signification;  a (skin or leather) bag (for fluids):—bottle.

H4998.definition: נָאָה nâʼâh, naw-aw'; a primitive root;  properly, to be at home, i.e. (by implication) to be pleasant (or suitable), i.e. beautiful:—be beautiful, become, be comely.

H4999.definition: נָאָה nâʼâh, naw-aw'; from H4998;  a home; figuratively, a pasture:—habitation, house, pasture, pleasant place.

H5.definition: אֲבַגְתָא ʼĂbagthâʼ, ab-ag-thaw'; of foreign origin;  Abagtha, a eunuch of Xerxes:—Abagtha.

H50.definition: אֲבִישׁוּעַ ʼĂbîyshûwaʻ, ab-ee-shoo'-ah; from H1 and H7771; father of plenty (i.e. prosperous);  Abishua, the name of two Israelites:—Abishua.

H500.definition: אֶלְעָלֵא ʼElʻâlêʼ, el-aw-lay'; or (more properly) אֶלְעָלֵה ʼElʻâlêh; from H410 and H5927; God (is) going up;  Elale or Elaleh, a place east of the Jordan:—Elealeh.

H5002.definition: נְאֻם nᵉʼum, neh-oom'; from H5001;  an oracle:—(hath) said, saith.

H5003.definition: נָאַף nâʼaph, naw-af'; a primitive root;  to commit adultery; figuratively, to apostatize:—adulterer(-ess), commit(-ing) adultery, woman that breaketh wedlock.

H5006.definition: נָאַץ nâʼats, naw-ats'; a primitive root;  to scorn; or (in Ecclesiastes 12:5), by interchange for H5132, to bloom:—abhor, (give occasion to) blaspheme, contemn, despise, flourish, × great, provoke.

H5007.definition: נְאָצָה nᵉʼâtsâh, neh-aw-tsaw'; or נֶאָצָה neʼâtsâh; from H5006;  scorn:—blasphemy.

H5008.definition: נָאַק nâʼaq, naw-ak'; a primitive root;  to groan:—groan.

H501.definition: אֶלְעָשָׂה ʼElʻâsâh, el-aw-saw'; from H410 and H6213; God has made;  Elasah, the name of four Israelites:—Elasah, Eleasah.

H5011.definition: נֹב Nôb, nobe; the same as H5108; fruit;  Nob, a place in Palestine:—Nob.

H5012.definition: נָבָא nâbâʼ, naw-baw'; a primitive root;  to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse):—prophesy(-ing), make self a prophet.

H5013.definition: נְבָא nᵉbâʼ, neb-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5012:—prophesy.

H5015.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5015.definition: נְבוֹ Nᵉbôw, neb-o'; probably of foreign derivation;  Nebo, the name of a Babylonian deity, also of a mountain in Moab, and of a place in Palestine:—Nebo.

H5018.definition: נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן Nᵉbûwzarʼădân, neb-oo-zar-ad-awn'; of foreign origin;  Nebuzaradan, a Babylonian general:—Nebuzaradan.

H5019.definition: נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר Nᵉbûwkadneʼtstsar, neb-oo-kad-nets-tsar'; or נְבֻּכַדְנֶאצַּר Nᵉbukadneʼtstsar; (2 Kings 24:1,10), or נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר Nᵉbûwkadnetstsar; (Esther 2:6; Daniel 1:18), or נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר Nᵉbûwkadreʼtstsar; or נְבוּכַדְרֶאצּוֹר Nᵉbûwkadreʼtstsôwr; (Ezra 2:1; Jeremiah 49:28), or foreign derivation;  Nebukadnetstsar (or -retstsar, or -retstsor), king of Babylon:—Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadrezzar.

H502.definition: אָלַף ʼâlaph, aw-lof'; a primitive root, to associate with;  hence, to learn (and causatively to teach):—learn, teach, utter.

H5020.definition: נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר Nᵉbûwkadnetstsar, neb-oo-kad-nets-tsar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5019:—Nebuchadnezzar.

H5022.definition: נָבוֹת Nâbôwth, naw-both'; feminine plural from the same as H5011; fruits;  Naboth, an Israelite:—Naboth.

H5024.definition: נָבַח nâbach, naw-bakh'; a primitive root;  to bark (as a dog):—bark.

H5025.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5025.definition: נֹבַח Nôbach, no'-bach; from H5024; a bark;  Nobach, the name of an Israelite, and of a place East of the Jordan:—Nobah.

H5026.definition: נִבְחַז Nibchaz, nib-khaz'; of foreign origin;  Nibchaz, a deity of the Avites:—Nibhaz.

H5027.definition: נָבַט nâbaṭ, naw-bat'; a primitive root;  to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care:—(cause to) behold, consider, look (down), regard, have respect, see.

H5029.definition: נְבִיא nᵉbîyʼ, neb-ee'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5030;  a prophet:—prophet.

H503.definition: אָלַף ʼâlaph, aw-laf'; denominative from H505;  causative, to make a thousandfold:—bring forth thousands.

H5030.definition: נָבִיא nâbîyʼ, naw-bee'; from H5012;  a prophet or (generally) inspired man:—prophecy, that prophesy, prophet.

H5032.definition: נְבָיוֹת Nᵉbâyôwth, neb-aw-yoth'; or נְבָיֹת Nᵉbâyôth; feminine plural from H5107; fruitfulnesses;  Nebajoth, a son of Ismael, and the country settled by him:—Nebaioth, Nebajoth.

H5034.definition: נָבֵל nâbêl, naw-bale'; a primitive root;  to wilt; generally, to fall away, fail, faint; figuratively, to be foolish or (morally) wicked; causatively, to despise, disgrace:—disgrace, dishounour, lightly esteem, fade (away, -ing), fall (down, -ling, off), do foolishly, come to nought, × surely, make vile, wither.

H5035.definition: נֶבֶל nebel, neh'-bel; or נֵבֶל nêbel; from H5034;  a skin-bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form):—bottle, pitcher, psaltery, vessel, viol.

H5036.definition: נָבָל nâbâl, naw-bawl'; from H5034;  stupid; wicked (especially impious):—fool(-ish, -ish man, -ish woman), vile person.

H5037.definition: נָבָל Nâbâl, naw-bawl'; the same as H5036; dolt;  Nabal, an Israelite:—Nabal.

H5038.definition: נְבֵלָה nᵉbêlâh, neb-ay-law'; from H5034;  a flabby thing, i.e. a carcase or carrion (human or bestial, often collectively); figuratively, an idol:—(dead) body, (dead) carcase, dead of itself, which died, (beast) that (which) dieth of itself.

H5039.definition: נְבָלָה nᵉbâlâh, neb-aw-law'; feminine of H5036;  foolishness, i.e. (morally) wickedness; concretely, a crime; by extension, punishment:—folly, vile, villany.

H504.definition: אֶלֶף ʼeleph, eh'-lef; from H502;  a family; also (from the sense of yoking or taming) an ox or cow:—family, kine, oxen.

H5041.definition: נְבַלָּט Nᵉballâṭ, neb-al-lawt'; apparently from H5036 and H3909; foolish secrecy;  Neballat, a place in Palestine:—Neballat.

H5042.definition: נָבַע nâbaʻ, naw-bah'; a primitive root;  to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor):—belch out, flowing, pour out, send forth, utter (abundantly).

H5045.definition: נֶגֶב negeb, neh'-gheb; from an unused root meaning to be parched;  the south (from its drought); specifically, the Negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine):—south (country, side, -ward).

H5046.definition: נָגַד nâgad, naw-gad'; a primitive root;  properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise:—bewray, × certainly, certify, declare(-ing), denounce, expound, × fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, × surely, tell, utter.

H5047.definition: נְגַד nᵉgad, neg-ad'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5046;  to flow (through the idea of clearing the way):—issue.

H5048.definition: נֶגֶד neged, neh'-ghed; from H5046;  a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before:—about, (over) against, × aloof, × far (off), × from, over, presence, × other side, sight, × to view.

H5049.definition: נֶגֶד neged, neh'-ghed; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5048;  opposite:—toward.

H505.definition: אֶלֶף ʼeleph, eh'-lef; prop, the same as H504;  hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand:—thousand.

H5050.definition: נָגַהּ nâgahh, naw-gah'; a primitive root;  to glitter; causatively, to illuminate:—(en-) lighten, (cause to) shine.

H5051.definition: נֹגַהּ nôgahh, no'-gah; from H5050;  brilliancy (literally or figuratively):—bright(-ness), light, (clear) shining.

H5052.definition: נֹגַהּ Nôgahh, no'-gah; the same as H5051;  Nogah, a son of David:—Nogah.

H5055.definition: נָגַח nâgach, naw-gakh'; a primitive root;  to butt with the horns; figuratively, to war against:—gore, push (down, -ing).

H5057.definition: נָגִיד nâgîyd, naw-gheed'; or נָגִד nâgid; from H5046;  a commander (as occupying the front), civil, military or religious; generally (abstractly, plural), honorable themes:—captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.

H5059.definition: נָגַן nâgan, naw-gan'; a primitive root;  properly, to thrum, i.e. beat a tune with the fingers; expectation. to play on a stringed instrument; hence (generally), to make music:—player on instruments, sing to the stringed instruments, melody, ministrel, play(-er, -ing).

H506.definition: אֲלַף ʼălaph, al-af'; (Aramaic) or אֶלֶף ʼeleph; (Aramaic), corresponding to H505:—thousand.

H5060.definition: נָגַע nâgaʻ, naw-gah'; a primitive root;  properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.):—beat, (× be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.

H5061.definition: נֶגַע negaʻ, neh'-gah; from H5060;  a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress):—plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound.

H5062.definition: נָגַף nâgaph, naw-gaf'; a primitive root;  to push, gore, defeat, stub (the toe), inflict (a disease):—beat, dash, hurt, plague, slay, smite (down), strike, stumble, × surely, put to the worse.

H5063.definition: נֶגֶף negeph, neh'-ghef; from H5062;  a trip (of the foot); figuratively, an infliction (of disease):—plague, stumbling.

H5064.definition: נָגַר nâgar, naw-gar'; a primitive root;  to flow; figuratively, to stretch out; causatively, to pour out or down; figuratively, to deliver over:—fall, flow away, pour down (out), run, shed, spilt, trickle down.

H5065.definition: נָגַשׂ nâgas, naw-gas'; a primitive root;  to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize:—distress, driver, exact(-or), oppress(-or), × raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

H5066.definition: נָגַשׁ nâgash, naw-gash'; a primitive root;  to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; religious to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively, to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back:—(make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.

H5067.definition: נֵד nêd, nade; from H5110 in the sense of piling up;  a mound, i.e. wave:—heap.

H5068.definition: נָדַב nâdab, naw-dab'; a primitive root;  to impel; hence, to volunteer (as a soldier), to present spontaneously:—offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing(-ly).

H5069.definition: נְדַב nᵉdab, ned-ab'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5068;  be (or give) liberal(-ly):—(be minded of...own) freewill (offering), offer freely (willingly).

H5070.definition: נָדָב Nâdâb, naw-dawb'; from H5068; liberal;  Nadab, the name of four Israelites:—Nadab.

H5071.definition: נְדָבָה nᵉdâbâh, ned-aw-baw'; from H5068;  properly (abstractly) spontaneity, or (adjectively) spontaneous; also (concretely) a spontaneous or (by inference, in plural) abundant gift:—free(-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary(-ily, offering), willing(-ly), offering).

H5073.definition: נִדְבָּךְ nidbâk, nid-bawk'; (Aramaic) from a root meaning to stick;  a layer (of building materials):—row.

H5074.definition: נָדַד nâdad, naw-dad'; a primitive root;  properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away:—chase (away), × could not, depart, flee (× apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).

H5075.definition: נְדַד nᵉdad, ned-ad'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5074;  to depart:—go from.

H5076.definition: נָדֻד nâdud, naw-dood'; passive participle of H5074;  properly, tossed; abstractly, a rolling (on the bed):—tossing to and fro.

H5077.definition: נָדָה nâdâh, naw-daw'; or נָדָא nâdâʼ; (2 Kings 17:21), a primitive root;  properly, to toss; figuratively, to exclude, i.e. banish, postpone, prohibit:—cast out, drive, put far away.

H5078.definition: נֵדֶה nêdeh, nay'-deh; from H5077 in the sense of freely flinging money;  a bounty (for prostitution):—gifts.

H5079.definition: נִדָּה niddâh, nid-daw'; from H5074;  properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest):—× far, filthiness, × flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, × removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean(-ness, thing, with filthiness).

H5080.definition: נָדַח nâdach, naw-dakh'; a primitive root;  to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.):—banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.

H5081.definition: נָדִיב nâdîyb, naw-deeb'; from H5068;  properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant):—free, liberal (things), noble, prince, willing (hearted).

H5082.definition: נְדִיבָה nᵉdîybâh, ned-ee-baw'; feminine of H5081;  properly, nobility, i.e. reputation:—soul.

H5086.definition: נָדַף nâdaph, naw-daf'; a primitive root;  to shove asunder, i.e. disperse:—drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro.

H5087.definition: נָדַר nâdar, naw-dar'; a primitive root;  to promise (pos., to do or give something to God):—(make a) vow.

H5088.definition: נֶדֶר neder, neh'-der; or נֵדֶר nêder; from H5087;  a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised:—vow(-ed).

H5090.definition: נָהַג nâhag, naw-hag'; a primitive root;  to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh:—acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).

H5091.definition: נָהָה nâhâh, naw-haw'; a primitive root;  to groan, i.e. bewail; hence (through the idea of crying aloud), to assemble (as if on proclamation):—lament, wail.

H5092.definition: נְהִי nᵉhîy, neh-hee'; from H5091;  an elegy:—lamentation, wailing.

H5094.definition: נְהִיר nᵉhîyr, neh-heere'; (Aramaic) or נְהִירוּ nᵉhîyrûw; (Aramaic), from the same as H5105;  illumination, i.e. (figuratively) wisdom:—light.

H5096.definition: נַהֲלָל Nahălâl, nah-hal-awl'; or נַהֲלֹל Nahălôl; the same as H5097;  Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine:—Nahalal, Nahallal, Nahalol.

H5101.definition: נָהַק nâhaq, naw-hak'; a primitive root;  to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger):—bray.

H5103.definition: נְהַר nᵉhar, neh-har'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H5102;  a river, especially the Euphrates:—river, stream.

H5104.definition: נָהָר nâhâr, naw-hawr'; from H5102;  a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity:—flood, river.

H5105.definition: נְהָרָה nᵉhârâh, neh-haw-raw'; from H5102 in its original sense;  daylight:—light.

H5106.definition: נוּא nûwʼ, noo; a primitive root;  to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize:—break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.

H5107.definition: נוּב nûwb, noob; a primitive root;  to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter:—bring forth (fruit), make cheerful, increase.

H5109.definition: נוֹבַי Nôwbay, no-bah'ee; from H5108; fruitful;  Nobai, an Israelite:—Nebai (from the margin).

H511.definition: אֶלְקָנָה ʼElqânâh, el-kaw-naw'; from H410 and H7069; God has obtained;  Elkanah, the name of several Israelites:—Elkanah.

H5110.definition: נוּד nûwd, nood; a primitive root;  to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt:—bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.

H5111.definition: נוּד nûwd, nood; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5116;  to flee:—get away.

H5116.definition: נָוֶה nâveh, naw-veh'; or (feminine) נָוָה nâvâh; from H5115;  (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den):—comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.

H5117.definition: נוּחַ nûwach, noo'-akh; a primitive root;  to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.):—cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare H3241.

H5119.definition: נוֹחָה Nôwchâh, no-chaw'; feminine of H5118; quietude;  Nochah, an Israelite:—Nohah.

H5123.definition: נוּם nûwm, noom; a primitive root;  to slumber (from drowsiness):—sleep, slumber.

H5127.definition: נוּס nûwç, noos; a primitive root;  to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver):—× abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, × hide, lift up a standard.

H5128.definition: נוּעַ nûwaʻ, noo'-ah; a primitive root;  to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined):—continually, fugitive, × make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).

H5129.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper masculine noun
H5129.definition: נוֹעַדְיָה Nôwʻadyâh, no-ad-yaw'; from H3259 and H3050; convened of Jah;  Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess:—Noadiah.

H5130.definition: נוּף nûwph, noof; a primitive root;  to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.):—lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.

H5132.definition: נוּץ nûwts, noots; a primitive root;  properly, to flash; also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion):—flee away, bud (forth).

H5133.definition: נוֹצָה nôwtsâh, no-tsaw'; or נֹצָה nôtsâh; feminine active participle of H5327 in the sense of flying;  a pinion (or wing feather); often (collectively) plumage:—feather(-s), ostrich.

H5135.definition: נוּר nûwr, noor; (Aramaic) from an unused root (corresponding to that of H5216) meaning to shine;  fire:—fiery, fire.

H5137.definition: נָזָה nâzâh, naw-zaw'; a primitive root;  to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation):—sprinkle.

H5138.definition: נָזִיד nâzîyd, naw-zeed'; from H2102;  something boiled, i.e. soup:—pottage.

H5139.definition: נָזִיר nâzîyr, naw-zeer'; or נָזִר nâzir; from H5144;  separate, i.e. consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite):—Nazarite (by a false alliteration with Nazareth), separate(-d), vine undressed.

H514.definition: אֶלְתְּקֵא ʼEltᵉqêʼ, el-te-kay'; or (more properly) אֶלְתְּקֵה ʼEltᵉqêh; of uncertain derivation;  Eltekeh or Elteke, a place in Palestine:—Eltekeh.

H5140.definition: נָזַל nâzal, naw-zal'; a primitive root;  to drip, or shed by trickling:—distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow(-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.

H5141.definition: נֶזֶם nezem, neh'-zem; from an unused root of uncertain meaning;  a nose-ring:—earring, jewel.

H5142.definition: נְזַק nᵉzaq, nez-ak'; (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of H5143;  to suffer (causatively, inflict) loss:—have (en-) damage, hurt(-ful).

H5145.definition: נֶזֶר nezer, neh'-zer; or נֵזֶר nêzer; from H5144;  properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty):—consecration, crown, hair, separation.

H5146.definition: נֹחַ Nôach, no'-akh; the same as H5118; rest;  Noach, the patriarch of the flood:—Noah.

H5147.definition: נַחְבִּי Nachbîy, nakh-bee'; from H2247; occult;  Nachbi, an Israelite:—Nakbi.

H5148.definition: נָחָה nâchâh, naw-khaw'; a primitive root;  to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists):—bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.

H5149.definition: נְחוּם Nᵉchûwm, neh-khoom'; from H5162; comforted;  Nechum, an Israelite:—Nehum.

H5150.definition: נִחוּם nichûwm, nee-khoom'; or נִחֻם nichum; from H5162;  properly, consoled; abstractly, solace:—comfort(-able), repenting.

H5152.definition: נָחוֹר Nâchôwr, naw-khore'; from the same as H5170; snorer;  Nachor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham:—Nahor.

H5153.definition: נָחוּשׁ nâchûwsh, naw-khoosh'; apparently passive participle of H5172 (perhaps in the sense of ringing), i.e. bell-metal; or from the red color of the throat of a serpent (H5175, as denominative) when hissing);  coppery, i.e. (figuratively) hard:—of brass.

H5154.definition: נְחוּשָׁה nᵉchûwshâh, nekh-oo-shaw'; or נְחֻשָׁה nᵉchushâh; feminine of H5153;  copper:—brass, steel. Compare H5176.

H5157.definition: נָחַל nâchal, naw-khal'; a primitive root;  to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively, to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate:—divide, have (inheritance), take as a heritage, (cause to, give to, make to) inherit, (distribute for, divide (for, for an, by), give for, have, leave for, take (for)) inheritance, (have in, cause to, be made to) possess(-ion).

H5158.definition: נַחַל nachal, nakh'-al; or (feminine) נַחְלָה nachlâh; (Psalm 124:4), or נַחֲלָה nachălâh; (Ezekiel 47:19; Ezekiel 48:28), from H5157 in its original sense;  a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine):—brook, flood, river, stream, valley.

H5159.definition: נַחֲלָה nachălâh, nakh-al-aw'; from H5157 (in its usual sense);  properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion:—heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158.

H5162.definition: נָחַם nâcham, naw-kham'; a primitive root;  properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself):—comfort (self), ease (one's self), repent(-er,-ing, self).

H5164.definition: נֹחַם nôcham, no'-kham; from H5162;  ruefulness, i.e. desistance:—repentance.

H5166.definition: נְחֶמְיָה Nᵉchemyâh, nekh-em-yaw'; from H5162 and H3050; consolation of Jah;  Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites:—Nehemiah.

H5167.definition: נַחֲמָנִי Nachămânîy, nakh-am-aw-nee'; from H5162; consolatory;  Nachamani, an Israelite:—Nahamani.

H5168.definition: נַחְנוּ nachnûw, nakh-noo'; for H587;  we:—we.

H517.definition: אֵם ʼêm, ame; a primitive word;  a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively [like father]):—dam, mother, × parting.

H5170.definition: נַחַר nachar, nakh'-ar; and (feminine) נַחֲרָה nachărâh; from an unused root meaning to snort or snore;  a snorting:—nostrils, snorting.

H5171.definition: נַחֲרַי Nachăray, nakh-ar-ah'-ee; or נַחְרַי Nachray; from the same as H5170; snorer;  Nacharai or Nachrai, an Israelite:—Naharai, Nahari.

H5172.definition: נָחַשׁ nâchash, naw-khash'; a primitive root;  properly, to hiss, i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate:—× certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) × enchantment, learn by experience, × indeed, diligently observe.

H5173.definition: נַחַשׁ nachash, nakh'-ash; from H5172;  an incantation or augury:—enchantment.

H5174.definition: נְחָשׁ nᵉchâsh, nekh-awsh'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5154;  copper:—brass.

H5175.definition: נָחָשׁ nâchâsh, naw-khawsh'; from H5172;  a snake (from its hiss):—serpent.

H5177.definition: נַחְשׁוֹן Nachshôwn, nakh-shone'; from H5172; enchanter;  Nachshon, an Israelite:—Naashon, Nahshon.

H5178.definition: נְחֹשֶׁת nᵉchôsheth, nekh-o'-sheth; for H5154;  copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver):—brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.

H518.definition: אִם ʼim, eem; a primitive particle;  used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not:—(and, can-, doubtless, if, that) (not), + but, either, + except, + more(-over if, than), neither, nevertheless, nor, oh that, or, + save (only, -ing), seeing, since, sith, + surely (no more, none, not), though, + of a truth, + unless, + verily, when, whereas, whether, while, + yet.

H5180.definition: נְחֻשְׁתָּן Nᵉchushtân, nekh-oosh-tawn'; from H5178;  something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert:—Nehushtan.

H5181.definition: נָחַת nâchath, naw-khath'; a primitive root;  to sink, i.e. descend; causatively, to press or lead down:—be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast.

H5183.definition: נַחַת Nachath, nakh'-ath; from H5182; also (intransitively; perhaps from H5117)  a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness:—lighting down, quiet(-ness), to rest, be set on.

H5184.definition: נַחַת Nachath, nakh'-ath; the same as H5183; quiet;  Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites:—Nahath.

H5185.definition: נָחֵת nâchêth, naw-khayth'; from H5181;  descending:—come down.

H5186.definition: נָטָה nâṭâh, naw-taw'; a primitive root;  to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application (as follows):—  afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.

H5189.definition: נְטִישָׁה nᵉṭîyshâh, net-ee-shaw'; from H5203;  a tendril (as an offshoot):—battlement, branch, plant.

H519.definition: אָמָה ʼâmâh, aw-maw'; apparently a primitive word;  a maid-servant or female slave:—(hand-) bondmaid(-woman), maid(-servant).

H5192.definition: נֵטֶל nêṭel, nay'-tel; from H5190;  a burden:—weighty.

H5193.definition: נָטַע nâṭaʻ, naw-tah'; a primitive root;  properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively):—fastened, plant(-er).

H5194.definition: נֶטַע neṭaʻ, neh'-tah; from H5193;  a plant; collectively, a plantation; abstractly, a planting:—plant.

H5195.definition: נָטִיעַ nâṭîyaʻ, naw-tee'-ah; from H5193;  a plant:—plant.

H5197.definition: נָטַף nâṭaph, naw-taf'; a primitive root;  to ooze, i.e. distil gradually; by implication, to fall in drops; figuratively, to speak by inspiration:—drop(-ping), prophesy(-et).

H5198.definition: נָטָף nâṭâph, naw-tawf'; from H5197;  a drop; specifically, an aromatic gum (probably stacte):—drop, stacte.

H52.definition: אֲבִישַׁי ʼĂbîyshay, ab-ee-shah'ee; or (shorter) אַבְשַׁי ʼAbshay ; from H1 and H7862; father of a gift (i.e. probably generous);  Abishai, an Israelite:—Abishai.

H520.definition: אַמָּה ʼammâh, am-maw'; prolonged from H517;  properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance):—cubit, + hundred (by exchange for H3967), measure, post.

H5203.definition: נָטַשׁ nâṭash, naw-tash'; a primitive root;  properly, to pound, i.e. smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (inclusively, reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.):—cast off, drawn, let fall, forsake, join (battle), leave (off), lie still, loose, spread (self) abroad, stretch out, suffer.

H5208.definition: נִיחוֹחַ nîychôwach, nee-kho'-akh; (Aramaic) or נִיחֹחַ nîychôach; (shorter) (Aramaic), corresponding to H5207;  pleasure:—sweet odour (savour).

H5209.definition: נִין nîyn, neen; from H5125;  progeny:—son.

H521.definition: אַמָּה ʼammâh, am-maw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H520:—cubit.

H5210.definition: נִינְוֵה Nîynᵉvêh, nee-nev-ay'; of foreign origin;  Nineveh, the capital of Assyria:—Nineveh.

H5212.definition: נִיסָן Nîyçân, nee-sawn'; probably of foreign origin;  Nisan, the first month of the Jewish sacred year:—Nisan.

H5214.definition: נִיר nîyr, neer; a root probably identical with that of H5216, through the idea of the gleam of a fresh furrow;  to till the soil:—break up.

H5215.definition: נִיר nîyr, neer; or נִר nir; from H5214;  properly, plowing, i.e. (concretely) freshly plowed land:—fallow ground, plowing, tillage.

H5216.definition: נִיר nîyr, neer; or נִר nir; also נֵיר nêyr; or נֵר nêr; or (feminine) נֵרָה nêrâh; from a primitive root (see H5214; H5135) properly, meaning to glisten;  a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively):—candle, lamp, light.

H5218.definition: נָכֵא nâkêʼ, naw-kay'; or נָכָא nâkâʼ; from H5217;  smitten, i.e. (figuratively) afflicted:—broken, stricken, wounded.

H5219.definition: נְכֹאת nᵉkôʼth, nek-ohth'; from H5218;  properly, a smiting, i.e. (concretely) an aromatic gum (perhaps styrax) (as powdered):—spicery(-ces).

H5221.definition: נָכָה nâkâh, naw-kaw'; a primitive root;  to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively):—beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), × go forward, × indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, × surely, wound.

H5223.definition: נָכֶה nâkeh, naw-keh';   smitten, i.e. (literally) maimed, or (figuratively) dejected:—contrite, lame.

H5224.definition: נְכוֹ Nᵉkôw, nek-o'; probably of Egyptian origin;  Neko, an Egyptian king:—Necho. Compare H6549.

H5227.definition: נֹכַח nôkach, no'-kakh; from the same as H5226;  properly, the front part; used adverbially (especially with preposition), opposite, in front of, forward, in behalf of:—(over) against, before, direct(-ly), for, right (on).

H5229.definition: נְכֹחָה nᵉkôchâh, nek-o-khaw'; feminine of H5228;  properly, straightforwardness, i.e. (figuratively) integrity, or (concretely) a truth:—equity, right (thing), uprightness.

H523.definition: אֻמַּה ʼummah, oom-maw'; from the same as H517;  a collection, i.e. community of persons:—nation, people.

H5230.definition: נָכַל nâkal, naw-kal'; a primitive root;  to defraud, i.e. act treacherously:—beguile, conspire, deceiver, deal subtilly.

H5233.definition: נֶכֶס nekeç, neh'-kes; from an unused root meaning to accumulate;  treasure:—riches, wealth.

H5234.definition: נָכַר nâkar, naw-kar'; a primitive root;  properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning):—acknowledge, × could, deliver, discern, dissemble, estrange, feign self to be another, know, take knowledge (notice), perceive, regard, (have) respect, behave (make) self strange(-ly).

H5236.definition: נֵכָר nêkâr, nay-kawr'; ' from H5234;  foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom:—alien, strange (+ -er).

H5237.definition: נׇכְרִי nokrîy, nok-ree'; from H5235 (second form);  strange, in a variety of degrees and applications (foreign, non-relative, adulterous, different, wonderful):—alien, foreigner, outlandish, strange(-r, woman).

H524.definition: אֻמָּה ʼummâh, oom-maw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H523:—nation.

H5241.definition: נְמוּאֵל Nᵉmûwʼêl, nem-oo-ale'; apparently for H3223;  Nemuel, the name of two Israelites:—Nemuel.

H5246.definition: נָמֵר nâmêr, naw-mare'; from an unused root meaning properly, to filtrate, i.e. be limpid (comp H5247 and H5249); and thus to spot or stain as if by dripping;  a leopard (from its stripes):—leopard.

H5247.definition: נִמְרָה Nimrâh, nim-raw'; from the same as H5246; clear water;  Nimrah, a place East of the Jordan:—Nimrah. See also H1039, H5249.

H5248.definition: נִמְרוֹד Nimrôwd, nim-rode'; or נִמְרֹד Nimrôd; probably of foreign origin;  Nimrod, a son of Cush:—Nimrod.

H525.definition: אָמוֹן ʼâmôwn, aw-mone'; from H539, probably in the sense of training; like H542  skilled, i.e. an architect:—one brought up.

H5254.definition: נָסָה nâçâh, naw-saw'; a primitive root;  to test; by implication, to attempt:—adventure, assay, prove, tempt, try.

H5255.definition: נָסַח nâçach, naw-sakh'; a primitive root;  to tear away:—destroy, pluck, root.

H5257.definition: נְסִיךְ nᵉçîyk, nes-eek'; from H5258;  properly, something poured out, i.e. a libation; also a molten image; by implication, a prince (as anointed):—drink offering, duke, prince(-ipal).

H5258.definition: נָסַךְ nâçak, naw-sak'; a primitive root;  to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy, to anoint a king:—cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up).

H526.definition: אָמוֹן ʼÂmôwn, aw-mone'; the same as H525;  Amon, the name of three Israelites:—Amon.

H5261.definition: נְסַךְ nᵉçak, nes-ak'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5262;  a libation:—drink offering.

H5262.definition: נֶסֶךְ neçek, neh'-sek; or נֵסֶךְ nêçek; from H5258;  a libation; also a cast idol:—cover, drink offering, molten image.

H5263.definition: נָסַס nâçaç, naw-sas'; a primitive root;  to wane, i.e. be sick:—faint.

H5265.definition: נָסַע nâçaʻ, naw-sah'; a primitive root;  properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on a journey:—cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), × still, be on his (go their) way.

H5267.definition: נְסַק nᵉçaq, nes-ak'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5266:—take up.

H5270.definition: נֹעָה Nôʻâh, no-aw'; from H5128; movement;  Noah, an Israelitess:—Noah.

H5273.definition: נָעִים nâʻîym, naw-eem'; from H5276;  delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative):—pleasant(-ure), sweet.

H5274.definition: נָעַל nâʻal, naw-al'; a primitive root; also denominative from H5275  properly, to fasten up, i.e. with a bar or cord; hence, to sandal, i.e. furnish with slippers:—bolt, inclose, lock, shoe, shut up.

H5275.definition: נַעַל naʻal, nah'-al; or (feminine) נַעֲלָה naʻălâh; from H5274;  properly, a sandal tongue; by extension a sandal or slipper (sometimes as a symbol of occupancy, a refusal to marry, or of something valueless):—dryshod, (pair of) shoe((-latchet), -s).

H5276.definition: נָעֵם nâʻêm, naw-ame'; a primitive root;  to be agreeable (literally or figuratively):—pass in beauty, be delight, be pleasant, be sweet.

H5278.definition: נֹעַם nôʻam, no'-am; from H5276;  agreeableness, i.e. delight, suitableness, splendor or grace:—beauty, pleasant(-ness).

H528.definition: אָמוֹן ʼÂmôwn, aw-mone'; of Egyptian derivation; used only as an adjunct of H4996  Amon (i.e. Ammon or Amn), a deity of Egypt:—multitude, populous.

H5281.definition: נׇעֳמִי Noʻŏmîy, no-om-ee'; from H5278; pleasant;  Noömi, an Israelitess:—Naomi.

H5282.definition: נַעֲמָן naʻămân, nah-am-awn'; from H5276;  pleasantness (plural as concrete):—pleasant.

H5283.definition: נַעֲמָן Naʻămân, nah-am-awn'; the same as H5282;  Naaman, the name of an Israelite and of a Damascene:—Naaman.

H5287.definition: נָעַר nâʻar, naw-ar'; a primitive root (probably identical with H5286, through the idea of the rustling of mane, which usually accompanies the lion's roar);  to tumble about:—shake (off, out, self), overthrow, toss up and down.

H5288.definition: נַעַר naʻar, nah'-ar; from H5287;  (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age):—babe, boy, child, damsel (from the margin), lad, servant, young (man).

H529.definition: אֵמוּן ʼêmûwn, ay-moon'; from H539;  established, i.e. (figuratively) trusty; also (abstractly) trustworthiness:—faith(-ful), truth.

H5291.definition: נַעֲרָה naʻărâh, nah-ar-aw'; feminine of H5288;  a girl (from infancy to adolescence):—damsel, maid(-en), young (woman).

H5292.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper locative noun
H5292.definition: נַעֲרָה Naʻărâh, nah-ar-aw'; the same as H5291;  Naarah, the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine:—Naarah, Naarath.

H5293.definition: נַעֲרַי Naʻăray, nah-ar-ah'-ee; from H5288; youthful;  Naarai, an Israelite:—Naarai.

H5294.definition: נְעַרְיָה Nᵉʻaryâh, neh-ar-yaw'; from H5288 and H3050; servant of Jah;  Nearjah, the name of two Israelites:—Neariah.

H5295.definition: נַעֲרָן Naʻărân, nah-ar-awn'; from H5288; juvenile;  Naaran, a place in Palestine:—Naaran.

H5296.definition: נְעֹרֶת nᵉʻôreth, neh-o'-reth; from H5287;  something shaken out, i.e. tow (as the refuse of flax):—tow.

H5297.definition: נֹף Nôph, nofe; a variation of H4644;  Noph, the capital of Upper Egypt:—Noph.

H5298.definition: נֶפֶג Nepheg, neh'-feg; from an unused root probably meaning to spring forth; a sprout;  Nepheg, the name of two Israelites:—Nepheg.

H53.definition: אֲבִישָׁלוֹם ʼĂbîyshâlôwm, ab-ee-shaw-lome'; or (shortened) אַבְשָׁלוֹם ʼAbshâlôwm ; from H1 and H7965; father of peace (i.e. friendly);  Abshalom, a son of David; also (the fuller form) a later Israelite:—Abishalom, Absalom.

H530.definition: אֱמוּנָה ʼĕmûwnâh, em-oo-naw'; or (shortened) אֱמֻנָה ʼĕmunâh; feminine of H529;  literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity:—faith(-ful, -ly, -ness, (man)), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.

H5304.definition: נְפִיסִים Nᵉphîyçîym, nef-ee-seem'; plural from an unused root meaning to scatter; expansions;  Nephisim, a Temple-servant:—Nephusim (from the margin).

H5305.definition: נָפִישׁ Nâphîysh, naw-feesh'; from H5314; refreshed;  Naphish, a son of Ishmael, and his posterity:—Naphish.

H5306.definition: נֹפֶךְ nôphek, no'-fek; from an unused root meaning to glisten;  shining; a gem, probably the garnet:—emerald.

H5307.definition: נָפַל nâphal, naw-fal'; a primitive root;  to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative):—be accepted, cast (down, self, (lots), out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (cause to, let, make, ready to) fall (away, down, -en, -ing), fell(-ing), fugitive, have (inheritance), inferior, be judged (by mistake for 6419), lay (along), (cause to) lie down, light (down), be (× hast) lost, lying, overthrow, overwhelm, perish, present(-ed, -ing), (make to) rot, slay, smite out, × surely, throw down.

H5308.definition: נְפַל nᵉphal, nef-al'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5307:—fall (down), have occasion.

H5310.definition: נָפַץ nâphats, naw-fats'; a primitive root;  to dash to pieces, or scatter:—be beaten in sunder, break (in pieces), broken, dash (in pieces), cause to be discharged, dispersed, be overspread, scatter.

H5312.definition: נְפַק nᵉphaq, nef-ak'; (Aramaic) a primitive root;  to issue; causatively, to bring out:—come (go, take) forth (out).

H5313.definition: נִפְקָא niphqâʼ, nif-kaw'; (Aramaic) from H5312;  an outgo, i.e. expense:—expense.

H5315.definition: נֶפֶשׁ nephesh, neh'-fesh; from H5314;  properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental):—any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, × dead(-ly), desire, × (dis-) contented, × fish, ghost,   greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, × jeopardy of) life (× in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves,   slay, soul,   tablet, they, thing, (× she) will, × would have it.

H5317.definition: נֹפֶת nôpheth, no'-feth; from H5130 in the sense of shaking to pieces;  a dripping i.e. of honey (from the comb):—honeycomb.

H5321.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5321.definition: נַפְתָּלִי Naphtâlîy, naf-taw-lee'; from H6617; my wrestling;  Naphtali, a son of Jacob, with the tribe descended from him, and its territory:—Naphtali.

H5324.definition: נָצַב nâtsab, naw-tsab'; a primitive root;  to station, in various applications (literally or figuratively):—appointed, deputy, erect, establish, × Huzzah (by mistake for a proper name), lay, officer, pillar, present, rear up, set (over, up), settle, sharpen, establish, (make to) stand(-ing, still, up, upright), best state.

H5327.definition: נָצָה nâtsâh, naw-tsaw'; a primitive root;  properly, to go forth, i.e. (by implication) to be expelled, and (consequently) desolate; causatively, to lay waste; also (specifically), to quarrel:—be laid waste, runinous, strive (together).

H5329.definition: נָצַח nâtsach, naw-tsakh'; a primitive root; also as denominative from H5331  properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent:—excel, chief musician (singer), oversee(-r), set forward.

H5331.definition: נֶצַח netsach, neh'-tsakh; or נֵצַח nêtsach; from H5329;  properly, a goal, i.e. the bright object at a distance travelled towards; hence (figuratively), splendor, or (subjectively) truthfulness, or (objectively) confidence; but usually (adverbially), continually (i.e. to the most distant point of view):—alway(-s), constantly, end, (+ n-) ever(more), perpetual, strength, victory.

H5333.definition: נְצִיב nᵉtsîyb, nets-eeb'; or נְצִב nᵉtsib; from H5324;  something stationary, i.e. a prefect, a military post, a statue:—garrison, officer, pillar.

H5337.definition: נָצַל nâtsal, naw-tsal'; a primitive root;  to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense:—× at all, defend, deliver (self), escape, × without fail, part, pluck, preserve, recover, rescue, rid, save, spoil, strip, × surely, take (out).

H534.definition: אָמִיר ʼâmîyr, aw-meer'; apparently from H559 (in the sense of self-exaltation);  a summit (of a tree or mountain):—bough, branch.

H5340.definition: נָצַץ nâtsats, naw-tsats'; a primitive root;  to glare, i.e. be bright-colored:—sparkle.

H5341.definition: נָצַר nâtsar, naw-tsar'; a primitive root;  to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.):—besieged, hidden thing, keep(-er, -ing), monument, observe, preserve(-r), subtil, watcher(-man).

H5342.definition: נֵצֶר nêtser, nay'-tser; from H5341 in the sense of greenness as a striking color;  a shoot; figuratively, a descendant:—branch.

H5344.definition: נָקַב nâqab, naw-kab'; a primitive root;  to puncture, literally (to perforate, with more or less violence) or figuratively (to specify, designate, libel):—appoint, blaspheme, bore, curse, express, with holes, name, pierce, strike through.

H5347.definition: נְקֵבָה nᵉqêbâh, nek-ay-baw'; from H5344;  female (from the sexual form):—female.

H5348.definition: נָקֹד nâqôd, naw-kode'; from an unused root meaning to mark (by puncturing or branding);  spotted:—speckled.

H535.definition: אָמַל ʼâmal, aw-mal'; a primitive root;  to droop; by implication to be sick, to mourn:—languish, be weak, wax feeble.

H5352.definition: נָקָה nâqâh, naw-kaw'; a primitive root;  to be (or make) clean (literally or figuratively); by implication (in an adverse sense) to be bare, i.e. extirpated:—acquit × at all, × altogether, be blameless, cleanse, (be) clear(-ing), cut off, be desolate, be free, be (hold) guiltless, be (hold) innocent, × by no means, be quit, be (leave) unpunished, × utterly, × wholly.

H5355.definition:
נָקִי nâqîy, naw-kee'; or נָקִיא nâqîyʼ; (Joel 4:19 [Joel 3:19][1]; Jonah 1:14), from H5352;  innocent:—blameless, clean, clear, exempted, free, guiltless, innocent, quit.


    
    
        1. Edited by BLB [Strong's references Joel 4:19 in the Hebrew Bible]

H5356.definition: נִקָּיוֹן niqqâyôwn, nik-kaw-yone'; or נִקָּיֹן niqqâyôn; from H5352;  clearness (literally or figuratively):—cleanness, innocency.

H5358.definition: נָקַם nâqam, naw-kam'; a primitive root;  to grudge, i.e. avenge or punish:—avenge(-r, self), punish, revenge (self), × surely, take vengeance.

H5359.definition: נָקָם nâqâm, naw-kawm'; from H5358;  revenge:—  avenged, quarrel, vengeance.

H5360.definition: נְקָמָה nᵉqâmâh, nek-aw-maw'; feminine of H5359;  avengement, whether the act or the passion:—  avenge, revenge(-ing), vengeance.

H5362.definition: נָקַף nâqaph, naw-kaf'; a primitive root;  to strike with more or less violence (beat, fell, corrode); by implication (of attack) to knock together, i.e. surround or circulate:—compass (about, -ing), cut down, destroy, go round (about), inclose, round.

H5367.definition: נָקַשׁ nâqash, naw-kash'; a primitive root;  to entrap (with a noose), literally or figuratively:—catch (lay a) snare.

H5369.definition: נֵר Nêr, nare; the same as H5216; lamp;  Ner, an Israelite:—Ner.

H5370.definition: נֵרְגַּל Nêrᵉgal, nare-gal'; of foreign origin;  Nergal, a Cuthite deity:—Nergal.

H5371.definition: נֵרְגַּל שַׁרְאֶצֶר Nêrᵉgal Sharʼetser, nare-gal' shar-eh'-tser; from H5370 and H8272;  Nergal-Sharetser, the name of two Babylonians:—Nergal-sharezer.

H5375.definition: נָשָׂא nâsâʼ, naw-saw'; or נָסָה nâçâh; (Psalm 4:6 [7]), a primitive root;  to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative:—accept, advance, arise, (able to, (armor), suffer to) bear(-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honorable (  man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, × needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up,   swear, take (away, up), × utterly, wear, yield.

H5376.definition: נְשָׂא nᵉsâʼ, nes-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5375:—carry away, make insurrection, take.

H5377.definition: נָשָׁא nâshâʼ, naw-shaw'; a primitive root;  to lead astray, i.e. (mentally) to delude, or (morally) to seduce:—beguile, deceive, × greatly, × utterly.

H5378.definition: נָשָׁא nâshâʼ, naw-shaw'; a primitive root (perhaps identical with H5377, through the idea of imposition);  to lend on interest; by implication, to dun for debt:—× debt, exact, giver of usury.

H538.definition: אֲמָם ʼĂmâm, am-awm'; from H517; gathering-spot;  Amam, a place in Palestine:—Amam.

H5380.definition: נָשַׁב nâshab, naw-shab'; a primitive root;  to blow; by implication, to disperse:—(cause to) blow, drive away.

H5381.definition: נָשַׂג nâsag, naw-sag'; a primitive root;  to reach (literally or figuratively):—ability, be able, attain (unto), (be able to, can) get, lay at, put, reach, remove, wax rich, × surely, (over-) take (hold of, on, upon).

H5387.definition: נָשִׂיא nâsîyʼ, naw-see'; or נָשִׂא nâsiʼ; from H5375;  properly, an exalted one, i.e. a king or sheik; also a rising mist:—captain, chief, cloud, governor, prince, ruler, vapour.

H539.definition: אָמַן ʼâman, aw-man'; a primitive root; (Isaiah 30:21; interchangeable with H541, to go to the right hand)  properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain;:—hence, assurance, believe, bring up, establish,   fail, be faithful (of long continuance, stedfast, sure, surely, trusty, verified), nurse, (-ing father), (put), trust, turn to the right.

H5391.definition: נָשַׁךְ nâshak, naw-shak'; a primitive root;  to strike with a sting (as a serpent); figuratively, to oppress with interest on a loan:—bite, lend upon usury.

H5392.definition: נֶשֶׁךְ neshek, neh'-shek; from H5391;  interest on a debt:—usury.

H5394.definition: נָשַׁל nâshal, naw-shal'; a primitive root;  to pluck off, i.e. divest, eject or drop:—cast (out), drive, loose, put off (out), slip.

H5395.definition: נָשַׁם nâsham, naw-sham'; a primitive root;  properly, to blow away, i.e. destroy:—destroy.

H5397.definition: נְשָׁמָה nᵉshâmâh, nesh-aw-maw'; from H5395;  a puff, i.e. wind, angry or vital breath, divine inspiration, intellect. or (concretely) an animal:—blast, (that) breath(-eth), inspiration, soul, spirit.

H5398.definition: נָשַׁף nâshaph, naw-shaf'; a primitive root;  to breeze, i.e. blow up fresh (as the wind):—blow.

H5399.definition: נֶשֶׁף nesheph, neh'-shef; from H5398;  properly, a breeze, i.e. (by implication) dusk (when the evening breeze prevails):—dark, dawning of the day (morning), night, twilight.

H54.definition: אֶבְיָתָר ʼEbyâthâr, ab-yaw-thawr'; contracted from H1 and H3498; father of abundance (i.e. liberal);  Ebjathar, an Israelite:—Abiathar.

H5400.definition: נָשַׂק nâsaq, naw-sak'; a primitive root;  to catch fire:—burn, kindle.

H5401.definition: נָשַׁק nâshaq, naw-shak'; a primitive root (identical with H5400, through the idea of fastening up; compare H2388, H2836);  to kiss, literally or figuratively (touch); also (as a mode of attachment), to equip with weapons:—armed (men), rule, kiss, that touched.

H5402.definition: נֶשֶׁק nesheq, neh'-shek; or נֵשֶׁק nêsheq; from H5401;  military equipment, i.e. (collectively) arms (offensive or defensive), or (concretely) an arsenal:—armed men, armour(-y), battle, harness, weapon.

H5404.definition: נֶשֶׁר nesher, neh'-sher; from an unused root meaning to lacerate;  the eagle (or other large bird of prey):—eagle.

H5407.definition: נִשְׁתְּוָן nishtᵉvân, nish-tev-awn'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5406:—letter.

H5409.definition: נֵתַח nêthach, nay'-thakh; from H5408;  a fragment:—part, piece.

H5410.definition: נָתִיב nâthîyb, naw-theeb'; or (feminine) נְתִיבָה nᵉthîybâh; or נְתִבָה nᵉthibâh; (Jeremiah 6:16), from an unused root meaning to tramp;  a (beaten) track:—path(-way), × travel(-ler), way.

H5414.definition: נָתַן nâthan, naw-than'; a primitive root;  to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.):—add, apply, appoint, ascribe, assign, × avenge, × be (healed), bestow, bring (forth, hither), cast, cause, charge, come, commit, consider, count,   cry, deliver (up), direct, distribute, do, × doubtless, × without fail, fasten, frame, × get, give (forth, over, up), grant, hang (up), × have, × indeed, lay (unto charge, up), (give) leave, lend, let (out),   lie, lift up, make,   O that, occupy, offer, ordain, pay, perform, place, pour, print, × pull, put (forth), recompense, render, requite, restore, send (out), set (forth), shew, shoot forth (up),   sing,   slander, strike, (sub-) mit, suffer, × surely, × take, thrust, trade, turn, utter,   weep,   willingly,   withdraw,   would (to) God, yield.

H5415.definition: נְתַן nᵉthan, neth-an'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5414;  give:—bestow, give pay.

H5416.definition: נָתָן Nâthân, naw-thawn'; from H5414; given;  Nathan, the name of five Israelites:—Nathan.

H5417.definition: נְתַנְאֵל Nᵉthanʼêl, neth-an-ale'; from H5414 and H410; given of God;  Nethanel, the name of ten Israelites:—Nethaneel.

H5418.definition: נְתַנְיָה Nᵉthanyâh, neth-an-yaw'; or נְתַנְיָהוּ Nᵉthanyâhûw; from H5414 and H3050; given of Jah;  Nethanjah, the name of four Israelites:—Nethaniah.

H5422.definition: נָתַץ nâthats, naw-thats'; a primitive root;  to tear down:—beat down, break down (out), cast down, destroy, overthrow, pull down, throw down.

H5423.definition: נָתַק nâthaq, naw-thak'; a primitive root;  to tear off:—break (off), burst, draw (away), lift up, pluck (away, off), pull (out), root out.

H5425.definition: נָתַר nâthar, naw-thar'; a primitive root;  to jump, i.e. be violently agitated; causatively, to terrify, shake off, untie:—drive asunder, leap, (let) loose, × make, move, undo.

H5428.definition: נָתַשׁ nâthash, naw-thash'; a primitive root;  to tear away:—destroy, forsake, pluck (out, up, by the roots), pull up, root out (up), × utterly.

H543.definition: אָמֵן ʼâmên, aw-mane'; from H539;  sure; abstract, faithfulness; adverb, truly:—Amen, so be it, truth.

H5430.definition: סְאוֹן çᵉʼôwn, seh-own'; from H5431;  perhaps a military boot (as a protection from mud):—battle.

H5431.definition: סָאַן çâʼan, saw-an'; a primitive root; to be miry; used only as denominative from H5430;  to shoe, i.e. (active participle) a soldier shod:—warrior.

H5434.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5434.definition: סְבָא Çᵉbâʼ, seb-aw'; of foreign origin;  Seba, a son of Cush, and the country settled by him:—Seba.

H5437.definition: סָבַב çâbab, saw-bab'; a primitive root;  to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively:—bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, × whirl, × round about, be about on every side, apply, avoid, beset (about), besiege, bring again, carry (about), change, cause to come about, × circuit, (fetch a) compass (about, round), drive, environ, × on every side, beset (close, come, compass, go, stand) round about, inclose, remove, return, set, sit down, turn (self) (about, aside, away, back).

H5439.definition: סָבִיב çâbîyb, saw-beeb'; or (feminine) סְבִיבָה çᵉbîybâh; from H5437;  (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around:—(place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.

H5443.definition: סַבְּכָא çabbᵉkâʼ, sab-bek-aw'; (Aramaic) or שַׂבְּכָא sabbᵉkâʼ; (Aramaic), from a root corresponding to H5440;  a lyre:—sackbut.

H5444.definition: סִבְּכַי Çibbᵉkay, sib-bek-ah'-ee; from H5440; copse-like;  Sibbecai, an Israelite:—Sibbecai, Sibbechai.

H5445.definition: סָבַל çâbal, saw-bal'; a primitive root;  to carry (literally or figuratively), or (reflexively) be burdensome; specifically, to be gravid:—bear, be a burden, carry, strong to labour.

H5447.definition: סֵבֶל çêbel, say'-bel; from H5445;  a load (literally or figuratively):—burden, charge.

H5451.definition: סִבֹּלֶת çibbôleth, sib-bo'-leth; for H7641;  an ear of grain:—Sibboleth.

H5453.definition: סִבְרַיִם Çibrayim, sib-rah'-yim; dual from a root corresponding to H5452; double hope;  Sibrajim, a place in Syria:—Sibraim.

H5454.definition: סַבְתָּא Çabtâʼ, sab-taw'; or סַבְתָּה Çabtâh; probably of foreign derivation;  Sabta or Sabtah, the name of a son of Cush, and the country occupied by his posterity:—Sabta, Sabtah.

H5456.definition: סָגַד çâgad, saw-gad'; a primitive root;  to prostrate oneself (in homage):—fall down.

H5457.definition: סְגִד çᵉgid, seg-eed'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5456:—worship.

H546.definition: אׇמְנָה ʼomnâh, om-naw'; feminine form of H544 (in its usual sense);  adverb, surely:—indeed.

H5460.definition: סְגַן çᵉgan, seg-an'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5461:—governor.

H5462.definition: סָגַר çâgar, saw-gar'; a primitive root;  to shut up; figuratively, to surrender:—close up, deliver (up), give over (up), inclose, × pure, repair, shut (in, self, out, up, up together), stop, × straitly.

H5466.definition: סָדִין çâdîyn, saw-deen'; from an unused root meaning to envelop;  a wrapper, i.e. shirt:—fine linen, sheet.

H5467.definition: סְדֹם Çᵉdôm, sed-ome'; from an unused root meaning to scorch; burnt (i.e. volcanic or bituminous) district;  Sedom, a place near the Dead Sea:—Sodom.

H5468.definition: סֶדֶר çeder, seh'-der; from an unused root meaning to arrange;  order:—order.

H5472.definition: סוּג çûwg, soog; a primitive root;  properly, to flinch, i.e. (by implication) to go back, literally (to retreat) or figuratively (to apostatize):—backslider, drive, go back, turn (away, back).

H5475.definition: סוֹד çôwd, sode; from H3245;  a session, i.e. company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication, intimacy, consultation, a secret:—assembly, consel, inward, secret (counsel).

H5477.definition: סוּחַ Çûwach, soo'-akh; from an unused root meaning to wipe away; sweeping;  Suach, an Israelite:—Suah.

H5480.definition: סוּךְ çûwk, sook; a primitive root;  properly, to smear over (with oil), i.e. anoint:—anoint (self), × at all.

H5481.definition: סוּמְפּוֹנְיָה çûwmᵉpôwnᵉyâh, soom-po-neh-yaw'; (Aramaic) or סוּמְפֹּנְיָה çûwmᵉpônᵉyâh; (Aramaic), or סִיפֹנְיָא çîyphônᵉyâʼ; (Daniel 3:10) (Aramaic), of Greek origin;  a bagpipe (with a double pipe):—dulcimer.

H5483.definition: סוּס çûwç, soos; or סֻס çuç; from an unused root meaning to skip (properly, for joy);  a horse (as leaping); also a swallow (from its rapid flight):—crane, horse (-back, -hoof). Compare H6571.

H5487.definition: סוּף çûwph, soof; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5486;  to come to an end:—consume, fulfill.

H5489.definition: סוּף Çûwph, soof; for H5488 (by ellipsis of H3220);  the Reed (Sea):—Red Sea.

H5493.definition: סוּר çûwr, soor; or שׂוּר sûwr; (Hosea 9:12), a primitive root;  to turn off (literally or figuratively):—be(-head), bring, call back, decline, depart, eschew, get (you), go (aside), × grievous, lay away (by), leave undone, be past, pluck away, put (away, down), rebel, remove (to and fro), revolt, × be sour, take (away, off), turn (aside, away, in), withdraw, be without.

H5495.definition: סוּר Çûwr, soor; the same as H5494;  Sur, a gate of the temple:—Sur.

H5496.definition: סוּת çûwth, sooth; perhaps denominative from H7898;  properly, to prick, i.e. (figuratively) stimulate; by implication, to seduce:—entice, move, persuade, provoke, remove, set on, stir up, take away.

H5499.definition: סְחָבָה çᵉchâbâh, seh-khaw-baw'; from H5498;  a rag:—cast clout.

H55.definition: אָבַךְ ʼâbak, aw-bak'; a primitive root;  probably to coil upward:—mount up.

H550.definition: אַמְנוֹן ʼAmnôwn, am-nohn'; or אֲמִינוֹן ʼĂmîynôwn; from H539; faithful;  Amnon (or Aminon), a son of David:—Amnon.

H5503.definition: סָחַר çâchar, saw-khar'; a primitive root;  to travel round (specifically as a pedlar); intensively, to palpitate:—go about, merchant(-man), occupy with, pant, trade, traffick.

H5509.definition: סִיג çîyg, seeg; or סוּג çûwg; (Ezekiel 22:18), from H5472 in the sense of refuse;  scoria:—dross.

H551.definition: אׇמְנָם ʼomnâm, om-nawm'; adverb from H544;  verily:—indeed, no doubt, surely, (it is, of a) true(-ly, -th).

H5510.definition: סִיוָן Çîyvân, see-vawn'; probably of Persian origin;  Sivan, the third Hebrew month:—Sivan.

H5511.definition: סִיחוֹן Çîychôwn, see-khone'; or סִיחֹן Çîychôn; from the same as H5477; tempestuous;  Sichon, an Amoritish king:—Sihon.

H5514.definition: סִינַי Çîynay, see-nah'-ee; of uncertain derivation;  Sinai, mountain of Arabia:—Sinai.

H5516.definition: סִיסְרָא Çîyçᵉrâʼ, see-ser-aw'; of uncertain derivation;  Sisera, the name of a Canaanitish king and of one of the Nethinim:—Sisera.

H5518.definition: סִיר çîyr, seer; or (feminine) סִירָה çîyrâh; or סִרָה çirâh; (Jeremiah 52:18), from a primitive root meaning to boil up;  a pot; also a thorn (as springing up rapidly); by implication, a hook:—caldron, fishhook, pan, (wash-)pot, thorn.

H552.definition: אֻמְנָם ʼumnâm, oom-nawm'; an orthographical variation of H551:—in (very) deed; of a surety.

H5521.definition: סֻכָּה çukkâh, sook-kaw'; feminine of H5520;  a hut or lair:—booth, cottage, covert, pavilion, tabernacle, tent.

H5523.definition: סֻכּוֹת Çukkôwth, sook-kohth'; or סֻכֹּת Çukkôth; plural of H5521; booths;  Succoth, the name of a place in Egypt and of three in Palestine:—Succoth.

H5524.definition: סֻכּוֹת בְּנוֹת Çukkôwth bᵉnôwth, sook-kohth' ben-ohth'; from H5523 and the (irregular) plural of H1323;  booths of (the) daughters; brothels, i.e. idoalatrous tents for impure purpose:—Succothbenoth.

H5526.definition: סָכַךְ çâkak, saw-kak'; or שָׂכַךְ sâkak; (Exodus 33:22), a primitive root;  properly, to entwine as a screen; by implication, to fence in, cover over, (figuratively) protect:—cover, defence, defend, hedge in, join together, set, shut up.

H5528.definition: סָכַל çâkal, saw-kal'; for H3688;  to be silly:—do (make, play the, turn into) fool(-ish, -ishly, -ishness).

H5529.definition: סֶכֶל çekel, seh'-kal; from H5528;  silliness; concretely and collectively, dolts:—folly.

H553.definition: אָמַץ ʼâmats, aw-mats'; a primitive root;  to be alert, physically (on foot) or mentally (in courage):—confirm, be courageous (of good courage, stedfastly minded, strong, stronger), establish, fortify, harden, increase, prevail, strengthen (self), make strong (obstinate, speed).

H5531.definition: סִכְלוּת çiklûwth, sik-looth'; or שִׂכְלוּת siklûwth; (Ecclesiastes 1:17), from H5528;  silliness:—folly, foolishness.

H5532.definition: סָכַן çâkan, saw-kan'; a primitive root;  to be familiar with; by implication, to minister to, be serviceable to, to cherish, be customary:—acquaint (self), be advantage, × ever, (be, (un-)) profit(-able), treasurer, be wont.

H5536.definition: סַל çal, sal; from H5549;  properly, a willow twig (as pendulous), i.e. an osier; but only as woven into a basket:—basket.

H554.definition: אָמֹץ ʼâmôts, aw-mohts'; probably from H553;  of a strong color, i.e. red (others fleet):—bay.

H5540.definition: סֶלֶד Çeled, seh'-led; from H5539; exultation;  Seled, an Israelite:—Seled.

H5542.definition: סֶלָה çelâh, seh'-law; from H5541;  suspension (of music), i.e. pause:—Selah.

H5543.definition: סַלּוּ Çallûw, sal-loo'; or סַלּוּא Çallûwʼ; or סָלוּא Çâlûwʼ; or סַלַּי Çallay; from H5541; weighed;  Sallu or Sallai, the name of two Israelites:—Sallai, Sallu, Salu.

H5544.definition: סִלּוֹן çillôwn, sil-lone'; or סַלּוֹן çallôwn; from H5541;  a prickle (as if pendulous):—brier, thorn.

H5545.definition: סָלַח çâlach, saw-lakh'; a primitive root;  to forgive:—forgive, pardon, spare.

H5549.definition: סָלַל çâlal, saw-lal'; a primitive root;  to mound up (especially a turnpike); figurative, to exalt; reflexively, to oppose (as by a dam):—cast up, exalt (self), extol, make plain, raise up.

H5553.definition: סֶלַע çelaʻ, seh'-lah; from an unused root meaning to be lofty;  a craggy rock, literally or figuratively (a fortress):—(ragged) rock, stone(-ny), strong hold.

H5554.definition: סֶלַע Çelaʻ, seh'-lah; the same as H5553;  Sela, the rock-city of Idumaea:—rock, Sela(-h).

H5556.definition: סׇלְעָם çolʻâm, sol-awm'; apparently from the same as H5553 in the sense of crushing as with a rock, i.e. consuming;  a kind of locust (from its destructiveness):—bald locust.

H5559.definition: סְלִק çᵉliq, sel-eek'; (Aramaic) a primitive root;  to ascend:—come (up).

H5560.definition: סֹלֶת çôleth, so'-leth; from an unused root meaning to strip;  flour (as chipped off):—(fine) flour, meal.

H5561.definition: סַם çam, sam; from an unused root meaning to smell sweet;  an aroma:—sweet (spice).

H5564.definition: סָמַךְ çâmak, saw-mak'; a primitive root;  to prop (literally or figuratively); reflexively, to lean upon or take hold of (in a favorable or unfavorable sense):—bear up, establish, (up-) hold, lay, lean, lie hard, put, rest self, set self, stand fast, stay (self), sustain.

H5566.definition: סֶמֶל çemel, seh'-mel; or סֵמֶל çêmel; from an unused root meaning to resemble;  a likeness:—figure, idol, image.

H5568.definition: סָמַר çâmar, saw-mar'; a primitive root;  to be erect, i.e. bristle as hair:—stand up, tremble.

H5571.definition: סַנְבַלַּט Çanballaṭ, san-bal-lat'; of foreign origin;  Sanballat, a Persian satrap of Samaria:—Sanballat.

H5573.definition: סֶנֶה Çeneh, seh-neh'; the same as H5572; thorn;  Seneh, a crag in Palestine:—Seneh.

H5576.definition: סַנְחֵרִיב Çanchêrîyb, san-khay-reeb'; of foreign origin;  Sancherib, an Assyrian king:—Sennacherib.

H5579.definition: סְנַפִּיר çᵉnappîyr, sen-ap-peer'; of uncertain derivation;  a fin (collectively):—fins.

H558.definition: אֲמַצְיָה ʼĂmatsyâh, am-ats-yaw'; or אֲמַצְיָהוּ ʼĂmatsyâhûw; from H553 and H3050; strength of Jah;  Amatsjah, the name of four Israelites:—Amaziah.

H5587.definition: סָעִף çâʻiph, saw-eef'; or שָׂעִף sâʻiph; from H5586;  divided (in mind), i.e. (abstractly) a sentiment:—opinion.

H559.definition: אָמַר ʼâmar, aw-mar'; a primitive root;  to say (used with great latitude):—answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge,   (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, × desire, determine, × expressly, × indeed, × intend, name, × plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), × still, × suppose, talk, tell, term, × that is, × think, use (speech), utter, × verily, × yet.

H5590.definition: סָעַר çâʻar, saw-ar'; a primitive root;  to rush upon; by implication, to toss (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative):—be (toss with) tempest(-uous), be sore, troubled, come out as a (drive with the, scatter with a) whirlwind.

H5591.definition: סַעַר çaʻar, sah'-ar; or (feminine) סְעָרָה çᵉʻârâh; from H5590;  a hurricane:—storm(-y), tempest, whirlwind.

H5592.definition: סַף çaph, saf; from H5605, in its original sense of containing;  a vestibule (as a limit); also a dish (for holding blood or wine):—bason, bowl, cup, door (post), gate, post, threshold.

H5593.definition: סַף Çaph, saf; the same as H5592;  Saph, a Philistine:—Saph. Compare H5598.

H5594.definition: סָפַד çâphad, saw-fad'; a primitive root;  properly, to tear the hair and beat the breasts (as Orientals do in grief); generally to lament; by implication, to wail:—lament, mourn(-er), wail.

H5595.definition: סָפָה çâphâh, saw-faw'; a primitive root;  properly, to scrape (literally, to shave; but usually figuratively) together (i.e. to accumulate or increase) or away (i.e. to scatter, remove, or ruin; intransitively, to perish):—add, augment, consume, destroy, heap, join, perish, put.

H5596.definition: סָפַח çâphach, saw-fakh'; or שָׂפַח sâphach; (Isaiah 3:17), a primitive root;  properly, to scrape out, but in certain peculiar senses (of removal or association):—abiding, gather together, cleave, smite with the scab.

H5598.definition: סִפַּי Çippay, sip-pah'-ee; from H5592; bason-like;  Sippai, a Philistine:—Sippai. Compare H5593.

H5599.definition: סָפִיחַ çâphîyach, saw-fee'-akh; from H5596;  something (spontaneously) falling off, i.e. a self-sown crop; figuratively, a freshet:—(such) things as (which) grow (of themselves), which groweth of its own accord (itself).

H56.definition: אָבַל ʼâbal, aw-bal'; a primitive root;  to bewail:—lament, mourn.

H560.definition: אֲמַר ʼămar, am-ar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H559:—command, declare, say, speak, tell.

H5602.definition: סֵפֶל çêphel, say'-fel; from an unused root meaning to depress;  a basin (as deepened out):—bowl, dish.

H5606.definition: סָפַק çâphaq, saw-fak'; or שָׂפַק sâphaq; (1 Kings 20:10; Job 27:23; Isaiah 2:6), a primitive root;  to clap the hands (in token of compact, derision, grief, indignation, or punishment); by implication of satisfaction, to be enough; by implication of excess, to vomit:—clap, smite, strike, suffice, wallow.

H5608.definition: סָפַר çâphar, saw-far'; a primitive root;  properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate:—commune, (ac-) count; declare, number,   penknife, reckon, scribe, shew forth, speak, talk, tell (out), writer.

H561.definition: אֵמֶר ʼêmer, ay'-mer; from H559;  something said:—answer, × appointed unto him, saying, speech, word.

H5612.definition: סֵפֶר çêpher, say'-fer; or (feminine) סִפְרָה çiphrâh; (Psalm 56:8 (H9)), from H5608;  properly, writing (the art or a document); by implication, a book:—bill, book, evidence, × learn(-ed) (-ing), letter, register, scroll.

H5619.definition: סָקַל çâqal, saw-kal'; a primitive root;  properly, to be weighty; but used only in the sense of lapidation or its contrary (as if a delapidation):—(cast, gather out, throw) stone(-s), × surely.

H562.definition: אֹמֶר ʼômer, o'-mer; the same as H561:—promise, speech, thing, word.

H5620.definition: סַר çar, sar; contracted from H5637;  peevish:—heavy, sad.

H5624.definition: סֶרֶד Çered, seh'-red; from a primitive root meaning to tremble; trembling;  Sered, an Israelite:—Sered.

H5627.definition: סָרָה çârâh, saw-raw'; from H5493;  apostasy, crime; figuratively, remission:—× continual, rebellion, revolt(-ed), turn away, wrong.

H5628.definition: סָרַח çârach, saw-rakh'; a primitive root;  to extend (even to excess):—exceeding, hand, spread, stretch self, banish.

H5629.definition: סֶרַח çerach, seh'-rakh; from H5628;  a redundancy:—remnant.

H563.definition: אִמַּר ʼimmar, im-mar'; (Aramaic) perhaps from H560 (in the sense of bringing forth);  a lamb:—lamb.

H5631.definition: סָרִיס çârîyç, saw-reece'; or סָרִס çâriç; from an unused root meaning to castrate;  a eunuch; by implication, valet (especially of the female apartments), and thus, a minister of state:—chamberlain, eunuch, officer. Compare H7249.

H5633.definition: סֶרֶן çeren, seh'-ren; from an unused root of uncertain meaning;  an axle; figuratively, a peer:—lord, plate.

H5637.definition: סָרַר çârar, saw-rar'; a primitive root;  to turn away, i.e. (morally) be refractory:—× away, backsliding, rebellious, revolter(-ing), slide back, stubborn, withdrew.

H5639.definition: סְתוּר Çᵉthûwr, seth-oor'; from H5641; hidden;  Sethur, an Israelite:—Sethur.

H5640.definition: סָתַם çâtham, saw-tham'; or שָׂתַם sâtham; (Numbers 24:15), a primitive root;  to stop up; by implication, to repair; figuratively, to keep secret:—closed up, hidden, secret, shut out (up), stop.

H5641.definition: סָתַר çâthar, saw-thar'; a primitive root;  to hide (by covering), literally or figuratively:—be absent, keep close, conceal, hide (self), (keep) secret, × surely.

H5642.definition: סְתַר çᵉthar, seth-ar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5641;  to conceal; figuratively, to demolish:—destroy, secret thing.

H5643.definition: סֵתֶר çêther, say'-ther; or (feminine) סִתְרָה çithrâh; (Deuteronomy 32:38), from H5641;  a cover (in a good or a bad, a literal or a figurative sense):—backbiting, covering, covert, × disguise(-th), hiding place, privily, protection, secret(-ly, place).

H5645.definition: עָב ʻâb, awb; (masculine and feminine); from H5743;  properly, an envelope, i.e. darkness (or density, 2 Chronicles 4:17); specifically, a (scud) cloud; also a copse:—clay, (thick) cloud, × thick, thicket. Compare H5672.

H5647.definition: עָבַד ʻâbad, aw-bad'; a primitive root;  to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.:—× be, keep in bondage, be bondmen, bond-service, compel, do, dress, ear, execute,   husbandman, keep, labour(-ing man, bring to pass, (cause to, make to) serve(-ing, self), (be, become) servant(-s), do (use) service, till(-er), transgress (from margin), (set a) work, be wrought, worshipper,

H5648.definition: עֲבַד ʻăbad, ab-bad'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5647;  to do, make, prepare, keep, etc.:—× cut, do, execute, go on, make, move, work.

H5649.definition: עֲבַד ʻăbad, ab-bad'; (Aramaic) from H5648;  a servant:—servant.

H565.definition: אִמְרָה ʼimrâh, im-raw'; or אֶמְרָה ʼemrâh; feminine of H561, and meaning the same:—commandment, speech, word.

H5650.definition: עֶבֶד ʻebed, eh'-bed; from H5647;  a servant:—× bondage, bondman, (bond-) servant, (man-) servant.

H5651.definition: עֶבֶד ʻEbed, eh'-bed; the same as H5650;  Ebed, the name of two Israelites:—Ebed.

H5654.definition: עֹבֵד אֱדוֹם ʻÔbêd ʼĔdôwm, o-bade' ed-ome'; from the active participle of H5647 and H123; worker of Edom;  Obed-Edom, the name of five Israelites:—Obed-edom.

H5656.definition: עֲבֹדָה ʻăbôdâh, ab-o-daw'; or עֲבוֹדָה ʻăbôwdâh; from H5647;  work of any kind:—act, bondage,   bondservant, effect, labour, ministering(-try), office, service(-ile, -itude), tillage, use, work, × wrought.

H5657.definition: עֲבֻדָּה ʻăbuddâh, ab-ood-daw'; passive participle of H5647;  something wrought, i.e. (concretely) service:—household, store of servants.

H5658.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5658.definition: עַבְדוֹן ʻAbdôwn, ab-dohn'; from H5647; servitude;  Abdon, the name of a place in Palestine and of four Israelites:—Abdon. Compare H5683.

H5660.definition: עַבְדִּי ʻAbdîy, ab-dee'; from H5647; serviceable;  Abdi, the name of two Israelites:—Abdi.

H5662.definition: עֹבַדְיָה ʻÔbadyâh, o-bad-yaw'; or עֹבַדְיָהוּ ʻÔbadyâhûw; active participle of H5647 and H3050; serving Jah;  Obadjah, the name of thirteen Israelites:—Obadiah.

H5663.definition: עֶבֶד מֶלֶךְ ʻEbed Melek, eh'-bed meh'-lek; from H5650 and H4428; servant of a king;  Ebed-Melek, a eunuch of Zedekeah:—Ebed-melech.

H5668.definition: עָבוּר ʻâbûwr, aw-boor'; or עָבֻר ʻâbur; passive participle of H5674;  properly, crossed, i.e. (abstractly) transit; used only adverbially, on account of, in order that:—because of, for (...'s sake), (intent) that, to.

H5670.definition: עָבַט ʻâbaṭ, aw-bat'; a primitive root;  to pawn; causatively, to lend (on security); figuratively, to entangle:—borrow, break (ranks), fetch (a pledge), lend, × surely.

H5673.definition: עֲבִידָה ʻăbîydâh, ab-ee-daw'; (Aramaic) from H5648;  labor or business:—affairs, service, work.

H5674.definition: עָבַר ʻâbar, aw-bar'; a primitive root;  to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation):—alienate, alter, × at all, beyond, bring (over, through), carry over, (over-) come (on, over), conduct (over), convey over, current, deliver, do away, enter, escape, fail, gender, get over, (make) go (away, beyond, by, forth, his way, in, on, over, through), have away (more), lay, meddle, overrun, make partition, (cause to, give, make to, over) pass(-age, along, away, beyond, by, -enger, on, out, over, through), (cause to, make)   proclaim(-amation), perish, provoke to anger, put away, rage,   raiser of taxes, remove, send over, set apart,   shave, cause to (make) sound, × speedily, × sweet smelling, take (away), (make to) transgress(-or), translate, turn away, (way-) faring man, be wrath.

H5676.definition: עֵבֶר ʻêber, ay'-ber; from H5674;  properly, a region across; but used only adverbially (with or without a preposition) on the opposite side (especially of the Jordan; ususally meaning the east):—× against, beyond, by, × from, over, passage, quarter, (other, this) side, straight.

H5677.definition: עֵבֵר ʻÊbêr, ay'-ber; the same as H5676;  Eber, the name of two patriarchs and four Israelites:—Eber, Heber.

H5678.definition: עֶבְרָה ʻebrâh, eb-raw'; feminine of H5676;  an outburst of passion:—anger, rage, wrath.

H568.definition: אֲמַרְיָה ʼĂmaryâh, am-ar-yaw'; or prolonged אֲמַרְיָהוּ ʼĂmaryâhûw; from H559 and H3050; Jah has said (i.e. promised);  Amarjah, the name of nine Israelites:—Amariah.

H5680.definition: עִבְרִי ʻIbrîy, ib-ree'; patronymic from H5677;  an Eberite (i.e. Hebrew) or descendant of Eber:—Hebrew(-ess, woman).

H5682.definition: עֲבָרִים ʻĂbârîym, ab-aw-reem'; plural of H5676; regions beyond;  Abarim, a place in Palestine:—Abarim, passages.

H5687.definition: עָבֹת ʻâbôth, aw-both'; or עָבוֹת ʻâbôwth; from H5686;  intwined, i.e. dense:—thick.

H5688.definition: עֲבֹת ʻăbôth, ab-oth'; or עֲבוֹת ʻăbôwth; or (feminine) עֲבֹתָה ʻăbôthâh; the same as H5687;  something intwined, i.e. a string, wreath or foliage:—band, cord, rope, thick bough (branch), wreathen (chain).

H5692.definition: עֻגָּה ʻuggâh, oog-gaw'; from H5746;  an ashcake (as round):—cake (upon the hearth).

H5694.definition: עָגִיל ʻâgîyl, aw-gheel'; from the same as H5696;  something round, i.e. a ring (for the ears):—earring.

H5695.definition: עֵגֶל ʻêgel, ay-ghel; from the same as H5696;  a (male) calf (as frisking round), especially one nearly grown (i.e. a steer):—bullock, calf.

H5696.definition: עָגֹל ʻâgôl, aw-gole'; or עָגוֹל ʻâgôwl; from an unused root meaning to revolve,  circular:—round.

H5697.definition: עֶגְלָה ʻeglâh, eg-law'; feminine of H5695;  a (female) calf, especially one nearly grown (i.e. a heifer):—calf, cow, heifer.

H5698.definition: עֶגְלָה ʻEglâh, eg-law'; the same as H5697;  Eglah, a wife of David:—Eglah.

H5699.definition: עֲגָלָה ʻăgâlâh, ag-aw-law'; from the same as H5696;  something revolving, i.e. a wheeled vehicle:—cart, chariot, wagon

H57.definition: אָבֵל ʼâbêl, aw-bale'; from H56;  lamenting:—mourn(-er, -ing).

H570.definition: אֶמֶשׁ ʼemesh, eh'-mesh; time past, i.e.  yesterday or last night:—former time, yesterday(-night)

H5700.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5700.definition: עֶגְלוֹן ʻEglôwn, eg-lawn'; from H5695; vituline;  Eglon, the name of a place in Palestine and of a Moabitish king:—Eglon.

H5701.definition: עָגַם ʻâgam, aw-gam'; a primitive root;  to be sad:—grieve.

H5702.definition: עָגַן ʻâgan, aw-gan'; a primitive root;  to debar, i.e. from marriage:—stay.

H5703.definition: עַד ʻad, ad; from H5710;  properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition):—eternity, ever(-lasting, -more), old, perpetually,   world without end.

H5704.definition: עַד ʻad, ad; properly, the same as H5703 (used as a preposition, adverb or conjunction; especially with a preposition);  as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with):—against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to,   how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, (+ as) yet.

H5705.definition: עַד ʻad, ad; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5704:—× and, at, for, (hither-) to, on till, (un-) to, until, within.

H5707.definition: עֵד ʻêd, ayd; contracted from H5749;  concretely, a witness; abstractly, testimony; specifically, a recorder, i.e. prince:—witness.

H5709.definition: עֲדָא ʻădâʼ, ad-aw'; (Aramaic) or עֲדָה ʻădâh; (Aramaic), corresponding to H5710:—alter, depart, pass (away), remove, take (away).

H571.definition: אֶמֶת ʼemeth, eh'-meth; contracted from H539;  stability; (figuratively) certainty, truth, trustworthiness:—assured(-ly), establishment, faithful, right, sure, true (-ly, -th), verity.

H5710.definition: עָדָה ʻâdâh, aw-daw'; a primitive root;  to advance, i.e. pass on or continue; causatively, to remove; specifically, to bedeck (i.e. bring an ornament upon):—adorn, deck (self), pass by, take away.

H5711.definition: עָדָה ʻÂdâh, aw-daw'; from H5710; ornament;  Adah, the name of two women:—Adah.

H5712.definition: עֵדָה ʻêdâh, ay-daw'; feminine of H5707 in the original sense of fixture;  a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse, or generally, a family or crowd):—assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare H5713.

H5714.definition: עִדּוֹ ʻIddôw, id-do'; or עִדּוֹא ʻIddôwʼ; or עִדִּיא ʻIddîyʼ; from H5710; timely;  Iddo (or Iddi), the name of five Israelites:—Iddo. Compare H3035, H3260.
