H5716.definition: עֲדִי ʻădîy, ad-ee'; from H5710 in the sense of trappings;  finery; generally an outfit; specifically, a headstall:—× excellent, mouth, ornament.

H5717.definition: עֲדִיאֵל ʻĂdîyʼêl, ad-ee-ale'; from H5716 and H410; ornament of God;  Adiel, the name of three Israelites:—Adiel.

H5718.definition: עֲדָיָה ʻĂdâyâh, ad-aw-yaw'; or עֲדָיָהוּ ʻĂdâyâhûw; from H5710 and H3050; Jah has adorned;  Adajah, the name of eight Israelites:—Adaiah.

H5719.definition: עָדִין ʻâdîyn, aw-deen'; from H5727;  voluptuous:—given to pleasures.

H572.definition: אַמְתַּחַת ʼamtachath, am-takh'-ath; from H4969;  properly, something expansive, i.e. a bag:—sack.

H5720.definition: עָדִין ʻÂdîyn, aw-deen'; the same as H5719;  Adin, the name of two Israelites:—Adin.

H5721.definition: עֲדִינָא ʻĂdîynâʼ, ad-ee-naw'; from H5719; effeminacy;  Adina, an Israelite:—Adina.

H5725.definition: עֲדֻלָּם ʻĂdullâm, ad-ool-lawm'; probably from the passive participle of the same as H5724;  Adullam, a place in Palestine:—Adullam.

H5726.definition: עֲדֻלָּמִי ʻĂdullâmîy, ad-ool-law-mee'; patrial from H5725;  an Adullamite or native of Adullam:—Adullamite.

H5729.definition: עֶדֶן ʻEden, eh'-den; from H5727; pleasure;  Eden, a place in Mesopotamia:—Eden.

H5730.definition: עֵדֶן ʻêden, ay'-den; or (feminine) עֶדְנָה ʻednâh; from H5727;  pleasure:—delicate, delight, pleasure. See also H1040.

H5733.definition: עַדְנָא ʻAdnâʼ, ad-naw'; from H5727; pleasure;  Adna, the name of two Israelites:—Adna.

H5734.definition: עַדְנָה ʻAdnâh, ad-naw'; from H5727; pleasure;  Adnah, the name of two Israelites:—Adnah.

H5736.definition: עֲדַף ʻădaph, aw-daf'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively have) redundant:—be more, odd number, be (have) over (and above), overplus, remain.

H5737.definition: עֲדַר ʻădar, aw-dar'; a primitive root;  to arrange, as a battle, a vineyard (to hoe); hence, to muster and so to miss (or find wanting):—dig, fail, keep (rank), lack.

H5738.definition: עֶדֶר ʻEder, eh'-der; from H5737; an arrangement (i.e. drove);  Eder, an Israelite:—Ader.

H5739.definition: עֵדֶר ʻêder, ay'-der; from H5737;  an arrangement, i.e. muster (of animals):—drove, flock, herd.

H5740.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5740.definition: עֵדֶר ʻÊder, ay'-der; the same as H5739;  Eder, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine:—Edar, Eder.

H5742.definition: עָדָשׁ ʻâdâsh, aw-dawsh'; from an unused root of uncertain meaning;  a lentil:—lentile.

H5744.definition: עוֹבֵד ʻÔwbêd, o-bade'; active participle of H5647; serving;  Obed, the name of five Israelites:—Obed.

H5747.definition: עוֹג ʻÔwg, ogue; probably from H5746; round;  Og, a king of Bashan:—Og.

H5749.definition: עוּד ʻûwd, ood; a primitive root;  to duplicate or repeat; by implication, to protest, testify (as by reiteration); intensively, to encompass, restore (as a sort of reduplication):—admonish, charge, earnestly, lift up, protest, call (take) to record, relieve, rob, solemnly, stand upright, testify, give warning, (bear, call to, give, take to) witness.

H575.definition: אָן ʼân, awn; or אָנָה ʼânâh; contracted from H370;  where?; hence, whither?, when?; also hither and thither:—  any (no) whither, now, where, whither(-soever).

H5750.definition: עוֹד ʻôwd, ode; or עֹד ʻôd; from H5749;  properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more:—again, × all life long, at all, besides, but, else, further(-more), henceforth, (any) longer, (any) more(-over), × once, since, (be) still, when, (good, the) while (having being), (as, because, whether, while) yet (within).

H5751.definition: עוֹד ʻôwd, ode; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5750:—while.

H5753.definition: עָוָה ʻâvâh, aw-vaw'; a primitive root;  to crook, literally or figuratively:—do amiss, bow down, make crooked, commit iniquity, pervert, (do) perverse(-ly), trouble, × turn, do wickedly, do wrong.

H5756.definition: עוּז ʻûwz, ooz; a primitive root;  to be strong; causatively, to strengthen, i.e. (figuratively) to save (by flight):—gather (self, self to flee), retire.

H5759.definition: עֲוִיל ʻăvîyl, av-eel'; from H5764;  a babe:—young child, little one.

H576.definition: אֲנָא ʼănâʼ, an-aw'; (Aramaic) or אֲנָה ʼănâh; (Aramaic), corresponding to H589;  I:—I, as for me.

H5764.definition: עוּל ʻûwl, ool; from H5763;  a babe:—sucking child, infant.

H5766.definition: עֶוֶל ʻevel, eh'-vel; or עָוֶל ʻâvel; and (feminine) עַוְלָה ʻavlâh; or עוֹלָה ʻôwlâh; or עֹלָה ʻôlâh; from H5765;  (moral) evil:—iniquity, perverseness, unjust(-ly), unrighteousness(-ly); wicked(-ness).

H5768.definition: עוֹלֵל ʻôwlêl, o-lale'; or עֹלָל ʻôlâl; from H5763;  a suckling:—babe, (young) child, infant, little one.

H5769.definition: עוֹלָם ʻôwlâm, o-lawm'; or עֹלָם ʻôlâm; from H5956;  properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always:—alway(-s), ancient (time), any more, continuance, eternal, (for, (n-)) ever(-lasting, -more, of old), lasting, long (time), (of) old (time), perpetual, at any time, (beginning of the) world (+ without end). Compare H5331, H5703.

H577.definition: אָנָּא ʼânnâʼ, awn-naw'; or אָנָּה ʼânnâh; apparent contracted from H160 and H4994;  oh now!:—I (me) beseech (pray) thee, O.

H5770.definition: עָוַן ʻâvan, aw-van'; denominative from H5869;  to watch (with jealosy):—eye.

H5771.definition: עָוֺן ʻâvôn, aw-vone'; or עָווֹן ʻâvôwn; (2 Kings 7:9; Psalm 51:5 [7]), from H5753;  perversity, i.e. (moral) evil:—fault, iniquity, mischeif, punishment (of iniquity), sin.

H5774.definition: עוּף ʻûwph, oof; a primitive root; to cover (with wings or obscurity); hence (as denominative from H5775)  to fly; also (by implication of dimness) to faint (from the darkness of swooning):—brandish, be (wax) faint, flee away, fly (away), × set, shine forth, weary.

H5775.definition: עוֹף ʻôwph, ofe; from H5774;  a bird (as covered with feathers, or rather as covering with wings), often collectively:—bird, that flieth, flying, fowl.

H5779.definition: עוּץ ʻûwts, oots; a primitive root;  to consult:—take advice ((counsel) together).

H5780.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5780.definition: עוּץ ʻÛwts, oots; apparently from H5779; consultation;  Uts, a son of Aram, also a Seirite, and the regions settled by them.:—Uz.

H5781.definition: עוּק ʻûwq, ook; a primitive root;  to pack:—be pressed.

H5782.definition: עוּר ʻûwr, oor; a primitive root (rather identical with through the idea of opening the eyes);  to wake (literally or figuratively):—(a-) wake(-n, up), lift up (self), × master, raise (up), stir up (self).

H5785.definition: עוֹר ʻôwr, ore; from H5783;  skin (as naked); by implication, hide, leather:—hide, leather, skin.

H5786.definition: עָוַר ʻâvar, aw-var'; a primitive root (rather denominatively from H5785 through the idea of a film over the eyes);  to blind:—blind, put out. See also H5895.

H5787.definition: עִוֵּר ʻivvêr, iv-vare'; intensive from H5786;  blind (literally or figuratively):—blind (men, people).

H5789.definition: עוּשׁ ʻûwsh, oosh; a primitive root;  to hasten:—assemble self.

H579.definition: אָנָה ʼânâh, aw-naw'; a primitive root (perhaps rather identical with H578 through the idea of contraction in anguish);  to approach; hence, to meet in various senses:—befall, deliver, happen, seek a quarrel.

H5791.definition: עָוַת ʻâvath, aw-vath'; a primitive root;  to wrest:—bow self, (make) crooked, falsifying, overthrow, deal perversely, pervert, subvert, turn upside down.

H5793.definition: עוּתַי ʻÛwthay, oo-thah'-ee; from H5790; succoring;  Uthai, the name of two Israelites:—Uthai.

H5794.definition: עַז ʻaz, az; from H5810;  strong, vehement, harsh:—fierce,   greedy, mighty, power, roughly, strong.

H5795.definition: עֵז ʻêz, aze; from H5810;  a she-goat (as strong), but masculine in plural (which also is used elliptically for goat's hair):—(she) goat, kid.

H5796.definition: עֵז ʻêz, aze; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5795:—goat.

H5797.definition: עֹז ʻôz, oze; or (fully) עוֹז ʻôwz; from H5810;  strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise):—boldness, loud, might, power, strength, strong.

H5798.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5798.definition: עֻזָּא ʻUzzâʼ, ooz-zaw'; or עֻזָּה ʻUzzâh; feminine of H5797; strength;  Uzza or Uzzah, the name of five Israelites:—Uzza, Uzzah.

H580.definition: אֲנוּ ʼănûw, an-oo'; contracted for H587;  we:—we.

H5800.definition: עָזַב ʻâzab, aw-zab'; a primitive root;  to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.:—commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, × surely.

H5803.definition: עַזְגָּד ʻAzgâd, az-gawd'; from H5794 and H1409; stern troop;  Azgad, an Israelite:—Azgad.

H5804.definition: עַזָּה ʻAzzâh, az-zaw'; feminine of H5794; strong;  Azzah, a place in Palestine:—Azzah, Gaza.

H5805.definition: עֲזוּבָה ʻăzûwbâh, az-oo-baw'; feminine passive participle of H5800;  desertion (of inhabitants):—forsaking.

H5806.definition: עֲזוּבָה ʻĂzûwbâh, az-oo-baw'; the same as H5805;  Azubah, the name of two Israelitesses:—Azubah.

H5808.definition: עִזּוּז ʻizzûwz, iz-zooz'; from H5810;  forcible; collectively and concretely, an army:—power, strong.

H5809.definition: עַזּוּר ʻAzzûwr, az-zoor'; or עַזֻּר ʻAzzur; from H5826; helpful;  Azzur, the name of three Israelites:—Azur, Azzur.

H581.definition: אִנּוּן ʼinnûwn, in-noon'; (Aramaic) or (feminine) אִנִּין ʼinnîynlemma אֵנִּין first vowel, corrected to אִנִּין; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1992;  they:—× are, them, these.

H5810.definition: עָזַז ʻâzaz, aw-zaz'; a primitive root;  to be stout (literally or figuratively):—harden, impudent, prevail, strengthen (self), be strong.

H5812.definition: עֲזַזְיָהוּ ʻĂzazyâhûw, az-az-yaw'-hoo; from H5810 and H3050; Jah has strengthened;  Azazjah, the name of three Israelites:—Azaziah.

H5813.definition: עֻזִּי ʻUzzîy, ooz-zee'; from H5810; forceful;  Uzzi, the name of six Israelites:—Uzzi.

H5814.definition: עֻזִּיָּא ʻUzzîyâʼ, ooz-zee-yaw'; perhaps for H5818;  Uzzija, an Israelite:—Uzzia.

H5815.definition: עֲזִיאֵל ʻĂzîyʼêl, az-ee-ale'; from H5756 and H410; strengthened of God;  Aziel, an Israelite:—Aziel. Compare H3268.

H5816.definition: עֻזִּיאֵל ʻUzzîyʼêl, ooz-zee-ale'; from H5797 and H410; strength of God;  Uzziel, the name of six Israelites:—Uzziel.

H5818.definition: עֻזִּיָּה ʻUzzîyâh, ooz-zee-yaw'; or עֻזִּיָּהוּ ʻUzzîyâhûw; from H5797 and H3050; strength of Jah;  Uzzijah, the name of five Israelites:—Uzziah.

H582.definition: אֱנוֹשׁ ʼĕnôwsh, en-oshe'; from H605;  properly, a mortal (and thus differing from the more dignified 120); hence, a man in general (singly or collectively):—another, × (blood-) thirsty, certain, chap(-man); divers, fellow, × in the flower of their age, husband, (certain, mortal) man, people, person, servant, some (× of them),   stranger, those,   their trade. It is often unexpressed in the English versions, especially when used in apposition with another word. Compare H376.

H5820.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5820.definition: עַזְמָוֶת ʻAzmâveth, az-maw'-veth; from H5794 and H4194; strong one of death;  Azmaveth, the name of three Israelites and of a place in Palestine:—Azmaveth. See also H1041.

H5825.definition: עֲזֵקָה ʻĂzêqâh, az-ay-kaw'; from H5823; tilled;  Azekah, a place in Palestine:—Azekah.

H5826.definition: עָזַר ʻâzar, aw-zar'; a primitive root;  to surround, i.e. protect or aid:—help, succour.

H5828.definition: עֵזֶר ʻêzer, ay'-zer; from H5826;  aid:—help.

H5829.definition: עֵזֶר ʻÊzer, ay'-zer; the same as H5828;  Ezer, the name of four Israelites:—Ezer. Compare H5827.

H583.definition: אֱנוֹשׁ ʼĔnôwsh, en-ohsh'; the same as H582;  Enosh, a son of Seth:—Enos.

H5830.definition: עֶזְרָא ʻEzrâʼ, ez-raw'; a variation of H5833;  Ezra, an Israelite:—Ezra.

H5831.definition: עֶזְרָא ʻEzrâʼ, ez-raw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5830;  Ezra, an Israelite:—Ezra.

H5832.definition: עֲזַרְאֵל ʻĂzarʼêl, az-ar-ale'; from H5826 and H410; God has helped;  Azarel, the name of five Israelites:—Azarael, Azareel.

H5833.definition: עֶזְרָה ʻezrâh, ez-raw'; or עֶזְרָת ʻezrâth; (Psalm 60:11 (13); Psalm 108:12 (13)), feminine of H5828;  aid:—help(-ed, -er).

H5835.definition: עֲזָרָה ʻăzârâh, az-aw-raw'; from H5826 in its original meaning of surrounding;  an inclosure; also a border:—court, settle.

H5836.definition: עֶזְרִי ʻEzrîy, ez-ree'; from H5828; helpful;  Ezri, an Israelite:—Ezri.

H5837.definition: עַזְרִיאֵל ʻAzrîyʼêl, az-ree-ale'; from H5828 and H410; help of God;  Azriel, the name of three Israelites:—Azriel.

H5838.definition: עֲזַרְיָה ʻĂzaryâh, az-ar-yaw'; or עֲזַרְיָהוּ ʻĂzaryâhûw; from H5826 and H3050; Jah has helped;  Azarjah, the name of nineteen Israelites:—Azariah.

H584.definition: אָנַח ʼânach, aw-nakh'; a primitive root;  to sigh:—groan, mourn, sigh.

H5840.definition: עַזְרִיקָם ʻAzrîyqâm, az-ree-kawm'; from H5828 and active participle of H6965; help of an enemy;  Azrikam, the name of four Israelites:—Azrikam.

H5842.definition: עֵט ʻêṭ, ate; from H5860 (contracted) in the sense of swooping, i.e. side-long stroke;  a stylus or marking stick:—pen.

H5844.definition: עָטָה ʻâṭâh, aw-taw'; a primitive root;  to wrap, i.e. cover, veil, clothe, or roll:—array self, be clad, (put a) cover (-ing, self), fill, put on, × surely, turn aside.

H5848.definition: עָטַף ʻâṭaph, aw-taf'; a primitive root;  to shroud, i.e. clothe (whether transitive or reflexive); hence (from the idea of darkness) to languish:—cover (over), fail, faint, feebler, hide self, be overwhelmed, swoon.

H5849.definition: עָטַר ʻâṭar, aw-tar'; a primitive root;  to encircle (for attack or protection); especially to crown (literally or figuratively):—compass, crown.

H5850.definition: עֲטָרָה ʻăṭârâh, at-aw-raw'; from H5849;  a crown:—crown.

H5852.definition: עֲטָרוֹת ʻĂṭârôwth, at-aw-roth'; or עֲטָרֹת ʻĂṭârôth; plural of H5850;  Ataroth, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine:—Ataroth.

H5854.definition: עַטְרוֹת בֵּית יוֹאָב ʻAṭrôwth bêyth Yôwʼâb, at-roth' bayth yoawb'; from the same as H5852 and H1004 and H3097; crowns of the house of Joab;  Atroth-beth-Joab, a place in Palestine:—Ataroth the house of Joab.

H5856.definition: עִי ʻîy, ee; from H5753;  a ruin (as if overturned):—heap.

H5857.definition: עַי ʻAy, ah'ee; or (feminine) עַיָּא ʻAyâʼ; (Nehemiah 11:31), or עַיָּת ʻAyâth; (Isaiah 10:28), for H5856;  Ai, Aja or Ajath, a place in Palestine:—Ai, Aija, Aijath, Hai.

H5858.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5858.definition: עֵיבָל ʻÊybâl, ay-bawl'; perhaps from an unused root probably meaning to be bald; bare;  Ebal, a mountain of Palestine:—Ebal.

H5859.definition: עִיּוֹן ʻÎyôwn, ee-yone'; from H5856; ruin;  Ijon, a place in Palestine:—Ijon.

H586.definition: אֲנַחְנָא ʼănachnâʼ, an-akh'-naw; (Aramaic) or אֲנַחְנָה ʼănachnâh; (Aramaic), corresponding to H587;  we:—we.

H5862.definition: עֵיטָם ʻÊyṭâm, ay-tawm'; from H5861; hawk-ground;  Etam, a place in Palestine:—Etam.

H5866.definition: עִילַי ʻÎylay, ee-lah'-ee; from H5927; elevated;  Ilai, an Israelite:—Ilai.

H5867.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H5867.definition: עֵילָם ʻÊylâm, ay-lawm'; or עוֹלָם ʻÔwlâm; (Ezra 10:2; Jeremiah 49:36), probably from H5956; hidden, i.e. distant;  Elam, a son of Shem and his descendants, with their country; also of six Israelites:—Elam.

H5869.definition: עַיִן ʻayin, ah'-yin; probably a primitive word;  an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape):—affliction, outward appearance,   before,   think best, colour, conceit,   be content, countenance,   displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face,   favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), × him,   humble, knowledge, look, (+ well), × me, open(-ly), + (not) please, presence,   regard, resemblance, sight, × thee, × them, + think, × us, well, × you(-rselves).

H587.definition: אֲנַחְנוּ ʼănachnûw, an-akh'-noo; apparently from H595;  we:—ourselves, us, we.

H5871.definition: עַיִן ʻAyin, ah'-yin; the same as H5869; fountain;  Ajin, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine:—Ain.

H5873.definition: עֵין גַּנִּים ʻÊyn Gannîym, ane gan-neem'; from H5869 and the plural of H1588; fountain of gardens;  En-Gannim, a place in Palestine:—En-gannim.

H5883.definition: עֵין רֹגֵל ʻÊyn Rôgêl, ane ro-gale'; from H5869 and the active participle of H7270; fountain of a traveller;  En-Rogel, a place near Jerusalem:—En-rogel.

H5888.definition: עָיֵף ʻâyêph, aw-yafe'; a primitive root;  to languish:—be wearied.

H5889.definition: עָיֵף ʻâyêph, aw-yafe'; from H5888;  languid:—faint, thirsty, weary.

H589.definition: אֲנִי ʼănîy, an-ee'; contracted from H595;  I:—I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, × which, × who.

H5890.definition: עֵיפָה ʻêyphâh, ay-faw'; feminine from H5774;  obscurity (as if from covering):—darkness.

H5891.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper masculine noun
H5891.definition: עֵיפָה ʻÊyphâh, ay-faw'; the same as H5890;  Ephah, the name of a son of Midian, and of the region settled by him; also of an Israelite and of an Israelitess:—Ephah.

H5892.definition: עִיר ʻîyr, eer; or (in the plural) עָר ʻâr; or עָיַר ʻâyar; (Judges 10:4), from H5782  a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post):—Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.

H5895.definition: עַיִר ʻayir, ah'-yeer; from H5782 in the sense of raising (i.e. bearing a burden);  properly, a young ass (as just broken to a load); hence an ass-colt:—(ass) colt, foal, young ass.

H5896.definition: עִירָא ʻÎyrâʼ, ee-raw'; from H5782; wakefulness;  Ira, the name of three Israelites:—Ira.

H5897.definition: עִירָד ʻÎyrâd, ee-rawd'; from the same as H6166; fugitive;  Irad, an antediluvian:—Irad.

H590.definition: אֳנִי ʼŏnîy, on-ee'; probably from H579 (in the sense of conveyance);  a ship or (collectively) a fleet:—galley, navy (of ships).

H5900.definition: עִירוּ ʻÎyrûw, ee-roo'; from H5892; a citizen;  Iru, an Israelite:—Iru.

H5902.definition: עִירָם ʻÎyrâm, ee-rawm'; from H5892; city-wise;  Iram, an Idumaean:—Iram.

H5907.definition: עַכְבּוֹר ʻAkbôwr, ak-bore'; probably for H5909;  Akbor, the name of an Idumaean and of two Israelites:—Achbor.

H5909.definition: עַכְבָּר ʻakbâr, ak-bawr'; probably from the same as H5908 in the secondary sense of attacking;  a mouse (as nibbling):—mouse.

H591.definition: אֳנִיָּה ʼŏnîyâh, on-ee-yaw'; feminine of H590;  a ship:—ship(-men).

H5912.definition: עָכָן ʻÂkân, aw-kawn'; from an unused root meaning to trouble; troublesome;  Akan, an Israelite:—Achan. Compare H5917.

H5915.definition: עַכְסָה ʻAkçâh, ak-saw'; feminine of H5914; anklet;  Aksah, an Israelitess:—Achsah.

H5916.definition: עָכַר ʻâkar, aw-kar'; a primitive root;  properly, to roil water; figuratively, to disturb or affict:—trouble, stir.

H5920.definition: עַל ʻal, al; from H5927;  properly, the top; specifically, the Highest (i.e. God); also (adverb) aloft, to Jehovah:—above, high, most High.

H5921.definition: עַל ʻal, al; properly, the same as H5920 used as a preposition (in the singular or plural often with prefix, or as conjunction with a particle following);  above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications:—above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, × as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, × both and, by (reason of), × had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, × with.

H5922.definition: עַל ʻal, al; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5921:—about, against, concerning, for, (there-) fore, from, in, × more, of, (there-, up-) on, (in-) to,   why with.

H5923.definition: עֹל ʻôl, ole; or עוֹל ʻôwl; from H5953;  a yoke (as imposed on the neck), literally or figuratively:—yoke.

H5927.definition: עָלָה ʻâlâh, aw-law'; a primitive root;  to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative:—arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up,   shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, × mention, mount up, offer, make to pay,   perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

H5929.definition: עָלֶה ʻâleh, aw-leh'; from H5927;  a leaf (as coming up on a tree); collectively, foliage:—branch, leaf.

H5930.definition: עֹלָה ʻôlâh, o-law'; or עוֹלָה ʻôwlâh; feminine active participle of H5927;  a step or (collectively, stairs, as ascending); usually a holocaust (as going up in smoke):—ascent, burnt offering (sacrifice), go up to. See also H5766.

H5931.definition: עִלָּה ʻillâh, il-law'; (Aramaic) feminine from a root corresponding to H5927;  a pretext (as arising artificially):—occasion.

H5933.definition: עַלְוָה ʻAlvâh, al-vaw'; or עַליָה ʻAlyâh; the same as H5932;  Alvah or Aljah, an Idumaean:—Aliah, Alvah.

H5934.definition: עָלוּם ʻâlûwm, aw-loom'; passive participle of H5956 in the denominative sense of H5958;  (only in plural as abstract) adolescence; figuratively, vigor:—youth.

H5935.definition: עַלְוָן ʻAlvân, al-vawn'; or עַלְיָן ʻAlyân; from H5927; lofty;  Alvan or Aljan, an Idumaean:—Alian, Alvan.

H5937.definition: עָלַז ʻâlaz, aw-laz'; a primitive root;  to jump for joy, i.e. exult:—be joyful, rejoice, triumph.

H5939.definition: עֲלָטָה ʻălâṭâh, al-aw-taw'; feminine from an unused root meaning to cover;  dusk:—dark, twilight.

H594.definition: אֲנָךְ ʼănâk, an-awk'; probably from an unused root meaning to be narrow;  according to most a plumb-line, and to others a hook:—plumb-line

H5941.definition: עֵלִי ʻÊlîy, ay-lee'; from H5927; lofty;  Eli, an Israelite highpriest:—Eli.

H5943.definition: עִלַּי ʻillay, il-lah'-ee; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5942;  supreme (i.e. God):—(most) high.

H5944.definition: עֲלִיָּה ʻălîyâh, al-ee-yaw'; feminine from H5927;  something lofty, i.e. a stair-way; also a second-story room (or even one on the roof); figuratively, the sky:—ascent, (upper) chamber, going up, loft, parlour.

H5945.definition: עֶלְיוֹן ʻelyôwn, el-yone'; from H5927;  an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (comparison); as title, the Supreme:—(Most, on) high(-er, -est), upper(-most).

H5947.definition: עַלִּיז ʻallîyz, al-leez'; from H5937;  exultant:—joyous, (that) rejoice(-ing)

H5949.definition: עֲלִילָה ʻălîylâh, al-ee-law'; or עֲלִלָה ʻălilâh; from H5953 in the sense of effecting;  an exploit (of God), or a performance (of man, often in a bad sense); by implication, an opportunity:—act(-ion), deed, doing, invention, occasion, work.

H5952.definition: עַלִּית ʻallîyth, al-leeth'; from H5927;  a second-story room:—chamber. Compare H5944.

H5953.definition: עָלַל ʻâlal, aw-lal'; a primitive root;  to effect thoroughly; specifically, to glean (also figuratively); by implication (in a bad sense) to overdo, i.e. maltreat, be saucy to, pain, impose (also literal):—abuse, affect, × child, defile, do, glean, mock, practise, thoroughly, work (wonderfully).

H5954.definition: עֲלַל ʻălal, al-al'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5953 (in the sense of thrusting oneself in),  to enter; causatively, to introduce:—bring in, come in, go in.

H5955.definition: עֹלֵלָה ʻôlêlâh, o-lay-law'; feminine active participle of H5953;  only in plural gleanings; by extension gleaning-time:—(gleaning) (of the) grapes, grapegleanings.

H5957.definition: עָלַם ʻâlam, aw-lam'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5769;  remote time, i.e. the future or past indefinitely; often adverb, forever:—for (n-)ever (lasting), old.

H596.definition: אָנַן ʼânan, aw-nan'; a primitive root;  to mourn, i.e. complain:—complain.

H5964.definition: עָלֶמֶת ʻÂlemeth, aw-leh'-meth; from H5956; a covering;  Alemeth, the name of a place in Palestine and of two Israelites:—Alameth, Alemeth.

H5967.definition: עֲלַע ʻălaʻ, al-ah'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6763;  a rib:—rib.

H5968.definition: עָלַף ʻâlaph, aw-laf'; a primitive root;  to veil or cover; figuratively, to be languid:—faint, overlaid, wrap self.

H5969.definition: עֻלְפֶּה ʻulpeh, ool-peh'; from H5968;  an envelope, i.e. (figuratively) mourning:—fainted.

H5970.definition: עָלַץ ʻâlats, aw-lats'; a primitive root;  to jump for joy, i.e. exult:—be joyful, rejoice, triumph.

H5971.definition: עַם ʻam, am; from H6004;  a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock:—folk, men, nation, people.

H5972.definition: עַם ʻam, am; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5971:—people.

H5973.definition: עִם ʻim, eem; from H6004;  adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English):—accompanying, against, and, as (× long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al).

H5974.definition: עִם ʻim, eem; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5973:—by, from, like, to(-ward), with.

H5975.definition: עָמַד ʻâmad, aw-mad'; a primitive root;  to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive):—abide (behind), appoint, arise, cease, confirm, continue, dwell, be employed, endure, establish, leave, make, ordain, be (over), place, (be) present (self), raise up, remain, repair,   serve, set (forth, over, -tle, up), (make to, make to be at a, with-) stand (by, fast, firm, still, up), (be at a) stay (up), tarry.

H5977.definition: עֹמֶד ʻômed, o'-med; from H5975;  a spot (as being fixed):—place, (+ where) stood, upright.

H5978.definition: עִמָּד ʻimmâd, im-mawd'; prolonged for H5973;  along with:—against, by, from, + me, + mine, of, + that I take, unto, upon, with(-in.)

H5980.definition: עֻמָּה ʻummâh, oom-maw'; from H6004;  conjunction, i.e. society; mostly adverb or preposition (with prepositional prefix), near, beside, along with:—(over) against, at, beside, hard by, in points.

H5982.definition: עַמּוּד ʻammûwd, am-mood'; or עַמֻּד ʻammud; from H5975;  a column (as standing); also a stand, i.e. platform:—× apiece, pillar.

H5984.definition: עַמּוֹנִי ʻAmmôwnîy, am-mo-nee'; patronymically from H5983;  an Ammonite or (the adjective) Ammonitish:—Ammonite(-s).

H5985.definition: עַמּוֹנִית ʻAmmôwnîyth, am-mo-neeth'; feminine of H5984;  an Ammonitess:—Ammonite(-ss).

H5986.definition: עָמוֹס ʻÂmôwç, aw-moce'; from H6006; burdensome;  Amos, an Israelite prophet:—Amos.

H5987.definition: עָמוֹק ʻÂmôwq, aw-moke'; from H6009; deep;  Amok, an Israelite:—Amok.

H5988.definition: עַמִּיאֵל ʻAmmîyʼêl, am-mee-ale'; from H5971 and H410; people of God;  Ammiel, the name of three or four Israelites:—Ammiel.

H5989.definition: עַמִּיהוּד ʻAmmîyhûwd, am-mee-hood'; from H5971 and H1935; people of splendor;  Ammihud, the name of three Israelites:—Ammihud.

H599.definition: אָנַף ʼânaph, aw-naf'; a primitive root;  to breathe hard, i.e. be enraged:—be angry (displeased).

H5991.definition: עַמִּיחוּר ʻAmmîychûwr, am-mee-khoor'; from H5971 and H2353; people of nobility;  Ammichur, a Syrian prince:—Ammihud (from the margin).

H5992.definition: עַמִּינָדָב ʻAmmîynâdâb, am-mee-naw-dawb'; from H5971 and H5068; people of liberality;  Amminadab, the name of four Israelites:—Amminadab.

H5998.definition: עָמַל ʻâmal, aw-mal'; a primitive root;  to toil, i.e. work severely and with irksomeness:—(take) labour (in).

H5999.definition: עָמָל ʻâmâl, aw-mawl'; from H5998;  toil, i.e. wearing effort; hence, worry, whether of body or mind:—grievance(-vousness), iniquity, labour, mischief, miserable(-sery), pain(-ful), perverseness, sorrow, toil, travail, trouble, wearisome, wickedness.

H6.definition: אָבַד ʼâbad, aw-bad'; a primitive root;  properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy):—break, destroy(-uction),   not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, × and surely, take, be undone, × utterly, be void of, have no way to flee.

H60.definition: אֵבֶל ʼêbel, ay'-bel; from H56;  lamentation:—mourning.

H6002.definition: עֲמָלֵק ʻĂmâlêq, am-aw-lake'; probably of foreign origin;  Amalek, a descendant of Esau; also his posterity and their country:—Amalek.

H6006.definition: עָמַס ʻâmaç, aw-mas'; or עָמַשׂ ʻâmas; a primitive root;  to load, i.e. impose a burden (or figuratively, infliction):—be borne, (heavy) burden (self), lade, load, put.

H6009.definition: עָמַק ʻâmaq, aw-mak'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, make) deep (literally or figuratively):—(be, have, make, seek) deep(-ly), depth, be profound.

H6010.definition: עֵמֶק ʻêmeq, ay'-mek; from H6009;  a vale (i.e. broad depression):—dale, vale, valley (often used as a part of proper names). See also H1025.

H6013.definition: עָמֹק ʻâmôq, aw-moke'; from H6009;  deep (literally or figuratively):—(× exceeding) deep (thing).

H6015.definition: עֲמַר ʻămar, am-ar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6785;  wool:—wool.

H6016.definition: עֹמֶר ʻômer, o'-mer; from H6014;  properly, a heap, i.e. a sheaf; also an omer, as a dry measure:—omer, sheaf.

H6017.definition: עֲמֹרָה ʻĂmôrâh, am-o-raw'; from H6014; a (ruined) heap;  Amorah, a place in Palestine:—Gomorrah.

H6018.definition: עׇמְרִי ʻOmrîy, om-ree'; from H6014; heaping;  Omri, an Israelite:—Omri.

H6019.definition: עַמְרָם ʻAmrâm, am-rawm'; probably from H5971 and H7311; high people;  Amram, the name of two Israelites:—Amram.

H602.definition: אָנַק ʼânaq, aw-nak'; a primitive root;  to shriek:—cry, groan.

H6021.definition: עֲמָשָׂא ʻĂmâsâʼ, am-aw-saw'; from H6006; burden;  Amasa, the name of two Israelites:—Amasa.

H6022.definition: עֲמָשַׂי ʻĂmâsay, am-aw-sah'-ee; from H6006; burdensome;  Amasai, the name of three Israelites:—Amasai.

H6025.definition: עֵנָב ʻênâb, ay-nawb'; from an unused root probably meaning to bear fruit;  a grape:—(ripe) grape, wine.

H6026.definition: עָנַג ʻânag, aw-nag'; a primitive root;  to be soft or pliable, i.e. (figuratively) effeminate or luxurious:—delicate(-ness), (have) delight (self), sport self.

H6028.definition: עָנֹג ʻânôg, aw-nogue'; from H6026;  luxurious:—delicate.

H6030.definition: עָנָה ʻânâh, aw-naw'; a primitive root;  properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce:—give account, afflict (by mistake for 6031), (cause to, give) answer, bring low (by mistake for 6031), cry, hear, Leannoth, lift up, say, × scholar, (give a) shout, sing (together by course), speak, testify, utter, (bear) witness. See also H1042, H1043.

H6031.definition: עָנָה ʻânâh, aw-naw'; a primitive root (possibly rather identical with H6030 through the idea of looking down or browbeating);  to depress literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive (in various applications, as follows):—abase self, afflict(-ion, self), answer (by mistake for H6030), chasten self, deal hardly with, defile, exercise, force, gentleness, humble (self), hurt, ravish, sing (by mistake for H6030), speak (by mistake for H6030), submit self, weaken, × in any wise.

H6032.definition: עֲנָה ʻănâh, an-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6030:—answer, speak.

H6034.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper masculine noun
H6034.definition: עֲנָה ʻĂnâh, an-aw'; probably from H6030; an answer;  Anah, the name of two Edomites and one Edomitess:—Anah.

H6035.definition: עָנָו ʻânâv, aw-nawv'; or (by intermixture with H6041) עָנָיו ʻânâyv; from H6031;  depressed (figuratively), in mind (gentle) or circumstances (needy, especially saintly):—humble, lowly, meek, poor. Compare H6041.

H6036.definition: עָנוּב ʻÂnûwb, aw-noob'; passive participle from the same as H6025; borne (as fruit);  Anub, an Israelite:—Anub.

H6038.definition: עֲנָוָה ʻănâvâh, an-aw-vaw'; from H6035;  condescension, human and subjective (modesty), or divine and objective (clemency):—gentleness, humility, meekness.

H6040.definition: עֳנִי ʻŏnîy, on-ee'; from H6031;  depression, i.e. misery:—afflicted(-ion), trouble.

H6041.definition: עָנִי ʻânîy, aw-nee'; from H6031; (practically the same as H6035, although the margin constantly disputes this, making H6035 subjective and objective);  depressed, in mind or circumstances:—afflicted, humble, lowly, needy, poor.

H6042.definition: עֻנִּי ʻUnnîy, oon-nee'; from H6031; afflicted;  Unni, the name of two Israelites:—Unni.

H6043.definition: עֲנָיָה ʻĂnâyâh, an-aw-yaw'; from H6030; Jah has answered;  Anajah, the name of two Israelites:—Anaiah.

H6046.definition: עָנֵם ʻÂnêm, aw-name'; from the dual of H5869; two fountains;  Anem, a place in Palestine:—Anem.

H605.definition: אָנַשׁ ʼânash, aw-nash'; a primitive root;  to be frail, feeble, or (figuratively) melancholy:—desperate(-ly wicked), incurable, sick, woeful.

H6051.definition: עָנָן ʻânân, aw-nawn'; from H6049;  a cloud (as covering the sky), i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud:—cloud(-y).

H6052.definition: עָנָן ʻÂnân, aw-nawn'; the same as H6051; cloud;  Anan, an Israelite:—Anan.

H6055.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H6055.definition: עֲנַנְיָה ʻĂnanyâh, an-an-yaw'; from H6049 and H3050; Jah has covered;  Ananjah, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:—Ananiah.

H6057.definition: עָנָף ʻânâph, aw-nawf'; from an unused root meaning to cover;  a twig (as covering the limbs):—bough, branch.

H606.definition: אֱנָשׁ ʼĕnâsh, en-awsh'; (Aramaic) or אֱנַשׁ ʼĕnash; (Aramaic), corresponding to H582;  a man:—man,   whosoever.

H6062.definition: עֲנָקִי ʻĂnâqîy, an-aw-kee'; patronymically from H6061;  an Anakite or descendant of Anak:—Anakim.

H6063.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H6063.definition: עָנֵר ʻÂnêr, aw-nare'; probably for H5288;  Aner, a Amorite, also a place in Palestine:—Aner.

H6068.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H6068.definition: עֲנָתוֹת ʻĂnâthôwth, an-aw-thoth'; plural of H6067;  Anathoth, the name of two Israelites, also of a place in Pal:—Anathoth.

H607.definition: אַנְתָּה ʼantâh, an-taw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H859;  thou:—as for thee, thou.

H6070.definition: עַנְתֹתִיָּה ʻAnthôthîyâh, an-tho-thee-yaw'; from the same as H6068 and H3050; answers of Jah;  Anthothijah, an Israelite:—Antothijah.

H6071.definition: עָסִיס ʻâçîyç, aw-sees'; from H6072;  must or fresh grape-juice (as just trodden out):—juice, new (sweet) wine.

H6072.definition: עָסַס ʻâçaç, aw-sas'; a primitive root;  to squeeze out juice; figuratively, to trample:—tread down.

H6076.definition: עֹפֶל ʻôphel, o'-fel; from H6075;  a tumor; also a mound, i.e. fortress:—emerod, fort, strong hold, tower.

H6081.definition: עֵפֶר ʻÊpher, ay'-fer; probably a variation of H6082; gazelle;  Epher, the name of an Arabian and of two Israelites:—Epher.

H6082.definition: עֹפֶר ʻôpher, o'-fer; from H6080;  a fawn (from the dusty color):—young roe (hart).

H6083.definition: עָפָר ʻâphâr, aw-fawr'; from H6080;  dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay, earth, mud:—ashes, dust, earth, ground, morter, powder, rubbish.

H6084.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H6084.definition: עׇפְרָה ʻOphrâh, of-raw'; feminine of H6082; female fawn;  Ophrah, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine:—Ophrah.

H6085.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H6085.definition: עֶפְרוֹן ʻEphrôwn, ef-rone'; from the same as H6081; fawn-like;  Ephron, the name of a Canaanite and of two places in Palestine:—Ephron, Ephrain (from the margin).

H6086.definition: עֵץ ʻêts, ates; from H6095;  a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks):—  carpenter, gallows, helve,   pine, plank, staff, stalk, stick, stock, timber, tree, wood.

H6087.definition: עָצַב ʻâtsab, aw-tsab'; a primitive root;  properly, to carve, i.e. fabricate or fashion; hence (in a bad sense) to worry, pain or anger:—displease, grieve, hurt, make, be sorry, vex, worship, wrest.

H6089.definition: עֶצֶב ʻetseb, eh'-tseb; from H6087;  an earthen vessel; usually (painful) toil; also a pang (whether of body or mind):—grievous, idol, labor, sorrow.

H609.definition: אָסָא ʼÂçâʼ, aw-saw'; of uncertain derivation;  Asa, the name of a king and of a Levite:—Asa.

H6091.definition: עָצָב ʻâtsâb, aw-tsawb'; from H6087;  an (idolatrous) image:—idol, image.

H6094.definition: עַצֶּבֶת ʻatstsebeth, ats-tseh'-beth; from H6087;  a idol; also, a pain or wound:—sorrow, wound.

H6097.definition: עֵצָה ʻêtsâh, ay-tsaw'; feminine of H6086;  timber:—trees.

H6098.definition: עֵצָה ʻêtsâh, ay-tsaw'; from H3289;  advice; by implication, plan; also prudence:—advice, advisement, counsel(-lor), purpose.

H6099.definition: עָצוּם ʻâtsûwm, aw-tsoom'; or עָצֻם ʻâtsum; passive participle of H6105;  powerful (specifically, a paw); by implication, numerous:—  feeble, great, mighty, must, strong.

H61.definition: אֲבָל ʼăbâl, ab-awl'; apparently from H56 through the idea of negation;  nay, i.e. truly or yet:—but, indeed, nevertheless, verily.

H6103.definition: עַצְלָה ʻatslâh, ats-law'; feminine of H6102;  (as abstractly) indolence:—slothfulness.

H6105.definition: עָצַם ʻâtsam, aw-tsam'; a primitive root; also denominatively (from H6106)  to bind fast, i.e. close (the eyes); intransitively, to be (causatively, make) powerful or numerous; to crunch the bones:—break the bones, close, be great, be increased, be (wax) mighty(-ier), be more, shut, be(-come, make) strong(-er).

H6106.definition: עֶצֶם ʻetsem, eh'tsem; from H6105; a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pronoun) selfsame:—body, bone, × life, (self-) same, strength, × very.

H6107.definition: עֶצֶם ʻEtsem, eh'-tsem; the same as H6106; bone;  Etsem, a place in Palestine:—Azem, Ezem.

H6109.definition: עׇצְמָה ʻotsmâh, ots-maw'; feminine of H6108;  powerfulness; by extension, numerousness:—abundance, strength.

H6113.definition: עָצָר ʻâtsâr, aw-tsar'; a primitive root;  to inclose; by analogy, to hold back; also to maintain, rule, assemble:—× be able, close up, detain, fast, keep (self close, still), prevail, recover, refrain, × reign, restrain, retain, shut (up), slack, stay, stop, withhold (self).

H6115.definition: עֹצֶר ʻôtser, o'-tser; from H6113;  closure; also constraint:—× barren, oppression, × prison.

H6116.definition: עֲצָרָה ʻătsârâh, ats-aw-raw'; or עֲצֶרֶת ʻătsereth; from H6113;  an assembly, especially on a festival or holiday:—(solemn) assembly (meeting).

H6118.definition: עֵקֶב ʻêqeb, ay'-keb; from H6117 in the sense of H6119;  a heel, i.e. (figuratively) the last of anything (used adverbially, for ever); also result, i.e. compensation; and so (adverb with preposition or relatively) on account of:—× because, by, end, for, if, reward.

H6119.definition: עָקֵב ʻâqêb, aw-kabe'; or (feminine) עִקְּבָה ʻiqqᵉbâh; from H6117;  a heel (as protuberant); hence, a track; figuratively, the rear (of an army):—heel, (horse-) hoof, last, lier in wait (by mistake for H6120), (foot-) step.

H6121.definition: עָקֹב ʻâqôb, aw-kobe'; from H6117; in the original sense, a knoll (as swelling up); in the denominative sense  (transitive) fraudulent or (intransitive) tracked:—crooked, deceitful, polluted.

H6124.definition: עָקֹד ʻâqôd, aw-kode'; from H6123;  striped (with bands):—ring straked.

H6126.definition: עַקּוּב ʻAqqûwb, ak-koob'; from H6117; insidious;  Akkub, the name of five Israelites:—Akkub.

H6128.definition: עֲקַלְקַל ʻăqalqal, ak-al-kal'; from H6127;  winding:—by(-way), crooked way.

H6131.definition: עָקַר ʻâqar, aw-kar'; a primitive root;  to pluck up (especially by the roots); specifically, to hamstring; figuratively, to exterminate:—dig down, hough, pluck up, root up.

H6135.definition: עָקָר ʻâqâr, aw-kawr'; from H6131;  sterile (as if extirpated in the generative organs):—(× male or female) barren (woman).

H6138.definition: עֶקְרוֹן ʻEqrôwn, ek-rone'; from H6131; eradication;  Ekron, a place in Palestine:—Ekron.

H6140.definition: עָקַשׁ ʻâqash, aw-kash'; a primitive root;  to knot or distort; figuratively, to pervert (act or declare perverse):—make crooked, (prove, that is) perverse(-rt).

H6144.definition: עָר ʻÂr, awr; the same as H5892; a city;  Ar, a place in Moab:—Ar.

H6145.definition: עָר ʻâr, awr; from H5782;  a foe (as watchful for mischief):—enemy.

H6147.definition: עֵר ʻÊr, ayr; from H5782; watchful;  Er, the name of two Israelites:—Er.

H6148.definition: עָרַב ʻârab, aw-rab'; a primitive root;  to braid, i.e. intermix; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange):—engage, (inter-) meddle (with), mingle (self), mortgage, occupy, give pledges, be(-come, put in) surety, undertake.

H6149.definition: עָרֵב ʻârêb, aw-rabe'; a primitive root (rather identical with H6148 through the idea of close association);  to be agreeable:—be pleasant(-ing), take pleasure in, be sweet.

H615.definition: אָסִיר ʼâçîyr, aw-sere'; from H631;  bound, i.e. a captive:—(those which are) bound, prisoner.

H6151.definition: עֲרַב ʻărab, ar-ab'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6148;  to commingle:—mingle (self), mix.

H6152.definition: עֲרָב ʻĂrâb, ar-awb'; or עֲרַב ʻĂrab; from H6150 in the figurative sense of sterility;  Arab (i.e. Arabia), a country East of Palestine:—Arabia.

H6153.definition: עֶרֶב ʻereb, eh'-reb; from H6150;  dusk:—  day, even(-ing, tide), night.

H6154.definition: עֵרֶב ʻêreb, ay'-reb; or עֶרֶב ʻereb; (1 Kings 10:15), (with the article prefix), from H6148;  the web (or transverse threads of cloth); also a mixture, (or mongrel race):—Arabia, mingled people, mixed (multitude), woof.

H6157.definition: עָרֹב ʻârôb, aw-robe'; from H6148;  a mosquito (from its swarming):—divers sorts of flies, swarm.

H6158.definition: עֹרֵב ʻôrêb, o-rabe'; or עוֹרֵב ʻôwrêb; from H6150;  a raven (from its dusky hue):—raven.

H6159.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H6159.definition: עֹרֵב ʻÔrêb, o-rabe'; or עוֹרֵב ʻÔwrêb; the same as H6158;  Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of the cliff near the Jordan:—Oreb.

H6160.definition: עֲרָבָה ʻărâbâh, ar-aw-baw'; from H6150 (in the sense of sterility);  a desert; especially (with the article prefix) the (generally) sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea:—Arabah, champaign, desert, evening, heaven, plain, wilderness. See also H1026.

H6162.definition: עֲרָבוֹן ʻărâbôwn, ar-aw-bone'; from H6148 (in the sense of exchange);  a pawn (given as security):—pledge.

H6165.definition: עָרַג ʻârag, aw-rag'; a primitive root;  to long for:—cry, pant.

H6166.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H6166.definition: עֲרָד ʻĂrâd, ar-awd'; from an unused root meaning to sequester itself; fugitive;  Arad, the name of a place near Palestine, also of a Canaanite and an Israelite:—Arad.

H6168.definition: עָרָה ʻârâh, aw-raw'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, make) bare; hence, to empty, pour out, demolish:—leave destitute, discover, empty, make naked, pour (out), rase, spread self, uncover.

H617.definition: אַסִּיר ʼAççîyr, as-sere'; the same as H616; prisoner;  Assir, the name of two Israelites:—Assir.

H6172.definition: עֶרְוָה ʻervâh, er-vaw'; from H6168;  nudity, literally (especially the pudenda) or figuratively (disgrace, blemish):—nakedness, shame, unclean(-ness).

H6173.definition: עַרְוָה ʻarvâh, ar-vaw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6172;  nakedness, i.e. (figuratively) impoverishment:—dishonor.

H6174.definition: עָרוֹם ʻârôwm, aw-rome'; or עָרֹם ʻârôm; from H6191 (in its original sense);  nude, either partially or totally:—naked.

H6175.definition: עָרוּם ʻârûwm, aw-room'; passive participle of H6191;  cunning (usually in a bad sense):—crafty, prudent, subtil.

H6179.definition: עֵרִי ʻÊrîy, ay-ree'; from H5782; watchful;  Eri, an Israelite:—Eri.

H6181.definition: עֶרְיָה ʻeryâh, er-yaw'; for H6172;  nudity:—bare, naked, × quite.

H6184.definition: עָרִיץ ʻârîyts, aw-reets'; from H6206;  fearful, i.e. powerful or tyrannical:—mighty, oppressor, in great power, strong, terrible, violent.

H6185.definition: עֲרִירִי ʻărîyrîy, ar-e-ree'; from H6209;  bare, i.e. destitute (of children):—childless.

H6186.definition: עָרַךְ ʻârak, aw-rak'; a primitive root;  to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications):—put (set) (the battle, self) in array, compare, direct, equal, esteem, estimate, expert (in war), furnish, handle, join (battle), ordain, (lay, put, reckon up, set) (in) order, prepare, tax, value.

H6187.definition: עֵרֶךְ ʻêrek, eh'rek; from H6186;  a pile, equipment, estimate:—equal, estimation, (things that are set in) order, price, proportion, × set at, suit, taxation, × valuest.

H6189.definition: עָרֵל ʻârêl, aw-rale'; from H6188;  properly, exposed, i.e. projecting loose (as to the prepuce); used only technically, uncircumcised (i.e. still having the prepuce uncurtailed):—uncircumcised (person).

H6190.definition: עׇרְלָה ʻorlâh, or-law'; feminine of H6189;  the prepuce:—foreskin,   uncircumcised.

H6191.definition: עָרַם ʻâram, aw-ram'; a primitive root;  properly, to be (or make) bare; but used only in the derivative sense (through the idea perhaps of smoothness) to be cunning (usually in a bad sense):—× very, beware, take crafty (counsel), be prudent, deal subtilly.

H6194.definition: עָרֵם ʻârêm, aw-rame'; (Jeremiah 50:26) or (feminine) עֲרֵמָה ʻărêmâh; from H6192;  a heap; specifically, a sheaf:—heap (of corn), sheaf.

H6195.definition: עׇרְמָה ʻormâh, or-maw'; feminine of H6193;  trickery; or (in a good sense) discretion:—guile, prudence, subtilty, wilily, wisdom.

H6196.definition: עַרְמוֹן ʻarmôwn, ar-mone'; probably from H6191;  the plane tree (from its smooth and shed bark):—chestnut tree.

H62.definition: אָבֵל בֵּית־מֲעַכָה ʼÂbêl Bêyth-Măʻakâh, aw-bale' bayth ma-akaw'; from H58 and H1004 and H4601; meadow of Beth-Maakah;  Abel of Beth-maakah, a place in Palestine:—Abel-beth-maachah, Abel of Beth-maachah,

H620.definition: אׇסְנַפַּר ʼOçnappar, os-nap-par'; of foreign derivation;  Osnappar, an Assyrian king:—Asnapper.

H6201.definition: עָרַף ʻâraph, aw-raf'; a primitive root;  to droop; hence, to drip:—drop (down).

H6202.definition: עָרַף ʻâraph, aw-raf'; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of slopping); properly, to bend downward; but used only as a denominative from H6203,  to break the neck; hence (figuratively) to destroy:—that is beheaded, break down, break (cut off, strike off) neck.

H6205.definition: עֲרָפֶל ʻărâphel, ar-aw-fel'; probably from H6201;  gloom (as of a lowering sky):—(gross, thick) dark (cloud, -ness).

H6206.definition: עָרַץ ʻârats, aw-rats'; a primitive root;  to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass:—be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly.

H621.definition: אָסְנַת ʼÂçᵉnath, aw-se-nath'; of Egyptian derivation;  Asenath, the wife of Joseph:—Asenath.

H6211.definition: עָשׁ ʻâsh, awsh; from H6244;  a moth:—moth. See also H5906.

H6212.definition: עֶשֶׂב ʻeseb, eh'seb; from an unused root meaning to glisten (or be green);  grass (or any tender shoot):—grass, herb.

H6213.definition: עָשָׂה ʻâsâh, aw-saw'; a primitive root;  to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application:—accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be busy, × certainly, have the charge of, commit, deal (with), deck,   displease, do, (ready) dress(-ed), (put in) execute(-ion), exercise, fashion,   feast, (fight-) ing man,   finish, fit, fly, follow, fulfill, furnish, gather, get, go about, govern, grant, great,   hinder, hold (a feast), × indeed,   be industrious,   journey, keep, labour, maintain, make, be meet, observe, be occupied, offer,   officer, pare, bring (come) to pass, perform, pracise, prepare, procure, provide, put, requite, × sacrifice, serve, set, shew, × sin, spend, × surely, take, × thoroughly, trim, × very,   vex, be (warr-) ior, work(-man), yield, use.

H6214.definition: עֲשָׂהאֵל ʻĂsâhʼêl, as-aw-ale'; from H6213 and H410; God has made;  Asahel, the name of four Israelites:—Asahel.

H6215.definition: עֵשָׂו ʻÊsâv, ay-sawv'; apparently a form of the passive participle of H6213 in the original sense of handling; rough (i.e. sensibly felt);  Esav, a son of Isaac, including his posterity:—Esau.

H6218.definition: עָשׂוֹר ʻâsôwr, aw-sore'; or עָשֹׂר ʻâsôr; from H6235;  ten; by abbreviated form ten strings, and so a decachord:—(instrument of) ten (strings, -th).

H6219.definition: עָשׁוֹת ʻâshôwth, aw-shoth'; from H6245;  shining, i.e. polished:—bright.

H622.definition: אָסַף ʼâçaph, aw-saf'; a primitive root;  to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.):—assemble, bring, consume, destroy, felch, gather (in, together, up again), × generally, get (him), lose, put all together, receive, recover (another from leprosy), (be) rereward, × surely, take (away, into, up), × utterly, withdraw.

H6222.definition: עֲשָׂיָה ʻĂsâyâh, aw-saw-yaw'; from H6213 and H3050; Jah has made;  Asajah, the name of three or four Israelites:—Asaiah.

H6223.definition: עָשִׁיר ʻâshîyr, aw-sheer'; from H6238;  rich, whether literal or figurative (noble):—rich (man).

H6225.definition: עָשַׁן ʻâshan, aw-shan'; a primitive root;  to smoke, whether literal or figurative:—be angry (be on a) smoke.

H6226.definition: עָשֵׁן ʻâshên, aw-shane'; from H6225;  smoky:—smoking.

H6227.definition: עָשָׁן ʻâshân, aw-shawn'; from H6225;  smoke, literally or figuratively (vapor, dust, anger):—smoke(-ing).

H6228.definition: עָשָׁן ʻÂshân, aw-shawn'; the same as H6227;  Ashan, a place in Palestine:—Ashan.

H623.definition: אָסָף ʼÂçâph, aw-sawf'; from H622; collector;  Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first:—Asaph.

H6230.definition: עֵשֶׂק ʻêseq, ay'sek; from H6229;  strife:—Esek.

H6231.definition: עָשַׁק ʻâshaq, aw-shak'; a primitive root (compare H6229);  to press upon, i.e. oppress, defraud, violate, overflow:—get deceitfully, deceive, defraud, drink up, (use) oppress(-ion), (-or), do violence (wrong).

H6233.definition: עֹשֶׁק ʻôsheq, o'-shek; from H6231;  injury, fraud, (subjectively) distress, (concretely) unjust gain:—cruelly, extortion, oppression, thing (deceitfully gotten).

H6235.definition: עֶשֶׂר ʻeser, eh'ser; masculine of term עֲשָׂרָה ʻăsârâh; from H6237;  ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits):—ten, (fif-, seven-) teen.

H6236.definition: עֲשַׂר ʻăsar, as-ar'; (Aramaic) masculine עֲשְׂרָה ʻăsrâh (Aramaic); corresponding to H6235;  ten:—ten,   twelve.

H6237.definition: עָשַׂר ʻâsar, aw-sar'; a primitive root (identical with H6238); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from H6235;  to tithe, i.e. to take or give a tenth:—× surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), × truly.

H6238.definition: עָשַׁר ʻâshar, aw-shar'; a primitive root;  properly, to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make) rich:—be(-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make (1 Kings 22:48 margin). See H6240.

H6239.definition: עֹשֶׁר ʻôsher, o'-sher; from H6238;  wealth:—× far (richer), riches.

H6240.definition: עָשָׂר ʻâsâr, aw-sawr'; for H6235;  ten (only in combination), i.e. -teen; also (ordinal) -teenth:—(eigh-, fif-, four-, nine-, seven-, six-, thir-) teen(-th), + eleven(-th), + sixscore thousand, + twelve(-th).

H6242.definition: עֶשְׂרִים ʻesrîym, es-reem'; from H6235;  twenty; also (ordinal) twentieth:—(six-) score, twenty(-ieth).

H6244.definition: עָשֵׁשׁ ʻâshêsh, aw-shaysh'; a primitive root;  probably to shrink, i.e. fail:—be consumed.

H6246.definition: עֲשִׁת ʻăshith, ash-eeth'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6245;  to purpose:—think.

H6249.definition: עַשְׁתֵּי ʻashtêy, ash-tay'; apparently masculine plural construction of H6247 in the sense of an afterthought (used only in connection with H6240 in lieu of H259)  eleven or (ordinal) eleventh:—  eleven(-th).

H625.definition: אֹסֶף ʼôçeph, o'-sef; from H622;  a collection (of fruits):—gathering.

H6253.definition: עַשְׁתֹּרֶת ʻAshtôreth, ash-to'reth; probably for H6251;  Ashtoreth, the Phoenician goddess of love (and increase):—Ashtoreth.

H6256.definition: עֵת ʻêth, ayth; from H5703;  time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.:—  after, (al-) ways, × certain,   continually,   evening, long, (due) season, so (long) as, (even-, evening-, noon-) tide, (meal-), what) time, when.

H6258.definition: עַתָּה ʻattâh, at-taw'; from H6256;  at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive:—henceforth, now, straightway, this time, whereas.

H626.definition: אֲסֵפָה ʼăçêphâh, as-ay-faw'; from H622;  a collection of people (only adverbial):—× together.

H6260.definition: עַתּוּד ʻattûwd, at-tood'; or עַתֻּד ʻattud; from H6257;  prepared, i.e. full grown; spoken only (in plural) of he-goats, or (figuratively) leaders of the people:—chief one, (he) goat, ram.

H6262.definition: עַתַּי ʻAttay, at-tah'ee; for H6261;  Attai, the name of three Israelites:—Attai.

H6263.definition: עֲתִיד ʻăthîyd, ath-eed'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6264;  prepared:—ready.

H6264.definition: עָתִיד ʻâthîyd, aw-theed'; from H6257;  prepared; by implication, skilful; feminine plural the future; also treasure:—things that shall come, ready, treasures.

H6265.definition: עֲתָיָה ʻĂthâyâh, ath-aw-yaw'; from H5790 and H3050; Jah has helped;  Athajah, an Israelite:—Athaiah.

H6271.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper masculine noun
H6271.definition: עֲתַלְיָה ʻĂthalyâh, ath-al-yaw'; or עֲתַלְיָהוּ ʻĂthalyâhûw; from the same as H6270 and H3050; Jah has constrained;  Athaljah, the name of an Israelitess and two Israelites:—Athaliah.

H6273.definition: עׇתְנִי ʻOthnîy, oth-nee'; from an unused root meaning to force; forcible;  Othni, an Israelite:—Othni.

H6274.definition: עׇתְנִיאֵל ʻOthnîyʼêl, oth-nee-ale'; from the same as H6273 and H410; force of God;  Othniel, an Israelite:—Othniel.

H6279.definition: עָתַר ʻâthar, aw-thar'; a primitive root (rather denominative from H6281);  to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer):—intreat, (make) pray(-er).

H6284.definition: פָּאָה pâʼâh, paw-aw'; a primitive root;  to puff, i.e. blow away:—scatter into corners.

H6285.definition: פֵּאָה pêʼâh, pay-aw'; feminine of H6311;  properly, mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction, region, extremity:—corner, end, quarter, side.

H6286.definition: פָּאַר pâʼar, paw-ar'; a primitive root; also denominative from H6288,  to gleam, i.e. (causatively) embellish; figuratively, to boast; also to explain (i.e. make clear) oneself; to shake a tree:—beautify, boast self, go over the boughs, glorify (self), glory, vaunt self.

H6287.definition: פְּאֵר pᵉʼêr, peh-ayr'; from H6286;  an embellishment, i.e. fancy head-dress:—beauty, bonnet, goodly, ornament, tire.

H6289.definition: פָּארוּר pâʼrûwr, paw-roor'; from H6286;  properly, illuminated, i.e. a glow; as noun, a flush (of anxiety):—blackness.

H629.definition: אׇסְפַּרְנָא ʼoçparnâʼ, os-par-naw'; (Aramaic) of Persian derivation;  diligently:—fast, forthwith, speed(-ily).

H6290.definition: פָּארָן Pâʼrân, paw-rawn'; from H6286; ornamental;  Paran, a desert of Arabia:—Paran.

H6292.definition: פִּגּוּל piggûwl, pig-gool'; or פִּגֻּל piggul; from an unused root meaning to stink;  properly, fetid, i.e. (figuratively) unclean (ceremonially):—abominable(-tion, thing).

H6293.definition: פָּגַע pâgaʻ, paw-gah'; a primitive root;  to impinge, by accident or violence, or (figuratively) by importunity:—come (betwixt), cause to entreat, fall (upon), make intercession, intercessor, intreat, lay, light (upon), meet (together), pray, reach, run.

H6294.definition: פֶּגַע pegaʻ, peh'-gah; from H6293;  impact (casual):—chance, occurent.

H6295.definition: פַּגְעִיאֵל Pagʻîyʼêl, pag-ee-ale'; from H6294 and H410; accident of God;  Pagiel, an Israelite:—Pagiel.

H6296.definition: פָּגַר pâgar, paw-gar'; a primitive root;  to relax, i.e. become exhausted:—be faint.

H6297.definition: פֶּגֶר peger, peh'gher; from H6296;  a carcase (as limp), whether of man or beast; figuratively, an idolatrous image:—carcase, corpse, dead body.

H6298.definition: פָּגַשׁ pâgash, paw-gash'; a primitive root;  to come in contact with, whether by accident or violence; figuratively, to concur:—meet (with, together).

H6299.definition: פָּדָה pâdâh, paw-daw'; a primitive root;  to sever, i.e. ransom; generally to release, preserve:—× at all, deliver, × by any means, ransom, (that are to be, let be) redeem(-ed), rescue, × surely.

H630.definition: אַסְפָּתָא ʼAçpâthâʼ, as-paw-thaw'; of Persian derivation;  Aspatha, a son of Haman:—Aspatha.

H6300.definition: פְּדַהְאֵל Pᵉdahʼêl, ped-ah-ale'; from H6299 and H410; God has ransomed;  Pedahel, an Israelite:—Pedahel.

H6304.definition: פְּדוּת pᵉdûwth, ped-ooth'; or פְּדֻת pᵉduth; from H6929;  distinction; also deliverance:—division, redeem, redemption.

H6305.definition: פְּדָיָה Pᵉdâyâh, ped-aw-yaw'; or פְּדָיָהוּ Pᵉdâyâhûw; from H6299 and H3050; Jah has ransomed;  Pedajah, the name of six Israelites:—Pedaiah.

H6308.definition: פָּדַע pâdaʻ, paw-dah'; a primitive root;  to retrieve:—deliver.

H631.definition: אָסַר ʼâçar, aw-sar'; a primitive root;  to yoke or hitch; by analogy, to fasten in any sense, to join battle:—bind, fast, gird, harness, hold, keep, make ready, order, prepare, prison(-er), put in bonds, set in array, tie.

H6310.definition: פֶּה peh, peh; from H6284;  the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to:—accord(-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command(-ment), × eat, edge, end, entry,   file, hole, × in, mind, mouth, part, portion, × (should) say(-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, × spoken, talk, tenor, × to,   two-edged, wish, word.

H6311.definition: פֹּה pôh, po; or פֹּא pôʼ; (Job 38:11), or פּוֹ pôw; probably from a primitive inseparable particle 'p' (of demonstrative force) and H1931;  this place (French ici), i.e. here or hence:—here, hither, the one (other, this, that) side.

H6312.definition: פּוּאָה Pûwʼâh, poo-aw'; or פֻּוָּה Puvvâh; from H6284; a blast;  Puah or Puvvah, the name of two Israelites:—Phuvah, Pua, Puah.

H6315.definition: פּוּחַ pûwach, poo'akh; a primitive root;  to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air; hence, to fan (as a breeze), to utter, to kindle (a fire), to scoff:—blow (upon), break, puff, bring into a snare, speak, utter.

H6316.partOfSpeech: proper noun with reference to people
H6316.definition: פּוּט Pûwṭ, poot; of foreign origin;  Put, a son of Ham, also the name of his descendants or their region, and of a Persian tribe:—Phut, Put.

H632.definition: אֱסָר ʼĕçâr, es-sawr'; or אִסָּר ʼiççâr; from H631;  an obligation or vow (of abstinence):—binding, bond.

H6321.definition: פּוֹל pôwl, pole; from an unused root meaning to be thick;  a bean (as plump):—beans.

H6322.definition: פּוּל Pûwl, pool; of foreign origin;  Pul, the name of an Assyrian king and of an Ethiopian tribe:—Pul.

H6326.definition: פּוּעָה Pûwʻâh, poo-aw'; from an unused root meaning to glitter; brilliancy;  Puah, an Israelitess:—Puah.

H6327.definition: פּוּץ pûwts, poots; a primitive root;  to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse):—break (dash, shake) in (to) pieces, cast (abroad), disperse (selves), drive, retire, scatter (abroad), spread abroad.

H6329.definition: פּוּק pûwq, pook; a primitive root [rather identical with H6328 through the idea of dropping out; compare H5312];  to issue, i.e. furnish; causatively, to secure; figuratively, to succeed:—afford, draw out, further, get, obtain.

H633.definition: אֱסָר ʼĕçâr, es-sawr'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H632 in a legal sense;  an interdict:—decree.

H6332.definition: פּוּר Pûwr, poor; also (plural) פּוּרִים Pûwrîym; or פֻּרִים Purîym; from H6331;  a lot (as by means of a broken piece):—Pur, Purim.

H6333.definition: פּוּרָה pûwrâh, poo-raw'; from H6331;  a wine-press (as crushing the grapes):—winepress.

H6334.definition: פּוֹרָתָא Pôwrâthâʼ, po-raw-thaw'; of Persian origin;  Poratha, a son of Haman:—Poratha.

H6337.definition: פָּז pâz, pawz; from H6338;  pure (gold); hence, gold itself (as refined):—fine (pure) gold.

H6339.definition: פָּזַז pâzaz, paw-zaz'; a primitive root (identical with H6338);  to solidify (as if by refining); also to spring (as if separating the limbs):—leap, be made strong.

H6340.definition: פָּזַר pâzar, paw-zar'; a primitive root;  to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty:—disperse, scatter (abroad).

H6341.definition: פַּח pach, pakh; from H6351;  a (metallic) sheet (as pounded thin); also a spring net (as spread out like a lamina):—gin, (thin) plate, snare.

H6342.definition: פָּחַד pâchad, paw-kkad'; a primitive root;  to be startled (by a sudden alarm); hence, to fear in general:—be afraid, stand in awe, (be in) fear, make to shake.

H6343.definition: פַּחַד pachad, pakh'-ad; from H6342;  a (sudden) alarm (properly, the object feared, by implication, the feeling):—dread(-ful), fear, (thing) great (fear, -ly feared), terror.

H6346.definition: פֶּחָה pechâh, peh-khaw'; of foreign origin;  a prefect (of a city or small district):—captain, deputy, governor.

H6347.definition: פֶּחָה pechâh, peh-khaw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6346:—captain, governor.

H6349.definition: פַּחַז pachaz, pakh'-az; from H6348;  ebullition, i.e. froth (figuratively, lust):—unstable.

H635.definition: אֶסְתֵּר ʼEçtêr, es-tare'; of Persian derivation;  Ester, the Jewish heroine:—Esther.

H6354.definition: פַּחַת pachath, pakh'-ath; probably from an unused root apparently meaning to dig;  a pit, especially for catching animals:—hole, pit, snare.

H6355.definition: פַּחַת מוֹאָב Pachath Môwʼâb, pakh'-ath mo-awb'; from H6354 and H4124; pit of Moab;  Pachath-Moab, an Israelite:—Pahathmoab.

H6357.definition: פִּטְדָה piṭdâh, pit-daw'; of foreign derivation;  a gem, probably the topaz:—topaz.

H636.definition: אָע ʼâʻ, aw; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6086;  a tree or wood:—timber, wood.

H6366.definition: פֵּיָה pêyâh, pay-aw'; or פִּיָּה pîyâh; feminine of H6310;  an edge:—(two-) edge(-d).

H6367.definition: פִּי הַחִירֹת Pîy ha-Chîyrôth, pee hah-khee-roth'; from H6310 and the feminine plural of a noun (from the same root as H2356), with the article interpolated; mouth of the gorges;  Pi-ha-Chiroth, a place in Egypt:—Pi-hahiroth. (In Numbers 14:19 without Pi-.)

H6368.definition: פִּיחַ pîyach, pee'-akh; from H6315;  a powder (as easily puffed away), i.e. ashes or dust:—ashes.

H637.definition: אַף ʼaph, af; a primitive particle;  meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though:—also, + although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, + how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.

H6370.definition: פִּילֶגֶשׁ pîylegesh, pee-leh'-ghesh; or פִּלֶגֶשׁ pilegesh; of uncertain derivation;  a concubine; also (masculine) a paramour:—concubine, paramour.

H6372.definition: פִּינְחָס Pîynᵉchâç, pee-nekh-aws'; apparently from H6310 and a variation of H5175; mouth of a serpent;  Pinechas, the name of three Israelites:—Phinehas.

H6373.definition: פִּינֹן pîynôn, pee-none'; probably the same as H6325;  Pinon, an Idumaean:—Pinon.

H6377.definition: פִּיתוֹן Pîythôwn, pee-thone'; probably from the same as H6596; expansive;  Pithon, an Israelite:—Pithon.

H6378.definition: פַּךְ pak, pak; from H6379;  a flask (from which a liquid may flow):—box, vial.

H638.definition: אַף ʼaph, af; (Aramaic) corresponding to H637:—also.

H6381.definition: פָּלָא pâlâʼ, paw-law'; a primitive root;  properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful:—accomplish, (arise...too, be too) hard, hidden, things too high, (be, do, do a, shew) marvelous(-ly, -els, things, work), miracles, perform, separate, make singular, (be, great, make) wonderful(-ers, -ly, things, works), wondrous (things, works, -ly).

H6382.definition: פֶּלֶא peleʼ, peh'-leh; from H6381;  a miracle:—marvellous thing, wonder(-ful, -fully).

H6383.definition: פִּלְאִי pilʼîy, pil-ee'; or פָּלִיא pâlîyʼ; from H6381;  remarkable:—secret, wonderful.

H6385.definition: פָּלַג pâlag, paw-lag'; a primitive root;  to split (literally or figuratively):—divide.

H6386.definition: פְּלַג pᵉlag, pel-ag'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6385:—divided.

H6388.definition: פֶּלֶג peleg, peh'-leg; from H6385;  a rill (i.e. small channel of water, as in irrigation):—river, stream.

H6389.definition: פֶּלֶג Peleg, peh'-leg; the same as H6388; earthquake;  Peleg, a son of Shem:—Peleg.

H639.definition: אַף ʼaph, af; from H599;  properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire:—anger(-gry),   before, countenance, face,   forebearing, forehead,   (long-) suffering, nose, nostril, snout, × worthy, wrath.

H6395.definition: פָּלָה pâlâh, paw-law'; a primitive root;  to distinguish (literally or figuratively):—put a difference, show marvellous, separate, set apart, sever, make wonderfully.

H6398.definition: פָּלַח pâlach, paw-lakh'; a primitive root;  to slice, i.e. break open or pierce:—bring forth, cleave, cut, shred, strike through.

H6399.definition: פְּלַח pᵉlach, pel-akh'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6398;  to serve or worship:—minister, serve.

H6400.definition: פֶּלַח pelach, peh'-lakh; from H6398;  a slice:—piece.

H6401.definition: פִּלְחָא Pilchâʼ, pil-khaw'; from H6400; slicing;  Pilcha, an Israelite:—Pilcha.

H6403.definition: פָּלַט pâlaṭ, paw-lat'; a primitive root;  to slip out, i.e. escape; causatively, to deliver:—calve, carry away safe, deliver, (cause to) escape.

H6404.definition: פֶּלֶט Peleṭ, peh'-let; from H6403; escape;  Pelet, the name of two Israelites:—Pelet. See also H1046.

H6405.definition: פַּלֵּט pallêṭ, pal-late'; from H6403;  escape:—deliverance, escape.

H6406.definition: פַּלְטִי Palṭîy, pal-tee'; from H6403; delivered;  Palti, the name of two Israelites:—Palti, Phalti.

H6408.definition: פִּלְטַי Pilṭay, pil-tah'-ee; for H6407;  Piltai, an Israelite:—Piltai.

H6409.definition: פַּלְטִיאֵל Palṭîyʼêl, pal-tee-ale'; from the same as H6404 and H410; deliverance of God;  Paltiel, the name of two Israelites:—Paltiel, Phaltiel.

H6410.definition: פְּלַטְיָה Pᵉlaṭyâh, pel-at-yaw'; or פְּלַטְיָהוּ Pᵉlaṭyâhûw; from H6403 and H3050; Jah has delivered;  Pelatjah, the name of four Israelites:—Pelatiah.

H6411.definition: פְּלָיָה Pᵉlâyâh, pel-aw-yaw'; or פְּלָאיָה Pᵉlâʼyâh; from H6381 and H3050; Jah has distinguished;  Pelajah, the name of three Israelites:—Pelaiah.

H6412.definition: פָּלִיט pâlîyṭ, paw-leet'; or פָּלֵיט pâlêyṭ; or פָּלֵט pâlêṭ; from H6403;  a refugee:—(that have) escape(-d, -th), fugitive.

H6413.definition: פְּלֵיטָה pᵉlêyṭâh, pel-ay-taw'; or פְּלֵטָה pᵉlêṭâh; feminine of H6412;  deliverance; concretely, an escaped portion:—deliverance, (that is) escape(-d), remnant.

H6419.definition: פָּלַל pâlal, paw-lal'; a primitive root;  to judge (officially or mentally); by extension, to intercede, pray:—intreat, judge(-ment), (make) pray(-er, -ing), make supplication.

H6420.definition: פָּלָל Pâlâl, paw-lawl'; from H6419; judge;  Palal, an Israelite:—Palal.

H6423.definition: פְּלֹנִי pᵉlônîy, pel-o-nee'; from H6395;  such a one, i.e. a specified person:—such.

H6424.definition: פָּלַס pâlaç, paw-las'; a primitive root;  properly, to roll flat, i.e. prepare (a road); also to revolve, i.e. weigh (mentally):—make, ponder, weigh.

H6425.definition: פֶּלֶס peleç, peh'-les; from H6424;  a balance:—scales, weight.

H6426.definition: פָּלַץ pâlats, paw-lats'; a primitive root;  properly, perhaps to rend, i.e. (by implication) to quiver:—tremble.

H6427.definition: פַּלָּצוּת pallâtsûwth, pal-law-tsooth'; from H6426;  affright:—fearfulness, horror, trembling.

H6428.definition: פָּלַשׁ pâlash, paw-lash'; a primitive root;  to roll (in dust):—roll (wallow) self.

H6429.definition: פְּלֶשֶׁת Pᵉlesheth, pel-eh'-sheth; from H6428; rolling, i.e. migratory;  Pelesheth, a region of Syria:—Palestina, Palestine, Philistia, Philistines.

H6430.definition: פְּלִשְׁתִּי Pᵉlishtîy, pel-ish-tee'; patrial from H6429;  a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth:—Philistine.

H6431.definition: פֶּלֶת Peleth, peh'-leth; from an unused root meaning to flee; swiftness;  Peleth, the name of two Israelites:—Peleth.

H6433.definition: פֻּם pum, poom; (Aramaic) probably for H6310;  the mouth (literally or figuratively):—mouth.

H6435.definition: פֵּן pên, pane; from H6437;  properly, removal; used only (in the construction) adverb as conjunction, lest:—(lest) (peradventure), that...not.

H6437.definition: פָּנָה pânâh, paw-naw'; a primitive root;  to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc.:—appear, at (even-) tide, behold, cast out, come on, × corner, dawning, empty, go away, lie, look, mark, pass away, prepare, regard, (have) respect (to), (re-) turn (aside, away, back, face, self), × right (early).

H6438.definition: פִּנָּה pinnâh, pin-naw'; feminine of H6434;  an angle; by implication, a pinnacle; figuratively, a chieftain:—bulwark, chief, corner, stay, tower.

H6439.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H6439.definition: פְּנוּאֵל Pᵉnûwʼêl, pen-oo-ale'; or (more properly,) פְּנִיאֵל Pᵉnîyʼêl; from H6437 and H410; face of God;  Penuel or Peniel, a place East of Jordan; also (as Penuel) the name of two Israelites:—Peniel, Penuel.

H644.definition: אָפָה ʼâphâh, aw-faw'; a primitive root;  to cook, especially to bake:—bake(-r, (-meats)).

H6440.definition: פָּנִים pânîym, paw-neem'; plural (but always as singular) of an unused noun פָּנֶה pâneh; from H6437);  the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.):—  accept, a-(be-) fore(-time), against, anger, × as (long as), at,   battle,   because (of),   beseech, countenance, edge,   employ, endure,   enquire, face, favour, fear of, for, forefront(-part), form(-er time, -ward), from, front, heaviness, × him(-self),   honourable,   impudent,   in, it, look(-eth) (-s), × me,   meet, × more than, mouth, of, off, (of) old (time), × on, open,   out of, over against, the partial, person,   please, presence, prospect, was purposed, by reason of,   regard, right forth,   serve, × shewbread, sight, state, straight,   street, × thee, × them(-selves), through (  -out), till, time(-s) past, (un-) to(-ward),   upon, upside (  down), with(-in,   -stand), × ye, × you.

H6441.definition: פְּנִימָה pᵉnîymâh, pen-ee'-maw; from H6440 with directive enclitic;  faceward, i.e. indoors:—(with-) in(-ner part, -ward).

H6442.definition: פְּנִימִי pᵉnîymîy, pen-ee-mee'; from H6440;  interior:—(with-) in(-ner, -ward).

H6443.definition: פָּנִין pânîyn, paw-neen'; or פָּנִי pânîy; from the same as H6434;  probably a pearl (as round):—ruby.

H6444.definition: פְּנִנָּה Pᵉninnâh, pen-in-naw'; probably feminine from H6443 contracted;  Peninnah, an Israelitess:—Peninnah.

H6448.definition: פָּסַג pâçag, paw-sag'; a primitive root;  to cut up, i.e. (figuratively) contemplate:—consider.

H645.definition: אֵפוֹ ʼêphôw, ay-fo'; or אֵפוֹא ʼêphôwʼ; from H6311;  strictly a demonstrative particle, here; but used of time, now or then:—here, now, where?

H6452.definition: פָּסַח pâçach, paw-sakh'; a primitive root;  to hop, i.e. (figuratively) skip over (or spare); by implication, to hesitate; also (literally) to limp, to dance:—halt, become lame, leap, pass over.

H6453.definition: פֶּסַח peçach, peh'-sakh; from H6452;  a pretermission, i.e. exemption; used only techically of the Jewish Passover (the festival or the victim):—passover (offering).

H6456.definition: פְּסִיל pᵉçîyl, pes-eel'; from H6458;  an idol:—carved (graven) image, quarry.

H6457.definition: פָּסַךְ Pâçak, paw-sak'; from an unused root meaning to divide; divider;  Pasak, an Israelite:—Pasach.

H6458.definition: פָּסַל pâçal, paw-sal'; a primitive root;  to carve, whether wood or stone:—grave, hew.

H6459.definition: פֶּסֶל peçel, peh'-sel; from H6458;  an idol:—carved (graven) image.

H646.definition: אֵפוֹד ʼêphôwd, ay-fode'; rarely אֵפֹד ʼêphôd; probably of foreign derivation  a girdle; specifically the ephod or highpriest's shoulder-piece; also generally, an image:—ephod.

H6462.definition: פִּסְפָּה Piçpâh, pis-paw'; perhaps from H6461; dispersion;  Pispah, an Israelite:—Pispah.

H6466.definition: פָּעַל pâʻal, paw-al'; a primitive root;  to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise:—commit, (evil-) do(-er), make(-r), ordain, work(-er).

H6467.definition: פֹּעַל pôʻal, po'-al; from H6466;  an act or work (concretely):—act, deed, do, getting, maker, work.

H6471.definition: פַּעַם paʻam, pah'-am; or (feminine) פַּעֲמָה paʻămâh; from H6470;  a stroke, literally or figuratively (in various applications, as follow):—anvil, corner, foot(-step), going, (hundred-) fold, × now, (this)   once, order, rank, step,   thrice, (often-), second, this, two) time(-s), twice, wheel.

H6472.definition: פַּעֲמֹן paʻămôn, pah-am-one'; from H6471;  a bell (as struck):—bell.

H6474.definition: פַּעֲרַי Paʻăray, pah-ar-ah'-ee; from H6473; yawning;  Paarai, an Israelite:—Paarai.

H6475.definition: פָּצָה pâtsâh, paw-tsaw'; a primitive root;  to rend, i.e. open (especially the mouth):—deliver, gape, open, rid, utter.

H6476.definition: פָּצַח pâtsach, paw-tsakh'; a primitive root;  to break out (in joyful sound):—break (forth, forth into joy), make a loud noise.

H6481.definition: פָּצַע pâtsaʻ, paw-tsah'; a primitive root;  to split, i.e. wound:—wound.

H6482.definition: פֶּצַע petsaʻ, peh'-tsah; from H6481;  a wound:—wound(-ing).

H6485.definition: פָּקַד pâqad, paw-kad'; a primitive root;  to visit (with friendly or hostile intent); by analogy, to oversee, muster, charge, care for, miss, deposit, etc.:—appoint, × at all, avenge, bestow, (appoint to have the, give a) charge, commit, count, deliver to keep, be empty, enjoin, go see, hurt, do judgment, lack, lay up, look, make, × by any means, miss, number, officer, (make) overseer, have (the) oversight, punish, reckon, (call to) remember(-brance), set (over), sum, × surely, visit, want.

H6489.partOfSpeech: proper noun with reference to people
H6489.definition: פְּקוֹד Pᵉqôwd, pek-ode'; from H6485; punishment;  Pekod, a symbolic name for Babylon:—Pekod.

H6491.definition: פָּקַח pâqach, paw-kakh'; a primitive root;  to open (the senses, especially the eyes); figuratively, to be observant:—open.

H6492.definition: פֶּקַח Peqach, peh'-kakh; from H6491; watch;  Pekach, an Israelite king:—Pekah.

H6493.definition: פִּקֵּחַ piqqêach, pik-kay'-akh; from H6491;  clear-sighted; figuratively, intelligent:—seeing, wise.

H6494.definition: פְּקַחְיָה Pᵉqachyâh, pek-akh-yaw'; from H6491 and H3050; Jah has observed;  Pekachjah, an Israelite king:—Pekahiah.

H6496.definition: פָּקִיד pâqîyd, paw-keed'; from H6485;  a superintendent (civil, military or religious):—which had the charge, governor, office, overseer, (that) was set.

H6497.definition: פֶּקַע peqaʻ, peh'-kah; from an unused root meaning to burst; only used as an architectural term of an ornament similar to H6498,  a semi-globe:—knop.

H6498.definition: פַּקֻּעָה paqquʻâh, pak-koo-aw'; from the same as H6497;  the wild cucumber (from splitting open to shed its seeds):—gourd.

H6499.definition: פַּר par, par; or פָּר pâr; from H6565; + a bullock (apparently as breaking forth in wild strength, or perhaps as dividing the hoof):—(+ young) bull(-ock), calf, ox.

H650.definition: אָפִיק ʼâphîyq, aw-feek'; from H622;  properly, containing, i.e. a tube; also a bed or valley of a stream; also a strong thing or a hero:—brook, channel, mighty, river,   scale, stream, strong piece.

H6501.definition: פֶּרֶא pereʼ, peh'-reh; or פֶּרֶה pereh; (Jeremiah 2:24), from H6500 in the secondary sense of running wild;  the onager:—wild (ass).

H6504.definition: פָּרַד pârad, paw-rad'; a primitive root;  to break through, i.e. spread or separate (oneself):—disperse, divide, be out of joint, part, scatter (abroad), separate (self), sever self, stretch, sunder.

H6505.definition: פֶּרֶד pered, peh'-red; from H6504;  a mule (perhaps from his lonely habits):—mule.

H6506.definition: פִּרְדָּה pirdâh, pir-daw'; feminine of H6505;  a she-mule:—mule.

H6508.definition: פַּרְדֵּס pardêç, par-dace'; of foreign origin;  a park:—forest, orchard.

H6509.definition: פָּרָה pârâh, paw-raw'; a primitive root;  to bear fruit (literally or figuratively):—bear, bring forth (fruit), (be, cause to be, make) fruitful, grow, increase.

H6510.definition: פָּרָה pârâh, paw-raw'; feminine of H6499;  a heifer:—cow, heifer, kine.

H6517.definition: פָּרוּר pârûwr, paw-roor'; passive participle of H6565 in the sense of spreading out (compare H6524);  a skillet (as flat or deep):—pan, pot.

H6519.definition: פְּרָזָה pᵉrâzâh, per-aw-zaw'; from the same as H6518;  an open country:—(unwalled) town (without walls), unwalled village.

H652.definition: אֹפֶל ʼôphel, o'fel; from the same as H651;  dusk:—darkness, obscurity, privily.

H6522.definition: פְּרִזִּי Pᵉrizzîy, per-iz-zee'; for H6521; inhabitant of the open country;  a Perizzite, one of the Canaanitish tribes:—Perizzite.

H6523.definition: פַּרְזֶל parzel, par-zel'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H1270;  iron:—iron.

H6524.definition: פָּרַח pârach, paw-rakh'; a primitive root;  to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom; generally, to spread; specifically, to fly (as extending the wings); figuratively, to flourish:—× abroad, × abundantly, blossom, break forth (out), bud, flourish, make fly, grow, spread, spring (up).

H6525.definition: פֶּרַח perach, peh'-rakh; from H6524;  a calyx (natural or artificial); generally, bloom:—blossom, bud, flower.

H6529.definition: פְּרִי pᵉrîy, per-ee'; from H6509;  fruit (literally or figuratively):—bough, (first-)fruit(-ful), reward.

H6532.definition: פֹּרֶכֶת pôreketh, po-reh'-keth; feminine active participle of the same as H6531;  a separatrix, i.e. (the sacred) screen:—vail.

H6533.definition: פָּרַם pâram, paw-ram'; a primitive root;  to tear:—rend.

H6534.definition: פַּרְמַשְׁתָּא Parmashtâʼ, par-mash-taw'; of Persian origin;  Parmashta, a son of Haman:—Parmasta.

H6537.definition: פְּרַס pᵉraç, per-as'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6536;  to split up:—divide, (U-) pharsin.

H6539.partOfSpeech: proper noun with reference to territory and people
H6539.definition: פָּרַס Pâraç, paw-ras'; of foreign origin;  Paras (i.e. Persia), an Eastern country, including its inhabitants:—Persia, Persians.

H654.definition: אֶפְלָל ʼEphlâl, ef-lawl'; from H6419; judge;  Ephlal, an Israelite:—Ephlal.

H6541.definition: פַּרְסָה parçâh, par-saw'; feminine of H6538;  a claw or split hoof:—claw, (cloven-) footed, hoof.

H6544.definition: פָּרַע pâraʻ, paw-rah'; a primitive root;  to loosen; by implication, to expose, dismiss; figuratively, absolve, begin:—avenge, avoid, bare, go back, let, (make) naked, set at nought, perish, refuse, uncover.

H6547.definition: פַּרְעֹה Parʻôh, par-o'; of Egyptian derivation;  Paroh, a general title of Egyptian kings:—Pharaoh.
