H6548.definition: פַּרְעֹה חׇפְרַע Parʻôh Chophraʻ, par-o' khof-rah'; of Egyptian derivation;  Paroh-Chophra, an Egyptian king:—Pharaoh-hophra.

H6549.definition: פַּרְעֹה נְכֹה Parʻôh Nᵉkôh, par-o' nek-o'; or פַּרְעֹה נְכוֹ Parʻôh Nᵉkôw; of Egyptian derivation;  Paroh-Nekoh (or -Neko), an Egyptian king:—Pharaoh-necho, Pharaohnechoh.

H6550.definition: פַּרְעֹשׁ parʻôsh, par-oshe'; probably from H6544 and H6211;  a flea (as the isolated insect):—flea.

H6551.definition: פַּרְעֹשׁ Parʻôsh, par-oshe'; the same as H6550;  Parosh, the name of our Israelite:—Parosh, Pharosh.

H6555.definition: פָּרַץ pârats, paw-rats'; a primitive root;  to break out (in many applications, direct and indirect, literal and figurative):—× abroad, (make a) breach, break (away, down, -er, forth, in, up), burst out, come (spread) abroad, compel, disperse, grow, increase, open, press, scatter, urge.

H6556.definition: פֶּרֶץ perets, peh'-rets; from H6555;  a break (literally or figuratively):—breach, breaking forth (in), × forth, gap.

H6557.definition: פֶּרֶץ Perets, peh'-rets; the same as H6556;  Perets, the name of two Israelites:—Perez, Pharez.

H6559.definition: פְּרָצִים pᵉrâtsîym, per-aw-tseem'; plural of H6556; breaks;  Peratsim, a mountain in Palestine:—Perazim.

H656.definition: אָפֵס ʼâphêç, aw-face'; a primitive root;  to disappear, i.e. cease:—be clean gone (at an end, brought to nought), fail.

H6560.definition: פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּא Perets ʻUzzâʼ, peh'-rets ooz-zaw'; from H6556 and H5798; break of Uzza;  Perets-Uzza, a place in Palestine:—Perezuzza.

H6561.definition: פָּרַק pâraq, paw-rak'; a primitive root;  to break off or crunch; figuratively, to deliver:—break (off), deliver, redeem, rend (in pieces), tear in pieces.

H6565.definition: פָּרַר pârar, paw-rar'; a primitive root;  to break up (usually figuratively), i.e. to violate, frustrate:—× any ways, break (asunder), cast off, cause to cease, × clean, defeat, disannul, disappoint, dissolve, divide, make of none effect, fail, frustrate, bring (come) to nought, × utterly, make void.

H6566.definition: פָּרַשׂ pâras, paw-ras'; a primitive root;  to break apart, disperse, etc.:—break, chop in pieces, lay open, scatter, spread (abroad, forth, selves, out), stretch (forth, out).

H6567.definition: פָּרָשׁ pârâsh, paw-rash'; a primitive root;  to separate, literally (to disperse) or figuratively (to specify); also (by implication) to wound:—scatter, declare, distinctly, shew, sting.

H6569.definition: פֶּרֶשׁ peresh, peh'-resh; from H6567;  excrement (as eliminated):—dung.

H657.definition: אֶפֶס ʼepheç, eh'-fes; from H656; (sometimes like H6466)  cessation, i.e. an end (especially of the earth); often used adverb, no further; also the ankle (in the dual), as being the extremity of the leg or foot:—ankle, but (only), end, howbeit, less than nothing, nevertheless (where), no, none (beside), not (any, -withstanding), thing of nought, save(-ing), there, uttermost part, want, without (cause).

H6570.definition: פֶּרֶשׁ Peresh, peh'-resh; the same as H6569;  Peresh, an Israelite:—Peresh.

H6571.definition: פָּרָשׁ pârâsh, paw-rawsh'; from H6567; (compare H5483)  a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle, not single nor for mounting ); also (by implication) a driver (in a chariot), i.e. (collectively) cavalry:—horseman.

H6575.definition: פָּרָשָׁה pârâshâh, paw-raw-shaw'; from H6567;  exposition:—declaration, sum.

H6578.definition: פְּרָת Pᵉrâth, per-awth'; from an unused root meaning to break forth; rushing;  Perath (i.e. Euphrates), a river of the East:—Euphrates.

H6581.definition: פָּשָׂה pâsâh, paw-saw'; a primitive root;  to spread:—spread.

H6583.definition: פַּשְׁחוּר Pashchûwr, pash-khoor'; probably from H6582; liberation;  Pashchur, the name of four Israelites:—Pashur.

H6584.definition: פָּשַׁט pâshaṭ, paw-shat'; a primitive root;  to spread out (i.e. deploy in hostile array); by analogy, to strip (i.e. unclothe, plunder, flay, etc.):—fall upon, flay, invade, make an invasion, pull off, put off, make a road, run upon, rush, set, spoil, spread selves (abroad), strip (off, self).

H6586.definition: פָּשַׁע pâshaʻ, paw-shah'; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of expansion);  to break away (from just authority), i.e. trespass, apostatize, quarrel:—offend, rebel, revolt, transgress(-ion, -or).

H6588.definition: פֶּשַׁע peshaʻ, peh'-shah; from H6586;  a revolt (national, moral or religious):—rebellion, sin, transgression, trespass.

H6589.definition: פָּשַׂק pâsaq, paw-sak'; a primitive root;  to dispart (the feet or lips), i.e. become licentious:—open (wide).

H6590.definition: פְּשַׁר pᵉshar, pesh-ar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6622;  to interpret:—make (interpretations), interpreting.

H6591.definition: פְּשַׁר pᵉshar, pesh-ar'; (Aramaic) from H6590;  an interpretation:—interpretation.

H6593.definition: פִּשְׁתֶּה pishteh, pish-teh'; from the same as H6580 as in the sense of comminuting;  linen (i.e. the thread, as carded):—flax, linen.

H6595.definition: פַּת path, path; from H6626; a bit:—meat, morsel, piece.

H6597.definition: פִּתְאוֹם pithʼôwm, pith-ome'; or פִּתְאֹם pithʼôm; from H6621;  instantly:—straightway, sudden(-ly).

H6598.definition: פַּתְבַּג pathbag, pathbag'; of Persian origin;  a dainty:—portion (provision) of meat.

H6599.definition: פִּתְגָּם pithgâm, pith-gawm'; of Persian origin;  a (judicial) sentence:—decree, sentence.

H66.definition: אַבֵל מַיִם ʼAbêl Mayim, aw-bale' mah'-yim; from H58 and H4325; meadow of water;  Abel-Majim, a place in Palestine:—Abel-maim.

H6600.definition: פִּתְגָּם pithgâm, pith-gawm'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6599;  a word, answer, letter or decree:—answer, letter, matter, word.

H6601.definition: פָּתָה pâthâh, paw-thaw'; a primitive root;  to open, i.e. be (causatively, make) roomy; usually figuratively (in a mental or moral sense) to be (causatively, make) simple or (in a sinister way) delude:—allure, deceive, enlarge, entice, flatter, persuade, silly (one).

H6603.definition: פִּתּוּחַ pittûwach, pit-too'-akh; or פִּתֻּחַ pittuach ; passive participle of H6605;  sculpture (in low or high relief or even intaglio):—carved (work) (are, en-) grave(-ing, -n).

H6605.definition: פָּתַח pâthach, paw-thakh'; a primitive root;  to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve:—appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave(-n), loose (self), (be, be set) open(-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent.

H6606.definition: פְּתַח pᵉthach, peth-akh'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6605;  to open:—open.

H6607.definition: פֶּתַח pethach, peh'-thakh; from H6605;  an opening (literally), i.e. door (gate) or entrance way:—door, entering (in), entrance (-ry), gate, opening, place.

H6609.definition: פְּתִחָה pᵉthichâh, peth-ee-khaw'; from H6605;  something opened, i.e. a drawn sword:—drawn sword.

H661.definition: אָפַף ʼâphaph, aw-faf'; a primitive root;  to surround:—compass.

H6610.definition: פִּתְחוֹן pithchôwn, pith-khone'; from H6605;  opening (the act):—open(-ing).

H6611.definition: פְּתַחְיָה Pᵉthachyâh, peth-akh-yaw'; from H6605 and H3050; Jah has opened;  Pethachjah, the name of four Israelites:—Pethakiah.

H6612.definition: פְּתִי pᵉthîy, peth-ee'; or פֶּתִי pethîy; or פְּתָאִי pᵉthâʼîy; from H6601;  silly (i.e. seducible):—foolish, simple(-icity, one).

H6616.definition: פָּתִיל pâthîyl, paw-theel'; from H6617;  twine:—bound, bracelet, lace, line, ribband, thread, wire.

H6617.definition: פָּתַל pâthal, paw-thal'; a primitive root;  to twine, i.e. (literally) to struggle or (figuratively) be (morally) tortuous:—(shew self) froward, shew self unsavoury, wrestle.

H6619.definition: פִּתֹם Pithôm, pee-thome'; of Egyptian derivation;  Pithom, a place in Egypt:—Pithom.

H6620.definition: פֶּתֶן pethen, peh'-then; from an unused root meaning to twist;  an asp (from its contortions):—adder.

H6621.definition: פֶּתַע pethaʻ, peh'-thah; from an unused root meaning to open (the eyes); (compare H6597)  a wink, i.e. moment (used only [with or without preposition] adverbially, quickly or unexpectedly):—at an instant, suddenly, × very.

H6624.definition: פַּתְרוֹס Pathrôwç, path-roce'; of Egyptian derivation;  Pathros, a part of Egypt:—Pathros.

H6628.definition: צֶאֶל tseʼel, tseh'-el; from an unused root meaning to be slender;  the lotus tree:—shady tree.

H6629.definition: צֹאן tsôʼn, tsone; or צאוֹן tsʼôwn; (Psalm 144:13), from an unused root meaning to migrate;  a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men):—(small) cattle, flock (+ -s), lamb (+ -s), sheep(-cote, -fold, -shearer, -herds).

H6631.definition: צֶאֱצָא tseʼĕtsâʼ, tseh-ets-aw'; from H3318;  issue, i.e. produce, children:—that which cometh forth (out), offspring.

H6632.definition: צָב tsâb, tsawb; from an unused root meaning to establish;  a palanquin or canopy (as a fixture); also a species of lizard (probably as clinging fast):—covered, litter, tortoise.

H6635.definition: צָבָא tsâbâʼ, tsaw-baw'; or (feminine) צְבָאָה tsᵉbâʼâh; from H6633;  a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized for war (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship):—appointed time, (+) army, (+) battle, company, host, service, soldiers, waiting upon, war(-fare).

H6638.definition: צָבָה tsâbâh, tsaw-baw'; a primitive root;  to amass, i.e. grow turgid; specifically, to array an army against:—fight swell.

H6639.definition: צָבֶה tsâbeh, tsaw-beh'; from H6638;  turgid:—swell.

H6643.definition: צְבִי tsᵉbîy, tseb-ee'; from H6638 in the sense of prominence;  splendor (as conspicuous):—beautiful(-ty), glorious (-ry), goodly, pleasant, roe(-buck).

H6644.definition: צִבְיָא Tsibyâʼ, tsib-yaw'; for H6645;  Tsibja, an Israelite:—Zibia.

H6648.definition: צֶבַע tsebaʻ, tseh'-bah; from an unused root meaning to dip (into coloring fluid);  a dye:—divers, colours.

H6649.definition: צִבְעוֹן Tsibʻôwn, tsib-one'; from the same as H6648; variegated;  Tsibon, an Idumaean:—Zibeon.

H665.definition: אֵפֶר ʼêpher, ay'-fer; from an unused root meaning to bestrew;  ashes:—ashes.

H6650.definition: צְבֹעִים Tsᵉbôʻîym, tseb-o-eem'; plural of H6641; hyenas;  Tseboim, a place in Palestine:—Zeboim.

H6651.definition: צָבַר tsâbar, tsaw-bar'; a primitive root;  to aggregate:—gather (together), heap (up), lay up.

H6652.definition: צִבֻּר tsibbur, tsib-boor'; from H6551;  a pile:—heap.

H6654.definition: צַד tsad, tsad; contr. from an unused root meaning to sidle off;  a side; figuratively, an adversary:—(be-) side.

H6655.definition: צַד tsad, tsad; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6654;  used adverbially (with preposition) at or upon the side of:—against, concerning.

H6659.definition: צָדוֹק Tsâdôwq, tsaw-doke'; from H6663; just;  Tsadok, the name of eight or nine Israelites:—Zadok.

H6660.definition: צְדִיָּה tsᵉdîyâh, tsed-ee-yaw'; from H6658; (compare H6656)  design:—lying in wait.

H6662.definition: צַדִּיק tsaddîyq, tsad-deek'; from H6663;  just:—just, lawful, righteous (man).

H6663.definition: צָדַק tsâdaq, tsaw-dak'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, make) right (in a moral or forensic sense):—cleanse, clear self, (be, do) just(-ice, -ify, -ify self), (be turn to) righteous(-ness).

H6664.definition: צֶדֶק tsedeq, tseh'-dek; from H6663;  the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity:—× even, (× that which is altogether) just(-ice), (un-)right(-eous) (cause, -ly, -ness).

H6666.definition: צְדָקָה tsᵉdâqâh, tsed-aw-kaw'; from H6663;  rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity):—justice, moderately, right(-eous) (act, -ly, -ness).

H6667.definition: צִדְקִיָּה Tsidqîyâh, tsid-kee-yaw'; or צִדְקִיָּהוּ Tsidqîyâhûw; from H6664 and H3050; right of Jah;  Tsidkijah, the name of six Israelites:—Zedekiah, Zidkijah.

H667.definition: אֶפְרֹחַ ʼephrôach, ef-ro'-akh; from H6524 (in the sense of bursting the shell);  the brood of a bird:—young (one).

H6670.definition: צָהַל tsâhal, tsaw-hal'; a primitive root;  to gleam, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; by transference to sound clear (of various animal or human expressions):—bellow, cry aloud (out), lift up, neigh, rejoice, make to shine, shout.

H6671.definition: צָהַר tsâhar, tsaw-har'; a primitive root; to glisten; used only as denominative from H3323,  to press out oil:—make oil.

H6672.definition: צֹהַר tsôhar, tso'-har; from H6671;  a light (i.e. window); dual double light, i.e. noon:—midday, noon(-day, -tide), window.

H6673.definition: צַו tsav, tsav; or צָו tsâv; from H6680;  an injunction:—commandment, precept.

H6677.definition: צַוָּאר tsavvâʼr, tsav-vawr'; or צַוָּר tsavvâr; (Nehemiah 3:5), or צַוָּרֹן tsavvârônlemma צַוָּרן missing vowel, corrected to צַוָּרֹן; (Song of Solomon 4:9), or (feminine) צַוָּארָה tsavvâʼrâh; (Micah 2:3), intensively from H6696 in the sense of binding;  the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound):—neck.

H6679.definition: צוּד tsûwd, tsood; a primitive root; also denominative from H6718  to lie alongside (i.e. in wait); by implication, to catch an animal (figuratively, men); to victual (for a journey):—chase, hunt, sore, take (provision).

H6680.definition: צָוָה tsâvâh, tsaw-vaw'; a primitive root;  (intensively) to constitute, enjoin:—appoint, (for-) bid, (give a) charge, (give a, give in, send with) command(-er, -ment), send a messenger, put, (set) in order.

H6684.definition: צוּם tsûwm, tsoom; a primitive root;  to cover over (the mouth), i.e. to fast:—× at all, fast.

H6687.definition: צוּף tsûwph, tsoof; a primitive root;  to overflow:—(make to over-) flow, swim.

H6689.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H6689.definition: צוּף Tsûwph, tsoof; or צוֹפַי Tsôwphay; or צִיף Tsîyph; from H6688; honey-comb;  Tsuph or Tsophai or Tsiph, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:—Zophai, Zuph.

H669.definition: אֶפְרַיִם ʼEphrayim, ef-rah'-yim; dual of masculine form of H672; double fruit;  Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory:—Ephraim, Ephraimites.

H6690.definition: צוֹפַח Tsôwphach, tso-fakh'; from an unused root meaning to expand, breadth;  Tsophach, an Israelite:—Zophah.

H6691.definition: צוֹפַר Tsôwphar, tso-far'; from H6852; departing;  Tsophar, a friend of Job:—Zophar.

H6693.definition: צוּק tsûwq, tsook; a primitive root;  to compress, i.e. (figuratively) oppress, distress:—constrain, distress, lie sore, (op-) press(-or), straiten.

H6694.definition: צוּק tsûwq, tsook; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of narrowness (of orifice));  to pour out, i.e. (figuratively) smelt, utter:—be molten, pour.

H6696.definition: צוּר tsûwr, tsoor; a primitive root;  to cramp, i.e. confine (in many applications, literally and figuratively, formative or hostile):—adversary, assault, beset, besiege, bind (up), cast, distress, fashion, fortify, inclose, lay siege, put up in bags.

H6697.partOfSpeech: masculine noun, proper noun with reference to deity
H6697.definition: צוּר tsûwr, tsoor; or צֻר tsur; from H6696;  properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous):—edge, × (mighty) God (one), rock, × sharp, stone, × strength, × strong. See also H1049.

H6699.definition: צוּרָה tsûwrâh, tsoo-raw'; feminine of H6697;  a rock (Job 28:10); also a form (as if pressed out):—form, rock.

H67.definition: אָבֵל מִצְרַיִם ʼÂbêl Mitsrayim, aw-bale' mits-rah'-yim; from H58 and H4714; meadow of Egypt;  Abel-Mitsrajim, a place in Palestine:—Abel-mizraim.

H6707.definition: צְחִיחָה tsᵉchîychâh, tsekh-ee-khaw'; feminine of H6706;  a parched region, i.e. the desert:—dry land.

H671.partOfSpeech: proper masculine plural noun (of Persian origin)
H671.definition: אֲפַרְסְכַי ʼĂpharçᵉkay, af-ar-sek-ah'ee; (Aramaic) or אֲפַרְסַתְכַי ʼĂpharçathkay; (Aramaic), of foreign origin (only in the plural);  an Apharsekite or Apharsathkite, an unknown Assyrian tribe:—Apharsachites, Apharasthchites.

H6710.definition: צַחְצָחָה tsachtsâchâh, tsakh-tsaw-khaw'; from H6705;  a dry place, i.e. desert:—drought.

H6711.definition: צָחַק tsâchaq, tsaw-khak'; a primitive root;  to laugh outright (in merriment or scorn); by implication, to sport:—laugh, mock, play, make sport.

H6712.definition: צְחֹק tsᵉchôq, tsekh-oke'; from H6711;  laughter (in pleasure or derision):—laugh(-ed to scorn).

H6716.definition: צִי tsîy, tsee; from H6680;  a ship (as a fixture):—ship.

H6717.definition: צִיבָא Tsîybâʼ, tsee-baw'; from the same as H6678; station;  Tsiba, an Israelite:—Ziba.

H6718.definition: צַיִד tsayid, tsah'-yid; from a form of H6679 and meaning the same;  the chase; also game (thus taken):—× catcheth, food, × hunter, (that which he took in) hunting, venison, victuals.

H6719.definition: צַיָּד tsayâd, tsah'-yawd; from the same as H6718;  a huntsman:—hunter.

H672.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper locative noun
H672.definition: אֶפְרָת ʼEphrâth, ef-rawth'; or אֶפְרָתָה ʼEphrâthâh; from H6509; fruitfulness;  Ephrath, another name for Bethlehem;:—once (Psalm 132:6) perhaps for Ephraim; also of an Israelitish woman; Ephrath, Ephratah.

H6720.definition: צֵידָה tsêydâh, tsay-daw'; or צֵדָה tsêdâh; feminine of H6718;  food:—meat, provision, venison, victuals.

H6721.definition: צִידוֹן Tsîydôwn, tsee-done'; or צִידֹן Tsîydôn; from H6679 in the sense of catching fish; fishery;  Tsidon, the name of a son of Canaan, and of a place in Palestine:—Sidon, Zidon.

H6722.definition: צִידֹנִי Tsîydônîy, tsee-do-nee'; patrial from H6721;  a Tsidonian or inhabitant of Tsidon:—Sidonian, of Sidon, Zidonian.

H6723.definition: צִיָּה tsîyâh, tsee-yaw'; from an unused root meaning to parch;  aridity; concretely, a desert:—barren, drought, dry (land, place), solitary place, wilderness.

H6725.definition: צִיּוּן tsîyûwn, tsee-yoon'; from the same as H6723 in the sense of conspicuousness (compare H5329);  a monumental or guiding pillar:—sign, title, waymark.

H6726.definition: צִיּוֹן Tsîyôwn, tsee-yone'; the same (regularly) as H6725;  Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem:—Zion.

H6728.definition: צִיִּי tsîyîy, tsee-ee'; from the same as H6723;  a desert-dweller, i.e. nomad or wild beast:—wild beast of the desert, that dwell in (inhabiting) the wilderness.

H673.definition: אֶפְרָתִי ʼEphrâthîy, ef-rawth-ee'; patrial from H672;  an Ephrathite or an Ephraimite:—Ephraimite, Ephrathite.

H6731.definition: צִיץ tsîyts, tseets; or צִץ tsits; from H6692;  properly, glistening, i.e. a burnished plate; also a flower (as bright colored); a wing (as gleaming in the air):—blossom, flower, plate, wing.

H6733.definition: צִיצָה tsîytsâh, tsee-tsaw'; feminine of H6731;  a flower:—flower.

H6735.definition: צִיר tsîyr, tseer; from H6696;  a hinge (as pressed in turning); also a throe (as a phys. or mental pressure); also a herald or errand-doer (as constrained by the principal):—ambassador, hinge, messenger, pain, pang, sorrow. Compare H6736.

H6738.definition: צֵל tsêl, tsale; from H6751;  shade, whether literal or figurative:—defence, shade(-ow).

H6741.definition: צִלָּה Tsillâh, tsil-law'; feminine of H6738;  Tsillah, an antediluvian woman:—Zillah.

H6742.definition: צְלוּל tsᵉlûwl, tsel-ool'; from H6749 in the sense of rolling;  a (round or flattened) cake:—cake.

H6743.definition: צָלַח tsâlach, tsaw-lakh'; or צָלֵחַ tsâlêach; a primitive root;  to push forward, in various senses (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive):—break out, come (mightily), go over, be good, be meet, be profitable, (cause to, effect, make to, send) prosper(-ity, -ous, -ously).

H6744.definition: צְלַח tsᵉlach, tsel-akh'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6743;  to advance (transitive or intransitive):—promote, prosper.

H6748.definition: צָלִי tsâlîy, tsaw-lee'; passive participle of H6740;  roasted:—roast.

H675.definition: אֶצְבּוֹן ʼEtsbôwn, ets-bone'; or אֶצְבֹּן ʼEtsbôn; of uncertain derivation;  Etsbon, the name of two Israelites:—Ezbon.

H6751.definition: צָלַל tsâlal, tsaw-lal'; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of hovering over (compare H6754));  to shade, as twilight or an opaque object:—begin to be dark, shadowing.

H6754.definition: צֶלֶם tselem, tseh'-lem; from an unused root meaning to shade;  a phantom, i.e. (figuratively) illusion, resemblance; hence, a representative figure, especially an idol:—image, vain shew.

H6755.definition: צֶלֶם tselem, tseh'-lem; (Aramaic) or צְלֶם tsᵉlem; (Aramaic), corresponding to H6754;  an idolatrous figure:—form, image.

H6756.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H6756.definition: צַלְמוֹן Tsalmôwn, tsal-mone'; from H6754; shady;  Tsalmon, the name of a place in Palestine and of an Israelite:—Zalmon.

H6757.definition: צַלְמָוֶת tsalmâveth, tsal-maw'-veth; from H6738 and H4194;  shade of death, i.e. the grave (figuratively, calamity):—shadow of death.

H676.definition: אֶצְבַּע ʼetsbaʻ, ets-bah'; from the same as H6648 (in the sense of grasping);  something to sieze with, i.e. a finger; by analogy, a toe:—finger, toe.

H6763.definition: צֵלָע tsêlâʻ, tsay-law'; or (feminine) צַלְעָה tsalʻâh; from H6760;  a rib (as curved), literally (of the body) or figuratively (of a door, i.e. leaf); hence, a side, literally (of a person) or figuratively (of an object or the sky, i.e. quarter); architecturally, a (especially floor or ceiling) timber or plank (single or collective, i.e. a flooring):—beam, board, chamber, corner, leaf, plank, rib, side (chamber).

H6767.definition: צְלָצַל tsᵉlâtsal, tsel-aw-tsal'; from H6750 reduplicated;  a clatter, i.e. (abstractly) whirring (of wings); (concretely) a cricket; also a harpoon (as rattling),a cymbal (as clanging):—cymbal, locust, shadowing, spear.

H6768.definition: צֶלֶק Tseleq, tseh'-lek; from an unused root meaning to split; fissure;  Tselek, an Israelite:—Zelek.

H6769.definition: צִלְּתַי Tsillᵉthay, tsil-leth-ah'-ee; from the feminine of H6738; shady;  Tsillethai, the name of two Israelites:—Zilthai.

H677.definition: אֶצְבַּע ʼetsbaʻ, ets-bah'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H676:—finger, toe.

H6770.definition: צָמֵא tsâmêʼ, tsaw-may'; a primitive root;  to thirst (literally or figuratively):—(be a-, suffer) thirst(-y).

H6772.definition: צָמָא tsâmâʼ, tsaw-maw'; from H6770;  thirst (literally or figuratively):—thirst(-y).

H6774.definition: צִמָּאוֹן tsimmâʼôwn, tsim-maw-one'; from H6771;  a thirsty place, i.e. desert:—drought, dry ground, thirsty land.

H6775.definition: צָמַד tsâmad, tsaw-mad'; a primitive root;  to link, i.e. gird; figuratively, to serve, (mentally) contrive:—fasten, frame, join (self).

H6776.definition: צֶמֶד tsemed, tseh'-med; a yoke or team (i.e. pair); hence, an acre (i.e. day's task for a yoke of cattle to plough)—acre, couple, × together, two (donkeys), yoke (of oxen).

H6778.definition: צַמּוּק tsammûwq, tsam-mook'; from H6784;  a cake of dried grapes:—bunch (cluster) of raisins.

H6779.definition: צָמַח tsâmach, tsaw-makh'; a primitive root;  to sprout (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative):—bear, bring forth, (cause to, make to) bud (forth), (cause to, make to) grow (again, up), (cause to) spring (forth, up).

H6780.definition: צֶמַח tsemach, tseh'-makh; from H6779;  a sprout (usually concrete), literal or figurative:—branch, bud, that which (where) grew (upon), spring(-ing).

H6781.definition: צָמִיד tsâmîyd, tsaw-meed'; or צָמִד tsâmid; from H6775;  a bracelet or arm-clasp; generally, a lid:—bracelet, covering.

H6785.definition: צֶמֶר tsemer, tseh'-mer; from an unused root probably meaning to be shaggy;  wool:—wool(-len).

H6787.definition: צְמָרַיִם Tsᵉmârayim, tsem-aw-rah'-yim; dual of H6785; double fleece;  Tsemarajim, a place in Palestine:—Zemaraim.

H6788.definition: צַמֶּרֶת tsammereth, tsam-meh'-reth; from the same as H6785;  fleeciness, i.e. foliage:—highest branch, top.

H6789.definition: צָמַת tsâmath, tsaw-math'; a primitive root;  to extirpate (literally or figuratively):—consume, cut off, destroy, vanish.

H679.definition: אַצִּיל ʼatstsîyl, ats-tseel'; from H680 (in its primary sense of uniting);  a joint of the hand (i.e. knuckle); also (according to some) a party-wall (Ezekiel 41:8):—(arm) hole, great.

H6791.definition: צֵן tsên, tsane; from an unused root meaning to be prickly;  a thorn; hence, a cactus-hedge:—thorn.

H6792.definition: צֹנֵא tsônêʼ, tso-nay'; or צֹנֶה tsôneh; for H6629;  a flock:—sheep.

H6793.definition: צִנָּה tsinnâh, tsin-naw'; feminine of H6791;  a hook (as pointed); also a (large) shield (as if guarding by prickliness); also cold (as piercing):—buckler, cold, hook, shield, target.

H6797.definition: צָנִיף tsânîyph, tsaw-neef'; or צָנוֹף tsânôwph; or (feminine) צָנִיפָה tsânîyphâh; from H6801;  a head-dress (i.e. piece of cloth wrapped around):—diadem, hood, mitre.

H6798.definition: צָנַם tsânam, tsaw-nam'; a primitive root;  to blast or shrink:—withered.

H6799.definition: צְנָן Tsᵉnân, tsen-awn'; probably for H6630;  Tsenan, a place near Palestine:—Zenan.

H68.definition: אֶבֶן ʼeben, eh'-ben; from the root of H1129 through the meaning to build;  a stone:—  carbuncle,   mason,   plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-) stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s).

H6800.definition: צָנַע tsânaʻ, tsaw-nah'; a primitive root;  to humiliate:—humbly, lowly.

H6804.definition: צַנְתָּרָה tsantârâh, tsan-taw-raw'; probably from the same as H6794;  a tube:—pipe.

H6805.definition: צָעַד tsâʻad, tsaw-ad'; a primitive root;  to pace, i.e. step regularly; (upward) to mount; (along) to march; (down and causatively) to hurl:—bring, go, march (through), run over.

H6808.definition: צָעָה tsâʻâh, tsaw-aw'; a primitive root;  to tip over (for the purpose of spilling or pouring out), i.e. (figuratively) depopulate; by implication, to imprison or conquer; (reflexive) to lie down (for coitus):—captive exile, travelling, (cause to) wander(-er).

H681.definition: אֵצֶל ʼêtsel, ay'-tsel; from H680 (in the sense of joining);  a side; (as a preposition) near:—at, (hard) by, (from) (beside), near (unto), toward, with. See also H1018.

H6810.definition: צָעִיר tsâʻîyr, tsaw-eer'; or צָעוֹר tsâʻôwr; from H6819;  little; (in number) few; (in age) young, (in value) ignoble:—least, little (one), small (one),   young(-er, -est).

H6814.definition: צֹעַן Tsôʻan, tso'-an; of Egyptian derivation;  Tsoän, a place in Egypt:—Zoan.

H6817.definition: צָעַק tsâʻaq, tsaw-ak'; a primitive root;  to shriek; (by implication) to proclaim (an assembly):—× at all, call together, cry (out), gather (selves) (together).

H6818.definition: צַעֲקָה tsaʻăqâh, tsah-ak-aw'; from H6817;  a shriek:—cry(-ing).

H682.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H682.definition: אָצֵל ʼÂtsêl, aw-tsale'; from H680; noble;  Atsel, the name of an Israelite, and of a place in Palestine:—Azal, Azel.

H6820.definition: צֹעַר Tsôʻar, tso'ar; from H6819; little;  Tsoar, a place East of the Jordan:—Zoar.

H6822.definition: צָפָה tsâphâh, tsaw-faw'; a primitive root;  properly, to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance; by implication, to observe, await:—behold, espy, look up (well), wait for, (keep the) watch(-man).

H6823.definition: צָפָה tsâphâh, tsaw-faw'; a primitive root (probably identical with H6822 through the idea of expansion in outlook, transferring to action);  to sheet over (especially with metal):—cover, overlay.

H6825.definition: צְפוֹ Tsᵉphôw, tsef-o'; or צְפִי Tsᵉphîy; from H6822; observant;  Tsepho or Tsephi, an Idumaean:—Zephi, Zepho.

H6826.definition: צִפּוּי tsippûwy, tsip-poo'-ee; from H6823;  encasement (with metal):—covering, overlaying.

H6828.definition: צָפוֹן tsâphôwn, tsaw-fone'; or צָפֹן tsâphôn; from H6845;  properly, hidden, i.e. dark; used only of the north as a quarter (gloomy and unknown):—north(-ern, side, -ward, wind).

H6832.definition: צְפוּעַ tsᵉphûwaʻ, tsef-oo'-ah; from the same as H6848;  excrement (as protruded):—dung.

H6833.definition: צִפּוֹר tsippôwr, tsip-pore'; or צִפֹּר tsippôr; from H6852;  a little bird (as hopping):—bird, fowl, sparrow.

H6837.definition: צִפְיוֹן Tsiphyôwn, tsif-yone'; from H6822; watch-tower;  Tsiphjon, an Israelite:—Ziphion. Compare H6827.

H684.definition: אֹצֶם ʼÔtsem, o'-tsem; from an unused root probably meaning to be strong; strength (i.e. strong);  Otsem, the name of two Israelites:—Ozem.

H6841.definition: צְפִיר tsᵉphîyr, tsef-eer'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6842;  a he-goat:—he (goat).

H6842.definition: צָפִיר tsâphîyr, tsaw-feer'; from H6852;  a male goat (as prancing):—(he) goat.

H6843.definition: צְפִירָה tsᵉphîyrâh, tsef-ee-raw'; feminine formed like H6842;  a crown (as encircling the head); also a turn of affairs (i.e. mishap):—diadem, morning.

H6845.definition: צָפַן tsâphan, tsaw-fan'; a primitive root;  to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk:—esteem, hide(-den one, self), lay up, lurk (be set) privily, (keep) secret(-ly, place).

H6846.definition: צְפַנְיָה Tsᵉphanyâh, tsef-an-yaw'; or צְפַנְיָהוּ Tsᵉphanyâhûw; from H6845 and H3050; Jah has secreted;  Tsephanjah, the name of four Israelites:—Zephaniah.

H6847.definition: צׇפְנַת פַּעְנֵחַ Tsophnath Paʻnêach, tsof-nath' pah-nay'-akh; of Egyptian derivation;  Tsophnath-Paneach, Joseph's Egyptian name:—Zaphnath-paaneah.

H685.definition: אֶצְעָדָה ʼetsʻâdâh, ets-aw-daw'; a variation from H6807;  properly, a step-chain; by analogy, a bracelet:—bracelet, chain.

H6854.definition: צְפַרְדֵּעַ tsᵉphardêaʻ, tsef-ar-day'-ah; from H6852 and a word elsewhere unused meaning a swamp;  a marsh-leaper, i.e. frog:—frog.

H6855.definition: צִפֹּרָה Tsippôrâh, tsip-po-raw'; feminine of H6833; bird;  Tsipporah, Moses’ wife:—Zipporah.

H6856.definition: צִפֹּרֶן tsippôren, tsip-po'-ren; from H6852 (in the denominative sense (from H6833) of scratching);  properly, a claw, i.e. (human) nail; also the point of a style (or pen, tipped with adamant):—nail, point.

H6857.definition: צְפַת Tsᵉphath, tsef-ath'; from H6822; watch-tower;  Tsephath, a place in Palestine:—Zephath.

H6860.definition: צִקְלַג Tsiqlag, tsik-lag'; or צִיקלַג Tsîyqlag; (1 Chronicles 12:1,20), of uncertain derivation;  Tsiklag or Tsikelag, a place in Palestine:—Ziklag.

H6862.definition: צַר tsar, tsar; or צָר tsâr; from H6887;  narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble (as in H6864); (transitive) an opponent (as crowding):—adversary, afflicted(-tion), anguish, close, distress, enemy, flint, foe, narrow, small, sorrow, strait, tribulation, trouble.

H6863.definition: צֵר Tsêr, tsare; from H6887; rock;  Tser, a place in Palestine:—Zer.

H6864.definition: צֹר tsôr, tsore; from H6696;  a stone (as if pressed hard or to a point); (by implication, of use) a knife:—flint, sharp stone.

H6865.definition: צֹר Tsôr, tsore; or צוֹר Tsôwr; the same as H6864; a rock;  Tsor, a place in Palestine:—Tyre, Tyrus.

H6869.definition: צָרָה tsârâh, tsaw-raw'; feminine of H6862;  tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival:—adversary, adversity, affliction, anguish, distress, tribulation, trouble.

H687.definition: אֶצֶר ʼEtser, ay'-tser; from H686; treasure;  Etser, an Idumaean:—Ezer.

H6872.definition: צְרוֹר tsᵉrôwr, tser-ore'; or (shorter) צְרֹר tsᵉrôr; from H6887;  a parcel (as packed up); also a kernel or particle (as if a package):—bag, × bendeth, bundle, least grain, small stone.

H6873.definition: צָרַח tsârach, tsaw-rakh'; a primitive root;  to be clear (in tone, i.e. shrill), i.e. to whoop:—cry, roar.

H6874.definition: צְרִי Tsᵉrîy, tser-ee'; the same as H6875;  Tseri, an Israelite:—Zeri. Compare H3340.

H6875.definition: צְרִי tsᵉrîy, tser-ee'; or צֳרִי tsŏrîy; from an unused root meaning to crack (as by pressure), hence, to leak;  distillation, i.e. balsam:—balm.

H6879.definition: צָרַע tsâraʻ, tsaw-rah'; a primitive root;  to scourge, i.e. (intransitive and figurative) to be stricken with leprosy:—leper, leprous.

H6880.definition: צִרְעָה tsirʻâh, tsir-aw'; from H6879;  a wasp (as stinging):—hornet.

H6881.definition: צׇרְעָה Tsorʻâh, tsor-aw'; apparently another form for H6880;  Tsorah, a place in Palestine:—Zareah, Zorah, Zoreah.

H6884.definition: צָרַף tsâraph, tsaw-raf'; a primitive root;  to fuse (metal), i.e. refine (literally or figuratively):—cast, (re-) fine(-er), founder, goldsmith, melt, pure, purge away, try.

H6887.definition: צָרַר tsârar, tsaw-rar'; a primitive root;  to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive:—adversary, (be in) afflict(-ion), beseige, bind (up), (be in, bring) distress, enemy, narrower, oppress, pangs, shut up, be in a strait (trouble), vex.

H6891.definition: צָרְתָן Tsârᵉthân, tsaw-reth-awn'; perhaps for H6868;  Tsarethan, a place in Palestine:—Zarthan.

H6892.definition: קֵא qêʼ, kay; or קִיא qîyʼ; from H6958;  vomit:—vomit.

H6895.definition: קָבַב qâbab, kaw-bab'; a primitive root;  to scoop out, i.e. (figuratively) to malign or execrate (i.e. stab with words):—× at all, curse.

H69.definition: אֶבֶן ʼeben, eh'-ben; (Aramaic) corresponding to H68:—stone.

H6900.definition: קְבוּרָה qᵉbûwrâh, keb-oo-raw'; or קְבֻרָה qᵉburâh; feminine passive participle of H6912;  sepulture; (concretely) a sepulchre:—burial, burying place, grave, sepulchre.

H6901.definition: קָבַל qâbal, kaw-bal'; a primitive root;  to admit, i.e. take (literally or figuratively):—choose, (take) hold, receive, (under-) take.

H6902.definition: קְבַל qᵉbal, keb-al'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6901;  to acquire:—receive, take.

H6903.definition: קְבֵל qᵉbêl, keb-ale'; (Aramaic) or קֳבֵל qŏbêl; (Aramaic), (corresponding to H6905;  (adverbially) in front of; usually (with other particles) on account of, so as, since, hence:—  according to,   as,   because, before,   for this cause,   forasmuch as,   by this means, over against, by reason of,   that,   therefore,   though,   wherefore.

H6906.definition: קָבַע qâbaʻ, kaw-bah'; a primitive root;  to cover, i.e. (figuratively) defraud:—rob, spoil.

H6908.definition: קָבַץ qâbats, kaw-bats'; a primitive root;  to grasp, i.e. collect:—assemble (selves), gather (bring) (together, selves together, up), heap, resort, × surely, take up.

H6912.definition: קָבַר qâbar, kaw-bar'; a primitive root;  to inter:—× in any wise, bury(-ier).

H6913.definition: קֶבֶר qeber, keh'-ber; or (feminine) קִבְרָה qibrâh; from H6912;  a sepulchre:—burying place, grave, sepulchre.

H6914.definition: קִבְרוֹת הַתַּאֲוָה Qibrôwth hat-Taʼă-vâh, kib-roth' hat-tahav-aw'; from the feminine plural of H6913 and H8378 with the article interposed; graves of the longing;  Kibroth-hat-Taavh, a place in the Desert:—Kibroth-hattaavah.

H6915.definition: קָדַד qâdad, kaw-dad'; a primitive root;  to shrivel up, i.e. contract or bend the body (or neck) in deference:—bow (down) (the) head, stoop.

H6916.definition: קִדָּה qiddâh, kid-daw'; from H6915;  cassia bark (as in shrivelled rolls):—cassia.

H6918.definition: קָדוֹשׁ qâdôwsh, kaw-doshe'; or קָדֹשׁ qâdôsh; from H6942;  sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary:—holy (One), saint.

H6919.definition: קָדַח qâdach, kaw-dakh'; a primitive root to inflame  to inflame:—burn, kindle.

H6921.definition: קָדִים qâdîym, kaw-deem'; or קָדִם qâdim; from H6923;  the fore or front part; hence (by orientation) the East (often adverbially, eastward, for brevity the east wind):—east(-ward, wind).

H6922.definition: קַדִּישׁ qaddîysh, kad-deesh'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6918.:—Holy (One), saint.

H6923.definition: קָדַם qâdam, kaw-dam'; a primitive root;  to project (one self), i.e. precede; hence, to anticipate, hasten, meet (usually for help):—come (go, (flee)) before,   disappoint, meet, prevent.

H6924.definition: קֶדֶם qedem, keh'-dem; or קֵדְמָה qêdᵉmâh; from H6923;  the front, of place (absolutely, the fore part, relatively the East) or time (antiquity); often used adverbially (before, anciently, eastward):—aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, × ever(-lasting), forward, old, past. Compare H6926.

H6925.definition: קֳדָם qŏdâm, kod-awm'; (Aramaic) or קְדָם qᵉdâm; (Aramaic) (Daniel 7:13), corresponding to H6924;  before:—before, × from, × I (thought), × me,   of, × it pleased, presence.

H6926.definition: קִדְמָה qidmâh, kid-maw'; feminine of H6924;  the forward part (or relatively) East (often adverbially, on the east or in front):—east(-ward).

H6927.definition: קַדְמָה qadmâh, kad-maw'; from H6923;  priority (in time); also used adverbially (before):—afore, antiquity, former (old) estate.

H6928.definition: קַדְמָה qadmâh, kad-maw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6927;  former time:—afore(-time), ago.

H693.definition: אָרַב ʼârab, aw-rab'; a primitive root;  to lurk:—(lie in) ambush(-ment), lay (lie in) wait.

H6932.definition: קְדֵמוֹת Qᵉdêmôwth, ked-ay-mothe'; from H6923; beginnings;  Kedemoth, a place in eastern Palestine:—Kedemoth.

H6933.definition: קַדְמַי qadmay, kad-mah'-ee; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H6923;  first:—first.

H6934.definition: קַדְמִיאֵל Qadmîyʼêl, kad-mee-ale'; from H6924 and H410; presence of God;  Kadmiel, the name of three Israelites:—Kadmiel.

H6936.definition: קׇדְקֹד qodqôd, kod-kode'; from H6915;  the crown of the head (as the part most bowed):—crown (of the head), pate, scalp, top of the head.

H6937.definition: קָדַר qâdar, kaw-dar'; a primitive root;  to be ashy, i.e. dark-colored; by implication, to mourn (in sackcloth or sordid garments):—be black(-ish), be (make) dark(-en), × heavily, (cause to) mourn.

H6939.partOfSpeech: proper noun with reference to a stream
H6939.definition: קִדְרוֹן Qidrôwn, kid-rone'; from H6937; dusky place;  Kidron, a brook near Jerusalem:—Kidron.

H694.definition: אֲרָב ʼĂrâb, ar-awb'; from H693; ambush;  Arab, a place in Palestine:—Arab.

H6942.definition: קָדַשׁ qâdash, kaw-dash'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, make, pronounce or observe as) clean (ceremonially or morally):—appoint, bid, consecrate, dedicate, defile, hallow, (be, keep) holy(-er, place), keep, prepare, proclaim, purify, sanctify(-ied one, self), × wholly.

H6943.definition: קֶדֶשׁ Qedesh, keh'-desh; from H6942; a sanctum;  Kedesh, the name of four places in Palestine:—Kedesh.

H6944.definition: קֹדֶשׁ qôdesh, ko'-desh; from H6942;  a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity:—consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, (× most) holy (× day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.

H6945.definition: קָדֵשׁ qâdêsh, kaw-dashe'; from H6942;  a (quasi) sacred person, i.e. (technically) a (male) devotee (by prostitution) to licentious idolatry:—sodomite, unclean.

H6946.definition: קָדֵשׁ Qâdêsh, kaw-dashe'; the same as H6945; sanctuary;  Kadesh, a place in the Desert:—Kadesh. Compare H6947.

H6949.definition: קָהָה qâhâh, kaw-haw'; a primitive root;  to be dull:—be set on edge, be blunt.

H695.definition: אֶרֶב ʼereb, eh'-reb; from H693;  ambuscade:—den, lie in wait.

H6950.definition: קָהַל qâhal, 'kaw-hal'; a primitive root;  to convoke:—assemble (selves) (together), gather (selves) (together).

H6951.definition: קָהָל qâhâl, kaw-hawl'; from H6950;  assemblage (usually concretely):—assembly, company, congregation, multitude.

H6952.definition: קְהִלָּה qᵉhillâh, keh-hil-law'; from H6950;  an assemblage:—assembly, congregation.

H6955.definition: קְהָת Qᵉhâth, keh-hawth'; from an unused root meaning to ally oneself; allied;  Kehath, an Israelite:—Kohath.

H6957.definition: קַו qav, kav; or קָו qâv; from H6960 (compare H6961);  a cord (as connecting), especially for measuring; figuratively, a rule; also a rim, a musical string or accord:—line. Compare H6978.

H6959.definition: קוֹבַע qôwbaʻ, ko'-bah or ko-bah'; a form collateral to H3553;  a helmet:—helmet.

H6960.definition: קָוָה qâvâh, kaw-vaw'; a primitive root;  to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect; (figuratively) to expect:—gather (together), look, patiently, tarry, wait (for, on, upon).

H6963.definition: קוֹל qôwl, kole; or קֹל qôl; from an unused root meaning to call aloud;  a voice or sound:—+ aloud, bleating, crackling, cry (+ out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, + hold peace, (pro-) claim, proclamation, + sing, sound, + spark, thunder(-ing), voice, + yell.

H6965.definition: קוּם qûwm, koom; a primitive root;  to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative):—abide, accomplish, × be clearer, confirm, continue, decree, × be dim, endure, × enemy, enjoin, get up, make good, help, hold, (help to) lift up (again), make, × but newly, ordain, perform, pitch, raise (up), rear (up), remain, (a-) rise (up) (again, against), rouse up, set (up), (e-) stablish, (make to) stand (up), stir up, strengthen, succeed, (as-, make) sure(-ly), (be) up(-hold, -rising).

H6966.definition: קוּם qûwm, koom; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6965:—appoint, establish, make, raise up self, (a-) rise (up), (make to) stand, set (up).

H6967.definition: קוֹמָה qôwmâh, ko-maw'; from H6965;  height:—× along, height, high, stature, tall.

H6968.definition: קוֹמְמִיּוּת qôwmᵉmîyûwth, ko-mem-ee-yooth'; from H6965;  elevation, i.e. (adverbially) erectly (figuratively):—upright.

H6969.definition: קוּן qûwn, koon; a primitive root;  to strike a musical note, i.e. chant or wail (at a funeral):—lament, mourning woman.

H697.definition: אַרְבֶּה ʼarbeh, ar-beh'; from H7235;  a locust (from its rapid increase):—grasshopper, locust.

H6974.definition: קוּץ qûwts, koots; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of abruptness in starting up from sleep (compare H3364));  to awake (literally or figuratively):—arise, (be) (a-) wake, watch.

H6975.definition: קוֹץ qôwts, kotse; or קֹץ qôts; from H6972 (in the sense of pricking);  a thorn:—thorn.

H6976.definition: קוֹץ Qôwts, kotse; the same as H6975;  Kots, the name of two Israelites:—Koz, Hakkoz (including the article).

H6979.definition: קוּר qûwr, koor; a primitive root; also denominative from H7023  to trench; by implication, to throw forth; to wall up, whether literal (to build a wall) or figurative (to estop):—break down, cast out, destroy, dig.

H6980.definition: קוּר qûwr, koor; from H6979;  (only plural) trenches, i.e. a web (as if so formed):—web.

H6981.definition: קוֹרֵא Qôwrêʼ, ko-ray'; or קֹרֵא Qôrêʼ; (1 Chronicles 26:1), active participle of H7121; crier;  Kore, the name of two Israelites:—Kore.

H6988.definition: קְטוֹרָה qᵉṭôwrâh, ket-o-raw'; from H6999;  perfume:—incense.

H699.definition: אֲרֻבָּה ʼărubbâh, ar-oob-baw'; feminine participle passive of H693 (as if for lurking);  a lattice; (by implication) a window, dovecot (because of the pigeon-holes), chimney (with its apertures for smoke), sluice (with openings for water):—chimney, window.

H6994.definition: קָטֹן qâṭôn, kaw-tone'; a primitive root (rather denominative from H6996);  to diminish, i.e. be (causatively, make) diminutive or (figuratively) of no account:—be a (make) small (thing), be not worthy.

H6995.definition: קֹטֶן qôṭen, ko'-ten; from H6994;  a pettiness, i.e. the little finger:—little finger.

H6996.definition: קָטָן qâṭân, kaw-tawn'; or קָטֹן qâṭôn; from H6962;  abbreviated, i.e. diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance):—least, less(-er), little (one), small(-est, one, quantity, thing), young(-er, -est).

H6998.definition: קָטַף qâṭaph, kaw-taf'; a primitive root;  to strip off:—crop off, cut down (up), pluck.

H6999.definition: קָטַר qâṭar, kaw-tar'; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of fumigation in a close place and perhaps thus driving out the occupants);  to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire (especially as an act of worship):—burn (incense, sacrifice) (upon), (altar for) incense, kindle, offer (incense, a sacrifice).

H7.definition: אֲבַד ʼăbad, ab-ad'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H6:—destroy, perish.

H7001.definition: קְטַר qᵉṭar, ket-ar'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H7000;  a knot (as tied up), i.e. (figuratively) a riddle; also a vertebra (as if a knot):—doubt, joint.

H7004.definition: קְטֹרֶת qᵉṭôreth, ket-o'-reth; from H6999;  a fumigation:—(sweet) incense, perfume.

H7006.definition: קָיָה qâyâh, kaw-yaw'; a primitive root;  to vomit:—spue.

H7014.partOfSpeech: proper gentilic noun, proper masculine noun
H7014.definition: קַיִן Qayin, kah'-yin; the same as H7013 (with a play upon the affinity to H7069);  Kajin, the name of the first child, also of a place in Palestine, and of an Oriental tribe:—Cain, Kenite(-s).

H7018.definition: קֵינָן Qêynân, kay-nawn'; from the same as H7064; fixed;  Kenan, an antediluvian:—Cainan, Kenan.

H7019.definition: קַיִץ qayits, kah'-yits; from H6972;  harvest (as the crop), whether the product (grain or fruit) or the (dry) season:—summer (fruit, house).

H702.definition: אַרְבַּע ʼarbaʻ, ar-bah'; masculine אַרְבָּעָה ʼarbâʻâh; from H7251;  four:—four.

H7023.definition: קִיר qîyr, keer; or קִר qir; (Isaiah 22:5), or (feminine) קִירָה qîyrâh; from H6979;  a wall (as built in a trench):—  mason, side, town, × very, wall.

H7027.definition: קִישׁ Qîysh, keesh; from H6983; a bow;  Kish, the name of five Israelites:—Kish.

H7028.definition: קִישׁוֹן Qîyshôwn, kee-shone'; from H6983; winding;  Kishon, a river of Palestine:—Kishon, Kison.

H703.definition: אַרְבַּע ʼarbaʻ, ar-bah'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H702:—four.

H7030.definition: קִיתָרֹס qîythârôç, kee-thaw-roce'; (Aramaic) of Greek origin;  a lyre:—harp.

H7031.definition: קַל qal, kal; contracted from H7043;  light; (by implication) rapid (also adverbial):—light, swift(-ly).

H7033.definition: קָלָה qâlâh, kaw-law'; a primitive root (rather identical with H7034 through the idea of shrinkage by heat);  to toast, i.e. scorch partially or slowly:—dried, loathsome, parch, roast.

H7036.definition: קָלוֹן qâlôwn, kaw-lone'; from H7034;  disgrace; (by implication) the pudenda:—confusion, dishonour, ignominy, reproach, shame.

H7039.definition: קָלִי qâlîy, kaw-lee'; or קָלִיא qâlîyʼ; from H7033;  roasted ears of grain:—parched corn.

H7040.definition: קַלַּי Qallay, kal-lah'-ee; from H7043; frivolous;  Kallai, an Israelite:—Kallai.

H7041.definition: קֵלָיָה Qêlâyâh, kay-law-yaw'; from H7034; insignificance;  Kelajah, an Israelite:—Kelaiah.

H7042.definition: קְלִיטָא Qᵉlîyṭâʼ, kel-ee-taw'; from H7038; maiming;  Kelita, the name of three Israelites:—Kelita.

H7043.definition: קָלַל qâlal, kaw-lal'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, make) light, literally (swift, small, sharp, etc.) or figuratively (easy, trifling, vile, etc.):—abate, make bright, bring into contempt, (ac-) curse, despise, (be) ease(-y, -ier), (be a, make, make somewhat, move, seem a, set) light(-en, -er, -ly, -ly afflict, -ly esteem, thing), × slight(-ly), be swift(-er), (be, be more, make, re-) vile, whet.

H7045.definition: קְלָלָה qᵉlâlâh, kel-aw-law'; from H7043;  vilification:—(ac-) curse(-d, -ing).

H705.definition: אַרְבָּעִים ʼarbâʻîym, ar-baw-eem'; multiple of H702;  forty:—forty.

H7054.definition: קָמָה qâmâh, kuw-maw'; feminine of active participle of H6965;  something that rises, i.e. a stalk of grain:—(standing) corn, grown up, stalk.

H7055.definition: קְמוּאֵל Qᵉmûwʼêl, kem-oo-ale'; from H6965 and H410; raised of God;  Kemuel, the name of a relative of Abraham, and of two Israelites:—Kemuel.

H7057.definition: קִמּוֹשׁ qimmôwsh, kim-moshe'; or קִימוֹשׁ qîymôwsh; from an unused root meaning to sting;  a prickly plant:—nettle. Compare H7063.

H7058.definition: קֶמַח qemach, keh'-makh; from an unused root probably meaning to grind;  flour:—flour, meal.

H7059.definition: קָמַט qâmaṭ, kaw-mat'; a primitive root;  to pluck, i.e. destroy:—cut down, fill with wrinkles.

H706.definition: אַרְבַּעְתַּיִם ʼarbaʻtayim, ar-bah-tah'-yim; dual of H702;  fourfold:—fourfold.

H7060.definition: קָמַל qâmal, kaw-mal'; a primitive root;  to wither:—hew down, wither.

H7062.definition: קֹמֶץ qômets, ko'mets; from H7061;  a grasp, i.e. handful:—handful.

H7064.definition: קֵן qên, kane; contracted from H7077;  a nest (as fixed), sometimes including the nestlings; figuratively, a chamber or dwelling:—nest, room.

H7065.definition: קָנָא qânâʼ, kaw-naw'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, make) zealous, i.e. (in a bad sense) jealous or envious:—(be) envy(-ious), be (move to, provoke to) jealous(-y), × very, (be) zeal(-ous).

H7066.definition: קְנָא qᵉnâʼ, ken-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7069;  to purchase:—buy.

H7068.definition: קִנְאָה qinʼâh, kin-aw'; from H7065;  jealousy or envy:—envy(-ied), jealousy, × sake, zeal.

H7069.definition: קָנָה qânâh, kaw-naw'; a primitive root;  to erect, i.e. create; by extension, to procure, especially by purchase (causatively, sell); by implication to own:—attain, buy(-er), teach to keep cattle, get, provoke to jealousy, possess(-or), purchase, recover, redeem, × surely, × verily.

H707.definition: אָרַג ʼârag, aw-rag'; a primitive root;  to plait or weave:—weaver(-r).

H7070.definition: קָנֶה qâneh, kaw-neh'; from H7069;  a reed (as erect); by resemblance a rod (especially for measuring), shaft, tube, stem, the radius (of the arm), beam (of a steelyard):—balance, bone, branch, calamus, cane, reed, × spearman, stalk.

H7071.definition: קָנָה Qânâh, kaw-naw'; feminine of H7070; reediness;  Kanah, the name of a stream and of a place in Palestine:—Kanah.

H7073.definition: קְנַז Qᵉnaz, ken-az'; probably from an unused root meaning to hunt; hunter;  Kenaz, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites:—Kenaz.

H7076.definition: קִנָּמוֹן qinnâmôwn, kin-naw-mone'; from an unused root (meaning to erect);  cinnamon bark (as in upright rolls):—cinnamon.

H7077.definition: קָנַן qânan, kaw-nan'; a primitive root; to erect; but used only as denominative from H7064;  to nestle, i.e. build or occupy as a nest:—make...nest.

H7079.definition: קְנָת Qᵉnâth, ken-awth'; from H7069; possession;  Kenath, a place East of the Jordan:—Kenath.

H7080.definition: קָסַם qâçam, kaw-sam'; a primitive root;  properly, to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll; by implication, to divine:—divine(-r, -ation), prudent, soothsayer, use (divination).

H7081.definition: קֶסֶם qeçem, keh'-sem; from H7080;  a lot; also divination (including its fee), oracle:—(reward of) divination, divine sentence, witchcraft.

H7082.definition: קָסַס qâçaç, kaw-sas'; a primitive root;  to lop off:—cut off.

H7083.definition: קֶסֶת qeçeth, keh'-seth; from the same as H3563 (or as H7185);  properly, a cup, i.e. an ink-stand:—inkhorn.

H7084.definition: קְעִילָה Qᵉʻîylâh, keh-ee-law'; perhaps from H7049 in the sense of enclosing; citadel;  Keilah, a place in Palestine:—Keilah.

H7086.definition: קְעָרָה qᵉʻârâh, keh-aw-raw'; probably from H7167;  a bowl (as cut out hollow):—charger, dish.

H7092.definition: קָפַץ qâphats, kaw-fats'; a primitive root;  to draw together, i.e. close; by implication, to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically, to die (from gathering up the feet):—shut (up), skip, stop, take out of the way.

H7093.definition: קֵץ qêts, kates; contracted from H7112;  an extremity; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after:—  after, (utmost) border, end, (in-) finite, × process.

H7094.definition: קָצַב qâtsab, kaw-tsab'; a primitive root;  to clip, or (generally) chop:—cut down, shorn.

H7095.definition: קֶצֶב qetseb, keh'-tseb; from H7094;  shape (as if cut out); base (as if there cut off):—bottom, size.

H7096.definition: קָצָה qâtsâh, kaw-tsaw'; a primitive root;  to cut off; (figuratively) to destroy; (partially) to scrape off:—cut off, cut short, scrape (off).

H7097.definition: קָצֶה qâtseh, kaw-tseh'; or (negative only) קֵצֶה qêtseh; from H7096; (used in a great variety of applications and idioms; compare H7093)  an extremity:—× after, border, brim, brink, edge, end, (in-) finite, frontier, outmost coast, quarter, shore, (out-) side, × some, ut(-ter-) most (part).

H7098.definition: קָצָה qâtsâh, kaw-tsaw'; feminine of H7097; (used like H7097)  a termination:—coast, corner, (selv-) edge, lowest, (uttermost) participle

H71.definition: אֲבָנָה ʼĂbânâh, ab-aw-naw'; perhaps feminine of H68; stony; Compare H549.  Abanah, a river near Damascus:—Abana.

H7100.definition: קֶצַח qetsach, keh'-tsakh; from an unused root apparently meaning to incise;  fennel-flower (from its pungency):—fitches.

H7101.definition: קָצִין qâtsîyn, kaw-tseen'; from H7096 in the sense of determining;  a magistrate (as deciding) or other leader:—captain, guide, prince, ruler. Compare H6278.

H7103.definition: קְצִיעָה Qᵉtsîyʻâh, kets-ee-aw'; the same as H7102;  Ketsiah, a daughter of Job:—Kezia.

H7105.definition: קָצִיר qâtsîyr, kaw-tseer'; from H7114;  severed, i.e. harvest (as reaped), the crop, the time, the reaper, or figuratively; also a limb (of a tree, or simply foliage):—bough, branch, harvest (man).

H7106.definition: קָצַע qâtsaʻ, kaw-tsah'; a primitive root;  to strip off, i.e. (partially) scrape; by implication, to segregate (as an angle):—cause to scrape, corner.

H7107.definition: קָצַף qâtsaph, kaw-tsaf'; a primitive root;  to crack off, i.e. (figuratively) burst out in rage:—(be) anger(-ry), displease, fret self, (provoke to) wrath (come), be wroth.

H7108.definition: קְצַף qᵉtsaph, kets-af'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7107;  to become enraged:—be furious.

H7109.definition: קְצַף qᵉtsaph, kets-af'; (Aramaic) from H7108;  rage:—wrath.

H7110.definition: קֶצֶף qetseph, keh'-tsef; from H7107;  a splinter (as chipped off); figuratively, rage or strife:—foam, indignation, × sore, wrath.

H7112.definition: קָצַץ qâtsats, kaw-tsats'; a primitive root;  to chop off (literally or figuratively):—cut (asunder, in pieces, in sunder, off), × utmost.

H7113.definition: קְצַץ qᵉtsats, kets-ats'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7112:—cut off.

H7114.definition: קָצַר qâtsar, kaw-tsar'; a primitive root;  to dock off, i.e. curtail (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative); especially to harvest (grass or grain):—× at all, cut down, much discouraged, grieve, harvestman, lothe, mourn, reap(-er), (be, wax) short(-en, -er), straiten, trouble, vex.

H7121.definition: קָרָא qârâʼ, kaw-raw'; a primitive root (rather identical with H7122 through the idea of accosting a person met);  to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications):—bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.

H7122.definition: קָרָא qârâʼ, kaw-raw'; a primitive root;  to encounter, whether accidentally or in a hostile manner:—befall, (by) chance, (cause to) come (upon), fall out, happen, meet.

H7123.definition: קְרָא qᵉrâʼ, ker-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7121:—call, cry, read.

H7125.definition: קִרְאָה qirʼâh, keer-aw'; from H7122;  an encountering, accidental, friendly or hostile (also adverbially, opposite):—× against (he come), help, meet, seek, × to, × in the way.

H7126.definition: קָרַב qârab, kaw-rab'; a primitive root;  to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose:—(cause to) approach, (cause to) bring (forth, near), (cause to) come (near, nigh), (cause to) draw near (nigh), go (near), be at hand, join, be near, offer, present, produce, make ready, stand, take.

H7127.definition: קְרֵב qᵉrêb, ker-abe'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7126:—approach, come (near, nigh), draw near.

H7129.definition: קְרָב qᵉrâb, ker-awb'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7128:—war.

H713.definition: אַרְגָּמָן ʼargâmân, ar-gaw-mawn'; of foreign origin;  purple (the color or the dyed stuff):—purple.

H7130.definition: קֶרֶב qereb, keh'-reb; from H7126;  properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition):—× among, × before, bowels, × unto charge,   eat (up), × heart, × him, × in, inward (× -ly, part, -s, thought), midst,   out of, purtenance, × therein, × through, × within self.

H7131.definition: קָרֵב qârêb, kaw-rabe'; from H7126;  near:—approach, come (near, nigh), draw near.

H7133.definition: קׇרְבָּן qorbân, kor-bawn'; or קֻרְבָּן qurbân; from H7126;  something brought near the altar, i.e. a sacrificial present:—oblation, that is offered, offering.

H7134.definition: קַרְדֹּם qardôm, kar-dome'; perhaps from H6923 in the sense of striking upon;  an axe:—ax.

H7136.definition: קָרָה qârâh, kaw-raw'; a primitive root;  to light upon (chiefly by accident); causatively, to bring about; specifically, to impose timbers (for roof or floor):—appoint, lay (make) beams, befall, bring, come (to pass unto), floor, (hap) was, happen (unto), meet, send good speed.

H7137.definition: קָרֶה qâreh, kaw-reh'; from H7136;  an (unfortunate) occurrence, i.e. some accidental (ceremonial) disqualification:—uncleanness that chanceth.

H7138.definition: קָרוֹב qârôwb, kaw-robe'; or קָרֹב qârôb; from H7126;  near (in place, kindred or time):—allied, approach, at hand,   any of kin, kinsfold(-sman), (that is) near (of kin), neighbour, (that is) next, (them that come) nigh (at hand), more ready, short(-ly).

H7139.definition: קָרַח qârach, kaw-rakh'; a primitive root;  to depilate:—make (self) bald.

H7140.definition: קֶרַח qerach, keh'-rakh; or קֹרַח qôrach; from H7139;  ice (as if bald, i.e. smooth); hence, hail; by resemblance, rock crystal:—crystal, frost, ice.

H7141.definition: קֹרַח Qôrach, ko'rakh; from H7139; ice;  Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites:—Korah.

H7144.definition: קׇרְחָה qorchâh, kor-khaw'; or קׇרְחָא qorchâʼ; (Ezekiel 27:31), from H7139;  baldness:—bald(-ness), × utterly.

H7146.definition: קָרַחַת qârachath, kaw-rakh'-ath; from H7139;  a bald spot (on the back of the head); figuratively, a threadbare spot (on the back side of the cloth):—bald head, bare within.

H7147.definition: קְרִי qᵉrîy, ker-ee'; from H7136;  hostile encounter:—contrary.

H7148.definition: קָרִיא qârîyʼ, kaw-ree'; from H7121;  called, i.e. select:—famous, renowned.

H7149.definition: קִרְיָא qiryâʼ, keer-yaw'; (Aramaic) or קִרְיָה qiryâh; (Aramaic), corresponding to H7151:—city.

H7151.definition: קִרְיָה qiryâh, kir-yaw'; from H7136 in the sense of flooring, i.e. building;  a city:—city.

H7152.definition: קְרִיּוֹת Qᵉrîyôwth, ker-ee-yoth'; plural of H7151; buildings;  Kerioth, the name of two places in Palestine:—Kerioth, Kirioth.

H7153.definition: קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע Qiryath ʼArbaʻ, keer-yath' ar-bah'; or (with the article interposed) קִרְיַת הָאַרְבַּע Qiryath hâ-ʼArbaʻ; (Nehemiah 11:25), from H7151 and H704 or H702; city of Arba, or city of the four (giants);  Kirjath-Arba or Kirjath-ha-Arba, a place in Palestine:—Kirjath-arba.

H7154.definition: קִרְיַת בַּעַל Qiryath Baʻal, keer-yath' bah'-al; from H7151 and H1168; city of Baal;  Kirjath-Baal, a place in Palestine:—Kirjathbaal.

H7156.definition: קִרְיָתַיִם Qiryâthayim, keer-yaw-thah'-yim; dual of H7151; double city;  Kirjathaim, the name of two placed in Palestine:—Kiriathaim, Kirjathaim.

H7158.definition: קִרְיַת סַנָּה Qiryath Çannâh, keer-yath' san-naw'; or קִרְיַת סֵפֶר Qiryath Çêpher; from H7151 and a simpler feminine from the same as H5577, or (for the latter name) H5612; city of branches, or of a book;  Kirjath-Sannah or Kirjath-Sepher, a place in Palestine:—Kirjath-sannah, Kirjath-sepher.

H7159.definition: קָרַם qâram, kaw-ram'; a primitive root;  to cover:—cover.

H7160.definition: קָרַן qâran, kaw-ran'; a primitive root; to push or gore; used only as denominative from H7161,  to shoot out horns; figuratively, rays:—have horns, shine.

H7161.definition: קֶרֶן qeren, keh'-ren; from H7160;  a horn (as projecting); by implication, a flask, cornet; by resemblance. an elephant's tooth (i.e. ivory), a corner (of the altar), a peak (of a mountain), a ray (of light); figuratively, power:—× hill, horn.

H7162.definition: קֶרֶן qeren, keh'-ren; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7161;  a horn (literally or for sound):—horn, cornet.

H7163.definition: קֶרֶן הַפּוּךְ qeren hap-pûwk, keh'-ren hap-pook'; from H7161 and H6320; horn of cosmetic;  Keren-hap-Puk, one of Job's daughters:—Keren-happuch.

H7164.definition: קָרַס qâraç, kaw-ras'; a primitive root; properly, to protrude; used only as denominative from H7165 (for alliteration with H7167),  to hunch, i.e. be hump-backed:—stoop.

H7165.definition: קֶרֶס qereç, keh'-res; from H7164;  a knob or belaying-pin (from its swelling form):—tache.

H7167.definition: קָרַע qâraʻ, kaw-rah'; a primitive root;  to rend, literally or figuratively (revile, paint the eyes, as if enlarging them):—cut out, rend, × surely, tear.

H7168.definition: קֶרַע qeraʻ, keh'-rah; from H7167;  a rag:—piece, rag.

H7169.definition: קָרַץ qârats, kaw-rats'; a primitive root;  to pinch, i.e. (partially) to bite the lips, blink the eyes (as a gesture of malice), or (fully) to squeeze off (a piece of clay in order to mould a vessel from it):—form, move, wink.

H7179.definition: קַשׁ qash, kash; from H7197;  straw (as dry):—stubble.

H7181.definition: קָשַׁב qâshab, kaw-shab'; a primitive root;  to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken:—attend, (cause to) hear(-ken), give heed, incline, mark (well), regard.

H7182.definition: קֶשֶׁב qesheb, keh'-sheb; from H7181;  a hearkening:—× diligently, hearing, much heed, that regarded.

H7183.definition: קַשָּׁב qashshâb, kash-shawb'; or קַשֻּׁב qashshub; from H7181;  hearkening:—attent(-ive).

H7185.definition: קָשָׁה qâshâh, kaw-shaw'; a primitive root;  properly, to be dense, i.e. tough or severe (in various applications):—be cruel, be fiercer, make grievous, be ((ask a), be in, have, seem, would) hard(-en, (labour), -ly, thing), be sore, (be, make) stiff(-en, (-necked)).

H7186.definition: קָשֶׁה qâsheh, kaw-sheh'; from H7185;  severe (in various applications):—churlish, cruel, grievous, hard((-hearted), thing), heavy,   impudent, obstinate, prevailed, rough(-ly), sore, sorrowful, stiff(necked), stubborn,   in trouble.

H7188.definition: קָשַׁח qâshach, kaw-shakh'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, make) unfeeling:—harden.

H7192.definition: קְשִׂיטָה qᵉsîyṭâh, kes-ee-taw'; from an unused root (probably meaning to weigh out);  an ingot (as definitely estimated and stamped for a coin):—piece of money (silver).

H7194.definition: קָשַׁר qâshar, kaw-shar'; a primitive root;  to tie, physically (gird, confine, compact) or mentally (in love, league):—bind (up), (make a) conspire(-acy, -ator), join together, knit, stronger, work (treason).

H7195.definition: קֶשֶׁר qesher, keh'-sher; from H7194;  an (unlawful) alliance:—confederacy, conspiracy, treason.

H7196.definition: קִשֻּׁר qishshur, kish-shoor'; from H7194;  an (ornamental) girdle (for women):—attire, headband.

H7197.definition: קָשַׁשׁ qâshash, kaw-shash'; a primitive root; to become sapless through drought; used only as denominative from H7179;  to forage for straw, stubble or wood; figuratively, to assemble:—gather (selves) (together).

H7198.definition: קֶשֶׁת qesheth, keh'-sheth; from H7185 in the original sense (of H6983) of bending;  a bow, for shooting (hence, figuratively, strength) or the iris:—× arch(-er),   arrow, bow(-man, -shot).

H72.definition: אֶבֶן הָעֵזֶר ʼEben hâ-ʻÊzer, eh'-ben haw-e'-zer; from H68 and H5828 with the article inserted; stone of the help;  Eben-ha-Ezer, a place in Palestine:—Ebenezer.

H7200.definition: רָאָה râʼâh, raw-aw'; a primitive root;  to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative):—advise self, appear, approve, behold, × certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, × indeed, × joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, × be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), × sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, × surely, × think, view, visions.

H7204.definition: רֹאֵה Rôʼêh, ro-ay'; for H7203; prophet;  Roeh, an Israelite:—Haroeh (including the article).

H7205.definition: רְאוּבֵן Rᵉʼûwbên, reh-oo-bane'; from the imperative of H7200 and H1121; see ye a son;  Reuben, a son of Jacob:—Reuben.

H7209.definition: רְאִי rᵉʼîy, reh-ee'; from H7200;  a mirror (as seen):—looking glass.

H7210.definition: רֳאִי rŏʼîy, ro-ee'; from H7200;  sight, whether abstractly (vision) or concretely (a spectacle):—gazingstock, look to, (that) see(-th).

H7211.definition: רְאָיָה Rᵉʼâyâh, reh-aw-yaw'; from H7200 and H3050; Jah has seen;  Reajah, the name of three Israelites:—Reaia, Reaiah.

H7214.definition: רְאֵם rᵉʼêm, reh-ame'; or רְאֵים rᵉʼêymlemma רְאיֵם second vowel, corrected to רְאֵים; or רֵים rêym; or רֵם rêm; from H7213;  a wild bull (from its conspicuousness):—unicorn.

H7215.definition: רָאמָה râʼmâh, raw-maw'; from H7213;  something high in value, i.e. perhaps coral:—coral.

H7216.definition: רָאמוֹת Râʼmôwth, raw-moth'; or רָאמֹת Râʼmôthxlit Râmôth corrected to Râʼmôth; plural of H7215; heights;  Ramoth, the name of two places in Palestine:—Ramoth.

H7217.definition: רֵאשׁ rêʼsh, raysh; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7218;  the head; figuratively, the sum:—chief, head, sum.

H7218.definition: רֹאשׁ rôʼsh, roshe; from an unused root apparently meaning to shake;  the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, etc.):—band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, × every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), × lead, × poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.

H7219.definition: רֹאשׁ rôʼsh, roshe; or רוֹשׁ rôwsh; (Deuteronomy 32:32), apparently the same as H7218;  a poisonous plant, probably the poppy (from its conspicuous head); generally poison (even of serpents):—gall, hemlock, poison, venom.

H7223.definition: רִאשׁוֹן riʼshôwn, ree-shone'; or רִאשֹׁן riʼshôn; from H7221;  first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun):—ancestor, (that were) before(-time), beginning, eldest, first, fore(-father) (-most), former (thing), of old time, past.

H7227.definition: רַב rab, rab; by contracted from H7231;  abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality):—(in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).

H7229.definition: רַב rab, rab; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7227:—captain, chief, great, lord, master, stout.

H723.definition: אֻרְוָה ʼurvâh, oor-vaw'; or אֲרָיָה ʼărâyâh; from H717 (in the sense of feeding);  a herding-place for an animal:—stall.

H7230.definition: רֹב rôb, robe; from H7231;  abundance (in any respect):—abundance(-antly), all, × common (sort), excellent, great(-ly, -ness, number), huge, be increased, long, many, more in number, most, much, multitude, plenty(-ifully), × very (age).

H7231.definition: רָבַב râbab, raw-bab'; a primitive root; (compare H7241); also as denominative from H7233;  properly, to cast together , i.e. increase, especially in number; to multiply by the myriad:—increase, be many(-ifold), be more, multiply, ten thousands.

H7233.definition: רְבָבָה rᵉbâbâh, reb-aw-baw'; from H7231;  abundance (in number), i.e. (specifically) a myriad (whether definite or indefinite):—many, million, × multiply, ten thousand.

H7235.definition: רָבָה râbâh, raw-baw'; a primitive root;  to increase (in whatever respect):—(bring in) abundance (× -antly),   archer (by mistake for H7232), be in authority, bring up, × continue, enlarge, excel, exceeding(-ly), be full of, (be, make) great(-er, -ly, × -ness), grow up, heap, increase, be long, (be, give, have, make, use) many (a time), (any, be, give, give the, have) more (in number), (ask, be, be so, gather, over, take, yield) much (greater, more), (make to) multiply, nourish, plenty(-eous), × process (of time), sore, store, thoroughly, very.

H7236.definition: רְבָה rᵉbâh, reb-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7235:—make a great man, grow.

H7237.definition: רַבָּה Rabbâh, rab-baw'; feminine of H7227; great;  Rabbah, the name of two places in Palestine, East and West:—Rabbah, Rabbath.

H7238.definition: רְבוּ rᵉbûw, reb-oo'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H7235;  increase (of dignity):—greatness, majesty.

H724.definition: אֲרוּכָה ʼărûwkâh, ar-oo-kaw'; or אֲרֻכָה ʼărukâh; feminine passive participle of H748 (in the sense of restoring to soundness);  wholeness (literally or figuratively):—health, made up, perfected.

H7241.definition: רָבִיב râbîyb, raw-beeb'; from H7231;  a rain (as an accumulation of drops):—shower.

H7242.definition: רָבִיד râbîyd, raw-beed'; from H7234;  a collar (as spread around the neck):—chain.

H7250.definition: רָבַע râbaʻ, raw-bah'; a primitive root;  to squat or lie out flat, i.e. (specifically) in copulation:—let gender, lie down.

H7251.definition: רָבַע râbaʻ, raw-bah'; a primitive root (rather identical with H7250 through the idea of sprawling 'at all fours' (or possibly the reverse is the order of derivation); compare H702); properly, to be four (sided); used only as denominative of H7253;  to be quadrate:—(four-) square(-d).

H7253.definition: רֶבַע rebaʻ, reh'-bah; from H7251;  a fourth (part or side):—fourth part, side, square.

H7255.definition: רֹבַע rôbaʻ, ro'-bah; from H7251;  a quarter:—fourth participle

H7257.definition: רָבַץ râbats, raw-bats'; a primitive root;  to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); by implication, to recline, repose, brood, lurk, imbed:—crouch (down), fall down, make a fold, lay, (cause to, make to) lie (down), make to rest, sit.

H7258.definition: רֵבֶץ rêbets, reh'-bets; from H7257;  a couch or place of repose:—where each lay, lie down in, resting place.

H7259.definition: רִבְקָה Ribqâh, rib-kaw'; from an unused root probably meaning to clog by tying up the fetlock; fettering (by beauty);  Ribkah, the wife of Isaac:—Rebekah.

H7260.definition: רַבְרַב rabrab, rab-rab'; (Aramaic) from H7229;  huge (in size); domineering (in character):—(very) great (things).

H7262.definition: רַבְשָׁקֵה Rabshâqêh, rab-shaw-kay'; from H7227 and H8248; chief butler;  Rabshakeh, a Babylonian official:—Rabshakeh.

H7264.definition: רָגַז râgaz, raw-gaz'; a primitive root;  to quiver (with any violent emotion, especially anger or fear):—be afraid, stand in awe, disquiet, fall out, fret, move, provoke, quake, rage, shake, tremble, trouble, be wroth.

H7267.definition: רֹגֶז rôgez, ro'-ghez; from H7264;  commotion, restlessness (of a horse), crash (of thunder), disquiet, anger:—fear, noise, rage, trouble(-ing), wrath.

H727.definition: אָרוֹן ʼârôwn, aw-rone'; or אָרֹן ʼârôn; from H717 (in the sense of gathering);  a box:—ark, chest, coffin.

H7270.definition: רָגַל râgal, raw-gal'; a primitive root; also as denominative from H7272  to walk along; but only in specifically, applications, to reconnoiter, to be a tale-bearer (i.e. slander); to lead about:—backbite, search, slander, (e-) spy (out), teach to go, view.

H7272.definition: רֶגֶל regel, reh'-gel; from H7270;  a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda:—× be able to endure, × according as, × after, × coming, × follow, (broken-)foot(-ed, -stool), × great toe, × haunt, × journey, leg,   piss,   possession, time.

H7273.definition: רַגְלִי raglîy, rag-lee'; from H7272;  a footman (soldier):—(on) foot(-man).

H7275.definition: רָגַם râgam, raw-gam'; a primitive root (compare H7263, H7321, H7551);  to cast together (stones), i.e. to lapidate:—× certainly, stone.

H7276.definition: רֶגֶם Regem, reh'-gem; from H7275; stoneheap;  Regem, an Israelite:—Regem.

H7279.definition: רָגַן râgan, raw-gan'; a primitive root;  to grumble, i.e. rebel:—murmur.

H728.definition: אֲרַוְנָה ʼĂravnâh, ar-av-naw'; or (by transposition) אוֹרְנָה ʼÔwrᵉnâh; or אַרְנִיָּה ʼArnîyâhlemma אַנִיָּה missing resh, corrected to אַרְנִיָּה; all by orthographical variation for H771;  Aravnah (or Arnijah or Ornah), a Jebusite:—Araunah.

H7280.definition: רָגַע râgaʻ, raw-gah'; a primitive root;  properly, to toss violently and suddenly (the sea with waves, the skin with boils); figuratively (in a favorable manner) to settle, i.e. quiet; specifically, to wink (from the motion of the eye-lids):—break, divide, find ease, be a moment, (cause, give, make to) rest, make suddenly.

H7281.definition: רֶגַע regaʻ, reh'-gah; from H7280.  a wink (of the eyes), i.e. a very short space of time:—instant, moment, space, suddenly.

H7283.definition: רָגַשׁ râgash, raw-gash'; a primitive root;  to be tumultuous:—rage.

H7284.definition: רְגַשׁ rᵉgash, reg-ash'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7283;  to gather tumultuously:—assemble (together).

H7287.definition: רָדָה râdâh, raw-daw'; a primitive root;  to tread down, i.e. subjugate; specifically, to crumble off:—(come to, make to) have dominion, prevail against, reign, (bear, make to) rule,(-r, over), take.

H7288.definition: רַדַּי Radday, rad-dah'-ee; intensive from H7287; domineering;  Raddai, an Israelite:—Raddai.

H7290.definition: רָדַם râdam, raw-dam'; a primitive root;  to stun, i.e. stupefy (with sleep or death):—(be fast a-, be in a deep, cast into a dead, that) sleep(-er, -eth).

H7291.definition: רָדַף râdaph, raw-daf'; a primitive root;  to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively [of time] gone by):—chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute(-ion, -or), pursue(-r).

H7293.definition: רַהַב rahab, rah'-hab; from H7292,  bluster(-er):—proud, strength.

H7294.definition: רַהַב Rahab, rah'-hab; the same as H7293;  Rahab (i.e. boaster), an epithet of Egypt:—Rahab.

H73.definition: אַבְנֵט ʼabnêṭ, ab-nate'; of uncertain derivation;  a belt:—girdle.

H730.definition: אֶרֶז ʼerez, eh-rez'; from H729;  a cedar tree (from the tenacity of its roots):—cedar (tree).

H7300.definition: רוּד rûwd, rood; a primitive root;  to tramp about, i.e. ramble (free or disconsolate):—have the dominion, be lord, mourn, rule.

H7301.definition: רָוָה râvâh, raw-vaw'; a primitive root;  to slake the thirst (occasionally of other appetites):—bathe, make drunk, (take the) fill, satiate, (abundantly) satisfy, soak, water (abundantly).

H7304.definition: רָוַח râvach, raw-vakh'; a primitive root (identical with H7306);  properly, to breathe freely, i.e. revive; by implication, to have ample room:—be refreshed, large.

H7305.definition: רֶוַח revach, reh'-vakh; from H7304;  room, literally (an interval) or figuratively (deliverance):—enlargement, space.

H7306.definition: רוּחַ rûwach, roo'-akh; a primitive root;  properly, to blow, i.e. breathe; only (literally) to smell or (by implication, perceive (figuratively, to anticipate, enjoy):—accept, smell, × touch, make of quick understanding.

H7307.definition: רוּחַ rûwach, roo'-akh; from H7306;  wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions):—air, anger, blast, breath, × cool, courage, mind, × quarter, × side, spirit(-ual), tempest, × vain, (whirl-) wind(-y).

H7308.definition: רוּחַ rûwach, roo'-akh; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7307:—mind, spirit, wind.

H731.definition: אַרְזָה ʼarzâh, ar-zaw'; feminine of H730;  cedar wainscoating:—cedar work.

H7310.definition: רְוָיָה rᵉvâyâh, rev-aw-yaw'; from H7301;  satisfaction:—runneth over, wealthy.

H7311.definition: רוּם rûwm, room; a primitive root;  to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively):—bring up, exalt (self), extol, give, go up, haughty, heave (up), (be, lift up on, make on, set up on, too) high(-er, one), hold up, levy, lift(-er) up, (be) lofty, (× a-) loud, mount up, offer (up),   presumptuously, (be) promote(-ion), proud, set up, tall(-er), take (away, off, up), breed worms.

H7312.definition: רוּם rûwm, room; or רֻם rum; from H7311;  (literally) elevation or (figuratively) elation:—haughtiness, height, × high.

H7315.definition: רוֹם rôwm, rome; from H7311;  elevation, i.e. (adverbially) aloft:—on high.

H7317.definition: רוֹמָה rôwmâh, ro-maw'; feminine of H7315;  elation, i.e. (adverbially) proudly:—haughtily.

H7318.definition: רוֹמָם rôwmâm, ro-mawm'; from H7426;  exaltation, i.e. (figuratively and specifically) praise:—be extolled.

H7321.definition: רוּעַ rûwaʻ, roo-ah'; a primitive root;  to mar (especially by breaking); figuratively, to split the ears (with sound), i.e. shout (for alarm or joy):—blow an alarm, cry (alarm, aloud, out), destroy, make a joyful noise, smart, shout (for joy), sound an alarm, triumph.

H7322.definition: רוּף rûwph, roof; a primitive root;  properly, to triturate (in a mortar), i.e. (figuratively) to agitate (by concussion):—tremble.

H7323.definition: רוּץ rûwts, roots; a primitive root;  to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush):—break down, divide speedily, footman, guard, bring hastily, (make) run (away, through), post.

H7324.definition: רוּק rûwq, rook; a primitive root;  to pour out (literally or figuratively), i.e. empty:—× arm, cast out, draw (out), (make) empty, pour forth (out).

H7326.definition: רוּשׁ rûwsh, roosh; a primitive root;  to be destitute:—lack, needy, (make self) poor (man).

H7327.definition: רוּת Rûwth, rooth; probably for H7468; friend;  Ruth, a Moabitess:—Ruth.

H7328.definition: רָז râz, rawz; (Aramaic) from an unused root probably meaning  to attenuate, i.e. (figuratively) hide; a mystery:—secret.

H7329.definition: רָזָה râzâh, raw-zaw'; a primitive root;  to emaciate, i.e. make (become) thin (literally or figuratively):—famish, wax lean.

H733.definition: אָרַח ʼÂrach, aw-rakh'; from H732; way faring;  Arach, the name of three Israelites:—Arah.

H7331.definition: רְזוֹן Rᵉzôwn, rez-one'; from H7336; prince;  Rezon, a Syrian:—Rezon.

H7332.definition: רָזוֹן râzôwn, raw-zone'; from H7329;  thinness:—leanness, × scant.

H7334.definition: רָזִי râzîy, raw-zee'; from H7329;  thinness:—leanness.

H7335.definition: רָזַם râzam, raw-zam'; a primitive root;  to twinkle the eye (in mockery):—wink.

H7336.definition: רָזַן râzan, raw-zan'; a primitive root;  probably to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) honorable:—prince, ruler.

H7337.definition: רָחַב râchab, raw-khab'; a primitive root;  to broaden (intransitive or transitive, literal or figurative):—be an en-(make) large(-ing), make room, make (open) wide.

H7338.definition: רַחַב rachab, rakh'-ab; from H7337;  a width:—breadth, broad place.

H7339.definition: רְחֹב rᵉchôb, rekh-obe'; or רְחוֹב rᵉchôwb; from H7337;  a width, i.e. (concretely) avenue or area:—broad place (way), street. See also H1050.

H734.definition: אֹרַח ʼôrach, o'-rakh; from H732;  a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan:—manner, path, race, rank, traveller, troop, (by-, high-) way.

H7340.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H7340.definition: רְחֹב Rᵉchôb, rekh-obe'; or רְחוֹב Rᵉchôwb; the same as H7339;  Rechob, the name of a place in Syria, also of a Syrian and an Israelite:—Rehob.

H7341.definition: רֹחַב rôchab, ro'-khab; from H7337;  width (literally or figuratively):—breadth, broad, largeness, thickness, wideness.

H7342.definition: רָחָב râchâb, raw-khawb'; from H7337;  roomy, in any (or every) direction, literally or figuratively:—broad, large, at liberty, proud, wide.

H7343.definition: רָחָב Râchâb, raw-khawb'; the same as H7342; proud;  Rachab, a Canaanitess:—Rahab.
