H7344.definition: רְחֹבוֹת Rᵉchôbôwth, rekh-o-both'; or רְחֹבֹת Rᵉchôbôth; plural of H7339; streets;  Rechoboth, a place in Assyria and one in Palestine:—Rehoboth.

H7345.definition: רְחַבְיָה Rᵉchabyâh, rekh-ab-yaw'; or רְחַבְיָהוּ Rᵉchabyâhûw; from H7337 and H3050; Jah has enlarged;  Rechabjah, an Israelite:—Rehabiah.

H7346.definition: רְחַבְעָם Rᵉchabʻâm, rekh-ab-awm'; from H7337 and H5971; a people has enlarged;  Rechabam, an Israelite king:—Rehoboam.

H7348.definition: רְחוּם Rᵉchûwm, rekh-oom'; a form of H7349;  Rechum, the name of a Persian and of three Israelites:—Rehum.

H7349.definition: רַחוּם rachûwm, rakh-oom'; from H7355;  compassionate:—full of compassion, merciful.

H7350.definition: רָחוֹק râchôwq, raw-khoke'; or רָחֹק râchôq; from H7368;  remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition):—(a-) far (abroad, off), long ago, of old, space, great while to come.

H7352.definition: רַחִיק rachîyq, rakh-eek'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7350:—far.

H7353.definition: רָחֵל râchêl, raw-kale'; from an unused root meaning to journey;  a ewe [the females being the predominant element of a flock] (as a good traveller):—ewe, sheep.

H7354.definition: רָחֵל Râchêl, raw-khale'; the same as H7353;  Rachel, a wife of Jacob:—Rachel.

H7355.definition: רָחַם râcham, raw-kham'; a primitive root;  to fondle; by implication, to love, especially to compassionate:—have compassion (on, upon), love, (find, have, obtain, shew) mercy(-iful, on, upon), (have) pity, Ruhamah, × surely.

H7356.partOfSpeech: masculine noun, absolute state masculine plural intensive noun
H7356.definition: רַחַם racham, rakh'-am; from H7355;  compassion (in the plural); by extension, the womb (as cherishing the fetus); by implication, a maiden:—bowels, compassion, damsel, tender love, (great, tender) mercy, pity, womb.

H7357.definition: רַחַם Racham, rakh'-am; the same as H7356; pity;  Racham, an Israelite:—Raham.

H7358.definition: רֶחֶם rechem, rekh'-em; from H7355; (compare H7356)  the womb:—matrix, womb.

H7360.definition: רָחָם râchâm, raw-khawm'; or (feminine) רָחָמָה râchâmâh; from H7355;  a kind of vulture (supposed to be tender towards its young):—gier-eagle.

H7363.definition: רָחַף râchaph, raw-khaf'; a primitive root;  to brood; by implication, to be relaxed:—flutter, move, shake.

H7364.definition: רָחַץ râchats, raw-khats'; a primitive root;  to lave (the whole or a part of a thing):—bathe (self), wash (self).

H7368.definition: רָחַק râchaq, raw-khak'; a primitive root;  to widen (in any direction), i.e. (intransitively) recede or (transitively) remove (literally or figuratively, of place or relation):—(a-, be, cast, drive, get, go, keep (self), put, remove, be too, (wander), withdraw) far (away, off), loose, × refrain, very, (be) a good way (off).

H737.definition: אֲרֻחָה ʼăruchâh, ar-oo-khaw'; feminine passive participle of H732 (in the sense of appointing);  a ration of food:—allowance, diet, dinner, victuals.

H7370.definition: רָחַשׁ râchash, raw-khash'; a primitive root;  to gush:—indite.

H7375.definition: רֻטֲפַשׁ ruṭăphash, roo-taf-ash'; a root compounded from H7373 and H2954;  to be rejuvenated:—be fresh.

H7376.definition: רָטַשׁ râṭâsh, raw-tash'; a primitive root;  to dash down:—dash (in pieces).

H7377.definition: רִי rîy, ree; from H7301;  irrigation, i.e. a shower:—watering.

H7378.definition: רִיב rîyb, reeb; or רוּב rûwb; a primitive root;  properly, to toss, i.e. grapple; mostly figuratively, to wrangle, i.e. hold a controversy; (by implication) to defend:—adversary, chide, complain, contend, debate, × ever, × lay wait, plead, rebuke, strive, × thoroughly.

H7379.definition: רִיב rîyb, reeb; or רִב rib; from H7378;  a contest (personal or legal):—  adversary, cause, chiding, contend(-tion), controversy, multitude (from the margin), pleading, strife, strive(-ing), suit.

H738.definition: אֲרִי ʼărîy, ar-ee'; or (prolonged) אַרְיֵה ʼaryêh; from H717 (in the sense of violence);  a lion:—(young) lion,   pierce (from the margin).

H7381.definition: רֵיחַ rêyach, ray'-akh; from H7306;  odor (as if blown):—savour, scent, smell.

H7383.definition: רִיפָה rîyphâh, ree-faw'; or רִפָה riphâh; from H7322;  (only plural), grits (as pounded):—ground corn, wheat.

H7385.definition: רִיק rîyq, reek; from H7324;  emptiness; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain:—empty, to no purpose, (in) vain (thing), vanity.

H7386.definition: רֵיק rêyq, rake; or (shorter) רֵק rêq; from H7324;  empty; figuratively, worthless:—emptied(-ty), vain (fellow, man).

H7387.definition: רֵיקָם rêyqâm, ray-kawm'; from H7386;  emptily; figuratively (objective) ineffectually, (subjective) undeservedly:—without cause, empty, in vain, void.

H7388.definition: רִיר rîyr, reer; from H7325;  saliva; by resemblance, broth:—spittle, white (of an egg).

H7389.definition: רֵישׁ rêysh, raysh; or רֵאשׁ rêʼsh; or רִישׁ rîysh; from H7326;  poverty:—poverty.

H739.definition: אֲרִיאֵל ʼărîyʼêl, ar-ee-ale'; or אֲרִאֵל ʼăriʼêl; from H738 and H410;  lion of God; i.e. heroic:—lionlike men.

H7390.definition: רַךְ rak, rak; from H7401;  tender (literally or figuratively); by implication, weak:—faint(-hearted), soft, tender ((-hearted), one), weak.

H7392.definition: רָכַב râkab, raw-kab'; a primitive root;  to ride (on an animal or in a vehicle); causatively, to place upon (for riding or generally), to despatch:—bring (on (horse-) back), carry, get (oneself) up, on (horse-) back, put, (cause to, make to) ride (in a chariot, on, -r), set.

H7393.definition: רֶכֶב rekeb, reh'-keb; from H7392;  a vehicle; by implication, a team; by extension, cavalry; by analogy a rider, i.e. the upper millstone:—chariot, (upper) millstone, multitude (from the margin), wagon.

H7394.definition: רֵכָב Rêkâb, ray-kawb'; from H7392; rider;  Rekab, the name of two Arabs and of two Israelites:—Rechab.

H7399.definition: רְכוּשׁ rᵉkûwsh, rek-oosh'; or רְכֻשׁ rᵉkush; from passive participle of H7408;  property (as gathered):—good, riches, substance.

H74.definition: אַבְנֵר ʼAbnêr, ab-nare'; or (fully) אֲבִינֵר ʼĂbîynêr ; from H1 and H5216; father of light (i.e. enlightening);  Abner, an Israelite:—Abner.

H740.definition: אֲרִיאֵל ʼĂrîyʼêl, ar-ee-ale'; the same as H739;  Ariel, a symbolical name for Jerusalem, also the name of an Israelite:—Ariel.

H7401.definition: רָכַךְ râkak, raw-kak'; a primitive root;  to soften (intransitively or transitively), used figuratively:—(be) faint(-hearted), mollify, (be, make) soft(-er), be tender.

H7402.definition: רָכַל râkal, raw-kal'; a primitive root;  to travel for trading:—(spice) merchant.

H7409.definition: רֶכֶשׁ rekesh, reh'-kesh; from H7408;  a relay of animals on a post-route (as stored up for that purpose); by implication, a courser:—dromedary, mule, swift beast.

H741.definition: אֲרִאֵיל ʼăriʼêyl, ar-ee-ale'; either by transposition for H739 or, more probably, an orthographical variation for H2025;  the altar of the temple:—altar.

H7410.definition: רָם Râm, rawm; active participle of H7311; high;  Ram, the name of an Arabian and of an Israelite:—Ram. See also H1027.

H7411.definition: רָמָה râmâh, raw-maw'; a primitive root;  to hurl; specifically, to shoot; figuratively, to delude or betray (as if causing to fall):—beguile, betray, (bow-) man, carry, deceive, throw.

H7413.definition: רָמָה râmâh, raw-maw'; feminine active participle of H7311;  a height (as a seat of idolatry):—high place.

H7414.definition: רָמָה Râmâh, raw-maw'; the same as H7413;  Ramah, the name of four places in Palestine:—Ramah.

H7416.definition: רִמּוֹן rimmôwn, rim-mone'; or רִמֹּן rimmôn; from H7426;  a pomegranate, the tree (from its upright growth) or the fruit (also an artificial ornament):—pomegranate.

H7417.partOfSpeech: proper noun with reference to deity, proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H7417.definition: רִמּוֹן Rimmôwn, rim-mone'; or (shorter) (רִמֹּן Rimmôn; or רִמּוֹנוֹ Rimmôwnôw; (1 Chronicles 6:62 (H77)), the same as H7416; in Joshua 19:13: הַמְּתֹאָר ham-mᵉthôʼâr is mistaken for part of a name; article with the passive participle of H8388; the (one) marked off, i.e. which pertains).  Rimmon, the name of a Syrian deity, also of five places in Palestine:—Remmon, Rimmon.

H742.definition: אֲרִידַי ʼĂrîyday, ar-ee-dah'-ee; of Persian origin;  Aridai, a son of Haman:—Aridai.

H7420.definition: רֹמַח rômach, ro'-makh; from an unused root meaning to hurl;  a lance (as thrown); especially the iron point:—buckler, javelin, lancet, spear.

H7422.definition: רַמְיָה Ramyâh, ram-yaw'; from H7311 and H3050; Jah has raised;  Ramjah, an Israelite:—Ramiah.

H7423.definition: רְמִיָּה rᵉmîyâh, rem-ee-yaw'; from H7411;  remissness, treachery:—deceit(-ful, -fully), false, guile, idle, slack, slothful.

H7429.definition: רָמַס râmaç, raw-mas'; a primitive root;  to tread upon (as a potter, in walking or abusively):—oppressor, stamp upon, trample (under feet), tread (down, upon).

H743.definition: אֲרִידָתָא ʼĂrîydâthâʼ, ar-ee-daw-thaw'; of Persian origin;  Aridatha, a son of Haman:—Aridatha.

H7430.definition: רָמַשׂ râmas, raw-mas'; a primitive root;  properly, to glide swiftly, i.e. to crawl or move with short steps; by analogy to swarm:—creep, move.

H7431.definition: רֶמֶשׂ remes, reh'-mes; from H7430;  a reptile or any other rapidly moving animal:—that creepeth, creeping (moving) thing.

H7433.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H7433.definition: רָמֹת גִּלעָד Râmôth Gilʻâd, raw-moth' gil-awd'; or רָמוֹת גִּלעָד Râmôwth Gilʻâd; (2 Chronicles 22:5), from the plural of H7413 and H1568; heights of Gilad;  Ramoth-Gilad, a place East of the Jordan:—Ramoth-gilead, Ramoth in Gilead. See also H7216.

H7437.definition: רָמַת לֶחִי Râmath Lechîy, raw'-math lekh'-ee; from H7413 and H3895; height of a jaw-bone;  Ramath-Lechi, a place in Palestine:—Ramath-lehi.

H7440.definition: רִנָּה rinnâh, rin-naw'; from H7442;  properly, a creaking (or shrill sound), i.e. shout (of joy or grief):—cry, gladness, joy, proclamation, rejoicing, shouting, sing(-ing), triumph.

H7442.definition: רָנַן rânan, raw-nan'; a primitive root;  properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy):—aloud for joy, cry out, be joyful (greatly, make to) rejoice, (cause to) shout (for joy), (cause to) sing (aloud, for joy, out), triumph.

H7445.definition: רְנָנָה rᵉnânâh, ren-aw-naw'; from H7442;  a shout (for joy):—joyful (voice), singing, triumphing.

H7448.definition: רֶסֶן reçen, reh'-sen; from an unused root meaning to curb;  a halter (as restraining); by implication, the jaw:—bridle.

H7451.partOfSpeech: absolute state masculine plural intensive noun
H7451.definition: רַע raʻ, rah; from H7489;  bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral):—adversity, affliction, bad, calamity,   displease(-ure), distress, evil((-favouredness), man, thing), + exceedingly, × great, grief(-vous), harm, heavy, hurt(-ful), ill (favoured), + mark, mischief(-vous), misery, naught(-ty), noisome, + not please, sad(-ly), sore, sorrow, trouble, vex, wicked(-ly, -ness, one), worse(-st), wretchedness, wrong. (Including feminine raaah; as adjective or noun.)

H7453.definition: רֵעַ rêaʻ, ray'-ah; or רֵיעַ rêyaʻ; from H7462;  an associate (more or less close):—brother, companion, fellow, friend, husband, lover, neighbour, × (an-) other.

H7456.definition: רָעֵב râʻêb, raw-abe'; a primitive root;  to hunger:—(suffer to) famish, (be, have, suffer, suffer to) hunger(-ry).

H7457.definition: רָעֵב râʻêb, raw-abe'; from H7456;  hungry (more or less intensely):—hunger bitten, hungry.

H7458.definition: רָעָב râʻâb, raw-awb'; from H7456;  hunger (more or less extensive):—dearth, famine,   famished, hunger.

H746.definition: אֲרְיוֹךְ ʼĂryôwk, ar-yoke'; of foreign origin;  Arjok, the name of two Babylonians:—Arioch.

H7460.definition: רָעַד râʻad, raw-ad'; a primitive root;  to shudder (more or less violently):—tremble.

H7461.definition: רַעַד raʻad, rah'-ad; or (feminine) רְעָדָה rᵉʻâdâhxlit rᵉâdâh corrected to rᵉʻâdâh; from H7460;  a shudder:—trembling.

H7462.definition: רָעָה râʻâh, raw-aw'; a primitive root;  to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend):—× break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a friend, make friendship with, herdman, keep (sheep) (-er), pastor,   shearing house, shepherd, wander, waste.

H7463.definition: רֵעֶה rêʻeh, ray-eh'; from H7462;  a (male) companion:—friend.

H7466.definition: רְעוּ Rᵉʻûw, reh-oo'; for H7471 in the sense of H7453; friend;  Reu, a postdiluvian patriarch:—Reu.

H7467.definition: רְעוּאֵל Rᵉʻûwʼêl, reh-oo-ale'; from the same as H7466 and H410; friend of God;  Reuel, the name of Moses' father-in-law, also of an Edomite and an Israelite:—Raguel, Reuel.

H747.definition: אֲרִיסַי ʼĂrîyçay, ar-ee-sah'-ee; of Persian origin;  Arisai, a son of Haman:—Arisai.

H7471.definition: רְעִי rᵉʻîy, reh-ee'; from H7462;  pasture:—pasture.

H7472.definition: רֵעִי Rêʻîy, ray-ee'; from H7453; social;  Rei, an Israelite:—Rei.

H7473.definition: רֹעִי rôʻîy, ro-ee'; from active participle of H7462;  pastoral; as noun, a shepherd:—shipherd.

H748.definition: אָרַךְ ʼârak, aw-rak'; a primitive root;  to be (causative, make) long (literally or figuratively):—defer, draw out, lengthen, (be, become, make, pro-) long,   (out-, over-) live, tarry (long).

H7480.definition: רְעֵלָיָה Rᵉʻêlâyâh, reh-ay-law-yaw'; from H7477 and H3050; made to tremble (i.e. fearful) of Jah;  Reelajah, an Israelite:—Reeliah.

H7481.definition: רָעַם râʻam, raw-am'; a primitive root;  to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated; specifically, to crash (of thunder); figuratively, to irritate (with anger):—make to fret, roar, thunder, trouble.

H7482.definition: רַעַם raʻam, rah'am; from H7481;  a peal of thunder:—thunder.

H7485.definition: רַעַמְיָה Raʻamyâh, rah-am-yaw'; from H7481 and H3050; Jah has shaken;  Raamjah, an Israelite:—Raamiah.

H7488.definition: רַעֲנָן raʻănân, rah-an-awn'; from an unused root meaning to be green;  verdant; by analogy, new; figuratively, prosperous:—green, flourishing.

H7489.definition: רָעַע râʻaʻ, raw-ah'; a primitive root;  properly, to spoil (literally, by breaking to pieces); figuratively, to make (or be) good for nothing, i.e. bad (physically, socially or morally):—afflict, associate selves (by mistake for 7462), break (down, in pieces),   displease, (be, bring, do) evil (doer, entreat, man), show self friendly (by mistake for 7462), do harm, (do) hurt, (behave self, deal) ill, × indeed, do mischief, punish, still, vex, (do) wicked (doer, -ly), be (deal, do) worse.

H7491.definition: רָעַף râʻaph, raw-af'; a primitive root;  to drip:—distil, drop (down).

H7492.definition: רָעַץ râʻats, raw-ats'; a primitive root;  to break in pieces; figuratively, harass:—dash in pieces, vex.

H7493.definition: רָעַשׁ râʻash, raw-ash; a primitive root;  to undulate (as the earth, the sky, etc.; also a field of grain), particularly through fear; specifically, to spring (as a locust):—make afraid, (re-) move, quake, (make to) shake, (make to) tremble.

H7494.definition: רַעַשׁ raʻash, rah'-ash; from H7493;  vibration, bounding, uproar:—commotion, confused noise, earthquake, fierceness, quaking, rattling, rushing, shaking.

H7495.definition: רָפָא râphâʼ, raw-faw'; or רָפָה râphâh; a primitive root;  properly, to mend (by stitching), i.e. (figuratively) to cure:—cure, (cause to) heal, physician, repair, × thoroughly, make whole. See H7503.

H7498.definition: רָפָא Râphâʼ, raw-faw'; or רָפָה Râphâh; probably the same as H7497; giant;  Rapha or Raphah, the name of two Israelites:—Rapha.

H7499.definition: רְפֻאָה rᵉphuʼâh, ref-oo-aw'; feminine passive participle of H7495;  a medicament:—heal(-ed), medicine.

H750.definition: אָרֵךְ ʼârêk, aw-rake'; from H748;  long:—long(-suffering, -winged), patient, slow (to anger).

H7501.definition: רְפָאֵל Rᵉphâʼêl, ref-aw-ale'; from H7495 and H410; God has cured;  Rephael, an Israelite:—Rephael.

H7502.definition: רָפַד râphad, raw-fad'; a primitive root;  to spread (a bed); by implication, to refresh:—comfort, make (a bed), spread.

H7503.definition: רָפָה râphâh, raw-faw'; a primitive root;  to slacken (in many applications, literal or figurative):—abate, cease, consume, draw (toward evening), fail, (be) faint, be (wax) feeble, forsake, idle, leave, let alone (go, down), (be) slack, stay, be still, be slothful, (be) weak(-en). See H7495.

H7504.definition: רָפֶה râpheh, raw-feh'; from H7503;  slack (in body or mind):—weak. Raphah. See H7497, H7498. Riphah. See H7383.

H7506.definition: רֶפַח Rephach, reh'-fakh; from an unused root apparently meaning to sustain; support;  Rephach, an Israelite:—Rephah.

H7509.definition: רְפָיָה Rᵉphâyâh, ref-aw-yaw'; from H7495 and H3050; Jah has cured;  Rephajah, the name of five Israelites:—Rephaiah.

H7514.definition: רָפַק râphaq, raw-fak'; a primitive root;  to recline:—lean.

H7516.definition: רֶפֶשׁ rephesh, reh'-fesh; from H7515;  mud (as roiled):—mire.

H7521.definition: רָצָה râtsâh, raw-tsaw'; a primitive root;  to be pleased with; specifically, to satisfy a debt:—(be) accept(-able), accomplish, set affection, approve, consent with, delight (self), enjoy, (be, have a) favour(-able), like, observe, pardon, (be, have, take) please(-ure), reconcile self.

H7522.definition: רָצוֹן râtsôwn, raw-tsone'; or רָצֹן râtsôn; from H7521;  delight (especially as shown):—(be) acceptable(-ance, -ed), delight, desire, favour, (good) pleasure, (own, self, voluntary) will, as...(what) would.

H7523.definition: רָצַח râtsach, raw-tsakh'; a primitive root;  properly, to dash in pieces, i.e. kill (a human being), especially to murder:—put to death, kill, (man-) slay(-er), murder(-er).

H7526.definition: רְצִין Rᵉtsîyn, rets-een'; probably for H7522;  Retsin, the name of a Syrian and of an Israelite:—Rezin.

H753.definition: אֹרֶךְ ʼôrek, o'rek; from H748;  length:—  forever, length, long.

H7531.definition: רִצְפָּה ritspâh, rits-paw'; feminine of H7529;  a hot stone; also a tessellated pavement:—live coal, pavement.

H7532.definition: רִצְפָּה Ritspâh, rits-paw'; the same as H7531;  Ritspah, an Israelitess:—Rizpah.

H7533.definition: רָצַץ râtsats, raw-tsats'; a primitive root;  to crack in pieces, literally or figuratively:—break, bruise, crush, discourage, oppress, struggle together.

H7534.definition: רַק raq, rak; from H7556 in its original sense;  emaciated (as if flattened out):—lean(-fleshed), thin.

H7535.definition: רַק raq, rak; the same as H7534 as a noun;  properly, leanness, i.e. (figuratively) limitation; only adverbial, merely, or conjunctional, although:—but, even, except, howbeit howsoever, at the least, nevertheless, nothing but, notwithstanding, only, save, so (that), surely, yet (so), in any wise.

H7538.definition: רָקָב râqâb, raw-kawb'; from H7537;  decay (by caries):—rottenness (thing).

H7540.definition: רָקַד râqad, raw-kad'; a primitive root;  properly, to stamp, i.e. to spring about (wildly or for joy):—dance, jump, leap, skip.

H7543.definition: רָקַח râqach, raw-kakh'; a primitive root;  to perfume:—apothecary, compound, make (ointment), prepare, spice.

H7549.definition: רָקִיעַ râqîyaʻ, raw-kee'-ah; from H7554;  properly, an expanse, i.e. the firmament or (apparently) visible arch of the sky:—firmament.

H7550.definition: רָקִיק râqîyq, raw-keek'; from, H7556 in its original sense;  a thin cake:—cake, wafer.

H7553.definition: רִקְמָה riqmâh, rik-maw'; from H7551;  variegation of color; specifically, embroidery:—broidered (work), divers colours, (raiment of) needlework (on both sides).

H7554.definition: רָקַע râqaʻ, raw-kah'; a primitive root;  to pound the earth (as a sign of passion); by analogy to expand (by hammering); by implication, to overlay (with thin sheets of metal):—beat, make broad, spread abroad (forth, over, out, into plates), stamp, stretch.

H7556.definition: רָקַק râqaq, raw-kak'; a primitive root;  to spit:—spit.

H7557.definition: רַקַּת Raqqath, rak-kath'; from H7556 in its original sense of diffusing; a beach (as expanded shingle);  Rakkath, a place in Palestine:—Rakkath.

H7560.definition: רְשַׁם rᵉsham, resh-am'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7559:—sign, write.

H7561.definition: רָשַׁע râshaʻ, raw-shah'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, do or declare) wrong; by implication, to disturb, violate:—condemn, make trouble, vex, be (commit, deal, depart, do) wicked(-ly, -ness).

H7562.definition: רֶשַׁע reshaʻ, reh'-shah; from H7561;  a wrong (especially moral):—iniquity, wicked(-ness).

H7563.definition: רָשָׁע râshâʻ, raw-shaw'; from H7561;  morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person:—  condemned, guilty, ungodly, wicked (man), that did wrong.

H7567.definition: רָשַׁשׁ râshash, raw-shash'; a primitive root;  to demolish:—impoverish.

H7568.definition: רֶשֶׁת resheth, reh'-sheth; from H3423;  a net (as catching animals):—net(-work).

H7569.definition: רַתּוֹק rattôwq, rat-toke'; from H7576;  a chain:—chain.

H7570.definition: רָתַח râthach, raw-thakh'; a primitive root;  to boil:—boil.

H7571.definition: רֶתַח rethach, reh'-thakh; from H7570;  a boiling:—× (boil) well.

H7573.definition: רָתַם râtham, raw-tham'; a primitive root;  to yoke up (to the pole of a vehicle):—bind.

H7574.definition: רֶתֶם rethem, reh'-them; or רֹתֶם rôthem; from H7573;  the Spanish broom (from its pole-like stems):—juniper (tree).

H7577.definition: רְתֻקָה rᵉthuqâh, reth-oo-kaw'; feminine passive participle of H7576;  something fastened, i.e. a chain:—chain.

H7578.definition: רְתֵת rᵉthêth, reth-ayth'; for H7374;  terror:—trembling.

H7579.definition: שָׁאַב shâʼab, sahw-ab'; a primitive root;  to bale up water:—(woman to) draw(-er, water).

H758.definition: אֲרָם ʼĂrâm, arawm'; from the same as H759; the highland;  Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants; also the name of the son of Shem, a grandson of Nahor, and of an Israelite:—Aram, Mesopotamia, Syria, Syrians.

H7580.definition: שָׁאַג shâʼag, shaw-ag'; a primitive root;  to rumble or moan:—× mightily, roar.

H7581.definition: שְׁאָגָה shᵉʼâgâh, sheh-aw-gaw'; from H7580;  a rumbling or moan:—roaring.

H7582.definition: שָׁאָה shâʼâh, shaw-aw'; a primitive root;  to rush; by implication, to desolate:—be desolate, (make a) rush(-ing), (lay) waste.

H7585.definition: שְׁאוֹל shᵉʼôwl, sheh-ole'; or שְׁאֹל shᵉʼôl; from H7592;  hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates:—grave, hell, pit.

H7586.definition: שָׁאוּל Shâʼûwl, shaw-ool'; passive participle of H7592; asked;  Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites:—Saul, Shaul.

H7592.definition: שָׁאַל shâʼal, shaw-al'; or שָׁאֵל shâʼêl; a primitive root;  to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand:—ask (counsel, on), beg, borrow, lay to charge, consult, demand, desire, × earnestly, enquire,   greet, obtain leave, lend, pray, request, require,   salute, × straitly, × surely, wish.

H7593.definition: שְׁאֵל shᵉʼêl, sheh-ale'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7592:—ask, demand, require.

H7594.definition: שְׁאָל Shᵉʼâl, sheh-awl'; from H7592; request;  Sheal, an Israelite:—Sheal.

H7596.definition: שְׁאֵלָה shᵉʼêlâh, sheh-ay-law'; or שֵׁלָה shêlâh; (1 Samuel 1:17), from H7592;  a petition; by implication, a loan:—loan, petition, request.

H7600.definition: שַׁאֲנָן shaʼănân, shah-an-awn'; from H7599;  secure; in a bad sense, haughty:—that is at ease, quiet, tumult. Compare H7946.

H7603.definition: שְׂאֹר sᵉʼôr, seh-ore'; from H7604;  barm or yeast-cake (as swelling by fermentation):—leaven.

H7604.definition: שָׁאַר shâʼar, shaw-ar'; a primitive root;  properly, to swell up, i.e. be (causatively, make) redundant:—leave, (be) left, let, remain, remnant, reserve, the rest.

H7607.definition: שְׁאֵר shᵉʼêr, sheh-ayr'; from H7604;  flesh (as swelling out), as living or for food; generally food of any kind; figuratively, kindred by blood:—body, flesh, food, (near) kin(-sman, -swoman), near (nigh) (of kin).

H761.definition: אֲרַמִּי ʼĂrammîy, ar-am-mee'; patrial from H758;  an Aramite or Aramaean:—Syrian, Aramitess.

H7610.definition: שְׁאָר יָשׁוּב Shᵉʼâr Yâshûwb, sheh-awr'yaw-shoob'; from H7605 and H7725; a remnant will return;  Shear-Jashub, the symbolic name of one of Isaiah's sons:—Shear-jashub.

H7611.definition: שְׁאֵרִית shᵉʼêrîyth, sheh-ay-reeth'; from H7604;  a remainder or residual (surviving, final) portion:—that had escaped, be left, posterity, remain(-der), remnant, residue, rest.

H7613.definition: שְׂאֵת sᵉʼêth, seh-ayth'; from H5375;  an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively, elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character:—be accepted, dignity, excellency, highness, raise up self, rising.

H7614.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H7614.definition: שְׁבָא Shᵉbâʼ, sheb-aw'; of foreign origin;  Sheba, the name of three early progenitors of tribes and of an Ethiopian district:—Sheba, Sabeans.

H7617.definition: שָׁבָה shâbâh, shaw-baw'; a primitive root;  to transport into captivity:—(bring away, carry, carry away, lead, lead away, take) captive(-s), drive (take) away.

H7619.definition: שְׁבוּאֵל Shᵉbûwʼêl, sheb-oo-ale'; or שׁוּבָאֵל Shûwbâʼêl; from H7617 (abbreviated form) or H7725 and H410; captive (or returned) of God;  Shebuel or Shubael, the name of two Israelites:—Shebuel, Shubael.

H7620.definition: שָׁבוּעַ shâbûwaʻ, shaw-boo'-ah; or שָׁבֻעַ shâbuaʻ; also (feminine) שְׁבֻעָה shᵉbuʻâh; properly, passive participle of H7650 as a denominative of H7651;  literally, sevened, i.e. a week (specifically, of years):—seven, week.

H7621.definition: שְׁבוּעָה shᵉbûwʻâh, sheb-oo-aw'; feminine passive participle of H7650;  properly, something sworn, i.e. an oath:—curse, oath, × sworn.

H7623.definition: שָׁבַח shâbach, shaw-bakh'; a primitive root;  properly, to address in a loud tone, i.e. (specifically) loud; figuratively, to pacify (as if by words):—commend, glory, keep in, praise, still, triumph.

H7624.definition: שְׁבַח shᵉbach, sheb-akh'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7623;  to adulate, i.e. adore:—praise.

H7626.definition: שֵׁבֶט shêbeṭ, shay'-bet; from an unused root probably meaning to branch off;  a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan:—× correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

H7627.definition: שְׁבָט Shᵉbâṭ, sheb-awt'; of foreign origin;  Shebat, a Jewish month:—Sebat.

H7628.definition: שְׁבִי shᵉbîy, sheb-ee'; from H7618;  exiled; captured; as noun, exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively); by extension, booty:—captive(-ity), prisoners, × take away, that was taken.

H7629.definition: שֹׁבִי Shôbîy, sho-bee'; from H7617; captor;  Shobi, an Ammonite:—Shobi.

H7634.definition: שׇׁבְיָה Shobyâh, shob-yaw'; feminine of the same as H7629; captivation;  Shobjah, an Israelite:—Shachia (from the margin).

H7636.definition: שָׁבִיס shâbîyç, shaw-beece'; from an unused root meaning to interweave;  a netting for the hair:—caul.

H7637.definition: שְׁבִיעִי shᵉbîyʻîy, sheb-ee-ee'; or שְׁבִעִי shᵉbiʻîy; ordinal from H7657;  seventh:—seventh (time).

H764.definition: אַרְמֹנִי ʼArmônîy, ar-mo-nee'; from H759; palatial;  Armoni, an Israelite:—Armoni.

H7641.definition: שִׁבֹּל shibbôl, shib-bole; or (feminine) שִׁבֹּלֶת shibbôleth; from the same as H7640;  a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch:—branch, channel, ear (of corn), (water-)flood, Shibboleth. Compare H5451.

H7643.definition: שְׂבָם Sᵉbâm, seb-awm'; or (feminine) שִׂבְמָה Sibmâh; probably from H1313; spice;  Sebam or Sibmah, a place in Moab:—Shebam, Shibmah, Sibmah.

H7645.definition: שְׁבַנְיָה Shᵉbanyâh, sheb-an-yaw'; or שְׁבַנְיָהוּ Shᵉbanyâhûw; from the same as H7644 and H3050; Jah has grown (i.e. prospered);  Shebanjah, the name of three or four Israelites:—Shebaniah.

H7646.definition: שָׂבַע sâbaʻ, saw-bah'; or שָׂבֵעַ sâbêaʻ; a primitive root;  to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively):—have enough, fill (full, self, with), be (to the) full (of), have plenty of, be satiate, satisfy (with), suffice, be weary of.

H7647.definition: שָׂבָע sâbâʻ, saw-baw'; from H7646;  copiousness:—abundance, plenteous(-ness, -ly).

H7649.definition: שָׂבֵעַ sâbêaʻ, saw-bay'-ah; from H7646;  satiated (in a pleasant or disagreeable sense):—full (of), satisfied (with).

H7650.definition: שָׁבַע shâbaʻ, shaw-bah'; a primitive root; properly to be complete, but used only as a denominative from H7651;  to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times):—adjure, charge (by an oath, with an oath), feed to the full (by mistake for H7646), take an oath, × straitly, (cause to, make to) swear.

H7651.definition: שֶׁבַע shebaʻ, sheh'-bah; or (masculine) (שִׁבְעָה shibʻâh); from H7650; a primitive cardinal number;  seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number:—(+ by) seven(-fold),-s, (-teen, -teenth), -th, times). Compare H7658.

H7652.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H7652.definition: שֶׁבַע shebaʻ, sheh'-bah; the same as H7651; seven;  Sheba, the name of a place in Palestine, and of two Israelites:—Sheba.

H7654.definition: שׇׂבְעָה sobʻâh, sob-aw'; feminine of H7648;  satiety:—(to have) enough, × till...be full, (un-) satiable, satisfy, × sufficiently.

H7655.definition: שִׁבְעָה shibʻâh, shib-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7651:—seven (times).

H7657.definition: שִׁבְעִים shibʻîym, shib-eem'; multiple of H7651;  seventy:—seventy, threescore and ten (+ -teen).

H7658.definition: שִׁבְעָנָה shibʻânâh, shib-aw-naw'; prolonged for the masculine of H7651;  seven:—seven.

H7659.definition: שִׁבְעָתַיִם shibʻâthayim, shib-aw-thah'-yim; dual (adverbially) of H7651;  seven-times:—seven(-fold, times).

H7662.definition: שְׁבַק shᵉbaq, sheb-ak'; (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of H7733;  to quit, i.e. allow to remain:—leave, let alone.

H7663.definition: שָׂבַר sâbar, saw-bar'; erroneously שָׁבַר shâbar; (Nehemiah 2:13,15), a primitive root;  to scrutinize; by implication (of watching) to expect (with hope and patience):—hope, tarry, view, wait.

H7665.definition: שָׁבַר shâbar, shaw-bar'; a primitive root;  to burst (literally or figuratively):—break (down, off, in pieces, up), broken (-hearted), bring to the birth, crush, destroy, hurt, quench, × quite, tear, view (by mistake for H7663).

H7666.definition: שָׁבַר shâbar, shaw-bar'; denominative from H7668;  to deal in grain:—buy, sell.

H7667.definition: שֶׁבֶר sheber, sheh'-ber; or שֵׁבֶר shêber; from H7665;  a fracture, figuratively, ruin; specifically, a solution (of a dream):—affliction, breach, breaking, broken(-footed, -handed), bruise, crashing, destruction, hurt, interpretation, vexation.

H7668.definition: שֶׁבֶר sheber, sheh'-ber; the same as H7667;  grain (as if broken into kernels):—corn, victuals.

H7669.definition: שֶׁבֶר Sheber, sheh'-ber; the same as H7667;  Sheber, an Israelite:—Sheber.

H767.definition: אֹרֶן ʼÔren, o'-ren; the same as H766;  Oren, an Israelite:—Oren.

H7670.definition: שִׁבְרוֹן shibrôwn, shib-rone'; from H7665;  rupture, i.e. a pang; figuratively, ruin:—breaking, destruction.

H7673.definition: שָׁבַת shâbath, shaw-bath'; a primitive root;  to repose, i.e. desist from exertion; used in many implied relations (causative, figurative or specific):—(cause to, let, make to) cease, celebrate, cause (make) to fail, keep (sabbath), suffer to be lacking, leave, put away (down), (make to) rest, rid, still, take away.

H7677.definition: שַׁבָּתוֹן shabbâthôwn, shab-baw-thone'; from H7676;  a sabbatism or special holiday:—rest, sabbath.

H7678.definition: שַׁבְּתַי Shabbᵉthay, shab-beth-ah'-ee; from H7676; restful;  Shabbethai, the name of three Israelites:—Shabbethai.

H7679.definition: שָׂגָא sâgâʼ, saw-gaw'; a primitive root;  to grow, i.e. (causatively) to enlarge, (figuratively) laud:—increase, magnify.

H7680.definition: שְׂגָא sᵉgâʼ, seg-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7679;  to increase:—grow, be multiplied.

H7682.definition: שָׂגַב sâgab, saw-gab'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, make) lofty, especially inaccessible; by implication, safe, strong; used literally and figuratively:—defend, exalt, be excellent, (be, set on) high, lofty, be safe, set up (on high), be too strong.

H7683.definition: שָׁגַג shâgag, shaw-gag'; a primitive root;  to stray, i.e. (figuratively) sin (with more or less apology):—× also for that, deceived, err, go astray, sin ignorantly.

H7684.definition: שְׁגָגָה shᵉgâgâh, sheg-aw-gaw'; from H7683;  a mistake or inadvertent transgression:—error, ignorance, at unawares; unwittingly.

H7685.definition: שָׂגָה sâgâh, saw-gaw'; a primitive root;  to enlarge (especially upward, also figuratively):—grow (up), increase.

H7686.definition: שָׁגָה shâgâh, shaw-gaw'; a primitive root;  to stray (causatively, mislead), usually (figuratively) to mistake, especially (morally) to transgress; by extension (through the idea of intoxication) to reel, (figuratively) be enraptured:—(cause to) go astray, deceive, err, be ravished, sin through ignorance, (let, make to) wander.

H7687.definition: שְׂגוּב Sᵉgûwb, seg-oob'; from H7682; aloft;  Segub, the name of two Israelites:—Segub.

H769.definition: אַרְנוֹן ʼArnôwn, ar-nohn'; or אַרְנֹן ʼArnônlemma אַרְנן missing vowel, corrected to אַרְנֹן; from H7442; a brawling stream;  the Arnon, a river east of the Jordan, also its territory:—Arnon.

H7690.definition: שַׂגִּיא saggîyʼ, sag-ghee'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7689;  large (in size, quantity or number, also adverbial):—exceeding, great(-ly); many, much, sore, very.

H7696.definition: שָׁגַע shâgaʻ, shaw-gah'; a primitive root;  to rave through insanity:—(be, play the) mad (man).

H7697.definition: שִׁגָּעוֹן shiggâʻôwn, shig-gaw-yone'; from H7696;  craziness:—furiously, madness.

H7699.definition: שַׁד shad, shad; or שֹׁד shôd; probably from H7736 (in its original sense) contracted;  the breast of a woman or animal (as bulging):—breast, pap, teat.

H7701.definition: שֹׁד shôd, shode; or שׁוֹד shôwd; (Job 5:21), from H7736;  violence, ravage:—desolation, destruction, oppression, robbery, spoil(-ed, -er, -ing), wasting.

H7703.definition: שָׁדַד shâdad, shaw-dad'; a primitive root;  properly, to be burly, i.e. (figuratively) powerful (passively, impregnable); by implication, to ravage:—dead, destroy(-er), oppress, robber, spoil(-er), × utterly, (lay) waste.

H7704.definition: שָׂדֶה sâdeh, saw-deh'; or שָׂדַי sâday; from an unused root meaning to spread out;  a field (as flat):—country, field, ground, land, soil, × wild.

H7705.definition: שִׁדָּה shiddâh, shid-dah'; from H7703;  a wife (as mistress of the house):—× all sorts, musical instrument.

H7706.partOfSpeech: masculine noun with reference to deity
H7706.definition: שַׁדַּי Shadday, shad-dah'-ee; from H7703;  the Almighty:—Almighty.

H771.definition: אׇרְנָן ʼOrnân, or-nawn'; probably from H766; strong;  Ornan, a Jebusite:—Ornan. See H728.

H7714.definition: שַׁדְרַךְ Shadrak, shad-rak'; probably of foreign origin;  Shadrak, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions:—Shadrach.

H7715.definition: שַׁדְרַךְ Shadrak, shad-rak'; (Aramaic) the same as H7714:—Shadrach.

H7716.definition: שֶׂה seh, seh; or שֵׂי sêy; probably from H7582 through the idea of pushing out to graze;  a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat:—(lesser, small) cattle, ewe, goat, lamb, sheep. Compare H2089.

H7718.definition: שֹׁהַם shôham, sho'-ham; from an unused root probably mean to blanch;  a gem, probably the beryl (from its pale green color):—onyx.

H7719.definition: שֹׁהַם Shôham, sho'-ham; the same as H7718;  Shoham, an Israelite:—Shoham.

H772.definition: אֲרַע ʼăraʻ, ar-ah'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H776;  the earth; by implication (figuratively) low:—earth, interior.

H7720.definition: שַׂהֲרֹן sahărôn, sah-har-one'; from the same as H5469;  a round pendant for the neck:—ornament, round tire like the moon.

H7723.definition: שָׁוְא shâvᵉʼ, shawv; or שַׁו shav; from the same as H7722 in the sense of desolating;  evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain):—false(-ly), lie, lying, vain, vanity.

H7724.definition: שְׁוָא Shᵉvâʼ, shev-aw'; from the same as H7723; false;  Sheva, an Israelite:—Sheva.

H7725.definition: שׁוּב shûwb, shoob; a primitive root;  to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again:—((break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep)) × again, (cause to) answer (  again), × in any case (wise), × at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call (to mind), carry again (back), cease, × certainly, come again (back), × consider,   continually, convert, deliver (again),   deny, draw back, fetch home again, × fro, get (oneself) (back) again, × give (again), go again (back, home), (go) out, hinder, let, (see) more, × needs, be past, × pay, pervert, pull in again, put (again, up again), recall, recompense, recover, refresh, relieve, render (again), requite, rescue, restore, retrieve, (cause to, make to) return, reverse, reward,   say nay, send back, set again, slide back, still, × surely, take back (off), (cause to, make to) turn (again, self again, away, back, back again, backward, from, off), withdraw.

H7727.definition: שׁוֹבָב Shôwbâb, sho-bawb'; the same as H7726; rebellious;  Shobab, the name of two Israelites:—Shobab.

H7730.definition: שׂוֹבֶךְ sôwbek, so'-bek; for H5441;  a thicket, i.e. interlaced branches:—thick boughs.

H7731.definition: שׁוֹבָךְ Shôwbâk, sho-bawk'; perhaps for H7730;  Shobak, a Syrian:—Shobach.

H7732.definition: שׁוֹבָל Shôwbâl, sho-bawl'; from the same as H7640; overflowing;  Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites:—Shobal.

H7733.definition: שׁוֹבֵק Shôwbêq, sho-bake'; active participle from a primitive root meaning to leave (compare H7662); forsaking;  Shobek, an Israelite:—Shobek.

H7734.definition: שׂוּג sûwg, soog; a primitive root;  to retreat:—turn back.

H7737.definition: שָׁוָה shâvâh, shaw-vaw'; a primitive root;  properly, to level, i.e. equalize; figuratively, to resemble; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.):—avail, behave, bring forth, compare, countervail, (be, make) equal, lay, be (make, a-) like, make plain, profit, reckon.

H7743.definition: שׁוּחַ shûwach, shoo'-akh; a primitive root;  to sink, literally or figuratively:—bow down, incline, humble.

H7745.definition: שׁוּחָה shûwchâh, shoo-khaw'; from H7743;  a chasm:—ditch, pit.

H775.definition: אַרְפַּכְשַׁד ʼArpakshad, ar-pak-shad'; probably of foreign origin;  Arpakshad, a son of Noah; also the region settled by him:—Arphaxad.

H7751.definition: שׁוּט shûwṭ, shoot; a primitive root;  properly, to push forth; (but used only figuratively) to lash, i.e. (the sea with oars) to row; by implication, to travel:—go (about, through, to and fro), mariner, rower, run to and fro.

H7752.definition: שׁוֹט shôwṭ, shote; from H7751;  a lash (literally or figuratively):—scourge, whip.

H7755.definition: שׂוֹכֹה Sôwkôh, so-ko'; or שֹׂכֹה Sôkôh; or שׂוֹכוֹ Sôwkôw; from H7753;  Sokoh or Soko, the name of two places in Palestine:—Shocho, Shochoh, Sochoh, Soco, Socoh.

H7758.definition: שׁוֹלָל shôwlâl, sho-lawl'; or שֵׁילָל shêylâl; (Micah 1:8), from H7997;  nude (especially bare-foot); by implication, captive:—spoiled, stripped.

H776.definition: אֶרֶץ ʼerets, eh'-rets; from an unused root probably meaning to be firm;  the earth (at large, or partitively a land):—× common, country, earth, field, ground, land, × natins, way, + wilderness, world.

H7760.definition: שׂוּם sûwm, soom; or שִׂים sîym; a primitive root;  to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically):—× any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine,   disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark,   name, × on, ordain, order,   paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on),   regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew,   stedfastly, take, × tell,   tread down, (over-)turn, × wholly, work.

H7761.definition: שׂוּם sûwm, soom; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7760:—  command, give, lay, make,   name,   regard, set.

H7763.definition: שׁוֹמֵר Shôwmêr, sho-mare'; or שֹׁמֵר Shômêr; active participle of H8104; keeper;  Shomer, the name of two Israelites:—Shomer.

H7764.definition: שׁוּנִי Shûwnîy, shoo-nee'; from an unused root meaning to rest; quiet;  Shuni, an Israelite:—Shuni.

H7767.definition: שׁוּנַמִּית Shûwnammîyth, shoo-nam-meeth'; patrial from H7766;  a Shunammitess, or female inhabitant of Shunem:—Shunamite.

H7768.definition: שָׁוַע shâvaʻ, shaw-vah'; a primitive root;  properly, to be free; but used only causatively and reflexively, to halloo (for help, i.e. freedom from some trouble):—cry (aloud, out), shout.

H7769.definition: שׁוּעַ shûwaʻ, shoo'-ah; from H7768;  a halloo:—cry, riches.

H7770.definition: שׁוּעַ Shûwaʻ, shoo'-ah; the same as H7769;  Shua, a Canaanite:—Shua, Shuah.

H7776.definition: שׁוּעָל shûwʻâl, shoo-awl'; or שֻׁעָל shuʻâl; from the same as H8168;  a jackal (as a burrower):—fox.

H7777.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H7777.definition: שׁוּעָל Shûwʻâl, shoo-awl'; the same as H7776;  Shual, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:—Shual.

H7778.definition: שׁוֹעֵר shôwʻêr, sho-are'; or שֹׁעֵר shôʻêr active participle of H8176 (as denominative from H8179);  a janitor:—doorkeeper, porter.

H7780.definition: שׁוֹפָךְ Shôwphâk, sho-fawk'; from H8210; poured;  Shophak, a Syrian:—Shophach.

H7782.definition: שׁוֹפָר shôwphâr, sho-far'; or שֹׁפָר shôphâr; from H8231 in the original sense of incising;  a cornet (as giving a clear sound) or curved horn:—cornet, trumpet.

H7783.definition: שׁוּק shûwq, shook; a primitive root;  to run after or over, i.e. overflow:—overflow, water.

H7785.definition: שׁוֹק shôwq, shoke; from H7783;  the (lower) leg (as a runner):—hip, leg, shoulder, thigh.

H7789.definition: שׁוּר shûwr, shoor; a primitive root (identical with through the idea of going round for inspection);  to spy out, i.e. (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for:—behold, lay wait, look, observe, perceive, regard, see.

H779.definition: אָרַר ʼârar, aw-rar'; a primitive root;  to execrate:—× bitterly curse.

H7794.definition: שׁוֹר shôwr, shore; from H7788;  a bullock (as a traveller):—bull(-ock), cow, ox, wall (by mistake for H7791).

H7797.definition: שׂוּשׂ sûws, soos; or שִׂישׂ sîys; a primitive root;  to be bright, i.e. cheerful:—be glad, × greatly, joy, make mirth, rejoice.

H7799.definition: שׁוּשַׁן shûwshan, shoo-shan'; or שׁוֹשָׁן shôwshân; or שֹׁשָׁן shôshân; and (feminine) שׁוֹשַׁנָּה shôwshannâh; from H7797;  a lily (from its whiteness), as a flower of architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape):—lily, Shoshannim.

H78.definition: אִבְצָן ʼIbtsân, ib-tsawn'; from the same as H76; splendid;  Ibtsan, an Israelite:—Ibzan.

H7803.definition: שׁוּתֶלַח Shûwthelach, shoo-theh'-lakh; probably from H7582 and the same as H8520; crash of breakage;  Shuthelach, the name of two Israelites:—Shuthelah.

H7804.definition: שְׁזַב shᵉzab, shez-ab'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H5800;  to leave, i.e. (causatively) free:—deliver.

H7810.definition: שַׁחַד shachad, shakh'-ad; from H7809;  a donation (venal or redemptive):—bribe(-ry), gift, present, reward.

H7812.definition: שָׁחָה shâchâh, shaw-khaw'; a primitive root;  to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God):—bow (self) down, crouch, fall down (flat), humbly beseech, do (make) obeisance, do reverence, make to stoop, worship.

H7814.definition: שְׂחוֹק sᵉchôwq, sekh-oke'; or שְׂחֹק sᵉchôq; from H7832;  laughter (in merriment or defiance):—derision, laughter(-ed to scorn, -ing), mocked, sport.

H7815.definition: שְׁחוֹר shᵉchôwr, shekh-ore'; from H7835;  dinginess, i.e. perhaps soot:—coal.

H7817.definition: שָׁחַח shâchach, shaw-khakh'; a primitive root;  to sink or depress (reflexive or causative):—bend, bow (down), bring (cast) down, couch, humble self, be (bring) low, stoop.

H7819.definition: שָׁחַט shâchaṭ, shaw-khat'; a primitive root;  to slaughter (in sacrifice or massacre):—kill, offer, shoot out, slay, slaughter.

H7822.definition: שְׁחִין shᵉchîyn, shekh-een'; from an unused root probably meaning to burn;  inflammation, i.e. an ulcer:—boil, botch.

H7823.definition: שָׁחִיס shâchîyç, shaw-khece'; or סָחִישׁ çâchîysh; from an unused root apparently meaning to sprout;  after-growth:—(that) which springeth of the same.

H7828.definition: שַׁחַף shachaph, shakh'-af; from an unused root meaning to peel, i.e. emaciate;  the gull (as thin):—cuckoo.

H783.definition: אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׁתָּא ʼArtachshashtâʼ, ar-takh-shash-taw'; or אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׁתְּא ʼArtachshashtᵉʼ; or by permutation אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא ʼArtachshaçtᵉʼ; of foreign origin;  Artachshasta (or Artaxerxes), a title (rather than name) of several Persian kings:—Artaxerxes.

H7832.definition: שָׂחַק sâchaq, saw-khak'; a primitive root;  to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play:—deride, have in derision, laugh, make merry, mock(-er), play, rejoice, (laugh to) scorn, be in (make) sport.

H7833.definition: שָׁחַק shâchaq, shaw-khak'; a primitive root;  to comminate (by trituration or attrition):—beat, wear.

H7835.definition: שָׁחַר shâchar, shaw-khar'; a primitive root (identical with H7836 through the idea of the duskiness of early dawn);  to be dim or dark (in color):—be black.

H7836.definition: שָׁחַר shâchar, shaw-khar'; a primitive root;  properly, to dawn, i.e. (figuratively) be (up) early at any task (with the implication of earnestness); by extension, to search for (with painstaking):—(do something) betimes, enquire early, rise (seek) betimes, seek diligently) early, in the morning).

H7837.definition: שַׁחַר shachar, shakh'-ar; from H7836;  dawn (literal, figurative or adverbial):—day(-spring), early, light, morning, whence riseth.

H7838.definition: שָׁחֹר shâchôr, shaw-khore'; or שָׁחוֹר shâchôwr; from H7835;  properly, dusky, but also (absolute) jetty:—black.

H784.definition: אֵשׁ ʼêsh, aysh; a primitive word;  fire (literally or figuratively):—burning, fiery, fire, flaming, hot.

H7841.definition: שְׁחַרְיָה Shᵉcharyâh, shekh-ar-yaw'; from H7836 and H3050; Jah has sought;  Shecharjah, an Israelite:—Shehariah.

H7842.definition: שַׁחֲרַיִם Shachărayim, shakh-ar-ah'-yim; dual of H7837; double dawn;  Shacharajim, an Israelite:—Shaharaim.

H7843.definition: שָׁחַת shâchath, shaw-khath'; a primitive root;  to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively):—batter, cast off, corrupt(-er, thing), destroy(-er, -uction), lose, mar, perish, spill, spoiler, × utterly, waste(-r).

H7844.definition: שְׁחַת shᵉchath, shekh-ath'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7843:—corrupt, fault.

H7845.definition: שַׁחַת shachath, shakh'-ath; from H7743;  a pit (especially as a trap); figuratively, destruction:—corruption, destruction, ditch, grave, pit.

H7847.definition: שָׂטָה sâṭâh, saw-taw'; a primitive root;  to deviate from duty:—decline, go aside, turn.

H7848.definition: שִׁטָּה shiṭṭâh, shit-taw'; feminine of a derivative (only in the plural שִׁטִּים shiṭṭîym; meaning the sticks of wood) from the same as H7850;  the acacia (from its scourging thorns):—shittah, shittim. See also H1029.

H785.definition: אֵשׁ ʼêsh, aysh; (Aramaic) corresponding to H784:—flame.

H7852.definition: שָׂטַם sâṭam, saw-tam'; a primitive root;  properly, to lurk for, i.e. persecute:—hate, oppose self against.

H7854.definition: שָׂטָן sâṭân, saw-tawn'; from H7853;  an opponent; especially (with the article prefixed) Satan, the arch-enemy of good:—adversary, Satan, withstand.

H7856.definition: שִׂטְנָה Siṭnâh, sit-naw'; the same as H7855;  Sitnah, the name of a well in Pal:—Sitnah.

H7857.definition: שָׁטַף shâṭaph, shaw-taf'; a primitive root;  to gush; by implication, to inundate, cleanse; by analogy, to gallop, conquer:—drown, (over-) flow(-whelm, rinse, run, rush, (throughly) wash (away).

H7858.definition: שֶׁטֶף sheṭeph, sheh'-tef; or שֵׁטֶף shêṭeph; from H7857;  a deluge (literally or figuratively):—flood, outrageous, overflowing.

H7859.definition: שְׁטַר shᵉṭar, shet-ar'; (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation;  a side:—side.

H7861.definition: שִׁטְרַי Shiṭray, shit-rah'-ee; from the same as H7860; magisterial;  Shitrai, an Israelite:—Shitrai.

H7862.definition: שַׁי shay, shah'-ee; probably from H7737;  a gift (as available):—present.

H7868.definition: שִׂיב sîyb, seeb; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7867:—elder.

H7872.definition: שֵׂיבָה sêybâh, say-baw'; feminine of H7869;  old age:—(be) gray (grey hoar,-y) hairs (head,-ed), old age.

H7878.definition: שִׂיחַ sîyach, see'-akh; a primitive root;  to ponder, i.e. (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence, aloud) or (transitively) utter:—commune, complain, declare, meditate, muse, pray, speak, talk (with).

H788.definition: אַשְׁבֵּל ʼAshbêl, ash-bale'; probably from the same as H7640; flowing;  Ashbel, an Israelite:—Ashbel.

H7881.definition: שִׂיחָה sîychâh, see-khaw'; feminine of H7879;  reflection; by extension, devotion:—meditation, prayer.

H7891.definition: שִׁיר shîyr, sheer; or (the original form) שׁוּר shûwr; (1 Samuel 18:6), a primitive root (rather identical with H7788 through the idea of strolling minstrelsy);  to sing:—behold (by mistake for H7789), sing(-er, -ing man, -ing woman).

H7892.definition: שִׁיר shîyr, sheer; or feminine שִׁירָה shîyrâh; from H7891;  a song; abstractly, singing:—musical(-ick), × sing(-er, -ing), song.

H7895.definition: שִׁישַׁק Shîyshaq, shee-shak'; or שׁוּשַׁק Shûwshaq; of Egyptian derivation;  Shishak, an Egyptian king:—Shishak.

H7896.definition: שִׁית shîyth, sheeth; a primitive root;  to place (in a very wide application):—apply, appoint, array, bring, consider, lay (up), let alone, × look, make, mark, put (on),   regard, set, shew, be stayed, × take.

H79.definition: אָבַק ʼâbaq, aw-bak'; a primitive root, probably to float away (as vapor), but used only as denominative from H80;  to bedust, i.e. grapple:—wrestle.

H790.definition: אֶשְׁבָּן ʼEshbân, esh-bawn'; probably from the same as H7644; vigorous;  Eshban, an Idumaean:—Eshban.

H7901.definition: שָׁכַב shâkab, shaw-kab'; a primitive root;  to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose):—× at all, cast down, (lover-)lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.

H7902.definition: שְׁכָבָה shᵉkâbâh, shek-aw-baw'; from H7901;  a lying down (of dew, or for the sexual act):—× carnally, copulation, × lay, seed.

H7903.definition: שְׁכֹבֶת shᵉkôbeth, shek-o'-beth; from H7901;  a (sexual) lying with:—× lie.

H7904.definition: שָׁכָה shâkâh, shaw-kaw'; a primitive root;  to roam (through lust):—in the morning (by mistake for H7925).

H7908.definition: שְׁכוֹל shᵉkôwl, shek-ole'; infinitive of H7921;  bereavement:—loss of children, spoiling.

H7909.definition: שַׁכּוּל shakkûwl, shak-kool'; or שַׁכֻּל shakkul; from H7921;  bereaved:—barren, bereaved (robbed) of children (whelps).

H7910.definition: שִׁכּוֹר shikkôwr, shik-kore'; or שִׁכֹּר shikkôr; from H7937;  intoxicated, as a state or a habit:—drunk(-ard, -en, -en man).

H7911.definition: שָׁכַח shâkach, shaw-kakh'; or שָׁכֵחַ shâkêach; a primitive root;  to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention:—× at all, (cause to) forget.

H7912.definition: שְׁכַח shᵉkach, shek-akh'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7911 through the idea of disclosure of a covered or forgotten thing;  to discover (literally or figuratively):—find.

H7913.definition: שָׁכֵחַ shâkêach, shaw-kay'-akh; from H7911;  oblivious:—forget.

H7914.definition: שְׂכִיָּה sᵉkîyâh, sek-ee-yaw'; feminine from the same as H7906;  a conspicuous object:—picture.

H7916.definition: שָׂכִיר sâkîyr, saw-keer'; from H7936;  a man at wages by the day or year:—hired (man, servant), hireling.

H7917.definition: שְׂכִירָה sᵉkîyrâh, sek-ee-raw'; feminine of H7916;  a hiring:—that is hired.

H7918.definition: שָׁכַךְ shâkak, shaw-kak'; a primitive root;  to weave (i.e. lay) a trap; figuratively, (through the idea of secreting) to allay (passions; physically, abate a flood):—appease, assuage, make to cease, pacify, set.

H7919.definition: שָׂכַל sâkal, saw-kal'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent:—consider, expert, instruct, prosper, (deal) prudent(-ly), (give) skill(-ful), have good success, teach, (have, make to) understand(-ing), wisdom, (be, behave self, consider, make) wise(-ly), guide wittingly.

H7921.definition: שָׁכֹל shâkôl, shaw-kole'; a primitive root;  properly, to miscarry, i.e. suffer abortion; by analogy, to bereave (literally or figuratively):—bereave (of children), barren, cast calf (fruit, young), be (make) childless, deprive, destroy, × expect, lose children, miscarry, rob of children, spoil.

H7922.definition: שֶׂכֶל sekel, seh'-kel; or שֵׂכֶל sêkel; from H7919;  intelligence; by implication, success:—discretion, knowledge, policy, prudence, sense, understanding, wisdom, wise.

H7925.definition: שָׁכַם shâkam, shaw-kam'; a primitive root; properly, to incline (the shoulder to a burden); but used only as denominative from H7926;  literally, to load up (on the back of man or beast), i.e. to start early in the morning:—(arise, be up, get (oneself) up, rise up) early (betimes), morning.

H7927.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H7927.definition: שְׁכֶם Shᵉkem, shek-em'; the same as H7926; ridge;  Shekem, a place in Palestine:—Shechem.

H7931.definition: שָׁכַן shâkan, shaw-kan'; a primitive root (apparently akin (by transmission) to H7901 through the idea of lodging; compare H5531, H7925);  to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively):—abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place, (cause to) remain, rest, set (up).

H7934.definition: שָׁכֵן shâkên, shaw-kane'; from H7931;  a resident; by extension, a fellow-citizen:—inhabitant, neighbour, nigh.

H7935.definition: שְׁכַנְיָה Shᵉkanyâh, shek-an-yaw'; or (prolonged) שְׁכַנְיָהוּ Shᵉkanyâhûw; from H7931 and H3050; Jah has dwelt;  Shekanjah, the name of nine Israelites:—Shecaniah, Shechaniah.

H7936.definition: שָׂכַר sâkar, saw-kar'; or (by permutation) סָכַר çâkar; (Ezra 4:5), a primitive root (apparently akin (by prosthesis) to H3739 through the idea of temporary purchase; compare H7937);  to hire:—earn wages, hire (out self), reward, × surely.

H7937.definition: שָׁכַר shâkar, shaw-kar'; a primitive root;  to become tipsy; in a qualified sense, to satiate with a stimulating drink or (figuratively) influence:—(be filled with) drink (abundantly), (be, make) drunk(-en), be merry. (Superlative of H8248.)

H7938.definition: שֶׂכֶר seker, seh'-ker; from H7936;  wages:—reward, sluices.

H7939.definition: שָׂכָר sâkâr, saw-kawr'; from H7936;  payment of contract; concretely, salary, fare, maintenance; by implication, compensation, benefit:—hire, price, reward(-ed), wages, worth.

H7941.definition: שֵׁכָר shêkâr, shay-kawr'; from H7937;  an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor:—strong drink,   drunkard, strong wine.

H7945.definition: שֶׁל shel, shel; for the rel. H834; used with prepositional prefix, and often followed by some pronominal affix;  on account of, whatsoever, whichsoever:—cause, sake.

H795.definition: אַשְׁדּוֹד ʼAshdôwd, ash-dode'; from H7703; ravager;  Ashdod, a place in Palestine:—Ahdod.

H7950.definition: שֶׁלֶג sheleg, sheh'-leg; from H7949;  snow (probably from its whiteness):—snow(-y).

H7951.definition: שָׁלָה shâlâh, shaw-law'; or שָׁלַו shâlav; (Job 3:26), a primitive root;  to be tranquil, i.e. secure or successful:—be happy, prosper, be in safety.

H7956.definition: שֵׁלָה Shêlâh, shay-law'; the same as H7596 (shortened); request;  Shelah, the name of a postdiluvian patriarch and of an Israelite:—Shelah.

H7957.definition: שַׁלְהֶבֶת shalhebeth, shal-heh'-beth; from the same as H3851 with sibilant prefix;  a flare of fire:—(flaming) flame.

H7958.definition: שְׂלָו sᵉlâv, sel-awv'; or שְׂלָיו sᵉlâyv; by orthographical variation from H7951 through the idea of sluggishness;  the quail collectively (as slow in flight from its weight):—quails.

H7960.definition: שָׁלוּ shâlûw, shaw-loo'; (Aramaic) or שָׁלוּת shâlûwth; (Aramaic), from the same as H7955;  a fault:—error, × fail, thing amiss.

H7962.definition: שַׁלְוָה shalvâh, shal-vaw'; from H7951;  security (genuine or false):—abundance, peace(-ably), prosperity, quietness.

H7964.definition: שִׁלּוּחַ shillûwach, shil-loo'-akh; or שִׁלֻּחַ shilluach; from H7971;  (only in plural) a dismissal, i.e. (of a wife) divorce (especially the document); also (of a daughter) dower:—presents, have sent back.

H7965.definition: שָׁלוֹם shâlôwm, shaw-lome'; or שָׁלֹם shâlôm; from H7999;  safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace:—× do, familiar, × fare, favour,   friend, × great, (good) health, (× perfect, such as be at) peace(-able, -ably), prosper(-ity, -ous), rest, safe(-ty), salute, welfare, (× all is, be) well, × wholly.

H7967.definition: שַׁלּוּם Shallûwm, shal-loom'; or (shorter) שַׁלֻּם Shallum; the same as H7966;  Shallum, the name of fourteen Israelites:—Shallum.

H7968.definition: שַׁלּוּן Shallûwn, shal-loon'; probably for H7967;  Shallun, an Israelite:—Shallum.

H7969.definition: שָׁלוֹשׁ shâlôwsh, shaw-loshe'; or שָׁלֹשׁ shâlôsh; masculine שְׁלוֹשָׁה shᵉlôwshâh; or שְׁלֹשָׁה shᵉlôshâh; a primitive number;  three; occasionally (ordinal) third, or (multiple) thrice:—+ fork, + often(-times), third, thir(-teen, -teenth), three, + thrice. Compare H7991.

H7970.definition: שְׁלוֹשִׁים shᵉlôwshîym, shel-o-sheem'; or שְׁלֹשִׁים shᵉlôshîym; multiple of H7969;  thirty; or (ordinal) thirtieth:—thirty, thirtieth. Compare H7991.

H7971.definition: שָׁלַח shâlach, shaw-lakh'; a primitive root;  to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications):—× any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, × earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).

H7972.definition: שְׁלַח shᵉlach, shel-akh'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7971:—put, send.

H7973.definition: שֶׁלַח shelach, sheh'-lakh; from H7971;  a missile of attack, i.e. spear; also (figuratively) a shoot of growth; i.e. branch:—dart, plant, × put off, sword, weapon.

H7974.definition: שֶׁלַח Shelach, sheh'-lakh; the same as H7973;  Shelach, a postdiluvian patriarch:—Salah, Shelah. Compare H7975.

H7979.definition: שֻׁלְחָן shulchân, shool-khawn'; from H7971;  a table (as spread out); by implication, a meal:—table.

H7980.definition: שָׁלַט shâlaṭ, shaw-lat'; a primitive root;  to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit:—(bear, have) rule, have dominion, give (have) power.

H7981.definition: שְׁלֵט shᵉlêṭ, shel-ate'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7980:—have the mastery, have power, bear rule, be (make) ruler.

H7982.definition: שֶׁלֶט sheleṭ, sheh'-let; from H7980;  probably a shield (as controlling, i.e. protecting the person):—shield.

H7985.definition: שׇׁלְטָן sholṭân, shol-tawn'; (Aramaic) from H7981;  empire (abstractly or concretely):—dominion.

H7989.definition: שַׁלִּיט shallîyṭ, shal-leet'; from H7980;  potent; concretely, a prince or warrior:—governor, mighty, that hath power, ruler.

H7990.definition: שַׁלִּיט shallîyṭ, shal-leet'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7989;  mighty; abstractly, permission; concretely, a premier:—captain, be lawful, rule(-r).

H7991.definition: שָׁלִישׁ shâlîysh, shaw-leesh'; or שָׁלוֹשׁ shâlôwsh; (1 Chronicles 11:11; 1 Chronicles 12:18), or שָׁלֹשׁ shâlôsh; (2 Samuel 23:13), from H7969;  a triple, i.e. (as a musical instrument) a triangle (or perhaps rather three-stringed lute); also (as an indefinite, great quantity) a three-fold measure (perhaps a treble ephah); also (as an officer) a general of the third rank (upward, i.e. the highest):—captain, instrument of musick, (great) lord, (great) measure, prince, three (from the margin).

H7992.definition: שְׁלִישִׁי shᵉlîyshîy, shel-ee-shee'; ordinal from H7969;  third; feminine a third (part); by extension, a third (day, year or time); specifically, a third-story cell):—third (part, rank, time), three (years old).

H7993.definition: שָׁלַךְ shâlak, shaw-lak; a primitive root;  to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively):—adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw.

H7996.definition: שַׁלֶּכֶת Shalleketh, shal-leh'-keth; the same as H7995;  Shalleketh, a gate in Jerusalem:—Shalleketh.

H7997.definition: שָׁלַל shâlal, shaw-lal'; a primitive root;  to drop or strip; by implication, to plunder:—let fall, make self a prey, × of purpose, (make a, (take)) spoil.

H7998.definition: שָׁלָל shâlâl, shaw-lawl'; from H7997;  booty:—prey, spoil.

H7999.definition: שָׁלַם shâlam, shaw-lam'; a primitive root;  to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively, to be (causatively, make) completed; by implication, to be friendly; by extension, to reciprocate (in various applications):—make amends, (make an) end, finish, full, give again, make good, (re-) pay (again), (make) (to) (be at) peace(-able), that is perfect, perform, (make) prosper(-ous), recompense, render, requite, make restitution, restore, reward, × surely.

H80.definition: אָבָק ʼâbâq, aw-bawk'; from root of H79;  light particles (as volatile):—(small) dust, powder.

H8000.definition: שְׁלַם shᵉlam, shel-am'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7999;  to complete, to restore:—deliver, finish.

H8001.definition: שְׁלָם shᵉlâm, shel-awm'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7965;  prosperity:—peace.

H8002.definition: שֶׁלֶם shelem, sheh'-lem; from H7999;  properly, requital, i.e. a (voluntary) sacrifice in thanks:—peace offering.

H8003.definition: שָׁלֵם shâlêm, shaw-lame'; from H7999;  complete (literally or figuratively); especially friendly:—full, just, made ready, peaceable, perfect(-ed), quiet, Shalem (by mistake for a name), whole.

H8007.definition: שַׂלְמָא Salmâʼ, sal-maw'; probably for H8008; clothing;  Salma, the name of two Israelites:—Salma.

H8008.definition: שַׂלְמָה salmâh, sal-maw'; transp. for H8071;  a dress:—clothes, garment, raiment.

H8009.definition: שַׂלְמָה Salmâh, sal-maw'; the same as H8008; clothing;  Salmah, an Israelite:—Salmon. Compare H8012.

H801.definition: אִשָּׁה ʼishshâh, ish-shaw'; the same as H800, but used in a liturgical sense;  properly, a burnt-offering; but occasionally of any sacrifice:—(offering, sacrifice), (made) by fire.

H8010.definition: שְׁלֹמֹה Shᵉlômôh, shel-o-mo'; from H7965; peaceful;  Shelomah, David's successor:—Solomon.

H8013.definition: שְׁלֹמוֹת Shᵉlômôwth, shel-o-moth'; feminine plural of H7965; pacifications;  Shelomoth, the name of two Israelites:—Shelomith (from the margin), Shelomoth. Compare H8019.

H8017.definition: שְׁלֻמִיאֵל Shᵉlumîyʼêl, shel-oo-mee-ale'; from H7965 and H410; peace of God;  Shelumiel, an Israelite:—Shelumiel.

H8018.definition: שֶׁלֶמְיָה Shelemyâh, shel-em-yaw'; or שֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ Shelemyâhûw; from H8002 and H3050; thank-offering of Jah;  Shelemjah, the name of nine Israelites:—Shelemiah.

H8019.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper masculine noun
H8019.definition: שְׁלֹמִית Shᵉlômîyth, shel-o-meeth'; or שׁלוֹמִית Shlôwmîyth; (Ezra 8:10), from H7965; peaceableness;  Shelomith, the name of five Israelites and three Israelitesses:—Shelomith.

H802.definition: אִשָּׁה ʼishshâh, ish-shaw'; feminine of H376 or H582; irregular plural, נָשִׁים nâshîym;(used in the same wide sense as H582)  a woman:—(adulter) ess, each, every, female, × many,   none, one,   together, wife, woman. Often unexpressed in English.

H8022.definition: שַׁלְמַנְאֶסֶר Shalmanʼeçer, shal-man-eh'-ser; of foreign derivation;  Shalmaneser, an Assyrian king:—Shalmaneser. Compare H8020.

H8025.definition: שָׁלַף shâlaph, saw-laf'; a primitive root;  to pull out, up or off:—draw (off), grow up, pluck off.

H8026.definition: שֶׁלֶף sheleph, sheh'-lef; from H8025; extract;  Sheleph, a son of Jokthan:—Sheleph.

H8027.definition: שָׁלַשׁ shâlash, shaw-lash'; a primitive root perhaps originally to intensify, i.e. treble; but apparently used only as denominative from H7969,  to be (causatively, make) triplicate (by restoration, in portions, strands, days or years):—do the third time, (divide into, stay) three (days, -fold, parts, years old).

H8028.definition: שֶׁלֶשׁ Shelesh, sheh'-lesh; from H8027; triplet;  Shelesh, an Israelite:—Shelesh.

H8030.definition: שִׁלְשָׁה Shilshâh, shil-shaw'; feminine from the same as H8028; triplication;  Shilshah, an Israelite:—Shilshah.

H8032.definition: שִׁלְשׁוֹם shilshôwm, shil-shome'; or שִׁלְשֹׁם shilshôm; from the same as H8028;  trebly, i.e. (in time) day before yesterday:—  before (that time, -time), excellent things (from the margin),   heretofore, three days,   time past.

H8033.definition: שָׁם shâm, shawm; a primitive particle (rather from the relative pronoun, H834);  there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence:—in it,   thence, there (-in,   of,   out),   thither,   whither.

H8034.definition: שֵׁם shêm, shame; a primitive word [perhaps rather from H7760 through the idea of definite and conspicuous position; compare H8064];  an appellation, as a mark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character:—+ base, (in-) fame(-ous), named(-d), renown, report.

H8035.definition: שֵׁם Shêm, shame; the same as H8034; name;  Shem, a son of Noah (often includ. his posterity):—Sem, Shem.

H8036.definition: שֻׁם shum, shoom; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8034:—name.

H8037.definition: שַׁמָּא Shammâʼ, sham-maw'; from H8074; desolation;  Shamma, an Israelite:—Shamma.

H8039.definition: שִׁמְאָה Shimʼâh, shim-aw'; perhaps for H8093;  Shimah, an Israelite:—Shimah. Compare H8043.

H804.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H804.definition: אַשּׁוּר ʼAshshûwr, ash-shoor'; or אַשֻּׁר ʼAshshur; apparently from H833 (in the sense of successful);  Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire:—Asshur, Assur, Assyria, Assyrians. See H838.

H8040.definition: שְׂמֹאול sᵉmôʼwl, sem-ole'; or שְׂמֹאל sᵉmôʼl; a primitive word (rather perhaps from the same as H8071 (by insertion of the aleph) through the idea of wrapping up);  properly, dark (as enveloped), i.e. the north; hence (by orientation), the left hand:—left (hand, side).

H8043.definition: שִׁמְאָם Shimʼâm, shim-awm'; for H8039 (compare H38);  Shimam, an Israelite:—Shimeam.

H8044.definition: שַׁמְגַּר Shamgar, sham-gar'; of uncertain derivation;  Shamgar, an Israelite judge:—Shamgar.

H8045.definition: שָׁמַד shâmad, shaw-mad'; a primitive root;  to desolate:—destory(-uction), bring to nought, overthrow, perish, pluck down, × utterly.

H8047.definition: שַׁמָּה shammâh, sham-maw'; from H8074;  ruin; by implication, consternation:—astonishment, desolate(-ion), waste, wonderful thing.

H8048.definition: שַׁמָּה Shammâh, sham-maw'; the same as H8047;  Shammah, the name of an Edomite and four Israelites:—Shammah.

H8049.definition: שַׁמְהוּת Shamhûwth, sham-hooth'; for H8048; desolation;  Shamhuth, an Israelite:—Shamhuth.

H8050.definition: שְׁמוּאֵל Shᵉmûwʼêl, sehm-oo-ale'; from the passive participle of H8085 and H410; heard of God;  Shemuël, the name of three Israelites:—Samuel, Shemuel.

H8051.definition: שַׁמּוּעַ Shammûwaʻ, sham-moo'-ah; from H8074; renowned;  Shammua, the name of four Israelites:—Shammua, Shammuah.

H8052.definition: שְׁמוּעָה shᵉmûwʻâh, shem-oo-aw'; feminine passive participle of H8074;  something heard, i.e. an announcement:—bruit, doctrine, fame, mentioned, news, report, rumor, tidings.

H8053.definition: שָׁמוּר Shâmûwr, shaw-moor'; passive participle of H8103; observed;  Shamur, an Israelite:—Shamir (from the margin).

H8054.definition: שַׁמּוֹת Shammôwth, sham-moth'; plural of H8047; ruins;  Shammoth, an Israelite:—Shamoth.

H8055.definition: שָׂמַח sâmach, saw-makh'; a primitive root;  probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome:—cheer up, be (make) glad, (have, make) joy(-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to) rejoice, × very.

H8056.definition: שָׂמֵחַ sâmêach, saw-may'-akh; from H8055;  blithe or gleeful:—(be) glad, joyful, (making) merry((-hearted), -ily), rejoice(-ing).

H8057.definition: שִׂמְחָה simchâh, sim-khaw'; from H8056;  blithesomeness or glee, (religious or festival):—× exceeding(-ly), gladness, joy(-fulness), mirth, pleasure, rejoice(-ing).

H8058.definition: שָׁמַט shâmaṭ, shaw-mat'; a primitive root;  to fling down; incipiently to jostle; figuratively, to let alone, desist, remit:—discontinue, overthrow, release, let rest, shake, stumble, throw down.

H8059.definition: שְׁמִטָּה shᵉmiṭṭâh, shem-it-taw'; from H8058;  remission (of debt) or suspension of labor):—release.

H806.definition: אַשְׁחוּר ʼAshchûwr, ash-khoor'; probably from H7835; black;  Ashchur, an Israelite:—Ashur.

H8060.definition: שַׁמַּי Shammay, sham-mah'-ee; from H8073; destructive;  Shammai, the name of three Israelites:—Shammai.

H8064.definition: שָׁמַיִם shâmayim, shaw-mah'-yim; dual of an unused singular שָׁמֶה shâmeh; from an unused root meaning to be lofty;  the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve):—air, × astrologer, heaven(-s).

H8065.definition: שָׁמַיִן shâmayin, shaw-mah'-yin; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8064:—heaven.

H8068.definition: שָׁמִיר shâmîyr, shaw-meer'; from H8104 in the original sense of pricking;  a thorn; also (from its keenness for scratching) a gem, probably the diamond:—adamant (stone), brier, diamond.

H8069.definition: שָׁמִיר Shâmîyr, shaw-meer'; the same as H8068;  Shamir, the name of two places in Palestine:—Shamir. Compare H8053.

H807.definition: אַשִׁימָא ʼAshîymâʼ, ash-ee-maw'; of foreign origin;  Ashima, a deity of Hamath:—Ashima.

H8070.definition: שְׁמִירָמוֹת Shᵉmîyrâmôwth, shem-ee-raw-moth'; or שְׁמָרִימוֹת Shᵉmârîymôwth; probably from H8034 and plural of H7413; name of heights;  Shemiramoth, the name of two Israelites:—Shemiramoth.

H8071.definition: שִׂמְלָה simlâh, sim-law'; perhaps by permutation for the feminine of H5566 (through the idea of a cover assuming the shape of the object beneath);  a dress, especially a mantle:—apparel, cloth(-es, -ing), garment, raiment. Compare H8008.

H8072.definition: שַׂמְלָה Samlâh, sam-law'; probably for the same as H8071;  Samlah, an Edomite:—Samlah.

H8074.definition: שָׁמֵם shâmêm, shaw-mame'; a primitive root;  to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense):—make amazed, be astonied, (be an) astonish(-ment), (be, bring into, unto, lay, lie, make) desolate(-ion, places), be destitute, destroy (self), (lay, lie, make) waste, wonder.

H8077.definition: שְׁמָמָה shᵉmâmâh, shem-aw-maw'; or שִׁמָמָה shimâmâh; feminine of H8076;  devastation; figuratively, astonishment:—(laid, × most) desolate(-ion), waste.

H8080.definition: שָׁמַן shâman, shaw-man'; a primitive root;  to shine, i.e. (by analogy) be (causatively, make) oily or gross:—become (make, wax) fat.

H8081.definition: שֶׁמֶן shemen, sheh'-men; from H8080;  grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness:—anointing, × fat (things), × fruitful, oil(-ed), ointment, olive,   pine.

H8082.definition: שָׁמֵן shâmên, shaw-mane'; from H8080;  greasy, i.e. gross; figuratively, rich:—fat, lusty, plenteous.

H8083.definition: שְׁמֹנֶה shᵉmôneh, shem-o-neh'; or שְׁמוֹנֶה shᵉmôwneh; feminine שְׁמֹנָה shᵉmônâh; or שְׁמוֹנָה shᵉmôwnâh; apparently from H8082 through the idea of plumpness;  a cardinal number, eight (as if a surplus above the 'perfect' seven); also (as ordinal) eighth:—eight(-een, -eenth), eighth.

H8084.definition: שְׁמֹנִים shᵉmônîym, shem-o-neem'; or שְׁמוֹנִים shᵉmôwnîym; multiple from H8083;  eighty, also eightieth:—eighty(-ieth), fourscore.

H8085.definition: שָׁמַע shâmaʻ, shaw-mah'; a primitive root;  to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.):—× attentively, call (gather) together, × carefully, × certainly, consent, consider, be content, declare, × diligently, discern, give ear, (cause to, let, make to) hear(-ken, tell), × indeed, listen, make (a) noise, (be) obedient, obey, perceive, (make a) proclaim(-ation), publish, regard, report, shew (forth), (make a) sound, × surely, tell, understand, whosoever (heareth), witness.

H8086.definition: שְׁמַע shᵉmaʻ, shem-ah'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8085:—hear, obey.

H8087.definition: שֶׁמַע Shemaʻ, sheh'-mah; for the same as H8088;  Shema, the name of a place in Palestine and of four Israelites:—Shema.

H8088.definition: שֵׁמַע shêmaʻ, shay'-mah; from H8085;  something heard, i.e. a sound, rumor, announcement; abstractly, audience:—bruit, fame, hear(-ing), loud, report, speech, tidings.

H809.definition: אֲשִׁישָׁה ʼăshîyshâh, ash-ee-shaw'; feminine of H808;  something closely pressed together, i.e. a cake of raisins or other comfits:—flagon.

H8091.definition: שָׁמָע Shâmâʻ, shaw-maw'; from H8085; obedient;  Shama, an Israelite:—Shama.

H8092.definition: שִׁמְעָא Shimʻâʼ, shim-aw'; for H8093;  Shima, the name of four Israelites:—Shimea, Shimei, Shamma.

H8095.definition: שִׁמְעוֹן Shimʻôwn, shim-one'; from H8085; hearing;  Shimon, one of Jacob's sons, also the tribe descended from him:—Simeon.

H8096.definition: שִׁמְעִי Shimʻîy, shim-ee'; from H8088; famous;  Shimi, the name of twenty Israelites:—Shimeah (from the margin), Shimei, Shimhi, Shimi.

H8098.definition: שְׁמַעְיָה Shᵉmaʻyâh, shem-aw-yaw'; or שְׁמַעְיָהוּ Shᵉmaʻyâhûw; from H8085 and H3050; Jah has heard;  Shemajah, the name of twenty-five Israelites:—Shemaiah.

H81.definition: אֲבָקָה ʼăbâqâh, ab-aw-kaw'; feminine of H80:—powder.

H810.definition: אֶשֶׁךְ ʼeshek, eh'-shek; from an unused root (probably meaning to bunch together);  a testicle (as a lump):—stone.

H8104.definition: שָׁמַר shâmar, shaw-mar'; a primitive root;  properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.:—beward, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep(-er, self), mark, look narrowly, observe, preserve, regard, reserve, save (self), sure, (that lay) wait (for), watch(-man).

H811.definition: אֶשְׁכּוֹל ʼeshkôwl, esh-kole'; or אֶשְׁכֹּל ʼeshkôl; probably prolonged from H810;  a bunch of grapes or other fruit:—cluster (of grapes).

H8111.definition: שֹׁמְרוֹן Shômᵉrôwn, sho-mer-one'; from the active participle of H8104; watch-station;  Shomeron, a place in Palestine:—Samaria.

H8113.definition: שִׁמְרִי Shimrîy, shim-ree'; from H8105 in its original sense; watchful;  Shimri, the name of four Israelites:—Shimri.

H8114.definition: שְׁמַרְיָה Shᵉmaryâh, shem-ar-yaw'; or שְׁמַרְיָהוּ Shᵉmaryâhûw; from H8104 and H3050; Jah has guarded;  Shemarjah, the name of four Israelites:—Shamariah, Shemariah.

H812.definition: אֶשְׁכֹּל ʼEshkôl, esh-kole'; the same as H811;  Eshcol, the name of an Amorite, also of a valley in Palestine:—Eshcol.

H8121.definition: שֶׁמֶשׁ shemesh, sheh'-mesh; from an unused root meaning to be brilliant;  the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement:—  east side(-ward), sun (rising),   west(-ward), window. See also H1053.

H8123.definition: שִׁמְשׁוֹן Shimshôwn, shim-shone'; from H8121; sunlight;  Shimshon, an Israelite:—Samson.

H8125.definition: שַׁמְשְׁרַי Shamshᵉray, sham-sher-ah'-ee; apparently from H8121; sunlike;  Shamsherai, an Israelite:—Shamsherai.

H8127.definition: שֵׁן shên, shane; from H8150; compare H8143  a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff:—crag, × forefront, ivory, × sharp, tooth.

H8128.definition: שֵׁן shên, shane; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8127;  a tooth:—tooth.

H813.definition: אַשְׁכְּנַז ʼAshkᵉnaz, ash-ken-az'; of foreign origin;  Ashkenaz, a Japhethite, also his descendants:—Ashkenaz.

H8130.definition: שָׂנֵא sânêʼ, saw-nay'; a primitive root;  to hate (personally):—enemy, foe, (be) hate(-ful, -r), odious, × utterly.

H8132.definition: שָׁנָא shânâʼ, shaw-naw'; a primitive root;  to alter:—change.

H8133.definition: שְׁנָא shᵉnâʼ, shen-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8132:—alter, change, (be) diverse.

H8134.definition: שִׁנְאָב Shinʼâb, shin-awb'; probably from H8132 and H1; a father has turned;  Shinab, a Canaanite:—Shinab.

H8135.definition: שִׂנְאָה sinʼâh, sin-aw'; from H8130;  hate:—  exceedingly, hate(-ful, -red).

H8137.definition: שֶׁנְאַצַּר Shenʼatstsar, shen-ats-tsar'; apparently of Babylonian origin;  Shenatstsar, an Israelite:—Senazar.

H8138.definition: שָׁנָה shânâh, shaw-naw'; a primitive root;  to fold, i.e. duplicate (literally or figuratively); by implication, to transmute (transitive or intransitive):—do (speak, strike) again, alter, double, (be given to) change, disguise, (be) diverse, pervert, prefer, repeat, return, do the second time.

H814.definition: אֶשְׁכָּר ʼeshkâr, esh-cawr'; for H7939;  a gratuity:—gift, present.

H8140.definition: שְׁנָה shᵉnâh, shen-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8141:—year.

H8141.definition: שָׁנֶה shâneh, shaw-neh'; (in plural or (feminine) שָׁנָה shânâh; from H8138;  a year (as a revolution of time):—  whole age, × long,   old, year(× -ly).

H8142.definition: שֵׁנָה shênâh, shay-naw'; or שֵׁנָא shênâʼ; (Psalm 127:2), from H3462;  sleep:—sleep.

H8143.definition: שֶׁנְהַבִּים shenhabbîym, shen-hab-beem'; from H8127 and the plural apparently of a foreign word;  probably, tooth of elephants, i.e. ivory tusk:—ivory.

H8145.definition: שֵׁנִי shênîy, shay-nee'; from H8138;  properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again:—again, either (of them), (an-) other, second (time).

H8147.definition: שְׁנַיִם shᵉnayim, shen-ah'-yim; dual of H8145; feminine שְׁתַּיִם shᵉttayim;  two; also (as ordinal) twofold:—both, couple, double, second, twain,   twelfth,   twelve,   twenty (sixscore) thousand, twice, two.

H815.definition: אֵשֶׁל ʼêshel, ay'-shel; from a root of uncertain signification;  a tamarisk tree; by extension, a grove of any kind:—grove, tree.

H8150.definition: שָׁנַן shânan, shaw-nan'; a primitive root;  to point (transitive or intransitive); intensively, to pierce; figuratively, to inculcate:—prick, sharp(-en), teach diligently, whet.

H8152.definition: שִׁנְעָר Shinʻâr, shin-awr'; probably of foreign derivation;  Shinar, a plain in Babylonia:—Shinar.

H8153.definition: שְׁנָת shᵉnâth, shen-awth'; from H3462;  sleep:—sleep.

H8154.definition: שָׁסָה shâçâh, shaw-saw'; or שָׁשָׂה shâsâh; (Isaiah 10:13), a primitive root;  to plunder:—destroyer, rob, spoil(-er).

H8155.definition: שָׁסַס shâçaç, shaw-sas'; a primitive root;  to plunder:—rifle, spoil.

H8156.definition: שָׁסַע shâçaʻ, shaw-sah'; a primitive root;  to split or tear; figuratively, to upbraid:—cleave, (be) cloven (footed), rend, stay.
