H8159.definition: שָׁעָה shâʻâh, shaw-aw'; a primitive root;  to gaze at or about (properly, for help); by implication, to inspect, consider, compassionate, be nonplussed (as looking around in amazement) or bewildered:—depart, be dim, be dismayed, look (away), regard, have respect, spare, turn.

H816.definition: אָשַׁם ʼâsham, aw-sham'; or אָשֵׁם ʼâshêm; a primitive root;  to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish:—× certainly, be(-come, made) desolate, destroy, × greatly, be(-come, found, hold) guilty, offend (acknowledge offence), trespass.

H8160.definition: שָׁעָה shâʻâh, shaw-aw'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H8159;  properly, a look, i.e. a moment:—hour.

H8162.definition: שַׁעַטְנֵז shaʻaṭnêz, shah-at-naze'; probably of foreign derivation;  linsey-woolsey, i.e. cloth of linen and wool carded and spun together:—garment of divers sorts, linen and wollen.

H8163.definition: שָׂעִיר sâʻîyr, saw-eer'; or שָׂעִר sâʻir; from H8175;  shaggy; as noun, a he-goat; by analogy, a faun:—devil, goat, hairy, kid, rough, satyr.

H8165.partOfSpeech: proper masculine noun, proper noun with reference to a mountain, proper noun with reference to territory
H8165.definition: שֵׂעִיר Sêʻîyr, say-eer'; formed like H8163; rough;  Seir, a mountain of Idumaea and its aboriginal occupants, also one in Palestine:—Seir.

H817.definition: אָשָׁם ʼâshâm, aw-shawm'; from H816;  guilt; by implication, a fault; also a sin-offering:—guiltiness, (offering for) sin, trespass (offering).

H8172.definition: שָׁעַן shâʻan, shaw-an'; a primitive root;  to support one's self:—lean, lie, rely, rest (on, self), stay.

H8174.definition: שַׁעַף Shaʻaph, shah'-af; from H5586; fluctuation;  Shaaph, the name of two Israelites:—Shaaph.

H8178.definition: שַׂעַר saʻar, sah'-ar; from H8175;  a terror:—affrighted, × horribly, × sore, storm. See H8181.

H8179.definition: שַׁעַר shaʻar, shah'-ar; from H8176 in its original sense;  an opening, i.e. door or gate:—city, door, gate, port (× -er).

H818.definition: אָשֵׁם ʼâshêm, aw-shame'; from H816;  guilty; hence, presenting a sin-offering:—one which is faulty, guilty.

H8181.definition: שֵׂעָר sêʻâr, say-awr'; or שַׂעַר saʻar; (Isaiah 7:20), from H8175 in the sense of dishevelling;  hair (as if tossed or bristling):—hair(-y), × rough.

H8184.definition: שְׂעֹרָה sᵉʻôrâh, seh-o-raw'; or שְׂעוֹרָה sᵉʻôwrâh (feminine meaning the plant); and (masculine meaning the grain); also שְׂעֹר sᵉʻôr; or שְׂעוֹר sᵉʻôwr; from H8175 in the sense of roughness;  barley (as villose):—barley.

H8186.definition: שַׁעֲרוּרָה shaʻărûwrâh, shah-ar-oo-raw'; or שַׁעֲרִירִיָּה shaʻărîyrîyâh; or שַׁעֲרֻרִת shaʻărurith; feminine from H8176 in the sense of H8175;  something fearful:—horrible thing.

H8187.definition: שְׁעַרְיָה Shᵉʻaryâh, sheh-ar-yaw'; from H8176 and H3050; Jah has stormed;  Shearjah, an Israelite:—Sheariah.

H819.definition: אַשְׁמָה ʼashmâh, ash-maw'; feminine of H817;  guiltiness, a fault, the presentation of a sin-offering:—offend, sin, (cause of) trespass(-ing, offering).

H8192.definition: שָׁפָה shâphâh, shaw-faw'; a primitive root;  to abrade, i.e. bare:—high, stick out.

H8193.definition: שָׂפָה sâphâh, saw-faw'; or (in dual and plural) שֶׂפֶת sepheth; probably from H5595 or H8192 through the idea of termination (compare H5490);  the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.):—band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, (sea-)shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words.

H8195.definition: שְׁפוֹ Shᵉphôw, shef-o'; or שְׁפִי Shᵉphîy; from H8192; baldness (compare H8205);  Shepho or Shephi, an Idumaean:—Shephi, Shepho.

H8196.definition: שְׁפוֹט shᵉphôwṭ, shef-ote'; or שְׁפוּט shᵉphûwṭ; from H8199;  a judicial sentence, i.e. punishment:—judgment.

H8197.definition: שְׁפוּפָם Shᵉphûwphâm, shef-oo-fawm'; or שְׁפוּפָן Shᵉphûwphân; from the same as H8207; serpent-like;  Shephupham, an Israelite:—Shephuphan, Shupham.

H8198.definition: שִׁפְחָה shiphchâh, shif-khaw'; feminine from an unused root meaning to spread out (as a family; see H4940);  a female slave (as a member of the household):—(bond-, hand-) maid(-en, -servant), wench, bondwoman, womanservant.

H8199.definition: שָׁפַט shâphaṭ, shaw-fat'; a primitive root;  to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively):—  avenge, × that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge(-ment), × needs, plead, reason, rule.

H82.definition: אָבַר ʼâbar, aw-bar'; a primitive root;  to soar:—fly.

H8200.definition: שְׁפַט shᵉphaṭ, shef-at'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8199;  to judge:—magistrate.

H8201.definition: שֶׁפֶט shepheṭ, sheh'-fet; from H8199;  a sentence, i.e. infliction:—judgment.

H8202.definition: שָׁפָט Shâphâṭ, shaw-fawt'; from H8199; judge;  Shaphat, the name of four Israelites:—Shaphat.

H8203.definition: שְׁפַטְיָה Shᵉphaṭyâh, shef-at-yaw'; or שְׁפַטְיָהוּ Shᵉphaṭyâhûw; from H8199 and H3050; Jah has judged;  Shephatjah, the name of ten Israelites:—Shephatiah.

H8205.definition: שְׁפִי shᵉphîy, shef-ee'; from H8192;  bareness; concretely, a bare hill or plain:—high place, stick out.

H8206.definition: שֻׁפִּים Shuppîym, shoop-peem'; plural of an unused noun from the same as H8207 and meaning the same; serpents;  Shuppim, an Israelite:—Shuppim.

H821.definition: אַשְׁמֻרָה ʼashmurâh, ash-moo-raw'; or אַשׁמוּרָה ʼashmûwrâh; or אַשׁמֹרֶת ʼashmôreth; (feminine) from H8104;  a night watch:—watch.

H8210.definition: שָׁפַךְ shâphak, shaw-fak'; a primitive root;  to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out:—cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.

H8213.definition: שָׁפֵל shâphêl, shaw-fale'; a primitive root;  to depress or sink (especially figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive):—abase, bring (cast, put) down, debase, humble (self), be (bring, lay, make, put) low(-er).

H8214.definition: שְׁפַל shᵉphal, shef-al'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8213:—abase, humble, put down, subdue.

H8216.definition: שֶׁפֶל shephel, shay'-fel; from H8213;  an humble rank:—low estate (place).

H8217.definition: שָׁפָל shâphâl, shaw-fawl'; from H8213;  depressed, literally or figuratively:—base(-st), humble, low(-er, -ly).

H8227.definition: שָׁפָן shâphân, shaw-fawn'; from H8226;  a species of rock-rabbit (from its hiding), i.e. probably the hyrax:—coney.

H8232.definition: שְׁפַר shᵉphar, shef-ar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8231;  to be beautiful:—be acceptable, please,   think good.

H8233.definition: שֶׁפֶר shepher, sheh'-fer; from H8231;  beauty:—× goodly.

H8234.partOfSpeech: proper noun with reference to a mountain
H8234.definition: שֶׁפֶר Shepher, sheh'-fer; the same as H8233;  Shepher, a place in the Desert:—Shapper.

H8236.definition: שִׁפְרָה Shiphrâh, shif-raw'; the same as H8235;  Shiphrah, an Israelitess:—Shiphrah.

H8239.definition: שָׁפַת shâphath, shaw-fath'; a primitive root;  to locate, i.e. (generally) hang on or (figuratively) establish, reduce:—bring, ordain, set on.

H8240.definition: שָׁפָת shâphâth, shaw-fawth'; from H8239;  a (double) stall (for cattle); also a (two-pronged) hook (for flaying animals on):—hook, pot.

H8242.definition: שַׂק saq, sak; from H8264;  properly, a mesh (as allowing a liquid to run through), i.e. coarse loose cloth or sacking (used in mourning and for bagging); hence, a bag (for grain, etc.):—sack(-cloth, -clothes).

H8245.definition: שָׁקַד shâqad, shaw-kad'; a primitive root;  to be alert, i.e. sleepless; hence to be on the lookout (whether for good or ill):—hasten, remain, wake, watch (for).

H8246.definition: שָׁקַד shâqad, shaw-kad'; a denominative from H8247;  to be (intensively, make) almond-shaped:—make like (unto, after the fashion of) almonds.

H8247.definition: שָׁקֵד shâqêd, shaw-kade'; from H8245;  the almond (tree or nut; as being the earliest in bloom):—almond (tree).

H8248.definition: שָׁקָה shâqâh, shaw-kaw'; a primitive root;  to quaff, i.e. (causatively) to irrigate or furnish a potion to:—cause to (give, give to, let, make to) drink, drown, moisten, water. See H7937, H8354.

H8251.definition: שִׁקּוּץ shiqqûwts, shik-koots'; or שִׁקֻּץ shiqquts; from H8262;  disgusting, i.e. filthy; especially idolatrous or (concretely) an idol:—abominable filth (idol, -ation), detestable (thing).

H8252.definition: שָׁקַט shâqaṭ, shaw-kat'; a primitive root;  to repose (usually figurative):—appease, idleness, (at, be at, be in, give) quiet(-ness), (be at, be in, give, have, take) rest, settle, be still.

H8254.definition: שָׁקַל shâqal, shaw-kal'; a primitive root;  to suspend or poise (especially in trade):—pay, receive(-r), spend, × throughly, weigh.

H8255.definition: שֶׁקֶל sheqel, sheh'-kel; from H8254;  probably a weight; used as a commercial standard:—shekel.

H8256.definition: שִׁקְמָה shiqmâh, shik-maw'; or (feminine) שִׁקְמָה shiqmâh; of uncertain derivation;  a sycamore (usually the tree):—sycamore (fruit, tree).

H8257.definition: שָׁקַע shâqaʻ, shaw-kah'; (abbreviated Amos 8:8); a primitive root;  to subside; by implication, to be overflowed, cease; causatively, to abate, subdue:—make deep, let down, drown, quench, sink.

H8259.definition: שָׁקַף shâqaph, shaw-kaf'; a primitive root;  properly, to lean out (of a window), i.e. (by implication) peep or gaze (passively, be a spectacle):—appear, look (down, forth, out).

H826.definition: אַשָּׁף ʼashshâph, ash-shawf'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H825:—astrologer.

H8262.definition: שָׁקַץ shâqats, shaw-kats'; a primitive root;  to be filthy, i.e. (intensively) to loathe, pollute:—abhor, make abominable, have in abomination, detest, × utterly.

H8263.definition: שֶׁקֶץ sheqets, sheh'-kets; from H8262;  filth, i.e. (figuratively and specifically) an idolatrous object:—abominable(-tion).

H8266.definition: שָׁקַר shâqar, shaw-kar'; a primitive root;  to cheat, i.e. be untrue (usually in words):—fail, deal falsely, lie.

H8267.definition: שֶׁקֶר sheqer, sheh'-ker; from H8266;  an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial):—without a cause, deceit(-ful), false(-hood, -ly), feignedly, liar,   lie, lying, vain (thing), wrongfully.

H8268.definition: שֹׁקֶת shôqeth, sho'-keth; from H8248;  a trough (for watering):—trough.

H8269.definition: שַׂר sar, sar; from H8323;  a head person (of any rank or class):—captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord,(-task-)master, prince(-ipal), ruler, steward.

H827.definition: אַשְׁפָּה ʼashpâh, ash-paw'; perhaps (feminine) from the same as H825 (in the sense of covering);  a quiver or arrow-case:—quiver.

H8270.definition: שֹׁר shôr, shore; from H8324; (compare H8306)  a string (as twisted), i.e. (specifically) the umbilical cord (also figuratively, as the centre of strength):—navel.

H8271.definition: שְׁרֵא shᵉrêʼ, sher-ay'; (Aramaic) a root corresponding to that of H8293;  to free, separate; figuratively, to unravel, commence; by implication (of unloading beasts) to reside:—begin, dissolve, dwell, loose.

H8272.definition: שַׁרְאֶצֶר Sharʼetser, shar-eh'-tser; of foreign derivation;  Sharetser, the name of an Assyrian and an Israelite:—Sharezer.

H8274.definition: שֵׁרֵבְיָה Shêrêbᵉyâh, shay-rayb-yaw'; from H8273 and H3050; Jah has brought heat;  Sherebjah, the name of two Israelites:—Sherebiah.

H8275.definition: שַׁרְבִיט sharbîyṭ, shar-beet'; for H7626;  a rod of empire:—sceptre.

H8276.definition: שָׂרַג sârag, saw-rag'; a primitive root;  to intwine:—wrap together, wreath.

H828.definition: אַשְׁפְּנַז ʼAshpᵉnaz, ash-pen-az'; of foreign origin;  Ashpenaz, a Babylonian eunuch:—Ashpenaz.

H8281.definition: שָׁרָה shârâh, shaw-raw'; a primitive root;  to free:—direct.

H8282.definition: שָׂרָה sârâh, saw-raw'; feminine of H8269;  a mistress, i.e. female noble:—lady, princess, queen.

H8283.definition: שָׂרָה Sârâh, saw-raw'; the same as H8282;  Sarah, Abraham's wife:—Sarah.

H8285.definition: שֵׁרָה shêrâh, shay-raw'; from H8324 in its original sense of pressing;  a wrist-band (as compact or clasping):—bracelet.

H8286.definition: שְׂרוּג Sᵉrûwg, ser-oog'; from H8276; tendril;  Serug, a postdiluvian patriarch:—Serug.

H8288.definition: שְׂרוֹךְ sᵉrôwk, ser-oke'; from H8308;  a thong (as laced or tied):—(shoe-)latchet.

H8289.definition: שָׁרוֹן Shârôwn, shaw-rone'; probably abridged from H3474; plain;  Sharon, the name of a place in Palestine:—Lasharon, Sharon.

H8294.definition: שֶׂרַח Serach, seh'-rakh; by permutation for H5629; superfluity;  Serach, an Israelitess:—Sarah, Serah.

H8295.definition: שָׂרַט sâraṭ, saw-rat'; a primitive root;  to gash:—cut in pieces, make [cuttings] pieces.

H8297.definition: שָׂרַי Sâray, saw-rah'-ee; from H8269; dominative;  Sarai, the wife of Abraham:—Sarai.

H8298.definition: שָׁרַי Shâray, shaw-rah'-ee; probably from H8324; hostile;  Sharay, an Israelite:—Sharai.

H8299.definition: שָׂרִיג sârîyg, saw-reeg'; from H8276;  a tendril (as entwining):—branch.

H83.definition: אֵבֶר ʼêber, ay-ber'; from H82;  a pinion:—(long-) wing(-ed).

H830.definition: אַשְׁפֹּת ʼashpôth, ash-pohth'; or אַשְׁפּוֹת ʼashpôwth; or שְׁפֹת shᵉphôth; (contraction) plural of a noun of the same form as H827, from H8192 (in the sense of scraping);  a heap of rubbish or filth:—dung (hill).

H8300.definition: שָׂרִיד sârîyd, saw-reed'; from H8277;  a survivor:—× alive, left, remain(-ing), remnant, rest.

H8303.partOfSpeech: proper noun with reference to a mountain
H8303.definition: שִׁרְיוֹן Shiryôwn, shir-yone'; and שִׂרְיֹן Siryôn; the same as H8302 (i.e. sheeted with snow);  Shirjon or Sirjon, a peak of the Lebanon:—Sirion.

H8304.definition: שְׂרָיָה Sᵉrâyâh, ser-aw-yaw'; or שְׂרָיָהוּ Sᵉrâyâhûw; from H8280 and H3050; Jah has prevailed;  Serajah, the name of nine Israelites:—Seraiah.

H831.definition: אַשְׁקְלוֹן ʼAshqᵉlôwn, ash-kel-one'; probably from H8254 in the sense of weighing-place (i.e. mart);  Ashkelon, a place in Palestine:—Ashkelon, Askalon.

H8312.definition: שַׂרְעַף sarʻaph, sar-af'; for H5587;  cogitation:—thought.

H8313.definition: שָׂרַף sâraph, saw-raf'; a primitive root;  to be (causatively, set) on fire:—(cause to, make a) burn((-ing), up) kindle, × utterly.

H8314.definition: שָׂרָף sârâph, saw-rawf'; from H8313;  burning, i.e. (figuratively) poisonous (serpent); specifically, a saraph or symbolical creature (from their copper color):—fiery (serpent), seraph.

H8315.definition: שָׂרָף Sârâph, saw-raf'; the same as H8314;  Saraph, an Israelite:—Saraph.

H8316.definition: שְׂרֵפָה sᵉrêphâh, ser-ay-faw'; from H8313;  cremation:—burning.

H8317.definition: שָׁרַץ shârats, shaw-rats'; a primitive root;  to wriggle, i.e. (by implication) swarm or abound:—breed (bring forth, increase) abundantly (in abundance), creep, move.

H8318.definition: שֶׁרֶץ sherets, sheh'-rets; from H8317;  a swarm, i.e. active mass of minute animals:—creep(-ing thing), move(-ing creature).

H8319.definition: שָׁרַק shâraq, shaw-rak'; a primitive root;  properly, to be shrill, i.e. to whistle or hiss (as a call or in scorn):—hiss.

H8320.definition: שָׂרֻק sâruq, saw-rook'; from H8319;  bright red (as piercing to the sight), i.e. bay:—speckled. See H8291.

H8321.definition: שֹׂרֵק sôrêq, so-rake'; or שׂוֹרֵק sôwrêq; and (feminine) שֹׂרֵקָה sôrêqâh; from H8319 in the sense of redness (compare H8320);  a vine stock (properly, one yielding purple grapes, the richest variety):—choice(-st, noble) wine. Compare H8291.

H8323.definition: שָׂרַר sârar, saw-rar'; a primitive root;  to have (transitively, exercise; reflexively, get) dominion:—× altogether, make self a prince, (bear) rule.

H8327.definition: שָׁרַשׁ shârash, shaw-rash'; a primitive root;  to root, i.e. strike into the soil, or (by implication) to pluck from it:—(take, cause to take) root (out).

H8328.definition: שֶׁרֶשׁ sheresh, sheh'-resh; from H8327;  a root (literally or figuratively):—bottom, deep, heel, root.

H833.definition: אָשַׁר ʼâshar, aw-shar'; or אָשֵׁר ʼâshêr; a primitive root;  to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively, to go forward, be honest, prosper:—(call, be) bless(-ed, happy), go, guide, lead, relieve.

H8330.definition: שֹׁרֶשׁ shôresh, sho'-resh; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8328:—root.

H8331.definition: שַׁרְשָׁה sharshâh, shar-shaw'; from H8327;  a chain (as rooted, i.e. linked):—chain. Compare H8333.

H8333.definition: שַׁרְשְׁרָה sharshᵉrâh, shar-sher-aw'; from H8327 (compare H8331);  a chain; (architectural) probably a garland:—chain.

H8334.definition: שָׁרַת shârath, shaw-rath'; a primitive root;  to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively, to contribute to:—minister (unto), (do) serve(-ant, -ice, -itor), wait on.

H8336.definition: שֵׁשׁ shêsh, shaysh; or (for alliteration with H4897) שְׁשִׁי shᵉshîy; for H7893;  bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or (by analogy) marble:—× blue, fine (twined) linen, marble, silk.

H8337.definition: שֵׁשׁ shêsh, shaysh; masculine שִׁשָּׁה shishshâh; a primitive number; see H7797  six (as an overplus beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ordinal sixth:—six(-teen, -teenth), sixth.

H8338.definition: שָׁשָׁא shâshâʼ, shaw-shaw'; a primitive root; apparently,  to annihilate:—leave by the sixth part (by confusion with H8341).

H8339.definition: שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר Shêshᵉbatstsar, shaysh-bats-tsar'; of foreign derivation;  Sheshbatstsar, Zerubbabel's Persian name:—Sheshbazzar.

H834.definition: אֲשֶׁר ʼăsher, ash-er'; a primitive relative pronoun (of every gender and number);  who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.:—× after, × alike, as (soon as), because, × every, for, + forasmuch, + from whence, + how(-soever), × if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), × though, + until, + whatsoever, when, where (+ -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, + whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

H8340.definition: שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר Shêshᵉbatstsar, shaysh-bats-tsar'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8339:—Sheshbazzar.

H8342.definition: שָׂשׂוֹן sâsôwn, saw-sone'; or שָׂשֹׂן sâsôn; from H7797;  cheerfulness; specifically, welcome:—gladness, joy, mirth, rejoicing.

H8343.definition: שָׁשַׁי Shâshay, shaw-shah'-ee; perhaps from H8336; whitish;  Shashai, an Israelite:—Shashai.

H8344.definition: שֵׁשַׁי Shêshay, shay-shah'-ee; probably for H8343;  Sheshai, a Canaanite:—Sheshai.

H8345.definition: שִׁשִּׁי shishshîy, shish-shee'; from H8337;  sixth, ordinal or (feminine) fractional:—sixth (part).

H8346.definition: שִׁשִּׁים shishshîym, shish-sheem'; multiple of H8337;  sixty:—sixty, three score.

H8348.definition: שֵׁשָׁן Shêshân, shay-shawn'; perhaps for H7799; lily;  Sheshan, an Israelite:—Sheshan.

H8349.definition: שָׁשַׁק Shâshaq, shaw-shak'; probably from the base of H7785; pedestrian;  Shashak, an Israelite:—Shashak.

H835.definition: אֶשֶׁר ʼesher, eh'-sher; from H833;  happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!:—blessed, happy.

H8352.definition: שֵׁת Shêth, shayth; from H7896; put, i.e. substituted;  Sheth, third son of Adam:—Seth, Sheth.

H8353.definition: שֵׁת shêth, shayth; (Aramaic) or שִׁת shith; (Aramaic), corresponding to H8337;:—six(-th).

H8354.definition: שָׁתָה shâthâh, shaw-thaw'; a primitive root;  to imbibe (literally or figuratively):—× assuredly, banquet, × certainly, drink(-er, -ing), drunk (× -ard), surely. (Intensive proposition of H8248.)

H8355.definition: שְׁתָה shᵉthâh, sheth-aw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8354:—drink.

H836.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H836.definition: אָשֵׁר ʼÂshêr, aw-share'; from H833, happy;  Asher, a son of Jacob, and the tribe descended from him, with its territory; also a place in Palestine:—Asher

H8362.definition: שָׁתַל shâthal, shaw-thal'; a primitive root;  to transplant:—plant.

H8366.definition: שָׁתַן shâthan, shaw-than'; a primitive root;  (causatively) to make water, i.e. urinate:—piss.

H8368.definition: שָׂתַר sâthar, saw-thar'; a primitive root;  to break out (as an eruption):—have in (one's) secret parts.

H8369.definition: שֵׁתָר Shêthâr, shay-thawr'; of foreign derivation;  Shethar, a Persian satrap:—Shethar.

H837.definition: אֹשֶׁר ʼôsher, o'-sher; from H833;  happiness:—happy.

H8370.definition: שְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי Shᵉthar Bôwzᵉnay, sheth-ar' bo-zen-ah'-ee; of foreign derivation;  Shethar-Bozenai, a Persian officer:—Shetharboznai.

H8378.definition: תַּאֲוָה taʼăvâh, tah-av-aw'; from H183 (abbreviated);  a longing; by implication, a delight (subjectively, satisfaction, objectively, a charm):—dainty, desire, × exceedingly, × greedily, lust(ing), pleasant. See also H6914.

H8382.definition: תָּאַם tâʼam, taw-am'; a primitive root; to be complete; but used only as denominative from H8380,  to be (causatively, make) twinned, i.e. (figuratively) duplicate or (architectural) jointed:—coupled (together), bear twins.

H8384.definition: תְּאֵן tᵉʼên, teh-ane'; or (in the singular, feminine) תְּאֵנָה tᵉʼênâh; perhaps of foreign derivation  the fig (tree or fruit):—fig (tree).

H8386.definition: תַּאֲנִיָּה taʼănîyâh, tah-an-ee-yaw'; from H578;  lamentation:—heaviness, mourning.

H8389.definition: תֹּאַר tôʼar, to'-ar; from H8388;  outline, i.e. figure or appearance:—  beautiful, × comely, countenance,   fair, × favoured, form, × goodly, × resemble, visage.

H8390.definition: תַּאֲרֵעַ Taʼărêaʻ, tah-ar-ay'-ah; perhaps from H772;  Taarea, an Israelite:—Tarea. See H8475.

H8392.definition: תֵּבָה têbâh, tay-baw'; perhaps of foreign derivation;  a box:—ark.

H8393.definition: תְּבוּאָה tᵉbûwʼâh, teb-oo-aw'; from H935;  income, i.e. produce (literally or figuratively):—fruit, gain, increase, revenue.

H8394.definition: תָּבוּן tâbûwn, taw-boon'; and (feminine) תְּבוּנָה tᵉbûwnâh; or תּוֹבֻנָה tôwbunâh; from H995;  intelligence; by implication, an argument; by extension, caprice:—discretion, reason, skilfulness, understanding, wisdom.

H8396.definition: תָּבוֹר Tâbôwr, taw-bore'; from a root corresponding to H8406; broken region;  Tabor, a mountain in Palestine, also a city adjacent:—Tabor.

H8398.definition: תֵּבֵל têbêl, tay-bale'; from H2986;  the earth (as moist and therefore inhabited); by extension, the globe; by implication, its inhabitants; specifically, a particular land, as Babylonia, Palestine:—habitable part, world.

H8401.definition: תֶּבֶן teben, teh'-ben; probably from H1129;  properly, material, i.e. (specifically) refuse haum or stalks of grain (as chopped in threshing and used for fodder):—chaff, straw, stubble.

H8402.definition: תִּבְנִי Tibnîy, tib-nee'; from H8401; strawy;  Tibni, an Israelite:—Tibni.

H8403.definition: תַּבְנִית tabnîyth, tab-neeth'; from H1129;  structure; by implication, a model, resemblance:—figure, form, likeness, pattern, similitude.

H8404.definition: תַּבְעֵרָה Tabʻêrâh, tab-ay-raw'; from H1197; burning;  Taberah, a place in the Desert:—Taberah.

H8407.definition: תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר Tiglath Pilʼeçer, tig-lath' pil-eh'-ser; or תִּגְלַת פְּלֶסֶר Tiglath Pᵉleçer; or תִּלְגַּת פִּלְנְאֶסֶר Tilgath Pilnᵉʼeçer or תִּלְגַּת פִּלְנֶסֶר Tilgath Pilneçer; of foreign derivation;  Tiglath-Pileser or Tilgath-pilneser, an Assyryrian king:—Tiglath-pileser, Tilgath-pilneser.

H8411.definition: תְּדִירָא tᵉdîyrâʼ, ted-ee-raw'; (Aramaic) from H1753 in the original sense of enduring;  permanence, i.e. (adverb) constantly:—continually.

H8412.definition: תַּדְמֹר Tadmôr, tad-more'; or תַּמֹּר Tammôr; (1 Kings 9:18), apparently from H8558; palm-city;  Tadmor, a place near Palestine:—Tadmor.

H8414.definition: תֹּהוּ tôhûw, to'-hoo; from an unused root meaning to lie waste;  a desolation (of surface), i.e. desert; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain:—confusion, empty place, without form, nothing, (thing of) nought, vain, vanity, waste, wilderness.

H8415.definition: תְּהוֹם tᵉhôwm, teh-home'; or תְּהֹם tᵉhôm; (usually feminine) from H1949;  an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean watersupply):—deep (place), depth.

H8416.definition: תְּהִלָּה tᵉhillâh, teh-hil-law'; from H1984;  laudation; specifically (concretely) a hymn:—praise.

H8417.definition: תׇּהֳלָה tohŏlâh, to-hol-aw'; feminine of an unused noun (apparently from H1984) meaning bluster;  braggadocio, i.e. (by implication) fatuity:—folly.

H8419.definition: תַּהְפֻּכָה tahpukâh, tah-poo-kaw'; from H2015;  a perversity or fraud:—(very) froward(-ness, thing), perverse thing.

H8421.definition: תּוּב tûwb, toob; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7725, to come back;  specifically (transitive and elliptical) to reply:—answer, restore, return (an answer).

H8422.definition: תּוּבַל Tûwbal, too-bal'; or תֻּבַל Tubal; probably of foreign derivation;  Tubal, a postdiluvian patriarch and his posterity:—Tubal.

H8426.definition: תּוֹדָה tôwdâh, to-daw'; from H3034;  properly, an extension of the hand, i.e. (by implication) avowal, or (usually) adoration; specifically, a choir of worshippers:—confession, (sacrifice of) praise, thanks(-giving, offering).

H8431.definition: תּוֹחֶלֶת tôwcheleth, to-kheh'-leth; from H3176;  expectation:—hope.

H8432.definition: תָּוֶךְ tâvek, taw'-vek; from an unused root meaning to sever;  a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre:—among(-st), × between, half, × (there-, where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), × out (of), × through, × with(-in).

H8433.definition: תּוֹכֵחָה tôwkêchâh, to-kay-khaw'; and תּוֹכַחַת tôwkachath; from H3198;  chastisement; figuratively (by words) correction, refutation, proof (even in defence):—argument, × chastened, correction, reasoning, rebuke, reproof, × be (often) reproved.

H8434.definition: תּוֹלָד Tôwlâd, to-lawd'; from H3205; posterity;  Tolad, a place in Palestine:—Tolad. Compare H513.

H8438.definition: תּוֹלָע tôwlâʻ, to-law'; and (feminine) תּוֹלֵעָה tôwlêʻâh; or תּוֹלַעַת tôwlaʻath; or תֹּלַעַת tôlaʻath; from H3216;  a maggot (as voracious); specifically (often with ellipsis of H8144) the crimson-grub, but used only (in this connection) of the color from it, and cloths dyed therewith:—crimson, scarlet, worm.

H8439.definition: תּוֹלָע Tôwlâʻ, to-law'; the same as H8438; worm;  Tola, the name of two Israelites:—Tola.

H8441.definition: תּוֹעֵבַה tôwʻêbah, to-ay-baw'; or תֹּעֵבַה tôʻêbah; feminine active participle of H8581;  properly, something disgusting (morally), i.e. (as noun) an abhorrence; especially idolatry or (concretely) an idol:—abominable (custom, thing), abomination.

H8442.definition: תּוֹעָה tôwʻâh, to-aw'; feminine active participle of H8582;  mistake, i.e. (morally) impiety, or (political) injury:—error, hinder.

H8444.definition: תּוֹצָאָה tôwtsâʼâh, to-tsaw-aw'; or תֹּצָאָה tôtsâʼâh; from H3318;  (only in plural collective) exit, i.e. (geographical) boundary, or (figuratively) deliverance, (actively) source:—border(-s), going(-s) forth (out), issues, outgoings.

H8447.definition: תּוֹר tôwr, tore; or תֹּר tôr; from H8446;  a succession, i.e. a string or (abstractly) order:—border, row, turn.

H8449.definition: תּוֹר tôwr, tore; or תֹּר tôr; probably the same as H8447;  a ring-dove, often (figuratively) as a term of endearment:—(turtle) dove.

H8450.definition: תּוֹר tôwr, tore; (Aramaic) corresponding (by permutation) to H7794;  a bull:—bullock, ox.

H8451.definition: תּוֹרָה tôwrâh, to-raw'; or תֹּרָה tôrâh; from H3384;  a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch:—law.

H8454.definition: תּוּשִׁיָּה tûwshîyâh, too-shee-yaw'; or תֻּשִׁיָּה tushîyâh; from an unused root probably meaning to substantiate;  support or (by implication) ability, i.e. (direct) help, (in purpose) an undertaking, (intellectual) understanding:—enterprise, that which (thing as it) is, substance, (sound) wisdom, working.

H8455.definition: תּוֹתָח tôwthâch, to-thawkh'; from an unused root meaning to smite;  a club:—darts.

H8456.definition: תָּזַז tâzaz, taw-zaz'; a primitive root;  to lop off:—cut down.

H8458.definition: תַּחְבֻּלָה tachbulâh, takh-boo-law'; or תַּחְבּוּלָה tachbûwlâh; from H2254 as denominative from H2256;  (only in plural) properly, steerage (as a management of ropes), i.e. (figuratively) guidance or (by implication) a plan:—good advice, (wise) counsels.

H846.definition: אֻשַּׁרְנָא ʼushsharnâʼ, oosh-ar-naw'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H833;  a wall (from its uprightness):—wall.

H8460.definition: תְּחוֹת tᵉchôwth, tekh-oth'; (Aramaic) or תּחֹת tchôth; (Aramaic), corresponding to H8478;  beneath:—under.

H8462.definition: תְּחִלָּה tᵉchillâh, tekh-il-law'; from H2490 in the sense of opening;  a commencement; relatively original (adverb, -ly):—begin(-ning), first (time).

H8463.definition: תַּחֲלוּא tachălûwʼ, takh-al-oo'; or תַּחֲלֻא tachăluʼ; from H2456;  a malady:—disease, × grievous, (that are) sick(-ness).

H8465.definition: תַּחַן Tachan, takh'-an; probably from H2583; station;  Tachan, the name of two Israelites:—Tahan.

H8467.definition: תְּחִנָּה tᵉchinnâh, tekh-in-naw'; from H2603;  graciousness; causatively, entreaty:—favour, grace, supplication.

H847.definition: אֶשְׁתָּאֹל ʼEshtâʼôl, esh-taw-ole'; or אֶשְׁתָּאוֹל ʼEshtâʼôwl; probably from H7592; intreaty;  Eshtaol, a place in Palestine:—Eshtaol.

H8471.definition: תַּחְפַּנְחֵס Tachpanchêç, takh-pan-khace'; or תְּחַפְנְחֵס Tᵉchaphnᵉchêç; (Ezekiel 30:18), or תַּחְפְּנֵס Tachpᵉnêç; (Jeremiah 2:16), of Egyptian derivation;  Tachpanches, Techaphneches or Tachpenes, a place in Egypt:—Tahapanes, Tahpanhes, Tehaphnehes.

H8475.definition: תַּחְרֵעַ Tachrêaʻ, takh-ray'-ah; for H8390;  Tachrea, an Israelite:—Tahrea.

H8478.partOfSpeech: proper patrial adjective, accusative adverb, masculine noun
H8478.definition: תַּחַת tachath, takh'-ath; from the same as H8430;  the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.:—as, beneath, × flat, in(-stead), (same) place (where...is), room, for...sake, stead of, under, × unto, × when...was mine, whereas, (where-) fore, with.

H8480.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H8480.definition: תַּחַת Tachath, takh'-ath; the same as H8478;  Tachath, the name of a place in the Desert, also of three Israelites:—Tahath.

H8482.definition: תַּחְתִּי tachtîy, takh-tee'; from H8478;  lowermost; as noun (feminine plural) the depths (figuratively, a pit, the womb):—low (parts, -er, -er parts, -est), nether (part).

H8484.definition: תִּיכוֹן tîykôwn, tee-kone'; or תִּיכֹן tîykôn; from H8432;  central:—middle(-most), midst.

H8485.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H8485.definition: תֵּימָא Têymâʼ, tay-maw'; or תֵּמָא Têmâʼ; probably of foreign derivation;  Tema, a son of Ishmael, and the region settled by him:—Tema.

H8486.definition: תֵּימָן têymân, tay-mawn'; or תֵּמָן têmân; denominative from H3225;  the south (as being on the right hand of a person facing the east):—south (side, -ward, wind).

H8487.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H8487.definition: תֵּימָן Têymân, tay-mawn'; or תֵּמָן Têmân; the same as H8486;  Teman, the name of two Edomites, and of the region and descendant of one of them:—south, Teman.

H8488.definition: תֵּימְנִי Têymᵉnîy, tay-men-ee'; probably for H8489;  Temeni, an Israelite:—Temeni.

H849.definition: אֶשְׁתַּדּוּר ʼeshtaddûwr, esh-tad-dure'; (Aramaic) from H7712 (in a bad sense);  rebellion:—sedition.

H8492.definition: תִּירוֹשׁ tîyrôwsh, tee-roshe'; or תִּירֹשׁ tîyrôsh; from H3423 in the sense of expulsion;  must or fresh grape-juice (as just squeezed out); by implication (rarely) fermented wine:—(new, sweet) wine.

H8493.definition: תִּירְיָא Tîyrᵉyâʼ, tee-reh-yaw'; probably from H3372;  fearful, Tirja, an Israelite:—Tiria.

H8495.definition: תַּיִשׁ tayish, tah'-yeesh; from an unused root meaning to butt;  a buck or he-goat (as given to butting):—he goat.

H85.definition: אַבְרָהָם ʼAbrâhâm, ab-raw-hawm'; contracted from H1 and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous); father of a multitude;  Abraham, the later name of Abram:—Abraham.

H850.definition: אֶשְׁתּוֹן ʼEshtôwn, esh-tone'; probably from the same as H7764; restful;  Eshton, an Israelite:—Eshton.

H8502.definition: תִּכְלָה tiklâh, tik-law'; from H3615;  completeness:—perfection.

H8503.definition: תַּכְלִית taklîyth, tak-leeth'; from H3615;  completion; by implication, an extremity:—end, perfect(-ion).

H8504.definition: תְּכֵלֶת tᵉkêleth, tek-ay'-leth; probably for H7827;  the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color (violet) obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith:—blue.

H8505.definition: תָּכַן tâkan, taw-kan'; a primitive root;  to balance, i.e. measure out (by weight or dimension); figuratively to arrange, equalize, through the idea of levelling (ment, estimate, test):—bear up, direct, be (un-)equal, mete, ponder, tell, weigh.

H8506.definition: תֹּכֶן tôken, to'-ken; from H8505;  a fixed quantity:—measure, tale.

H8507.definition: תֹּכֶן Tôken, to'-ken; the same as H8506;  Token, a place in Palestine:—Tochen.

H851.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H851.definition: אֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ ʼEshtᵉmôaʻ, esh-tem-o'-ah; or אֶשְׁתְּמוֹעַ ʼEshtᵉmôwaʻ; or אֶשְׁתְּמֹה ʼEshtᵉmôh; from H8085 (in the sense of obedience);  Eshtemoa or Eshtemoh, a place in Palestine:—Eshtemoa, Eshtemoh.

H8511.definition: תָּלָא tâlâʼ, taw-law'; a primitive root;  to suspend; figuratively (through hesitation) to be uncertain; by implication (of mental dependence) to habituate:—be bent, hang (in doubt).

H8517.definition: תְּלַג tᵉlag, tel-ag'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H7950;  snow:—snow.

H8518.definition: תָּלָה tâlâh, taw-law'; a primitive root;  to suspend (especially to gibbet):—hang (up).

H852.definition: אָת ʼâth, awth; (Aramaic) corresponding to H226;  a portent:—sign.

H8520.definition: תֶּלַח Telach, teh'-lakh; probably from an unused root meaning to dissever; breach;  Telach, an Israelite:—Telah.

H8521.definition: תֵּל חַרְשָׁא Têl Charshâʼ, tale khar-shaw'; from H8510 and the feminine of H2798; mound of workmanship;  Tel-Charsha, a place in Babylonia:—Tel-haresha, Tel-harsa.

H8523.definition: תְּלִיתַי tᵉlîythay, tel-ee-thah'-ee; (Aramaic) or תַּלְתִּי taltîy; (Aramaic), ordinal from H8532;  third:—third.

H8524.definition: תָּלַל tâlal, taw-lal'; a primitive root;  to pile up, i.e. elevate:—eminent. Compare H2048.

H853.definition: אֵת ʼêth, ayth; apparent contracted from H226 in the demonstrative sense of entity;  properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely):—[as such unrepresented in English].

H8532.definition: תְּלָת tᵉlâth, tel-awth'; (Aramaic) masculine תְּלָתָה tᵉlâthâh; (Aramaic), or תְּלָתָא tᵉlâthâʼ; (Aramaic), corresponding to H7969;  three or third:—third, three.

H8533.definition: תְּלָתִין tᵉlâthîyn, tel-aw-theen'; (Aramaic) multiple of H8532;  ten times three:—thirty.

H8535.definition: תָּם tâm, tawm; from H8552;  complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear:—coupled together, perfect, plain, undefiled, upright.

H8536.definition: תָּם tâm, tawm; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8033;  there:—× thence, there, × where.

H8537.definition: תֹּם tôm, tome; from H8552;  completeness; figuratively, prosperity; usually (morally) innocence:—full, integrity, perfect(-ion), simplicity, upright(-ly, -ness), at a venture. See H8550.

H8539.definition: תָּמַהּ tâmahh, taw-mah'; a primitive root;  to be in consternation:—be amazed, be astonished, marvel(-lously), wonder.

H854.definition: אֵת ʼêth, ayth; probably from H579;  properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.:—against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

H8543.definition: תְּמוֹל tᵉmôwl, tem-ole'; or תְּמֹל tᵉmôl; probably for H865; sometimes with H8032  properly, ago, i.e. a (short or long) time since; especially yesterday, or day before yesterday:—  before (-time),   these (three) days,   heretofore,   time past, yesterday.

H8544.definition: תְּמוּנָה tᵉmûwnâh, tem-oo-naw'; or תְּמֻנָה tᵉmunâh; from H4327;  something portioned (i.e. fashioned) out, as a shape, i.e. (indefinitely) phantom, or (specifically) embodiment, or (figuratively) manifestation (of favor):—image, likeness, similitude.

H8548.definition: תָּמִיד tâmîyd, taw-meed'; from an unused root meaning to stretch;  properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); elliptically the regular (daily) sacrifice:—alway(-s), continual (employment, -ly), daily, (n-)ever(-more), perpetual.

H8549.definition: תָּמִים tâmîym, taw-meem'; from H8552;  entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth:—without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefiled, upright(-ly), whole.

H8551.definition: תָּמַךְ tâmak, taw-mak'; a primitive root;  to sustain; by implication, to obtain, keep fast; figuratively, to help, follow close:—(take, up-) hold (up), maintain, retain, stay (up).

H8552.definition: תָּמַם tâmam, taw-mam'; a primitive root;  to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive:—accomplish, cease, be clean (pass-) ed, consume, have done, (come to an, have an, make an) end, fail, come to the full, be all gone, × be all here, be (make) perfect, be spent, sum, be (shew self) upright, be wasted, whole.

H8553.definition: תִּמְנָה Timnâh, tim-naw'; from H4487; a portion assigned;  Timnah, the name of two places in Palestine:—Timnah, Timnath, Thimnathah.

H8555.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper masculine noun
H8555.definition: תִּמְנָע Timnâʻ, tim-naw'; from H4513; restraint;  Timna, the name of two Edomites:—Timna, Timnah.

H8556.definition: תִּמְנַת חֶרֶס Timnath Chereç, tim-nath kheh'-res; or תִּמְנַת סֶרַח Timnath Çerach; from H8553 and H2775; portion of (the) sun;  Timnath-Cheres, a place in Palestine:—Timnath-heres, Timnath-serah.

H8558.definition: תָּמָר tâmâr, taw-mawr'; from an unused root meaning to be erect;  a palm tree:—palm (tree).

H8559.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper locative noun
H8559.definition: תָּמָר Tâmâr, taw-mawr'; the same as H8558;  Tamar, the name of three women and a place:—Tamar.

H8561.definition: תִּמֹּר timmôr, tim-more'; (plural or (feminine) תִּמֹּרָה timmôrâh; (singular and plural), from the same root as H8558;  (architectural) a palm-like pilaster (i.e. umbellate):—palm tree.

H8563.definition: תַּמְרוּר tamrûwr, tam-roor'; from H4843;  bitterness (plural as collective):—× most bitter(-ly).

H8565.definition: תַּן tan, tan; from an unused root probably meaning to elongate;  a monster (as preternaturally formed), i.e. a sea-serpent (or other huge marine animal); also a jackal (or other hideous land animal):—dragon, whale. Compare H8577.

H8569.definition: תְּנוּאָה tᵉnûwʼâh, ten-oo-aw'; from H5106;  alienation; by implication, enmity:—breach of promise, occasion.

H857.definition: אָתָה ʼâthâh, aw-thaw'; or אָתָא ʼâthâʼ; a primitive root (collateral to H225 contraction);  to arrive:—(be-, things to) come (upon), bring.

H8570.definition: תְּנוּבָה tᵉnûwbâh, ten-oo-baw'; from H5107;  produce:—fruit, increase.

H8571.definition: תְּנוּךְ tᵉnûwk, ten-ook'; perhaps from the same as H594 through the idea of protraction;  a pinnacle, i.e. extremity:—tip.

H8572.definition: תְּנוּמָה tᵉnûwmâh, ten-oo-maw'; from H5123;  drowsiness, i.e. sleep:—slumber(-ing).

H8573.definition: תְּנוּפָה tᵉnûwphâh, ten-oo-faw'; from H5130;  a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings:—offering, shaking, wave (offering).

H8574.definition: תַּנּוּר tannûwr, tan-noor'; from H5216;  a fire-pot:—furnace, oven.

H8577.definition: תַּנִּין tannîyn, tan-neen'; or תַּנִּים tannîym; (Ezekiel 29:3), intensive from the same as H8565;  a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal:—dragon, sea-monster, serpent, whale.

H8579.definition: תִּנְיָנוּת tinyânûwth, tin-yaw-nooth'; (Aramaic) from H8578;  a second time:—again.

H858.definition: אָתָה ʼâthâh, aw-thaw'; (Aramaic) or אָתָא ʼâthâʼ; (Aramaic), corresponding to H857:—(be-) come, bring.

H8580.definition: תַּנְשֶׁמֶת tanshemeth, tan-sheh'-meth; from H5395;  properly, a hard breather, i.e. the name of two unclean creatures, a lizard and a bird (both perhaps from changing color through their irascibility), probably the tree-toad and the water-hen:—mole, swan.

H8581.definition: תַּעָב taʻâb, taw-ab'; a primitive root;  to loathe, i.e. (morally) detest:—(make to be) abhor(-red), (be, commit more, do) abominable(-y), × utterly.

H8582.definition: תָּעָה tâʻâh, taw-aw'; a primitive root;  to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray (literally or figuratively); also causative of both:—(cause to) go astray, deceive, dissemble, (cause to, make to) err, pant, seduce, (make to) stagger, (cause to) wander, be out of the way.

H8583.definition: תֹּעוּ Tôʻûw, to'-oo; or תֹּעִי Tôʻîy; from H8582; error  Tou or Toi, a Syrian king:—Toi, Tou.

H8585.definition: תְּעָלָה tᵉʻâlâh, teh-aw-law'; from H5927;  a channel (into which water is raised for irrigation); also a bandage or plaster (as placed upon a wound):—conduit, cured, healing, little river, trench, watercourse.

H859.definition: אַתָּה ʼattâh, at-taw'; or (shortened); אַתָּ ʼattâ; or אַת ʼath; feminine (irregular) sometimes אַתִּי ʼattîy; plural masculine אַתֶּם ʼattem; feminine אַתֶּן ʼatten; or אַתֵּנָה ʼattênâhlemma אתֵּנָה missing vowel, corrected to אַתֵּנָה; or אַתֵּנָּה ʼattênnâh; a primitive pronoun of the second person;  thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you:—thee, thou, ye, you.

H8590.definition: תַּעֲנָךְ Taʻănâk, tah-an-awk'; or תַּעְנָךְ Taʻnâk; of uncertain derivation;  Taanak or Tanak, a place in Palestine:—Taanach, Tanach.

H8593.definition: תַּעַר taʻar, tah'-ar; from H6168;  a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare, i.e. empty):—(pen-) knife, razor, scabbard, shave, sheath.

H8596.definition: תֹּף tôph, tofe; from H8608 contracted;  a tambourine:—tabret, timbrel.

H8597.definition: תִּפְאָרָה tiphʼârâh, tif-aw-raw'; or תִּפְאֶרֶת tiphʼereth; from H6286;  ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively):—beauty(-iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory(-ious), honour, majesty.

H8598.definition: תַּפּוּחַ tappûwach, tap-poo'-akh; from H5301;  an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.):—apple (tree). See also H1054.

H8599.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H8599.definition: תַּפּוּחַ Tappûwach, tap-poo'-akh; the same as H8598;  Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite:—Tappuah.

H860.definition: אָתוֹן ʼâthôwn, aw-thone'; probably from the same as H386 (in the sense of patience);  a female donkey (from its docility):—(she) ass.

H8602.definition: תָּפֵל tâphêl, taw-fale'; from an unused root meaning to smear;  plaster (as gummy) or slime; (figuratively) frivolity:—foolish things, unsavoury, untempered.

H8604.definition: תִּפְלָה tiphlâh, tif-law'; from the same as H8602;  frivolity:—folly, foolishly.

H8605.definition: תְּפִלָּה tᵉphillâh, tef-il-law'; from H6419;  intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn:—prayer.

H8607.definition: תִּפְסַח Tiphçach, tif-sakh'; from H6452; ford;  Tiphsach, a place in Mesopotamia:—Tipsah.

H8608.definition: תָּפַף tâphaph, taw-faf'; a primitive root;  to drum, i.e. play (as) on the tambourine:—taber, play with timbrels.

H8609.definition: תָּפַר tâphar, taw-far'; a primitive root;  to sew:—(women that) sew (together).

H861.definition: אַתּוּן ʼattûwn, at-toon'; (Aramaic) probably from the corresponding to H784;  probably a fire-place, i.e. furnace:—furnace.

H8610.definition: תָּפַשׂ tâphas, taw-fas'; a primitive root;  to manipulate, i.e. seize; chiefly to capture, wield, specifically, to overlay; figuratively, to use unwarrantably:—catch, handle, (lay, take) hold (on, over), stop, × surely, surprise, take.

H8612.definition: תֹּפֶת Tôpheth, to'-feth; the same as H8611;  Topheth, a place near Jerusalem:—Tophet, Topheth.

H8615.definition: תִּקְוָה tiqvâh, tik-vaw'; from H6960; (compare H6961)  literally a cord (as an attachment); figuratively, expectancy:—expectation(-ted), hope, live, thing that I long for.

H862.definition: אַתּוּק ʼattûwq, at-tooke'; or אַתִּיק ʼattîyq; from H5423 in the sense of decreasing;  a ledge or offset in a building:—gallery.

H8620.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H8620.definition: תְּקוֹעַ Tᵉqôwaʻ, tek-o'-ah; a form of H8619;  Tekoa, a place in Palestine:—Tekoa, Tekoah.

H8622.definition: תְּקוּפָה tᵉqûwphâh, tek-oo-faw'; or תְּקֻפָה tᵉquphâh; from H5362;  a revolution, i.e. (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse:—circuit, come about, end.

H8624.definition: תַּקִּיף taqqîyph, tak-keef'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8623:—mighty, strong.

H8628.definition: תָּקַע tâqaʻ, taw-kah'; a primitive root;  to clatter, i.e. slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy, to drive (a nail or tent-pin, a dart, etc.); by implication, to become bondsman by handclasping):—blow (a trumpet), cast, clap, fasten, pitch (tent), smite, sound, strike, × suretiship, thrust.

H8629.definition: תֵּקַע têqaʻ, tay-kah'; from H8628;  a blast of a trumpet:—sound.

H863.definition: אִתַּי ʼIttay, it-tah'ee; or אִיתַי ʼÎythay; from H854; near;  Ittai or Ithai, the name of a Gittite and of an Israelite:—Ithai, Ittai.

H8630.definition: תָּקַף tâqaph, taw-kaf'; a primitive root;  to overpower:—prevail (against).

H8631.definition: תְּקֵף tᵉqêph, tek-afe'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8630;  to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate:—make firm, harden, be(-come) strong.

H8633.definition: תֹּקֶף tôqeph, to'-kef; from H8630;  might or (figuratively) positiveness:—authority, power, strength.

H8639.definition: תַּרְדֵּמָה tardêmâh, tar-day-maw'; from H7290;  a lethargy or (by implication) trance:—deep sleep.

H8640.definition: תִּרְהָקָה Tirhâqâh, teer-haw'-kaw; of foreign derivation;  Tirhakah, a king of Kush:—Tirhakah.

H8641.definition: תְּרוּמָה tᵉrûwmâh, ter-oo-maw'; or תְּרֻמָה tᵉrumâh; (Deuteronomy 12:11), from H7311;  a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute:—gift, heave offering (shoulder), oblation, offered(-ing).

H8643.definition: תְּרוּעָה tᵉrûwʻâh, ter-oo-aw'; from H7321;  clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangor of trumpets, as an alarum:—alarm, blow(-ing) (of, the) (trumpets), joy, jubile, loud noise, rejoicing, shout(-ing), (high, joyful) sound(-ing).

H8646.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H8646.definition: תֶּרַח Terach, teh'-rakh; of uncertain derivation;  Terach, the father of Abraham; also a place in the Desert:—Tarah, Terah.

H8648.definition: תְּרֵין tᵉrêyn, ter-ane'; (Aramaic) feminine תַּרְתֵּין tartêyn; corresponding to H8147;  two:—second,   twelve, two.

H865.definition: אֶתְמוֹל ʼethmôwl, eth-mole'; or אִתְמוֹל ʼithmôwl; or אֶתְמוּל ʼethmûwl; probably from H853 or H854 and H4136;  heretofore; definitely yesterday:—  before (that) time,   heretofore, of late (old),   times past, yester(day).

H8651.definition: תְּרַע tᵉraʻ, ter-ah'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H8179;  a door; by implication, a palace:—gate mouth.

H8652.definition: תָּרָע târâʻ, taw-raw'; (Aramaic) from H8651;  a doorkeeper:—porter.

H8656.partOfSpeech: proper feminine noun, proper locative noun
H8656.definition: תִּרְצָה Tirtsâh, teer-tsaw'; from H7521; delightsomeness;  Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess:—Tirzah.

H8658.definition: תַּרְשִׁישׁ tarshîysh, tar-sheesh'; probably of foreign derivation (compare H8659);  a gem, perhaps the topaz:—beryl.

H8659.partOfSpeech: proper locative noun, proper masculine noun
H8659.definition: תַּרְשִׁישׁ Tarshîysh, tar-sheesh'; probably the same as H8658 (as the region of the stone, or the reverse);  Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite:—Tarshish, Tharshish.

H8661.definition: תַּרְתָּן Tartân, tar-tawn'; of foreign derivation;  Tartan, an Assyrian:—Tartan.

H8665.definition: תַּשְׁבֵּץ tashbêts, tash-bates'; from H7660;  checkered stuff (as reticulated):—broidered.

H8668.definition: תְּשׁוּעָה tᵉshûwʻâh, tesh-oo-aw'; or תְּשֻׁעָה tᵉshuʻâh; from H7768 in the sense of H3467;  rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual):—deliverance, help, safety, salvation, victory.

H8670.definition: תְּשׁוּרָה tᵉshûwrâh, tesh-oo-raw'; from H7788 in the sense of arrival;  a gift:—present.

H8672.definition: תֵּשַׁע têshaʻ, tay'-shah; or (masculine) תִּשְׁעָה tishʻâh; perhaps from H8159 through the idea of a turn to the next or full number ten;  nine or (ordinal) ninth:—nine (+ -teen, + -teenth, -th).

H8673.definition: תִּשְׁעִים tishʻîym, tish-eem'; multiple from H8672;  ninety:—ninety.

H8674.definition: תַּתְּנַי Tattᵉnay, tat-ten-ah'-ee; of foreign derivation;  Tattenai, a Persian:—Tatnai.

H868.definition: אֶתְנַן ʼethnan, eth-nan'; the same as H866;  a gift (as the price of harlotry or idolatry):—hire, reward.

H87.definition: אַבְרָם ʼAbrâm, ab-rawm'; contracted from H48; high father;  Abram, the original name of Abraham:—Abram.

H870.definition: אֲתַר ʼăthar, ath-ar'; (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of H871;  a place; (adverb) after:—after, place.

H874.definition: בָּאַר bâʼar, baw-ar'; a primitive root;  to dig; by analogy, to engrave; figuratively, to explain:—declare, (make) plain(-ly).

H875.definition: בְּאֵר bᵉʼêr, be-ayr'; from H874;  a pit; especially a well:—pit, well.

H877.definition: בֹּאר bôʼr, bore; from H874;  a cistern:—cistern.

H880.definition: בְּאֵרָה Bᵉʼêrâh, be-ay-raw'; the same as H878;  Beerah, an Israelite:—Beerah.

H883.definition: בְּאֵר לַחַי רֹאִי Bᵉʼêr la-Chay Rôʼîy, be-ayr' lakh-ah'ee ro-ee'; from H875 and H2416 (with prefix) and H7203; well of a living (One) my Seer;  Beer-Lachai-Roi, a place in the Desert:—Beer-lahai-roi.

H884.definition: בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע Bᵉʼêr Shebaʻ, be-ayr' sheh'-bah; from H875 and H7651 (in the sense of H7650); well of an oath;  Beer-Sheba, a place in Palestine:—Beer-shebah.

H887.definition: בָּאַשׁ bâʼash, baw-ash'; a primitive root;  to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally:—(make to) be abhorred (had in abomination, loathsome, odious), (cause a, make to) stink(-ing savour), × utterly.

H888.definition: בְּאֵשׁ bᵉʼêsh, be-aysh'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H887:—displease.

H891.definition: בְּאֻשִׁים bᵉʼushîym, be-oo-sheem'; plural of H889;  poison-berries:—wild grapes.

H893.definition: בֵּבַי Bêbay, bay-bah'ee; probably of foreign origin;  Bebai, an Israelite:—Bebai.

H894.definition: בָּבֶל Bâbel, baw-bel'; from H1101; confusion;  Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire:—Babel, Babylon.

H895.definition: בַּבֶל Babel, baw-bel'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H894:—Babylon.

H898.definition: בָּגַד bâgad, baw-gad'; a primitive root;  to cover (with a garment); figuratively, to act covertly; by implication, to pillage:—deal deceitfully (treacherously, unfaithfully), offend, transgress(-or), (depart), treacherous (dealer, -ly, man), unfaithful(-ly, man), × very.

H899.definition: בֶּגֶד beged, behg'-ed; from H898;  a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage:—apparel, cloth(-es, ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, × very (treacherously), vesture, wardrobe.

H9.definition: אֲבֵדָה ʼăbêdâh, ab-ay-daw'; from H6; Compare H10.  concrete, something lost; abstract, destruction, i.e. Hades:—lost.

H90.definition: אֲגַג ʼĂgag, ag-ag'; or אֲגָג ʼĂgâg; of uncertain derivation (compare H89); flame;  Agag, a title of Amalekitish kings:—Agag.

H900.definition: בֹּגְדוֹת bôgᵉdôwth, bohg-ed-ohth; feminine plural active participle of H898;  treacheries:—treacherous.

H902.definition: בִּגְוַי Bigvay, big-vah'ee; probably of foreign origin;  Bigvai, an Israelite:—Bigvai.

H903.definition: בִּגְתָא Bigthâʼ, big-thaw'; of Persian derivation;  Bigtha, a eunuch of Xerxes:—Bigtha.

H904.definition: בִּגְתָן Bigthân, big-thawn'; or בִּגְתָנָא Bigthânâʼ; of similar derivation to H903;  Bigthan or Bigthana, a eunuch of Xerxes:—Bigthan, Bigthana.

H906.definition: בַּד bad, bad; perhaps from H909 (in the sense of divided fibres);  flaxen thread or yarn; hence, a linen garment:—linen.

H907.definition: בַּד bad, bad; from H908;  a brag or lie; also a liar:—liar, lie.

H909.definition: בָּדַד bâdad, baw-dad'; a primitive root;  to divide, i.e. (reflexively) be solitary:—alone.

H910.definition: בָּדָד bâdâd, baw-dawd'; from H909;  separate; adverb, separately:—alone, desolate, only, solitary.

H912.definition: בֵּדְיָה Bêdᵉyâh, bay-de-yaw'; probably a shortened form H5662; servant of Jehovah;  Bedejah, an Israelite:—Bedeiah.

H913.definition: בְּדִיל bᵉdîyl, bed-eel'; from H914;  alloy (because removed by smelting); by analogy, tin:—  plummet, tin.

H914.definition: בָּדַל bâdal, baw-dal'; a primitive root;  to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.):—(make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), × utterly.

H917.definition: בְּדָן Bᵉdân, bed-awn'; probably shortened for H5658; servile;  Bedan, the name of two Israelites:—Bedan.

H926.definition: בָּהַל bâhal, baw-hal'; a primitive root;  to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously:—be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste(-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy(-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex.

H927.definition: בְּהַל bᵉhal, be-hal'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H926;  to terrify, hasten:—in haste, trouble.

H928.definition: בֶּהָלָה behâlâh, beh-haw-law'; from H926;  panic, destruction:—terror, trouble.

H929.definition: בְּהֵמָה bᵉhêmâh, be-hay-maw'; from an unused root (probably meaning to be mute);  properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective):—beast, cattle.

H930.definition: בְּהֵמוֹת bᵉhêmôwth, be-hay-mohth'; in form a plural or H929, but really a singular of Egyptian derivation;  a water-ox, i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile-horse:—Behemoth.

H934.definition: בֹּהֶרֶת bôhereth, bo-heh'-reth; feminine active participle of the same as H925;  a whitish spot on the skin:—bright spot.

H935.definition: בּוֹא bôwʼ, bo; a primitive root;  to go or come (in a wide variety of applications):—abide, apply, attain, × be, befall,   besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, × certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, × doubtless again,   eat,   employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch,   follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant,   have, × indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, × (well) stricken (in age), × surely, take (in), way.

H936.definition: בּוּז bûwz, booz; a primitive root;  to disrespect:—contemn, despise, × utterly.

H937.definition: בּוּז bûwz, booz; from H936;  disrespect:—contempt(-uously), despised, shamed.

H938.definition: בּוּז Bûwz, booz; the same as H937;  Buz, the name of a son of Nahor, and of an Israelite:—Buz.

H944.definition: בּוּל bûwl, bool; for H2981;  produce (of the earth, etc.):—food, stock.

H945.definition: בּוּל Bûwl, bool; the same as H944 (in the sense of rain);  Bul, the eighth Hebrew month:—Bul.

H947.definition: בּוּס bûwç, boos; a primitive root;  to trample (literally or figuratively):—loath, tread (down, under (foot)), be polluted.

H948.definition: בּוּץ bûwts, boots; from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white;  probably cotton (of some sort):—fine (white) linen.

H953.definition: בּוֹר bôwr, bore; from H952 (in the sense of H877);  a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or a prison):—cistern, dungeon, fountain, pit, well.

H954.definition: בּוּשׁ bûwsh, boosh; a primitive root;  properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed:—(be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long.

H955.definition: בּוּשָׁה bûwshâh, boo-shaw'; feminine participle passive of H954;  shame:—shame.

H957.definition: בַּז baz, baz; from H962;  plunder:—booty, prey, spoil(-ed).

H958.definition: בָּזָא bâzâʼ, baw-zaw'; a primitive root;  probably to cleave:—spoil.

H959.definition: בָּזָה bâzâh, baw-zaw'; a primitive root;  to disesteem:—despise, disdain, contemn(-ptible),   think to scorn, vile person.

H961.definition: בִּזָּה bizzâh, biz-zaw'; feminine of H957;  booty:—prey, spoil.

H962.definition: בָּזַז bâzaz, baw-zaz'; a primitive root;  to plunder:—catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob(-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), × utterly.

H963.definition: בִּזָּיוֹן bizzâyôwn, biz-zaw-yone'; from H959  disesteem:—contempt.

H967.definition: בָּזַר bâzar, baw-zar'; a primitive root;  to disperse:—scatter.

H968.definition: בִּזְתָא Bizthâʼ, biz-thaw'; of Persian origin;  Biztha, a eunuch of Xerxes:—Biztha.

H970.definition: בָּחוּר bâchûwr, baw-khoor'; or בָּחֻר bâchur; participle passive of H977;  properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective):—(choice) young (man), chosen, × hole.

H972.definition: בָּחִיר bâchîyr, baw-kheer'; from H977;  select:—choose, chosen one, elect.

H973.definition: בָּחַל bâchal, baw-khal'; a primitive root;  to loath:—abhor, get hastily (from the margin for H926).

H974.definition: בָּחַן bâchan, baw-khan'; a primitive root;  to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate:—examine, prove, tempt, try (trial).

H977.definition: בָּחַר bâchar, baw-khar'; a primitive root;  properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select:—acceptable, appoint, choose (choice), excellent, join, be rather, require.

H982.definition: בָּטַח bâṭach, baw-takh'; a primitive root;  properly, to hie for refuge (but not so precipitately as H2620); figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure:—be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.

H988.definition: בָּטֵל bâṭêl, baw-tale'; a primitive root;  to desist from labor:—cease.

H989.definition: בְּטֵל bᵉṭêl, bet-ale'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H988;  to stop:—(cause, make to), cease, hinder.

H990.definition: בֶּטֶן beṭen, beh'-ten; from an unused root probably meaning to be hollow;  the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything:—belly, body,   as they be born,   within, womb.

H992.definition: בֹּטֶן bôṭen, bo'-ten; from H990;  (only in plural) a pistachio-nut (from its form):—nut.

H994.definition: בִּי bîy, bee; perhaps from H1158 (in the sense of asking); properly, a request; used only adverbially (always with 'my Lord');  oh that!; with leave, or if it please:—alas, O, oh.

H996.partOfSpeech: masculine substantive (always used as a preposition)
H996.definition: בֵּין bêyn, bane; (sometimes in the plural masculine or feminine); properly, the constructive form of an otherwise unused noun from H995; a distinction; but used only as a preposition,  between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or:—among, asunder, at, between (-twixt...and), + from (the widest), × in, out of, whether (it be...or), within.

H997.definition: בֵּין bêyn, bane; (Aramaic) corresponding to H996:—among, between.

H998.definition: בִּינָה bîynâh, bee-naw'; from H995;  understanding:—knowledge, meaning, × perfectly, understanding, wisdom.

H999.definition: בִּינָה bîynâh, bee-naw'; (Aramaic) corresponding to H998:—knowledge.
